name: Puff
shortdesc: Puff the Fractal Dragon is here, contemplating a higher reality.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The Ringwraith
shortdesc: A Ringwraith stands here.
longdesc:
Dressed in black, it is almost invisible within the shadows. It promises
to be a formidable opponent

name: The tormentor
shortdesc: The tormentor stands here.
longdesc: He sneers at you.

name: James Hetfield
shortdesc: James Hetfield stands here.
longdesc: He sneers at you.

name: The Inquisitor
shortdesc: The Inquisitor stands here.
longdesc: He sneers at you.

name: Fupp
shortdesc: Fupp the evil Fractal Dragon is here, contemplating a lower reality.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: Malcor
shortdesc: Malcor the apprentice guildmaster is standing here.
longdesc:
Wrapped in a long wooly brown toga, Malcor is only an apprentice
guildmaster.  Recently promoted, he can only assist the most junior
of guildmembers.  He looks friendly enough.

name: Khull
shortdesc: Khull the veteran is here to help (just say HELP)
longdesc:
You see a friendly old man. He looks at you, and says if you need
help, just say HELP.

name: A fire elemental
shortdesc: A huge fire burns here
longdesc: It looks vaguely man-shaped

name: A water elemental
shortdesc: A large water elemental stands here
longdesc: It looks vaguely man-shaped.

name: An earth elemental
shortdesc: A large earth elemental stands here
longdesc: It looks vaguely man-shaped.

name: An air elemental
shortdesc: A small tornado spins here
longdesc: It looks vaguely man-shaped.

name: A vrock
shortdesc: A Vrock stands here
longdesc: It is a vulture/human creature. Extremely ugly, and nasty

name: A hezrou
shortdesc: A demon Hezrou stands here.
longdesc: Not unlike A large toad/man

name: A glabrezu
shortdesc: A demon Glabrezu stands here
longdesc: I forget what this one looks like.

name: Nalfeshnee
shortdesc: Nalfeshnee stands here
longdesc: This one is big and mean looking.

name: Marilith
shortdesc: Marilith slithers here
longdesc: A woman with 6 arms and a snake's tail

name: Balor
shortdesc: Balor stands here, surrounded by electrical fire
longdesc: He is very large, and looks rather deadly

name: Vespa
shortdesc: Vespa the auctioneer is standing here glancing around the room.
longdesc: she stares back at you waiting for your bid.

name: a Dragonborne noble Leader
shortdesc: A huge multi-hued dragon stands here with a well-armored man astride it.
longdesc:
A man of clearly noble birth sits upon the back of this huge, 45-foot long
polychromatic dragon.  He surveys the area with open contempt.

name: a white Dragonborne noble
shortdesc: A huge white dragon stands here with a well-armored man astride it.
longdesc:
A man of obviously noble blood sits astride the huge white dragon, surveying
the area with open contempt.

name: a red Dragonborne noble
shortdesc: A huge red dragons stands here with a well-armored man astride it.
longdesc:
A man of obviously noble blood sits astride the huge red dragon, surveying
the area with open contempt.

name: a blue Dragonborne noble
shortdesc: A huge blue dragon stands here with a well-armored man astride it.
longdesc:
A man of obviously noble blood sits astride the huge blue dragon, surveying
the area with open contempt.

name: a brown Dragonborne noble
shortdesc: A huge brown dragon stands here with a well-armored man astride it.
longdesc:
A man of obviously noble blood sits astride the huge brown dragon, surveying
the area with open contempt.

name: a red Dragonborne soldier
shortdesc: A well-armored man and his large red dragon mount stand here.
longdesc:
The rider of this 30 foot long dragon looks about with a cold, inscrutable
gaze while his mount eyes you hungrily.

name: a white Dragonborne soldier
shortdesc: A well-armored man and his large white dragon mount stand here.
longdesc:
The rider of this 30 foot long dragon looks about with a cold, inscrutable
gaze while his mount eyes you hungrily.

name: a blue Dragonborne soldier
shortdesc: A well-armored man and his large blue dragon mount stand here.
longdesc:
The rider of this 30 foot long dragon looks about with a cold, inscrutable
gaze while his mount eyes you hungrily.

name: a brown Dragonborne soldier
shortdesc: A well-armored man and his large brown dragon mount stand here.
longdesc:
The rider of this 30 foot long dragon looks about with a cold, inscrutable
gaze while his mount eyes you hungrily.

name: a dark man
shortdesc: An unusually dark man skulks about in the shadows.
longdesc:
The man is so dark (almost pitch black!) that he blends into the
shadows amazingly well.  You _think_ you see a tattoo in the
shape of a dragon on his head, but it's hard to be certain.

name: the Prophet
shortdesc: The Prophet stands here with a fanatic gleam in his eye.
longdesc:
The Prophet of the Dragon is a small but imposing figure.  There is
a sense of both the charismatic and the mad about him.

name: the Yaelm
shortdesc: You see a very tall, willowy creature here.
longdesc:
A seven foot tall, thin humanoid.  It has pale skin, and no visible
hair apparent on its frame.  Its eyes are very large and expressive.

name: a zombie
shortdesc: A rotting zombie stands here vacantly.
longdesc:
Its eyes show no sign of intelligence, or free will. It is but the animated
flesh of a luckless being.

name: A giant troll
shortdesc: A giant troll stands here
longdesc: It looks really pissed to be in its current predicament.

name: A shark
shortdesc: A large shark swims here.
longdesc: It's a man-eating shark!

name: a goblin
shortdesc: A goblin stands here.
longdesc:
The goblin is small and pitiful looking.  He is dressed in filthy clothes,
and looks rather repulsive.

name: an orc
shortdesc: An orc stands here.
longdesc:
The orc is small and pitiful looking.  He is dressed in filthy clothes,
and looks rather repulsive.

name: a badger
shortdesc: a badger stands here.
longdesc: She is small, but moves very quickly

name: a fire beetle
shortdesc: A fire beetle stands here
longdesc: It is small, and has glowing red spots on its abdomen

name: A troglodyte
shortdesc: A small troglodyte stands here
longdesc: She smells repulsive.

name: a cow
shortdesc: A cow stands here
longdesc: She is quietly chewing her cud

name: A wild dog
shortdesc: A wild dog stands here
longdesc: He looks well, wild...

name: A giant frog
shortdesc: A giant frog stands here
longdesc: Its not easy being green.

name: A hobgoblin
shortdesc: A hobgoblin stands here
longdesc: He is fierce looking, and fairly strong

name: A large spider
shortdesc: A large spider stands here
longdesc: She is small, but moves quickly

name: a gnoll
shortdesc: A gnoll stands here, he looks mean.
longdesc:
He is dressed in yellow rags, and has a dog-like face.  He is not very much
fun to stare at like this.  People are looking at you

name: A giant beetle
shortdesc: A giant beetle stands here
longdesc: It is about 3 feet long, and looks like a sturdy fighter

name: a giant ant
shortdesc: A giant ant stands here.
longdesc: It has large mandibles, and looks like it could lift 16 times its own weight.

name: A war dog
shortdesc: A war dog stands here
longdesc: He is large, and trained to kill

name: A giant frog
shortdesc: A giant frog stands here
longdesc: It is fairly large, and tough looking.

name: A lemure
shortdesc: A lemure stands here
longdesc: It is mindless and looks pretty gross too!

name: A giant toad
shortdesc: A giant toad sits here.
longdesc:
Large and covered with warts.  Don't touch him or you'll get them too!
(heh)

name: A stirge
shortdesc: A stirge flaps about here
longdesc: Looks like an interesting cross between a mosquito and a bird.

name: A troglodyte
shortdesc: A troglodyte stands here.
longdesc: Big, ugly and really smelly

name: The human fighter
shortdesc: A human fighter stands here.
longdesc: Looks like a fairly tough fellow.

name: a bugbear
shortdesc: A bugbear stands here.
longdesc:
He is furry, and nasty.  He looks like a mean walking carpet.  You probably
don't want to piss him off.

name: A boring beetle
shortdesc: A giant boring beetle stands here.
longdesc: It has a shiny black carapace

name: A ghoul
shortdesc: A ghoul stands here.
longdesc: It smells awful!  And looks worse!

name: A giant lizard
shortdesc: A giant lizard rests here.
longdesc: It is rather large.  Could probably swallow a small child whole.

name: A wererat
shortdesc: A wererat stands here, staring at you intently.
longdesc:
It is small, but VERY quick.  A combination of rat, and man, standing
about 4'.

name: An ogre
shortdesc: An ogre stands here, grinning at you
longdesc:
He is rather large, and nasty looking.  You are well aware of his huge
muscles.  Pissing him off is not a good idea.

name: A huge spider
shortdesc: A huge spider scurries about.
longdesc:
It looks like this spider would have no problem carrying off small
children.

name: A giant tick
shortdesc: A giant tick sits here
longdesc: It looks like a nasty bloodsucker.

name: A giant weasel
shortdesc: A giant weasel scurries about.
longdesc:
It is moving so fast that all you can see is some fur, a tail and at least
4 legs.

name: A black dragon
shortdesc: A very young black dragon sits here.
longdesc: It is very small, and looks rather lost

name: A carniverous ape
shortdesc: A carniverous ape stands here.
longdesc: He looks rather hungrily back at you

name: A blink dog
shortdesc: A blink dog stand here, randomly teleporting
longdesc: He doesn't stay still long enough to get a good look at him

name: A blue dragon
shortdesc: A very young blue dragon.
longdesc: She looks lost and confused.

name: A dwarven cleric
shortdesc: A dwarven cleric stands here
longdesc: He looks rather holy.

name: A gargoyle
shortdesc: A gargoyle stands here.
longdesc: He is man-sized, and has leathery bat-like wings.

name: A ghast
shortdesc: A ghast is here.
longdesc: Ugly and smelly beyond description.

name: A werewolf
shortdesc: A werewolf stands here
longdesc: He looks viscious and evil.

name: An owlbear
shortdesc: An owlbear stands here.
longdesc: Looks like a cross between a large owl, and a large bear.

name: A shadow
shortdesc: You see a shadow on the ground.
longdesc: It doesn't look like it belongs to anyone.

name: A poisonous toad
shortdesc: A poisonous toad hops about.
longdesc: It looks fairly large, and the poison (you suspect) can be lethal.

name: An Elven assassin
shortdesc: An Elven assassin stands here.
longdesc: She is dangerous to provoke.

name: A displacer beast
shortdesc: A displacer beast stands um... somewhere
longdesc:
The displacer beast is a large cat-like creature with two large
tentacles.  It magically shifts its image, so it is hard to fight.

name: A white dragon
shortdesc: A young adult white dragon slithers about.
longdesc:
A white, lizard like creature.  Looks fairly competent, and ready to
kill

name: A leucrotta
shortdesc: A leucrotta stands here.
longdesc: A disgusting horse-like beast, with a long, forked tongue

name: A giant lizard
shortdesc: A subterranean lizard stands here
longdesc: Very large.  It could probably swallow a large child.

name: A wereboar
shortdesc: A wereboar stands here.
longdesc: It is a human/pig combo.  Rather ugly too.

name: A minotaur
shortdesc: A minotaur stands here, snorting.
longdesc: A large man with the head of a bull.. Not the type you want to mess with.

name: A two-headed snake
shortdesc: A snake slithers about here.. It has a head at either end!
longdesc: It must move about by gripping one head with the other!

name: A rattlesnake
shortdesc: A rattlesnake shakes his tail in warning.
longdesc: It is rather large for a snake... You probably want to go now...

name: A giant spider
shortdesc: A giant spider scurries about.
longdesc: It is about 8' across, including legs.

name: A carrion crawler
shortdesc: A carrion crawler searches for food here.
longdesc: It is a grotesque beast, with numerous legs, and strange tentacles

name: An erinyes
shortdesc: An erinyes is here, folding her bat wings.
longdesc: She looks like a human female...with bat wings...a tail...and horns...

name: The hydra
shortdesc: An eight-headed hydra snaps at you.. Eight times!
longdesc: It is a large, eight headed dragon-like creature.

name: The jackalwere
shortdesc: A jackalwere looks at you.. You feel sleepy
longdesc: It is a jackal-like creature, that has partially taken the shape of a man.

name: A weretiger
shortdesc: A weretiger snarls at you.
longdesc: A very large tiger/man combination...

name: a manticore
shortdesc: A manticore stands here, tail thrashing.
longdesc: It is like a lion, but with a spiked tail.

name: An ogre magi
shortdesc: An ogre magi stands here, feasting on human flesh.
longdesc: He is large, and vaguely oriental.

name: An otyugh
shortdesc: An otyugh squats here, tentacles flailing.
longdesc: It looks like the word sounds... UGLY.

name: a hill giant
shortdesc: A rather large humanoid stands here, picking his teeth
longdesc:
He is about 10 feet tall, maybe 12.  He carries a spear that is substantially
taller than you are.

name: a troll
shortdesc: A green-skinned troll is here.  He smells disgusting.
longdesc:
He is about 7 feet tall.  He carries no weapons, but his breath is strong
enough to kill trees.

name: a werewolf
shortdesc: A furry wolfman is here.  He snarls at you.
longdesc:
He is 5' tall, because he has horrible posture.  He is a swift, and merciless
fighter.

name: a goblin
shortdesc: A goblin stands here.
longdesc: Actually, now that you think about it, he's pretty tough!

name: The hydra
shortdesc: A sixteen-headed hydra snaps at you.. sixteen times!
longdesc: It is a large, sixteen headed dragon-like creature.

name: the capitalist
shortdesc: A capitalist.
longdesc: A young capitalist, who still has lots to learn.

name: the bodyguard
shortdesc: A bodyguard stands here.
longdesc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

name: the Dark Knight
shortdesc: A Dark Knight stands here
longdesc: You see nothing special..

name: the White Knight
shortdesc: A White Knight stands here
longdesc: You see nothing special..

name: the thug
shortdesc: A thug stands here.
longdesc: you see nothing special

name: The Dark Lord
shortdesc: A Lord of Darkness stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special...

name: The Light Lord
shortdesc: A Lord of Light stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special...

name: a baby shadow Dragon
shortdesc: The baby Shadow Dragon is here, wondering how flesh would taste.
longdesc:
The baby Shadow Dragon has huge white scales on its body which are hard as steel.
It dosent look as if it were an easy kill.

name: The giant, purple sand worm
shortdesc: A giant, purple sand worm wants to eat you.
longdesc: He's EXTREMELEY big, mean, and purple. Watch out!

name: The sand worm
shortdesc: The young sandworm launches towards you!
longdesc:
It is about 50 feet long, and looks very dangerous.  Better
flee!

name: The Drow commoner
shortdesc: A drow commoner walks around on guard duty.
longdesc: I doubt he is the type to give directions.

name: The drow warrior noble
shortdesc: The drow warrior noble stands here guarding his home.
longdesc: He looks kind of p.o.ed!

name: The elven commoner
shortdesc: An elven commoner walks around on guard duty.
longdesc: I doubt he is the type to give directions.

name: The elven warrior noble
shortdesc: The elven warrior noble stands here guarding his home.
longdesc: He looks kind of p.o.ed!

name: The yochlol
shortdesc: A yochlol forms out of a swirling mist.
longdesc: The yochlol is not in a good mood.

name: The beholder
shortdesc: You meet a beholder's gaze!
longdesc:
It has a large central eye that projects an anti-magic ray and ten
eyestalks atop the round body which can do anything from charm you
to disintegrate you.  Beholders are not known for their personality.

name: The lamia
shortdesc: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
longdesc:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

name: The stone golem
shortdesc: A Huge stone golem stands here.  Much bigger than you are used to seeing.
longdesc: He looks like he belongs on other worlds.

name: The iron golem
shortdesc: A Gigantic iron golem stands here.  He raises his sword to strike you.
longdesc: He looks VERY mean

name: A Polar Bear
shortdesc: A giant white polar bear is here.
longdesc: He looks VERY mean.

name: The Vampiress
shortdesc: A vampiress stands here
longdesc: Lovely in every detail, but Lethal!

name: the Elite Guardsman
shortdesc: The Elite Guardsman is standing here.
longdesc: Not as big as a royal guard, but still rather large

name: the Elite Badguy
shortdesc: The Elite Badguy is standing here.
longdesc: Not as big as a royal guard, but still rather large

name: the Player killer
shortdesc: The Player Killer eyes you and wonders how much exp you're worth.
longdesc: He does not look like a fun encounter

name: the purple enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a purple suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the yellow enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a yellow suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the black enfan
shortdesc:
There is a positively evil enfan in front of you. He is dressed in black and
  carries a large weapon.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: The huge bartender
shortdesc:
A huge, ugly bartender is here pouring beer, he grins a demented grin as you
  walk in.
longdesc:
On his left shoulder is a metal armband with the symbol of Chaos engraved
upon it. "What today, member?", he says.

name: Mel
shortdesc: Mel the Demoted Imp from PukeMud (Judy) is standing here
longdesc:
Mel looks like he is thinking of more ways to piss off his players on JudyMud
and make the monsters even more impossible to kill.

name: Roo
shortdesc: Roo the BrownNoser from PukeMud is standing here
longdesc:
Roo is looking for mel so she can tell on someone or maybe just so she can
see how his butt smells today.

name: the Elven Wizard
shortdesc: An Elven Wizard is here, creating fireworks for the festivities.
longdesc:
The Elven Wizard looks at you in a solemn sort of way.  His gaze seems
penetrate through your innermost being.  He is wearing a silvery cloak
and holding a multi-coloured staff.  Although he appears to be older
than the oldest man, he seems to have an inner strength which most mortals
cannot overcome.

name: the Keeper of the Ring
shortdesc: The Keeper of the Ring is here, guarding his treasure jealously.
longdesc:
The Ring Keeper is a rather big but short halfling.  His short stature and
bulbous nose belie his true nature.  An elven sword that glows with a blue
light hangs from his belt, and on his finger you see the One Ring.  Although
usually a halfling of peace, he will fight you to the death if you attempt
to take away that which belongs to him.

name: Farmer Gamgee
shortdesc: Farmer Gamgee sniffs the air, wondering if harvest time is near.
longdesc:
Farmer Gamgee is a short, stout halfling of thirty years.  His skin has
been tanned from working the fields night and day.  He's quite a jolly
chap, always ready to befriend an injured bunny rabbit.

name: a toddler
shortdesc: A toddler crawls about, looking for something to chew on.
longdesc:
The toddler is dressed in nothing but his birthday suit.  He crawls about
for he hasn't learned to walk yet.  He peers up at you and asks "da da?

name: a nursemaid
shortdesc: A nursemaid wanders about, trying to keep track of all the toddlers.
longdesc:
The nursemaid looks rather tired and worn out.  Taking care of so many
toddlers for too long has evidently taken its toll.  She looks to you and
in her eyes you can see her longing for a better life.

name: a cow
shortdesc: A cow is here, chewing her cud.
longdesc:
The cow looks like it hasn't been milked in quite some time.  Although she
is past her prime, you see that she still has a lot of years left, and that
if provoked, her rear kick can be quite deadly.

name: a pig
shortdesc: A pig wallows in the mud and oinks in contentment.
longdesc:
The pig appears quite happy to be a pig.  He is oblivious to your presence
and cares only for the care-free life that he leads.  It is enormously fat
and consequently cannot move around very quickly.

name: a chicken
shortdesc: A chicken sits on her nest.
longdesc: The chicken is bright and healthy.  She has no weapons but her beak.

name: a bull
shortdesc: A bull scratches at the ground and lowers his head.
longdesc:
The bull is in top condition.  He looks like quite a fighter, nothing to be
reckoned with.  With his horns and his hooves he can attack just about
anything.

name: a horse
shortdesc: A horse becomes frightened by your presence.
longdesc: The horse looks at you and turns away.  You can tell that it is afraid of you.

name: a shiriff Ryas
shortdesc: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff-raff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.

name: a shiriff Theron
shortdesc: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff raff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.

name: the Thain
shortdesc: The Thain commands respect from all Shire folk.
longdesc:
A personable yet serious halfling, the Thain looks at you and yells a
deep 'Hullo'.  He walks about comfortably, secure in the knowledge that
as long as he's in office, the Shire will always remain a safe haven for
Shire folk.

name: the Innkeeper
shortdesc: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
longdesc:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveller.

name: the Miller
shortdesc: The Miller is here, overseeing his busy mill workers.
longdesc:
The Miller is an impatient young halfling, always trying to command more
respect from his workers than he can get.  He looks like the type of person
who deserves a spanking but never got one.

name: the mill worker
shortdesc: The mill worker runs to and fro.
longdesc:
The mill worker is in fine shape from the hard labor that he does at the
mill.  He doesn't notice your presence, but he looks like he could break you
in two without thinking about it.

name: the elven warrior
shortdesc: The elven warrior watches you solemnly.
longdesc:
The tall elven warrior is light and fair-skinned.  The expression that he wears
on his countenance is solemn and tragic.  He cares not for this world any
longer and wearies of it.

name: the dwarven prince
shortdesc: The dwarven prince sits here patiently for the return of his king.
longdesc:
Grim and cold, the dwarven prince is quite strong and bulky, even for the
dwarves of his land.  His glowing eyes peer out of his bushy face and stare
beyond your gaze.

name: the shopkeeper
shortdesc: the shopkeeper smiles and patiently waits for you to buy something.
longdesc:
The shopkeeper will fight like a madman to protect his store from riff-raff
like you.

name: the grocer
shortdesc: The grocer offers you the finest breads in all the land.
longdesc:
The grocer is a large, jovial halfling who knows how to enjoy his pipeweed.
However, he also knows that it's worth protecting and so will do everything
in his power to prevent riff-raff like you from stealing it.

name: Shammy the Shopkeeper
shortdesc: Shammy the Shopkeeper bids you welcome to his humble store.
longdesc:
Shammy is a lean and mean fighting machine.  His knowledge of weapons
and armour would certainly help him in any fight against riff-raff like you.

name: the battle master
shortdesc: The battle master offers you the services of his fine trainees.
longdesc: The battle master is a wizened fighter, with many scars to prove his worth.

name: a halfling youth
shortdesc: A halfling youth stands here, waiting for nothing in particular.
longdesc:
The halfling youth is not yet quite in the prime of his youth.  He's knee
high and you get the sudden urge to step on him.

name: a seasoned adventurer
shortdesc: A seasoned adventurer sits here, telling tales of fame and fortune.
longdesc:
The seasoned adventurer has seen his share of glory days.  Although he is
past his prime, he still looks like he could put up more than his share of
a good fight.

name: a local gossip
shortdesc: A local gossip asks you, "Have you heard the latest?
longdesc:
The gossip is all talk and no action.  You're transfixed by her ability to
talk so much so quickly.

name: a halfling beauty
shortdesc: A halfling beauty stares dreamily into your eyes.
longdesc:
She is the most beautiful creature you've seen in quite some time.  As you
stare at her, thoughts of all else vanish.  You get the sudden urge to grovel
at her feet, hoping she'll take you in like a lost puppy.  You wouldn't dare
harm a hair on her precious little head.

name: a trainee
shortdesc: A trainee screams a death cry as he delivers the fatal blow to a dummy.
longdesc:
The trainee smiles smugly, aware of your interest in him.  He's a little
fresh, but his enthusiasm and desire to please more than make up for what
he lacks in skill.

name: a chic urbanite
shortdesc: A chic urbanite sits here, enjoying his class status.
longdesc:
The urbanite seems very much at home in his surroundings.  His clothes are
all of the latest fashions and his manners impeccable.  He offers you some
coins if you'd be so good as to order a drink for him.

name: a country bumpkin
shortdesc: A country bumpkin dreams of pipeweed and its many uses.
longdesc: The country bumpkin snores noisily.

name: the Innkeeper
shortdesc: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
longdesc:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveller.

name: the receptionist
shortdesc: The receptionist sits here, signing forms.
longdesc: He is a very professional looking type.

name: a shiriff Anash
shortdesc: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff raff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.

name: a shiriff Pim
shortdesc: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff raff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.

name: a shiriff Morche
shortdesc: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff raff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.

name: The Rook
shortdesc: A Rook is standing here.
longdesc:
A tall knight of Canticle.  The Rook, a veteran of many holy wars is
dressed in golden armour.

name: The Old Frump
shortdesc: An Old Frump sweeps past you.
longdesc:
An old Frump stands here cleaning up.  The ugly hag appears to be at least
100 years old.  She looks at you with a scowl.

name: The Gargon
shortdesc: The Gargon stands here mixing the brew.
longdesc:
The kitchen witch is a horrible sight.  She is filthy and covered with
warts.  The witch looks ready to cast a spell.

name: The Blue Rook
shortdesc: The Blue Rook is sitting here at this desk.
longdesc: A grand knight.  He looks extremely strong, and glows with a blue haze.

name: The Sentinel
shortdesc: The Sentinel stands at his post.
longdesc: A stolid, stoic soldier.  He glares icily at the surrounding area.

name: The Demiwolf
shortdesc: A Demiwolf skulks here, guarding the entrance.
longdesc: A viscious wolf grinds its teeth and growls at you.

name: The Overlord
shortdesc: The Overlord stands here.
longdesc:
A great Demi-God, the Overlord.  His eyes flicker gold and his face is pure
bronze.  He tells you it would be wise to leave now.

name: The Moorbeast
shortdesc: The Moorbeast is here, looking hungry.
longdesc:
A terrible moorbeast, half-human, half-wolf, half-crazed.  It's eyes are
golden and feral.  It wants to eat you!

name: The Dark Rook
shortdesc: The Dark Rook is imprisoned.
longdesc: A dark knight.  He has been imprisoned for unimaginable crimes.

name: The Edifican Rook
shortdesc: The Edifican Rook is sitting here reading.
longdesc: A grand knight.  He looks extremely strong, and glows with a booky haze.

name: the Demogrogridon
shortdesc: The terrifying, tentacled, demogrogridon is here, waving a spoon.
longdesc:
Goddess of Frumps, terror of the kitchen, wielder of the ladle!  She is
as terrifying as a tentacled squid beast can be whilst waving a large
spoon.

name: the black Rook
shortdesc: A black rook stands here, prepared for battle.
longdesc: It reminds of you a stone golem, but quite a bit smaller.

name: the black Knight
shortdesc: There is a scraggly knight dressed in black here.
longdesc: This is most certainly not the Black Knight of legendary fame.

name: the black Bishop
shortdesc: There is a bishop dressed in black standing here.
longdesc: Hmm, maybe it's an arch bishop.  Or an arch arch bishop.

name: the black Queen
shortdesc: There is a queen dressed in black standing here.
longdesc: She looks rather fearsome.

name: the black King
shortdesc: The King, Ruler of Darkness, is standing here.
longdesc:
He is a far cry from the white haired wizened old man you might expect.  It
looks as though he could put up a good fight.

name: the black Pawn
shortdesc: A statuesque black pawn stands here.
longdesc:
Though this scrawny fighter is not an impressive sight, he is obedient to his
master.

name: The Mini Mindflayer
shortdesc: The mini mindflayer is here, looking at you with a... well, some kind of look.
longdesc:
It's a three foot tall humanoid that seems rather menacing for its size.
In the middle of its head are four tentacles with sharp points.

name: The Curser
shortdesc: The Curser is here, muttering incomprehensible obscenities to the air.
longdesc:
It is short stocky guy dressed in clashing colors, spewing gutteral sounds
and interjections continuously.

name: The Cow
shortdesc: A hard-eyed cow is here, going about his business.
longdesc:
He is walking around purposefully, as if searching for something,
occasionally lowering his head, sniffing at the air, then eating
pieces of the ground that are apparently somewhat grassy.  When he
notices your intense scrutiny, he looks at you coldly, until you are
forced to look away.

name: Net Lag
shortdesc: Net Lag cuts your link, throws his head back, and cackles with insane glee!
longdesc:
As you try to peer into his beady eyes, you feel your sense of time slowing,
slowing, slowing....

name: The young sapling, walking on dainty roots
shortdesc: A sapling stands here eye to eye with you.
longdesc: Its roots are rather petite, and small parts of them are above ground.

name: The Jugglernaut
shortdesc: A Jugglernaut is here, juggling madly.
longdesc:
It is kind of large, some 10 yds in length, walking on several hundred
tiny legs. It is metallic-looking, with large spots of corrosion
marring its angular skin. On its sides are large signs, written in an
incomprehensible language. On its top, a small eye cluster swivels back
and forth continually.  A number of tentacles are juggling a dizzying
blur of objects.

name: The Mutterfly
shortdesc: An ugly butterfly-like thing is here, muttering about its problems.
longdesc: it is ugly, and unfriendly

name: The banana peel
shortdesc: There is a magical banana peel here.
longdesc:
It seems harmless enough, although according to ancient legend, they
cause people to slip and fall.

name: the white Pawn
shortdesc: A statuesque white pawn stands here.
longdesc:
Though this scrawny fighter is not an impressive sight, he is obedient to his
master.

name: the white Rook
shortdesc: A white rook stands here, prepared for battle.
longdesc:
It reminds of you a stone golem, but quite a bit smaller.  He matches the
white marble quite nicely.

name: the white Knight
shortdesc: There is a scraggly knight dressed in white here.
longdesc: You're not so sure that you'd want *him* to come to your rescue.

name: the white Bishop
shortdesc: There is a bishop dressed in white standing here.
longdesc: Hmm, maybe it's an arch bishop.  Or an arch arch bishop.

name: the white Queen
shortdesc: There is a queen dressed in white standing here.
longdesc: She looks rather fearsome.

name: the white King
shortdesc: The King, Protector of the Flame, is standing here.
longdesc:
He is a far cry from the white haired wizened old man you might expect.  It
looks as though he could put up a good fight.

name: The Jabberwocky
shortdesc: The Jabberwocky stands here, prepared to maul you.
longdesc: It is big, and alien in appearance.  Probably not here for a cup of tea.

name: A pair of Medics
shortdesc: A pair of Medics is here, looking for someone to help.
longdesc: Not only are they identical twins, but they do everything in perfect unison.

name: The Flame
shortdesc: The Flame hovers here before you.
longdesc:
The Flame flickers almost imperceptibly about you.  You can barely feel the
warmth, so gentle is The Flame.

name: A Delivery Beast
shortdesc: A Delivery Beast is here, sleeping on the job.
longdesc:
Well, it looks beastly.  And oily.  It's black, and shiny, and oozes
slime as it goes...hard to be more specific than that.

name: An Oil Beast
shortdesc: An Oil Beast is here, working quasi-diligently.
longdesc:
Well, it looks beastly.  And oily.  It's black, and shiny, and oozes
slime as it goes...hard to be more specific than that.

name: The Delivery Elf
shortdesc: An Elf is here, making deliveries for the Market Plaza Bakery.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: An Elf
shortdesc: An Elf is here, working diligently.
longdesc: He looks busy.

name: The Cheshire Cat
shortdesc: The Cheshire Cat flashes a grin at you.
longdesc:
Looks like the obligatory invisible monster for this area.  He has that
confident, artificial smile that means he knows too much about you.

name: The Pigeon
shortdesc: A plump pigeon is wandering here, oblivious to your presence.
longdesc: Dinner on the table....

name: Sisyphus
shortdesc: Sisyphus of Corinth stands here, guarding the gate.
longdesc:
The once tyrannical King of Corinth has been consigned to barring
unqualified characters from entering the Tower.  A Sisyphean task indeed.

name: A shadow guardian
shortdesc: A shadow guardian screams a challenge and attacks
longdesc: It seems to made of nothing more than darkness...

name: A lost adventurer
shortdesc: An emaciated adventurer is here looking lost and hopeless
longdesc: He looks haggard and sickly, no doubt he's been lost here for quite some time.

name: Edgar
shortdesc: Edgar the Human Swordpupil
longdesc:
Edgar says 'pardon me, can you tell me where to buy cups?'

You see before you, one of Midgaard's finest fighting elite, the mighty
bunny slayer himself, Edgar the horrible!

name: The golem
shortdesc: A huge diamond golem is standing guard here
longdesc: It looks quite strong

name: A mage
shortdesc: A young mage wanders about, oblivious to all
longdesc:
He seems to be contemplating life, love and the mysteries of the universe,
then again, he may just have a headache.

name: Strick the bartender
shortdesc: Strick is here levetating drinks to his customers
longdesc: He looks rather harmless, but then again so does a sleeping dragon.

name: Tatorious
shortdesc: Tatorious the wizard is here counting his earnings
longdesc: Tatorious winks at you mischeviously.

name: Ezmerelda
shortdesc: Ezmerelda the cook is here stiring a larg pot of something
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The cook's assistant
shortdesc: The cook's assistant is here assisting the cook
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The prisoner
shortdesc: A prisoner is chained to the wall here
longdesc:
Though his clothes are all in rags, you can see that at one time they must
have been fine garments. A metal muzzle has been fitted over the poor
wretch's mouth, wether to keep him from screaming, or to silence his spell
casting you cannot tell.
He looks quite mad, no doubt he's been mistreated horribly.

name: The Jailor
shortdesc: The Jailor is here enjoying a comfortable nap
longdesc: He looks rather dirty.

name: A broom
shortdesc: A straw broom is here leaning against the wall
longdesc: The broom screams 'Take that you lout!'

name: A pair of disembodied hands
shortdesc: A pair of disembodied hands floats in the air here
longdesc: The hands twitch witch anticipation of strangling someone.

name: A pair of disembodied eyes
shortdesc: A pair of disembodied eyes floats here glaring at you
longdesc: The eyes smolder with hatred.

name: The mage
shortdesc: A visiting mage is here snoring away in peaceful slumber
longdesc: He looks quite sleepy

name: A young apprentice magic user
shortdesc: A young apprentice magic user is here doing magical studies
longdesc: She looks quite intent on her studies

name: A young apprentice
shortdesc: A young apprentice is here mumbling words of magic to himself
longdesc: He looks to be oblivious to all but the spell he is memorizing.

name: A young apprentice
shortdesc: A young apprentice is sleeping here
longdesc: He seems to be dreaming

name: A young apprentice
shortdesc: A young apprentice is here teasing a cornered kitten
longdesc: He looks like a mischevious youth

name: A small kitten
shortdesc: A small kitten is here meowing in terror
longdesc:
The little ball of fur looks very unhappy, singed fur and a few minor burns
mark its mottled coat.

name: A student
shortdesc: A sudent of spells is here looking quite bored
longdesc: The student yawns.

name: An instructor of magic
shortdesc: The instructor screams at your interruption and attacks you
longdesc: He looks quite angry at your interruption

name: A student of spells
shortdesc: A student of spells is here trying to master invisibility
longdesc: He blinks in and out of existance, trying to master the spell.

name: A spell teacher
shortdesc: A spell teacher screams at your interuption and attacks
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A student of spells
shortdesc: A student of spells has fallen asleep at her desk here
longdesc: She looks to have collapsed from sheer boredom.

name: A wizard
shortdesc: An old wizard is here making a speach
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A young mage
shortdesc: A young mage is here learning hand to hand combat
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The battle mistress
shortdesc: The battle mistress is here teaching the fine uses of a dagger
longdesc:
She looks quite rugged. In fact, she more resembles a warrior than a magic
user.

name: A spell teacher
shortdesc: A spell teacher is here relaxing
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: An aged wizard
shortdesc: An aged wizard is sleeping here
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A scribe
shortdesc: A scribe is here working on some manuscripts
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A scribe
shortdesc: A scribe is here working diligently on some translations
longdesc:
She looks quite cute, too bad her only interest seems to be the words of
lore she is translating.

name: The master scribe
shortdesc: The master scribe is here looking a little upset
longdesc:
He seems to be so old, his skin has become nothing but a giant wrinkle.
The master scribe screams 'How dare you interrupt my important work???'

name: The scribe's assistant
shortdesc: The scribe's assistant is here folding parchments
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The Enchanter
shortdesc: The Enchanter is here placing a dweomer upon well made sword
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A dancing sword
shortdesc: An well crafted sword lies on the work table here
longdesc: It looks quite sharp.

name: The Mad Alchemist
shortdesc: The Mad Alchemist babbles something un-comprehensible and attacks
longdesc:
He looks like he's been quaffing too many potions. His eyes dart around
wildly, and he starts to drool.

The Mad Alchemist throws back his head and cackles with insane glee!

name: The master summoner
shortdesc: The master summoner is here holding gateways open to other planes
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The master charmer
shortdesc: The master charmer utters the words, 'uuuzzldctz'
longdesc: The master charmer sizes you up, always looking for a new pet.

name: A wooden golem
shortdesc: A wooden golem stands a silent vigil here, guarding the stairs
longdesc: He looks flamable

name: The master spell binder
shortdesc: The master spell binder is here re-charging a blackened wand
longdesc: The master spell binder snarls at you and attacks.

name: The golem maker
shortdesc: The golem maker is here chiseling some stone
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A granite golem
shortdesc: A granite golem stands here waiting to do its master's bidding
longdesc: It looks like a statue, until you see it shamble towards you.

name: A bronze golem
shortdesc: A bronze golem stands here shining in the light
longdesc: He looks rather dim witted.

name: A flesh golem
shortdesc: A flesh golem stands guard here
longdesc:
It looks to be made of a mix match of different body parts, some don't even
resemble anything human.

name: A cloth golem
shortdesc: A cloth golem wanders around here
longdesc: It looks like a bunch of old rags, quite supprising it can actually walk.

name: An adamantite golem
shortdesc: An adamantite golem stands here looking very dangerous
longdesc:
It seems to be forged of dark metal. It looks both incredibly strong, and
durrable, but somewhat un-intelligent.

name: A clay golem
shortdesc: A clay golem stands guard here
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The master of illusions
shortdesc: An enormous multi-colored three-headed dragon growls at you
longdesc:
The image of an ugly dragon flickers slightly, and where the dragon was
now stands a small harmless looking old man.

name: The Necromancer
shortdesc: The Necromancer is here raising undead servants
longdesc:
Attired all in black, the Necromancer is tall and gangly, but still quite
an imposing figure. A dark cowl shrouds most of his face, but two blazing
embers which must serve as eyes can be seen through the shadow.
The Necromancer shrieks some obsenities and orders his minions to attack.

name: An animated skeleton
shortdesc: An animated skeleton screams silently and attacks
longdesc: It seems to feel no pain, and hacks at you ruthlessly

name: An undead giant
shortdesc: An undead giant lumbers towards you
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: An ugly witch
shortdesc: An ugly witch is here scrying out secrets
longdesc:
She has no face at all, just blank skin, rather disturbing. From about where
her mouth should be, comes a disgusting giggling sound that makes your skin
crawl with revulsion.

name: The Librarian
shortdesc: The Librarian has fallen asleep at his desk here
longdesc: He looks like a rather peaceful old man.

name: The master's apprentice
shortdesc: The master's apprentice leaps to halt your passage
longdesc:
A powerful wizard in his own right, the apprentice of the master of balance
has given up his station in the mageguild hierarchy in order to serve the
great master in hopes of gleaning secrets one could never hope to uncover
alone.

name: A grey cat
shortdesc: A grey cat is lounging lazily here
longdesc:
The grey cat cocks an ear towards you, sensing your scrutiny, then purrs
contentedly.
It looks rather harmless, untill you notice its very large claws.

name: The master of Neutrality
shortdesc: The master of Neutrality stands here contemplating the balance of the universe
longdesc: He looks quite peaceful.

name: A black robed apprentice
shortdesc: A black robed apprentice jumps from the shadows and attacks
longdesc:
She bears a wicked looking scar down the side of her face, though once she
must have been beautiful, now the scar combined with what seems to be a
permenent scowl make her looks quite fearsome.

name: A black cat
shortdesc: A black cat with its fur up hisses at you
longdesc:
It looks both mean and dangerous, petting seems to be completely out of
the question.

name: The master of the black robes
shortdesc: The master of the black robes is here plotting vile deeds
longdesc: The master glares at you.

name: A white robed apprentice
shortdesc: A white robed apprentice screams at your desecration of goodness
longdesc:
He looks like a fanatic.
The apprentice screams 'Thou art unworthy of this honor!'

name: A white cat
shortdesc: A white cat is here preening its fur
longdesc: It seems to be nothing more than a large ball of fluf with claws.

name: The master of goodness
shortdesc: The master of goodness is here frowning at your intrusion
longdesc: He looks like a self rightious bastard.

name: A chalico cat
shortdesc: A large chalico cat is here
longdesc:
It looks incredibly large for a cat, no doubt a giant of its species.
A beautiful jewel encrusted colar about its neck is its only adornments.

name: The Grand Master
shortdesc: The Grand Master of Magic is sitting here
longdesc:
She looks quite comfortable on her emerald throne. Amazingly young and
pretty for one of such stature in the mageguild, no doubt she has kept her
youthful appearance through the use of strong magics.
The Grand Master pets her familiar and smiles at you in confidence.

name: A wizard
shortdesc: A wandering wizard is here mumbling to himself
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: Marduk
shortdesc: Marduk relaxes comfortably in the throne, seemingly content.
longdesc:
Marduk new lord of the tower of sorcery, once a student here. He
  was once a potention successor to be the new Grand Master of Magic
  being the most powerful student ever to have undergone training
  here. However patience was never his strong suite and Marduk
  murdered his old teacher, with him gone there are none powerful
  enough among these walls to stop him. His skin is a deep blue and
  his ears pointed. His hair is a silvery gray and tied with a cord
  in the back.

name: Millena
shortdesc: Millena the instructor of dark magics, studies the sigils.
longdesc:
Millena, right hand to Marduk is a powerful enchantress, master
  of fire and knowledgeable in all the dark arts. She is an amazon
  of a woman, powerfully built. she is wrapped in leathers from feet
  to head all black.

name: Brogh
shortdesc: Brogh Themis, diplomat of Marduk is here keeping the peace.
longdesc:
Brogh Themis, a wise mage longs for peace. His body marked from battles
  of his youth. He has learned much over the years in the arts of war,
  but even more the benefits of peace. He lectures his students on the
  benefits of diplomacy, and negotiation.

name: Stella
shortdesc: Stella the white wizard, misses the old ways she seems to be plotting something.
longdesc:
Stella was the greatest student of the previous master of goodness.
  Her powers eclipsing even his. She is wrapped in flowing robes, her
  hair auburn and her eyes a deep green. Her skin seems pale. Her look
  is distraught, and she plots on how to restore the tower to
  its former balance.

name: Zriophent the Doomwhisper
shortdesc: The decaying corpse that is Zriophent the Doomwhisper is here, summoning his undead minions.
longdesc:
In life, Zriophent was a powerful necromancer.  He earned his nickname,
the Doomwhisper, when he was insulted by a township and sent a powerful
spell their way that whispered to all the dead in the local graveyard so
that at night they rose up and destroyed the living and when the last of
the townfolk was killed the undead destroyed the town brick by brick,
sending it back in to the dirt as if it had never existed before.  Now,
long dead but still full of vital energy, the Doomwhisper continues his
work in the Tower of Sorcery, creating undead and advising the Grand
Master of Magick in any way he can.

name: An animated zombie
shortdesc: An animated zombie shuffles towards you mumbling something about 'Braaaiiins!'
longdesc: It is a life-less corpse given... Umm... Life.

name: An animated ghoul
shortdesc: A disgusting animated ghoul shrieks as it rushes towards you!
longdesc: This animated cadaver is looks like it will leave you with a nasty disease if it touches you!

name: Malfarious the Grandmaster Lich
shortdesc: Malfarious the Lichmaster hovers here, full of malicious intent.
longdesc:
Malfarious is a Lich.  That's right.  He is the skeletal remains of a long-dead
mage of such power that he was able to cheat death and continue on with singular
purpose.  In life he was part of a cabal of powerful mages, all of whom built
this very tower of sorcery.

name: Glamdin the White Lich
shortdesc: Glamdin the White Lich preserves the balance here.
longdesc:
In life Glamdin was a power wizard who fought hard for the forces of good and
right in war without end.  He made a pact with three other power wizards to
create a balance where all could be equal.  He was one of the founders of this
very Tower of Sorcery.

name: Cissero the Grey Lich
shortdesc: Cissero the Grey Lich works his magics here.
longdesc:
Cissero was once considered the most powerful of all wizards in life.  In death,
it is not so much different.  Although he mostly just glowing energy and long
dead bone and sinew, he is still able to command a mighty presence.  He was one
of the original founders of this very Tower of Sorcery.

name: Ameris the Black Lich
shortdesc: Ameris the Black Lich brews up trouble here.
longdesc:
Ameris was once a beautiful and powerful wizard, easily besting her male
counterparts in all arenas - from golem building to fireballs at noon.
In death, her power has intensified!  She was one of the original founders
of this very Tower of Sorcery.

name: the Statue of Buntastein
shortdesc: A gigantic statue of the Tower of Sorcery founder Buntastein is here
longdesc:
This is a gigantic statue of the Tower of Sorcery, and first grand master,
Buntastein.  Wearing wizardly robes, a pointed hat with stars and glitter
on it, and curly-toed shoes, he sure does look the part.  He holds a staff
in one hand and a book of power in the other!  He is made of granite and
is probably really tough.

name: Bandits Monk 3rd Class
shortdesc: A Bandits Monk stands here praying.
longdesc: He looks like he is at peace with the world.

name: Bandits Monk 2nd Class
shortdesc: A Bandits Monk stands here praying.
longdesc: He looks like he is at peace with the world.

name: Bandits Monk 1st Class
shortdesc: A Bandits Monk stands here praying.
longdesc: He looks like he is at peace with the world.

name: A marauder
shortdesc: A marauder is here.
longdesc:
The marauder looks desceptively human.  But there is no hint of
intelligence - he is just a rapacious beast.

name: A hyena
shortdesc: A snarling hyena is here.
longdesc:
The hyena is pack animal.  She is rather helpless alone, but can
be trouble in a large group.

name: Aello, the First Harpy
shortdesc: Aello, the First Harpy, is here
longdesc:
A harpy has the head and body of a woman, with the wings, legs, and
talons of a bird of prey.

name: Ocypete, the Second Harpy
shortdesc: Ocypete, the Second Harpy, is here
longdesc:
A harpy has the head and body of a woman, with the wings, legs, and
talons of a bird of prey.

name: Celeno, the Third Harpy
shortdesc: Celeno, the Third Harpy, is here
longdesc:
A harpy has the head and body of a woman, with the wings, legs, and
talons of a bird of prey.

name: The Statue of Hades
shortdesc: A lifelike statue of Hades, the ruler of the underworld, is here
longdesc: a statue

name: Stheno, the First Gorgon
shortdesc: Stheno, the First Gorgon, is here
longdesc:
A gorgon is a creature with snakes for hair, and that is not the end
of her charms.

name: Euryale, the Second Gorgon
shortdesc: Euryale, the Second Gorgon, is here
longdesc:
A gorgon is a creature with snakes for hair, and that is not the end
of her charms.

name: Medusa, the Third Gorgon
shortdesc: Medusa, the Third Gorgon, is here.
longdesc:
A gorgon is a creature with snakes for hair, and that is not the end
of her charms.

name: the monoceros
shortdesc: The monoceros is here.
longdesc:
The monoceros is a close relative to the unicorn, and is a noble
beast.

name: Alecto, the First Fury
shortdesc: Alecto, the First Fury, is here.
longdesc:
The furies where born of the blood of the wounded Uranus, attendants
of Proserpina.  Their heads are wreathed with serpents.

name: Tisiphone, the Second Fury
shortdesc: Tisiphone, the Second Fury, is here.
longdesc:
The furies where born of the blood of the wounded Uranus, attendants
of Proserpina.  Their heads are wreathed with serpents.

name: Megaera, the Third Fury
shortdesc: Megaera, the Third Fury, is here.
longdesc:
The furies where born of the blood of the wounded Uranus, attendants
of Proserpina.  Their heads are wreathed with serpents.

name: The Lesser God Aeacus
shortdesc: Aeacus, a lesser god of the underworld, is here.
longdesc: During his earthly life, Aeacus was King of Aegina.

name: The Lesser God Radamanthus
shortdesc: Radamanthus, a lesser god of the underworld, is here.
longdesc: Radamanthus is a mystery.

name: The Lesser God Minos
shortdesc: Minos, a lesser god of the underworld, is here.
longdesc: During his earthly life, Minos was the King of Crete.

name: a hound of Hades
shortdesc: One of the hounds of Hades is here, howling.
longdesc: The hound is fearsome, with large teeth, and eyes that glow yellow.

name: Hecate
shortdesc: Hecate, the Goddess of Sorcery and Witchcraft, is here.
longdesc: Hecate was rumored to be visible only to dogs.

name: Proserpina
shortdesc: Proserpina, the Queen of the Underworld, is wandering about.
longdesc:
Proserpina looks unhappy.  Perhaps because Hades abducted her from
her garden and brought her to the Underworld?

name: Hades
shortdesc: Hades, the King of the Underworld, is standing here.
longdesc: Hades fears nobody, save perhaps Zeus.

name: a eunuch
shortdesc: A eunuch is milling about.
longdesc: The eunuch was brought here to help (guard?) Proserpina.

name: Hypnos
shortdesc: Hypnos, the God of Dreams, is here.
longdesc: Hypnos may be kindest of the gods of the underworld.

name: a larger hound of Hades
shortdesc: One of the larger hounds of Hades is here, howling loudly.
longdesc: The hound is fearsome, with huge teeth, and eyes that glow.

name: The 50 Headed Hydra
shortdesc: The 50 Headed Hydra is here, gyrating, screaming, snorting, salivating...
longdesc: It's a lot to look at.

name: Cerberus
shortdesc: A ferocious multi-headed hound is here.
longdesc:
A ferocious lion-like beast with three heads and burning tail paces
before you.  A swirling mass of snakes make up the manes on each of
the heads, as its fanged jaws all snap in unison.

name: a Stympalian
shortdesc: An evil looking bird circles over head.
longdesc:
With metallic feathers and sharpened bronze beaks this unnatural looking
bird circles over head looking for another feed.

name: Cetus
shortdesc: A large fish-like monster sits at the bottom of the well.
longdesc:
An angry monster obviously trapped in this well for a long time has managed
to adapt and survive on eating anything that falls down the well.  An unusual
cross between a large fish, a whale and a lizard this monster has an enormous
whale tail and a mouth full of razor sharp teeth.  Its scales are hardened
and it somehow manages to hold its head up on extremely strong front fins.

name: The Jailer
shortdesc: The Jailer is standing here, leering at you
longdesc: He smiles knowingly, and whacks you very hard.

name: Bangfizzle
shortdesc: Bangfizzle wanders behind the counter, trying to make new magic items
longdesc:
She is wearing tattered brown robes, and seems to be having a
conversation with the her beakers.  All the more disturbing
because the beakers occasionally explode with a thunderous roar.

name: the Cheeser
shortdesc: The Cheeser looks at you calmly, wiping debris from his face with one hand.
longdesc:
A fat, nice looking Cheeser. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body, probably because he is so close to Bangfizzle.

name: the Pawnbroker
shortdesc:
A Pawnbroker stands at the counter, he looks as if he would gladly sell
  you your children for one of his items.
longdesc:
A tall Pawnbroker, who moves two 200 pound bags of stuff around on his
shoulders.

name: the dwarven slave weaponsmith
shortdesc: A dwarven slave weaponsmith.
longdesc: An old tired dwarven weaponsmith, who still has yet to escape.

name: the Armorer
shortdesc: A Militia armorer stands here.
longdesc:
An old but very strong armorer, he has made more armor in his
lifetime than you have ever seen.  Shame it doesn't look very good.

name: the receptionist
shortdesc: A buxom receptionist is here, expertly filing her nails.
longdesc: She seems very good at her job, whatever that entails.

name: The Warren Guard
shortdesc: A Warren Guard stands here, grinning evilly.
longdesc:
As you peer intently at the Warren Guard it sneers at you, revealing
rotting yellow teeth.  The guard is dressed in a motley asortment of
armor, none of which looks like it's doing much good.  Fortunately, for
it, it appears to be very quick, and very strong.  As you approach it
brandishes it's glaive and mumbles something about dinner ariving.

name: Queeklor, God of the Rats
shortdesc: Queeklor, God of the Rats has seen you, flee!
longdesc:
You are lucky if you come up to Queeklor's knees.  From beneath
his snout, rancid breath assaults your nose, its stench unbearable.
Boy, you wish you had a breath mint about now.

name: the Ratman Templar
shortdesc: A wicked big rat stands here, his description fully outfitted in chaos armor.
longdesc:
The Ratman Templar is outfitted in very ornate brown and yellow chaos
armor.  Atop his head is a chaos helm, and in his very capable paws,
is a wicked glaive.

name: the Waitress
shortdesc: A Ratwoman Waitress stands here, carefully trying not to smile so much.
longdesc:
Closer inspection reveals why she is not showing her pearly whites,
er, better make that rotting yellows.  Even so she is more than willing
to sell you a drink.

name: a greasy cook
shortdesc: A rotund rat is here, cheerfully cooking some sort of questionable substance.
longdesc:
The apron that this rat is wearing barely covers his rather large belly.
Ocassionally the cook prods the roasted cat with one finger, sticks it
in his mouth, and smiles happily.

name: the bony skeleton
shortdesc: A bony skeleton is here.
longdesc:
Brown bones with tufts of clothing still hanging from them. This
skeleton looks very mindless but still dangerous...

name: The undead zombie
shortdesc: An undead zombie sits here munching on something...
longdesc:
His body is totally white and slowly rotting away.  Each Zombie looks
quite different from the next because they were, of course, once alive and
human.

name: The ghoul
shortdesc: A ghoul is here staring at you hungrily.
longdesc:
The ghoul no longer resembles the adventurer he once was.  Nonetheless
he looks like he hasn't forgot his fighting skills.

name: The wraith
shortdesc: You spot a wraith advancing towards you from the shadows.
longdesc:
The wraith no longer has a material form.  He is wearing a tattered
black robe which hides all but the darkness of his face and the glimmer
in his eyes.

name: The guardian vampire
shortdesc: A vampire is here hiding his face from your light source.
longdesc:
The guardian vampire looks quite EVIL.  Just by looking at him the hair on your
arms raises. He looks mighty tough to be just a minor minion.

name: The priest
shortdesc: A priest of all gods stands here solemnly speaking words of praise.
longdesc:
Obviously a goodly man, you feel somehow...closer to the gods just
by gazing upon this man.  Dressed in white, fine white hair, and
a soft slighty wrinkled face...this man has an sacred beauty.
You'd swear you saw a halo around his head.

name: The Mi-Go
shortdesc: A Mig-Go is walking around here
longdesc:
Mi-Go, the Fungi from Yuggoth...it is a pinkish being about five feet long;
with a custaceous body bearing a vast pair of or membraneous wings and several
sets of articulate limbs, and with a sort of convuluted ellipsoid, covered with
multitudes of very small antennae, where a head would ordinarily be. ... These
beings sometimes walk on all their legs and sometimes on the hindmost pair only

name: The nightgaunt
shortdesc: A nightgaunt is standing here
longdesc:
...shocking and uncouth black thing with smooth, oily, skin, unpleasant horns
that curve inward toward each other, bat wings whose beating make no sound,
ugly prehensile paws, and a barbed tail that lashes disquietingly.  And worst
of all, it makes absolutely no sound or speach and smiles not at all because
it has no face, only a suggestive blackness where a face ought to be...

name: The hunting horror
shortdesc: The hunting horror is here in wait of an unwary traveler...
longdesc:
Serving Nyarlathotep, and now Roch'tar these beings are hunting for victims.
These beings resemble enormous ropy black serpents or worms possessing bat-
like or umbrella-like wings.  Their forms continually shift and change,
twitching and writhing, so it is hard to look at them.  They speak in great
harsh voices. A hunting horror is HUGE, normally around 40 feet long.

name: Some cave weeds spring up out of the ground
shortdesc: Some weeds are creeping across the floor.
longdesc: Just some unpleasant looking vine-like growths...

name: Snapper Joe
shortdesc: Snapper Joe is standing here leering at you chillingly
longdesc:
What an ugly fiend! He is about 6'6'' and has mostly greenish skin with
bright red hair. Half his face is burnt off and he has a perpetual smile.
He is called up from his service in hell in order to aid the Undying One.

name: The X'ist flesh eater
shortdesc: An X'ist flesh eater is sitting here munching on some coffin remains
longdesc:
A large hairy monsterous beast, the only LIVE thing you have seen down
here. It stands approximately 8 feet tall and hunches over to fit in this
small room. It has a pair of tremendous claws that he uses to rip and tear.
It has dog-like face except ...different... Bright glowing eyes and a grimace
lend you to believe that he knew that you were coming...

name: The spirit of King Crotus
shortdesc: The spirit of King Crotus is floating here lazing above the floor
longdesc:
Floating above the ground here and looking a bit dead, he whispers
softly into the air : "The forces of evil have unlocked my spirit as
                       well as one other. Free me from this misery
                       anyone that can hear. The peace of the grave
                       calls me but I am blocked from its quiet.

name: The rock slug
shortdesc: A rock slug is slowly creeping along, leaving a slime trail behind it
longdesc: It is a large brownish slug. Got any salt? Didnt think so...

name: The mad etcher
shortdesc: The mad etcher is sitting here babbling to himself and working on the wall
longdesc:
Quite insane, the mad etcher has been here it seems for decades...
His hair is white; he babbles nonsense to himself; a layer of dust covers
his out of date clothing; and he seems to be working on the same portion of
the wall near the base...oh and he seems quite blind.

      He leers insanely at you ans says 'heh heh what can I do for you
children?  Please dont mind my wife, she is always like that...hello
dear can you make some tea for our company? Oh good! Now sit right down
will you? would you like hot or cold tea? Yes the weather is....'

And on he babbles....

name: The specteral etchers wife
shortdesc: The specteral wife of the etcher is very faintly floating here
longdesc:
Yes you can barely make her out...though it almost makes you vomit.
She is missing half her head...the one half is smashed in horribly like
she took a nasty fall. Her one damaged eye hangs on its own. She smiles
insanely at you thru a broken jaw and missing teeth. One hand of hers is
resting on the shoulder of the etcher...her husband.

name: The half-decomposed body
shortdesc: A half-decomposed body is lying in the corner here
longdesc: YUK! Its ugly, disgusting ...it smells ...it just also moving a bit!

name: The priest
shortdesc: A priest of all gods stands here solemnly speaking words of praise.
longdesc:
Obviously a goodly man, you feel somehow...closer to the gods just
by gazing upon this man.  Dressed in white, fine white hair, and
a soft slighty wrinkled face...this man has an sacred beauty.
You'd swear you saw a halo around his head.

name: Dread
shortdesc: Dread commander of the undead armies stands here contemplating battle plans.
longdesc:
An Undead winged demon with a rather small head with 
  huge horns protruding, he is amassing an army of the dead to do 
  his bidding

name: Corrupted Spirit of King Crotus
shortdesc: King Crotus moves rapidly around the room, fueled with the powers granted to him by his new lord.
longdesc:
Floating above the ground and barking orders in 
  his masters name. He is forceful in the inflection of his voice, 
  and has quite possibly gone mad with the powers bestowed upon him 
  by his dark lord.

name: Pain Bringer
shortdesc: Pain the master of darkness awaits to inflict his passion...
longdesc: Here stands a massive being covered with blood and gore. He has obviously been up to no good. You had better look out!

name: Zifnab
shortdesc: Zifnab wanders behind the counter, talking to himself
longdesc:
He is wearing brown robes, and seems to be having a conversation with the
floor.  All the more disturbing because the floor occasionally answers.

name: Rudyard the Baker
shortdesc: Rudyard, the baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one hand.
longdesc:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.

name: Gruffydd the Grocer
shortdesc: Gruffydd the grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his face.
longdesc: A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his shoulders.

name: Farro the Weaponsmith
shortdesc: Farro the weaponsmith stands here.
longdesc: A young weaponsmith, who still has lots to learn.

name: Kennik the Armourer
shortdesc: Kennik the Armorer stands here.
longdesc:
An old but very strong armorer, he has made more armour in his
lifetime than you have ever seen.

name: Maggie the receptionist
shortdesc: Maggie, a petite receptionist is here, expertly filing papers.
longdesc: She seems very good at her job.

name: Yarrick Fisheye the Captain
shortdesc: Yarrick Fisheye, a retired Captain stands here, selling boats.
longdesc: This Captain has eaten more sharks than you have killed peas.

name: the Sailor
shortdesc: A Sailor stands here, waiting to help you.
longdesc: He looks like a strong, fit sailor.

name: the Cavalier
shortdesc: A Cavalier is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Cavaliers and his
extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly
opponent.

name: The Barbarian
shortdesc: A Barbarian is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an berserk warrior who has vanquished many foes through countless
battles.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Barbarians and his extreme
skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly opponent.

name: The Master Druid
shortdesc: A Master Druid is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert druid who has become one with nature and the universe.
His duty is to protect the Guild of Druids and his expert skills make
him a deadly opponent.

name: The Illusionist
shortdesc: An Illusionist is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert image creator. His duty is to protect the Guild of
Illusionists His mastery in illusions makes him a deadly opponent.

name: The Bard
shortdesc: A Bard is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert song master and could probably sing you to death.
His duty is to protect the Guild of Bards and his mastery of his
class makes him a deadly opponent.

name: The Ninja
shortdesc: A Ninja is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert fighter and could probably kill you in 1 hit. His duty is
to protect the Guild of Ninjas and his mastery of his class makes him a
deadly opponent.

name: The Assassin
shortdesc: An Assassin is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert killer and could probably kill you easily. His duty is to
protect the Guild of Assassins and his mastery of his class makes him a
deadly opponent.

name: The Avenger
shortdesc: An Avenger is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert fighter and could probably arm wrestle you to death.
His duty is to protect the Guild of Avengers and his mastery of his
class makes him a deadly opponent.

name: Osfol
shortdesc: Osfol stands here waiting for you to make up your mind.
longdesc:
Osfol stares back at you with a burning intensity in his eyes, it would
be best to not even think about attacking him.

name: Zandar
shortdesc: Zandar the dwarf wizard is waiting for your order
longdesc: Zandar looks like one nasty sob i wouldnt attack him!

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster is standing here.
longdesc:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she posesses. She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

name: Candar guildmaster
shortdesc: Candar the Cleric
longdesc:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to your god; she has
a peaceful, loving look. You notice that she is surrounded by a white aura.

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster is standing here.
longdesc:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief. She is dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster is standing here.
longdesc:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born. He
has a calm look on his face.

name: the Sorcerer
shortdesc: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat Magic.
He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge of offensive as
well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

name: the Knight Templar
shortdesc: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the Faith.
His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel attacks and
his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a deadly
opponent.

name: the Assassin
shortdesc: An assassin is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as possible,
using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and where to use
them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes him a deadly opponent.

name: the Knight
shortdesc: A knight is guarding the entrance.
longdesc:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Swordsmen and his
extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly
opponent.

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster is standing here.
longdesc:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born. He
has a calm look on his face.

longdesc:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born. He
has a calm look on his face.

This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars

This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars

longdesc:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars

Filthy looks real, ehm, dirty. He likes to keep his costumers happy,
but do not mess with him or else he'll get upset.

OUCH!

weapon.

He is big and strong one of the elite fighters of the world, trained for years
in the shadow corps. He will certainly be a very worthy opponent.

longdesc: You see nothing special...

name: Ingrid, the fishmonger
shortdesc: Ingrid looks at you patiently, wiping fishscales and guts from her hands.
longdesc:
Ingrid has seen the passage of many years.  Her face is weathered with
the beating of rain and sun.  She is clearly a born-fishmonger, the scales
and guts of the fish don't bother her nor the smell of fresh fish.

name: the Kitten
shortdesc: A small loyal Kitten is here.
longdesc: The Kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

name: the Puppy
shortdesc: A small loyal Puppy is here.
longdesc: The Puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

name: the Beagle

longdesc: The Beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

name: the Rottweiler
shortdesc: A large, loyal Rottweiler is here.
longdesc: The Rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

longdesc: The Wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

name: Banzif
shortdesc: Banzif wanders around, trying to sell his insurance.
longdesc: He is wearing a tacky 3 piece suit.

name: darlak
shortdesc: Darlak wanders around, picking at various pieces of armor.
longdesc: He is wearing a tacky 3 piece suit.

name: talamark
