longdesc: He is wearing a tacky 3 piece suit.

name: Jules
shortdesc: Jules, purchaser of fine gems.
longdesc:
Jules is a distant tradesman from the Dwarven Realm.  Stocky
of build, he has a good eye for quality.. He.. well hard to say
really with a dwarf.. it could be a she!

name: the Maid
shortdesc: The Maid is here, waiting to take your order.
longdesc:
She is very beautiful with golden hair, and deep blue eyes. A good reason
for coming here more often.

name: the Sexton
shortdesc: A Sexton is sitting here, drinking hot tea.
longdesc: The Sexton looks like he is relaxing after another gravedigging job.

name: the Swan
shortdesc: A swan is swimming around in the pond.
longdesc: The white swan is very elegant.

name: the Duckling
shortdesc: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
longdesc: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny furball.

name: the Sparrow
shortdesc: A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.
longdesc: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.

name: the Duck
shortdesc: A duck is here, quacking happily.
longdesc: The duck is quite fat.  It looks like it is enjoying life.

name: the Chief
shortdesc: The Chief Guard is looking very upset.
longdesc: A very angry chief.

name: the Cityguard
shortdesc: A cityguard stands here, looking very upset.
longdesc: A big, strong, angry guard.  He looks very well trained.

name: the Secretary
shortdesc: A secretary is sitting at the desk, typing away on the typewriter.
longdesc:
She looks very busy.

>
The Secretary says 'Sorry, but the Mayor is extremely busy today.'
The Secretary says 'Please sit down and have a seat in the meantime.'

name: the Mayor
shortdesc: The Mayor is sitting in his huge chair, snoring loudly.
longdesc: He is a stocky, middle-aged man with thin, grey hair.

name: the Town Crier
shortdesc: The Town Crier is here, weeping quietly.
longdesc: He is very good at his job - completely dissolved in tears.

name: A Huge Swamp Troll
shortdesc: A Huge Swamp Troll charges towards you.
longdesc:
This huge behemoth towers to a height of 15 feet, It sneers at you
as it approaches and raises its black taloned claws to strike you.

name: A Large Green Troll
shortdesc: A Large Green Troll attempts to get a hold on you.
longdesc:
This big troll is towers several feet over you.  He has a large spear
which he seems to ply with utmost prowess.  He jabs his spear at you
and cackles with glee.

name: A Mean Looking Ogre
shortdesc: A Mean Looking Ogre stands here getting ready to beat in your face.
longdesc: This mean looking bastard looks like he could tear you limb from limb.

name: The Swamp Thing
shortdesc: The Swamp Thing shambles about here, It seems hungry.
longdesc: The Swamp Thing has huge fists, which look like they could pound you flat.

name: A Mean Looking Gnoll
shortdesc: There is a Mean Looking Gnoll here, he looks slightly unhappy.
longdesc: The Gnoll is clad in a suit of chain, and carries a large morning star.

name: A Huge Hairy Beast
shortdesc: A Huge Hairy Beast shambles towards you with death in his eyes.
longdesc:
This Huge Beast stands about 20 feet in height and has huge green clawed
appendages.

name: A Rather Small Beast
shortdesc: A Rather Small Beast cringes in terror as it notices you.
longdesc:
This Rather Small Beast looks like you could take it out with a single
sword blow.

name: The Will-O-Wisp
shortdesc: A Will-O-Wisp darts hear and there, making fun of you.
longdesc:
This strange little creature seems very hard to keep your eyes on.
You stare as hard as you can at the glowing ball of floating light and
are just able to notice a small pair of glowing eyes.

name: The Monsterous Snake
shortdesc: A Huge Snake slithers towards you, thinking "Lunch".
longdesc: This 18 or so foot long reptile looks rather hungry.

name: A Large Snake
shortdesc: A Rather Large Python rests in a coil here.
longdesc: It looks similar to some of the largest Amazon pythons you have never seen.

name: The Marshman
shortdesc: A Marshman saunters towards you, reaching for your pouch of gold.
longdesc:
This rather gaunt individual seems tired of people who play mud and
has decided it is time for you to die.

name: The Old Marsh Hag
shortdesc: An Old Marsh Hag is here.
longdesc:
This disgusting bitch deserves to die.  You feel a great need to put a
sword through her.  She does have rather large nails though.

name: A Rotting Treant
shortdesc: A rotting ancient treant crawls about here.
longdesc:
This rotting ancient tree looks like it will be hard to kill.  And hard
to get that smell of dung off your weapon after.

name: A Marsh Wolf
shortdesc: A Marsh Wolf sniffs the ground and then notices your scent and leaps at you.
longdesc:
This rather plump wolf looks well fed, probably ate a friend or two of
yours who came into the marsh.

name: An air elemental
shortdesc: An air elemental hovers here.
longdesc: All you see is air!

name: A water elemental splashes water on you and
shortdesc: A water elemental oozes about here.
longdesc: This puddle of water moves about by its own free will!

name: A Titanic Sea Monster
shortdesc: A Titanic Sea Monster wades in the water here.
longdesc:
This Huge beast has huge nasty fangs and bloodshot eyes, looks like he
could eat your whole party for desert.

name: A Shambling Mound
shortdesc: A Large Shambling Mound shambles towards you.
longdesc:
This grotesque pile of plant matter fills you with utmost horror as
it tries to lay its grimy paws on you.

name: The Hangman Tree
shortdesc: The Hangman Tree is here, ready to string you up and feast upon your fleshy corpse.
longdesc:
The hangman tree resembles a sparsely foliaged, deciduous oak with noose-like 
vines hanging from the branches, hence the name.

name: A Marsh Giant
shortdesc: A Huge Marsh Giant stomps towards you.
longdesc:
This Huge monster of a man, has green gnarly teeth and a slight disposition
about him.  He carries a BIG stick.

name: The Gargoyle
shortdesc: A Large Gargoyle lands next to you, baring his fangs at you.
longdesc: This creepy fellow looks like he could use you as a meal, and might.

name: Eddie the Chef
shortdesc: Eddie looks at you calmly, while watching his fish and chips cook away.
longdesc:
A fat, nice looking man, a bit rotund from eating his own cooking... however
the fat doesn't hide the thick muscles underneath.

name: Kargarn Blackhold
shortdesc: Kargarn Blackhold is here offering spell buffs for a fee.
longdesc:
This is Kargarn Blackhold.  He is an opportunistic Scholar of ill repute.
Kargarn is also an Arcanist of immense power - and if you didn't know, an
Arcanists' power comes from their surrounds.  So if there is an abundance
of spell power in the area when Kargarn casts a spell, this makes all of
his spells more potent.  But don't let that put you off, Kargarn is here
only to make money, which he keeps securely tied to his body via a money
pouch.  In return for the hard-earned money of adventurers he offers high
-end spell buffs to all and sundry, regardless of alignment, creed, race,
or number of fingers on your hands.

name: the pet cat
shortdesc: someones pet cat is here sniffing in the trash for something to eat.
longdesc:
A sort of scrawny little cat but it has a worn and faded collar with a name
tag on it.

name: the black cat
shortdesc: a black cat is here sniffing in the trash for something to eat.
longdesc:
A sort of scrawny little cat but it has a worn and faded collar with a name
tag on it.

name: a small puppy
shortdesc: a small puppy is chasing a leaf around here.
longdesc: A grey and white puppy he looks well fed.

name: a large dog
shortdesc: a rather large dog is sniffing a pile of rags.
longdesc: A rather large dog with a white and grey coat.

name: a mad dog
shortdesc: a dog growls at you.
longdesc: A scrawny dog with a temper it looks like.

name: a beggar
shortdesc: A beggar asks for some lose change.
longdesc: he has worn and dusty cloths.

name: a peasant girl
shortdesc: A peasant girl with few clothes on smiles at you.
longdesc: I wonder what she has in mind?

name: a peasant boy
shortdesc: A peasant boy is here looking after his sister.
longdesc: He looks really handy with a pitchfork.  Ouch!

name: the cat
shortdesc: Papi's favorite cat is resting here, purring gently.
longdesc:
This is just about the most huggable cat you have ever seen! You notice
that the cat has exceptionally big claws - guess it's nothing to worry
about as long as you leave it alone.

name: the bony skeleton
shortdesc: A bony skeleton is here. (CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
Brown bones with tufts of clothing still hanging from them. This
skeleton looks very mindless but still dangerous...

name: The undead zombie
shortdesc: An undead zombie sits here munching on something... (CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
His body is totally white and slowly rotting away.  Each Zombie looks
quite different from the next because they were, of course, once alive and
human.

name: The ghoul
shortdesc: A ghoul is here staring at you hungrily. (CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
The ghoul no longer resembles the adventurer he once was.  Nonetheless
he looks like he hasn't forgot his fighting skills.

name: The wraith
shortdesc: You spot a wraith advancing towards you from the shadows.(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
The wraith no longer has a material form.  He is wearing a tattered
black robe which hides all but the darkness of his face and the glimmer
in his eyes.

name: The guardian vampire
shortdesc: A vampire is here hiding his face from your light source.(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
The guardian vampire looks quite EVIL.  Just by looking at him the hair on your
arms raises. He looks mighty tough to be just a minor minion.

name: The priest
shortdesc: A priest of all gods stands here solemnly speaking words of praise(CONTACT IMM).
longdesc:
Obviously a goodly man, you feel somehow...closer to the gods just
by gazing upon this man.  Dressed in white, fine white hair, and
a soft slighty wrinkled face...this man has an sacred beauty.
You'd swear you saw a halo around his head.

name: The Mi-Go
shortdesc: A Mig-Go is walking around here(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
Mi-Go, the Fungi from Yuggoth...it is a pinkish being about five feet long;
with a custaceous body bearing a vast pair of or membraneous wings and several
sets of articulate limbs, and with a sort of convuluted ellipsoid, covered with
multitudes of very small antennae, where a head would ordinarily be. ... These
beings sometimes walk on all their legs and sometimes on the hindmost pair only

name: The nightgaunt
shortdesc: A nightgaunt is standing here(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
...shocking and uncouth black thing with smooth, oily, skin, unpleasant horns
that curve inward toward each other, bat wings whose beating make no sound,
ugly prehensile paws, and a barbed tail that lashes disquietingly.  And worst
of all, it makes absolutely no sound or speach and smiles not at all because
it has no face, only a suggestive blackness where a face ought to be...

name: The hunting horror
shortdesc: The hunting horror is here in wait of an unwary traveler.(CONTACT IMM)..
longdesc:
Serving Nyarlathotep, and now Roch'tar these beings are hunting for victims.
These beings resemble enormous ropy black serpents or worms possessing bat-
like or umbrella-like wings.  Their forms continually shift and change,
twitching and writhing, so it is hard to look at them.  They speak in great
harsh voices. A hunting horror is HUGE, normally around 40 feet long.

name: Some cave weeds spring up out of the ground
shortdesc: Some weeds are creeping across the floor(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc: Just some unpleasant looking vine-like growths...

name: Snapper Joe
shortdesc: Snapper Joe is standing here leering at you chillingly(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
What an ugly fiend! He is about 6'6'' and has mostly greenish skin with
bright red hair. Half his face is burnt off and he has a perpetual smile.
He is called up from his service in hell in order to aid the Undying One.

name: The X'ist flesh eater
shortdesc: An X'ist flesh eater is sitting here munching on some coffin remains(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
A large hairy monsterous beast, the only LIVE thing you have seen down
here. It stands approximately 8 feet tall and hunches over to fit in this
small room. It has a pair of tremendous claws that he uses to rip and tear.
It has dog-like face except ...different... Bright glowing eyes and a grimace
lend you to believe that he knew that you were coming...

name: The spirit of King Crotus
shortdesc: The spirit of King Crotus is floating here lazing above the floor (CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
Floating above the ground here and looking a bit dead, he whispers
softly into the air : "The forces of evil have unlocked my spirit as
                       well as one other. Free me from this misery
                       anyone that can hear. The peace of the grave
                       calls me but I am blocked from its quiet.

name: The rock slug
shortdesc: A rock slug is slowly creeping along, leaving a slime trail behind it (CONTACT IMM)
longdesc: It is a large brownish slug. Got any salt? Didnt think so...

name: The mad etcher
shortdesc: The mad etcher is sitting here babbling to himself and working on the wall (CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
Quite insane, the mad etcher has been here it seems for decades...
His hair is white; he babbles nonsense to himself; a layer of dust covers
his out of date clothing; and he seems to be working on the same portion of
the wall near the base...oh and he seems quite blind.

      He leers insanely at you ans says 'heh heh what can I do for you
children?  Please dont mind my wife, she is always like that...hello
dear can you make some tea for our company? Oh good! Now sit right down
will you? would you like hot or cold tea? Yes the weather is....'

And on he babbles....

name: The specteral etchers wife
shortdesc: The specteral wife of the etcher is very faintly floating here(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
Yes you can barely make her out...though it almost makes you vomit.
She is missing half her head...the one half is smashed in horribly like
she took a nasty fall. Her one damaged eye hangs on its own. She smiles
insanely at you thru a broken jaw and missing teeth. One hand of hers is
resting on the shoulder of the etcher...her husband.

name: The half-decomposed body
shortdesc: A half-decomposed body is lying in the corner here(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc: YUK! Its ugly, disgusting ...it smells ...it just also moving a bit!

name: The priest
shortdesc: A priest of all gods stands here solemnly speaking words of praise.(CONTACT IMM)
longdesc:
Obviously a goodly man, you feel somehow...closer to the gods just
by gazing upon this man.  Dressed in white, fine white hair, and
a soft slighty wrinkled face...this man has an sacred beauty.
You'd swear you saw a halo around his head.

name: The wyvern
shortdesc: A monsterous wyvern slowly circles just above your heads...
longdesc: This huge winged creature looks really menacing...(insert desc.)

name: the guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster stands here.
longdesc: An old man peering through ancient tomes rests here.

name: the guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster stands here.
longdesc: An older man wrapped in purple, long-flowing robes meditates here.

name: the guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster stands here.
longdesc: A smaller man dressed in nothing but a tunic stands here waiting to train you.

name: the guildmaster
shortdesc: Your guildmaster stands here.
longdesc:
A small hobbit dressed in black rests in the corner. As you enter he grabs
a knife an throws it at you. It lands the wall next to your left ear. We
will now begin, is all he says.

name: the receptionist
shortdesc: A dark skinned, vieled woman greets you from behind the desk.
longdesc:
This arabian beauty is obviously the daughter of some high ranking
official. As you attempt to sneak a peek under her viel you notice
a small moon-shaped birthmark on her left cheek.

name: the old witherd mage/bartender
shortdesc: An old witherd mage/bartender leans against the bar.
longdesc: He looks distracted as he pours five drinks at once without error.

name: Brother John
shortdesc: Brother John, lead singer for the Lokettes stands on stage.
longdesc: You see the lead singer of the Lokettes lip synching to an old Zeppelin tune.

name: a panhandler
shortdesc: A panhandler rests here.
longdesc: A small skinny man rests here hoping to find a warm heart.

name: a panhandler
shortdesc: A panhandler rests here.
longdesc: A small skinny man rests here staring at your clothes.

name: a beggar
shortdesc: A grubby beggar sits here in the filth.
longdesc: This poor soul seems down on his luck, perhaps you might spare a dime?

name: the baker
shortdesc: The baker stands here playing solitaire.
longdesc: You see a large man in a white apron covered in flour from head to toe.

name: the shopkeeper
shortdesc: The shopkeeper stands here.
longdesc: You see a half-elf sitting on a stool behind his counter.

name: the banker
shortdesc: A banker stands here waiting to help you.
longdesc: This small hobbit seems adept at counting money.

name: Ahkeem the tailor
shortdesc: Ahkeem the tailor welcomes you to his store.
longdesc:
This middle-aged man looks over you with disdain and quickly suggests a new
wardrobe.

name: Vera the veggie lady
shortdesc: Vera the veggie lady beems as you look over her stand.
longdesc: A tall slender elf stands before you smiling broadly.

name: Butch the meatcutter
shortdesc: Butch the meatcutter stands here in his bloodied apron.
longdesc:
This stocky dwarf has a mad glint in his eye as he twirls his clever
carelessly into the air.

name: Abdul the armorer
shortdesc: Abdul stands here, waiting to help you.
longdesc:
Abdul returns your gaze with a steady eye. You quickly glance away under
his cold stare and place your order.

name: Igor the weaponsmith
shortdesc: Igor stands here doing... something.
longdesc: You see a small dwarf with a large hump on his left shoulder.

name: Cassandra
shortdesc: Cassandra stands proudly over her selection.
longdesc:
You see a happy weather-worn face whose lines suggest many years on the
open sea. It is only through years of fishing that she is able to withstand
the smell that permeates the air.

name: the foreman
shortdesc: The foreman stands here screaming at the workers.
longdesc:
A worried working dwarf stands here constantly making notes in his
book and looking at his watch.

name: a construction worker
shortdesc: A construction worker steadily works here.
longdesc: A large sweaty looking man doesn't even return your glance.

name: The statue of Conner
shortdesc: The statue of Conner stands here.
longdesc:
A statue made of solid marble depicts the mighty Highlander defeating
the Kurgan in swordplay.

name: The statue of Excavator
shortdesc: The statue of Excavator stands here.
longdesc:
A statue of the High Lord of Construction stands here overseeing the
rebuilding of castle RavenLoft.

name: The statue of Haplo

longdesc: A statue of Haplo.

longdesc: A statue of Hachiman.

longdesc: A statue of Xenakis.

longdesc: A statue of Herne.

longdesc: A statue of Parallax.

name: Kareem
shortdesc: Kareem the Dwarven Mercenary stands here.

name: A nomad merchant
shortdesc: A nomad merchant looks you over.
longdesc:
This robust fellow returns your gaze with a smile, but something inside
tells you not to trust him very far.

name: A bodyguard
shortdesc: A bodyguard sizes you up.
longdesc: The large half-orc quickly glances you over and returns to his duties.

name: a small child
shortdesc: A small child looks a little lost.
longdesc:
This small city child sees you looking at him and smiles
politely and askes you for a few pennies.

name: the dockworker
shortdesc: A strong dockworker walks by moving crates.
longdesc:
Although seemingly dull witted, this hulking mass carries the huge
crates from the boats like so many lilies.

name: the taxcollector
shortdesc: A small man walks around scribbling in a notebook.
longdesc:
The city's taxcollextor walks from store to store collecting the
Sultan's fee for living in his grand city.

name: Gord
shortdesc: Gord the Rogue stand here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: Caramon
shortdesc: Caramon the Knight stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: Raistlin
shortdesc: Raistlin the Arch-Magi
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: Curley GreenLeaf
shortdesc: Curley GreenLeaf stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the wandering prophet
shortdesc: A small grey-haired man walks around spouting gospel.
longdesc:
This sad case may have been an evangelist in another lifetime. He is known
to stand on corners and accost passers-by with his doomsday preaching.

name: the alley cat
shortdesc: A small harmless feline searches for food.
longdesc: You see a small starved cat.

name: the vulture
shortdesc: A vulture circles above you.
longdesc: As you look up at this bird, you see the only thing it wants is a corpse.

name: the old man
shortdesc: An old man sits here playing chess.
longdesc: He seems intent on winning.

name: Conan the Librarian
shortdesc: Conan the Librarian sits behind a desk.
longdesc: The huge hulking mass rises as someone asks him a question.

name: the dirt devil
shortdesc: The wind kicks up some dust.
longdesc: What you see before you is really a baby air elemental.

name: the lamia
shortdesc: A lamia stands here.
longdesc: A half snake half woman creature rears back to attack you.

name: the raggety dervish
shortdesc: A raggety dervish stands here.
longdesc: This man looks like he could use a lot of rest.

name: The Sultan
shortdesc: The Sultan rests here on his throne.
longdesc: You see a large wealthy man in red robes smiling at you.

name: a harem girl
shortdesc: A lovely, vieled harem girl stands here.
longdesc:
You see a dark skinned beauty, wearing almost transparent silks and
light blue viel. Her loyalty to the sultan is unwavering.

name: the jailor
shortdesc: The Jailer sleeps here, snoring loudly.
longdesc:
You see a pathetic soul lying here. Some ex-nobleman that has fallen
out of grace with the Sultan.

name: a eunich
shortdesc: a eunich stands here watching over the girls.
longdesc:
You see a large man whose only duty is to protect the harem. He has been
castrated for the ladies safety.

name: Nichole, the sultan's favorite
shortdesc: Nichole, the sultan's favorite girl rests on a mound of pillows.
longdesc:
You see the most beautiful arabian girl that has ever meet your eyes. Too
bad she's about to kill you.

name: Allah
shortdesc: Allah is here.
longdesc: You see the all-knowing Allah.

name: the guildguard
shortdesc: The Guard for the Guild of Mages stand here.
longdesc: This man looks like a mage/warrior, i wouldn't mess with him.

name: the guildguard
shortdesc: The Guard for the Guild of Clerics stands here.
longdesc: This man looks like a cleric/warrior, I wouldn't mess with him.

name: the guildguard
shortdesc: The Guard for the Guild of Warriors stands here.
longdesc: The man looks like Conan's cousin, I wouldn't mess with him.

name: the guildguard
shortdesc: The Guard for the Guild of theives stands here.
longdesc:
You see a thief dressed all in black, he quickly stands as you enter
and steps to bar your way. You notice his hands resting on two sheafs.

name: a servant boy
shortdesc: A servant boy is here running errands.
longdesc: You see a small boy running around the halls of the palace.

name: the sultans guard
shortdesc: A guard stands here, protecting the innocent.
longdesc: You see a trained fighter, ready to help those in need.

name: the sultans guard
shortdesc: A guard stands here, watching the gate.
longdesc: You see a trained fighter, readt to defend the city.

name: The chief guard
shortdesc: The chief of the sultan's guard stands here.
longdesc: You see a large mane skilled in hunting and killing.

name: the mercenary
shortdesc: A mercenary stands here waiting for a job.
longdesc: You see an assassin down on his luck looking to be freelanced out.

name: the shipwright
shortdesc: An old captain rests here carving on a stick.
longdesc:
You see the shipwright of New Thalos, waiting to make someone a boat. He
beams a smile at you through his beard as you walk in.

name: the blacksmith
shortdesc: The blacksmith stands here pumping air into his fire.
longdesc:
You see a large human, dripping in sweat, standing before you. He takes a
break from his swealtering work to bid you welcome.

name: a horse
shortdesc: a horse stands here.
longdesc: You see one of the fine arabian beasts known about the land.

name: a tourist
shortdesc: a tourist stands here looking lost.
longdesc:
You see a small round japanese man, with a camera around his neck and
a nose guard. He's looking at a small road map that he seems to be holding
upside down.

name: Shelbye
shortdesc: Shelbye stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the cryohydra
shortdesc: The cryohydra stands here.
longdesc: A grey-brown reptillian creature with amber eyes stands before you.

name: the minotaur lizard
shortdesc: the minotaur lizard stands here.
longdesc: A huge lizard like reptile with horns like a minotaur.

name: the spotted lion
shortdesc: The spotted lion stands here.
longdesc: A large fierce dapple skinned lion glares at you.

name: the behir
shortdesc: A behir slithers on the ground.
longdesc: You see a large snake like reptile with more than a dozen legs.

name: the chimera
shortdesc: A creature with three heads: lion, goat, and dragon stands here.
longdesc:
The chimera is still a mystery, better left unexplored. This creature has
the hindquarters of a goat, the forepaws of a lion and the body of a red
dragon.

name: the couatl
shortdesc: A couatl hovers here.
longdesc:
A beautiful creature with the body of a serpent and feathered wings the
color of the rainbow.

name: the giant hornet
shortdesc: The giant hornet hovers here.
longdesc:
The giant hornet hits you very hard!
That REALLY hurt!
You wish you wounds would stop BLEEDING so much!
You feel less perceptive.
Welcome to Perilous Realms.

0) Exit from Perilous Realms.
1) Enter the game.
2) Enter Desciption.
3) Read the background story
4) Change password.

     Make your choice:

name: the pegasus
shortdesc: The pegasus stands here, flexing its wings.
longdesc:
A magnificant winged steed, this horse looks much like the arabian
thoroughbred you've seen in the stables.

name: Elvria
shortdesc: Elvira stands here mixing a love potion.
longdesc:
You see a very healthy female dressed in black, with long flowing
hair to match her outfit.

name: Braheem
shortdesc: Braheem stands here talking to the walls.
longdesc: You see a powerful but slighty insane mage.

name: the high priest
shortdesc: The high priest rests here meditating, well he WAS meditating.
longdesc: He does NOT look real happy that you have disturbed him.

name: The Royal Guard
shortdesc: An Elite Royal Guard stands here smiling happily.
longdesc:
You see one of the Royal Guards from Midgaard who seems to have gone
through some training.

name: Patch the bartender
shortdesc: A large half-orc with a patch over one eye pours beer behind the counter
longdesc:
You see a really big guy here who seems to have lost an eye in one manner
or another.

name: Stitch, the leather dude.
shortdesc: Stitch, the leather dude reclines in his chair.
longdesc:
You see a small hobbit with his feet kicked up on his desk waiting for
some sucker, um, customer to walk in his store.

name: the gardener
shortdesc: A small elf stands here tending the garden.
longdesc:
A young elf stands here in dirt covered overalls. He seems to be weeding
his garden.

name: the nightmare
shortdesc: A large horse, black as night, stands here.
longdesc:
You see the largest horse you have ever seen before. Standing 10' at the
shoulder he breathes flame from his nostrils and leaps to protect
his love.

name: the wolverine
shortdesc: A large wolf like creature leaps out from the darkness.
longdesc:
You see a half wolf- half human beast wearing a glove with long thin
blades on it.

name: the mimic
shortdesc: You see an incredibly life-like painting of the Sultan's mother.
longdesc: Boy is she ugly.

name: the mayor
shortdesc: The Mayor of New Thalos stands here.
longdesc: You see a chubby hobbit dressed in his best suit.

name: the chef
shortdesc: The chef stands here making dinner.
longdesc: You see a very large human who seems to taste everything he makes.

name: the Ixitxachitl
shortdesc: A very large ray with a wicked looking tail swims here.
longdesc: You see a large ray with sharp fangs and a barbed tail.

name: Midgard Soldier
shortdesc: A soldier of Midgard
longdesc:
A Midgardian soldier is patrolling the area, keeping an eye out for
any possible threats to the city.

name: Midgard Guard Captain
shortdesc: A Captain of the Midgardian Guard
longdesc:
He is big and strong and trained for years in the Midgardian army.
Experienced from years of border skirmishes, his easy grip of his
weapon and the command of his soldiers sends a clear message.

name: Bailrar the Bartender
shortdesc: Bailrar watches you calmly, while he skillfully mixes a drink.
longdesc: A tired looking bartender who hates trouble in his bar.

name: Wenworth the Tanner
shortdesc: Wenworth the Tanner is here ready to trade his fine leathers and cloths.
longdesc:
Wenworth reeks of something really, really bad.  It must be because of his
profession.  You hope!

name: an old man
shortdesc: An old man sits here reading a book.
longdesc:
The old man sits in the corner occasionally glancing
up to see who's blocking his light.  He's a grumpy looking
man who would appear not to want to be disturbed.

name: a replica beggar
shortdesc: A replica of a beggar is here.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: a replica tiger
shortdesc: A replica of a tiger is here.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: a replica gelfling
shortdesc: A replica of a gelfling is here.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: a replica Elven Gentleman
shortdesc: A replica of an Elven Gentleman is here.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: a replica of a cleric from Agatar's Order
shortdesc: A replica of a cleric from Agatar's Order is standing here.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: a replica of the Grey Dragon
shortdesc: A replica of the giant grey dragon stares at you icily.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: A replica of a shopkeeper
shortdesc: A replica of an old man is sitting here.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: A replace of the master of goodness
shortdesc: A replica of the master of goodness is here.
longdesc: Looking closely at the replica, it's forms shimmers, losing clarity.

name: a Ball of Fire
shortdesc: A ball of fire moves with intelligence.
longdesc:
The ball of fire notices your gaze and telepathically informs
you that it is the guardian of the final passage.

name: August Arcana
shortdesc: August Arcana is sitting behind a desk going through a pile of keys.
longdesc:
You see a man dressed in kaki pants, tan jacket and wearing a safari hat.
He is studying a key through a jewlers loop and when you approach he looks up
and says 'can I help you?  If you have a key I can attempt to identify it'

name: Genral
shortdesc: The Genral of midguard stands here contemplating battle plans.
longdesc:
The Genral is standing here with a map finding ways to attack
the graveyard.

name: the Captain of Midguard
shortdesc: The Captain of midguard is standing here advising the genral.
longdesc:
The captain stands here tall with a scar going across his eye, his eye is
	completely white. He whispers to the genral about the battle of graveyard.

name: Lieutenant
shortdesc: The Lieutenant of midguard is standing here...
longdesc:
The Lieutennant stands tall and still guarding the genral
	with absolute power over the younger ranks.

name: a Soilder
shortdesc: A Soilder is standing here twiddling his thumbs.
longdesc: A Midguard Soilder is here wondering when somthing cool will happen.

name: Amory Thames
shortdesc: Amory Thames, Adventurer's Guild Armourer, stands here.
longdesc:
Amory has taken the plunge and moved his entire business from
Old Port to Midgard just to be near his beau.  He won't tell
you who that is because he fears you'll steal her from him :-(

name: Felix Naxitor
shortdesc: Felix Naxitor, Adenturer's Guild Magic Supplies Tradesman, stands here.
longdesc:
Felix Naxitor, a rather new tradesman from the city of Oldport, has
taken up residence in the new low cost magic shop here in Midgard.

name: Wally Snufflegrump
shortdesc: Wally Snufflegrump, proud Adventurers Guild Weaponsmith, stands here.
longdesc:
Wally is a Dwarf. He's proud to be one of the Elders of the
Smufflegrump clan, a very ancient family in Dwarf circles. He
always wonders why people make fun of his name.

name: Waggles Wonderfoot
shortdesc: Waggles Wonderfoot stands here, ready to sell you something expensive.
longdesc:
Waggles is an elf.  And a very very clever elf.  He would have been
the foremost wizard were it not for his leeeeetle speech problem...

name: Elsie Mae Herbalist
shortdesc: Elsie Mae, the Herbalist, stands here looking stoned.
longdesc:
Elsie Mae is a middle aged woman with a very happy outlook on life.  She
spends her days sampling her own wares and is rarely on this planet for
long.

name: Locke Lamorra
shortdesc: Locke Lamorra, the Zen Cleric, sits here in meditation
longdesc:
Locke is a remarkably young man. He has long, flowing hair that reaches
down to his shoulders and eyes that sparkle bright and blue.  It is said
that Locke is so powerful he can enter any of the shrines in Midgard,
bypassing the magic that prevents entry to any of a non-desirable
alignment.

name: a rough pirate
shortdesc: A rough looking pirate is here, chewing tobacco.
longdesc:
He looks like he would sell his own grandmother if he thought he
could make a profit from her!

name: a desperate pirate
shortdesc: A desperate looking pirate is here, picking his nose.
longdesc:
He looks like he would sell his own grandmother if he thought he
could make a profit from her!

name: a scurvy pirate
shortdesc: A scurvy looking pirate is here, scratching his groin.
longdesc:
He looks like he would sell his own grandmother if he thought he
could make a profit from her!

name: Mister Jakes
shortdesc: Mister Jakes, the first mate, is here keeping an eye on the crew.
longdesc:
He looks like he would sell his own grandmother if he thought he
could make a profit from her!

name: Cooky Joe
shortdesc: Cooky Joe, the ship cook, is here chopping something unidentifiable.
longdesc:
He looks like he would sell his own grandmother if he thought he
could make a profit from her!

name: Captain Blackdog
shortdesc: Captain Blackdog is here, pouring over a map, searching for treasure.  Arr!
longdesc:
He looks like he would sell his own grandmother if he thought he
could make a profit from her!

name: Roger the Cabin Boy
shortdesc: Roger, the cabin boy, is here, grinning mischievously.
longdesc: Why is he grinning like that??

name: Silverfish
shortdesc: Silverfish is here, brewing up the latest potions for you to try!
longdesc:
He is a happy, middle-aged man with no eyebrows... Are you sure you trust
this guy to be selling you a potion??

name: Maisy's Shadow Guard
shortdesc: A Shadow Guard stands here ready to protect Maisy from the likes of you.
longdesc:
He is big and strong one of the elite fighters of the world, trained for years
in the shadow corps. He will certainly be a very worthy opponent.

name: Brommel
shortdesc: Brommel the toy seller is here, smiling happily as he oversees his jolly stock.
longdesc:
Round glasses, white hair and beard, a jolly expression.  Brommel is the epitome of
what a toy seller should be!

name: Mister Peacock
shortdesc: Mister Peacock stands here, ready to sell you something in brown.
longdesc:
Mister Peacock is a very particular gentleman.  He wears a very fancy brown suit and
brown hat.  It all matches his brown moustache and his brown wares.  You'll be sure
to find something brown sold by Mister Peacock.

name: Splodge
shortdesc: Splodge is here, smelling of goats.  Eww.
longdesc:
In a remote corner of Pharisca lies the small sovereign state of Pharsickle.
The Phasicklians are a fierce nomadic race who smell of goats.  Splodge is no
exception.  The rank odour of goats is almost visible about him.

name: #{green}#{bold}Saemus the Leprechaun#{off}
shortdesc: #{green}#{bold}Saemus the Leprechaun#{off} stands here, grinning mischievously.
longdesc:
He's a dapper little guy with a bright orange beard and a 
tendency for mischief.  I doubt he has a pot of gold hidden
anywhere, but his hat is rather fetching, and he appears to
be enjoying a Guinness.

name: #{magenta}#{bold}Snuggles, the 2018 Easter Bunny#{off}
shortdesc: #{magenta}#{bold}Snuggles, the 2018 Easter Bunny#{off} hops here, waiting to pull your head off.
longdesc: She is a cute little bunny with pink fur and long ears.  She'd *never* hurt you...

name: #{red}#{bold}Deth Vader#{off}
shortdesc: #{red}#{bold}Deth Vader#{off} is here, swinging his lightsaber!
longdesc: He wears a lotta black and looks really, really, really evil.  Uh oh!

name: #{green}#{bold}Siouxsie the Screaming Siren#{off}
shortdesc:
#{green}#{bold}Siouxsie the Screaming Siren#{off} is here, heralding in Halloween!
Siouxsie the Screaming Siren glows with the Stench of Death!
longdesc:
She is as insubstantial as mist, with a pale face and green hair that flows as if underwater.
Ooooooooo!

name: Al Boggins
shortdesc: Al Boggins is stood here, scratching his armpit.
longdesc:
This is Al Boggins.  He doesn't look clean.  But he sells cheap and
honest food.

name: a busy beaver
shortdesc: A beaver is here busily building a dam.
longdesc:
This beaver is very busy.  He is building a dam.  He has no time
to waste on the likes of you.  So he ignores you.

name: #{red}#{bold}The Queen of Scream#{off}
shortdesc:
#{red}#{bold}The Queen of Scream#{off} is here, looking terrorised!
The Queen of Scream glows with the Stench of Death!
longdesc:
She has short dark hair, a mean attitude and a scream that will burst your eardrums
and leave you deaf as a post!
OoooooH!

name: a furry beaver
shortdesc: A large furry beaver is here gnawing on a fresh log.
longdesc:
Nibble nibble.  Nibble.  Wot yo lookin' at?  Nibble gnaw nibble swallow.
That would be an accurate description of this animals behaviour and mood.
It's also very furry and looks dangerous.  I wouldn't attack it if I were
you!

name: a cuddly bunny
shortdesc: A cuddly bunny wabbit sits here chewing on some greenery.
longdesc: This is a large and not-so-cuddly wild rabbit from outside the city walls. If you were to put a name to this creature it would likely be General Woundwort.  It has one milky-white blind eye, ears like chewed leather socks, and claws that a rabid warg would be proud of.  It has all the  cuddly temperament of a bear with a sore bottom.

name: a rascally racoon
shortdesc: A rascally-looking racoon is here, looking for trouble.
longdesc:
This racoon looks like its come straight from the bank which was robbed
at knife point for the contents of the vault.  It has thick grey fur
ending in a striped tail and a mask-like covering over it's eyes.  It
has very dextrous fingers and is likely to steal your money if you get
too close!

name: a cackling goblin
shortdesc: A goblin is here cackling wildly and causing lots of trouble!
longdesc: This is a goblin.  It is short, mean, and green.  It is very pleased with itself and won't stop cackling as it marauders about terrorising the nice tourists.

name: a ticket seller
shortdesc: A bored-looking ticket seller in a bright t-shirt is here.
longdesc: This nice man is selling tickets for Midgard Zoo.  He looks a trifle bored with his lot in life.  But he is wearing a beautiful orange t-shirt with a purple dragon on it.  Tasteful!

name: a Deadly Creatures Exhibit ticket seller
shortdesc: An over-entusiastic ticket seller in a bright t-shirt is here.
longdesc: This nice man is selling tickets for the Deadly Creatures Exhibit. He looks very enthusiastic about this...  But he is wearing a beautiful orange t-shirt with a purple dragon on it.  Nice!

name: a gift shop attendant
shortdesc: An underpaid-overworked gift shop attendant bustles around busily here.
longdesc:
This lovely lady looks after the Midgard Zoo gift shop.  If you want a fluffy lion or
a mug with a goggly eyed panda on it, she's the person to see!

name: Doctor Sagacious Blackwood
shortdesc: Doctor Sagacious Blackwood is here studying various animal remains at her desk.
longdesc:
This is Doctor Sagacious Blackwood.  She is an older lady in her mid to late
fifties with a friendly face and inviting smile.  She is very enthusiastic for
her work and is one of those people who loves to think everyone knows what she
knows about animals and zoology.  She is wearing a functional set of thickly
padded tweed in the form of a skirt, jacket, and ruffle, along with a creamy-
coloured blouse, thick tights and sensible brown shoes.

name: a devious goblin
shortdesc: A goblin is here looking devious!
longdesc: This is a goblin.  It is short, mean, and green.  It looks very devious and probably is planning some nefarious deed!

name: Alcanzar Windu
shortdesc: Alcanzar Windu stands here looking cool AF.
longdesc: He wears a brown robe and oozes cool.  Even Fonzie ain't this cool!

name: The Queen's Soldier Guard
shortdesc: A very big soldier fireant with big pinchers defends the queen.
longdesc: A bright red, fireant angrily defending the queen races towards you.

name: A Fireant
shortdesc:
A worker fireant, busily going about its business of finding food for the
  nest.
longdesc:
A bright red, fireant looking to feed its hungry nest with any and all
possible food sources, scuttles towards you.

name: A Soldier Fireant
shortdesc: A large soldier fireant with big pinchers.
longdesc: A bright red, fireant angrily defending its nest races towards you.

name: The Queen Fireant
shortdesc: A huge, fat queen fireant.
longdesc: Surrounded by white, oval eggs, the queen glares at you with vast hunger.

name: A cute, warg-fido puppy
shortdesc: A cute, but mean looking puppy.
longdesc:
Cute like most baby animals, with too long ears and huge paws. And very
large jaws, filled with huge teeth. Compared to most fidos you have seen,
the teeth are huge.

name: Half-grown warg like pup
shortdesc: Mean, half-grown pup.
longdesc: Larger and meaner looking than your normal fido. It looks very hungry.

name: Nearly grown warg like dog
shortdesc: Large, shaggy warg like fido.
longdesc: Three times the size of your normal fido. It looks very hungry.

name: Large warg
shortdesc: A massive and very aggressive warg.
longdesc:
The largest warg you have ever seen or heard about. It has a sleek, well-fed
look. Though from the way it is looking at you, perhaps it thinks you are
more food. Is it time to panic?

name: Ivan the Trainer
shortdesc: The angry Ivan, trainer of the wargs, stands here.
longdesc:
Ivan is a tall and well-equipped warrior.  He wears some amazingly worked
studded leather armour and carries a fine-looking sword.  Presumably the
wargs are being trained to fence.  Engarde!

name: Mistress Ekaterina Volstova
shortdesc: The beautiful Warg-Mistress Ekaterina Volstova stands here.
longdesc:
This is Ekaterina Volstova.  She is the mistress of this house.  She is
dressed in fine leathers covering nearly every square inch of skin.  She
is a fearsome warrior!  Prepare to die!

name: Andy the brewer
shortdesc: Andy Wilcox, owner, brewer and barkeep is waiting here to serve you.
longdesc:
Andy is a slim, happy guy with glasses and a light beard.  He
graduated from college with a love of computers and beer, and he's
indulging one of those right here.
  He is also a martial arts master so don't even THINK of starting a
fight in here.

name: Big Guy the cat
shortdesc: Big Guy the cat is resting here.  What a lazy cat.
longdesc:
Big Guy is a rather large house cat.  He has complete freedom to
roam the DanjerHaus because his owner holds the lease.  He is usually
lying about catching rays or lumbering towards food.  On the rare
occasions he breaks into a run, it sounds like thunder on the wood
floors.

name: Little Guy the kitten
shortdesc: Little Guy the kitten is sitting at attention.
longdesc:
This little kitten looks like a miniature of Big Guy and has many
of the same mannerisms.

name: Runt the kitten
shortdesc: Runt the kitten is staring at you intently.
longdesc:
This little kitten is the brother of Little Guy and looks like a
lighter colored version of him.

name: the Zombie Master
shortdesc: The Zombie Master is standing here looking very frightening.
longdesc:
The Zombie Master is tall (7'2") and skinny.  He's wearing a tie-dye
T-shirt and blue jeans.  He's fairly handsome if you don't consider
the hordes of walking dead following him around...

name: the Demon Turtle
shortdesc: The Demon Turtle is standing here totally ignoring you.
longdesc:
The Demon Turtle is about 20 feet long and 12 feet high.  He has a shiny
metallic carapace that looks pretty much impervious.  You probably don't
want to mess with him

name: a titanium dragon
shortdesc: An ancient titanium dragon stands here bravely.
longdesc:
This dragon has many scratches on its armor but it looks like nothing ever
got underneath the scales.

name: The demon Vrock
shortdesc: The demon Vrock does not enjoy being purged by DeathDealer.
longdesc:
Vrock is a scary looking birdlike demon about 8' tall.  He has a hatred of
lamias.  You don't want to mess with him because he's Deth's pet.

name: the Replacer
shortdesc: The Replacer stands here.
longdesc: A young guy who lookes bored with his life stands here.

name: the snake
shortdesc: A large dreadful snake.
longdesc: It looks hungry.

name: the green snake
shortdesc: A small green snake.
longdesc: It looks harmless.

name: the centipede
shortdesc: A small centipede.
longdesc: It looks completely harmless.

name: the kobold
shortdesc: A ugly kobold.
longdesc: It looks ugly.

name: the orc
shortdesc: The orc walks around, looking for someone to kill.
longdesc: You notice an evil look in his eyes

name: the orc
shortdesc: A large orc, really mean.
longdesc: He looks dreadful.

name: the bugbear
shortdesc: A hairy bugbear stands here.
longdesc: It looks like a walking carpet.

name: the warrior
shortdesc:
A tall dangerous warrior. He has more scars than anyone you have
  seen before.
longdesc: Well he looks like a strong, brainless fighter.

name: the warrior
shortdesc: A tall warrior.
longdesc: He seems to know his way with weapons.

name: the hobgoblin
shortdesc: A small hobgoblin stands here.
longdesc: The hobgoblin looks quite lost.

name: the snake
shortdesc: A brown snake watches you.
longdesc: The snake looks quite mean.

name: the centipede
shortdesc: A white centipede is here.
longdesc: The centipede doesn't really seem to notice you.

name: the hobgoblin
shortdesc: A large hobgoblin is here.
longdesc: The hobgoblin looks quite dangerous.

name: the orc
shortdesc: An orc is here, looking for something (or perhaps someone ? ) to eat.
longdesc: Well he doesn't seem to be friendly.

name: the bugbear
shortdesc: A hairy bugbear stands here.
longdesc: It looks like a walking carpet.

name: the ogre
shortdesc: An ogre stands here, grinning broadly.
longdesc: It looks rather pleased with itself.

name: the Giant Seamonster
shortdesc: the Seamonster stands here, guarding the gates of Moria
longdesc:
The Seamonster is a huge monster with lots of tentacles sticking out from
it. You can't see its whole body as it's mostly submerged in the pond.

name: Balgor Onetusk
shortdesc: Balgor Onetusk, Orc Hero of Moria, is here sharpening his tusk.
longdesc:
This is Balgor.  Or 'Boss' to his friends.  He's big.  He's mean.  He's
green.  He doesn't hulk out.  He wears a single spiky pauldron and wields
a similarly spiky club.  He's even painted a skull on his armour to show
how tough he is.  Oh, and he's only got one big spiky tusk in his mouth -
a clue to his nickname!

name: Barbs Kannon
shortdesc: Barbs Kannon lounges here, counting out her wealth.
longdesc:
Barbara 'Barbs' Kannon is a thief, and a damn good thief at that.
Originally from Midgard, she ran from the Shadow Guards as a child when
caught stealing food to feed her dying mother.  She now lives like a
queen (of thieves) in the depths of Moria.  She is well into her fourth
decade and has a face so covered in scar tissue that you could play tic-
tac-toe on it.  But don't let her pretty demeanour fool you, she is an
athletic, fearsome killer who would do anything for profit.

name: Pippi Hornfoot
shortdesc: Pippi Hornfoot, the Big Bad Bandit Boss is here, trying to look mean and tough.
longdesc:
Pippi Hornfoot is a somewhat soft and round Halfling with rosey cheeks and
a mass of ginger curls.  And although she looks like she'd serve you a nice
cold pint in a quiet pub in the Shire, she is actually a master criminal
and bandit out to make more gold than the founders of Fortrum could imagine.
She is wearing a tough pair of leather boots, leather britches and a starched
white shirt with the sleeves rolled up revealing a mass of tattoos that seem
out of place on one such as Pippi.  Across her knuckles you make out a series
of letters that spell (badly) 'C O W E' and 'P E Y E'... Probably a reference
to her favourite meal.

name: the Mage
shortdesc:
A small intelligent looking mage is standing here. It looks like he
  knows his way with the magic.
longdesc: His IQ makes almost any dikumud player look stupid..

name: the troll
shortdesc: A large mean-looking troll is here.
longdesc: Well, he looks dangerous.!

name: the snake
shortdesc: A large green snake, looks like a guardian for an evil force.
longdesc: You see a evil creature.

name: the Thief
shortdesc: A thief, all dressed in black.
longdesc: Well, COUNT your money..!

name: the orc
shortdesc: A ugly orc is standing here.
longdesc: Yrkk..

name: a centipede
shortdesc: A small harmless centipede is here.
longdesc: It doesn't seem to pay any attention to you.

name: the Warrior
shortdesc: A human warrior is here. He has a evil grin in his face.
longdesc: He doesn't look friendly at all...

name: the kobold
shortdesc: A green kobold is here.
longdesc: It looks slimy..

name: the bugbear
shortdesc: A hairy bugbear stands here.
longdesc: It looks like a walking carpet.

name: the ogre
shortdesc: An ogre stands here, grinning broadly.
longdesc: It looks rather pleased with itself.

name: the bugbear
shortdesc: A hairy bugbear stands here.
longdesc: It looks like a walking carpet.

name: the ogre
shortdesc: An ogre stands here, grinning broadly.
longdesc: It looks rather pleased with itself.

name: the Cavern Crawler
shortdesc: The cavern crawler lurks here, ready to ensnare its prey!
longdesc:
The cavern crawler looks like a giant spider but with ten legs and more
eyes than a witches soup.  It has fangs.  And very probably a venom sack.
It would be wise to turn back now!

name: Gary the Giant Warrior
shortdesc: The gigantic warrior Gary is here scratching at his plethora of scars.  He looks dangerous.
longdesc:
This is Gary.  He appears to be a very strong and extremely capable
fighter.  Shame he doesn't have an amazingly heroic name to match.

name: The dervish
shortdesc: The raggity dervish walks on aimlessly.
longdesc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
some rest.

name: The dervish
shortdesc: The large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
LOTS of rest.

name: The coral snake
shortdesc: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
longdesc:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.

name: The small scorpion
shortdesc: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
longdesc: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

name: The giant, purple sand worm
shortdesc: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
longdesc: He's EXTREMELEY big, mean, and purple. Watch out!

name: The brass dragon
shortdesc: A very large brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says "Hello".
longdesc: The brass dragon is large, brassy and very majestic!  It seems friendly enough.

name: The nomad leader
shortdesc: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
longdesc:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread. At his side
is a large, engraved cutlass. He has an especially haughty air
about him.

name: The nomad commander
shortdesc: The nomad commander stands here staring suspiciously at you.
longdesc:
This is the nomad leader's second in command. His clothes are richly
woven of silk and gold thread. A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.

name: The nomad warrior
shortdesc: A proud nomad warrior stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The slave
shortdesc: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.
longdesc: What are you looking at?

name: The dracolich
shortdesc: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
longdesc:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.

name: The drider
shortdesc: The drider looks at you with anger while it draws its sword.
longdesc: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

name: The dark dwarf
shortdesc: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
longdesc: The duergar could crush your head as easily as it does those rocks.

name: The myconoid
shortdesc: A myconoid lumbers along peacefully.
longdesc:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably
has the same effect).

name: The myconoid shaman
shortdesc: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tounge.
longdesc: The shaman shoots spores into the air.

name: The dustdigger
shortdesc: A small oasis invites you to dive in.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The rabid camel
shortdesc: A very dangerous rabid camel snorts at you.
longdesc: Don't mess with this animal.

name: The sand worm
shortdesc: The young sandworm launches out of the sand to attack you!
longdesc:
It is about 50 feet long, and looks very dangerous.  Better
flee!

name: a goblin slave
shortdesc: A goblin slave stands here awaiting orders.
longdesc:
This poor goblin has been enslaved by the Drow.  He obeys every order
without question, for the consequences of disobedience far outweigh
whatever task his cruel master's inflict upon him.

name: a Drow commoner of House Udrinor
shortdesc: A Drow commoner wearing the sigil of House Udrinor is here.
longdesc:
Drow commoners are common in every house in Drow society. They
function as guards, servants, cooks, cleaners and a plethora of
other roles that are beneath the nobles. They are the fodder on
the field of battle. But don't let their lesser status fool you,
even a Drow commoner is a dangerous foe! This one wears a sigil
that shows he belongs to House Udrinor.

name: a Drow commoner of House Udrinor
shortdesc: A female Drow commoner wearing the sigil of House Udrinor is here, supervising.
longdesc:
Even in the lowest ranks of Drow society, the females are the
stronger, more dominant sex of the species. No female, no matter
what her status, would ever be so common as to be a servant or
cook. No. The females are always in charge of something and this
one is supervising the tasks that her lesser male cousins and the
slaves are performing. Don't let her lesser status fool you, it
is well know that every Drow female has the ability to cast spells!
This one wears a sigil that shows she belongs to House Udrinor.

name: A Drow warrior of House Udrinor
shortdesc: A Drow warrior of House Udrinor stands here at his post.
longdesc:
Drow warriors are elite combatants, trained from the youngest age to be
skilled in all weapons and tactics. It can be said that even the lowliest
of Drow warriors is more than a match for any warrior of any other race.
At least, that is said by the Drow themselves. He is dressed in elaborate
armour and carries a deadly, magical weapon to help him at his task. This
one wears the sigil of House Udrinor.

name: A Drow mage Noble of House Udrinor
namelist: drow noble mage udrinor male elf
shortdesc: A Drow mage Noble of House Udrinor stands here bending the winds of magic.
longdesc:
Drow males are forbidden to directly worship their cruel diety, Lloth, so
Noble males have the choice of becoming Weaponsmaster's or Mages. Very few
choose the life of a warrior, preferring the prestige and power that being
a mighty mage will bring them. It is only the mages who rival the clergy,
the priestesses, in power. A fact that makes every Drow priestess extremely
wary of any mage. This one wears the sigil of House Udrinor.

name: A Drow priestess of House Udrinor
shortdesc: A Drow priestess of House Udrinor is here attending to her matron.
longdesc:
Every noble Drow house has at least one Priestess to serve and aid her
Matron Mother. The more powerful the house, the priestesses that will
be in attendance to the Matron, for this is where the main bulk of the
Drow power flows from. The priestesses are the voice and will of Lloth,
and every priestess has the desire to become a Matron Mother herself.
Stronger than any male, these are scourges of Drow society, the rulers
and the peacemakers. Nothing is more feared. This one wears the sigil
of House Udrinor.

shortdesc: A Drow priestess of House Sardavac is here attending to her matron.

name: The Weaponmaster of House Parastric
shortdesc: The Drow Weaponmaster of House Parastric is here practicing his swordplay.
longdesc:
Without being a mage, a weaponmaster is the highest honour that a male
can attain in Drow society. These warriors have advanced to legendary
status with their weapons, often dual-wielding or using unconventional
pole-arms just to show off their skills. Weaponmaster's train warriors
from all Houses, and it is not uncommon for a Weaponmaster to train
nobles from more powerful houses, thus earning their own house prestige
and fame. Anyone tackling a weaponmaster should be wary, for not only
are these males skilled at arms, they are often adorned with the very
best of magical aids. This weaponmaster wears the sigil of House
Parastric.

name: Haeltyna Udrinor, Matron Mother of House Udrinor
namelist: drow matron mother haeltyna udrinor female elf
shortdesc: Matron Mother Haeltyna Udrinor of House Udrinor is standing here, glowering.
longdesc:
The singular most powerful position in Drow society is that of Matron
Mother. It is not just a title, she literally is the mother of her
House, having given birth to most of the Drow in powerful positions
beneath her. She is a powerful priestess, blessed by her cruel deity,
Lloth. Although a Matron Mother will rarely leave the relative safety
of her house boundaries, when she does all fear her very tread, for
her word is life and death.

Matron Healtyna Udrinor is a young Drow of a meagre ninety years.  She
has a powerful, if short, frame and looks like she could crush your
skull quite easily.

name: Qitlara Sardavac, Matron Mother of House Sardavac
namelist: drow matron mother qitlara sardavac female elf
shortdesc: Matron Mother Qitlara Sardavac of House Sardavac is standing here, snarling.
longdesc:
The singular most powerful position in Drow society is that of Matron
Mother. It is not just a title, she literally is the mother of her
House, having given birth to most of the Drow in powerful positions
beneath her. She is a powerful priestess, blessed by her cruel deity,
Lloth. Although a Matron Mother will rarely leave the relative safety
of her house boundaries, when she does all fear her very tread, for
her word is life and death.

Matron Qitlara Sardavac is a stern looking Drow standing just over five
feet tall.  Every inch of her perfect, ebony skin is covered in a dazzling
array of swirling white tattoos that seem to make her glow with evil intent.

name: Indica Violenta Parastric, Matron Mother of House Parastric
namelist: drow matron mother indica violenta parastric female elf
shortdesc: Indica Violenta Parastric, Matron Mother of House Parastric is standing here, growling.
longdesc:

Mother. It is not just a title, she literally is the mother of her

Matron Indica Violenta Parastric is an ancient woman.  Her skin has
paled over the millennia is lined and wrinkled.  She sits hunched up
small and almost vulnerable.  Yet, there is an underlying sense of
tremendous power about her.

name: Ruinia Moivas, Matron Mother of House Moivas
namelist: drow matron mother ruinia moivas female elf
shortdesc: Ruinia Moivas, Matron Mother of House Moivas is standing here, hissing.
longdesc:
The singular most powerful position in Drow society is that of Matron
Mother. It is not just a title, she literally is the mother of her
House, having given birth to most of the Drow in powerful positions
beneath her. She is a powerful priestess, blessed by her cruel deity,
Lloth. Although a Matron Mother will rarely leave the relative safety
of her house boundaries, when she does all fear her very tread, for
her word is life and death.

Ruinia Moivas is a diminutive woman, even for a Drow.  She stands shorter
than most of the males that serve her.  Yet, under that short stature and
that sweet smile and those lavender eyes, rages the destructive, evil,
malign soul of a true terror.

name: A yochlol
shortdesc: A yochlol forms out of a swirling mist.
longdesc:
A yochlol! The very handmaiden of the Drow deity Lloh herself! This
demonic creature was clearly summoned, although for what purpose is
yet unknown. The creature appears to look like a melted blob of wax
with 8 arms that continually reforms and remoulds itself. Yuck!

name: a hobgoblin slave
shortdesc: A small hobgoblin stands here, doing what it's told.
longdesc:
This Hobgoblin is lifting and dragging masonry, hard at work for the
cruel Drow master's that it is forced to serve. Whatever it is doing,
it is a sign that the Drow are clearly up to something.

name: an ogre slave
shortdesc: An ogre stands grunts as it carries something heavy.
longdesc:
Not even the ogre's are safe from the slavery of the Drow. This
poor beast is being used to haul heavy machinery under the watchful
gaze and cruel whip of his Drow overseer.

name: The Weaponmaster of House Moivas
shortdesc: The Drow Weaponmaster of House Moivas is here training budding warriors.
longdesc:

Moivas.

namelist: drow commoner vexidyre male elf messenger
shortdesc: A Drow commoner wearing the sigil of House Vexidyre is here delivering a message.
longdesc:

function as guards, servants, cooks, cleaners and a plethora of
other roles that are beneath the nobles. They are the fodder on
the field of battle. But don't let their lesser status fool you,
even a Drow commoner is a dangerous foe! This one wears a sigil
that shows he belongs to House Vexidyre.

name: a hideous drider
shortdesc: A hideous drider stands here, ready to defend it's Mistress.
longdesc: Driders are aberrations that were once Drow.  These individuals either angered Lloth or failed one of Her tests, and the priestesses performed the rituals required to mutate the lackless Drow into the abomination you see before you: half-Drow from the waist up, and half-spider from the waist down.

name: a grotesque drider
shortdesc: A grotesque drider stands here, ready to defend it's Mistress.
longdesc: Driders are aberrations that were once Drow.  These individuals either angered Lloth or failed one of Her tests, and the priestesses performed the rituals required to mutate the lackless Drow into the abomination you see before you: half-Drow from the waist up, and half-spider from the waist down.

name: a buggy bug
shortdesc: A bug is here! Quick! Slay it!
longdesc: This is a tiny little bug. It is brown. It is up to no good! Slay it!

name: Rakdagor Weaponlord Ryltar Vek'Zor
shortdesc: The Weaponlord of Rakdagor, Ryltar Vek'zor, is here, whirling his blade Darkfire around him.
longdesc:
This arrogant drow is Ryltar Vek'Zor, Weaponlord of Rakdagor. He is tall
and lean with the coiled grace of a serpent about to strike.  His dark,
obsidian skin gleams like polished stone, marred only by faint ritual
scars left by the dark priestesses across his collarbone - marking him
as a chosen of the Spider Queen.  His Long silver-white hair is bound in
tight braids, each threaded with onyx beads to represent a kill in ritual
combat.  His crimson eyes burn with a cold calculation, and his expression
rarely shifts beyond a smirk or scowl.

name: The mighty beholder
shortdesc: You meet a beholder's deadly gaze!
longdesc:
It has a large central eye that projects an anti-magic ray and ten
eyestalks atop the round body which can do anything from charm you
to disintegrate you.  Beholders are not known for their personality.

name: The lamia
shortdesc: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
longdesc:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

name: The mimic
shortdesc: A strong chest lies in one corner of the room.
longdesc:
A strong, wooden chest bound with iron straps and a heavy pad-lock on the
front.

name: The mimic
shortdesc: Two skeletons lie crushed under a large boulder.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The mimic
shortdesc: The stone floor of this house has been ripped apart.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The mimic
shortdesc: Some broken shards of potery lie strewn about the floor.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The mimic
shortdesc: A few wooden planks lie stacked on a low shelf.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The horned lizard
shortdesc: A small horned lizard flicks his tounge and slithers away.
longdesc: A cute little lizard, that is, if you like reptiles!

name: The stone golem
shortdesc: In the corner you see a large, stone golem faithfully standing watch.
longdesc:
It is a big chunk of rock that has been magically formed into a giant
stone creature. He stands here still guarding the city.

name: The iron golem
shortdesc: A Huge iron golem stands here.  He raises his sword to strike you.
longdesc:
It has been set here to guard the nexus gate.  It will allow no intruders
to pass.

name: The lamia
shortdesc: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
longdesc:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

name: The iron golem
shortdesc: A large iron golem stands here.
longdesc: He is large, and metallic.

name: The clay golem
shortdesc: A clay golem stands here
longdesc: He is large, and ceramic.

name: The stone golem
shortdesc: A stone golem stands here
longdesc: He looks large and granite.

name: The spectre
shortdesc: A spectre stands here, reaching out for you.
longdesc: He looks sad.

name: The mummy
shortdesc: A mummy gasps in astonishment at your success thus far.
longdesc: He looks like he wants to change your luck.

name: The statue
shortdesc: A statue of Akinra stands here, and blocks your path.
longdesc: He looks really mean.

name: Anubis
shortdesc: Anubis sits in his throne, wearing a glowing key.
longdesc: He has the body of a man, and the head of a jackal.

name: The mimic
shortdesc: An ornate chest sits in the corner.
longdesc: It looks well made.

name: A rust monster
shortdesc: A rust monster squats here, eagerly eyeing your armor and weapons.
longdesc: It looks hungry.

name: A black pudding
shortdesc: A black pudding oozes towards you.
longdesc: It is gelantinous and gooey.

name: The nile crocodile
shortdesc: The nile crocodile swallows the last of his rat appetizer.
longdesc: I bet you're next!

name: The guardian naga
shortdesc: The guardian naga slithers toward you to protect her lair.
longdesc: You are intruders, and you must die.

name: The rabid rat
shortdesc: The rabid rat scurries towards you.  Its eyes glowing deep red.
longdesc: They scurry into the shadows and attack en-masse.

name: John the Lumberjack
shortdesc: John the Lumberjack is here, looking for some trees to chop down.
longdesc:
He is six feet tall and looks quite strong, muscles bulging under his heavy,
chequered shirt.  His features are worn with hard work and his expression is
one of a peaceful man leading a simple life.

name: the cute rabbit
shortdesc: A cute rabbit is here.
longdesc: It is a small, furry creature with long ears and big feet.

name: the brown bear
shortdesc: A big, brown, angry-looking bear is here.
longdesc:
The bear is a big, brown, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp
teeth.  It doesn't resemble those cute little thingies from toy shops at all.

name: the ferocious rabbit
shortdesc: A ferocious rabbit is here, glaring hungrily at you.
longdesc:
This small, furry creature with long ears and big feet has been attacked by
the dreaded rabbit rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and innocent
rabbits into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters.

name: the fallow deer
shortdesc: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.
longdesc:
She is a graceful creature on long, slender legs, and with large, brown eyes
looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.

name: the brown fox
shortdesc: A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.
longdesc: It is a large fox with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick brush.

name: A large troll
shortdesc: A large troll is standing here growling at you.. better run!
longdesc: A big ugly mean looking troll, not fun!

name: A large troll
shortdesc: A large troll is standing here growling at you.. better run!
longdesc: A big ugly mean looking troll, not fun!

name: the vicious warg
shortdesc: A vicious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
longdesc:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

name: the ferocious warg
shortdesc: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
longdesc:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

name: the large, grey wolf
shortdesc: A large, grey wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
longdesc: The large, grey wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

name: the large, black wolf
shortdesc: A large, black wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
longdesc: The large, black wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

name: a huge ancient tree
shortdesc: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
longdesc:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground.

The enormous grey trunk shivers slightly, as if sighing deeply.

name: a huge ancient tree
shortdesc: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
longdesc:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground.
>
The enormous grey trunk emits a deep, moaning sound.

name: a huge, green dragon
shortdesc: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
longdesc:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

name: the huge, poisonous spider
shortdesc: A huge, poisonous spider is here.
longdesc:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a human crawling on all four.  It
has eight hairy legs that gives it a tremendous speed on almost any surface and
sharp poisonous fangs to paralyze or kill its prey.

name: the Queen Spider
shortdesc: The huge, bulky Queen Spider is here.
longdesc:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
if it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.

name: Shargugh
shortdesc: Shargugh the Forest Brownie is here, grinning broadly at you.
longdesc:
This little fellow is only three foot tall with wild matted brown hair and long
tangled brown beard.  He wears ragged brown and green clothing and looks as if
he is having great fun.

name: the huge blue dragon
shortdesc: A huge blue dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
longdesc:
This enormous winged serpent has dark blue scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

name: A quickling commoner
shortdesc: A quickling commoner is here, running circles around you.
longdesc:
The quickling commoner is extremely fast, you almost break you neck trying
to turn your head as fast as he moves.

name: A quickling raider
shortdesc: A quickling raider standing here blurs into a att0k position.
longdesc: The quickling raider att0ks you with a frenzied blood-lust.

name: A baby quickling
shortdesc: A baby quickling is  here, running around looking for someone to "play" with.
longdesc:
The baby quicklings look kind of cute, but you are not decieved their
obviously malicious intent.

name: The Queen of the Quicklings
shortdesc: The Queen of the Quicklings here ignores you as she orders commoners around.
longdesc:
The Queen of the Quicklings does not appear to 0knowledge your existence
as she orders quickling commoners to do their menial tasks.

name: The Raider Captain of the Quicklings
shortdesc: The Raider Captain is a large, extremely fast quickling.
longdesc:
The Raider Captain of the Quicklings frowns at your entrance into the
barracks, and orders his troops to att0k you!

name: A quickling raider guard
shortdesc: A quickling raider guard here blurs into a att0k position.
longdesc: The quickling raider guard att0ks you, determined to hold his position.

name: Tephanis, King of the Quicklings
shortdesc: Tephanis glares at you with unconcealed hatred blazing in his eyes.
longdesc:
Tephanis is the biggest, fastest, most dangerous quickling you've ever
seen.  He gets off his throne angrily and rushes to att0k you!

name: The quickling look-out guard
shortdesc: The Quickling Guard here assigned to spy on Midgaard ignores you completely.
longdesc:
He is hunched over some sort of spy glass which is looks through.  It
appears to be pointed in the direction of Midgaard.

name: Rezrae the Suntail
shortdesc: The ancient blue dragon Rezrae the Suntail is here.
longdesc:
Rezrae the Suntail is an ancient blue dragon who has made her lair in the
thick, dense brush of the Haondor Forest.  She is an elusive creature, but
has been known to go on the odd murderous rampage to seek out treasure for
her nest...

name: Duskwing
shortdesc: The ancient green dragon Duskwing is here.
longdesc:
Duskwing is an immense green dragon who is probably older than the forest he
can be found in.  He has dark green scales and a creamy-white underbelly.  He
is as beautiful as he is cruel.  A pair of curling horns adorn his handsome
head like a wicked halo.

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A dwarven guard is here.
longdesc: The guard looks very tough and mean.

name: a dwarven worker
shortdesc: A dwarven mining worker is here.
longdesc: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

name: a Night Wraith
shortdesc: A Wraith is awaiting your first move here.
longdesc: A black, almost transparent wraith.

name: the Hide & Tooth storekeeper
shortdesc: There is the Hide & Tooth storekeeper standing here, waiting patiently.
longdesc: The storekeeper is very rotund, but looks in excellent condition.

name: Granite Head the baker
shortdesc: Granite Head, the baker, is waiting for a customer here.
longdesc: Granite Head is covered with flour and grains.

name: The giant lizard
shortdesc: A giant lizard is here.
longdesc:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to it's underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.

name: The giant
shortdesc: A giant is here.
longdesc:
The giant is about 8 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks in
excellent physical condition.

name: A dwarven mineworker
shortdesc: A dwarven mineworker is here.
longdesc: The mineworker is very tired, and very dirty, and he has bulging muscles.

name: A dwarven mine leader
shortdesc: A dwarven mine leader is here.
longdesc: The mine leader is very big and very strong.

name: the dwarven doctor
shortdesc: The dwarven doctor is here.
longdesc: He is a very skilled surgeon, with hands of steel.

name: the dwarven peon
shortdesc: A dwarven peon is awaiting help here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the dwarf
shortdesc: A dwarf is here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the unwanted son
shortdesc: An unwanted son is here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the unwanted daughter
shortdesc: An unwanted daughter is here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the barrack's guard
shortdesc: A barrack guard is here.
longdesc: He looks alert

name: the dwarf in waiting
shortdesc: A dwarf in waiting is here.
longdesc: He looks bored.

name: the mazekeeper
shortdesc: A mazekeeper is here.
longdesc: He looks VERY tough.

name: the giant snake
shortdesc: There is a giant snake here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: Death
shortdesc: Death the Grim Reaper is observing you silently from empty eye sockets.
longdesc: The dark-robed skeletal figure radiates an unendurable coldness.

name: The horrifying Mudmonster
shortdesc: A horrifying Mudmonster is slowly evolving from the mud ...
longdesc:
It sure looks like something out of a horror movie. It strongly resembles
a huge figure made up from mud alone, and it sure looks like it had human
flesh for breakfast and is strongly intent on having the same for dinner
- Perhaps you?

name: The small bat
shortdesc: The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling, obviously sleeping.
longdesc:
You have never in your entire life seen such a mean looking small creature,
though it looks rather peaceful, hanging there, sleeping. The thought of
arousing this cruel creature doesn't appeal to you

name: The Great Sewer Rat
shortdesc: The Huge Hungry-looking Sewer Rat sits here
longdesc: It is large, and very hungry looking

name: The small Spider
shortdesc: The small hairy Spider
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The giant earth beetle
shortdesc: The Giant Mean-looking Earth Beetle
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The maggot
shortdesc: The Giant Maggot
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The slithering snake
shortdesc: The snake slithers towards you
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The evil wanderer
shortdesc: The evil wanderer stares at you
longdesc: The evil wanderer is very thin. He is dressed in a grey cloak.

name: the creature homonculous
shortdesc: The creature homonculous is here, looking at you with an evil look.
longdesc:
The Homonculous appers in a man-like form, about 18'' tall, have a
greenish, reptilian skin, leathery wings, and a batlike mouth, with
teeth passing on a venom.

name: The Grand Knight of Paladins
shortdesc: The Grand Knight is standing here, waiting for someone to help.
longdesc:
The Knight is standing here, smiling at you. He is dressed all in
white, blue and silver. He looks VERY strong, as he stands here, ready to
help the innocent.

name: the evil chr-eff'n
shortdesc: The chr-eff'n is crawling here, looking around with its yellow eyes.
longdesc:
The head and torso of a chr-eff'n is copper-covered, with yellow
