glowing eyes. The lower body is in an orange shading.

name: the shadowy morkoth
shortdesc: The morkoth are standing here, waiting for someone to KILL!
longdesc:
It's a five feet tall, shadow monster. This has the shape between
a human and a rat. It breaths very heavily, while it stares at you.

name: Madam Esther
shortdesc: Madam Esther is standing here, trying to sell dust.
longdesc:
She is very big standing here, smiling to you. She looks like the
mother of the town, sometimes playing with the children, sometimes
helping the old people, with their daily work. All this in spite of
her own hard work.

name: The young red dragon
shortdesc: A young yet fierce looking red dragon stares at you angrily
longdesc:
The young red dragon stares at you, angrilly, as he wakes when you
arrives.  He says 'Oh, human YOU woke me up...Hsssss', as
he moves closer ,'Can one NEVER sleep in peace..Hssss'.

name: The sea hag
shortdesc: The Sea Hag is swimming around here
longdesc:
The sea hag is so ghastly looking that you feel the deepest
fear. Big yellow eyes and sharp teeth. Its ears are very big,
and it have small sharp horns. This type of monsters are one of
the greatest haters of beauty (Next after Medusa).

name: The guardian naga
shortdesc: The Guardian Naga looks kindly at you.
longdesc:
The naga are a snake-liked creature. She is covered in green-gold
scale with silvery triangles along her back. Her eyes are golden.
She notice that you look at her, and she says: 'Watch out. This way
leads to some evil creatures'.

name: The scaled basilisk
shortdesc: The scaled Basilisk crawls towards you slowly.
longdesc:
The basilisk is a reptilian monster. It has eight legs, and a strong
toothy jaws. It is dull brown with yellowish underbell. It's eyes are
glowing pale green.

name: The lemure
shortdesc: The lemure blob slithers terribly precisely towards you for an attack!
longdesc:
This looks like a vaguely human blob. Big black yellow eyes, and a
mouth going a little bit out from the face. The lemure does not look
interested in you at all, but anyway it attackes. It looks like it's
mind has been burned out.

name: Jones 'cruncher' the ettin
shortdesc: Jones is standing here glaring at you.
longdesc:
At the first sight you thought Jones was an Orc, but when it came
closer you saw his second head. He wears an animal skinn dress,
filthy and moth eaten. Jones really stinks...

name: Harold 'the mouse-killer' ettin
shortdesc: Harold is standing here looking confused at you.
longdesc:
When you look at Harold, you feel petty. His dress are really poor,
and the one of his heads hangs down. At the rope around his stomach
hangs dead mouses and rats. He does not smell good.

name: The master mindflayer
shortdesc: The master mindflayer is here, looking at you with an evil look.
longdesc:
It's a seven foot tall humanoid dressed in a purple cloak, and swinging a
black and purple rod above its head as if it was going to attack you any
moment now. In the middle of its head are four tentacles with sharp points.

name: The senior mindflayer
shortdesc: The senior mindflayer walks around here, looking for something useful.
longdesc:
This is a horrifying monster indeed, 6'6" high. Dressed in purple and black,
and carrying a large mace in its hand. In the center of its head are four large
tentacles with very sharp points.

name: The junior mindflayer
shortdesc: The junior mindflayer is here, watching you carefully from the corner.
longdesc:
This mindflayer is six foot high. It has a small mace in its belt, and is
dressed in purple and black cloth. It has four small tentacles in the
center of its head.

name: The ugly wererat
shortdesc: An ugly wererat is here, looking at you with a strange flick in his eyes.
longdesc:
The wererat is about four foot tall. It looks very much like rat, exept
that it is standing.

name: The gigantic rat
shortdesc: There is a gigantic rat here, looking at you with a hungry look.
longdesc:
The gigantic rat is about ten foot long from head to tail and has claws
the size of your head looking very nasty.

name: the Asp
shortdesc: A hissing asp slithers nearby.
longdesc: The asp looks quick and mean

name: The creepy spider
shortdesc: A creepy spider crawls around.
longdesc: It is about 10 inches long, with small fangs.

name: The Norwegian Blue
shortdesc: the Norwegian Blue parrot is here, it's just stunned.
longdesc: It has remarkable plumage.

name: The baby pigmy brontosaurus
shortdesc: The baby pigmy brontosaurus is here, looking for her momma.
longdesc:
There are supposed to be LOTS of dinosaurs out there somewhere!  This one
is just 6' tall, and looks very confused.

name: The baby crocodile
shortdesc: The baby crocodile is here, looking for ducks to eat.
longdesc: It looks like a 2' replica of a a bigger crocodile.

name: The baby llama
shortdesc: The baby llama is here, looking cute and pettable.
longdesc: She just looks so darn CUTE!

name: The scruffy mutt
shortdesc: The scruffy mutt is here, digging for bones.
longdesc: He looks small and weak.

name: The frothing dog
shortdesc: A frothing dog is here, acting rabid.
longdesc: He is large, and madness fills his eyes.

name: The starving coyote
shortdesc: A starving coyote is here, gnawing on a root.
longdesc: He is large and very hungry

name: The laughing hyena
shortdesc: a laughing hyena is here, grinning and resting.
longdesc: He is very large and has powerful jaws

name: The Norwegian black
shortdesc: a norwegian black parrot is here, cawing angrily.
longdesc: He is large, and looks much more active than the norwegian blue.

name: The Norwegian red
shortdesc: A norwegian red parrot is here.
longdesc: He used to be black, but it is covered in bright red blood

name: The fire beetle
shortdesc: A large black fire beetle is here
longdesc: It has a glowing red abdomen

name: The large spider
shortdesc: A large spider is here, looking for food
longdesc: It is about 2' long, with 3' legs.  It is covered in black hair.

name: The nasty scorpion
shortdesc: A nasty looking scorpion is here, looking for food
longdesc: It is about 3' long, and has a long sting

name: The spider Monkey
shortdesc: The spider monkey is here, acting silly.
longdesc: He is quick and nimble

name: The nasty chimp
shortdesc: A chimp is here, it snarls at you nastily.
longdesc: He is filthy and viscious.

name: The big gorilla
shortdesc: A big gorilla is here looking for food.
longdesc: She is gentle unless provoked

name: The horned lizard
shortdesc: A Horned lizard is here, searching for food.
longdesc: It is about 3 feet long.

name: The Monty Python
shortdesc: A Monty Python is here.  It is dressed up as an old lady.
longdesc: It appears to think that it is a housewife from Bristol.

name: The Huge gila monster
shortdesc: A huge gila monster is here. Beware its poison!
longdesc: It is very pretty for a nasty thing.

name: The Brown bear
shortdesc: A Brown bear is here.
longdesc: She is large, but cute.

name: The Black bear
shortdesc: A black bear is here.
longdesc: He is fairly large and impressive looking.

name: The Grizzly bear
shortdesc: A Grizzly bear is here, he looks mean.
longdesc: He is very large, and looks very dangerous if provoked.

name: The tawny cougar
shortdesc: A tawny cougar is here.
longdesc: He is small and looks almost tame.

name: The young lion
shortdesc: A young lion is here.
longdesc: He hasn't made much of a mane for himself.

name: The Bengal tiger
shortdesc: A white bengal tiger is here.
longdesc: Large and very ferocious looking.

name: The Giant Norwegian Green
shortdesc: A Giant norwegian green parrot is here.
longdesc: He is Very large for a parrot!

name: The Hel Hound
shortdesc: A vicious hel hound is here, prowling for prey
longdesc: His eyes are sulfurous glowing red!

name: The slasher monkey
shortdesc: A gruesome slasher monkey is here, waving its sharp claws menacingly
longdesc: His fangs and claws are razor sharp!

name: The cocorada
shortdesc: A disgustingly large cocorada bug is here
longdesc: She looks like a giant praying mantis.

name: The alligator
shortdesc: A huge hungry alligator is here.
longdesc: Mean, green and lean.  'Nuff said.

name: The Saber-Tooth Tiger
shortdesc: A huge Saber-Tooth tiger is here, growling angrily
longdesc: His fangs are enormous and he is nearly 6' at the shoulder!

name: A Polar Bear
shortdesc: A giant white polar bear is here.
longdesc: He looks VERY mean.

name: the Vampire bat
shortdesc: A Vampire bat is here.
longdesc:
He hovers around your head, waiting for his moment to strike....

OUCH!
That REALLY hurt!

name: The Vampiress
shortdesc: A vampiress stands here
longdesc: Lovely in every detail, but Lethal!

name: The screaming, filthy harpy
shortdesc: The screaming, filthy harpy claws madly at your face!
longdesc:
The harpy looks at you with blood in her eyes.  Her entire body is
caked in filth and grime and she stinks to high heaven.  Her razor-
sharp talons flex as she considers you for her dinner.

name: The screaming harpy leader
shortdesc: The screaming harpy leader tries to scratch your eyes out!
longdesc:
The harpy leader looks at you and grins menacingly.  She stretches
her wings and you see insects crawling around them.  Her hair is
matted and greasy and you are sickened by the stench that pervades
her presence.

name: The ghostly air elemental
shortdesc: The ghostly air elemental.
longdesc:
The air elemental is hard to see.  You know that it is there
because objects behind it seem to waver and are slightly blurred.

name: The mysterious effreeti
shortdesc: The mysterious effreeti grins in delight at its new prey.
longdesc:
The effreeti towers menacingly over you.  It is dressed in the
finest ghostly silks and a headdress with an elaborate brooch.

name: The gigantic roc
shortdesc: The gigantic roc.
longdesc:
This bird has a wingspan that stretches several spearlengths.  It
moves surprisingly fast for something of its size.

name: The gigantic roc
shortdesc: The gigantic roc stares menacingly at you.
longdesc:
This bird has a wingspan that stretches several spear-lengths.  It
moves surprisingly fast for something of its size.

name: the ugly, wicked witch
shortdesc: The ugly, wicked witch cackles maniacally.
longdesc:
The witch has jet black hair and sickly green skin.  She is covered
with warts and boils.  Her nails are long and sharp and look like
they would be quite painful.  Her eyes pierce your very soul.

name: the orc
shortdesc: A ugly orc is standing here.
longdesc: Yrkk..

name: the Elite Hill Giant
shortdesc: There is a very large Hill Giant standing here.
longdesc:
A 10 and 1/2 foot tall humanoid stands before you. He has reddish brown skin,
black hair and red rimmed eyes. He is wearing the hides of some large creature.
He strangely appears a bit more alert than your average hill giant.

name: the Hill Giant Chieftain
shortdesc: The Chieftain of the Hill Giants is standing here.
longdesc:
The largest and meanest looking Hill Giant you have ever seen stands before
you. He has the scars from many bodies across his body. He is wearing some
hides of a very large dragon. He returns you look with a look of pure and utter
hatred.

name: The Hill Giant Chieftess
shortdesc: The Chieftess of the Hill Giants is standing here.
longdesc:
The largest female you have ever seen stands before you. She has a moose skin
wrapped around her shoulders. You smell the scent of "Eau de Giant" originating
from her. She appears to be heading off to go shopping. A huge stone VISA card
is clenched between her fingers.

name: The Cloud Giant Ambassador
shortdesc: The Ambassador of the Cloud Giants is standing here.
longdesc:
A strange looking giant stands before you. He has a light blue skin, silver
hair, and is about 18 feet tall. He is wearing a badge of the Cloud Giant Clan
from the east. He looks at you with an interested look in his eyes.

name: The Stone Giant
shortdesc: A large Stone Giant is standing here.
longdesc:
A 12 foot tall, gray skinned, silver eyed giant with blue-gray hair stands
before you. He has a stoney appearance to his skin. His rock colored garments
make him tough to pick out from the shadows of the light.

name: The Cave Bear
shortdesc: A large Cave Bear is standing here.
longdesc:
A incredibly large bear stands on his hind legs before you. He has got to be a
full 12 foot tall! The bear has a dark brown fur coloring and its growl is very
loud and powerful sounding.

name: The Dwarf
shortdesc: A Dwarf with a crazed look in his eyes paces around the room frantically.
longdesc:
He appears to have been a great warrior at one time, now driven insane through
some inhuman torture. Scars cover his body and he has a strange, confused look
in his eyes. He is frothing from the mouth and muttering something to himself.

name: The Keeper of the Hill Giants
shortdesc: A large, hunchbacked Hill Giant is standing here.
longdesc:
This hill giant has a large hump over one shoulder. He is missing one eye and
walks with a limp. His scars show him to be a warrior of great age and his arms
show that he still has great strength.

name: The Undead Priestess
shortdesc: A priestess is standing here, it's flesh falling off its bones.
longdesc:
A humanoid that once appears to have been a cleric is standing here. Its flesh
is rotted away in many places. Empty eyesockets turn stare at you, a strange
internal light glowing inside them.

name: The Undead Hill Giant
shortdesc: A skeletal hill giant stands before you
longdesc:
The body of once might have been a Giant has been animated into what you now
see. The flesh of the creature is rotted and missing in many places. It turns
in your direction and points at you!

name: A troglodyte
shortdesc: A small troglodyte stands here
longdesc: She smells repulsive.

name: a gnoll
shortdesc: A gnoll stands here, he looks mean.
longdesc:
He is dressed in yellow rags, and has a dog-like face.  He is not very much
fun to stare at like this.  People are looking at you

name: An ogre
shortdesc: An ogre stands here, grinning at you
longdesc:
He is rather large, and nasty looking.  You are well aware of his huge
muscles.  Pissing him off is not a good idea.

name: A carrion crawler
shortdesc: A carrion crawler searches for food here.
longdesc: It is a grotesque beast, with numerous legs, and strange tentacles

name: a manticore
shortdesc: A manticore stands here, tail thrashing.
longdesc: It is like a lion, but with a spiked tail.

name: the orc
shortdesc: The orc walks around, looking for someone to kill.
longdesc: You notice an evil look in his eyes

name: the bugbear
shortdesc: A hairy bugbear stands here.
longdesc: It looks like a walking carpet.

name: An adult blue dragon
shortdesc: An incredibly huge blue dragon sits here.
longdesc: You see a very large blue dragon before you. It appears to be quite old.

name: The screaming, angry harpy
shortdesc: The screaming, angry harpy claws madly at your face!
longdesc:
The harpy looks at you with blood in her eyes.  Her entire body is
caked in filth and grime and she stinks to high heaven.  Her razor-
sharp talons flex as she considers you for her dinner.

name: The screaming, ugly harpy
shortdesc: The screaming, ugly harpy claws madly at your face!
longdesc:
The harpy looks at you with blood in her eyes.  Her entire body is
caked in filth and grime and she stinks to high heaven.  Her razor-
sharp talons flex as she considers you for her dinner.

name: The screaming, dirty harpy
shortdesc: The screaming, dirty harpy claws madly at your face!
longdesc:
The harpy looks at you with blood in her eyes.  Her entire body is
caked in filth and grime and she stinks to high heaven.  Her razor-
sharp talons flex as she considers you for her dinner.

name: Lord Python of Castle Python
shortdesc: Lord Python is resting on his great throne.
longdesc:
Lord Python sits here contemplating higher realities and bad
sketches. However Python has killed more people on the battlefield
than you have ever seen.

name: the Elite Guardsman
shortdesc: The Elite Guardsman is standing here, maintaining order in the castle.
longdesc:
The guardsman is HUGE, and has little patience for evildoers.  You
immediately grab the nearest halo and hang it over her head.
The Python crest is emblazoned on his armour.

name: Count Monty of Castle Python
shortdesc: Count Monty is resting on his great throne.
longdesc:
Count Monty sits here contemplating higher realities and bad
sketches. However Monty has killed more people on the battlefield
than you have ever seen.

name: the Guardsman
shortdesc: A guardsman is standing here, watching over the castle.
longdesc:
A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armour.

name: the Guardsman
shortdesc: A guardsman is standing here, guarding his post.
longdesc:
A big, strong, trustworthy guard. He will not abandon his post.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armour.

name: the Guardsman
shortdesc: A guardsman is standing here, drinking lots of ale.
longdesc:
A big, strong, ale drinking guard. He will not abandon his ale.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armour.

name: the Guardsman
shortdesc: A guardsman is standing here, lifting weights.
longdesc:
A big, strong, guard. She is intent on her weightlifting.

The Python crest is emblazoned on her armour.

name: the sheep
shortdesc: A sheep is sitting in a tree here, very strange.
longdesc: The sheep appears to be nesting.

name: A commoner
shortdesc: The commoner stands here, looking at the sheep.
longdesc:
You see an average commoner, not too bright.
>
the commoner says "My theory is that the sheep think they are birds."
the commoner says "Right now you can see them nesting."
the commoner says "You should see them when they try to fly.

name: the pantomime horse
shortdesc: A pantomime horse runs around, playing pranks.
longdesc:
The pantomime horse doesn't look that real.

The words "Property of the BBC" are stamped on the horse.

name: the pepperpot
shortdesc: A pepperpot walks by, chatting anoyingly.
longdesc:
The pepperpot appears to be a housewife from Bristol. However, you
suspect that she is not a woman.

name: The cheeser
shortdesc: The cheeser is here, waiting for your order
longdesc:
He smiles happily while waiting for you to ask for something that
he can sell you.

name: The Official, Garaunteed Genuine Python Castle Baker
shortdesc: The Official, Garaunteed Genuine Python Castle Baker stands here
longdesc: He looks very real.

name: The maid
shortdesc: A buxom maid stands here, waiting to take you to your room
longdesc: She looks very healthy.

name: The Nudge Nudge guy
shortdesc: The Nudge Nudge guy is standing here, winking at you
longdesc: He smiles knowingly.

name: An Unseen Servant
shortdesc: An visible Unseen Servant floats around aimlessly, waiting to be summoned.
longdesc: It definitely wants a master.

name: A Dust Devil
shortdesc: The Dust Devil floats long, picking up debris left lying around.
longdesc: A swirling vortex of dust.

name: A Lesser Air Elemental
shortdesc: One of the lesser Air Elementals exists here.
longdesc: A swirling mass of air.

name: An Invisible Stalker
shortdesc: A Stalker is standing here, glaring at you.
longdesc: He seems pretty nasty, but he does hold the key to the other realms.

name: The Djinn
shortdesc: A powerful Djinn, Lord of this Element, glances at you with scorn.
longdesc:
Clad in silken Pantalons and a flowing azure cloak, he seems in control of
the situation.

name: The Djnniyeh
shortdesc: A Djinniyeh reclines upon a silken cushion.
longdesc:
This Djinniyeh, while not very strong, is in command of superior magical
forces.

name: The Greater Air Elemental Guard
shortdesc: A Greater Air Elemental stands guard here.
longdesc: This mass of air looks very large and hard to hit.

name: The Water Wierd
shortdesc: You faintly make out a disturbance in the water here.
longdesc: A vaguely snake-like discoloration of the water.

name: Lesser Water Elemental
shortdesc: One of the Lesser Water Elementals swirls here.
longdesc: Two orbs of deep green peer out of this wave.

name: A Triton
shortdesc: A strange fish-man is swimming by you
longdesc:
The lower half of this creature ends in two finned legs, while his
torso, head, and arms are handsomely human.  He has a silvery skin,
which fades into sliver-blue scales on the lower half of his body.
His hair is deep blue.

name: The Greater Water Elemental
shortdesc: This Elemental seems much more powerful than the lesser's of its kind.
longdesc: A very large pool of swirling water.

name: Steven the Marid
shortdesc: A tall Marid named Steven glances at you with his arms crossed in contempt.
longdesc: A tall, arrogant Marid.  His muscles are very well devolped.

name: A brave warrior
shortdesc: A brave warrior sharpening his sword stands here.
longdesc:
This brave warrior does not fear death.  He has been through trials of
life and death that are unknown to you.  His wounds from many a battle
have formed scars on his bulging muscles.

name: A Graecian Guard
shortdesc: A Graecian Guard cautiously watches his post.
longdesc:
This man wears the insignia of the town of Graecia on his breastplate.
Although, lightly armored, his battle scars indicate that this man
REALLY knows how to fight.  Judging by his companions, you think it
would be wise not to anger him.

name: King Agamemnon
shortdesc: King Agamemnon, ruler of Graecia, is sitting upon his throne.
longdesc:
King Agamemnon, the wise and fair ruler of Graecia is sitting on his
huge throne.  He has huge muscles balanced only by his wisdom.  As you
can tell, he is the strongest warrior in all of Graecia.

name: scholar
shortdesc: A Scholar, arguing over the future of Graecia is standing here.
longdesc:
This feeble old man represents the wisdom of Graecia.  He was taught by
Aristotle and really is much wiser than you will ever be.  He is
advising King Agamemnon about the future of Graecia.

name: Assassin
shortdesc: An Assassin is hiding here, eager to place a dagger in your back
longdesc:
This cruel man is wearing a black cloak which conceals him very well.
Judging by the way he stalks you as you look around, it would be a good
idea to leave before he attacks.

name: Hercules
shortdesc: Hercules is resting here, tired from his many labors.
longdesc:
Hercules is wearing only a Large belt and shorts about his waist.  He is
definately the largest man you have ever seen.  He is wielding a Huge
club that is made from the finest wood in all of Graecia.  His muscles
are so huge that it looks like he could crush you by flexing.

name: horse
shortdesc: A horse is here making a big mess for you to clean up.
longdesc:
This horse has been spoiled rotten from the start.  He is allowed to do
whatever he wants and Nero might even recruit him into his army if hes
lucky.

name: The Nemean Lion
shortdesc: The Nemean Lion is looking for its next meal.
longdesc:
This lion is mean!  His hide looks to be as hard as steel and his teeth
remind you of a knife shop.  His claws are as sharp as swords.  He looks
straight into your eyes and you can tell that he is thinking DINNER.

name: Hydra
shortdesc: The Pyro Hydra is stalking for prey
longdesc:
Count them...1, 2, 4, 8, 10!  Ten huge heads coming from all directions
to eat you.  He has the body of a dragon, but his ten heads mean that he
is no push-over.

name: Amazon
shortdesc: A huge amazon warrior stands here, defending her home
longdesc:
This woman is huge, considering she towers over you at nearly 7 feet in
height.  Now you know why no one has attacked their secret village and
survived.  Although she is only equipped with a spear and shield, she
looks like a formidable opponent

name: Queen Hippolyta
shortdesc: Queen Hippolyta, queen of the amazons, stands here.
longdesc:
This fierce warrior is the queen of the amazons.  You can tell that she
earned her position by battle.  Like her sisters she is only armed with
a spear and shield, but her agility is amazing.  Around her waist is a
Jeweled Girdle, which signifies her leadership over the amazon tribe.

name: Giant
shortdesc: A Huge Two-Headed Giant stands here guarding Geryon.
longdesc:
The only strange thing you notice other than his huge size is his second
head.  They say two heads are better than one.  As they grin you feel
like maybe the old saying may be true after all.

name: Two-Headed Dog
shortdesc: A Giant Two-Headed dog snarls at you.
longdesc:
You've seen dogs, and giants, but never a giant dog.  And certainly not one
with two heads.  His legs are so muscular that he could rip you to
shreds without even using both sets of his powerful jaws.  But you
wouldn't get so lucky.

name: Geryon
shortdesc: Geryon, Nero's prized Oxen, stands here eating some grass.
longdesc:
This is the largest oxen you have ever seen.  You can see PRIME RIB
written all over him in tiny letters.  He is flawless in all respects
and his presence makes you the slightest bit hungry.

name: A Watchful Dragon
shortdesc: The Watchful Dragon roars as you enter
longdesc:
Welcome to Dikumud
0) Exit Dikumud
1) Enter the game
2) Set Password
3) Enter Description
4) Read Background Story

Enter Choice:

name: A Giant
shortdesc: A huge Giant stands here
longdesc:
He is a typical giant: tall, strong, and mean.  His huge club indicates
that he doesnt like you very much.

name: Thief
shortdesc: A shadowy figure
longdesc:
This cruel man cares about nothing except the contents of your money
pouch

name: Snake
shortdesc: A Huge Green Snake
longdesc:
This foul creature has huge fangs and you can tell that his poison is
quite potent, judging by the glands on his head.

name: A hungry wolf
shortdesc: A hungry wolf growls at you
longdesc: This wolf looks like it was bred for one purpose...eating YOU!

name: Giant Bat
shortdesc: A Giant Bat swoops at you
longdesc:
This huge bat has a 16 foot wingspan.  He has huge claws that look
capable of tearing you apart, and a razor sharp fangs that could
penetrate stone!

name: Cerebus
shortdesc: Cerebus, the guardian of Hades is here.
longdesc:
Cerebus has three heads, all of which are much bigger than you!  His
teeth look like a knife shop, and it makes you wander whether you should
try to enter Hades afterall

name: Spirit
shortdesc: A peaceful spirit resides here.
longdesc: There is really not much to see, just the outline of a human.

name: A skeletal warrior
shortdesc: A skeletal warrior guards the way back to Graecia
longdesc:
This creature was once a powerful warrior in his mortal days, but now
his only care is that you don't leave the underworld.

name: A torturer
shortdesc: A torturer is here, eager to show you the meaning of pain
longdesc: He is big, mean, and looks at you like you are his special project

name: The acid monster
shortdesc: The acid monster reaches out to corrode you.
longdesc: There is not much here except decaying flesh.

name: Doctor Guillotine
shortdesc: Doctor Guillotine is ready to behead you
longdesc: This man is quite inventive and eager to test his new toy

name: The evil centaur
shortdesc: The evil master centaur is staring at you.
longdesc:
This half-man and half-horse would draw and quarter you himself, but he
has too many volunteers today.

name: Vlad the Impaler
shortdesc: Vlad the Impaler is standing here.
longdesc: Vlad is everything you expect him to be...mean, nasty, and cruel.

name: roper
shortdesc: A roper is looking for something to strangle.
longdesc: This creature has eight tentacles and a huge mouth with decaying teeth.

name: giant Octupus
shortdesc: A giant Octupus is swimming here
longdesc: This guy is pretty simple, 8 tentacles and a strong beak.

name: giant Squid
shortdesc: A giant Squid is here, pulling victims underwater.
longdesc: Like his friend the octopus, he has many tentacles to grab you with.

name: Master torturer
shortdesc: The Master torturer of the underworld is standing here.
longdesc:
This spirit is big and mean, and he is going to show you the meaning of
pain.

name: Proserpina
shortdesc: Proserpina is weeping here.
longdesc:
This woman is really beautiful and has the most beautiful eyes you have
ever seen.

name: Pluto, ruler of the Underworld
shortdesc: Pluto, ruler of the Underworld is sitting here
longdesc: What do you expect??

name: Zeus
shortdesc: Zeus, ruler of the Gods, is standing here.
longdesc:
Zeus has a flowing white beard and is wearing gleaming white robes.
When he looks at you, you see lightning in his eyes, and you tremble
before his mighty presence.

name: Aphrodite
shortdesc: Aphrodite, the goddess of love, is standing here.
longdesc:
This is the most beautiful woman you have ever seen.  She is wearing a
very close fitting dress, ans as you look into her eyes you fill like
melting like a lump of butter.

name: Hera
shortdesc: Hera, the wife of Zeus, is standing here.
longdesc:
This is one mean woman.  You better hope that she is not in a bad mood,
otherwise she could really do some damage.  She his lines in her face
that remind you of the stress Zeus places on her.

name: Apollo
shortdesc: Apollo, god of the sun, is standing here.
longdesc:
Apollo is wearing only a pair of white shorts.  He wears a crown made on
fire and he is holding a whistle in his left hand.  His eyes glow fiery
red and and you can see flames coming from his mouth.

name: Dionysus
shortdesc: Dionysus the god of wine is passing out here.
longdesc:
This man is really drunk, but he still looks like he could crush you if
he desired.  He is holding a huge flagon that is constantly emptied and
filled with wine.

name: Ares
shortdesc: Ares, the god of war, is preparing for battle
longdesc:
Ares is surely the strongest of the gods.  He is the prefect example of
a warrior.  He has bulging muscles and is fitted with the finest armor
possible.

name: Athena
shortdesc: Athena, the goddess od wisdom, is standing here.
longdesc:
She is the wisest of all the gods and perhaps the most noble.  She is
wearing very old armor and has a spear.  She smiles as you enter, but
she knows why you have come here.

name: Hermes
shortdesc: Hermes, the god of thievery, is standing here
longdesc:
Hermes is a teenager, and has very odd clothing.  He is only wearing a
pair of boots, and a tunic that fall to his thighs.  He looks very fast,
and clever.

name: A rabid dog
shortdesc: A rabid dog is foaming at the mouth here.
longdesc: This dog looks very sick.  WATCH OUT!

name: A witch
shortdesc: A wrinkled old lady is cackiling here
longdesc: This foul lady is evil down to the last bone.

name: A cyclops
shortdesc: A one-eyed giant is standing here.
longdesc: Looks like a giant except it has only one eye in the center of its head.

name: The Cyclops King
shortdesc: The King of the Cyclops is resting here.
longdesc: He looks like the others, except he is much stronger.

name: A serpent
shortdesc: A huge serpent is hissing here.
longdesc: This is one of the largest snakes that you have ever seen.

name: A mermaid
shortdesc: A lovely Mermaid is singing here.
longdesc: This beautiful woman has the lower body of a fish.

name: A gorgon
shortdesc: A hideous gorgon is slithering here.
longdesc: This foul creature was once a beautiful maiden.

name: A Golem
shortdesc: A massive golem is guarding the gate.
longdesc: This golem is made from pure granite.

name: A harpy
shortdesc: A harpy is singing here.
longdesc:
This creature has the head of a woman, wings of a bird, and razor sharp
talons.

name: A pirate
shortdesc: A pirate is waiting to kill you.
longdesc: This man is cruel and wants to do nothing except hurt you.

name: Medusa
shortdesc: Medusa leaps form the shadows and tries to meet your gaze.
longdesc: Medusa is the most evil of the three gorgons.

name: A pirate corporal
shortdesc: A mean looking pirate is ready to kill you.
longdesc: This pirate is much larger than the rest and he looks quite tough.

name: An elf
shortdesc: An elven pirate is frozen by fear.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A pirate leader
shortdesc: A pirate leader is trying to escape.
longdesc: This pirate is responsible for the pillaging of the Graecin coast.

name: A Minotaur
shortdesc: A Minotaur tries to impale you.
longdesc: The creature has the head of a bull and the lower body of a man.

name: The troll
shortdesc: A large, gross looking troll stands here
longdesc: He looks like a wrestler

name: Wild Willy
shortdesc: Waving his arms about randomly, Wild Willy turns himself in circles here.
longdesc:
His sanity apparently left him ages ago. A mass of hair surrounds his
head, stringily pointing in various directions, and he hasn't bathed
recently either.

name: the vicious pink rabbit
shortdesc: A pink rabbit creeps along in search of food.
longdesc:
The rabbit is a bright shade of pink, which fades toward white at
spots, and is nearly dark red in the eyes. The rabbit seems hungry and
inordinately malevolent.

name: the big ugly troll
shortdesc: A big ugly troll stands here, holding out its hand.
longdesc:
It must be taller than twelve feet, with muscles that shine dirtily
through what is either fur or a poorly constructed garment. Behind the
eyes lies a certain amount of intelligent, and a considerable amount of
greed.

name: the wilkey
shortdesc: An angry wilkey stands here, howling at the moon.
longdesc:
This wolf-like creature has shaggy black fur. His teeth are
large, but his most menacing weapon is his horned snout.
He doesn't seem happy to see you.

name: the owl
shortdesc: A Giant Owl snaps its beak at you.
longdesc: This giant owl is pretty mean looking. Best keep your distance.

name: the huge eagle
shortdesc: A Huge Eagle is here ruffling its feathers.
longdesc: This huge bird is truly a work of nature. It has beautiful plummage.

name: the Skexie Reject
shortdesc: A Skexie Reject makes his home in this pit.
longdesc: This Skexie is a gnarled old codger. His beak is horribly crooked.

name: the Festering Charik
shortdesc: A Festering Charik flashes his tail at you.
longdesc:
This armadillo type animal has a long pointed tail with a diamond
at its tip. Its scales look like pretty good protection.

name: the Ghost of Brackenred
shortdesc: An Appartion hisses at you.
longdesc: This is the ghost of Brackenred. He's not expecting visitors today.

name: the flying rat
shortdesc: A Flying Rat whizzes by your head.
longdesc:
This is some sort of mutated pigeon/rat. His beak is really
sharp though!

name: a secrant
shortdesc: A trash eating Secrant gobbles some nearby junk.
longdesc:
This insatiable little guy looks like some sort of small dog.
He can open his jaws really wide, though, to let garbage into his
seemingly bottomless gullet.

name: the Skexie Guard
shortdesc: A Skexie guard is here checking your progress.
longdesc:
This Skexie has a certain robustness about him. His feathers
are rather shiny. He's only here doing his job. Don't mess with him,
and he won't mess with you.

name: the Skexie Maiden
shortdesc: An ugly Skexie Maiden winks at you suggestively.
longdesc: Wow! Is she ugly!

name: the Skexie Matron
shortdesc: An obese, Matronly Skexie is here barking orders.
longdesc: Wow! Is she ugly! And so fat! Sheeesh!

name: the Skexie Nanny
shortdesc: A Skexie Nanny tends to Skexie young here.
longdesc: She seems really run down from chasing these little demons.

name: the Fledgling Skexie
shortdesc: A Fledgling Skexie youth is here exercising his wings.
longdesc:
This little guys is really flapping hard. His young feathers
are still growing. His beak looks real sharp though.

name: the Ancient Mantern
shortdesc: An Ancient Mantern snickers at your feeble armor.
longdesc:
A cross between a human and a giant vulture, the Mantern is a
relative of the Skexie. His claws are huge long spikes. Mantern's are
very hateful creatures. Queeklor is their god. He has magic in
his eyes!

name: the Skexie Guard
shortdesc: A Skexie guard is here using the facilties.
longdesc:
This Skexie has a certain robustness about him. His feathers
are rather shiny. He's only here doing his job. Don't mess with him,
and he won't mess with you. Let him pull his pants up!

name: the Ancient Skexie
shortdesc: An Ancient Skexie with blue robes stands here performing a ritual.
longdesc:
This Skexie is really old. He has several tallisman around
his neck. His wiry claws have many rings. His eyes are a firey red.
Do not bother him now, he is praying.

name: the Neathar Supervisor
shortdesc: A Neathar Construction Supervisor is here supervising some workmen.
longdesc: This man is rather strong and commands a great deal of respect.

name: the Neathar Workman
shortdesc: A Neathar Workman is here repairing the masonry.
longdesc: This man is rather strong and can carry huge bricks.

name: the Skexie Altar Boy
shortdesc: A Skexie Altar Boy is here praying quietly.
longdesc: This young Skexie seems to be a bit more studious than others.

name: Palthor the Skexie Sergeant
shortdesc: Palthor the Skexie Sergeant at Arms is here practicing his swordsmanship.
longdesc:
Palthor is a very strong middle-aged Skexie. He is red feathered
and shows signs of many battles. He is a very serious Skexie, and prefers
prefers to be left alone.

name: Wegendel the Skexie Illusionist
shortdesc: Wegendel the Skexie Illusionist waves his hands in a magical gesture.
longdesc:
Wegendel is a master of illusion. His feathers are green and red.
he has a very strong beak. He has several strings of decorative beads
hanging from his neck.

name: Crandel the Skexie Mage
shortdesc: Crandel the Skexie Mage is here playing with reality.
longdesc:
Crandel is a master of magic. His feathers are green and red.
He has a very strong beak. An unusual mark has been burnt into
his chest. He often assists the Ancient Skexie in performing special
rituals.

name: Alastair the Skexie Leader
shortdesc: Alastair the Skexie Leader is here relaxing in an easy chair.
longdesc:
Alastair doesn't take his job too seriously. He is a very large
robust Skexie. His feathers are red and yellow. His entire appearance
is a bit more professional than that the other Skexies, however.

name: Turendac the Skexie High Magister
shortdesc: Turendac the Skexie High Magister is here smoking a pipe.
longdesc:
Turendac is a very professional Skexie. He handles most of the
disputes that occur among Skexie. He is highly revered for his
intelligence and fairness.

name: the Skexie Child
shortdesc: A Deaf Skexie Child is here banging a big hammer on the ground.
longdesc: This Skexie cannot hear a thing.

name: the Skexie Jester
shortdesc: The Skexie Jester falls down laughing.
longdesc:
This Skexie is dressed in human clothing. The Skexie find
this very amusing.

name: the Skexie Magister
shortdesc: The Skexie Magister has a very serious look about him.
longdesc:
This Skexie is the assistant to the Skexie High Magister.
He takes his job very seriously. He says, "What are you doing in
my room! Get out!

name: the Skexie Scribe
shortdesc: The Skexie Scribe sits at a nearby desk scribling frantically.
longdesc: He doesn't even care that you are looking. He keeps on writing.

name: the Skexie Bard
shortdesc: The Skexie Bard is here fiddling with a strange instrument.
longdesc: He's not too impressed with you. He continues to twang away.

name: the Skexie Lair Guard
shortdesc: A Skexie Lair Guard stands here rather concerned about your presence.
longdesc:
The is a very big strong Skexie. Normally outsiders are not
welcome in the lair. You'd better go quickly to the Challenge Area.

name: the Mulichort
shortdesc: A Mulichort jumps up out of the tank and snaps his jaws at you.
longdesc: This is some sort of mean reptile!

name: the Champion of Queeklor
shortdesc: The Champion of Queeklor is here guarding the statue.
longdesc:
He is a 20' tall Golem with the head of a rat. His fists are
the size of an average shield! He hits really hard!

name: the Champion of Rugrat
shortdesc: Ruggy the Champion of Rugrat is here guarding the statue.
longdesc:
He is a 20' tall Golem with the head of a rat. His fists are
the size of an average shield! He hits really hard!

name: a Bachelor Skexie
shortdesc: A Skexie Bachelor relaxes on a nearby nest.
longdesc:
This Skexie has black and red feathers. He is otherwise a
normal looking bird-man.

name: a Gentleman Skexie
shortdesc: A Skexie Gentleman sits in his chair.
longdesc:
This Skexie has black and orange feathers. He is otherwise a
normal looking bird-man.

name: an Adolescent Skexie
shortdesc: A Skexie Adolecent is lying on the floor looking quite intoxicated.
longdesc:
Boy is he hammered! He has black and yellow feathers. He's been
in a scuffle recently and has lost some feathers.

name: the Skexie Waiter
shortdesc: A Skexie Waiter is here preparing for a feast.
longdesc:
This Skexie has all black feathers. This job is considered
very undesirable.

name: the Gelfling Child
shortdesc: A Gelfling Child throws a big snowball at you.
longdesc:
Fun and frolicking all the time. All fun, and no work. He
points his finger and laughs at your appearance.

name: the Blink Dog
shortdesc: A Blink Dog flashes into phase nearby.
longdesc:
This is no regular dog. He can travel ethereally. The Gelfling
feed them and keep them as pets.

name: the Striped Bechemel
shortdesc: A Striped Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
longdesc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors.
This one happens to be black and white.

name: the Polkadotted Bechemel
shortdesc: A Polkadotted Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
longdesc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors.
This one happens to be polkadotted.

name: the Herringbone Bechemel
shortdesc: A Herringbone Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
longdesc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors.
This one happens to be wearing a herringbone suit.

name: the Midnight Bechemel
shortdesc: A Midnight Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
longdesc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors.
This one happens to be wearing a midnight suit.

name: the Gelfling Guardsman
shortdesc: A Gelfling Guardsman smiles broadly.
longdesc:
He is very happy to see you. He's glad that you will some
day destroy the Skexies!

name: the Gelfling Cleric
shortdesc: The Gelfling Cleric sits here meditating.
longdesc:
This Gelfling is dressed in white robes. His face is a pale
color. His robes are lined with a golden silk.

name: Gilkey
shortdesc: Gilkey the Gelfling is here sharpening his knives.
longdesc:
Gilkey is highly respected among Gelfling. He is bearded and
a bit portly.

name: the Gelfling Weaponsmaster
shortdesc: The Gelfling Weaponsmaster is here pounding away at some metal.
longdesc:
He is a very strong Gelfling. His muscles ripple, and he sweats,
even in this cold environment.

name: the Mad Gelfling
shortdesc: The Mad Gelfling stands here acting like a Skexie.
longdesc: Except for looking like a Gelfling, he acts like a Skexie.

name: the Warrior Gelfling
shortdesc: A Gelfling Warrior is here socializing.
longdesc:
He is a more muscular Gelfling, and has more experience with
fighting the Skexies.

name: the Beautiful Gelfling
shortdesc: A Beautiful Gelfling Woman smiles at you.
longdesc:
She is quite attractive. She has a wonderous body and lovely
long dark hair.

name: the Porgi
shortdesc: A Porgi waddles around happily.
longdesc:
This is a penguin type creature with extra long feet. He is
really cute.

name: Feuq the Gelfling
shortdesc: Feuq the Gelfling is here working on some new traps for the Skexies.
longdesc:
Feuq is a very popular Gelfling. He makes the best traps
among all the Gelfling.

name: Dasillea the Gelfling
shortdesc: Dasillea the Gelfling is wandering around searching for troublemakers.
longdesc:
Dasillea the Gelfling is a rather beautiful young woman.
She is quite busty in fact!

name: Thrack the Gelfling
shortdesc: Thrack the Gelfling stands here. He smiles. Then gives you the bird!
longdesc:
Thrack is a really well known warrior. He also has a bit
of a sense of humor.

name: Driscol the Gelfling
shortdesc: Driscol the Gelfling pokes you in the ribs.
longdesc: Driscol is a generally nice guy.

name: Haag the Gelfling
shortdesc: Haag the Gelfling Gentleman shakes your hand. He's really glad to see you.
longdesc: Haag is very much a gentleman. Too bad you have to kill him.

name: a Lost Soul
shortdesc: A ghostly apparition floats here, staring at you in utter hatred.
longdesc: The lost soul is a ghostly apparition, seeking revenge on the living.

name: a dwarven worker
shortdesc: A dwarven mining worker is here.
longdesc: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

name: the huge, green dragon
shortdesc: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
longdesc:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

name: the black enfan
shortdesc:
There is a positively evil enfan in front of you. He is dressed in black and
  carries a large weapon.
longdesc: He looks like a large piece of licoriche, only bigger.

name: A Polar Bear
shortdesc: A giant white polar bear is here.
longdesc:
A large white furball.... He is handing out Klondike Ice Cream (tm) bars.
Would you like one?

name: The Enchanter
shortdesc: The Enchanter is here placing a dweomer upon well made sword
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The master charmer
shortdesc: The master charmer utters the words, 'uuuzzldctz'
longdesc: The master charmer sizes you up, always looking for a new pet.

name: The Ringwraith
shortdesc: A Ringwraith stands here.
longdesc:
Dressed in black, it is almost invisible within the shadows. It promises
to be a formidable opponent

name: Sisyphus Jr.
shortdesc: Sisyphus Jr. of Corinth stands here, guarding the gate.
longdesc:
The once tyrannical King of Corinth has been consigned to barring
unqualified characters from entering the Tower.  A Sisyphean task indeed.

name: The Bengal tiger
shortdesc: A white bengal tiger is here.
longdesc: Large and very ferocious looking.

name: the Elven Wizard
shortdesc: An Elven Wizard is here, creating fireworks for the festivities.
longdesc:
The Elven Wizard looks at you in a solemn sort of way.  His gaze seems
penetrate through your innermost being.  He is wearing a silvery cloak
and holding a multi-colored staff.  Although he appears to be older
than the oldest man, he seems to have an inner strength which most mortals
cannot overcome.

name: The Flame
shortdesc: The Flame hovers here before you.
longdesc:
The Flame flickers almost imperceptibly about you.  You can barely feel the
warmth, so gentle is The Flame.

name: the Queen Spider
shortdesc: The huge, bulky Queen Spider is here.
longdesc:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
if it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.

name: Raistlin
shortdesc: Raistlin the Arch-Magi
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the black enfan
shortdesc:
There is a positively evil enfan in front of you. He is dressed in black and
  carries a large weapon.
longdesc: He looks like a large piece of licoriche, only bigger.

name: A wizard
shortdesc: An old wizard is here making a speach
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: Anubis
shortdesc: Anubis sits in his throne, wearing a glowing key.
longdesc: He has the body of a man, and the head of a jackal.

name: The Librarian
shortdesc: The Librarian has fallen asleep at his desk here
longdesc: He looks like a rather peaceful old man.

name: the battle master
shortdesc: The battle master offers you the services of his fine trainees.
longdesc: The battle master is a wizened fighter, with many scars to prove his worth.

name: The High Priest
shortdesc: The High Priest is standing here
longdesc:
He is dressed in back robes and wields a very wicked mace he
would give you a very tough challange

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A dwarven guard is here.
longdesc: The guard looks very tough and mean.

name: The Necromancer
shortdesc: The Necromancer is here raising undead servants
longdesc:
Attired all in black, the Necromancer is tall and gangly, but still quite
an imposing figure. A dark cowl shrouds most of his face, but two blazing
embers which must serve as eyes can be seen through the shadow.
The Necromancer shrieks some obsenities and orders his minions to attack.

name: Lord Python of Castle Python
shortdesc: Lord Python is resting on his great throne.
longdesc:
Lord Python sits here contemplating higher realities and bad
sketches. However Python has killed more people on the battlefield
than you have ever seen.

name: Yevaud
shortdesc: Yevaud the Usurper of Midgaard is here, grinning evilly at you.
longdesc: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.

name: the Grand Knight of Paladins
shortdesc: The Grand Knight of Paladins rests here, welcoming you to his guild.
longdesc:
He is huge warrior, clad in very magical armor, he rests here,
silently observing you.

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A dwarven guard is here.
longdesc: The guard looks very tough and mean.

name: the Keeper of the Ring
shortdesc: The Keeper of the Ring is here, guarding his treasure jealously.
longdesc:
The Ring Keeper is a rather big but short halfling.  His short stature and
bulbous nose belie his true nature.  An elven sword that glows with a blue
light hangs from his belt, and on his finger you see the One Ring.  Although
usually a halfling of peace, he will fight you to the death if you attempt
to take away that which belongs to him.

name: larry Skexie gentleman
shortdesc: Leisure Suit Larry, the Lord Gentleman Skexie
longdesc:
Larry was a nerdy geek all his life and eventually became a computer programmer.
He never had close relations with friends, women, or his colleagues, and every
day of his life was identical. He lived with his mother and brother.
Around his 38th birthday, his brain hit a sexual alarm and started having his first
kinky thoughts. He started reading adult magazines and could not concentrate on his
work. Because of this his life was destroyed; he was fired from his job, and upon
returning home he found his house had been sold and his mother had left for vacation.

name: Brackenred
shortdesc: Brackenred the former skexie champion
longdesc:
Brackenred is the largest skexie you've seen. He is wearing a breastplate and his beak
  has sustained heavy damage from battle. it has been replaced by a sharpened steel prosthetic.
  He is in meditation as to what his plans should be going forward. He was betrayed by Queeklor
  who envied his power and status and wanted to become champion himself. But Queeklor was no
  match physically and restorted to poison to gain position.

name: A goblin
shortdesc: A goblin is here, arguing over a few coins on the floor.
longdesc: She looks scrawny, hungry perhaps?

name: A trader
shortdesc: You see a man lying on a bed peacefully.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A stirge
shortdesc: A stirge flies towards you at great speed and attacks!
longdesc: It does NOT look happy about you being here.

name: A large kobold
shortdesc: A large, rust-brown kobold stands here, eyeing you suspiciously.
longdesc: He doesn't know whether to trust you or not.

name: A giant shrew
shortdesc: A giant shrew scuttles around the room..
longdesc: The shrew has no eyes, and "sees" with its ears..

name: A huge white wolf
shortdesc: A huge white wolf jumps up and pounces on you!
longdesc: Its drooling at you.. better not let it get what it wants, would ruin your whole day.

name: The evil priestess
shortdesc: A priestess of Set kneels at the altar here.
longdesc:
She looks at you through blackened eyes... you can tell she has been through
a lot in her life.

name: The fire beetle
shortdesc: A huge beetle sits on a dusty carpet here.
longdesc: Funny, he seems to be glowing..

name: A crab spider
shortdesc: A crab spider drops from the ceiling and attacks!
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: The bandit
shortdesc: A bandit is here, eyeing you suspiciously.
longdesc: He has obviously made this room a hideout, and doesnt like you intruding.

name: The bandit leader
shortdesc: The bandit leader is here, giving you an icy glare.
longdesc:
She has the bandits under her control and will do anything to get you out
of here.

name: A wandering goblin
shortdesc: A goblin is here, wandering through the hallways..
longdesc:
This is a goblin. He is quite happy wandering around,
picking things up.

name: Edgar
shortdesc: Edgar the Sword pupil is here, looking quite lost..
longdesc: He looks confused.. and he is trying to figure out how to light his lantern

name: Berk
shortdesc: Berk, overworked servant of 'the thing upstairs', runs around here.
longdesc:
An oviform blue creature who speaks with a West Country accent, Berk is
the steward or caretaker of the Castle Mistamere.  As such, Berk often
goes about his duties with simple-minded glee, and enjoys cooking with
ingredients such as mud, eyeballs, snakes, and worms.  Berk is often
warned not to open the trap door by his friends, or forbidden by his
master, but often does so nonetheless.

name: Boni
shortdesc: Boni, a disembodied human skull, sits on the floor chattering away.
longdesc:
Boni is a disembodied human skull, and Berk's closest friend.  Speaking
with a stuffy upper-class accent, he is something of an intellectual,
but has a tendency to complain or bore others. Boni dislikes to be moved
from his favourite spot, an alcove in the wall near the trapdoor, and
often fails to warn Berk about the various monsters that come from it.
Although serious most of the time, he is given to childish excitements
on par with those of Berk.

name: Drutt
shortdesc: Drutt, a spider-like creature, scuttles around here!
longdesc:
Berk's pet, resembling an oversized spider, who often causes trouble
when chasing after worms and other invaders.

name: Big Angry Red Thing
shortdesc: A Big, Angry Red Thing roars at the world in general!
longdesc:
The Big, Angry Red Thing is a big, angry red thing...
Nothing describes it better. Be careful!

name: Rogg
shortdesc: Rogg, a purple slime monster slithers about here.
longdesc:
Rogg is a large creature with purple skin and tentacles.
He looks very slimy. Yuck!

name: Bubo
shortdesc: Bubo, the invisible destroyer slug is here!
longdesc: Bubo is an invisible slug. You can't see him!

name: The Splund
shortdesc: The Splund is here, ready to send you to sleep.
longdesc:
The Splund is a large, round, yellow monster that has the power
to send it's enemies to sleep!

name: the young spider
shortdesc: The young spider is ballooning by you.
longdesc:
He looks freshly hatched and sprightly.  His young fangs are just
growing in as of late.

name: Yevaud
shortdesc: Yevaud the Usurper of Midgard is here, grinning evilly at you.
longdesc: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.

name: the Wolf Spider
shortdesc: The Wolf Spider is here, licking its bloody fangs.
longdesc: The Wolf Spider is hairy, very hairy.

name: the orc
shortdesc: The orc is stuck in the web and he can't get out.
longdesc: You notice an evil look in his eyes.

name: the Queen Wasp
shortdesc:
The Queen Wasp is here, thinking that you would make a tasty offering
  to her mistress.
longdesc: You notice a glazed look in her eyes.

name: the drone spider
shortdesc: The drone spider walks around doing her master's bidding.
longdesc: An ordinary drone spider.

name: the ethereal spider
shortdesc: The ethereal spider strides here, traveling to different worlds.
longdesc: She winks in and out.

name: the slave of Arachnos
shortdesc: The slave works here relentlessly.
longdesc: The slave does not mind you, but will fight like a warrior if attacked.

name: the quasit
shortdesc: The quasit blinks in and out, grinning at you.
longdesc:
Demoniac in nature, but more mischievous.  He twiddles his thumbs
and creates a magical treasure!

name: the Bird Spider
shortdesc: The Bird Spider snaps its powerful jaws.
longdesc: The Bird Spider has very powerful jaws.

name: the Hermit
shortdesc: The Hermit sits here and warns, "Go back before it's too late!
longdesc:
A dishevelled veteran warrior in disguise is what he is, but he
means well.

name: the Donjonkeeper
shortdesc: The Donjonkeeper eyes you and wonders how pure your soul is.
longdesc: He delves deeper into you as you stare at him.

name: The guardian
shortdesc: The guardian is obviously not doing his job.
longdesc: He looks like a lazy bum who sleeps half the time.

name: Arachnos
shortdesc: Arachnos the Empress of Spiders welcomes you with an evil smile.
longdesc:
She is a very attractive spider with an ornate gown.  She tempts you
into being one of her many slaves.  She does not possess the venomous
fangs of normal spiders, but then, as you realize, she does not need
them.

name: the Ki-Rin
shortdesc: The Ki-Rin smiles good-naturedly to you.
longdesc:
She is the last bastion of good in this realm.  Her mission is to
someday free the slaves of the Empress.

name: the young dragon wormkin
shortdesc: A wormkin with no teeth plays here.
longdesc: Rather small, you almost feel sad in killing it.

name: the elder dragon wormkin
shortdesc: A wormkin that has grown a bit stares at you inquisitively.
longdesc: A medium-sized dragon--seems it hasn't killed anything yet by itself.

name: the blue enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a blue suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the grey enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a grey suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the green enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a green suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the purple enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a purple suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the yellow enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a yellow suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the black enfan
shortdesc:
There is a positively evil enfan in front of you. He is dressed in black and
  carries a large weapon.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the guard dog
shortdesc: A guard dog sits here staring hungrily.
longdesc: A large, ugly, evil dog.

name: the rat
shortdesc: A large mutated rat stares at you with glowing eyes.
longdesc: It is simply very ugly.

name: the green enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a green suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the purple enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a purple suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the yellow enfan
shortdesc: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a yellow suit.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the gargoyle
shortdesc: A stone gargoyle stands before you blocking your way.
longdesc:
Very, very ugly. Much like a stereo-typical mother-in-law,
only a lot worse!

name: a desert coyote
shortdesc: A coyote is here, it looks at you wisely.
longdesc:
The coyote seems to be surprised to see you. It warily keeps its distance
when you approach.

name: a grass snake
shortdesc: There is something slithering about in the tall grass.
longdesc:
You notice the grass snake has a small lump in it's midsection. Scratch
one rabbit! It doesn't look particularly hungry.

name: a large stallion
shortdesc: A large stallion runs freely in the tall grass.
longdesc: It is a magnificent beast. It would make a fine steed, if you could only ride.

name: a mountain goat
shortdesc: There is a large mountain goat here. She thinks you look like a target.
longdesc: She has big curved horns. It's likely she's just being playful.

name: the dark bat
shortdesc: The bat hangs from the roof, swaying slightly.
longdesc: It's hard to distinguish one bat from another, there are so many.

name: the cave fisher
shortdesc: A large cave fisher is here, reeling you in for a welcome meal.
longdesc:
It's a big ugly squat beast, on four legs, with a hard exoskeleton and a long
sticky tongue-like appendage with which it lifts its prey into its formidable
looking jaws. Flee if you can!

name: the yellow mold
shortdesc: There is a spotted yellow-colored mold flourishing here.
longdesc: What did you expect? It's spores galore!

name: the red mold
shortdesc: There is bit of red mold growing near the water.
longdesc: It is a rusty reddish color. Sort of like rusted matel...

name: the cave wight
shortdesc: A shadowy cave wight eyes you hungrily.
longdesc:
It is difficult to make out precisely, as it blends in with the
shadows, but from what you can see, you realize this is a fearsome
creature, and its undead claws twitch in anticipation as it closes in
on you.

name: the large troglodyte
shortdesc: A large troglodyte stands pounces on you from behind a stone!
longdesc:
An ugly troglodtye with large yellow teeth stands here, preparing to make you
into a meal for the whole family. He eyes your weapons and armor greedily.

name: the troglodyte lieutenant
shortdesc: A troglodyte lieutenant stands here, ording others about.
longdesc: He is in complete control here.

name: the cave spider
shortdesc: The cave spider hangs nimbly from the webby roof.
longdesc:
The spider's hard exoskeleton is covered with an oily substance that keeps its
sticky webs from clinging to it. It is large and quite dangerous looking.

name: the gigantic trapper
shortdesc: A gigantic trapper engulfs you from the floor below!
longdesc: It looks exactly like the floor it mimics.

name: the evil troglodyte
shortdesc: The troglodyte attacks you with a yell!
longdesc:
He is dirty, and covered in grime and dried blood, some of which is apparently
his own. He doesn't look particularly well fed, but would like to take this
opportunity to improve that situation.

name: the troglodyte guard
shortdesc: The troglodyte guardsman defends his post from all invaders.
longdesc:
They guard their post diligently, fighting off all who would attack their
homeland and pose a threat to the survival of their people. Each is armored
and carries a sharp weapon.

name: the adolescent troglodyte
shortdesc: The young troglodyte rests here between training sessions.
longdesc:
He looks at you with alarm. He isn't sure whether he should stay and fight, or
run. He scrambles for his weapons, just in case...

name: the adolescent troglodyte
shortdesc: The young troglodyte is bashing his fellows with abandon.
longdesc: He looks at his battlemaster, who urges him to slay you.

name: the troglodyte battlemaster
shortdesc: The battlemaster screams at his pupils to attack, then assaults you himself.
longdesc:
He is extremely large, and is covered with battlescars. His armor is nice, and
is finely polished, as is his sword, which is sharp and wicked looking.

name: the troglodyte clansman
shortdesc: The troglodyte clansman cries for aid as he defends his homeland.
longdesc:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

name: the troglodyte clansman
shortdesc: The troglodyte clansman is here, foraging for food.
longdesc:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

name: the tunnel rat
shortdesc: There is a tunnel rat here, running for its life.
longdesc:
It is trying desperately to avoid becoming a troglodyte meal, like others of
its kind. It edges away as you approach.

name: the troglodyte cook
shortdesc: A troglodyte cook is here, slaving over an pot of tunnel rat stew.
longdesc:
She looks at you as if you would make an excellent addition to the stew. Given
the large knife she brandishes at you, you think she just might do it, too.

name: the troglodyte shaman
shortdesc: A troglodyte shaman is here, mumbling incantations.
longdesc:
She curses you, lifting aloft the small humanoid skull around her neck. The
incantations spewing from her mouth send shivers down your spine.

name: the troglodyte chief
shortdesc: The great chief of the troglodytes is here, regarding you dispassionately.
longdesc:
He is the largest troglodyte you've ever seen. He is covered with battle scars.
He looks at you with resignation, and slowly pulls out his great sword for
battle.

name: Golgar, god of the troglodytes
shortdesc: Golgar, the mighty god of the troglodytes, prepares to smite you.
longdesc:
This lordly figure is like a troglodyte, only on a larger scale. He must be
twenty feet tall, and as such barely fits inside the caves of his believers.
Golgar wears no armor and holds no weapon - his skin looks like it is carved
from solid granite, and his heavy fists area easily larger than the head of
any humanoid. You feel a tremendous urge to grovel in supplication before him,
but this is slightly weaker than your urge to run in terror.

name: the troglodyte clanswoman
shortdesc: The troglodyte clanswoman is here, crushing bone to paste.
longdesc: She doesn't appear to think much or your company.

name: the troglodyte matron
shortdesc: The troglodyte matron is here, watching over the young.
longdesc: She would kill you just for *thinking* about touching one of the little ones.

name: the troglodyte clanswoman
shortdesc: The troglodyte clanswoman is here, getting some needed rest.
longdesc: She looks annoyed and frightened at your intrusion.

name: the young troglodyte
shortdesc: The young troglodyte is annoying the adults here.
longdesc: It ceases all such activity when you enter, and attacks you dutifully.

name: the infant troglodyte
shortdesc: The infant troglodyte is here, waddling around and acting cute.
longdesc: It's too young to understand the concept of killing.

name: Valik
shortdesc: A wizened mage paces quietly here, waiting for the end of time.
longdesc:
The robes he wears are old and worn, and his pointy hat droops a bit as he
walks to and fro, intently staring with unfocused eyes at a point somewhere
on the infinite horizon. When his attention flicks by you, a strong feeling
of guilt washes over you and fades, like everything must in the passage of
time. You suddenly recall a phrase you've heard somewhere:

    "Do not meddle in the affairs of wizards, for they are subtle,
     and quick to anger.

name: a blind fish
shortdesc: A blind fish swims about in the dark water, searching for food.
longdesc: It isn't very big, and it doesn't look very appetizing.

name: the mud eel
shortdesc: There is an a dark eel swimmimg along the lake bottom.
longdesc:
It's hard to get a good look at it with all the mud, but you'd estimate it as
being a good four inches in diameter. As it turns, you get a brief glimpse of
some sharp and nasty looking teeth.

name: a lake crayfish
shortdesc: A small crayfish scuttles along the lake floor.
longdesc: It is barely visible, what with all the mud and darkness.

name: a humongous lake gar
shortdesc: A really big fish with lots of sharp teeth has lucked into its next meal.
longdesc:
This fresh water whopper must weigh half a ton. It is shaped like a cigar
tube, and has the same silver coloring. It's fins are small, but its teeth
more than make up for its lack of maneuverability.

name: the cave troll
shortdesc: A gangly cave troll grins at you hungrily, showing lots of bug teeth.
longdesc:
He grins when you look at him. Good thing you came along, as he was just
starting to get hungry.

name: a cobra
shortdesc: A cobra is staying cool in the shade here.
longdesc:
It erects itself and flattens out it's neck as you approach, warning you to
keep a safe distance. It looks quite deadly.

name: the yeti
shortdesc: A huge ape-like beast covered in white fur leaps to the attack!
longdesc:
The yeti is a big, white, furry animal with very sharp claws and very long
fangs. The yeti seems impervious to the icy cold.

name: the ghostly Soldier
shortdesc: A ghostly soldier makes you cower in dread as he floats nearby.
longdesc:
He is covered in ghostly armor, and holds a ghostly sword. There is little
doubt in your mind that this fearsome undead creature will do real damage,
however.

name: the ghostly Lieutenant
shortdesc: You cover your eyes in horror as you see the ghostly lieutenant.
longdesc:
He radiates with a red glow, through which you can see he is covered in
armor, which also seems to be spritual in nature. He has such a fearsome
visage that just looking at him makes you shiver in dread.

name: the Ghost Captain
shortdesc: The visage of the ghostly captain makes you cringe in terror!
longdesc: You cannot keep your eyes on him, his countenance is so ghastly!

name: an orc
shortdesc: A small orc is trying to break into a locker.
longdesc:
The orc is small and pitiful looking.  He is dressed in filthy clothes,
and looks rather repulsive.

name: the invisible watcher
shortdesc: The invisible watcher looks at you with disdain.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the troglodyte clansman
shortdesc: The troglodyte clansman jumps up from his nap with a yell!
longdesc: He doesn't seem to like having been interrupted.

name: the frost daemon
shortdesc: An evil frost demon is spewing ice and snow into the air.
longdesc:
It's hard to believe this creature could be the cause of all this snow, but
at the rate it's generating ice and snow, it may well be a possibility.

name: the acid blob
shortdesc: A menacing acid blob quivers with anticipation as it oozes towards you.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the red enfan
shortdesc:
There is a large, angry enfan in front of you. He is dressed in red and
  wants to beat on you!.
longdesc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: Gorn
shortdesc: Gorn, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Gorn, Guardian Eternal, formerly a soldier in Sareks personal guard appears
to be weary of his task.  With a saddening glance Gorn says "I am truly
sorry, but I am afraid I must kill you.

name: Krin
shortdesc: Krin, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Krin, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  Krin looks at you
and says "Fear not, your deaths shall swift and painless.

name: Seth
shortdesc: Seth, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Seth, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  His eyes speak of
a longing to end the Guardianship, the endless vigil.  Krin looks at you
with smouldering eyes, striking fear into your veins.

name: Byrn
shortdesc: Byrn, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Byrn, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  He glows red and
looks like a demon from hell.

name: Hyd
shortdesc: Hyd, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Hyd, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  It is hard to get a
good look at him as he darts into the shadows.

name: Cerne
shortdesc: Cerne, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Cerne, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  Cerne, proud and
noble, promises to be a worthy opponent.

name: Lord Hansen
shortdesc: Lord Hansen, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Lord Hansen, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  Lord Hansen
appears to be weary of this world, almost as if longing for death.

name: General Gerath
shortdesc: General Gerath, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
General Gerath, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  Gerath
is riddled with scars warning you that this is no feeble opponent you face.

name: The Forestal
shortdesc: The Forestal, Guardian Keeper Of The One Tree
longdesc:
The Forestal appears to be ancient beyond belief.  His eyes are a deep green
and he emanates a goodness unlike any you have encountered before.  He is
clothed in a deep blue robe and carries a staff made from the wood of the
one tree.  The Forestal will protect the one tree with his life.

name: the one tree
shortdesc: The One Tree
longdesc:
The one tree is more beautiful than anything you have ever seen before.  It
embodies the health and beauty of the land.

name: the Githyanki Mage
shortdesc: You see a powerful looking Githyanki Mage bathed in eldritch light.
longdesc: You become fearful as you contemplate melee with this powerful mage.

name: The Demi-Lich
shortdesc:
The Demi-Lich leaps from his throne as you enter the room, his evil
  eyes fixed dead upon you!
longdesc:
The Demi-Lich is, perhaps, the single most powerful undead creature known
to exist.  Greatly resembling a wight or mummy, and being gaunt and skeletal
in form. It is, nevertheless a being of forboding might. Its eye sockets
are black and empty, save for the fierce pinpoints of light which serve as
eyes. An aura of cold and darkness radiates from it, which makes it an
ominous and fearsome sight. Despite the wasted, rotten flesh it is garbed
in the rich clothes of nobility.

name: Keftab, the Ancient One
shortdesc: Keftab, the Ancient One stands here, calmly searching ceaslessly.
longdesc:
A writhing, quivering mass of horrific, unspeakable flesh-like material, this
ancient one stares coldly about through its many multifacted eyes.
viscious, vile smelling liquid seeps through its flesh in many places,
originating from the ghastly, crater like pores which pepper his body.
Disgustingly, large portions of its flesh seem to bubble with an alien
life of their own. The surface of its body, where not oozing, is covered
with mottled, grey, mossy protrusions, like some strange malignant
blemishes. It emits low, gutteral mewlings from its fanged, quivering
oriface.  You quickly decide that this is a battle you should probably
not partake in.

name: A Crimson Death
shortdesc: A crimson death materializes from a dense patch of red mist.
longdesc:
Its skeletal form is garbed in a robe of crimson, the blood of its many
victims stain the robe. Its skeletal figure resembles that of the angel of
death. Its eyes glow with a furious fire to kill.

name: A Mist Daemon
shortdesc: A mist daemon stands here, in a cloud of grey mist.
longdesc:
A large demon like creature hovers abover you, in a cloud of grey mist.
Its winged form stares down at you in utter hatred.

name: a Black Slayer
shortdesc: A huge, shadowy figure materializes from the shadows around you.
longdesc:
The black slayer is a shadowy figure, about 7 feet in height. Garbed in
a heavey, black cloak, in his right hand, he wields a wicked dagger.

name: a Lost Soul
shortdesc: A ghostly apparition floats here, staring at you in utter hatred.
longdesc: The lost soul is a ghostly apparition, seeking revenge on the living.

name: a Storm Giant
shortdesc: A storm giant stands here, angered by your presence.
longdesc:
This huge creature is approximatly 8 feet tall, He grasps a huge bolt
of lightning it his right hand.... He doesnt look happy to see you.

name: a White Gold Manticore
shortdesc: A statuesque manticore stands here, crafted entirely of white gold.
longdesc:
The statue is beautifully crafted, the whole statue is formed entirely
of white gold. Its eyes seem to watch your every move.. they almost
appear is if they were alive.

name: an Efreet
shortdesc: A huge flaming figure stands here, with a glint of evil in his eyes.
longdesc:
The creature is formed entirely of flames. The creature gives off an
intense heat.

name: the Hydra
shortdesc: A huge eight headed hydra is sleeping here
longdesc:
The huge, scaled creature  has eight heads... each capable of breathing
a dangerous stream of fire.

name: the Kraken
shortdesc: A large squid-like creature erputs from the waters beneath you!
longdesc:
This large creature is a close relative of the squid but a much larger
size. its huge tentacles grasp something... though you can not make out
what the object is.

name: the Treant
shortdesc: A large tree-like creature reaches out for you with its many limbs.
longdesc:
It is a rather large creature resembling a tree. At the base of the trunk
is a large opening that looks very much like a mouth.

name: a Githyanki
shortdesc:
A disgusting creature of etheral nature stands here, its body completely
  wraped in bandages..
longdesc:
This man sized creature has bandages wrapped all about its body. Its eyes
glow with a brilliant red fire, in its right hand he grasps a an extremely
sharp blade of magical nature.

name: Kalas
shortdesc:
Kalas, the guardian and knight of the castle stands here preparing himself for
  battle.
longdesc:
He is a large, muscular man of undead nature. He is clad in rather magical
looking suit of armor, his sword burning fiercly.

name: the Death knight
shortdesc: The death knight stands here, preparing to do you in.
longdesc:
This creature is the result of a powerful mage animating the dead remains
of a once mighty warrior. Its eyes are fixed coldly upon you, unsheathing
its sword, he charges for battle.

name: the Neo-Otyugh
shortdesc: A large, disgusting, vile creature stands here, smelling putrid.
longdesc:
This creature is covered with slime like substance, many tentacles protrude
from its disgusting body.

name: a Shadow Daemon
shortdesc: A shadowy figure stands here, looking you over with greed.
longdesc:
This creature has almost no form, it looks like some sort of shadow with
wings.

name: the Gatekeeper
shortdesc: A huge warrior stands here guarding the portal beyond.
longdesc:
He is a huge man, his strong, muscular body stands about 8 feet tall.
He guards the portal beyond him angrily.

name: the Paladin Guardsman
shortdesc: A Paladin guardsman stands here, silently standing watch.
longdesc:
He looks very skilled in combat, and is clad heavy, metal armor.
Strapped to his right arm is a heavy, golden shield with the insignia
of the guild of paladins engraved into it.

name: the Grand Knight of Paladins
shortdesc: The Grand Knight of Paladins rests here, welcoming you to his guild.
longdesc:
He is huge warrior, clad in very magical armor, he rests here,
silently observing you.

name: Vascar the Guardian
shortdesc: Vascar, guardian of the enchanted realm stands here.
longdesc:
He is a rather tall mage with long, flowing black hair that cascades
down the shoulders and back of his black robe. His silver eyes seem to hold
a power only known to him.

name: Ralthar the Guardian
shortdesc: Ralthar, guardian of the Temple of Lucenia stands here.
longdesc:
He is a rather large, well built cleric. His strong arms and
broad shoulders clearly tell you that this man would die to protect
this temple.

name: the Draco
shortdesc:
A large winged beast with the body of a human and the head of a dragon stands
  here
longdesc:
This large dragon-like creature seems to be the cross between a dragon
and a man. the razor sharp teeth in the mouth of the beast strikes fear into
you at the very thought of the damage they are capable of.

name: Tashir the Dark Assassin
shortdesc: Tashir, the dark assassin stands here, ready for battle.
longdesc:
This man is about 5 feet tall, and his face is covered by a black hood
over his head. In his right hand is a dagger with a strange blade.

name: the Balrog-Dragon
shortdesc: A Balrog dragon stands here, eyeing you hungrily.
longdesc:
This horrible creature stands about 8 feet tall and looks like the
cross between a balrog and a dragon. Although is looks quite mean, from
what you can tell, it has no breath ability.

name: a Balrog
shortdesc: A large demonic looking balrog stand here.
longdesc:
It is a rather tough looking demon, looking closely at it
reveals its sharp claws and you decide that its not a good idea to
upset it.

name: the Shambling Mound
shortdesc: A large pile of moss slowly forms into a human shape creature.
longdesc:
This large, disgusting creature is formed entirely of plant
life and looks quits strong.

name: Raylock
shortdesc: Raylock stands here, offering you a look at his finest wares.
longdesc:
