He is a large man, well built and the scares scattering his
body tell you that he is not a man to make angry. From the look on
the mans face, and the rather large sword in his hand, you decide it
would be wise to leave this one alone.

name: the Rainbow Dragon
shortdesc: The legendary Rainbow Dragon dwells here, luckily for you its sleeping.
longdesc:
This large dragon has several large, multi-colored scales about its
body, it appears to be guarding a large chest that rests beside its large
form.

name: Cyanis
shortdesc: Cyanis, keeper of the tower of Lucenia stands here.
longdesc:
This is a short, aging man garbed in flowing white robes, adorned with
many arcane symbols. Around his neck, you notice a cloak, which appears to
be giving him some sort of glowing aura.

name: the Lucenian Mage
shortdesc: The mage of Lucenia stands here, trying to sell the products or his creation.
longdesc:
This man is fairly short, about 5 feet tall, and has practically
no hair at all. Even though he looks very odd and clumsy, from his regal
clothing and strange magical gestures, you could easily see that he is
a powerful adept in the magical arts.

name: the Lucenian baker
shortdesc: The baker of lucenia stands here, selling various baked goods.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the Lucenian Barkeep
shortdesc: The local barkeep stands here, calmly serving his patrons.
longdesc:
He is a large, muscular man, and he doesnt look like he would
hesitate to rip your head off if you cause him any trouble.

name: the Arch-Wizard
shortdesc: An arch-wizard stands here, faithfully guarding his place of learning.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the Knight of Lucenia
shortdesc: The knight of lucenia stands here, defending his guild.
longdesc:
This large man is clad in an extremely fine suit of armor,
he wields a large bastard sword and looks as though he has killed
many with the use of its blade.

name: the Master Assassin
shortdesc: A master assassin stands here, threatening to kill you.
longdesc:
He is a tall man, his features hidden beneath the fabric of his hooded
cloak. Though you see no weapon in sight, he could easily be concealing one beneath his clothing.

name: the Bishop
shortdesc: A Bishop of the hall of clerics stands here, looking for those in need.
longdesc:
He is a rather normal looking cleric, nothiing out of the ordinary to
specify that he has and true fighting abilities, but you never can be sure.

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: The clerics guildmaster stands here, waiting to train you.
longdesc:
The guildmaster is quite old, you dont see how he could possibly do
your skills any good.

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: The mages guildmaster is here, waiting to train you.
longdesc:
The guildmaster is quite old, you do not see how he could possibly do
your skills any good.

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: The warriors guildmaster is here, waiting to train you.
longdesc:
The guildmaster is quite old, you do not see how he could possibly do
your skills any good.

name: the Guildmaster
shortdesc: The thieves guildmaster is here, waiting to train you.
longdesc:
the guildmaster is quite old, you do not see how he could possibly do
your skiils any good.

name: a Warrior Trainee
shortdesc: A young warrior trainee stands here, learning his fighting skills.
longdesc:
He is a young lad, clad entirely in training armor. Though not quite
adept in the art of fighting, he is still well built.

name: a Mage Trainee
shortdesc: A noble looking trainee mage stands here, practicing arcane gestures.
longdesc:
He is a regal looking young man, dressed in the usual training robes
of the mage class. Though not adept in his art, he looks as though he could
cast a mean magic missile.

name: a Thief Trainee
shortdesc: A seedy looking thief trainee stands here, counting his pilferings.
longdesc:
He is a small, seedy looking rogue, he appears to be counting a small
pile of coins in his hand, todays "earnings" no doubt.

name: a Cleric Trainee
shortdesc: A peacefull looking man stands here, making friendly gestures.
longdesc:
He is a rather gentle looking man, as you glare at him he makes
a warm welcoming gesture towords you.

name: a Small Duck
shortdesc: A smalll duck swims in the fountain here.
longdesc:
He is a normal looking duck, swimming peacfully in the gentle
waters of the fountain.

name: the Town Watchman
shortdesc: The town watchman stands here, eyeing you curiously.
longdesc:
He is a tall, lean looking man, dressed in a full suit of armor,
though not fine steel, the armor serves its purpose well.

name: a Small Pigeon
shortdesc: A small pigeon walks here.
longdesc: Its your average, every day pigeon...

name: the Wyvern
shortdesc: A wyvern stands here, its hugh wings extended in preperation for flight.
longdesc:
Its hugh wingspan and sharp teeth make you think twice about harming him,
for he may decide that your presence isnt needed.

name: a Paladin Guard
shortdesc: A paladin guard stands here, guarding the town.
longdesc:
He is a tall, muscular man, clad in a full suit of plate armor,
and carrying a fierce looking sword.

name: the Janitor
shortdesc: The town janitor stands here, smelling of garbage.
longdesc:
He is a small, dirty man. His dirt covered clothes make him
smell horribly of garbage.

name: an Elderly Beggar
shortdesc: An old, frail looking man limps here, his eyes light up with hope as you enter.
longdesc:
He is dressed in old, tattered clothing, which bears a horrible stench.
He looks to be somewhere near 80 years of age, and doesnt look very strong.

name: the Guardian Wizard
shortdesc: A tall man stands here, patroling the area for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
He is a tall man, dressed in the flowing black robes, that identifies
him as a member of local magi.

name: an Arch-Magi
shortdesc: An arch-magi stands here, making strange, arcane gestures.
longdesc:
He looks pretty adept at spell casting, and would probaly make an
tough opponent.

name: an Enchanter
shortdesc: An enchanter stands here, wadering aimlessly.
longdesc: He looks like he would make a tough opponent.

name: an Elven Lord
shortdesc: An elven lord stands here, practicing battle techniques.
longdesc: He looks like a fighter that is quite adepts in the art of battle.

name: the Illusionist
shortdesc: An illusionist stands here.
longdesc: He looks quite adept in the art of magic.

name: the Cutthroat
shortdesc: A cutthroat stands here, looking for his next victim.
longdesc: He looks like he is very skilled in the art of theft.

name: the Patriarch
shortdesc: A patriarch stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the Vicar
shortdesc: A vicar stands here.
longdesc: He looks very skilled in the arts of healing.

name: the Medium
shortdesc: A medium of magic stands here.
longdesc: He looks pretty sorry in the arts of magic.

name: the Rogue
shortdesc: A rogue stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the Wizard
shortdesc: A wizard stands here, making clothing for mages.
longdesc: He is dressed in the regal robes of an Arch-Magi, it would be best to avoid him.

name: a Paladin Warrior
shortdesc: A paladin warrior stands here, honing his sword.
longdesc:
He is a tall, muscular man, clad in a full suit of plate armor,
and carrying a fierce looking sword.

name: A stone giant
shortdesc: A stone giant stands here.
longdesc:
Shorter than all their cousins, these giants stand around eight feet tall.  They
have hard, dark brown skin that seems to resemble rocks and in some cases lichen
even grows were a beard or mane of hair should be.  Their eyes are dull, white
marbles that seem to see through even the most diligent of disguises.  They may
be slow, but they are powerful.

name: A cloud giant
shortdesc: A cloud giant stands here.
longdesc:
Rising up like Zeus upon his mountain, with skin that is translucent like the
billowing of steam and all held together by bright flashes of lightning, these
giants are the rulers of their kind.  Towering up to fifteen feet in height,
with the power to bring down storms upon their foes, Cloud giants are rarely
seen, but greatly feared.

name: A fire giant
shortdesc: A fire giant is here.
longdesc:
Standing well over ten-feet tall, these giants have blackened, cracked skin that
burns with a fiery heat.  Their hair and beards are living flames, their eyes
like pools of molten gold that steam and spark as they blink.  They have an evil
reputation and are known for being soldiers, conquerors and savage overlords.

name: A frost giant
shortdesc: A frost giant is here.
longdesc:
Cyan-blue skin, hair as white as the freshest snow, eyes like distant stars that
burn and steam with intense cold, the Frost giant thrives in icy, frigid places.
They are not as evil as their fiery cousins, but they are far more cunning. 
They have been known to group up against other giant-clans and overthrow them,
even enslaving them.  It is rumoured they can freeze a man with a touch...

name: Jarl Bjorn
shortdesc: Jarl Bjorn of the stone giants is here, brooding angrily.
longdesc:
Jarl Bjorn is the leader of the stone giant clan that controls the valley
between the icy tundra of the frost giants, the lofty valley tops of the
cloud giants and the dark, heat-filled caves of the fire giants.  He is
said to be a harsh but fair ruler, respected by his clan and by the other
giants.

name: Ulf
shortdesc: Ulf of the frost giants stands here, snarling.
longdesc:
Ulf is a thickly built brute of a giant.  He dwarfs all the others in
the hall by at least a foot.  His shock of white hair hangs like a mane
around his bull-like neck.  Known only for wearing the Hide of Fenris
and wielding his axe Hausakljufr, one wonders why Jarl Kaldrhond would
place such a well known recluse in a position of bargaining.

name: Arne
shortdesc: Arne of the cloud giants stands here, tall and proud.
longdesc:
Arne is short for a cloud giant, standing at around twelve feet tall.  He
is not less impressive for that however; his arms are thickly corded and
uncovered, showing off muscles and scars that have no doubt been built
and earned in countless battles.  Rumour has it he is in love with Ravna
of the fire giants, but that she rejected his advances in favour of her
own Jarl Bodil, the chief who never leaves the lava caves of her people.

name: Ravna
shortdesc: Ravna of the fire giants is here, laughing.
longdesc:
Were it not for her tremendous height of fourteen feet, her shocking mane
of fiery hair that hangs in braids across her shoulders and down her back,
and that tell-tale blackened, cracked skin, Ravna might be considered a
beauty.  A shield maid of the fire giants, she is Jarl Bodil's bride to be,
a fact that grants her power and influence of over others of her clan and
is a source of great amusement to her.  Rumour has it then whenever she
enters combat, the cloud giant Arne leaps to protect her, laying down his
life for hers if needed.  A sentiment she doesn't mirror.

name: Jarl Sigurd
shortdesc: Jarl Sigurd stands here, commanding his cloud giant people.
longdesc:
Sigurd is an enigma wrapped up in muscle, fine, chiselled good looks and
a powerful intellect.  He towers above the other cloud giants and is by
far the biggest giant yet seen.  It is said that he disapproves of the
alliance with the Drow, but is careful not to let his opinion become too
well known - it wouldn't be wise to disagree with the dark-skinned elves.

name: Skald Yrsa
shortdesc: Skald Yrsa is here, advising her Jarl.
longdesc:
Yrsa is an old, bent giant with a thick mop of blonde-white curly hair
that frames her hard but wrinkled face.  In her day she was a shamanka
of terrible power, but since the Drow came, and what the Drow bargained
for subsequently happened, so her power was shorn in two.  She now serves
Jarl Sigurd as his advisor, pushing for freedom of the clan away from the
other giants and the machinations of the Drow.

name: Jarl Kaldrhond
shortdesc: Jarl Kaldrhond stands here, frost steaming off his icy-blue skin.
longdesc:
Kaldrhond is the Jarl of the frost giants.  He is not a particularly large
giant, or even that cunning.  In fact, his lack of wits makes him an easy
target for the other tribes and rumour has it that he was quickly fooled by
the Drow in to siding with them.  But if Kaldrhond has something special,
it is his affinity to the cold.  It is said that Kaldrhond has the ability
to chill a man to the bone with just a glare.

name: Jarl Bodil
shortdesc: Jarl Bodil is here, burning fiercely.
longdesc:
Bodil is, as you may have guessed, not male.  She is one of those rare
females who has risen to a place of power far-beyond what anyone could
ever have dreamed possible.  Even for a fire giant, with her soot-black
skin, eyes of white-hot molten metal and hair like dripping fire, she
is beautiful to behold.  It is told that she stole her Jarldom from King
Harald and imprisoned him deep in the mountain.  Like many who find
power in such ways, she seeks more and is greedy for every morsel she
can get, a fact that the Drow use to their advantage as they give her
all she desires, and nothing that she truly needs.

name: Valkyrie Tora
shortdesc: The Valkyrie Tora stands here, defending her Jarl.
longdesc:
Tora is a squat, evil-looking brute of a giant.  And the fact that she
too is female just seems to make her all that much more dangerous.  In
spite of the fact that she loudly, and passionately, disagrees with her
Jarl that working with Drow with benefit them, she is fiercely loyal to
Jarl Bodil and was rumoured to be the muscle that helped imprison King
Harald.

name: Shamanka Helga
shortdesc: Shamanka Helga sits here, guarding the way.
longdesc:
Helga is young, barely out of her teens, although she stands well
over nine feet tall.  Despite this, she is a powerful Shamanka,
even with her powers severely curtailed thanks to the plotting of
the Drow.  But her young age also makes her very naive, she is
easily led, and Jarl Bodil uses her with precious skill.  The
young Shamanka is most powerful near her Goddess, so the clever
Jarl has positioned her at the very gates of the cavernous den
that imprisons the source of her power, forcing her to be the
one who prevents others from freeing something that would in the
end grant her more power than she currently possesses.

name: King Harald
shortdesc: King Harald is here, seeking revenge!
longdesc:
This is King Harald, Fire Giant, Scourge of the Mountain Valley. He is as
tall as he is powerful.  He was betrayed Bodil, the Drow interlopers, and
those he trusted most when he refused to imprison the Draconic Goddess,
Tiamat.  He knew that the Drow intended to contain Her power and to limit
Her influence on the world and to further their own nefarious deeds and
plots that they hatch deep under ground.  He was imprisoned and due to be
killed within the next few days.  Be warned!  For he will likely think
YOU are his executioners!  Only by Harald's Hand can someone gain access
to the Great and Powerful Draconic Goddess, the Chromatic Mother, Tiamat.

name: a dire wolf
shortdesc: A large, tusked wolf is here, sniffing out prey.
longdesc:
The direwolf is an ancient ancestor of the modern wolf.  It can stand anywhere
from 50cm to 200cm at the shoulder.  Typically it has enlarged, tusk-like canine
teeth that jut out of its mouth in a demonic, or vampiric way.  Far from being
superflous, these tusks help it to kill prey.

name: the Yeti
shortdesc: The giant furry Yeti is here, looking for food.
longdesc:
The Yeti is covered in shaggy white fur and has a pair of horns sticking out
of the top of its head.  It's hands end in long, vicious-looking claws.  It is
not likely to be friendly.

name: a hardy tundra goat
shortdesc: A hardy tundra goat leaps deftly across the wasteland here.
longdesc:
Native to Tundra and other icy, desolate areas, these goats are the main
source of food for most predators.  It's not uncommon to see them being
attacked whenever they are spotted.  But they are quick and agile and run
at the first sign of danger.

name: Gnatt
shortdesc: The green wyvern Gnatt is here, tending her eggs.
longdesc:
Gnatt is a greeny-gold coloured Wyvern.  Unlike dragons, Wyverns are
not well known for their intelligence and grace but are often confused
with them, which is why Gnatt is tolerated in this place.  Wyverns
only have a pair of hind legs and wings and their tails are often
tipped with a cruel barb.  Gnatt's barb looks especially dangerous,
dripping with thick, oily venom.  It wouldn't be a good idea to get
in to a fight with this beast.

name: King Knutt
shortdesc: King Knutt is here, raging!
longdesc:
King Knutt is a fire giant and master smith.  And not just any fire
giant; he was defeated in battle by Harold and forced in to hiding.
If the fates have decided that he should return then it is because
Harald has failed in his mission to free the great Goddess Tiamat,
and the time is now ripe for him to reclaim his throne.  Legend tells
that Knutt designed a weapon of such power that even the Slaadi in
their ancient plane coveted it.  Could it be true?

name: a hardy mountain goat
shortdesc: A hardy mountain goat skitters across the valley gracefully.
longdesc:
This goat has a shaggy fur of brown and white, helping it to blend in to
it's natural environment and avoid predators, most notably the wild wolves
that roam the mountain valley's.  They are quick and agile and run at the
first sign of danger.

name: a wild mountain wolf
shortdesc: A grey and brown wolf is here, sniffing out prey.
longdesc:
Mountain wolves are solitary hunters, seeking out prey in the rocky,
inaccessible sides of mountains.  For wolves, they are extremely agile
and have been known to climb to great heights.  They are also quite
dangerous, attacking anything that it considers to be prey.

name: a wyvern hatchling
shortdesc: A hatchling is here, feeding life to Gnatt!
longdesc:
This is a freshly hatched wyvern.  It looks very much like its mother,
with green-gold scales and a distintive, rotten stink to it.  Yet it
is full of life, and has the ability to pass that life on to its mother
when it latches on to her.

name: a giant eagle
shortdesc: A giant eagle hops along a cloud here.
longdesc:
This eagle is on the lookout for prey.  Of course.  It stands as tall as
a man and is likely to be quite mean.  I'd be careful if I were you.

name: a stormflurry
shortdesc: A stormflurry whips up the clouds here.
longdesc:
The stormflurry is a form of air elemental.  It looks like a conical
swirl of clouds and gas with a pair of glowing, malevolent looking eyes
where you guess its head should be.  A pair of thick, gaseous arms end
in lightning tipped claws... Oh dear.

name: Gunhilde the Volva
shortdesc: Gunhilde the Volva cackles insanely here.
longdesc:
Gunhilde is a messy, disgusting, ancient stone giant.  Although she
stands nearly nine feet in height, her hunched, archaic form leaves
her bent almost half of that.  Stringy black hair, greasy and unwashed
sticks to the side of her pale, liver-spotted skin.  She's quite mad,
but then that is why, in the language of the giants, she is called a
volva.  A witch!

name: a Dragon Hound
shortdesc: A Dragon Hound is stomping around here, breathing fire!
longdesc:
The Dragon Hound is a 2-headed dog like beast with a glowing, burning
antenna that juts out of the centre of each of its foreheads.  It is
approximately the size of a bull elephant and is a match for the over-
sized giants that call it a pet.  Each mouth is capable of breathing a
devastating hail of fire - so when you tank it turn it away from the
rest of the raid so they don't get incinerated... Wait... Wrong world.

name: Mephisto Misraria
shortdesc: Mephisto Misraria the Smith is here, supervising the work.
longdesc:
Mephisto is renowned wizard, warrior and smith.  It is his weapons that the
Drow of House Misraria use in their war efforts.  He is a standard looking
Drow, with jet black, almost blue, skin and a shock of white hair.  His eyes
are tinted with that tale-tell red that denotes his innate powers of infra-
vision.  You won't be sneaking past this one!

name: A stone giant worker
shortdesc: A stone giant works here.
longdesc:
This stone giant has been put to work by the Drow overlord and is busy
smashing out swords and pikes and other weapons that the giants will be
using in the wars to come.  He doesn't care about your presence, a first
for any giant in this place, and just wants to get the work done so he
can go home and daydream of watching the Drow die slowly in a fire.

name: A stone giant guard
shortdesc: A stone giant guard guards here...
longdesc:
Shorter than all their cousins, these giants stand around eight feet tall.  They
have hard, dark brown skin that seems to resemble rocks and in some cases lichen
even grows were a beard or mane of hair should be.  Their eyes are dull, white
marbles that seem to see through even the most diligent of disguises.  They may
be slow, but they are powerful.  This one has been designated a guard.  It does
not look excited.

name: Chancellor Nimruil Misraria
shortdesc: Chancellor Nimruil Misraria is here, consulting the giants.
longdesc:
Nimruil Misraria is one of the most powerful priestesses of House Misrara.
She is a fierce and dominating character, taller than most and stocky in
stature, as if she is a ball of muscle just waiting to explode.  She has
all the diplomatic skills necessary to close deals and further the schemes
of her kind.

name: A fire giant guard
shortdesc: A fire giant guard guards here...
longdesc:
Standing well over ten-feet tall, these giants have blackened, cracked skin that
burns with a fiery heat.  Their hair and beards are living flames, their eyes
like pools of molten gold that steam and spark as they blink.  They have an evil
reputation and are known for being soldiers, conquerors and savage overlords.

name: Fenris
shortdesc: Fenris the ancient dire wolf is here, snarling!
longdesc:
Fenris is a dire wolf.  A very big, very ferocious dire wolf.  According to
frost giant legend, Fenris once howled at the moon and shattered her where
she lay.  In response the moon created Tiamat, releasing her from her belly
and setting her to bring Fenris to heel.  Of course, these are just stories
and are probably not true.  Probably.  Fenris has a thick coat of silvery
grey fur that shrugs off the cold easily.

name: Tiamat
shortdesc: Tiamat, the gargantuan, five-headed chromatic draconic goddess sleeps here.
longdesc:
Tiamat is a five-headed draconic goddess.  Each of her heads is the chromatic
colour of one of her children, and her children's children and all their
descendants, for all dragons that are red, blue, green, black and white are
her progeny, and they all follow her evil nature.  It is told that when she
roamed the skies, long years ago, she was supremely powerful, unmatched in
all of the realms.  But she grew and she slept, and her slumbers lasted years.
Her scales are as hard as diamond, her horns crown like aegis over each head,
and her tail, reminiscent of a wyvern's, is complete with evil-looking stinger
that can cause the victim to be sent in to a deep sleep that, ultimately, they
will never wake from.  She has been shackled, a ring of dark iron around each
of her necks and legs connected to chains so big that a man could stand inside
a single link.  Dark red runes glow over each binding, sparking and spitting
in the language of the Underdark.  The language of the Drow...

name: A large Fire Giant
shortdesc: A large Fire Giant sentry eyes you suspiously.
longdesc:
This creature is as large as a house, and as strong as a dragon.
he stands here guarding his post faithfully.

name: The Fire Giant lieutenant
shortdesc: A large Fire Giant is standing here
longdesc:
This is the largest Fire Giant you have seen yet.  Massive muscles
bulge from his gargantuan body.  A flaming helm rests atop his monstrus
head.

name: The General
shortdesc: A large Fire Giant making battle plans.
longdesc:
This ugly Fire Giant is the leader of the fire giant army.  His
massive uniform is adorned with medals and other decorations, in
his hands is a very powerful looking Battle Axe.

name: The Fire Giant King
shortdesc: The Fire Giant King is here resting in a large oak chair
longdesc:
This is a very large obese creature, lines of many years of
frustration and pain mark his aged skin. He wears a long cloak
that covers most of his large frame, but you notice a huge great-
sword hanging from a jeweled scabard at his side.

name: an ancient blue dragon
shortdesc: An ancient blue dragon stares at you wisely
longdesc:
She is the largest dragon you have ever seen, she has no weapons
and the only armor she possesses are the shiny blue scales that cover
her massive body.

name: The High Priest
shortdesc: The High Priest is standing here
longdesc:
He is dressed in back robes and wields a very wicked mace he
would give you a very tough challange

name: A Giant Salamander
shortdesc: A Giant Salamander slithers here quietly
longdesc:
This is a large snake like creature with small limbs
extending from its long body, it glares at you hungerily
as you approach.

name: A Skeletal Giant
shortdesc: A Massive Skeletal Giant charges at you mindlessly
longdesc:
This is the undead remains of a long dead Fire Giant, its
body's flesh has decayed many years ago leaving a pile of charred
bones and a few scraps of clothing.

name: The Patryn
shortdesc: An Angry Young Patryn glares angrily at you.
longdesc:
The otherwise human-looking Patryn has brown hair with white ends and is
covered with glowing blue runes.

name: The Patryn
shortdesc: A Patryn Runner considers you and prepares to attack.
longdesc:
This humanoid creature is covered in runes and wears only a loincloth.
He is wielding a spear and knife.

name: The Patryn
shortdesc: A Patryn Squatter sits here, eyeing you carefully.
longdesc: This Humanoid is covered in glowing blue runes.

name: The Patryn
shortdesc: An Old Patryn glares evilly at you.
longdesc:
This old man has glowin blue runes on his hands-the only exposed skin
other than his head.

name: The Lord of the Nexus
shortdesc: The Lord of the Nexus does not approve of your continued existance.
longdesc: This is the oldest and most malicious Patryn you have seen.

name: The Tytan
shortdesc: The jungle appears to be moving...
longdesc: This isn't jungle! This is a giant humanoid!

name: A Chaodyn
shortdesc: An insect-like Chaodyn stands here, preparing to strike.
longdesc: The Chaodyn has four arms and two powerful hind legs.

name: A Snog
shortdesc: A large snog is here.
longdesc: The snog has a hulking body and long, razor-sharp claws. It is hungry.

name: A wolfen
shortdesc: A wolfen growls angrily at you.
longdesc: This wolf-like humanoid stares back with wild yellow eyes.

name: The Elven warrior
shortdesc: An Elven warrior ragards you cautiously.
longdesc:
He is wearing a vest and skirt that looks like it was made of a
tapestry...not a thing to fight in at all. He wields a shortsword.

name: An Elven Guard
shortdesc: An Elven guard stands at attention.
longdesc: He is wearing tapestry-like Elven armor and wields a shortsword.

name: A noble Elf
shortdesc: A noble Elf sneers at you.
longdesc:
She is quite beautifull, and clearly regards humans as the lowest life form
in existance.

name: The Captain
shortdesc: The Captain of this vessel regards you coldly.
longdesc: He is dressed in fine Elven tapestry and has quite a commanding presence.

name: The Geir
shortdesc: A Geir pays no attention to you.
longdesc:
The Geir is an old Elven wizard, addorned in black robes.  He seems far more
interested in other Elves than in you.

name: A human soldier
shortdesc: A human soldier stands here.
longdesc: He is wearing much armor and has a large sword.

name: an adolescent red dragon
shortdesc: An adolescent Red Dragon prepairs for dinner
longdesc:
Red Dragons possess remarkable intelligence. One is tempted to say
malevolent intelligence, but, in fairness, who are we to judge a race
our ancestors hunted almost to extinction? You have no dount that, if
the dragon could speak to you, it would remind you that it has good
cause to hate you.

name: The Sartan Necromancer
shortdesc: A Sartan necromancer regards you eagerly.
longdesc:
The necromancer would much rather have you be an animated corpse
than free willed and alive.
He is dressed in long black robes.

name: The Lazar
shortdesc: A Lazar is standing here,  screaming for your death.
longdesc:
The Lazar was once alive, but is no longer. It is quit unlike the
docile animated dead you have encountered here so far. It HATES you.

name: The magician
shortdesc: A human magician stands here.
longdesc:
He appears rather wimpy as far as mages go...probably Fourth House
at the absolute most.

name: The Farming Zombie
shortdesc: An agricultural zombie vacantly works in the field.
longdesc: It has no clue.

name: The Zombie Soldier
shortdesc: A soldier zombie wander, looking for foes in a war that ended long ago.
longdesc: Ah, it seems to recognize you...you must be the enemy!

name: The Sentry zombie
shortdesc: An undead Sentry stares alertly off into space.
longdesc: It could alertly watch the horizon for days and not notice you standing here.

name: The Guard zombie
shortdesc: An undead cityguard patrolls here, alert for any signs of life.
longdesc: It seems quite animated, really.

name: Chad Jackson, International Recording Artist
shortdesc:
Chad Jackson, International Recording Artist is standing here, palming
  a harmonica
longdesc:
You see a sturdily-built musician, holding a harmonica in one hand and
a saxophone slung around his arm.  He says "Can I help you?" as he
busts out the line "Hear the Drummer get Wicked!" to some nearby
customers.

name: Herb the Jeweler
shortdesc: Herb the Jeweler is here, waiting to show you his finest jewelry and stones.
longdesc:
Herb is a small, slightly overweight man dressed in fine middle aged garb.
You notice rings on every finger, and many golden chains that he wears with
pride around his neck.

name: Spike Leroy
shortdesc: Spike Leroy is here, shining a piece of fine plate mail armor.
longdesc:
Spike Leroy, famed adventurer for the ages, has settled down and owns this
modest armory in the Forrest Landing mall.  He shoots you a toothy grin as
you enter the store and take inventory of his fine collection of armor.

name: Sam Kitling
shortdesc: Sam Kitling greets you with a fine "Hello!" and offers to show you a sword.
longdesc:
You see a finely-built man, rough and hardy yet with a pleasant soothing voice.
Sam greets everyone in the store with a friendly smile and provides the
best service of any Weapons store around.  "And I don't charge you an arm and
a leg either, like that Shire blacksmith!

name: Norm
shortdesc: Norm is here, waiting for your order.
longdesc:
Norm is your standard, run-of-the-mill teenage fast food worker.  A little
short on brains and common sense, at least he remembers orders well and won't
give you a Goblin Burger (tm) if you order a grilled cheese.

name: Boots Day
shortdesc: Boots Day is here, showing a nice pair of shoes to a customer.
longdesc:
Boots Day, ex-Mercenary and gun for hire, has changed his ways.  After a near
brush with death, Boots reformed his ways and settled down to middle class
SillyMud life.  Boots and his wife bought a small shoe store and turned it into
a successful franchise establishment.  Boots' wife can be seen wandering
the mall from time to time.

name: Eddy
shortdesc: Eddy the Magician is here, mixing a potion dextrously.
longdesc:
Eddy is a kind middle-aged magician, wondrously talented in mixing potions.
So, like any other intelligent magician in this day and age, he's putting
his talents to their full use -- and making a profit.

name: Forrest Landing Mall Security guard.
shortdesc: A Forrest Landing Mall Security guard is standing here, eying you suspiciously.
longdesc:
A standard rent-a-guard Mall Security person.  If it weren't for the steady
paycheck for this guy's bulk, he might be in the circus.

name: Forrest Landing Cleaning Woman
shortdesc: A cleaning woman is here, picking up some litter from shoppers.
longdesc:
The cleaning woman is here, with broom and dustpan, trying to keep the
Forrest Landing mall somewhat clean.  She is losing her battle.

name: A crying child
shortdesc: A child is here, crying for his mommy.
longdesc:
A small child; he is holding a pudding pop, but is lost.  Can you help him
find his mommy?

name: Tiffany
shortdesc: Tiffany is here, singing to the gathered mall teeny-boppers.
longdesc:
Tiffany is as young, cute and atonal as expected.  This is her latest stop
on her SillyMud in '92 tour.

name: Mrs. Day
shortdesc: Mrs. Day is here, enjoying a little shopping.
longdesc:
Mrs. Day, the wife of The Bootery's Boots Day, is here spending a little of
her husband's hard-earned money.  Think twice about crossing her -- she has
credit cards and knows how to use them!

name: George, the head of Mall Security
shortdesc: George, the head of Forrest Landing Mall Security is standing here.
longdesc:
George, a very muscular man, stands here at the entrance of the Forrest
Landing Mall, making sure the mall is secure.  He locks up the mall at closing
time every night, and opens it up the following morning without fail.

name: Swordmistress Shanda Misraria
shortdesc: Swordmistress Shanda Misraria is here, consulting the giants.
longdesc:
This is Shanda Misraria.  Neither priestess nor wizard, she is a capable
and deadly warrior and assassin.  She is dressed in the black garb of her
kind and wields a pair of elegant stilettos.  On her feet a pair of boots
glow with fiery, spitting runes that seem to protect her from the heat of
the fire caves.

DO NOT USE - DO NOT DELETE

name: Swordmistress Shanda Misraria
shortdesc: Swordmistress Shanda Misraria is here, consulting the giants.
longdesc:
This is Shanda Misraria.  Neither priestess nor wizard, she is a capable
and deadly warrior and assassin.  She is dressed in the black garb of her
kind and wields a pair of elegant stilettos.  On her feet a pair of boots
glow with fiery, spitting runes that seem to protect her from the heat of
the fire caves.

name: A Troll Warrior
shortdesc: An ugly, mean-looking troll warrior is standing here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: A young troll
shortdesc: A young troll stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The troll shamen
shortdesc: The troll shamen stands here, guarding what lies beyond.
longdesc:
His eyes glow with power, and as he looks at you, sizing you up, he grins
and readies himself for an attack. His attitude is foreboding of a long and
difficult fight, should you choose to attack him.

name: A Troll Guard
shortdesc: An ugly, mean-looking troll guard is standing here.
longdesc: It is heavily armored, and promises to be a difficult opponent.

name: A tree
shortdesc: A tree is sleeping soundly here.
longdesc:
The trees mourned long for the loss of the Entwives, now they are in a resigned
slumber.

name: An ent
shortdesc: A guardian ent is standing here.
longdesc:
It has long guarded this forest, forsaken of all pleasures
by the departure of the EntWives, all that remains is duty.

name: Treebeard
shortdesc: Treebeard the Ent is slowly walking about.
longdesc: He has a beard of moss, and seems a  being.

name: The labyrinth guardian
shortdesc: The labyrinth guardian stands before you..
longdesc:
You see him standing before you, laughing insanely.. Wait, no he's over there..
No, he's right here.. No, he's over there too! You're so confused..

name: TreeWard
shortdesc: TreeWard the Ent is slowly walking about.
longdesc:
He has a beard of moss, and seems a restless, wondering at
who is intruding on this domain.

name: Spirit of the Lake
shortdesc: The Spirit of the Lake flickers in an out of view.
longdesc:
She's beautiful, shimmering golden light.  She smiles at you and 
you feel that she's praising you for having come and visited her.

name: Kilfen, the bartender
shortdesc: The bartender, Kilfen, is here ready to serve you.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The treasure broker
shortdesc: The treasure broker is standing here, ready to rip you off.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The shopkeeper
shortdesc: An old man is sitting here, rocking in his old chair.
longdesc: He looks very, very old..

name: The innkeeper
shortdesc: The innkeeper is standing here, eager to serve you.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The baker
shortdesc: The baker stands here, wiping flour from her face.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The armourer
shortdesc: The amourer stands here, ready to sell you everything you need.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The jeweler
shortdesc: The jeweler is standing here, working on a bracelet.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The swordsmith
shortdesc: The swordsmith stands here, ready to sell you all the best blades.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: Kilnab, the wizard
shortdesc: Kilnab, Zifnab's brother is here, ready to serve you.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The chandler
shortdesc: The chandler is here, ready to serve you.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: The scribe
shortdesc: The scribe is here, eager to write you a scroll.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: A citizen
shortdesc: A citizen of Quinmoor is walking by.
longdesc: You see nothing special

name: Hathor
shortdesc: Hathor stands here, ready to take your order.
longdesc:
Hathor is round, jolly, and unusually tall for a dwarf.  Despite his jovial
disposition, you have little doubt on his value in a fight.

name: Spave
shortdesc: Spave stalks the shadows here, hunting his next bounty.
longdesc:
You wonder what kind of atrocities Spave must have committed to exile himself
deep into these caves.  He looks like a dangerous customer.

name: Kinsil
shortdesc: Kinsil paces about the room, admiring his collection.

name: Jah
shortdesc: Jah beams a smile at you, inviting you in.
longdesc:
Jah is a beautiful dwarven maiden, renouned as the finest gold-smith under the
mountain.  She takes great pride is satisfying her customers.

name: Dwarven Cityguard
shortdesc: a stocky dwarven cityguard is posted here, looking for wrongdoers.
longdesc: The cityguard looks strong and determined.  He is obviously proud of his post

name: Peacekeeper
shortdesc: a city Peacekeeper stands here, looking after the town's innocent.
longdesc:
The Peacekeepers are the city's elite law-enforcement suad, and it shows.  The
guard is rippling with muscle and power.

name: Guard warg
shortdesc: a guard warg is here, sniffing out danger.
longdesc: The warg is small, but powerfully built.  It wears the city seal around it's neck.

name: Master Guardian
shortdesc: The Master Guardian is here, looking after the innocent.
longdesc:
The Master Guardian has given his life to the upholding of the law.  He would
willingly give his life to keep the city free of sealing and murderous scum.

name: Dwarven citizen
shortdesc: a dwavern citizen is here, going about his daily business.
longdesc:
The dwarf doesn't look very imposing or interested at all that you,
another tourist is staring them down.

name: Filthy Rogue
shortdesc: a filthy rogue lurks in the shadows, waiting for an innocent victim.
longdesc:
You see the flash of steel as the roght slips a dagger into his sleeve, I wouln't
turn my back to him.

name: Shadowy cloaked figure
shortdesc: a shadowy cloaked figure is here, fingering his dagger.
longdesc: The cloaked man is pretty tall, and looks dangerous.  You might want to move on.

name: A tourist
shortdesc: A tourist from Midgard is walking around admiring the ancient stone city.
longdesc:
Tall slender man, dressed in comfortable cloths styled for a
different climate, by his build you would guess that he is a 
laborer by trade back home. He  looks very peaceful and content
as he walks around with a tourist guide.  The expression on his 
face is so enthusiastic, it almost seems as if this is his first 
time away from Midgard.

name: A tourist
shortdesc: A young woman
longdesc:
The woman is dressed simly in a one-piece purple bathing suit.  She
smiles happily as she stares into the sun with her sunglass covered
face.  Her tan is quite exceptional.  She must be out here every day.
Does anybody go to work around here?

name: A dwavern courier
shortdesc: A dwavern courier is here, looking to make a delivery.
longdesc:
Before you is an unusual sight in terms of dwarfs, a slender one!
This courier has been in the business for some time, as his body has
adapted to the constant running needed to be a successful courier.
Also unlike most dwarfs his beard his well groomed and kept short, no
doubt to meld into whatever environment he would find himself in, especially
in this diverse ancient city.

name: An elven merchant
shortdesc: An elven merchant is here trying to make a sale with some of the locals.
longdesc:
This elven woman is quite lovely, long blonde hair and green eyes
compliment all of her facial features.  She is in her finest wardrobe
as she attempts to use her looks to sell some trinkets of no real value 
to the locals of Tagol.

name: Dwarven citizen
shortdesc: a dwavern citizen is here, going about her daily business.
longdesc:
The dwarf doesn't look very imposing or interested at the fact your
staring at her.

name: A reading woman
shortdesc: A young woman takes out a book and sinks back in her chair.
longdesc:
The young woman seems to be having an extremely relaxing day.  A glass
of iced tea in one hand and a small paperback in the other, she sinks
back into her chair with a happy sigh.  "What.", she states plainly,
looking up at you above the rim of her sunglasses.  "Can't you see I'm 
trying to read.".  Oh my, better not mess with her.

name: A walking man
shortdesc: A smiling man takes a peaceful walk along the sandy beach.
longdesc:
The man walks peacefully along the beach, enjoying the sights, sounds
and smells of his surroundings.  He is dressed simply in some colored
swim trunks.  His bare upper body is taking a nice licking from the 
sun high above, as his skin is turning a love shade of brown.  Smiling
at you as he notices you checking him out, he non-chalantly continues
along the beach.

name: A walking woman
shortdesc: A beautiful woman tosses her hair as she strides across the sand.
longdesc:
Wow!  What a beautiful woman!  She almost floats across the sand as she
walks along the beach.  Everyone on the beach stops what they are doing
and simply stare at her, tongues wagging.  Tossing her hair at the 
onlookers, she smiles and continues along the beach.

name: A young dwarf
shortdesc: A smiling young dwarf is wandering around looking for some mischief.
longdesc:
Dressed in a green tunic and green trousers, this young one is looking
for a good time and some good ale.  As you make eye contact with this
young dwarf a smirk develops on his face and he begins to eye your coin
purse.  He better not try anything!

name: A sand castle man
shortdesc: A smiling man builds a sand castle with his family.
longdesc:
The man carefully plans his next move.  He takes a step back to look
at his work and begins to shake his head.  Getting on his knees, he
looks at the sand castle and begins to smile.  "We need somemore
water boy.", he shouts to his son.  "Run to the water and grab some
for me, won't you?

name: A sand castle child
shortdesc: A young child helps his father build a huge sand castle.
longdesc:
The young man packs some sand into different size buckets next to the
sand castle.  He awaits the newest order from his father with baited
breath.  Quickly realizing that his father is too busy, he continues
to pack more buckets with sand.

name: A sand castle child
shortdesc: A little girl cries next to a large sand castle.
longdesc:
The little girl is a complete mess.  Her long blond pig tails are
drooped across her face.  Strands of snot flow from her nose and
drip into the sand as she cries for attention.  She must be jealous
of her brother.

name: A ball playing child
shortdesc: A small child tosses a beach ball to an older boy.
longdesc:
This young man seems to be having a ball, quite literally.  "Throw it
to me!", he shouts, jumping up and down.  "Stop hogging it all to
yourself!".  He stands about three feet tall and has a full head of
brown hair.  The child is dressed only in some red swimming shorts.

name: A ball playing kid
shortdesc: A young man plays ball with a small child.
longdesc:
Taunting his playmate, the young man keeps making motions that he is
going to throw his friend the ball, but keeps it all to himself.  The
boy seems to be about thirteen years old and is acting every bit of
it!  How rude.  He sticks his tongue out at the other boy and continues
to tease him.

name: A mean kid
shortdesc: A mean-looking young man walks up and kicks sand at you.
longdesc:
What a jerk!  This boy looks mean as spit!  He walks along the beach
kicking sand at beach goers and making rude remarks.  The bully notices
you looking at him and starts to move in your direction.  Stopping just
a few feet in front of you, he kicks a nice amount of sand on your
feet and moves about his merry way.  Jerk!

name: A walking couple
shortdesc: A happy couple walk hand in hand along the beach.
longdesc:
The couple does not even notice you as they walk along the beach  Their
hands break contact briefly as they move seperately around you, only
to reconnect quickly behind your back.  It is amazing they did not knock
you over!  Turning around to get another look at the love birds, you
notice them gazing lovingly in eachothers eyes.  L'amour!

name: a rat
shortdesc: A rat wanders about here.
longdesc:
The rat bares its teeth in resistance...Looks like a tough
little bastard.

name: a youngster
shortdesc: A youngster runs aimlessly around in circles here.
longdesc: Looks like a troublesome little brat.

name: an addict
shortdesc: An opium addict lies here in a stupor.
longdesc:
The opium addict lies here in stoned conentment.  Doesn't
look like much of a challenge.

name: the peacock
shortdesc: A peacock stands here showing off its plumage.
longdesc:
The peacock is beautiful and fiercely proud, its beak looks
pretty sharp.

name: the crane
shortdesc: A crane stands here.
longdesc:
This beautiful bird seems to epitomize grace, its long legs move
smoothly as it wanders about.

name: the monkey
shortdesc: A monkey scampers about, chattering incessantly.
longdesc:
The monkey bares its teeth at you and scampers about, screaming.
It's quite an annoying little creature.

name: the geisha
namelist: geisha whore slut prostitute girl hooker
shortdesc: A geisha lies here invitingly.
longdesc:
At first glance, she appears very beautiful.  But then you begin
to notice the subtle things; the tacky way that her face is painted,
the cheap quality of her garments, you begin to feel sorry for her.

name: the farmer
shortdesc: A farmer stands here.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: Miller
shortdesc: A miller works here grinding rice.
longdesc: You see nothing special.

name: the yakuza
shortdesc: A yakuza lurks here, watching your every move.
longdesc:
The yakuza is dressed poorly and is missing several fingers.  He
looks tough and ruthless.

name: the white belt
shortdesc:
A white belt practices here, looking slightly unsure of
  himself.
longdesc:
The white belt's gi is a very clean, bright shade of white, like
fallen snow.  His belt is tied wrong, and he looks rather unsure of
himself.

name: the whore matron
shortdesc: The whore matron lies here invitingly.
longdesc:
She is fat and ugly, obviously quite past her prime.  She knows her
business however, and looks ready to defend it.

name: the shinto priest
shortdesc: A priest meditates here, counting his beads.
longdesc:
The priest sits here in silent meditation, counting his necklace of
beads to prepare for some unknown ritual.

name: the samurai
shortdesc: A samurai warrior stands here, ready for battle.
longdesc:
The samurai is young and hot-blooded, always ready for a fight.  He
is wearing the box-shaped armor of the samurai, only vulnerable on
the right side where it is laced in place.  He is carrying a katana.

name: the samurai ghost
shortdesc: The ghost of a fallen samurai stands here.
longdesc:
The shade of a fallen warrior, this samurai seems more prepared for
combat...with nothing to lose.

name: the burly yakuza
shortdesc: A burly yakuza stands here, attending to his post.
longdesc:
The burly yakuza stands here with his arms crossed over his chest,
attending to his duty with no hesitance.  He is missing several fin-
gers.

name: the ninja
shortdesc: A ninja is here, cloaked in secrecy.
longdesc:
Dressed in black, the ninja is almost invisible within the shadows.
He promises to be a formidable opponent.

name: the undead warrior
shortdesc: An undead warrior stands here, vengeance burning in his eyes.
longdesc:
Perhaps the shadow of some unfortunate former adventurer like your-
self, he is forever trapped in the tombs.

name: the Kunoichi
shortdesc: A kunoichi stands here.
longdesc:
Dressed in black, the ninja is almost invisible within the shadows.
She promises to be a formidable opponent.

name: the Shadow Swordsman
namelist: swordsman shadow warrior samurai ghost undead
shortdesc: A Shadow Swordsman stands here.
longdesc:
The Shadow Swordsman wields his blade with a vengeance, ready
to sever your head from your body.

name: the tiger
shortdesc: A tiger crouches here, ready to pounce.
longdesc:
The tiger is fierce and beautiful, a perfect expression of vitality and
puissance.  He bares his fangs, like forgotten daggers, which he
occasionally exposes in an evil grin before the kill.

name: the chunin ninja
shortdesc: A chunin blends into the darkness.
longdesc:
Dressed in black, the ninja is almost invisible within the shadows.
He promises to be a formidable opponent.

name: the black belt
namelist: black belt teacher sensei instructor karate-ka
shortdesc: A black belt stands here, instructing his students.
longdesc:
The black belt is clean and well-kempt, and appears to be very
sure of himself.  He moves like he is constantly concious of the
parameters of his body.

name: the Yakuza Master
shortdesc: The Yakuza Master sits here, counting his wealth.
longdesc:
The Yakuza Master has grown rather fat in his laziness and opulence,
but he is very experienced, and looks ready to defend his wealth with
his life.

name: the Shihan
shortdesc: A Shihan stands here, instructing his black belt students.
longdesc:
He looks polite and friendly, but VERY tough...he wears the red-and-
white-striped belt marking him of a rank above sixth dan black belt.

name: Yamaguchi Sensei
shortdesc: Yamaguchi Sensei stands here in neko-ashi-dachi.
longdesc:
Yamaguchi Sensei looks very comfortable in his favorite
kumite-dachi...the cat stance.  His gi looks old and worn, and he wears
the solid red belt that marks him as a judan...tenth dan black belt.

name: the Shinobi
shortdesc: The ninja master stands here.
longdesc:
The Shinobi smiles his black-toothed grin, a veritable master of
invisibilty.

name: the Shogun
shortdesc: The Shogun sits here amidst glory and power.
longdesc:
The Shogun commands respect and a heavy rice tax.  He is wearing
full samurai battle dress and wields his kyosi blade like an
extension of his own body.

name: Yukio
shortdesc: Yukio wanders about, playing beautiful music on his flute.
longdesc:
Yukio is lithe and slender, and he looks very young.  Mischievious
laughter twinkles in his eyes, and he plays beautiful music on his
flute, Little Branch.  He is armed with a warfan.

name: the Mad Shogun
shortdesc: The Mad Shogun has emerged from the darkness
longdesc:
The Mad Shogun has come forth, he's the master of the shogun who
trained lesser shoguns for many years to be successful tax collectors.

name: Huiquon, The Whisper
shortdesc: Huiqwon moves about the room in complete silence.
longdesc:
Huiquon is known simply as The Whisper.  He is the master of stealth.
It is rumored he was born without the ability to speak.  He is a
physically impressive man.

name: Wai, The Blade
shortdesc: Wai stands here sharpening his famed blades.
longdesc:
Wai is the master of blades for the ninja clan.  Any sharp
object in his hands becomes an instrument of death.

name: Kotaru, The Unknown
shortdesc: Kotaru glares at you.
longdesc:
Kotaru is the leader of the ninja clan.  There are no
known physical descriptions of the man.  It is rumored
he kills anyone who has seen him.  Run!

name: Smaug
shortdesc: The ancient dragon Smaug lies here.
longdesc:
Smaug is an ancient, evil, and most of all powerful brass dragon.  He has
thick, metallic scales in highly polished brass the merge from lustrous
brown-green to soot-black at his shoulders and down his spine.  Two horns
bend backwards away from his brow and give his head an elegant, stream-
lined, snake-like beauty.  He is rumoured to breathe fire and gas.  He is
as big a dragon as you are ever likely to meet.

name: Fafnir the spectral Dwarven High Priest
shortdesc: You see Fafnir the Dwarven High Priest standing here in prayer.
longdesc:
Fafnir, the Dwarven High Priest stands before you.  His hands are held in 
prayer and the aura emanating from him makes you very certain that you do
not want to piss off any gods that favor him.  Fafnir died defending the
outpost and now he haunts the temple halls, a haunted, dark and fearful
shadow of his former self.  He still grips the

name: a spectral Dwarven priest
shortdesc: You see a spectral Dwarven priest standing here in prayer.
longdesc:
A Dwarven priest stands before you.  He stood with Fafnir when the
dragon came and gave his life to protect the outpost.  Now he is but
a shadow of his former self, the ghostly lines of his well toned body
telling you that his god was one who appreciated exercise (and maybe
a love for combat).

name: a Dwarven defender
shortdesc: A dwarf in battered armour stands before you..
longdesc:
This is one of the one's that survived the original conquest of this outpost.
His armour is battered and he looks tired but as you approach he stands and
raises his axe.

name: Halfnit the crazed Dwarven cook
shortdesc: A dwarf in a bloodied smock stands before you..
longdesc:
Halfnit is obviously the cook.  His bloodied smock gives you the willies...
but then again he must of been butchering something.  You fervently hope
he doesn't decide to butcher you!  He survived the dragon attack, but was
wounded enough that he went mad from pain.  He now spends his days crazily
cooking, butchering and taunting Smaug.

name: Danlia the Dragonmistress
shortdesc: Danlia the Dragonmistress is kneeling here, cradling her friend, Agni.
longdesc:
This is Danlia Surefoot, Dragonmistress of Fortrum.  She has lead 
the brave Fortish dragonriders in to the Outpost, the first of the
Fortish reinforcements sent by Odin.  But even she was ill-prepared
to face the beast.  Her fine armour is scorched back from fire and
cursed from lethal poison, the skin on her face is red and welted
from intense heat.  But she feels none of it.  She cradles her friend
Agni in her arms, tears wetting her cheeks, another victim of Smaug
the Mighty.

name: Agni the Dragonrider
shortdesc: Agni is here, dying from his wounds.
longdesc:
Agni is a member of the Black Dragonriders of Fortrum.  These elite soldiers
are ready to jump in to battle at a moments notice upon their black dragon
steeds.  Agni entered the Outpost with Danlia and flung himself in front of
her to save her from the beasts breath.  Danlia managed to drag him inside
but he will succumb to his wounds soon, and there is nothing, no healing,
no magic and no God that can help him now.  He shudders in Danlia's arms even
as tears roll down his soot-blackened cheeks.

name: Scorch the dragon
shortdesc: Scorch, the dragon, is curled up near her mistress Danlia
longdesc:
Every Fortish Dragonrider has a dragon to rider.  This is Danlia's.  Her name
is Scorch, she is a mature black dragon.  It wouldn't be wise to pet her, she
will tear off your arm as quick as look at you, and with that acidic vitriol
dripping from her lips, it would be a painful bite.  She has a damaged wing,
but otherwise she seems to be in fine shape considering.

name: A Fortish Dragonrider
shortdesc: A Fortish Dragonrider guards the entrance here.
longdesc:
A Dragonrider from Fortrum stands guard here.  He seems to looking in to
outpost fearfully, as if his orders were to stop something getting out,
rather than getting in.  He is part of a contingent sent by Odin to help
the outpost.  His commander, Danlia, has already gone inside with the rest
of the squad...

name: a Drow Looter
shortdesc: A Drow Looter is here, sneaking around and stealing what he can!
longdesc:
The Drow are nothing if not opportunistic when the need arrives, and the
great houses are known to send out scouts to forage and steal when another
race is experiencing war or troubles.  This Drow is one of those scouts.
He is a nasty little thief who is picking over the dragon hoard whilst the
Dwarves die horrible fiery deaths around him.  He seems to be smiling...
This looter wears the sigil of House Parastric.

name: Smaug the Fallen
shortdesc: The skeletal remains of Smaug the Fallen are here, destroying everything!
longdesc:
In life Smaug was a magnificent ancient brass dragon, with wings like gold
and highly-polished scales that glimmered in the sunlight.  His fearsome 
horns pitch-black and needle-sharp.  Alas, he was killed by ruthless and
treasure-hungry adventurers and has risen back to seek his vengeance!  His
once beautiful coat now broken and dull, rusted with dried blood and show-
ing ribs and worse below.  His once lustrous-blue eyes are now empty-pits
of smoking evil that fixate on his prey.  Smaug the Fallen is much more
dangerous in death than he ever was in life.

name: Guard
shortdesc: A Guard stands here ignoring you.
longdesc: This Giant of a guard seems prepared to defend his castle

name: Royal Guard
shortdesc: A Royal Guard stands here smiling proudly.
longdesc:
The Royal guard Stands here wearing his gleaming armor, Hiseyes peer into yours
as he searchs for any dent in your armor

name: The captain of the guard
shortdesc: The Captain of the guards stands here watching his Royal Guards
longdesc: The Captain holds alot of power in this realm.

name: King Nodonn
shortdesc: King Nodonn stands here looking Regal
longdesc: King Nodonn seems mighty busy, and mighty strong.

name: Queen Merce
shortdesc: Queen Merce looks down upon you sadly.
longdesc: from long ago, she looks capable of defending herself.

name: Aluteyn
shortdesc: Aluteyn walks around staring at the walls.
longdesc: Aluteyn, royal cousin to Nodonn, looks like he is here for more then just a visit.

name: Servent
shortdesc: A Servent stands here doing some house work
longdesc: This dusty old  servent doesnt seem quite content wish his job.

name: Prisoner
shortdesc: A prisoner stands here, seeking blindly for the exit.
longdesc: this dude looks pathatic, he has been here for quite some time.

name: Death Knight
shortdesc: Someone reaches for your soul.
longdesc: This ghastly remains  of a once great warrior reaches hungrily for your soul.

name: Alastrasza the Red Dragon
shortdesc: Alastrasza the Red Dragon sees you and strikes!
longdesc:
Alastrasza is an ancient red dragon.  She is so old, and grown so big
that she can not escape the gigantic cavern that imprisons her.  There
are rumours that Tiamat herself is this dragons sire.  Although, most
likely, those are just rumours.  She will not be an easy foe to defeat.

name: Hill Giant
shortdesc: A Hill giant stands here looking all gloomy.
longdesc: This hill giant seems to be imprisoned, and doesn't seem to happy about it.

name: Magus
shortdesc: Magus is here standing over an experiment in progress.
longdesc:
This wizard has to be the biggest wizard you have ever seen.
He seems quite drained from the experiments he has been doing.  Yet you are sure he
will be a worthy challenge

name: Vie-Tiamen
shortdesc: Vie-Tiamen is floating here reaching for you!!!
longdesc:
Two pulsasting red orbs float in an formless cloud of misty death.  This
King-lich is radiating truly awesome power.  You tremble in fear as he reaches
 for you.

name: Birdy
shortdesc: Birdy is flying merrily about.
longdesc: This cute bird looks happy flying about and around.  The bird seems harmless enough

name: the Dread Soul of Vie Tiamen
shortdesc: The black and twisted soul of Vie Tiamen screams in defiance here.
longdesc:
Dark and evil, the dread soul of Vie Tiamen looks like a hole in space where a 
body should be.  Such power it possesses that the very stars shine from within
to cast shadows around it's twisted form.  Rings of immeasurable power adorn
it's crooked fingers, and a cloak of purest night hangs like a death-shroud
from it's bent, ancient shoulders.  Your death has come.

name: Grenob
shortdesc: The orcish leader Grenob stands here radiating evil.
longdesc:
This particular orc seems to have been more affected by the radiation
than his underlings.  His muscles are knotted up in bizarre contortions
far beyond the usual deformity of orcs, and patches of wispy hair have
sprouted up all over his body.

name: an elite orc guard
shortdesc: An elite orc guard stands here watching for intruders like you.
longdesc:
The guard shows definite signs of severe mutation.  Unfortunately, the
mutations all seem to have made it stronger!  Huge, bulging muscles stick
out all over its body, and it surveys the room with a particularly keen
gaze.

name: an elite orc mage
shortdesc: An elite orc mage weaves spells of protection here.
longdesc:
Although not physically impressive, the mage is possessed of a
disturbing air of self-assurance.  It seems to be in deep concentration,
but you wonder if that is simply a ruse.

name: an orc fanatic
shortdesc: An orc fanatic stands here looking rather crazed.
longdesc:
The orc's eyes betray a complete and total lack of conscious thought...
even more so than orcs in general, which is saying a lot.  It stands here
fidgeting uncontrollably, waiting for something you can only wonder about.

name: Lord Draxas
shortdesc: Lord Draxas sits upon his throne, eagerly expecting your company.
longdesc:
This is Draxas, Lord of Chaos.  He is a towering demon of unfathomable
power and lusts.  His skin is a rich, blood-red that sets off the luster
of his amber eyes with their feline irises.  A set of rich-black, thick
horns extend from his equine-shaped head and curl out and then inwards
like that of a bull.  His feet are cloven, with muscular legs that show
he never misses the chance to squat his max.  Draxas is the antithesis
of Law, the direct thing the powers of Thaumlore work to protect the
Realms against.  Here he gathers his forces, plots his next moves, and
readies for the inevitable fall of your world.

name: a Chaos Warrior
shortdesc: A muscular warrior paces here, looking for enemies... Any enemy.
longdesc:
This is a dedicated human follower of Lord Draxas.  He wears mostly thin
leathers and furs that leave most of his flesh exposed to the elements.
He is covered in red scabs, scars, burns and half-healed charring. It
*really* must hurt.  Maybe that is why he is so brutal and and ravening?
His mind is like a box of cats - the type of mind drawn to the Lord of
Chaos.

name: Kharn, the Immolator
shortdesc: Kharn, the Immolator, is here, sharpening his great sword.
longdesc:
Kharn is a warrior of epic proportions.  When not leading the vanguard
with his mighty horde of Chaos Warriors, he can be found here, working
a sharpening stone against his great sword Abolleth.  His armour looks
to be forged from molten steel and glows red-hot from the inside out.
From what you can see of his flesh, it looks blackened and charred, as
if he always burns with an inner fire.  His helm is typical of the Chaos
Horde, with a flat crown and T-shaped visor, concealing his face and
leaving only the dim-glow of his burning eyes peering through.

name: Esadora Onyx
shortdesc: Esadora Onyx, the Lady of the Wastes is here, waiting for her Lord.
longdesc:
Esadora Onyx looks like a sweet and innocent girl in her early teens. In
reality she a foul Hellspawn and minion of the Lord of Chaos.  She wears
a simple nightgown of fair-looking lace and carries a staff of bright,
golden apple wood.  Only her eyes betray her true form; they are feline
in shape, with bright red irises that glow with unearthly sheen.

name: a Darkling Marauder
shortdesc: A large, muscular, elven-looking marauder sits here, scowling.
longdesc:
Darklings are very similar is looks to a Drow, however, they are much
heavier set and tend to stand as tall as a human.  They have ebony skin
that appears to be too-tight for their frame, dark, dirty brown hair and
eyes that glow red with no sign of pupil or iris.  They are fearsome
fighters in service to the Lord of Chaos.

name: a Darkling Warlock
shortdesc: A tall Elven-looking warlock stands here, wearing a wizards hat.
longdesc:
Darkling warlocks form a large part of the armies of the Lord of Chaos.
They are master spell casters with the martial knowledge of a trained
warrior.  Looking very similar to Drow, but with tight, painful-looking
skin, dirty brown hair and glowing red eyes, it is no surprise they can
insill fear into the hearts of heroes and knights.

name: Knight Captain Jenna Blackberry
shortdesc: Knight Captain Jenna Blackberry of Thaumlore is here, preventing anything entering from the portal.
longdesc:
This is Knight Captain Jenna Blackberry.  For a Halfling, she is chunky,
well-built, and courageous.  Standing just under three feet tall, she is
not likely to intimidate anyone.  But, don't be fooled by her stature.
As a Knight Captain of Thaumlore, it is her sworn duty to protect these
Realms against incursions from chaos, and this is a task she does well
and efficiently.  She is also the protector and teacher of her two young
Squires, George and Henry.  She'll let you pass her to access to the
realm beyond the portal, but her mission means she won't let you leave
again.  Now in her sixth decade of life, her hair is as silvery as her
Shire-Forged Maille, Polished Short Sword and Decorated Kite Shield.

name: Warduke Festergax
shortdesc: Festergax, Warduke of Draxas, is here planning his next moves.
longdesc:
Infamous for his title of 'Warduke', Festergax is the Champion of Lord
Draxas, Commander of His Chaos forces, and Hero of the Realm of Chaos.
He stands close to seven-feet in height and is grossly fat, with heavy
jowls that give his face a sagging, sweaty pear-shape. He is covered in
sores and scars, and his flesh, where you can see it, has an unhealthy, 
venomous green tinge to it.  His eyes are pink and milky and weep a pus
-like fluid that stains his unshaven cheeks brown.  Even so, he is as
powerful a creature of Chaos as you are like to meet, in his rusted and
stained mail that crawls with maggots and grave worms.  You risk more
than death facing off against this bloated, diseased monstrosity.

name: Pyros
shortdesc: Pyros, First Daughter of Tiamat is here, sleeping peacefully.
longdesc:
Pyros is ancient even by ancient terms.  She was whelped by the dragon
Goddess Tiamat and was the first ever red dragon to bring terror to the
realms.  Scholars have long thought she died millenia ago.  She rests,
her golden eyes closed, and just a wisp of smoking curling from her long
flared nostrils.  She has dark red scales, battered and hardened from
the long ravages of time, with a creamy-pink underbelly.  Despite her
advanced age, she is likely to be a formidable foe.

name: Moxia, the Cursed
shortdesc: Moxia, the Cursed, is here, burning like a bonfire.
longdesc:
Long, long ago, Moxia was a force for good.  She fought for her peoples
against neighbour and distant enemy alike.  She was a demon on the field
of battle, with her twin sabres whirling like a barrier of blades.  She
was betrayed by her own people, who viewed her skill and dedication as
one possessed by a witch.  They burnt her at the stake, without trial or
mercy.  And as the flames took her, she screamed and called out for aid.
And there, deep in the dark places, something heard her.  It let her burn
and took her smoking, ruined corpse and gave it a new life in service to
the Draxas, Lord of Chaos.  Now she leads multitudes of ravening Chaos
Warriors as a trusted and valued lieutenant.  And, all the while, she
burns and smoulders from the heat of her execution.

name: Sir Xavier of the Vale
shortdesc: The honourable and bold Sir Xavier of the Vale is here, trapped.
longdesc:
Sir Xavier of the Vale is a Paladin and good-aligned Champion of Justice
and Law.  Hailing from the Valley's of Pharsica, this lone Knight joined
forces with an expedition from Thaumlore Fortress to prevent an invasion
of the forces of Chaos.  However, he quickly grew bored with the task of
guarding the portal and set himself a geas to set forth and kill the very
roots of chaos and injustice.  He was doing a fine job until he got lost
and found himself stuck in this prison.  Now he spends his days holding
his Cross of Lorraine and praying to lords of light to guide him out of
this place.  So far his Gods haven't listened... Much to the amusement of
his captor.

name: a Chaos Champion
shortdesc: An intimidating Champion of Chaos stands here, looking for enemies.
longdesc:
Wearing fine leathers and sporting a helm that conceals his face, this
huge warrior is a Champion of the forces of Chaos and dedicated follower
of Lord Draxas.  His chest is bare is covered in inky blue tattoos of
skulls, weapons and patterns of chaos, but most prominently, from the
his belly to his naval, is the symbol of the Lord of Chaos; the eight-
pointed cross.  Crazed with religious fervour, rumour has it that these
Champions can get themselves in to a berserker state and fight non-stop
for hours.

name: a Beastling Guard
shortdesc: A beastling guard patrols the hall for intruders here.
longdesc:
Beastlings form the bulk the Lord of Chaos' army.  They have the body
and arms of a human, but the hindlegs and head of a horned mountain goat
with shaggy grey-yellow fur that is thick at the neck and blends down to
the backbone and sternum.  Golden-coloured eyes, with a horizontal bar-
like pupil and dark sclera put you in mind of a crazed sheep. These are
well-built, powerful creatures, that should be dealt with carefully.

name: a Beastling Marauder
shortdesc: A beastling marauder stalks the plains in search of prey.
longdesc:
Beastlings form the bulk the Lord of Chaos' army.  They have the body
and arms of a human, but the hindlegs and head of a horned mountain goat
with shaggy grey-yellow fur that is thick at the neck and blends down to
the backbone and sternum.  Golden-coloured eyes, with a horizontal bar-
like pupil and dark sclera put you in mind of a crazed sheep. These are
well-built, powerful creatures, that should be dealt with carefully.

name: a Dracthyr Forsaken
shortdesc: A beastial forsaken of Dracthyr is here, snarling viciously.
longdesc:
The Forsaken are abberations created by the Lord of Chaos to guard his
daughter in her lair.  With the muscular body of a large human, the head
of a sleek, dark-red dragon and the wings of a demonic serpent, these
half-breeds are a horror to behold.  They have no will or mind of their
own, their thoughts no more than animal yearnings, and all they desire
is the blood of the next kill.

name: Onydraxas the Deathbringer
shortdesc: Onydraxas the Deathbringer is sleeping here, quiet and silent.
longdesc:
Onydraxas is the Hellspawn daughter of Lord Draxas and the Lady Esadora
Onyx.  Using the blood of Pyros, the Lord of Chaos has forged his great-
est weapon - Onydraxas.  She looks like a huge, ancient dragon with dark
sangria-coloured scales that form a diamond at her forehead and ripple
down her spine to the tip of her tail. Her underbelly, lower neck and
inside wings are all a pale crimson lined with inky black streaks.  Not
much is known of her powers, but if she is a spawn of the three great
foes who reside in Castle Draxas, then she is likely more powerful than
all of them combined.

name: Squire George of Thaumlore
shortdesc: George, a Squire Valiant of Thaumlore stands here, guarding the portal.
longdesc:
Squire Valiants are well trained warriors of Thaumlore who stand under the
protective gaze of a Knight Captain and undertake dangerous missions.  In
this case, the valiant is charged with preventing anything from entering in
to Realms from the inky portal that shimmers and glows in this room.  That
said, they're not under orders to stop anyone entering the Chaos Realm and
will likely let you pass if you remain peaceful.  George looks to be around
twenty years old, with a moustache that appears to more fluff than bristle,
a mass of curly brown hair, and a manly scowl of bravery.

name: Squire Henry of Thaumlore
shortdesc: Henry, a Squire Valiant of Thaumlore stands here, guarding the portal.
longdesc:
Squire Valiants are well trained warriors of Thaumlore who stand under the
protective gaze of a Knight Captain and undertake dangerous missions.  In
this case, the valiant is charged with preventing anything from entering in
to Realms from the inky portal that shimmers and glows in this room.  That
said, they're not under orders to stop anyone entering the Chaos Realm and
will likely let you pass if you remain peaceful.  Henry looks to be in his
mid-to-late teens, with a shock of red hair, lots of pimples, and arms that
would rival a snowman's.

name: a Beastling Darkrunner
shortdesc: A stealthy beastling darkrunner is here, fighting for Lord Tyr!
longdesc:
Darkrunners are capable and elite assassins, even with their obvious dis
-advantage from being an aberration of goat and man.  With dark, silky
fur and good eyesight, this Beastling fights with Lord Tyr to further
the maturations of Draxas, Lord of Chaos.

name: a Beastling Darksummoner
shortdesc: A beastling with magical powers is here, bringing for the arcane for Lord Tyr!
longdesc:
With the head and hindquarters of a goat, you'd think there wasn't much
in the way of a brain with a beastling.  But you could not be more wrong
in any way!  This beastling, with yellowy-blue fur veritably buzzes with
power.  It fights for Lord Tyr to further the maturations of the Lord of
Chaos.

name: Lord Tyr the Butcher
shortdesc: Lord Tyr The Butcher stands here, roaring defiance.
longdesc:
Tyr is an insanely large beastling with the head and hindquarters of a
powerful mountain goat.  Standing at over twelve feet in height, Tyr is
a Hero of the forces of Chaos, and his presence on the battlefield up-
lifts the spirits and lust of victory in the ravening hordes.  The Lord
of Chaos, Draxas, uses him to execute powerful prisoners.  A task that
the Beastling Giant is well-suited for.  Rumour has it that he has the
power to summon his loyal follows at will to group and kill with him.

name: Coringor the Ancient Elven King
shortdesc: Coringor the Ancient Elven King is here lamenting his existance.
longdesc:
The elven king is very miserable.  He looks at you sadly, knowing that he must
kill you to save the rest of the world. Keftab, the Ancient, one along with Kalas
has tried to prevent him coming into this world, but this time they failed.

'You fear your final time has come as you stare into the icy glare of the Elven King.'

name: Prince Vlad the Destroyer
shortdesc: Prince Vlad the Destroyer is here, looking for someone to kill.
longdesc:
A tall, dark man, Prince Vlad looks very frightening.  His long black hair is
matted with blood, as his entire body.  He eminates a aura of fear, making you
afraid to even touch him.  He screams loudly when he sees you, a scream so
utterly animalistic it makes you shudder. Forever longing after his lover,
Mina the Queen.

name: A defiler
shortdesc: A defiler stands here, holding bloody body parts.
longdesc:
A short, squat demon, the defiler looks at you hungrily.  Bubbling,
oozing sores cover it's entire body.  Short, powerful arms end in long, wicked
claws, dripping blood and peices of flesh.

name: A Greater Tarrasgue
shortdesc: The legendary Tarrasque is here, waiting for you.
longdesc:
The legendary tarrasque, for there is fortunately only two know to exist,
is the most dreaded creature on the prime material plane.  The creature is
a scaly biped with two huge horns on its head, a lashing, barbed tail, and a
reflective carpace.

name: Crunch, the jailer
shortdesc: Crunch the jailer stands here, looking at you strangely.
longdesc:
A tall, dirty ogre, Crunch stands far above you.  His teeth are covered with
rotting flesh, and he doesnt smell to nice.  He doesnt look very nice, either.

name: A Lich
shortdesc: A lich is here, sobbing quietly.
longdesc:
The lich, a truly pittiful being, seems to be trapped in it's own
fortress.  It is covered in rotting flesh, and some of the bones is exposed
in raw relief.  You cant help but feel sorry for it, but as its glittering
eyes fix upon you, you begin to feel sorry for yourself.

name: A Slave
shortdesc: A overworked slave stands here.
longdesc:
This poor slave seems to be on it's last legs.  It just looks at you sadly,
shaking his head slightly, muttering under his breath.  You cant help but
feel sorry for it.

name: A blood-thirsty slave
shortdesc: A blood-thirsty slave stands here, drooling over you.
longdesc: This slave, driven to madness long ago, craves human flesh.

name: The Head Mortician
shortdesc: The Head Mortician stands here, embalming unfortunate souls.
longdesc:
The head morticain, in his office, is a sight to behold.  He just reaches
into a unfortunate person's body, and rips the soul clean out.  Not a pretty
site, either.  He is covered head to toe in blood and entrails. Yech.

name: A huge stone golem
shortdesc: A huge stone golem stands here, blocking the doorway.
longdesc:
Dark, cold, unrelenting, the stone golem utters a low groan as you
approch.  It's huge feet thud loudly, shaking the drawbridge as you approach.
A faint glimmer of intelligence sparks briefly in it's eyes as you come
nearer.

name: Corrosion, the Black Dragon
shortdesc: Corrosion, the ancient black dragon, lies here waiting to eat.
longdesc:
An immpossibly huge dragon, Corrosion certainly lives up to it's name.
Gaping holes lie in the floor, where he has drooled over some unfortunate
victim.  Glittering teeth, shining in the light, snap together as it awakes.

name: Spider
shortdesc: Spider stands here, a shimmering blur in front of you.
longdesc:
Spider is a short halfling, about two and a half feet tall.  He dances in
front of your eyes, shimmering, glowing.  He is neither here, nor there.

name: A zombie of a giant
shortdesc: A zombie of a giant stands here, moaning softly.
longdesc:
Long dead, this zombie reeks of mildew and decay.  It doesnt look very
happy, either.

name: A Large Black Man
shortdesc: A large, black man stands here, polishing a sword.
longdesc:
Tall and very dark, this man looks like a fierce opponent.  He looks angry,
also.

name: A sabre-toothed tiger
shortdesc: A sabre-toothed tiger is here, on the prowl
longdesc: Armed with long claws and huge teeth, this tiger is not to be messed with.

name: A Gladiator
shortdesc: A Gladiator stands here, waiting for someone to fight.
longdesc:
With long, corded, musculed arms, the Gladiator looks like and promises to
be a formidable opponenet.

name: A zombie
shortdesc: A zombie stands here, moaning softly.
longdesc: Dead for a long time, this zombie doesnt care about anything anymore.

name: A Skeleton
shortdesc: A Skeleton stands here, looking off into space.
longdesc: It looks confused.

name: The Nameless
shortdesc: The Nameless is floating here, existing.
longdesc:
A amorphous blob of undefined flesh and mist, the nameless is very disgusting.
