Flesh oozes and squirms, only to turn to vapor and float away.

name: A Guardian
shortdesc: A Guardian stands here, fiercely protecting the door.
longdesc:
A tall, whispery being without form, the guardian materializes around you to
attack.  Long limbs reach for you, eyes of red pry into your soul.  They wail,
a long, drawn out cry, lamenting to kill you.

name: A amorphous blob
shortdesc: A Amorphous blob is here, secreting digestive juices.
longdesc:
A quivering blob of flesh-like substances, this blob seems to have no head or
tail.  Digestive juices flow like water from pores about it's body, covering
the ground as it oozes towards you.

name: Alvyn Gallax, a madman
shortdesc: Alvyn Gallax, a madman, is standing here screaming.
longdesc:
Driven mad long ago by the sight of his shadow attacking him, Alvyn Gallax
does nothing but scream now.  Blood runs freely from open wounds across his
body, and his shrill scream pierces the air.

name: A Shadow Dragon
shortdesc: A Shadow Dragon is here, flickering in the light.
longdesc:
Formed of in-substantial shadow stuff, the shadow dragon exists on the prime
material and the plane of shadows at the same time.  Dwarfing even the largest
dragons on the prime material plane, the shadow dragon is impossobly huge.

name: Sir Xavier
shortdesc: Sir Xavier stands here, sharpening his scimitar.
longdesc:
A paladin of the highest degree, Sir Xavier has been here for a long time.
He stands tall and proud, filled with pride of being a paladin.  He looks like
he is truly protected by god.

name: Mathew the Wizard
shortdesc: Mathew the Wizards stands here, practicing spells.
longdesc: A Very powerful wizard, mathew is the right-hand man to Sir Xavier.

name: A Mist
shortdesc: A Mist is here, surrounding you.
longdesc: Formed of nothing but air, the mist surrounds you completely.

name: A Bone Guardian
shortdesc: A Bone Guardian is here, waiting to kill you.
longdesc:
Formed entirely of bones, this immense skeleton leaps form the surrounding
bones to attack!

name: A Shadow
shortdesc: A shadow flickers here, withdrawing from the light.
longdesc:
Barely able to see it, you cringe at the sight of your own shadows attacking
you.

name: A Soul Beckoner
shortdesc: A Soul Beckoner stands here, wailing eeriely.
longdesc:
a humanoid shape with large wings, the soul beckoner is a pitiful
creature, feeding off of the souls of living beings.

name: A Greater Flame
shortdesc: A Greater Flame is here, flickering, burning brightly.
longdesc: A mass of flame, the Greater Flame burns brightly.

name: A Minor Flame
shortdesc: A Minor Flame is here, burning playfully.
longdesc:
Burning brightly, the minor flame like to play tricks.  He circles
around you, reaching to touch you....


OUCH! That really did HURT!

name: A Flaming Griffin
shortdesc: A Flaming Griffin stands here silently.
longdesc:
A Mass of flame, towering far above you, the flaming griffin stands
silently.  A majestic head scans the entire countryside, then it spots you.
It regards you with curiosity for a moment, then looks away.

name: The Protector of the Flames
shortdesc: The Protector of the Flames stands here, silently observing you.
longdesc:
'Have you harmed my children?' a tall flaming figure asks.  'Of course
not,' he replies, 'you wouldn't.'  He grins evilly.  'Cause then you would have
to deal with me.'

name: A Burning Shadow
shortdesc: A Shadow stands here, burning birghtly.
longdesc:
Utterly miserable, this burning shadow hates it here.  It seems to have
wandered in here and caught fire.  It looks pissed off.

name: A shadow mastiff
shortdesc: A Shadow Mastiff is here, baying loudly.
longdesc:
This shadow resembles a dog.  It sends a shiver down your spine as it howls
loudly.

name: A summoned shadow
shortdesc: A Summoned shadow stands here, looking very angry.
longdesc:
Haveing been ripped from its home with magic, this shadow looks
very angry.

name: Loliadac the Rakashaka
shortdesc: Loliadac the Rakashaka stands here, grinning evilly.
longdesc:
With all five head turned on you, Loliadac is a truly gruesome creature.
A mantis, a crocodile, a gorilla, a human and a tiger mashed into one,
Loliadac is your worst nightmare.

name: An Animated Suit of Armor
shortdesc: An animated suit of armor is standing here, blocking your way.
longdesc: Enchanted by some powerful magic, these suits of armor look tough.

name: A Large Skeleton
shortdesc: A Large skeleton is here, beckoning you closer.
longdesc:
Seeminly unable to let go of life, this skeleton is rather nice.  It has
good manners, speaks well, but smells rather bad.  About it's neck you can
see a small silver cross, and it is wielding a rusty dagger.

name: The Judgement Maker
shortdesc: The Judgement maker is here, weighing your soul.
longdesc:
An angelic being of immense power, the judgement maker looks truly
protected by god.  Not someone to mess with.

name: A Small Dragon
shortdesc: A Small Dragon stands here, whistling to itself.
longdesc: It appears to be a tiny dragon, with big nasty sharp teeth.

name: The First Champion
shortdesc: The First Champion stands here, waiting for you.
longdesc:
He looks tuff.  Very tuff.  I wouldnt mess with him if I were you.

The First Champion grins evilly.

name: The Second Champion
shortdesc: The Second Champion stands here, practicing her spells.
longdesc: Look just about as tough as the first champion.

name: The Third Champion
shortdesc: The Third Champion is here, emerging from the shadows.
longdesc: Whoah!  It just came out of no-where.....

name: The Fourth Champion
shortdesc: The Fourth Champion stands here, waiting to begin.
longdesc: He looks impossible to kill.  Or at least, very nearly so.

name: Santa Claws
shortdesc: Santa Claws stands here throwing around nicely wrapped gifts
longdesc:
A very old man, with an evil grin on is face is here. His beard is long
and dirty, it looks like he's fell of the sled a few too many times on 
his terrifying journeys. You feel almost charmed to tag along on a ride!

name: Mina, Queen of the Fatal
shortdesc:
A tall angelic woman stands here with a menacing look in her eyes.
Mina, Queen of the Fatal glows with a black aura!
longdesc:
A tall angelic woman stands here with a menacing look in her eyes
Mina was a human offspring of an angel.  She was bitten by the Vampire Phardrad to 
become his queen.  Once transformed, her angelic nature merged with vampire blood to
create a monster of extraordinary power.  She found Phardard beneath her, so she 
cast him aside and took over the dark realm for her own.  She coupled with the 
Dark God, Velsha Kalan to sire Setra and Prince Vlad, whom she later deamed worthy
to be her lover.

name: The Schizomidae
shortdesc:
A Schizomidae is lying here legs spread, blending into
  the rock.
longdesc:
Commonly called whip scorpions, they appear as a cross between a spider
and
a scorpion. This type is equiped with fearsome-looking mandibles. Strong
  and quick as hell, they are very dangerous.

name: The Amblypygi
shortdesc: A Amblypygi is waiting here for something to hunt.
longdesc:
Commonly called whip scorpions, they appear as a cross between a spider
and
a scorpion. This type is equiped with two fearsome-looking spine pincers
and two whip-like appendages. Strong and quick, they are very dangerous.

name: The Uropygi
shortdesc:
A Uropygi stands here motionless, waiting for food to
  come.
longdesc:
Commonly called whip scorpions, they appear as a cross between a spider
and
a scorpion. This type is equiped with two fearsome-looking spine pincers
and two whip-like appendages and a whip tail. Strong and fast, they are
  very dangerous.

name: The young Nightcrawler
shortdesc: A young Nightcrawler moves here, searching for food.
longdesc:
Usually found in the deep depths of the earth, it is a baby Nightshade
40' long and shiny black, the great mouth large and looks like it
inflicts
  horrible wounds, while the sting on the tail holds vile poison.

name: An adult Nightcrawler
shortdesc: An adult Nightcrawler moves here, searching for food.
longdesc:
Usually found in the deep depths of the earth, it is a young adult
Nightshade
60' long and shiny black, the great mouth large and looks like it
inflicts
  horrible wounds, while the sting on the tail holds vile poison.

name: A Great Nightcrawler
shortdesc: A Great Nightcrawler rises 30ft above you, as you enter!
longdesc:
Usually found in the deep depths of the earth, it is a Nightshade 60'
long
and shiny black, the great mouth large and looks like it inflicts
horrible
wounds, while the sting on the tail holds vile poison. This is full blown
  one, a lord of the deep earth.

name: The Grey Margot
shortdesc: A grey Margot stands here, gnashing it's great mouth.
longdesc:
Margots are hideous giant maws set upon three thick legs that end in
  thick three-toed pads. Three eyes are set on long muscled stalks.

name: The Dusky Margot
shortdesc: A dusky Margot is stomping about, gnashing it's teeth.
longdesc:
Margots are hideous giant maws set upon three thick legs that end in
  thick three-toed pads. Three eyes are set on long muscled stalks.

name: The black Margot
shortdesc:
A black Margot stomps it's great pads, bringing dust
  down.
longdesc:
Margots are hideous giant maws set upon three thick legs that end in
  thick three-toed pads. Three eyes are set on long muscled stalks.

name: The Being
shortdesc: A mist is swirling and flowing here.
longdesc:
Facing the mist, waves of deathly chill wash over you. Already your face
begins to frostbite. The mist undulates and pulses slowly. Tendres of
  glittering white float out to touch you.

name: Shades
shortdesc: Shades is here exploring.
longdesc:
Looking closer, you can see right through Shades. He is in fact a Shade!
>From what you recall, a Shade is a powerful mortal that has found a way
  to become part shadow. Living forever yet weak in pure light or dark.

name: The Drow scout
shortdesc:
A Drow dressed in scout fashon, stands in the shadows
  here.
longdesc:
Ebon skinned and dressed in black armor that denotes him as a powerful
  scout.

name: An Aquatic
shortdesc: An Aquatic swims out of the dark at you.
longdesc:
Thought to be kin to demons, the Aquatic's octopus-like head sports a
fanged
maw that snaps as it's glassy black eyes fasten on you. Four tentacles
grow
  from the body that tapers into a fish-like tail.

name: The small Galeb Duhr
shortdesc: A smallish boulder lies here.
longdesc:
A curious boulder-like creature. The Galeb Duhr moves upon two large
apendages that can serve as both hands and feet. Small mushrooms and
  lichen grows upon it's surface.

name: The large Galeb Duhr
shortdesc: A large boulder lies here.
longdesc:
A curious boulder-like creature. The Galeb Duhr moves upon two large
apendages that can serve as both hands and feet. Small mushrooms and
  lichen grows upon it's surface.

name: The King Galeb Duhr
shortdesc:
A large boulder with veins of gold and silver, stands
  here.
longdesc:
A curious noble boulder-like creature. There is a vaguely humanoid
visage,
  turned in your direction. The eyes hold wisdom and look kindly.

name: The Nightwing
shortdesc:
A Nightwing glides silently out of the darkness toward
  you!
longdesc:
A Nightshade, similar to a gigantic bat. Solid black, with a 50'
wingspread!
  It moves on silent wings as it homes in on you.

name: The White Kraken
shortdesc: A huge White Kraken has arrived from the depths.
longdesc:
A gigantic squid-like creature. Ten of the twelve tentacles, surrounding
a huge beaked mouth, whip out to attack. Looking into the eyes, you see
intelligence laced with evil. This perticular Kraken is albino white and
  has grown even larger than it's surface brothers.

name: The Aboleth
shortdesc: The huge bulk of an Aboleth looms out of the dark waters.
longdesc:
Resembles a large, blue-green fish which lacks all fins but the caudal.
The
body is 20' long and has a head with three large, slitlike eyes and four
  10' long tentacles.

name: Utmodoch
shortdesc: Utmodoch, Sovereign Shator Demodand, is sitting upon the throne.
longdesc:
The huge bulk of a Shator Demodand sits upon the throne. Utmodoch is here
trying to get a foothold on the realms. He hopes to soon add it to the
  planes that he already rules.

name: Ur-Vile
shortdesc: Count Ur-Vile the Lord Entropic, stands here studying a wall.
longdesc:
Count Ur-Vile smiles wickedly at you, revealing the teeth of a vampire.
Once a Mage-Assassin, then a Vampire Lord, and now some kind of demon-
vampire of great power. Ur-Vile is dressed in resplendent clothing and
  armor of black.

name: Veron
shortdesc: Prince Veron walks out of the darkness toward you, and grins.
longdesc:
Prince Veron, Thain Evil looks back at you with evil contempt. When he
grins you see that he is a vampire. Once a powerful Cleric, then a Prince
of the Undead, he now is second in command to Utmodoch. The demon-vampire
half-breed is devilishly handsome and is garbed in fine black cloths and
  armor.

name: The Great Thessalhydra
shortdesc:
A gigantic creature, much like a hydra, notes your
  arrival.
longdesc:
Your gaze slides up a gigantic body of black shiny scales, to a mass of
huge shiny black serpent heads with glowing red eyes, that twist in the
darkness above you. As you watch, the serpent heads part to reviel the
huge central mouth they fringe. A black pincer on the end of a serpentine
  tail whips out of the darkness, aiming to sever your body in half.

name: a mini-bunny
shortdesc: The mini-bunny stands here, Brrrrrrrrr..
longdesc: The image of Bunta, in a fucked up small form

name: an insubstancial ghost
shortdesc: A beautiful yet insubstantial ghost floats here.  She wants to be your friend.
longdesc:
If you were in to girls, this would be your ideal woman.  It is almost as if
the very essence of what you deem beautiful has been lifted from your mind
and given form.  Of course, if you're not in to girls, then she just looks
like a very pretty girl-ghost.

name: A Giant Bat
shortdesc: A Giant Bat swoops in at you from above.
longdesc:
This huge bat has a 16 foot wingspan.  It has huge claws that look
capable of tearing you apart, and razor sharp fangs that could
penetrate stone!

name: a haunt
shortdesc: A ghostly apparition weeps silently.
longdesc:
This is the cursed spirit of a former noble of this once fair house,
doomed to remain and watch it slowly decay into nothing, helpless to
leave or prevent this or its own suffering. Coupled with this is the
fact that anyone who could speak her language died millennia ago.

name: The Heartchord
shortdesc: The Heartchord stands here, it's heart beating visibly between the open wound of his chest.
longdesc:
Long dead, with mildew clinging to the rotting, stinking flesh, the Heartchord
is a giant, restless zombie.  It's name comes from the open, gaping wound on it's
chest where it's purple-black heart can be seen visibly pounding with every beat.
It is rumoured that Lord Flay attempted to tear the heart out in his rampage, but
succeeded only in leaving the gaping wound we see now.

name: a greasy cook
shortdesc:
A rotund rat is here, cheerfully cooking some sort of questionable s
ubsatnce.
longdesc:
The apron that this rat is wearing barely covers his rather large belly.
Occasionally the cook prods the roasted cat with one finger, sticks it
in his mouth, and smiles happily.

name: the Zombie Master
shortdesc: The Zombie Master is standing here looking very frightening.
longdesc:
The Zombie Master is tall (7'2") and skinny.  He's wearing a tie-dye
  T-shirt and blue jeans.  He's fairly handsome if you don't consider
  the hordes of walking dead following him around...

name: the wraith
shortdesc: A misty wraith is drifting around here.
longdesc:
Made up of the pure negative energy the wraith feasts upon the life energy of
all living creatures.

name: A Skeletal Giant
shortdesc: A Massive Skeletal Giant charges at you mindlessly
longdesc:
This is the undead remains of a long dead Fire Giant, its
body's flesh has decayed many years ago leaving a pile of charred
bones and a few scraps of clothing.

name: Vartha, the Vampiress
shortdesc: Vartha, the Vampiress stands here, licking her fangs.
longdesc:
Vartha is a short girl, standing only 5' tall, although the gentle
curve of her legs makes her appear taller.  She was turned in to a
vampire when she was still a teen and, like many teenagers, has a
tendency towards petulance and small evil acts.  Be careful around
her, for she is like to look upon you as her plaything!

name: Lord Flay
shortdesc: Lord Flay, the Juggernaut looms here, full of fury and malice.
longdesc:
Lord Flay, known as the Juggernaut for his ferocity and malice, was
once the owner of this mansion.  Legend says that in a fit of rage
he destroyed his family and cursed them all with un-life.  The hellish
existence attracted the attentions of the paladin, Sir Wrathschide,
who managed to trap Lord Flay at the top of his tower, but at the
cost of his immortal soul, for should he leave, Lord Flay would be
free of his prison and able to roam the world!

name: Squire Trellary, the Death Knight
shortdesc: The Death Knight, Squire Trellary, is praying here.
longdesc:
Squire Trellary was a paladin, a knight in service under Sir Wrath-
schide.  In life he was hot-headed, quick to judge and mistook bravery
for recklessness.  He rushed on ahead of Sir Wrathschide, convinced he
would slay all the evildoers and return triumphant.  He met Lord Flay
soon on and was bested.  As he lay bleeding, dying, on the floor, Lord
Flay cursed his foolishness, making him rise as a Death Knight for all
eternity.

name: the Cambion
shortdesc:
The Cambion stands here, radiating power.
The Cambion is surrounded by an evil aura.
longdesc:
The Cambion is an arch-duke in the deeper layers of Hell.  It was summoned 
and set loose in the mansion to wreak havoc and destroy all it encountered.
Having long ago accomplished it's mission, it now sits and waits for the
souls it feeds upon to come to it where it devours them slowly, savouring
their terror.

name: the Crippled Boy
shortdesc: The corpse of a crippled child is here, squirming on the floor.
longdesc:
In life, the Crippled Boy was the son of Lord Flay.  He loved to run
and play in the fields surrounding the house.  He would chase butter-
flies and catch frogs to scare his mother with.  And then the madness
descended and Lord Flay broke both his legs before unleashing the
horror upon the mansion, knowing that his son, the poor Crippled Boy,
would never be able to run away his doom.

name: the Fallen Guardian
shortdesc: A fallen knight stands here, guarding the way upwards.
longdesc:
When Sir Wrathschide sought to cleanse the mansion, he brought with
him many good men who had sworn to vanquish evil.  Many of the knight
companions fell to the power of Lord Flay, being unable to withstand
the sheer power.  As the c

name: the skeletal warrior
shortdesc: A skeletal warrior stands guard here.
longdesc:
Larger than a regular skeleton and certainly more power, this skeleton looks
as if it has been standing guard here for centuries.

name: Gorn
shortdesc: Gorn, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Gorn, Guardian Eternal, formerly a soldier in Sareks personal guard appears
to be weary of his task.  With a saddening glance Gorn says "I am truly
sorry, but I am afraid I must kill you.

name: Byrn
shortdesc: Byrn, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Byrn, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  He glows red and
looks like a demon from hell.

name: Krin
shortdesc: Krin, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Krin, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  Krin looks at you
and says "Fear not, your deaths shall swift and painless.

name: Seth
shortdesc: Seth, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Seth, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  His eyes speak of
a longing to end the Guardianship, the endless vigil.  Krin looks at you
with smouldering eyes, striking fear into your veins.

name: Lord Hansen
shortdesc: Lord Hansen, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Lord Hansen, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  Lord Hansen
appears to be weary of this world, almost as if longing for death.

name: the black baron
shortdesc: The black baron stands here staring out over the balcony into the distance.
longdesc: The black baron is a nasty looking man converted to the dark side of life, his ears have been cut off and the only thing on him that reminds that he was once a human being is the fact that he still got his nose and eyes. Both blue!

name: the bone devil
shortdesc: A bone devil hisses at you in defiance.
longdesc:
This monster is one of the lesser devils of this plane. He stands nearly nine
feet tall and has a tail with a poisonous barbed stinger on the end.

name: A Bone Guardian
shortdesc: A Bone Guardian is here, waiting to kill you.
longdesc:
Formed entirely of bones, this immense skeleton leaps form the surrounding
bones to attack!

name: an unholy spirit
shortdesc: A snarling, drooling clawed creature flies screaming at you!
longdesc: You look long and hard but see nothing notable.

name: Hyd
shortdesc: Hyd, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Hyd, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  It is hard to get a
good look at him as he darts into the shadows.

name: Cerne
shortdesc: Cerne, Guardian Eternal
longdesc:
Cerne, Guardian Eternal, bears the ensignia of Sarek.  Cerne, proud and
noble, promises to be a worthy opponent.

name: Sir Wrathschide
shortdesc:
Sir Wrathschide, the Guardian Eternal, is ever alert here.
Sir Wrathschide glows with a silvery sheen.
longdesc:
Sir Wrathschide stormed the mansion with his men long ago.  Their task
was simple; hold back the spreading evil and destroy Lord Flay.  Sadly,
Lord Flay proved too powerful to destroy and the only way that the evil
could be contained was to lock it away in the very top of the tower and
prevent anyone from ever getting to it.  So Sir Wrathschide laid down
his life to this end, swearing that he would remain a vigilant guardian
until the day Lord Flay was no longer a threat.

name: The Drowned Son
shortdesc: A sopping wet, pale-blue corpse shuffles around here.
longdesc:
This poor, dishevelled, sopping wet corpse was once Lord Flay's son.  He was
handsome in life, standing over two meters tall, with flowing dark locks.
Those same tresses now hang limply, damply across his shoulders, his skin
wrinkled and pale from water exposure.  Lord Flay drowned his own son in the
bath.  And there was, apparently, no reason for such madness!

name: a manes demon
shortdesc: A manes demon is staring you with an insane bloodlust.
longdesc:
A man sized figured with long taloned hands. It has been summoned here by a
greater power to serve without question.

name: A demon lord
shortdesc: An enormous demon notices you and steps out of the shadows
longdesc:
This is on impressive being he has an enormous set of horns on his head,
which match the rest of him he must be atleast 10 feet tall, and he just fills
the room with his presence. He turns towards and flash you a smile with alot of
big pointy teeth in it. Maybe he thinks dinner has arrived..........

name: A group of skeletons
shortdesc: A huge pile of bones start to move on the floor
longdesc: A group of skeletons start to form up from out of the pile of bones.

name: a wandering draggahn
shortdesc: A starving draggahn is lurking here.
longdesc:
You see a scaley humanoid, that has large yellow teeth, and piercing
eyes. It wears a torn primitive cloak, denoting some kind of tribal
rank. It grins evilly at you.  Large wings are folded behind its back.

name: a snarling bear
shortdesc: A snarling bear is pawing at the ground here.
longdesc:
You see a very large black bear, with huge dripping fangs.  It seems to
sniff the air in your direction... assessing your presence here.

name: a jungle lion
shortdesc: A jungle lion is prowling here.
longdesc:
You see a large lion, lazily stalking around the trees. It seems quite
agile and sensitive to your presence. It growls, sniffing the air.

name: a travelling merchant
shortdesc: A travelling merchant is looking for directions here.
longdesc:
You see a merchant wearing strange clothes, obviously wandering along
from a distant land. The man wears heavy robes, hiding any bags, or
possessions he may have.

name: a burdened trader
shortdesc: A hunting trader is standing here.
longdesc:
You see a trader who is bearing animal skins from his hunting adventures
in the jungle. He appears to be a strong, guarded man.

name: a cloaked figure
shortdesc: A cloaked figure is standing here.
longdesc:
You see a shadowy, cloaked figure. It hides from your gaze, fumbling
around to avoid contact with anyone. You see no face beneath its
dark hood.

name: a screeching buzzard
shortdesc: A buzzard is flying low here.
longdesc:
A thin buzzard is hovering before, hoping that you will be its next
easy meal.  It seems to be scanning for carcases in the area.

name: a grass snake
shortdesc: A large red grass snake is wriggling here.
longdesc:
This beast has long reddish stripes on its back.  It is a huge snake,
with coils that are almost twenty feet long.

name: a small cheetah
shortdesc: A small cheetah is stalking here.
longdesc:
You see the graceful grasslands runner, a wild cheetah. It seems oblivious
to any danger. It playfully paws at a nearby field mouse.

name: a badger
shortdesc: A badger is clawing at the ground here.
longdesc:
This small badger is quite frightened, as it senses your approach.
It tries to hide in a bush to get away from you, snarling in defiance.

name: a silver wolf
shortdesc: A silver wolf is prowling here.
longdesc:
You see one of the guardian animals of the great plains, a massive
silver wolf.  It stands proudly before you, bearing its large fangs.

name: a patrolling warrior
shortdesc: A patrolling warrior is keeping track of the road here.
longdesc:
A battle hardened fighter stands here, watching over the Bandit's Run
with experienced eyes, looking for signs of invaders.

name: a peasant
shortdesc: A feeble peasant is looking for wisdom and learning here.
longdesc:
This peasant looks as if they are about to starve to death.  But they
avert their eyes from your probing gaze, and humbly back into a submissive
posture.

name: a pathetic beggar
shortdesc: A beggar is slouching here, looking at you with sad eyes.
longdesc:
The beggar has a wild look in their eyes, as if they might be desperate
enought to take whatever they need from you, at any cost.

name: The Grey Dragon
shortdesc: The giant grey dragon stares at you icily, looking into your soul.
longdesc:
This old dragon has seen more than one adventurer gaze upon its
presence.  It smirks as you approach, fully confident that it can
blast you into oblivion with one breath should you dare to threaten
it.

name: a humble townsman
shortdesc: A townsman is wandering along the road here, whistling pleasantly.
longdesc:
This person wears the drab brown colors of typical Phul clothing,
as most fancier garments are rare and expensive.  He looks
as if he has seen many a strange traveller here as he goes along
his way on the road.

name: Owlbane
shortdesc: The archmage Owlbane paces here, contemplating odd mysteries.
longdesc:
This mage radiates power and magical presence.  He has a worried
look upon his brow, as if things are not at all as they should be.

name: a bandit
shortdesc: A stealthy bandit is plotting evil schemes here.
longdesc:
The bandit wears the black robes of the bandit clan. He thumbs his nose at
you as you pass by him through the camp.

name: a thug
shortdesc: A brutal looking thug is picking his nose here.
longdesc:
The thug wears the typical rags of carefree life in the jungle.  He stiffens
as you approach, thinking that you are one of the bandit leaders.

name: an assassin
shortdesc: A cold blooded assassin is sharpening his knives here.
longdesc:
The assassin wears the chameleon-like robes of the jungle hunter. He peers
at you very intently, sizing up your combat skills.

name: a berserker
shortdesc: An anxious berserker hacks at a wooden stump here.
longdesc:
The berserker wears tattered rags, and has a fevorish look in his eyes.  He
seems to be struggling with a decision about how soon he should attack you.

name: The Master Bandit
shortdesc: The Master of Bandits is plotting here.
longdesc:
The master blabbers on and on about his grandios planes for his guild.
No one is listening to him, as the stories often repeat themselves.

name: Tigershark
shortdesc: A large striped shark swims by.
longdesc:
This large predatory fish has to be one of mother natures most perfect
killers.  Rows of razor sharp teeth grin your way in a way saying 'lunch'.

name: jellyfish
shortdesc: A small jellyfish floats by in the currents.
longdesc:
This strange creature uses the currents as it's main way of locomotion.  Several
tentacles run from it's gelatenous body.

name: snapper
shortdesc: A medium sized red fish swims bye.
longdesc:
This reef predator is covered with tiny red and silver scales, which help camoflauge
the fish on it's daily life.

name: hermitcrab
shortdesc: A small crab moves around the beach.
longdesc:
This small crab scurries along the beach with it's home on it's back.  When the crab
gets too big for the house it carries now it will seek out a new one.

name: bluering
shortdesc: A tiny octopus with small blue rings all over it's body hides here.
longdesc:
This tiny octopus is one of those most beautiful octopod in the sea.  It's body is
covered in tiny bright blue rings.  These rings aren't just for decoration, but also
to serve a poison warning to all who see it.

name: hammerhead
shortdesc: A large shark with a hammer-like head swims by.
longdesc:
This large meateater searches the ocean waters for it's next meal.  The wide "hammer"
head serves as a radar of sorts.  Sending out electrical signals that pick up on it's
next meal.

name: Seagull
shortdesc: A sqaucking white sea bird spirals in the air currents from the sea.
longdesc:
This bird doesn't seem to do anything important for the grand plan of the ocean.
It's  loud squacking can be heard for houndreds of feet away as it abd many like it
dart in and out of the waters for food.

name: eel
shortdesc: A large green eels peers at you from the shadows.
longdesc:
This snake like eel watches you from is't hole with a wide open mouth showing
you rows of needle sharp teeth.  The majority of it's green body is hidden in the
depths of the reef.

name: A stonecrab
shortdesc: A large crab with even larger pinchers stands here tring to get some food.
longdesc: This large orange and white crab is large enough to be able to walk around without much fear from any of the many predators that would try and eat it.  It's large pinchers serve for both attackindg and defending.

name: A Horseshoe crab
shortdesc: The wierdest looking crab skids across the sand.
longdesc: There is no other way to describe this thing then wierd.  It kind of looks like something out of the prehistoric age.  It's head looks more like a bowl that has been turned over then a horseshoe.  Out the back of this bowl extends a rather lond spike that looks like it could do some real damage.

name: A grouper
shortdesc: A big fat spotted fish swims around looking for something to eat.
longdesc: This large fish swims along darting here and there tring either to get something to eat or no be something elses food for the day.

name: A clownfish
shortdesc: A colorful fish hides in the shadows.
longdesc: This tiny orange and white striped  fish is too small to be much of a predator so instead of attacking things it run around eating the scraps of what the bigger guys leave around.

name: The eel
shortdesc: A slimy eel stares at you with it's mouth gaping open.
longdesc: This long greyish green eel has to be about 10 feet in length.  It's rows and rows of needle sharp teeth look like they could and will do some serious damage to anyone who might be stupid enough to get too close.

name: Nasis
shortdesc: Nasis, The Flame-Lord of Tartarus rules here with an iron fist.
longdesc:
This is Nasis, Flame-Lord of Tartarus, Ruler of the Deepest Places. If he
had a title it would be longer and more cringe than anything Sabor could
dream up.  He is a mighty, powerful titan, standing well over twenty feet
tall.  He is a perfect, unmarred alabaster in colour with veins of fiery
red snaking across him like blood vessels.  He is dressed in his finest
robe with his dagger Midnight secured at his side.  On his feet are a pair
of simple sandals and a crown of embers adorns his brow.  All of it is in
the same alabaster as his flesh, as if his very touch taints everything 
around him.  A powerful sorcerer and warrior, he holds back the aeon long
rebellion of Adina even as he plans domination of the rest of the realms.

name: Adina
shortdesc: Adina, the titanic Frost-Queen stands here.
longdesc:
Adina is a towering example of her kind, a Titan of emense power.
As with all of the Titan-kin, she looks like a perfect alabaster
statue, sculpted by the most talented artist ever to live, with
glowing veins of icy blue snaking over her like blood vessels.  
She moves fluidly, effortlessly, with a grace no creature made of
flesh and bone would ever achieve.  She wears a skirt of leather
pleats that hang down to her mid-thigh, and her shins and upper
feet are protected by form-fitting greaves.  Over her bosom she
wears a studded plate chest guard that leaves Her naval exposed.
In left her hand she grips the hilt of Catastrophe, her powerful,
self-forged mace.  All of it is the same alabaster stone as the
titan Herself, as if part of Her infuses the items she holds and
wears.

name: Trichlid
shortdesc: A disgusting pile of decaying bone and flesh lies here.
longdesc:
Several animated bones and rotten flesh are combined to form this
satanic creature.  He is well aware of your presence and preparing to
defend his home.

name: Sespore
shortdesc: The sespore slithers through the trash here setting it ablaze.
longdesc:
A Fiery, snake-like creature wades through this disgusting sespool in
search of dinner.  It seems to take a liking to you.  Perhaps, you will be
its next meal.

name: A prison guard
shortdesc: A massive and toned man guards the prison entrance from intruders.
longdesc:
This man is huge!  He stares down at you with a cold and intimidating
glare.  You sure wouldn't want to be thrown in this prison.

name: A prisoner
shortdesc: A prisoner tries to clamber to his feet.
longdesc:
These prisoners must be held for some serious crimes.  They are almost
forgotten as their boney figures show the signs of malnutrition and
sickness.

name: Nasis' henchman
shortdesc: Nasis' henchman dare you to endure his challenging maze.
longdesc:
These are simple minded people who have sacrificed themselves to
serve the almighty Nasis.  They are prepared to do all it takes to protect their leader.

name: A hidden thief
shortdesc: A sneaky thief searches your pockets for gold and valuables.
longdesc:
Suprisingly you notice this sneaky little trouble-maker.  He is lightning
quick and stealthy.  You had better check your pockets!

name: A hidden assassin
shortdesc: A mysterious assassin hides in the shadows here.
longdesc:
An undistinguishable man tries to hide in the shadows from you.  He is
alerted to your presence and doesn't appreciate you being here.

name: An ugly witch
shortdesc: An ugly old woman with a pointed nose stirs her kettle fervently.
longdesc:
This woman is scary but really pays no attention to you.  She is too
busy making her concoction.  You can't get over the ugly wart on her
nose.

name: A solemn priest
shortdesc: A dark, robed man mumbles incantations as he kneels in prayer.
longdesc:
You are unable to see his face as his hooded robe casts a dark shadow
over it.  It is a mystery to you why this man is here, especially why he carries
a gold key tied to his waist.

name: A stone angel
shortdesc: A stone angel breaks free from her restricting fountain.
longdesc:
This creature must be a magical animation.  Whoever is controlling her
surely doesn't appreciate you being here and certainly will not offer you
an invitation to come back if you survive.

name: A hairy man
shortdesc: A hairy man leans against the small statue here.
longdesc:
This man is disgusting.  Hair flows out of almost every pore in his entire
body.  You don't even want to touch him let alone fight him.

name: a mature red dragon
shortdesc: A mature red dragon stares at his next fried dinner.
longdesc:
This fierce dragon is trapped in Nasis' small trap.  It must have been one
his pets that he captured.  Unfortunately, he doesn't look to be enjoying
himself in here.

name: Elvid
shortdesc: A strange man sits here with reddish skin.
longdesc: Elvid has strangely pointed teeth, a forked tongue and seems to look right past you.

name: Rizillizesixxiz
shortdesc: A very large blue dragon waits here to avenge Adina.
longdesc:
Rizillizesixxiz is surrounded by a blue glow, the ground below it freezing, large puffs of vapor come 
 from its jaws and nostrils. The tail of this dragon is quite easily longer than its body with
 a shard of ice on the tip.

name: Siqixisas
shortdesc: Siqixisas, protector of the Chalice.
longdesc:
A rather short male human, looks around for the chalice and seems to think
that you have stolen it.

name: a warrior monk of Agatar
shortdesc: A well built white clad figure stands silently nearby.
longdesc:
A strongly built figure stands before you.  The well spun woolen
cloth falls tightly across his prominent muscles.  His biceps ripple
as he grips his longsword in his hands.  His eyes stare out in the
distance as if there is more to this world than just what you can see.

name: a cleric from Agatar's Order
shortdesc: A cleric from Agatar's Order is standing here.
longdesc:
The cleric is busily mumbling.  The white cloth hangs gracefully
from the shoulders and hides the feet from view.  It looks as if
the cleric is moving on air and maybe it is true for the eyes are
old and deep, a deep sky blue with a sea blue instead of a black
iris....

name: a guardian warrior
shortdesc: A well built white clad figure stands silently nearby.
longdesc:
A strongly built figure stands before you.  The well spun woolen
cloth falls tightly across his prominent muscles.  His biceps ripple
as he grips his longsword in his hands.  His eyes stare out in the
distance as if there is more to this world than just what you can see.

name: The Abbot of Agatar
shortdesc: The Abbot of Agatar is standing here, smiling peacefully at you.
longdesc:
The Abbot is a friendly looking character who could do with a few 
more meals.  He's lean and gaunt but the smile encompasses you
with a welcoming warmth.  The eyes are strangely blue on blue
and his hands are not those of a simple cleric.

name: A young monk of Agatar
shortdesc: A young monk stands nervously nearby, fingering his sword
longdesc:
The young monk is obviously in training.  Hanging from the belt
about his waist you can see a small book and a short sword.
His face still has the look of youth, not yet fully tempered by
life.

name: A withered spirit
shortdesc: A withered spirit hovers in the half-light.
longdesc:
The visage before you is neither in the here or the beyond
but in that limbo in between.  It is translucent and gleaming
and has a haunted look in its eyes.

name: A haunted soul
shortdesc: A haunted soul is barely visible before you.
longdesc:
The visage before you is neither in the here or the beyond
but in that limbo in between.  It is nearly opaque and gleams
and glistens with every movement.  There is a haunted hunted
look in its eyes, a look of desperation and hunger.

name: A withered soldier
shortdesc: A withered soldier is standing here.
longdesc:
The poor soul that was the proud soldier that this wreck
of a vision once was.  The armour hangs mysteriously
off its shoulders, its sword held by a wisp of darkness.
Staring into its face you sense a great sadness, a desire
to be set free.

name: A kitchen ghost
shortdesc: A kitchen ghost is standing here, it looks surprisingly friendly.
longdesc:
Ooh you reach out to touch it and it feels nice... This is strange,
the body is contorted in pain but it is as if the goodness of the
character survived this transformation and still shines.... poor
soul.

name: A green slime
shortdesc: A green slime covers the floor.
longdesc:
the slime is icky to the touch and smelly too.  With every step
upon it you squeeze a green watery liquid out of it, which quickly
is absorbed by the rest of the slime.  The slime has a movement all
of its own, a slithering movement down the walls and along the 
floor, slipping down to the lowest level.

name: A deep darkness
shortdesc: A deep darkness stands before you.
longdesc:
What can be said, its dark, just dark, nothing else.  A pillar
of deep deep darkness in the middle of the room, forming
a barrier blocking the light.

name: A dull darkness
shortdesc: A dull darkness stands before you.
longdesc:
What can be said, its dark, just dark, nothing else.  A pillar
of great darkness in the middle of the room.

name: A soulless guardian
shortdesc: A soulless guardian is standing here.
longdesc:
A stolid figure, not just dressed in black, but enamating black,
stands before you.  The figure has no eyes but the sockets seem
to blaze fire, baring your soul, raising your actions to be seen, the
good to be punished, the evil praised.

name: A dark guardian
shortdesc: A dark guardian is standing here.
longdesc:
A stolid figure, not just dressed in black, but enamating black,
stands before you.  The figure has no eyes but the sockets seem
to blaze fire, baring your sou.

name: A Carpenter
shortdesc: A carpenter is standing here.
longdesc:
The carpenter is busy choosing wood for the ship, his mouth is full of
nails, as he holds them there, before he needs to use them.

name: A Shipwright
shortdesc: The shipwright is standing here, frowning.
longdesc:
The shipwright is elven naturally, and is an expert is designing new 
ships.  It is on his skills and a few others that have made the ship-
yards of Endar world renowned for quality and durability.  He notices
your gaze, and turns away, shy of the attention.

name: A Construction Worker
shortdesc: A construction worker is standing here.
longdesc:
Construction workers are all alike, arms the size of tree trunks, and
the braincells to match.  They all work very hard, and like to retire
to the pubs at night, for some ale and hard play.

name: The foreman
shortdesc: The foreman is standing here.
longdesc:
He is shouting very loudly, looks at you, and then decides to shout
even louder, something about the workers being related to slime rats
and something about schedules.. you shrug and turn away.

name: A wood snarget
shortdesc: A small wood snarget is hissing at you.
longdesc:
The small lizard-like wood snarget is dark brown in colour.
If it were not for its constant hissing you would easily 
miss it in the piles of wood.

name: A wood snake
shortdesc: A small wood snake is looking at you.
longdesc:
The small snake is quietly looking at you, watching your movements.
It's head is slightly raised and when it opens it's mouth you can see
some vicious fangs inside.

name: moss
shortdesc: A large moss patch covers the floor.
longdesc:
The slimy moss is strange, it moves around your feet whenever you move,
but yet not likely ordinary sediment.  It is strange, it is everywhere,
but yet some bits give an impression of malevolence.

name: a farmland bovine
shortdesc: A farmland bovine, unconcerned about the surroundings.
longdesc:
With its thick and healthy looking hide, this muscular bovine
stare blindly into the air, concerned about nothing but its own
well being. Shifting between bright white, and grayish black, the
creature seem well tended by its handlers. Muscular shaped legs
keep the cattle standing within its cage for several  hours without
rest, truly a magnificent creation. A plain metal collar, with a
number etched into its surface fits tightly around the creature's
neck, allowing the keeper to identify its cattle.

name: a fat-looking pig
shortdesc: A dirt-stained pig, searching the ground for food.
longdesc:
Rumbling around upon the ground, this pig seems well fed. Since
it's very fat, the creature is having trouble moving around properly.
The color shifts between pink and pale red, with spots of dirt upon
its skin. Its tail waves happily high above in the air, not knowing
its fate. The eyes have been placed deep within the head, with the
hungry mouth between, always searching for food.

name: a draft horse
shortdesc: A heavy-muscled draft horse, waiting for its master.
longdesc:
Standing proud here, holding its head high, the horse looks impressive.
Used for heavy work upon the fields, has made this horse more muscled
than the ordinary riding horse, tended with careful but yet firm hand.
Muscles seen to move beneath its blackish healthy skin, as it shifts
position, moving the weight over towards the back legs. A thick brown
fur surrounds the horse's hooves, an adding protection when riding
through rough terrain. A burn mark has been set into the creature's
left side, "Property of Dundred". The horse moves uneasy, willing
to serve instantly or ready to protect itself fiercely.

name: a fierce dog
shortdesc: A skinny dog, growling dangerously.
longdesc:
During the years, this guard dog has received several nasty-looking
scars, defending its keeper's farmstead or properties. Shifting
between deep black, and light brown in color, the dog seem capable
of defending itself quite well, with a set of sharp teeth visibly
sticking out. Its hair-crowned ears lean backwards when someone
unknown approaches, otherwise standing up, listening for sounds
of trouble. The dog seems lanky from too little food, bones lie
visible through the skin here and there. A fierce opponent, the dog
keeps a constant eye on the surroundings.

name: a family dog
shortdesc: A rabis-infested dog, growling dangerously.
longdesc:
Shifting between deep black, and deep brown in color, the dog
seem capable of defending itself quite well, with a set of sharp
teeth visible sticking out, traces of saliva runs down its lips.
Its hair-crowned ears lean backwards when someone approaches,
always listening for sounds of trouble. Bones almost ready to burst
out through the skin, eyes have drawn back deep into its head, making
it appear unfriendly. Unclean and uncut claws stick out from the paws,
ready to strike its unfortunate victim.

name: the elder farmer
shortdesc: A tired-looking farmer considers your presence.
longdesc:
The tired eyes make this man's age hard to determine. He stands
high among most men, with broad shoulders, and big hands, gained
from years of heavy work upon the fields and cattle handling.
A thin, almost invisible scar stains this once beautiful man's face,
running from his forehead, towards his lower lip. His hair, black
as coal, flows down past his shoulders, neatly collected in a tight
held ponytail. His pale-blue eyes are placed close to each other,
and quite far into his face, giving him a primitive look.

name: the young farmer
shortdesc: A young farmer child, eyeing you carefully.
longdesc:
This young child seem ready to perform small pranks whenever
possible. Short blond hair, and bright blue eyes, this child
could be around his tenth year. Short, chubby legs and thin
arms, the boy hasn't been forced to do any heavy bodywork yet,
but will surely grow with time. Constantly in movement,
he seems to have a hard time to relax, he rushes back and forth,
looking for something, or someone to play with.

name: the mistress farmer
shortdesc: A flour-stained mistress of the household.
longdesc:
A friendly face, with traces of flour upon it, this mistress
emits a welcoming and friendly feeling. She is quite large,
her skin soft as silk, the only thing not stained with the
signs of age. She misses a few teeth, visible within her
thick red lips. Her silver-colored hair is kept in a neat
ellipse-shape upon  her head, kept in position by several
hair-needles. Her deep brown eyes watch the surroundings,
looking for someone to fed.

name: the lady farmer
shortdesc: A beautiful farmer lady, lost in thoughts.
longdesc:
A beauty, with smooth silk-like skin, dark-green eyes and flowing
blond hair, running far down beneath her waist. Well-shaped and
untouched innocent hands, with long fingers, edged off by neatly
trimmed fingernails, this lady could easily be a princess in anyone's
court. Her eyebrows have taken on a deep black color, giving a perfect
contrast against her pale-white skin. Her look is intense as fire,
causing most men to turn away, blushing, the lady of family Ember
stands out above most women.

name: the farmer boy
shortdesc: A well-fed child, staring into the air.
longdesc:
Everything about this young man seem to be a mess, his hair is
standing out into all directions, small spots of dirt visible
upon his face, and small unhealed bruises here and there upon
his body. His brown eyes peer out into the air, searching for
something undetectable, he seems to wander in his own world.
He's quite fat for his age, chubby short legs slowly making their
way towards its next goal.

name: the farmer daughter
shortdesc: A polite-looking girl, scanning the area.
longdesc:
Slightly above the age of 15, this girl has adopted fully to
her country position. She's quite sturdy for a girl in her age,
with thick underarms, which easily could belong to a man in her
age. Her face remains very female, with rosy skin, looking almost
stretched out towards the sides of her face. Her nose, slightly
red a quite large, positioned in the very middle, with two deep
blue eyes on each side.

name: the farmer father
shortdesc: A tired-looking farmer son considers your presence.
longdesc:
Before you stands a hairy old man, skinny but yet muscular. Several
scars cover his worn-out hands, running across the skin in
unidentified figures. His hair, brightly white, kept short,
with a hairless area just on top of his head. Icy-blue eyes
with bushy white eyebrows above them, constantly keep a watching
eye at the surroundings. Several wrinkles stains his wise face, a
certain sign of knowledge.

name: a cow
shortdesc: A cow is here, chewing her cud.
longdesc:
Unlike the domensticated variety, the feral cows are quite
capable of taking care of themselves and are totally unused
to the idea of people.

name: a boar
shortdesc: A boar wallows in the mud and oinks in contentment.
longdesc:
The boar appears quite happy to be a boar.  He is oblivious to your presence
but there is a glint in its eyes that suggest that it wouldn't back down
from a fight.

name: a bull
shortdesc: A bull scratches at the ground and lowers his head.
longdesc:
The bull is in top condition.  He looks like quite a fighter, nothing to be
reckoned with.  With his horns and his hooves he can attack just about
anything that threatens his herd.

name: a horse
shortdesc: A horse becomes frightened by your presence.
longdesc: The horse looks at you and turns away.  You can tell that it is afraid of you.

name: a proud stallion
shortdesc: A proud stallion watches you warily.
longdesc:
The beautiful stallion looks warily at you as you near his herd.
He is clearly willing to defend his herd against any and all dangers.

name: an elder silver dragon
shortdesc: An elder silver dragon lazes on the ground..
longdesc:
A beautiful silver dragon fills your gaze, all you can see is the
silver scales, the large fangs, the larger eyes... The dragon snorts
and suddenly you are free of the dragon's spell.

name: a seasoned adventurer
shortdesc: A seasoned adventurer stands here eyeing you carefully
longdesc:
The seasoned adventurer has seen his share of glory days.  Although he is
past his prime, he still looks like he could put up more than his share of
a good fight.

name: an wilderness bandit
shortdesc: A rough looking fellow sizes you up.
longdesc:
A rough looking fellow he is.  Seeing you give him a look over
he grins, sharpens his weapons and gives you a toothy grin.

name: an wilderness bandit leader
shortdesc: A rough looking fellow sizes you up.
longdesc:
A rough looking fellow he is.  Seeing you give him a look over
he grins, sharpens his weapons and gives you a toothy grin.  
He's not much better than the other ruffians you see around
but they seem to respect his scruff-bag more.

name: Johan the Harbour Keeper
shortdesc: Johan sits beside an old desk, smoking a pipe.
longdesc:
Johan wears a tacky old suit and smokes a long hawthorn pipe.  
His hands are rough and worn from his many days sailing the
southern seas, a weathered man, tough as old leather.

name: Rachele
shortdesc: Rachele rests behind her desk waiting for the next visitor
longdesc: She wears a bright white dress and a blue apron.  In her hand is a small notebook and pen that she uses to check in new visitors.  She sighs for a moment and looks at you, trying to figure out if you are going to stay the evening.

name: Betty Baker
shortdesc: Betty Baker looks at you from behind the counter with a smile.
longdesc:
A plump older woman, Betty looks as though she has had many miscreants in her bakery
throughout her lifetime.  She happily sings to herself as she brushes butter on pasteries.

name: Alex the Bartender
shortdesc: Alex the Bartender stands behind the counter watering down drinks.
longdesc:
He looks around the room wondering if he'll get caught as he attempts to justify
his contemptable actions within his own mind.  He is a seasoned looking gentleman,
knowledgable of the world and its ways .

name: Victoria the Priestess
shortdesc: Victoria the Priestess stands at an altar tending to candles.
longdesc:
A beautiful young woman stands before you in shimmering robes of silk and taffeta.  
She moves gracefuly and without haste as she tends to the many candles within the chapel.

name: Annabelle the Armorer
shortdesc: Annabelle the Armorer stands here.
longdesc:
She appears to be a frail and fragile young woman, inexperienced in the ways of the world.
She smiles happily as she dusts armor and places weapons in their proper places.

name: Byron the Pawn Broker
shortdesc: Byron sits at his desk with an adbecus contemplating future riches.
longdesc:
Byron wears a tacky old suit and an eye piece over his left eye.  He hums the
tune of some unknown classical song as he contemplates massive fortunes and higher
interest rates.

name: The Mist Wyvern
shortdesc: A majestic Mist Wyvern protects the entrance of this town.
longdesc:
The Mist Wyvern towers next to the gates of this small town.  Its eyes 
are gentle, its face is kind and sweet.  She stares off into the distance looking
for imminent danger.

name: the wandering warrior
shortdesc: A Wandering Warrior stands here, waiting to help you.
longdesc:
He stands proud and tall.  Clad in the finest of armor, he seeks to help
those in need whenever possible.  He is rather handsome!

name: An Elven woman
shortdesc: An Elven woman in a pretty white dress.
longdesc:
She looks around as if to find somwhere to rest herself.  In her arms she 
holds a small basket full of items to sell in the market.  Her appearance is
neat, her clothes are well pressed and taken care of.

name: a tiny warrior
shortdesc: A tiny Warrior mutters something to himself about "short jokes".
longdesc:
This miniature warrior is not actually a man, but a child in training to
protect the town! He snickers as you peer at him, trying to figure out if he's
actually some kind of pixie.

name: A hunter
shortdesc: A dirty hunter gives you a toothless grin as you pass.
longdesc:
This is a stern looking middle aged man with a bushy red beard 
and long matted hair. His hands are large and blood stained, probably
used more than once to break a neck. He is dressed in a animal skin
jacket and blood stained pants. As you approach he gives you a toothless 
grin, daring you to challenge his abilities.

name: Tunis, the Chief Hunter
shortdesc: Tunis, the chief hunter is here sharpening his weapons.
longdesc:
Tunis is an older man with a long flowing white beard and a completely
bald head. He towers above all of his subordinates and displays his
fighting abilities through bulging forearms and biceps. He is well
dressed in the finest furs from the all over the world. Brandishing a large
two handed bastard sword you can tell that he not only likes to kill but
slaughter his prey.

name: A travelling Merchant
shortdesc: A travelling Merchant is here displaying his wares
longdesc:
The merchant is a tall skinny man dressed in fine silk. He has a sickly look
as though he hasn't eaten in a while. As you approach he forces a smile and
asks if you would like to look at his wares. His hands shake and body quivers
as the hunters laugh and spit at him. You feel sorry for the poor fellow, maybe
you can put him out of his misery.

name: A hunting dog
shortdesc: A hunting dog glares at you hungrily.
longdesc:
This is a scrawny little dog obviously due to starvation and frequent
beatings. It sniffs the air as you approach detecting that you are 
carrying food. It crouches on its hind legs ready to jump at
your throat hoping win a meal.

name: A fat cook
shortdesc: A fat cook is here making supper over a boiling pot.
longdesc:
This is a fat, portly man with a blonde beard which covers his double chin.
He continues to cut meat and throw it into a boiling pot even though
it is obviously rotten. Constantly his dips his finger in to test the water
and tasting the concoction. An apron covered with food and blood
barely covers his fat gut. He points at the pot as you enter, enticing
you to taste his mixture. You decide not to take his offer.

name: An animal skinner
shortdesc: A young hunter is here skinning and gutting the days kill.
longdesc:
Oh how he longs to hunt with the others. Due to his young age 
and small stature he was forced to spend his time skinning and 
cleaning each days killing. Covered in blood and wearing an old
apron over his raggedy cloths he looks very displeased with his
duties. He vows to one day prove his skill with weapons to the 
chief hunter. He smiles at you as if he has found the answer to
all his problems.

name: A black stallion
shortdesc: A black stallion grazes here preparing to kick as you approach.
longdesc:
This is a black stallion, it was probably captured from the wild and trained
to be ridden. The horse glares you in the eye without fear, wanting
nothing else but to be free. Scars cover his body and head from
several whippings. He waits, ready to kick as you approach.

name: a tanglethorn CLAN
shortdesc: A thick, spikey plant with long thorny tendrils waves in the wind.
longdesc:
This is one of the many evil, semi-intelligent plants that thrives in this
cursed wood. It subsists on the flesh of creatures it incapacitates and kills
with its potent acidic venom all those not from -=<S*O*F*K>=-.

name: the Clan Guard
shortdesc: A clan guardian stands here, watching all passing by.
longdesc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard of clan Dark Hand.

name: the Clan Guard
shortdesc: A clan guardian stands here, watching all passing by.
longdesc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard of clan HLE - Honorable, Loyal, Elite.

name: the Clan Guard
shortdesc: A clan guardian stands here, watching all passing by.
longdesc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard of clan Punkers.

name: the Clan Guard
shortdesc: A clan guardian stands here, watching all passing by.
longdesc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard of clan MaKaG - Mooses are Kewl Appreciation Group.

name: the Clan Guard
shortdesc: A clan guardian stands here, watching all passing by.
longdesc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard of clan Five Lions.

name: Darlok BountyHunter Master
shortdesc: Darlok, master of the bountyhunter guild, watches you carefully.
longdesc:
A big man, the master of the guild has many scars to show his experience
in his craft..

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: A young bountyhunter twitches restlessly.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: A proficient bountyhunter paces about.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: An experienced bountyhunter watches all carefully.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: A veteran bountyhunter stands out in the crowd.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: A master of his arts, the bountyhunter is near invisible.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: An immortal-authorised bountyhunter paces about.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: An immortal-authorised bountyhunter paces about.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: bountyhunter
shortdesc: A deadly immortal-authorised bountyhunter paces about.
longdesc: anonymous anonymous

name: the embodiment of good
shortdesc: The embodiment of good shines like a beacon here.
longdesc:
You feel the warmth of that shining goodness flow through
you.  Yuck.

name: the embodiment of evil
shortdesc: The embodiment of evil wilts like a rotten egg here.
longdesc:
You feel the cold of that sucking evilness flow through
you.  Yuck.

name: a huge wolf spider
shortdesc:
A huge wolf spider stares at you menacingly, as green ichor 
drips from its protruding fangs.
longdesc:
A huge furry spider with multiple eyes stares at you with a deep menace 
as you progress.  A thick green ichor drips slowly down its elongated 
fangs, as it raises its front legs towards you.  Faint chittering seems 
to emanate from this magically enhanced arachnid, echoing faintly 
before fading away.  Trails of shredded webs trail along its body, as a 
faint acrid odor fills the air.  This quick and nimble arachnid 
scrambles easily along any surface, searching for a better place to 
catch its prey.

name: a large furry bat
shortdesc:
A large furry bat spreads its wings in flight, fangs 
gleaming in the faint light.
longdesc:
An extremely large bat, covered in a thick brown fur spreads its wings 
in flight as it takes to the sky.  A high-pitched whine emits from its 
mouth, as it turns its head back and forth, searching constantly for 
its signal.  Wickedly sharp claws reflect in the light, curled at the 
end of the thick membranes that make up its vast wingspan.  A pug nose 
and sharp black glittering eyes stare back at you from its face, as its 
plump body twitches in anticipation.

name: a large grey wolf
shortdesc:
A large grey wolf growls menacingly at your approach, its 
fur bristling in challenge.
longdesc:
A large wolf with bristling grey fur tinged with silver highlights, 
growls menacingly at your arrival.  The fur has coarse edges, and 
stands deep on end in anticipation for a fight for dominance.  Almond-
shaped eyes reflect in the light, glowing an eerie haunting green in 
the near darkness.  Large sharp fangs glisten wetly, as a throaty growl 
escapes its massive jaws.  Its well-muscled body quivers with sheer 
power and rage, as its near silent approach can be felt in the air.

name: a skeletal rat
shortdesc:
The enchanted skeletal remains of a rat clatters toward 
you.
longdesc:
Minor necromantic enchantments bind the bones of this rat, allowing 
them to move of their own volition.  The sharp clattering of bones 
fills the air, as the clicking of bony claws on the ground echo 
constantly.  The jaws of the rat have been sharpened and hang slightly 
open, clacking shut together and opening again in hunger.  Small 
pinpoints of crimson light can be seen in the eye sockets of the skull, 
a burning hatred for all things living.

name: an immense hunter owl
shortdesc:
An immense hunter owl swoops out of the darkness, searching 
for prey.
longdesc:
An immense hunter owl stretches its feathered pinions wide, as its 
claws are outstretched in the anticipation of an upcoming kill.  The 
round feathered head swivels constantly to and fro, its eyes wide and 
circular, seeming to see everything around it.  The sharp twisted beak 
opens and closes, a faint clicking echoing in the air.  A gentle rustle 
of its feathers are the only thing most prey hears, shortly before its 
grisly demise.

name: a shuffling zombie
shortdesc:
A slow moving putrid corpse shuffles toward you, its arms 
outstretched.
longdesc:
A putrid mass of rotting flesh that was once a living being, shuffles 
toward you with its arms outstretched.  Its entire body is decaying, as 
the flesh of its body is starting to liquefy.  Patches of skin flakes 
to the ground, as clumps of battered flesh drop off its bones to fall 
to the floor with a thump.  Its eyes are vacant unthinking things, yet 
there is a definite hatred for all living things.  A sickening smell of 
putrid meat pervades the air, as a low moan of anguish escapes its 
desiccated lips.

name: a juju zombie
shortdesc:
An unusually large corpse shuffles toward you, hatred 
gleaming in its eyes.
longdesc:
An unusually large mass of rotting flesh shuffles toward you, its eyes 
gleaming with crimson pinpoints of light.  Within its vast depths, one 
can see, and almost feel, the intelligence and hatred of all things 
living coming from these orbs.  This juju zombie has been heavily 
enchanted with the dark arts of necromancy, allowing it powers beyond 
the norm.  An almost palatable cloud of decay and rot seems to surround 
it, bringing illness to those nearby.  A low growl of anger escapes its 
leathery lips, as it lunges forward into battle.

name: an animated skeleton
shortdesc:
A magically animated skeleton rises up from a pile of 
bones, ready for battle.
longdesc:
Magical enchantments of the necromantic sphere have animated these 
piles of bones.  Skeletons of chipped and yellowed bone arise from 
their resting place, clad in rusted armor, ready for battle.  Their 
armor is dented and battered, covered in a crimson film.  Their bones 
are ancient, discolored and damaged with age, yet magically hardened.  
Their jaws clatter together, opening and closing in a grimacing smile.  
Long skeleton hands reach out toward the living, small pinpoints of 
hatred reflected within their ocular sockets.

name: a malice filled shadow
shortdesc:
An almost invisible shadow flitters back and forth in the 
near darkness, a cold chill following it.
longdesc:
A bone-chilling sensation fills the air, as a shadowy formation 
materializes in front of you.  Two dark glowing eyes, burning bright 
crimson stares back at you, hatred filled within their depths.  Black 
energy, cold as night, crackles along its arms as it reaches towards 
you, disdain and hatred in its malice filled heart.  Silent as a still 
night, quick as a chill wind, evil as only man could once be, this 
shadow lives on in the afterlife, seeking vengeance.

name: a pile of grubs
shortdesc:
A writhing pile of grubs slithers towards you, feeding on 
the living.
longdesc:
A writhing pile of maggots, worms, and other assorted grubs move 
together in a cluster.  A trail of sticky mucous follows wherever the 
grubs go, clinging to any surface it comes in contact with.  They seem 
to multiply quickly over a short period of time, as there are many of 
them and the numbers continue to grow.  Faint slithering sounds comes 
from the pile, followed by the sounds of minute devouring, as the grubs 
consume all the vegetation and animal remains they come across.

name: a howling spectre
shortdesc:
A transparent apparition howls in anger and hatred, as it 
reaches out to drain your life essence.
longdesc:
A wailing howl filled with a deep and utter hatred, combined 
with an anger at all things that still cling to the material world, 
echoes throughout the air.  A distorted translucent image materializes 
from the darkness of the void, a pale reflection of what was 
represented in life.  Crazed orbs of deep crimson reflect the hatred 
and madness that fills this undead, as it reaches out towards you.   
Long crackling bolts climb up and down its forearms, a deep shade of 
midnight magicks that threaten the life essences of the living.

name: a foul smelling wight
shortdesc:
A foul smelling creature escapes its barrows, in the hunt 
for the living.
longdesc:
A creature of nightmares, a pale reflection and parody of what it was 
once in life, escapes its barrows to enter the hunt.  A feeling of 
unease fills the air, as a noxious odor clings to every surface.  The 
pale and rotted remains of this undead are animated by the darkest of 
arts, as well as its undying hatred for those that still live.  Strips 
of flesh hang from the bones, greyish long dead flesh.  Bolts of the 
darkest hue crackle along its clawed hands, as it strives to fulfil an 
unending hunger.

name: the graveyard caretaker
shortdesc:
The animated remains of the caretaker, dressed in battered 
overalls, shuffles toward you.
longdesc:
The caretaker of the graveyard has fallen under the same curse that has 
struck this area.  Once living, his soul is now trapped in this 
unending form, in constant agony, as he searches for an escape.  His 
flesh has rotted away, the remains of bones poking through the putrid 
skin and muscles.  Tendons and ligaments snap from their moorings and 
sway gently in the wind, as the caretaker progresses through what was 
once his home.  He wears the old battered overalls that he once 
cherished in life, one of the few things of his previous life that he 
retains, in this realm of constant nightmare.

name: a wandering spirit
shortdesc:
A pale apparition wanders for all eternity, searching for 
redemption.
longdesc:
A fading memory is all that remains of these apparitions, as they 
wander for all eternity.  Their unending search is for a redemption 
that will never come, a fruitless search till the ends of time.  Slowly 
the passing of the ages has worn the poor soul down, shredding some of 
its remains and sanity, till all that is left is a pale waning 
reflection of what it once was.

name: the mortician
shortdesc: The Undead Mortician rises to meet you.
longdesc:
A heavy curse of darken magicks parvades the room.  The mortician 
stands before you, a once holy office to help aid the recent dead 
on their journey into the afterlife, now desecrated.  His flesh 
has shriveled and started to decay, segments of bone jutting through 
the openings in his skin.  His dark black clothes of mourning have 
also started to rot, a mockery of the once fine tailoring that they
once were.  Yet he continues to move with a quiet grace, his 
long spindly arms reaching out to greet those that enter.

name: the accursed priest
shortdesc:
The animated remains of a holy priest, cursed by the dark 
arts, rises from the altar.
longdesc:
The twisted remains of a once holy priest, still dressed in the 
remnants of his holy vestments, rises from the altar at your approach.  
Dark crackling energies of protection hum gently in the air, as faint 
magicks spark along his body.  His eyes glimmer with a faint fire, dark 
azure blazes where his eyes once were.  His flesh is smooth, yet there 
is a deep shadow that tinges his once fair skin, a darkness that is 
slowly spreading.  He beckons a warning to leave these premises, as a 
danger has corrupted these hallowed halls.

name: the embalmer
shortdesc:
The animated smooth remains of the embalmer looks up from 
his devices, and grins evilly at your presence.
longdesc:
The irony of the darken curse is evident here, as the embalmer seems 
untouched from the chaotic spread of decay that has claimed the others.  
His skin is smooth and unbroken, yet there is a deepening shadow that 
clings to and crawls along its surface.  His eyes blaze with emerald 
flames, as he reaches for his devices and chemicals.  The faint and 
bitter odor of embalming liquids clings to him, an acrid cloud of 
preservatives seeming to envelope him in their noxious mists.  A wide 
toothy grin splits his face, as a look of sheer sadistic delight 
spreads across his face.

name: the cremator
shortdesc:
The ashen remains of the cremator springs to life, small 
flames dancing along its body.
longdesc:
Flames dance along the surface of the cremator, dancing quickly to and 
from. Oddly these non-consuming fires burn brightly while leaving him 
relatively untouched.  His body is slightly burnt, and covered in a 
thick dark ash that never seems to fade. Deep crimson fires replace his 
knowing orbs, tiny flames of intellect and hatred that will burn for 
all eternity.  A faint cloud of brimstone seems to hang on him, the 
sulfuric stench pervading the room.  He reaches out with his arm, 
layers of ash falling to the ground in slow twirling eddies, as 
flickering flames dance along his fingers, beckoning to be released.

name: the coffin maker
shortdesc:
The undead remains of the coffin maker reaches out towards 
you, as wood shavings and sawdust trickle to the floor.
longdesc:
Curled wood shavings and sawdust trickle gently to the floor, as the 
coffin maker looks up.  His skin is rotted, yet bears an uncanny 
resemblance to the medium he worked with throughout his life.  Knots 
and swirls decorate his skin, as it takes on a more wooden appearance.  
A thick apron of worked leather protects his body, with pockets to hold 
his many carving tools.  Hollow eyes stare back at you, yet they seem 
to contain a burning desire for vengeance in their vast depths.  Long 
nimble fingers dance along the handles of his tools, as he awaits your 
approach.

name: the gravecrawler
shortdesc: The gravecrawler is here, spreading its vile corruption!
longdesc:
This humanoid corpse is not animated by some necromancy.  Rather, this foul
creature is a product of it's own internal desires and willpower.  In life,
the gravecrawler worked in a cemetery of some kind, it's job a mortician or
an embalmer of the dead.  And what it desired most was to be one of them,
one of the dead, that was treated so lovingly under it's care.  Now it crawls
around, as if prone of the ground, moving from dead to dead, drawing on their
power and feeding its own.  Don't let its prone state deceive you, for it
moves faster than anything you would have ever seen!

name: A black rat
shortdesc: A black rat scurrys around
longdesc: An irregularly large rat is here squinting its nose.

name: The ghost of Armicus
shortdesc: The ghost of Armicus floats here.
longdesc:
The ghost of Armicus flots here phasing in and out of view with
a look of disgust on his barly visable face.

name: A Hairy Spider
shortdesc: A hairy spider is here spinning its web.
longdesc:
A large hairy spider stands before you spinnings it web paying
no attention to you.

name: Shipmates Ghost
shortdesc: The ghost of a shipmates stands here.
longdesc:
The Ghost of a shipmates stands here guarding the remnants
of his once great ship.

name: A Large Purple Octopus
shortdesc: A large purple octopus swims before you
longdesc:
A large purple octpous swims before you with its eight tentacles
waving wildly through the water.

name: Arathon
shortdesc: Arathon, the smithy, is here forging weapons.
longdesc:
A burly man stands here pounding upon some metal.  His muscular frame 
protrudes from beneath his dirty smock.  Any exposed flesh has been stained 
a charcoal colour.  He hardly notices you, as he has no time for such trivial 
matters.

name: Captain Sevren
shortdesc: Sevren, the captain of the guard stands here.
longdesc:
A dark haired man with a large scar on his right arm.  He stands with a 
confidence few men can boast of.  It is apparent the people of the encampment 
fear and respect this man from the looks that he gets as he passes 
by them.

name: First Lieutenant Khazoi
shortdesc: Khazoi, the First Lieutenant is here performing his duties.
longdesc:
A strong man stands about checking this and that.  His skin tone betrays 
the fact that he has spent many days under the hot sun.  His arms are 
marked here and there with various size scratches and wounds.  
This man obviously demands respect.

name: Common Soldier
shortdesc: A stout soldier stands his post here.
longdesc:
The man looks straight ahead.  The only sign of him being alive is 
the up and down motion of his armor as he breathes in and out.  He 
is silent as he stares forward with an intent glare.

name: A deadly archer
shortdesc: A deadly archer is standing here.
longdesc:
An attractive woman adorned in light leather armor is here scanning 
the hillside for a target.  Her blonde hair can be seen beneath her leather cap.  
Her finger bounces upon the string of her bow in rhythm with the soft tune 
she is humming.

name: Dracathzt
namelist: Dracathzt dragon demon evil black winged
shortdesc: Dracathzt, the Black Dragon stares at you with an evil glare.
longdesc:
The winged creature is old even for a dragon.  His scales cling to his bones, 
and a black aura fills its eye sockets.  He has long since lost his dragon soul.  
From the faint aura that surrounds the cursed creature, one can assume a 
foul magic is associated with this demon-like dragon.

name: BreezeWalker
shortdesc: A large, magnificently winged horse prances about.
longdesc:
The horse glides about as if its movements were effortless.  As the 
creature breathes, a faint grey mist spills forth from its nostrils.

name: Wyndhelt
shortdesc: Wyndhelt the Ancient floats here in deep meditation.
longdesc:
The man is obviously from a time long before this one.  His wrinkled face is 
motionless as he concentrates his powers on the task he has been charged with.  
A faint red glow emanates from his feeble body.

name: Lahyrem
shortdesc: Lahyrem of  is here in deep meditation.
longdesc:
This man appears to be completely oblivious of his surroundings.  His legs are crossed, 
as he hovers about.  While it looks as though physically he has seen better days, the soft 
glow about his body is a reminder that he can more then make up for it with his ancient 
knowledge of the magics.

name: Johram
shortdesc: Johram the Magi floats about, deep in meditation.
longdesc:
This elf looks to be quite young.  His small frame and pointed ears are a sure 
sign that this man is an elf.  He is dressed in fine white silk from head to toe.

name: The northwest archer
shortdesc: An archer stands ready with her bow at the ready.
longdesc: The woman has a twinkle in her eye as she surveys the horizon.

name: The southwest archer
shortdesc: An archer stands ready with her bow at the ready.
longdesc: The woman has a twinkle in her eye as she surveys the horizon.

name: The northeast archer
shortdesc: An archer stands ready with her bow at the ready.
longdesc: The woman has a twinkle in her eye as she surveys the horizon.

name: The southeast archer
shortdesc: An archer stands ready with her bow at the ready.
longdesc: The woman has a twinkle in her eye as she surveys the horizon.

name: Lanson the Quartermaster
shortdesc: Lanson the Quartermaster is scanning over his inventory
longdesc: An aged man of moderate build has a stern look of concentration.

name: Silas the Templar
shortdesc: Silas, a young templar, wanders about checking on everyone's current ability to fight.
longdesc:
With a bag of potions and scrolls thrown over one shoulder, and his
dagger sheathed on his left hip he walks about checking on his friends.

name: Gauthis the Supply Runner
shortdesc: Gauthis, the supply runner, is running errands for the Quartermaster.
longdesc:
This young man is red of face, with sweat beading at his brow and
getting in his eyes as he runs about hither and tither on never-ending
errands.

name: Ainsley the Camp Cook
shortdesc: Ainsley, the camp cook is baking bread and preparing meals.
longdesc:
This fat man is eating more than his fair share of the rations.
He smiles as he pokes more food in his round face and reaches
for his cask.

name: Skarthax
namelist: Skarthax dragon demon evil red winged
shortdesc: Skarthax, the Red Dragon stares at you with boiling red eyes.
longdesc:
