Muscles move under this dragons scales, hinting at its strength and power.
An aura of ageless evil escapes from it in waves of malice and doom.  This
creature has long since lost his dragon soul.  From the faint aura that 
surrounds the cursed creature, one can assume a foul magic is associated 
with this demon-like dragon.

name: Xalanock
namelist: Xalanock dragon demon evil white winged
shortdesc: Xalanock, the White Dragon stares at you with a frosty gaze.
longdesc:
Icy tendrils of creepy mist ooze slowly from her body, as if she freezes the
very air around her.  Her scales sparkle white and blue when she moves, revealing
a thickness that even the mightiest of hammers would find hard to crack!  SHe has
long since lost her dragon soul.  From the faint aura that surrounds the cursed 
creature, one can assume a foul magic is associated with this demon-like dragon.

name: Vragothz
namelist: Vragothz dragon demon evil green winged
shortdesc: Vragothz, the Green Dragon stares at you with poisonous intent.
longdesc:
Pungent green clouds roll off this gigantic dragon.  Glossy black eyes steam
with malice and hate.  The very air that Vragothz belches forward is enough to
curdle the blood of even the strongest barbarian.  He has long since lost his 
dragon soul.  From the faint aura that surrounds the cursed creature, one can 
assume a foul magic is associated with this demon-like dragon.

name: Zxarbolt
namelist: Zxarbolt dragon demon evil blue winged
shortdesc: Zxarbolt, the Blue Dragon stares at you with a crackling, lightning-filled eyes.
longdesc:
Cobalt blue scales give way to bright, shiny cream on the under belly of this
beast.  Static fills the air, making your hair stand on end in his presence.
He has long since lost his dragon soul.  From the faint aura that surrounds the 
cursed creature, one can assume a foul magic is associated with this demon-like
dragon.

name: A Plush Golem
shortdesc: A Plush Golem pads menacingly toward your food supplies.
longdesc:
This is a bear shaped golem with button eyes, a red thread 'X' mouth,
and sharp claws of a strange material.

name: Major General Plush Golem
shortdesc: A uniformed plush bear polishes its buttons.
longdesc:
This is a bear shaped golem with button eyes, a red thread 'X' mouth,
and sharp claws of a strange material. It is wearing a red and white
uniform with brass buttons and has a large peaked white hat.
It bears the insignia of a Major General, and looks very tough.

name: Gundyorlchenonthiusamusharisthkuna the Toymaker
shortdesc: The Toymaker searchs for errant creations.
longdesc:
The Toymaker wields a huge hammer, and burns with the heat of the
forge. You sense that he is just as good at destroying as he is
at creating.

name: Sir Robin
shortdesc: A brave knight slows to a fast walk as he sees you
longdesc:
This knight is armored in light chainmail and plate armor, and seems
able to move quite quickly despite the weight. You can tell that this
is the brave knight featured in song, as there seems to be a pack of
minstrels trailing behind singing it.

name: A Ratty avatar
shortdesc: A ratty looking avatar looks for a good place to die.
longdesc: This ratty looking man pauses in his search and blinks at you momentarily.

name: A Ratty terminator
shortdesc: This ratty looking man doesn't seem quite right.
longdesc:
It looks like a man, but the skin and hair seem rather artificial under
closer inspection.  Most people don't have glowing red eyes either...

name: RA-T1000
shortdesc: A silvery rat flows toward you, looking for someone.
longdesc:
It looks like a humanoid rat, but even as you watch all color leaches
away, leaving it a metallic silver.  Its form flows to resemble someone
very familiar...

name: The Black Knight
shortdesc: A black armored warrior growls, "None Shall Pass!
longdesc:
No flesh is visible, this figure is completely encased in a suit of
blackened plate mail.

name: The Black Knight
shortdesc: A black armored warrior growls, "It's only a flesh wound.
longdesc:
No flesh is visible, this figure is completely encased in a suit of
blackened plate mail, save for the spurting wound where it's right arm
was.

name: The Black Knight
shortdesc: A black armored warrior growls, "Chicken!
longdesc:
No flesh is visible, this figure is completely encased in a suit of
blackened plate mail, save the bloody stumps of its arms.

name: The Black Knight
shortdesc: A black armored warrior growls, "I'll bleed on you!
longdesc:
No flesh is visible, this figure is completely encased in a suit of
blackened plate mail, save the bloody stumps of its arms and leg.

name: The Black Knight
shortdesc:
A black armored warrior growls, "Come back! I'll bite your 
kneecaps off!
longdesc:
No flesh is visible, this figure is completely encased in a suit of
blackened plate mail, save the bloody stumps of its arms and leg.

name: Beeping Plush Golem
shortdesc: A Plush Golem with strangely glowing button eyes beeps at you.
longdesc:
This is a bear shaped golem with red glowing button eyes, a red thread 'X'
mouth, and sharp claws of a strange material.  It seems to emit a steady
beeping sound.

name: Eeyore
shortdesc: Despondent donkey dithers droopily.
longdesc:
This donkey stands passively with his head hanging low, you get the
impression he'd suicide if it wasn't too much effort.  His tail seems
to be pinned on!

name: The cute bunny rabbit
shortdesc: A bunny glows with a blue aura here.
longdesc:
This is a cute 'lil pale white bunny rabbit.  He seems to be
chewing on a thin bit of metal, and emits crackling blue sparks
constantly.

name: Tigger
shortdesc: A large black and orange feline bounces madly on his tail.
longdesc: desc

name: A Smurf
shortdesc: A little blue creature in white overalls sings 'La la la'
longdesc:
A little blue humanoid, wearing a conical white hat and white overalls.
He seems unusually happy, and is far too cute to be allowed to live.

name: Papa Smurf
shortdesc: A little blue greybeard in red stands lost in thought.
longdesc:
A little blue humanoid.  This one has a white beard, and wears a red hat
and overalls.  He seems to be concentrating on drawing glowing letters
in the air.

name: Smurfette
shortdesc: A little blue creature in a white dress skips along.
longdesc:
The lone female of her race, Smurfette is a small blue humanoid with
long golden hair, and a white distress.  Fortunately, she seems to
have a lot of practice escaping.

name: a kobold
shortdesc: A Kobold is here alert to danger in the tunnels...
longdesc:
This kobold is a short, lithe, reptilian humanoid, with scaled skin that
ranges from reddish brown and black on its back to burnt orange on the
stomach, neck and muzzle.  Its eyes are small and red and its legs are
sinewy and digitigrade.  It has long, clawed fingers and a jaw like a
crocodile.  Small tan horns protrude from its head.  To complete the
image it also has a rat-like tail.  It smells like a wet dog at low tide,
wears some ragged red clothing and carries a stubby sword.

name: a kobold
shortdesc: A Kobold is here, trying to keep out of danger!
longdesc:
This kobold is a short, lithe, reptilian humanoid, with scaled skin that
ranges from reddish brown and black on its back to burnt orange on the
stomach, neck and muzzle.  Its eyes are small and red and its legs are
sinewy and digitigrade.  It has long, clawed fingers and a jaw like a
crocodile.  Small tan horns protrude from its head.  To complete the
image it also has a rat-like tail.  It smells like a wet dog at low tide
and wears some ragged black clothing and carries a very sharp knife.

name: a dire weasel
shortdesc: A dire weasel snuffles about here.
longdesc:
This is a very large weasel of approximately ten feet long from the tip
of the nose to end of the tail.  Weighing in at seven hundred pounds, it
has a reddish-brown coat with a creamy-white underbelly from chin to
groin.  It is fast, quick, and very agile.  It has been bred and reared
by the Kobold here for companionship and protection.

name: Doktor Neek
shortdesc: Doktor Neek von Eshin is here negotiating.
longdesc:
Doktor Neek is a bipedal creature around the same height and weight as a
Kobold.  In fact, you could be forgiven for mistaking this creature as a
kobold - at least at a distance.  It is ugly, and ratty with matted fur
instead of scales.  It is actually a member of a humanoid race of rat-like
beasts that call themselves Skaven; rat-like features, with humanoid gnarly
hands, sharp teeth and prehensile tails, the Skaven are elusive, with a few
sightings only ever being recorded in the deep sewer networks of the big
cities of the realms.  Doktor Neek wears a pair of thick iron goggles with
green lenses and his head is covered by a leather hood that has slits for
his long, pointed rat-like ears.  He is currently negotiating something
with Boss Snelpi.

name: Boss Snelpi
shortdesc: Boss Snelpi of the Kobolds sits here, dealing with her prisoner.
longdesc:
This is Boss Snelpi.  She actually looks like any other Kobold, and does
not appear to be any bigger or stronger than her brethren.  She has the
same scaly skin of burnt-umber on her back that leads to a dirty orange
on her chest, neck and muzzle.  She has small, glowing red eyes and 
sinewy legs.  She wears a rustic necklace of brass discs as a badge of
office and carries an unusually shiny short sword for his race.  Sadly,
like most of her race, she stinks of rotten garbage.

name: Bonescream
shortdesc: Bonescream the Skaven-Ogre is here, causing chaos!
longdesc:
Bonescream is an abomination, a thing created by the secretive Skaven in
the deep places of some dark, dank sewer of a civilised city.  It stands
over nine-feet tall, has incredible strength, and a rage to match.  It's
Lucky for you that it has poor eyesight so you should be able to sneak
past it unnoticed.  Rarer than rocking horse poop, Bonescream represents
the power of a race that rarely rears its ratty head in the realms.  Why
it is here in a Kobold den is anyones guess.  Manacles, still hosting
the sheered chains that once held it to a wall, adorn it's thick wrists.

name: a kobold
shortdesc: A Kobold is here, alert for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
This kobold is a short, lithe, reptilian humanoid, with scaled skin that
ranges from reddish brown and black on its back to burnt orange on the
stomach, neck and muzzle.  Its eyes are small and red and its legs are
sinewy and digitigrade.  It has long, clawed fingers and a jaw like a
crocodile.  Small tan horns protrude from its head.  To complete the
image it also has a rat-like tail.  It smells like a wet dog at low tide
and wears some ragged red clothing and carries a very sharp knife.

name: a naga ghost warrior
shortdesc: The ghostly remains of a naga warrior swims in the darkness here.
longdesc:
Naga are aquatic abberations originally created by the elves.  Since the
wars with the dwarfs, most Naga have split from the elves and sought out
a violent independence in the deep waters of the realms.  They are half-
elf and half-sea snake creatures, with the males known for being violent
and fierce warriors, and the females known for being dread spellcasters 
and mages.  This one is an undead ghost of a naga warrior, with ghostly
green flesh and wielding an ethereal trident.

name: a naga shadow spellbinder
shortdesc: The shadowy remains of a naga swims here, preparing spells to repel enemies.
longdesc:
Naga are aquatic abberations originally created by the elves.  Since the
wars with the dwarfs, most Naga have split from the elves and sought out
a violent independence in the deep waters of the realms.  They are half-
elf and half-sea snake creatures, with the males known for being violent
and fierce warriors, and the females known for being dread spellcasters
and mages.  This one is an undead shadow of a naga spellbinder, with
ghostly green flesh and surrounded by a magical aura.

name: the Bladderwort
shortdesc: The bladderwort hangs from the ceiling here, with trailing creepers dangling below it.
longdesc: The bladderwort is a type of giant carnivorous plant that thrives in damp, dark places looking for lost prey (like you) that wanders unsuspectingly into it's dangling creepers (like you).  It has a maw with a lot of sharp teeth that puts you in mind of your grannies' pin cushion.  It is covered in tiny yellow flowers that smell sweet and make you want to stick your head in and breath in that lovely scent... Go on... Stick your head in there.

name: Ashleen Deepsong
shortdesc: Commander Ashleen Deepsong of the Naga swims here.
longdesc:
Half-elf, half sea-snake, Ashleen is not the common example of her species.
Among the first of the Naga to be created by the elves, and cursed (blessed?)
with a life so long she may as well be immortal, Ashleen still obeys the will
of her Sylvan cousins.  She commands a force of dark Naga within these caves,
her brethren who sacrificed their lives to be reborn as eternal guardians to
something so precious that she, and her minions, have foresaken her people in
the outside world to be in this place forever.  Beautiful and deadly, she is
the wielder of the Spear of Naralax, a powerful, ancient relic forged by the
elves of old.

name: Doomguard Imra Darkfire
shortdesc: Doomguard Imra Darkfire stands her with eyes like flames.
longdesc: Imra Darkfire was the first mage to the line of Shandon, the Sylvan King of old.  Ancient by Elven standards even then, with hair as white as snow, she had been amongst those born on the timeless isle of Efravor in the far, far East, before the migration West to spread the seeds of Vordrassil, the World Tree.  During the war of the Elves and Dwarfs she gave up her life after her King was defeated in battle by the massed armies of the Dwarfs and their black-winged dragon allies so that she may forever protect Him in death, where she had failed in life.  As a Doomguard she is still a cunning sorceress and general, standing in eternal vigilance, weaving spells to protect her leige.

name: King Shandon, the Ancient Silver Dragon
shortdesc: The Ancient Silver Dragon form of King Shandon is here, roaring with bestial fury!
longdesc:
This is the Ancient Silver Dragon form of King Shandon.  Before he chose
to take the Elven form, he was already ancient among the dragonkin.  With
wings of filigree silver and scales tinted silvery-green along his belly
and ruddy, dark-silver across his back, he is fearsome to behold.  His
golden eyes are full of fury and hate, he no longer has that noble air of
a silver dragon.  Instead, he is several thousand tons of malice and wild
rage ready to burn the world to a cinder if it meant that every last one
of the accursed dwarfs were wiped from existence...

name: a Boneguard
shortdesc: An undead Boneguard stands here, on the lookout for intruders.
longdesc:
These armoured skeletons are the remains of Elven heroes who gave their
lives to defend their leige for eternity in the afterlife.  Whilst they
are no longer the beautiful warriors of their youth, they are still just
as deadly.  With fine armour and deadly weapons, it might be wise not to
engage them in combat.

name: Doomguard Lyndah the Fair
shortdesc: Doomguard Lyndah the Fair stands her, watching and waiting.
longdesc: Captain Lyndah the Fair was a young Elven maid in life.  A distant cousin to Princess Aszhera, hers was an honorary title and position within the Kings Court.  She was with her cousin the day those dark-clothed Dwarfs broke in to the palace intent on taking Aszhera for ransom.  She fought them with the ferocity of a lion, and even when cut and mutilated by their heavy axes, she would not fall.  But alone she couldn't save the Princess, and when they escaped she collapsed, begging for forgiveness before dying of her wounds.  For her courage and loyalty she was born again as a Doomguard, forever charged with the protection of her King and her cousin in death.

name: Doomguard Alea Goldhaven
shortdesc: Doomguard Alea Goldhaven stands here, burning with rage.
longdesc: Alea Goldhaven would have been Queen were it not for the fact that was King Shandon's second wife.  And whilst his first wife, Queen Alysandra, still lived on the far away isle of Efravor, Alea would only be consort and never given title to suit her position.  The mother of Princess Aszhera, she could no longer face life after her daughter was killed and her husband defeated, so at the behest of the Elven Prophets, she volunteered to be a Doomguard, to sit near her slain daughter for eternity, and protect her with all of her power.

name: Princess Aszhera
shortdesc: The Phantom remains of Princess Aszhera skips around in play here.
longdesc: In life Princess Aszhera was a golden-haired little girl with a joyous laugh and a love for all living things.  She was the apple of her fathers eye, and the very pride of her mother.  Innocent and caring, she was slaughtered like a day old lamb at the hands of the Dwarfs as a means to get what they wanted from the Elves, an act that sparked a war that lasted generations and reaped untold ruin upon the Realms and leaving most of the Old World, Ostengard, a spiralling desert of chaos and death.  She skips around the tree she loved so much in life, leaving a trail in the dirt where no grass will grow.  She's only a tiny thing, you wouldn't be like those nasty Dwarfs... Would you?

name: a Sidhe Centaur
shortdesc: A Sidhe Centaur gallops here, looking for intruders.
longdesc: Sidhe Centaurs are the offspring of elves and centaurs.  In most cases the union produces a centaur with the upper body of an elf, instead of that of a human - as is the case here.  Unlike true centaurs, the Sidhe centaurs are vicious and untrusting.  They attack all intruders on-sight and show no mercy to young or old.  You had best defend yourself!

name: Chief Chiron
shortdesc: Chief Chiron is here, watching over the hidden vale.
longdesc: Chief Chiron is the leader of the Sidhe centaur tribe that watches over the vale.  In case you're wondering, Sidhe is pronounced 'Shee'.  Chiron is as old as the vale he walks in, surveying and protecting all he can see.  In the years since he was entrusted with the task by the Elves of old only one visitor has he seen from the outside world; Nuahlon.  What that dark prince was doing here, beyond the tombs of his ancestors is anyones guess.  But he left soon after and Chiron was relieved to return to peace and sanctity... That is, until you arrived!

name: Chef Fungus
shortdesc: Chef Fungus is here selling his special sausages.
longdesc:
This is Chef Fungus.  He is a happy little Kobold that is not quite
atypical of his race.  Instead of small red eyes he has wide yellow 
ones that reveal an intelligence and cunning.  His crocodile-like
maw turns upwards at the jaw and gives the impression of a wide smile.
He even speaks quite good common and wants to sell you something...
How brave are you?

name: a Knight Errant of Thaumlore
shortdesc: A Knight Errant of Thaumlore stands here, guarding the Fortress.
longdesc:
The Knights of Thaumlore Fortress are no mere soldier of fortune.  These
highly trained individuals are all volunteers who have given their lives
to the cause of fighting Chaos.  Each Knight has faced fiends from the
deepest planes.  Each Knight has been trained to fight his hardest and
to never give ground in the face of evil.  It would not be wise to engage
one in combat.

name: a Knight Guardian of Thaumlore
shortdesc: A Knight Guardian of Thaumlore walks around, guarding the sacred Fortress.
longdesc:
Uniquely, the Knight Guardians are all females who excelled in the tests.  
They were the best of the best, and in reward each was granted the honour
protecting a part of the Fortress; albeit the impress gate or the Knight
Commander herself.  Trained in the art of combat to rival any warrior, these
elite Knights can also wield deadly magical powers that have the ability
to turn even the strongest of fiends in to a smoking ruin.  Care should
be taken when engaging them.

name: Emilee Starsoul the Knight Commander of Thaumlore
namelist: emilee starsoul knight commander warrior thaumlore
shortdesc: Emilee Starsoul, the Knight Commander of Thaumlore stands here, resplendent in her armour.
longdesc:
Once in every lifetime there comes a soul to the Fortress of Thaumlore
who is so pure in their task, so powerful in their training, that they
ascend to the top, to lead and carry the flame of goodness against the
vile armies of chaos and evil.  They are named the Knight Commander, and 
they demand the respect and loyalty of all in the Fortress.  

The current Knight Commander is named Emilee Starsoul.  She was born a waif
and stray in Midgard, a homeless orphan.  Her destiny in that dark clime
was to become a thief.  A vagabond.  And to face eventual punishment like
so many others before her.  She choose instead to leave Midgard, to make
herself better than anything the Gods had in store for her.  She passed
the tests of Thaumlore at the young age of 12.  At 16, she is now the Knight
Commander.  Don't let her age fool you, she wields more power than you
could ever imagine.

name: Hilux Stormhammer the shopkeeper
shortdesc: Hilux Stormhammer, the shopkeeper is busy working here.
longdesc:
Hilux Stormhammer is a dwarf.  And like many of his kin, he is a very
grumpy little dwarf.  At least, that seems to be the case to those who
don't know him.  Born in Fortrum, he gravitated to the Fortress of
Thaumlore when he was a but a young lad.  He was one of the very few non-
humans to the hold the rank of Knight Commander, a title that he wore for
almost a century.  It was only when he saw a young waif best the trials
beneath the Fortress that he knew his time was near.  He trained the
young warrioress himself, as she was nearer to his height than any of her
fellow humans.  And it was he who bestowed upon her the name of Starsoul
when he announced her as his successor.  Emilee Starsoul is like a the
daughter this dour dwarf never had, and only he in the whole of the
Fortress rivals her in power.

name: Faustas, the guildmaster's familiar
shortdesc: Faustas, the guildmaster's familiar, a rat, is scurrying around here.
longdesc:
Faustas is a small rat, with a beautiful gleaming coat and bright green 
eyes.  By looking at her you receive a telepathic thought...

name: Horar Frogroarer, the Guildmaster of Thaumlore
shortdesc: Horar Frogroarer, the Guildmaster of Thaumlore, notes your presence.
longdesc:
Horar the Frog, as he is more commonly known, is the teacher of Thaumlore
Fortress.  His knowledge is vast, yet he had never taken the tests of the
castle himself, for whatever reason.  It is also apparent that his presence
is barely tolerated by the Knight Commander, who deems him unfit to train
the souls that will march in to battle against the fiends of the deepest
Hells.

name: an agathion
shortdesc: An agathion is here, engaged in testing the souls of those engaged in the trials.
longdesc:
Agathion's are the spirits of dead warriors who choose the side of law and
goodness in life.  These warriors fell in battle against evil fiends in
the never ending war against chaos that is raged in the outer planes.  In
their afterlife they have chosen to train the next generation of warriors
in defence of all that is good by giving their eternal souls to the tests
and trials in the labyrinth of Thaumlore.

name: an aasimar
shortdesc: An aasimar creeps along here, preparing to test those who deem themselves ready.
longdesc:
Aasimar are the mortal descendants of angelic beings.  They possess the
qualities of both their plane-touched and mortal ancestors.  Most of these
beings try to hide their ancestry, but these ones, under the Fortress of
Thaumlore, wear it proudly.  They have made the choice to dedicate their
very lives to training of the next generation of guardians.  And in doing
so, they know they will die by the sword of a soon-to-be hero of the
planes.

name: A hopeful candidate
shortdesc: A trainee stalks the corridor, nervous and hopeful all at once.
longdesc:
This lad is taking the trials.  It is the candidate who decides when he or
she is ready for the ordeal.  And sadly, many do not make it back to see
the sunlight of the world above.

name: a deva
shortdesc: A deva stands here, hunting the hopefuls who take the trials.
longdesc:
The deva are powerful angelic souls locked inside mortals shells.  They
yearn for freedom from the flesh, to take flight and soar amongst the soft
clouds of their home planes.  But they are here, punished for a slight
wrong, forced to hunt down and kill the hopefuls who wander these halls,
or be be slain in turn and earn their release.  The deva are dangerous
and powerful and are most alike to the fiends that the hopefuls have been
trained to fight.

name: a deva
shortdesc: A deva tears madly at its own flesh, seeking freedom from this place.
longdesc:
The deva are powerful angelic souls locked inside mortals shells.  They
yearn for freedom from the flesh, to take flight and soar amongst the soft
clouds of their home planes.  But they are here, punished for a slight
wrong, forced to hunt down and kill the hopefuls who wander these halls,
or be be slain in turn and earn their release.  The deva are dangerous
and powerful and are most alike to the fiends that the hopefuls have been
trained to fight.

name: Uriel, the Angel of Fire
shortdesc: Uriel, a tall angelic being, stands here wreathed in blue and gold flames.
longdesc:
Uriel is a being of pure energy that has been given form by the ruling
deity of her home plane.  In this case, the Uriel appears as a beautiful
woman with wings of fiery feathers arching up from her back.  Her clothing
burns a deep blue and gold, flickering brightly and licking out at anything
foolhardy enough to come close.  She is the most perfect thing you have
ever seen.  And yet, she is here for a reason.  She carries the only way
out of these halls, and she guards it with a fiery passion.  To defeat her
is pass the test.

name: a tiny angelic imp
shortdesc: A tiny angelic imp scampers about picking up discarded body remains and bits.
longdesc:
It looks almost cat-like, with small pointed ears and a cute, lovable
face.  It is covered in a soft, downy light blue fur that is almost pure
white in patches.  As you watch it leans down and collects a small bloody
object that looks remarkably like a finger.  It sniffs it and then opens
it's mouth, revealing row-upon-row of razor sharp teeth.  Snap!  Crunch!
The finger is gone!

name: a small angelic wisp
shortdesc: A small angelic wisp floats here, searching for souls to test.
longdesc:
These spirits are almost insubstantial.  They are the weakest form of
angelic being and yet even they do their job and fullfil the needs of the
Fortress.  They too hunt down and attack the hopefuls who take the test.

name: a well trained candidate
shortdesc: A well equipped trainee sneaks along here carefully.
longdesc:
This hopeful appears to have been well trained.  He carries his sword low
and ready as he sneaks along, checking each of the angels he encounters,
looking for something.

name: a lantern archon
shortdesc: A lantern archon floats here, illuminating a safe place to rest.
longdesc:
A lantern archon is a floating ball of light, usually blue, that protects
and helps those would stand against evil and chaos.  This one is here to
help the souls of Thaumlore who brave the challenge.  In it's presence
there can be no violence.  In it's presence, anyone can sleep peacefully
and heal at increased speed.

name: a hound archon
shortdesc: A hound archon stands here, baying loudly.
longdesc:
Hound archons are the well-disciplined soldiers and sentinels of their
heavenly realm. They are well-trained in the fight against evil and show
no mercy to fiends. Against mortals, however, they are loath to use lethal
force, even against those dedicated to evil. They believe that mortals
should be the judges of their own kind while on the mortal world.  This
one holds a circle of protection inside the Proving Grounds, allowing
spell casters to recharge their mana at an increased rate.

name: a trumpet archon
shortdesc: A beautiful trumpet archon is here, creating a calming aura of peace.
longdesc:
The trumpet archon is beautiful to behold.  She has pale, almost white,
skin, white hair and soft, feathered wings.  She wears a cloth-of-gold
dress and corset that accentuates her gleaming, pearly-white eyes.  She
carries a long, golden trumpet that she plays to create a zone of peace,
allowing the most devout to pray to their deity and attain a close bond
usually only found in a dedicated cathedral.

name: a sword archon
shortdesc: A sword archon stands here, defending the area with his flaming swords.
longdesc:
The sword archon appears as a tall humanoid warrior.  His swords are
extensions of his arms, literally attached to his fists and never able to
be put down.  Legend has it that anyone defeating a sword archon and
cutting off it's hand will find themselves possessing a weapon far greater
than any a mortal could own.

name: Ramial, the Planetar
shortdesc: Ramial, the Planetar, stands here gloriously.
longdesc:
Planetars are mighty angels that lead the armies of law against the fiends
in the Dawn War.  They stand as tall as a giant and have elegant wings of
white feathers that shine brightly.  It is rumoured that a single feather
from the wing of a planetar has magical properties akin to the mightiest
of relics.  Planetars are known to help mortals who are on missions to
further the cause of goodness and law against the fiends.  And that is why
this one is here, to help the warriors of Thaumlore in their struggle by
providing a final test to the skilled men and women of the Fortress.

name: Mannix Flamebow
shortdesc: Mannix Flamebow is here preparing a scroll for sale.
longdesc:
Mannix Flamebow is an elderly elf.  He has strangely dark skin that is
almost blue in hue and hair that is a stark white.  Rumour has it that
Mannix was the arch-warrior long ago, but his size and frailty do little
to enhance that particular tale.  He stands here now selling his potions
and scrolls that he mixes and writes himself.  There is sure to be a
bargain amongst his many wares.

name: a Knight Guardian of Thaumlore
shortdesc: A Knight Guardian of Thaumlore is here, protecting the Knight Commander.
longdesc:
Uniquely, the Knight Guardians are all females who excelled in the tests.  
They were the best of the best, and in reward each was granted the honour
protecting a part of the Fortress; albeit the impress gate or the Knight
Commander herself.  Trained in the art of combat to rival any warrior, these
elite Knights can also wield deadly magical powers that have the ability
to turn even the strongest of fiends in to a smoking ruin.  Care should
be taken when engaging them.

name: George Thunderbelly
shortdesc: George is here doing something strange with his apparatus.
longdesc:
George Thunderbelly is a lively, chatty halfling with the *biggest*
belly.  It is so big it spills out of his shirt and almost hits the
floor!  But it's not flabby and loose, it's hard and round, like a
barrel, for George's favourite passion is brewing his Thunder Ale
and tasting it whenever he can!  His rosey cheeks are a testament to
his hearty ways and congenial attitude.

name: Maude 'The Mistress' Lipton
shortdesc: Maude is here, scowling at anyone browsing her goods.
longdesc:
Maude Lipton is an ex-Nun with a pinched face and sour who has taken 
up residence in the Fortress of Thaumlore because she believes in
punishing evilness wherever it can be found.  In Maude's case she
patrols the dormitory's late at night seeking out anyone involved
in what she refers to as 'self flagellation'.  It's best not to ask
whatever that is or what is involved.  She has earned her name as
'The Mistress' for she invokes a no-nonsense air of authority,
respect and discipline.

name: Captain Forbes Goodwill
shortdesc: Captain Goodwill is here looking immaculate.
longdesc:
Captain Forbes Goodwill is easily in his eighties.  He has a kind
looking face and a mop of fuzzy white hair that just doesn't like
a comb or brush so it sticks out madly in all directions.  A
former Captain of the Thaumlore militia, he now looks after the
armoury, doling out protective wear to the recruits and selling
expensive armours to the many adventurers who pass through.

name: Fortrus the Protector
shortdesc: The old, grey shape of Fortrus the Protector is here, guarding the final barrier.
longdesc:
Fortus is old, even for a dwarf.  His beard and hair are white, his eyes icy blue. 
There is a stiffness to his movements, as if age has worn down his once mighty
soul.  Yet still he stands, protecting the last barrier in Fortrum, the prison
of his once great enemy.

name: Warbex Dragonhand
shortdesc: Warbex Dragonhand is here trying out a wand.
longdesc:
Warbex Dragonhand is a half-elf half-dragon hybrid who chooses the
humanoid form over his draconic one.  He is a maker of wands and
amulets that are used to protect the lawful warriors of Thaumlore
Fortress.  It is rumoured that Warbex likes to grow wings at night
and set fire to the farmsteads of peasants... Maybe you shouldn't
be listening to this kind of thing?  Shame on you.

name: orcish guard
shortdesc: A tall and muscular orc walks in a sentry circuit, grimacing.
longdesc:
This tall orc has obviously been put on guard duty -- he walks back and 
forth in a sentry circuit, grimacing, and occasionally looking up at 
the sky to ascertain the time.  He is well-built and seems suited to
combat, and his boredom may be the result of too little of it.

name: the stonemaster
shortdesc: A massive, hulking orc seems to be lost in thought.
longdesc:
This massive orc has skin that has dulled to the color of stone, and 
seems to have attained its consistency.  His broad brow is furrowed 
above his slate eyes, and his massive hands folded one into the other. 
He occasionally blinks, very slowly, as though existing in a place 
where time moves slower than this one.

name: an orcish campaigner
shortdesc: A tall, nervous-looking orc stands here, flexing his muscles.
longdesc:
This orc is very tall, and well-muscled. His expression is one of 
nervousness and annoyance, however, and he checks himself over at an 
obsessive rate.  His skin bears only token scars, perhaps arising 
from tribal rituals, but likely not from mortal combat.

name: an elven scout
shortdesc: An elf is very obviously trying to keep out of sight, here.
longdesc:
This elf peers about nervously, hoping to remain unseen. He is possessed 
of considerable stealth, as his continued existance testifies.  His 
flittering eyes are hazel, and his complexion is fair and soft. His long, 
elegant hands run themselves across surfaces as he comes into contact 
with them, keeping the measure and texture of his surroundings.

name: orcish armourer
shortdesc: A muscular orcish woman stands here, arms folded across her chest, grinning toothily.
longdesc:
This woman is built compactly, and possessed of the kind of musculature 
normally associated with a wild animal.  Her obvious strength doesn't 
detract from her charms, but rather seems to add to them, or perhaps 
even be the base of them.  Her flint-grey eyes are set beneath a pair of 
thick eyebrows, and her facial features are prominent to the point of 
aquilinity.  Her hands are calloused and cracked from labouring.

name: supply clerk
shortdesc: A frantic-looking orc runs to and fro, checking on the status of supplies.
longdesc:
This orc moves around at a very rapid speed, his long arms reaching from 
shelf to shelf and counter to counter, sorting powders and tinctures and 
liquids with astonishing speed.  A sweat has broken out across his brow, 
and droplets of moisture roll into his haggard yellow eyes.

name: an apprentice smith
shortdesc: A very strong-looking orc works the forge.
longdesc:
This orc has a barrel-chest and arms that ripple with muscles, gleaming 
beneath the sheen of sweat that coats his body. He works at a steady, 
unyielding pace and displays no sign of being tired, at all. His eyes, 
peculiarly, are bright blue and sparkle brilliantly within his grayish, 
grim countenance.

name: a massive orc Blacksmith
shortdesc: An absolutely massive orc Blacksmith stands here, working the forge.
longdesc:
This orc is huge.  His chest is so broad that it seems a beast attempting 
to escape from his skin, and his long arms are bulky in the manner that 
only unceasing physical activity can bring about.  His yellow eyes are 
bright as jewels, and his skin is a mottled gray and black, with splotches 
of white where it has been burned by chemicals.  His expression is grim, 
humorless and full of concentration.

name: a tall barbarian
shortdesc: A tall human seems out of place amidst the forge, quenching steel as it is produced.
longdesc:
This human would tower above most of his race.  His build is lanky, and 
his green eyes display the glint of deep intelligence, muted to better 
adapt to his condition.  His long, blonde hair is kept in an unkempt 
ponytail that dangles halfway down his back, and his skin is covered in 
blue and green tattoos.

name: the jeweler
shortdesc: A tall, thin orc stands here, his dextrous hands moving nimbly.
longdesc:
This tall orc is almost elfin in his appearance.  Though obviously strong, 
his physique is more toned than muscular.  He carries himself haughtily, 
his graying hair swept back from his temples and worn loose across his
back.  His eyes are a brilliant shade of penetrating blue.

name: a towering gateguard
shortdesc: A towering gateguard stands at the ready, eyes narrowed.
longdesc:
This female orc stands at least two meters tall, and stands at full 
alertness, gazing from the gates and into the wilderness beyond.  Her 
body is keenly shifted to attention, and her green eyes gleam with 
cunning and cruelty.

name: an orcish baker
shortdesc: A rotund orc slumps against a wall here, covered in flour and sweat.
longdesc:
This orc bears an ample midsection, and has somehow managed to coat his 
entire body in a layer of fine flour, disturbed only by the rivulets of 
sweat streaming down his skin.  A weary expression rests on his face in
such a manner that it likely seldom leaves, and his hands bear hard 
callouses from hot surfaces and steady work.

name: a wealthy orcish woman
shortdesc: An orcish woman stands here haughtily.
longdesc:
This orcish woman presents all of the attributes that any orc might find 
desirable in a mate -- her tusks are perfectly formed, and curve alluringly 
across her upper lip, while her physique displays the hardness of one 
readied for battle coupled with the broad hips associated with childbearing.

name: an orcish shaman
shortdesc: A youthful orcish shaman chants slowly under his breath.
longdesc:
This youthful orc has no marks on his skin, save for two thick scars 
creasing his cheeks and marking him as one of the few selected to 
undergo initiation in the shamanic rites. His eyes are a fiery shade 
of orange, and voraciously sweep his surroundings as if to somehow 
absorb or encapsulate them.

name: the Ironaxe Chief
shortdesc: A large, regal-appearing orc stands casually here.
longdesc:
This tall orc bristles with the quiet confidence of one unused to being 
balked.  His body is well-formed, and surprisingly bears almost no scars 
from conflict.  His large, well-worn hands display a familiarity with 
weaponry in the pattern of their callouses, and his stance is of one
prepared, but not expecting, an attack at any moment.  A permanent smile 
seems to be at play across his lips, causing his tusks to be bared and 
unbared regularly, though it doesn't twinkle in his slate-gray eyes.

name: an Ironaxe attendant
shortdesc: A powerful orcish warrior stands stiffly at attention.
longdesc:
This attendant has been drilled since his youth in the duties of his 
station.  He stands rigidly still, his back as straight as a board, and 
his eyes narrowed to take in only what appears directly before him.  His 
sea-gray eyes are expressionless, and within their depths swims only
obedience and loyalty.

name: an orcish man
shortdesc: An orcish male wanders about listlessly.
longdesc:
This orc does not bear sufficient scars to class him as a member of the 
warrior caste, and so it is likely that the grin dancing across his lips 
is not due to the savouring of an enemy vanquished, but rather of another 
gold piece earned.  Although muscular, his stomach has developed the
paunch associated with the easy life, and he seems dull and unalert.

name: an orcish woman
shortdesc: A bored-looking orcish female wanders nearby.
longdesc:
This orcish woman must once have been attractive, but her tusks have 
now yellowed and cracked in an unappealing way, making her seem 
incapable of even drawing blood with a bite.  Her stomach is rounded, 
though likely with mutton and not a contribution to the orcish armies.
Her hands are appallingly smooth for an orc; she has grown used to the 
city life, and this fact is reflected in the drowsiness evident within 
her dim blue eyes.

name: the tattooist
shortdesc: An tall and slender orcish woman covered in cerulean and emerald tattoos, looks about attentively.
longdesc:
This orcish woman is as tall and slender as a willow branch, and 
completely naked save for the tattoos that have been etched across her 
perfect body.  The swirling patterns accentuate her flawless attributes, 
from her hardened gray skin to her high breasts to the tusks that
curve upwards very nearly to the bottoms of her glowing yellow eyes. 
Her expression is one of inquisitiveness and curiousity, flirting with 
the possibility of experimentation.

name: the Spirit of Siragus
shortdesc: A ghastly spirit flutters here, stinking of brimstone.
longdesc:
This horrific spirit is semi-transparent, and its form dances with flames. 
Ashes swirl about and help to give definition to its lines -- it appears 
to have been, in life, a mighty warrior, now reduced to an undeath of 
hellish torment.  Laughter flows freely along with the flames, calling
into question whether this is an eternity of punishment or glee, and 
the shade's eyes flash red as it glances about.

name: an orcish acolyte
shortdesc: A thin, heavily scarred orc wanders about with his hands clasped before him.
longdesc:
This orc has been ritually scarred across most of his visible body, with 
tattoos twining about them as if to tell the story of their making.  He 
has bright, piercing blue eyes and a facial expression best described 
as grim.  He is, perhaps, peering into a world beyond our own and
discovering something not to his liking.

name: a powerful shaman
shortdesc: A powerfully built orcish shaman kneels here, his body tensed.
longdesc:
This orcish shaman has a build normally associated with a warrior, but 
the scars and tattoos that are the right only of the shaman caste.  His 
body trembles as he kneels, his muscles coiling and uncoiling rapidly. 
The spiralling tattoos and the scars mingle together, until it appears 
that you can see the blood this shaman has shed for his totems coursing 
across his body, and feeding power into his being.  His eyes are a 
brilliant, multi-faceted shade of green, like burning emeralds set into 
his dark and creased visage.

name: an ancient shaman
shortdesc: An ancient, weathered orc sits calmly cross-legged.
longdesc:
This orc's nearly translucent skin has collapsed into layer upon layer 
of wrinkles and scars, and his ritualistic tattoos have fallen into 
the mix.  Simply distinguishing a nose or an ear can be a chore, 
particularly with the wisps of whitened hair that hang across his face
and chest, blowing this way and that with the breezes that caress him. 
His sunken amber eyes, though, cannot be missed. They carry a hatred 
and a power that seems beyond all reckoning and that sits at odds with 
his nonchalant stance.

name: a frenzied warrior
shortdesc: A youthful orc, dripping blood, screams wildly in an ululating tone.
longdesc:
This youthful orc has deep cuts across his collar-bones that have yet 
to heal; they drip blood across his muscled chest and around the single 
tattoo impressed upon it.  His canine-yellow eyes are creased by his 
lids as he attempts to master the pain that he's been placed in, and
his throat gives voice to a lament more savage and keening than that 
of any wolf.

name: an orcish priest
shortdesc: A youthful orc stands with his hands folded across his shoulders.
longdesc:
This orc is unscarred, and yet still has the cool confidence associated 
with the shamanic caste. His blue eyes are dull, though that appears 
more a deception than an actuality. He is well-built, though his 
physique is not overpowering, and he continually makes a curious, 
growling keen from the back of his throat.

name: the ironmaster
shortdesc: A massive, hulking orc seems to be lost in thought.
longdesc:
This massive orc has skin that has darkened to the color of worked, and 
seems to have attained its consistency.  His broad brow is furrowed above 
his coal eyes, and his massive hands folded one into the other.  He
occasionally blinks, very slowly, as though existing in a place where 
time moves slower than this one.

name: the Bloodscalp Chief
shortdesc: A bulky orc of regal bearing stands here impatiently.
longdesc:
This bulky orc is possessed of dull yellow eyes that flit constantly 
from side to side.  His powerful physique seems to be coiled like the 
body of a serpent, prepared to strike at any moment.  Scars and tattoos 
are laced sporadically across his body, particularly grouped about his
chest. He has the bearing of a ruler, unused to taking orders but 
accustomed to giving them.

name: a Bloodscalp attendant
shortdesc: A powerful orcish warrior stands stiffly at attention.
longdesc:
This attendant has been drilled since his youth in the duties of his 
station.  He stands rigidly still, his back as straight as a board, and 
his yellow eyes narrowed to take in only what appears directly before 
him.

name: the Lapislaz Chieftess
shortdesc: A tall and slender orcish woman stands here, smirking.
longdesc:
This tall, slender orcish woman has deep and sombre blue eyes that do 
not match the smirk constantly curling its way about her tusks.  Her 
skin is virtually flawless, and a light gray in tone.  She carries 
herself with the easy bearing of one unused to opposition and defined
by a quiet competence.

name: a Lapislaz attendant
shortdesc: A powerful orcish warrior stands stiffly at attention.
longdesc:
This woman has been taught the rigors of loyalty since a young age, and 
the teachings are displayed in her posture.  She stands stiffly at 
attention, blue eyes constantly scanning the area, prepared for whatever 
might befall her or those in her charge.  Her skin is flawless, and small
tattoos run up her arms to her collar bones.

name: the Blackwolf Chiefess
shortdesc: A tall and vicious looking orcish female.
longdesc:
This tall orcish female wears a scowl tinged with bloodlust.  Her tusks 
twist in upon themselves, eventually rising to her thin nostrils.  Her 
body is muscular, and her movements indicate a dissatisfaction with 
the notion of standing still.  Her eyes are a mossy shade of green, and
almost go unnoticed, set deeply within her gray features.

name: a Blackwolf attendant
shortdesc: A powerful orcish spearmaiden stands stiffly at attention.
longdesc:
This orcish spearmaiden has long, ropy arms and an extremely stiff 
posture.  Her green eyes sparkle as she surveys the area around her 
attentively.

name: a creature of crystal and light
shortdesc: A bizarre creature seemingly formed of crystal and light shimmers, here.
longdesc:
This strange creature has somehow been formed from shards of razor-
sharp crystal, seemingly bound together by ribbons of multi-coloured 
light.  It moves in the manner of a monster on a rampage, heedless of 
its surroundings and any beings that may inhabit them.

name: a creature of shadow
shortdesc: Multiple shadows coalesce into a form vaguely resembling a humanoid.
longdesc:
Thick, inky shadows coalesce here into a form that mostly resembles a 
humanoid, although the number of limbs, heads, and even bodies shifts 
and alters as the darkness oozes to and fro.  The shadows seem to have 
no purpose, and no awareness of their surroundings. They slide 
aimlessly onward, disregarding anything that might get in their way.

name: a misshapen creature
shortdesc: A deformed creature of indeterminate origin drags itself forward.
longdesc:
The lineage of this creature is a mystery.  Its body appears to be formed 
of parts of various creatures, including a heavily scarred humanoid torso 
and the arms of some sort of giant insectoid.  Its head appears to be 
that of an elf, but when it opens its mouth to howl mournfully, chitinous 
inner workings can be glimpsed.

name: an insectoid creature
shortdesc: A huge insectoid of some sort rests here, coated in blood and gore.
longdesc:
This massive insectoid creature has razor sharp and multi-jointed limbs 
that, along with its mandibles, seem constantly to be in motion.  Rather 
than being a typical insect of any sort, this creature seems to exist 
for no other reason than to kill the unwary, and the blood and bile 
coating the beast bear a mute and powerful testament to this fact.  A
klacking sound issues forth from somewhere in the mass of its body, 
unceasingly.

name: a wailing shade
shortdesc: A shadowy image of an orc keens mournfully.
longdesc:
The vague outlines of this entity provide just enough detail to 
determine that the shade must once have belonged to the orcish race, 
being possessed of their typical physique.  From within the shade 
issues forth a keening wail that chills the soul.

name: a cautious orc
shortdesc: An orc cautiously moves through the area, peering about.
longdesc:
This orc is extremely nervous. He constantly peers from side to side, 
and his yellow eyes display an evident fear.  He has two wounds across 
his collarbone, both of which drip blood in a slow but steady stream, 
and both of which have begun to coagulate with a thick black crust.

name: the warrior of light
shortdesc: The outline of a warrior can be seen faintly, absorbing and radiating large amounts of light.
longdesc:
No features of this warrior can be seen, save that his statue is massive 
and that he is roughly humanoid in form.  The light being cast from him 
is too intense to distinguish any more detail.

name: a crystalline giant
shortdesc: A giant formed of sparkling crystal towers here.
longdesc:
This giant has been constructed -- or birthed -- entirely of crystal.  
His body sparkles as he moves, casting bows of light throughout the 
area.  His stature is beyond being merely impressive -- his arms are 
as thick as tree trunks, and his head is the size of a boulder.  His 
irridescent eyes contain all the colours of the rainbow, constantly
shifting.

name: a spotted leopard
shortdesc: A spotted leopard roams the valley hungrily.
longdesc:
This beautiful leopard is lithe and muscular, seemingly read to pounce 
upon unwary prey at any moment.  It moves without making a sound, and 
causes barely a ripple in the tall grass as it undulates through it.

name: a carnivorous plant
shortdesc: A vine creeps forward, extending from the undergrowth.
longdesc:
This thin creeper trails back into a plant of unknown size, though a 
thick and knotted stem system can occasionally be glimpsed within the 
undergrowth.  It moves with a definite purpose.

name: a hulking primate
shortdesc: A large primate drags itself through the brush.
longdesc:
This huge primate has a creased brow and bared fangs; apparently it is 
displeased by the notion that others might be intruding by its home.  It 
sniffs the air periodically, moving about with a definite and dangerous
purpose.

name: Balmek
shortdesc: Balmek Warrior King of The Ork.
longdesc:
Balmek is a massive ork, he towers above his chiefs. His hair 
is unkempt and greasy, he smells badly even for an ork. He values 
his privacy when not at war and does not accept visitors kindly.

name: an old gravekeeper
shortdesc: An old gravekeeper runs around swinging his shovel in the air.
longdesc:
The gravekeeper looks scared for his life.  Tightly grasping his trusty
shovel to his chest,  he scans the graves around him, looking for.....
something.  An inhuman houl echoes through the air, causing the poor
old soul to jump to his feet.  He starts to swing his shovel around in
the air as though he is being attacked.  What a freak.

name: a wandering zombie
shortdesc: An animated corpse is walking through the graveyard.
longdesc:
A low moan comes from this poor creature as it walks aimlessly through
the graveyard.  Its hair and skin clumps into pieces and falls onto the
ground as its body starts to degrade.  It stops.  The moan is rising 
into a scream.  Turning in your direction, its decaying legs start 
hobbling towards you.

name: a wandering ghast
shortdesc: An opaque, humanoid-like outline hovers in the air.
longdesc:
The ghast lets out an ear-splitting scream as he floats around the
graveyard.  It is difficult to see the ghast through the overcast and
foggy weather conditions.  The moon pokes through the clouds, raining
down some columns of light and illuminating the outline of a ghast,
directly above your head.

name: Doctor Frankenstein *QUEST*
shortdesc: A madman stands cackling before a giant machine.
longdesc:
The mad doctor is oblivious to your entrance in to the room.  His
attention is focused on the machine covering the east wall.  He turns
some knobs and presses a few buttons.  *CRACK*  A loud clap of thunder
comes from above your head.  He stops, stares straight up and lets out
an insane laugh with all his might.  What is he looking at?

name: Doctor Frankenstein
shortdesc: A madman stands cackling before a giant machine.
longdesc:
The mad doctor is oblivious to your entrance in to the room.  His
attention is focused on the machine covering the east wall.  He turns
some knobs and presses a few buttons.  *CRACK*  A loud clap of thunder
comes from above your head.  He stops, stares straight up and lets out
an insane laugh with all his might.  What is he looking at?

name: Frankenstein's monster
shortdesc: A giant monster rages around the room.
longdesc:
The monster is completely tearing up the room.  There are stitches all
across its skin.  It looks as though it was pieced together.  The skin
types do not even match.  Some steel bolts jut out from its neck.  A
bright spark seems to jolt out of the bolts when the monster loses 
control.  The sparks suddenly turn into fireworks, as you now realize 
the monster is staring straight at you.

name: a wandering corpse
shortdesc: A patch-work corpse walks randomly along the hallways.
longdesc:
Mindless and broken, the patch-work corpse limps along the hallway.  It
does not seem to have anywhere to go.  There are limbs from various
bodies making up the corpse.  The arm of a slim lady, the leg and head
of a fat man and the hands of of strong warrior all make its appearance
very disturbing.  Moaning, it turns and jumps at you, sensing your 
warmth.

name: a mutilated experiment
shortdesc: A mutilated experiment moans from the examination table.
longdesc:
Its body jumps and seizes as you move closer to get a better look.  It
stares at you, with its one good eye.  A metal plate has been molded
and bolted across the right side of its head.  A tear drops from its
eye.  "K...k....Kill ME!", it desperately whispers.  "I cannot live
like this anymore!", it weeps, closing its eye.  A green luster seems
to be emitting from its body.

name: Sparky, a mutilated experiment
shortdesc: A mutilated experiment moans from the examination table.
longdesc:
Its body jumps and seizes as you move closer to get a better look.  It
stares at you with sad desperation.  A bolt of lightning soars from
the sky a strikes the poor creature.  Its body shakes so hard it falls
off the table.  It raises its head towards you and you see a tear drop 
from its eye.  "K...k....kill me!", it desperately whispers.  "I cannot
live like this anymore!", it weeps, closing its eyes.  A green luster 
seems to be emitting from its body.

name: The vampire Lestat *QUEST*
shortdesc: A pale and weak looking figure lurks in the shadows.
longdesc:
Your initial fear subsides as you notice the figure cower from you.  
>From the looks of him, he has been rotting away here for some time now.
He may not have the strength to move, let alone be a threat to you. 
However, as you approach, you notice two abnormally pointy teeth.  
There is also a certain gleam in his eye that tells you this fellow 
isn't looking for a new friend.

name: The vampire lord
shortdesc: The vampire lord eyes you hungrily from the back of the room.
longdesc:
A handsome man, dressed in a classic black tuxedo, rests against the
wall to the back of the room.  He looks to be very young in age, but the
haunted look in his eyes reveals an amost agelessness.  His face
contorts into a smile as he realizes you are staring at him.  Two long,
sharp canine teeth are revealed beneath his ruby red lips.

name: The vampire underling
shortdesc: A young man hisses at you and rears to attack.
longdesc:
The vampire underling stands before his master, hissing at you with his
teeth bared.  He is dressed in a shining black tuxedo and his hair is
completely slicked back.  Some trickles of blood still linger on his
chin.

name: a vampire bat
shortdesc: A large, black vampire bat flies around the room.
longdesc:
*Whoosh*  The vampire bat does a kamikaze dive straight for your head.
The bat is quite large and its color is pitch black.  It flies back up,
screeches at you and sets back into another dive.

name: a vampire bat
shortdesc: A large, black vampire bat flies around the room.
longdesc:
*Whoosh*  The vampire bat does a kamikaze dive straight for your head.
The bat is quite large and its color is pitch black.  It flies back up,
screeches at you and sets back into another dive.

name: Patricia, the lonely ghost
shortdesc: The ghost of a lonely woman sits with some skeletons near the corner.
longdesc:
A lovely looking old lady floats in the corner, speaking to some long
dead skeletons.  "Oh course, Mr. Penniweather, I will get us some tea
right now!", she cheerfully bellows.  Floating over to a table, made
out of some broken tombstones, she grabs a tea set and brings it back
over to her friends.  "One lump or two, Mrs. Simpson.".

name: The Pumpkin King *QUEST*
shortdesc: A gigantic orange pumpkin etched with battle scars sits here.
longdesc:
The Pumpkin King rests in a patch of thorny, green vines.  A shiny
golden crown sits upon his gigantic pumpkin head.  His head is slowly
pushed up by the vines beneath him.  The vines start to form a body,
then some arms and legs.  The Pumpkin King now towers high above you.
A giant, oval eye slowly opens in the middle of its face.  A vicious
smile opens width wise across his face, revealing a black pit of
swirling mist.

name: The Pumpkin King
shortdesc: A gigantic orange pumpkin slowly rises from the mist.
longdesc:
The Pumpkin King slowly rises from a glowing, foggy mist.  A shiny
golden crown sits upon his gigantic pumpkin head.  Thousands of thorny,
green vines shout out from the bottom of its head, like thin, waving
arms.  A mighty golden brown sceptor with a pumpkin at the top is held
tightly with some of the vines.  A giant, oval eye slowly opens in the
middle of its face.  A vicious smile opens width wise across his face,
revealing a black pit of swirling mist.

name: A wandering pumpkin
shortdesc: A giant pumpkin roams the pumpkin patch for its next victim.
longdesc:
A giant pumpkin roams along the trails of the pumpkin patch.  The
pumpkin is a glowing orange color and has a bunch of thorny, green
vines beneath it, moving it along.  You cannot see an eye, mouth, nose
or ear, but you can tell the pumpkin is well aware you are intruding on
his turf.  A very pumpkin-like moan comes from the creature as he rears
to attack.

name: A giant pumpkin
shortdesc: A giant pumpkin blocks the way to the east.
longdesc:
This pumpkin is easily the size of a small shack.  Its color is a 
beautiful golden orange hue.  The thorny, green vines drape over and
around it, as though they are holding it to the ground.  Pretty white
and yellow flowers are growing from the green vines.  The pumpkin 
starts to shake and a fine yellow power starts to drift from the
blossoms.  *Ah-Chew*!  You seem to have inhaled some of the yellow
powder and your eyes are getting very sleepy.

name: A simple scarecrow
shortdesc: A simple scarecrow sticks out from the pumpkin patch.
longdesc:
The scarecrow is dressed in a simple brown and gray suit.  The suit is
in very good condition considering the scarecrow is stuck out in the
open and has probably been for awhile.  A warm energy seems to be 
emitting from the scarecrow.  Maybe it is not as simple as it looks.  A
wide smile seems to have appeared no its face.

name: Apollo
shortdesc: Apollo walks around here, looking annoying and entitled.
longdesc:
Apollo is a young, athletic man with locks of jet-black hair and a smile
that makes you want to slap him.  Hard.  He wanders around wearing just
light toga that barely covers him and shows more flesh than you want to
see at any time of day.

name: Artemis
shortdesc: Artemis lounges here nonchalantly, watching the world go by.
longdesc:
Artemis is a beautiful young woman with locks of jet-black hair that
tumble down over her shoulders and back and are kept away from her eyes
with a silver laurel wreath.  She doesn't wear much else, except her
sandals and quiver, which should give your imagination a nice whirl. 
She carries her Epirus Bow with her wherever she goes.

name: Leto
shortdesc: Leto is here, looking for a way to sneak off without Zeus noticing!
longdesc:
Leto is a pretty woman in her mid-to-late forties with jet-black hair
that is greying at the temples.  Despite her age her body is well honed
and lithe, much akin to an acrobat.  She is the wife of Zeus, but
secretly she hates him and wishes to be free.  She wears only a pair of
laced up slippers and a hairnet of silver filigree in her hair.

name: Zeus
shortdesc: Zeus is here, furiously looking for his wife Leto.
longdesc:
Zeus is a very tall, very imposing man with muscles on his muscles.  He
knows how good his body looks (or thinks it looks) and that must explain
why he insists on walking around butt-naked.  Sigh.  Does anyone in this
house wear clothes??  His hair and beard of golden, like his eyes, and
his single adornment is the cracking length of lightning known as
Thunderbolt.

name: Dionysus
shortdesc: Dionysus is here, looking immensely drunk.
longdesc:
This dishevelled creature is Dionysus.  He is a young-ish man, although
it is hard to tell with the years of over-indulgence taking its toll on
him.  Unlike everyone else in this place, he is a flabby, unfit mess of
a man.  His lank ginger hair and beard are unwashed and he smells of the
very worst of human-kind.  It's quite possible his breath could turn
silver black.  Thanfully he wears a horrible green robe so we are spared
yet one more naked form at least.   All he seems to talk about is his
half-sister Ariadne and how much of a hotty she is.  Gross.

name: Ariadne
shortdesc: Ariadne is scowling here, working out ways to torment Dionysus.
longdesc:
Ariadne is a young woman in her very late teens or early twenties.  She
takes after her father Zeus, with curly golden hair that frames a pretty
but expressionless face.  Her eyes are black, pupil and iris both, which
contrasts with the stark white of her sclera and gives her a demonic,
evil-look.  She is slim but not muscular or lithe, but like many of her
family she fails to wear much in the way of clothes.  She keeps her long
stave handy and wears only a belt of golden links around her tiny waist.

name: Captain of the guards
shortdesc: The captain stands here looking over reports.
longdesc:
The captain is rather well dressed in his green silks, and has a silver
jewelled dagger belted to his waist.  He stands here looking over the 
reports of the day.  He does not look like some one who would take too 
kindly to being interrupted.

name: The outpost guard
shortdesc: The elven guard stands here eyeing you suspiciously.
longdesc:
The elven guard, with his green armour, would be almost invisible from 
the ground.  All an intruder would see would be a flash of silver as he 
drew his sword.

name: The elven priestess
shortdesc: The priestess stands here by her altar.
longdesc:
The priestess is the picture of serenity in her ceremonial robes. But 
with the hammer she carries, she definitely looks like she can defend 
herself, if the need arose.

name: The elven ranger
shortdesc: The ranger stands here inspecting his equipment for the trip back into the forest.
longdesc:
The ranger is here looking over his equipment. If you were not standing
right here in the room with him, he would be invisible in the forest, 
with his full length multi-hued cloak.

name: The elven lieutenant
shortdesc: The lieutenant stands here awaiting commands from the general.
longdesc:
The lieutenant is more heavily armoured then the other elves you have 
seen so far.  His mithril armour is well cared for and his sword was 
designed for use, not ceremony.

name: The elven general
shortdesc: The general stands here looking over his maps.
longdesc:
The general stands here in his ceremonial armour.  Although his armour is
ceremonial, he exudes an aura of command.  He definitely looks like 
someone who expects his commands to be obeyed at once.

name: The chamber guard
shortdesc: The chamber guard stands here to turn back those who should not be here.
longdesc:
The chamber guard is more heavily armoured then the other guards you 
have seen so far.  His demeanour and armour let you know he will not let 
anyone pass by him.

name: The elven archer
shortdesc: The archer is here scanning the forest.
longdesc:
The archer stands here scanning the forest floor for possible enemies.
He is clothed in simple silks and only lightly armored.

name: The elven scholar
shortdesc: The scholar is here reading an ancient tome.
longdesc:
The scholar looks very old, which means he must be ancient, even by 
elven standards.  He is dressed in very fine purple silks.  He 
radiates a magical aura.

name: An ancient king
shortdesc: The king is here and he does not look pleased about it.
longdesc:
The king emanates with ancient and mysterious powers.  He is dressed in 
ancient golden armour, and he has drawn an ancient sword as he turns 
toward you.  You get the feeling he is planning on using it too.

name: The statue guard
shortdesc: The statue is here to guard his king.
longdesc:
The statue creaks and groans, rubbing stone on stone! It starts to move 
toward you as you enter the room and, although it might be slow, it 
definitely looks like it can use the huge axe in its hand.

name: An ancient magic user
shortdesc: The form of an ancient magic user floats here by his altar.
longdesc:
The form of an ancient magic user floats here by his altar, eyeing you 
with menace in his eyes.  He literally glows with magical power.

name: The sentinel
shortdesc: The sentinel stands here guarding the circle.
longdesc:
The sentinel stands here, in his mithril armour, to stop all those who 
should not have gotten this far into the outpost.  He looks like he 
would be well suited to his duties here.

name: An old half-elf warrior
shortdesc: An old half-elf stands here.
longdesc:
The ancient warrior, even lounging in his room, has his battle armour 
on and it looks like it has been well used.  The ancient warrior eyes 
you and a confident smile comes across his face, as he stands and faces
you.

name: The elven bard
shortdesc: The bard lounges here strumming a harp.
longdesc:
The bard lounges here strumming an old harp.  He looks like he has 
traveled far and wide and has many stories to tell and songs to sing. 
You think he would have to be rather handy with that staff he 
carries, to be traveling alone for so long.

name: Glaurung the Golden
shortdesc: Glaurung the Golden is here about to devour you!!
longdesc:
This is Glaurung the Golden.  He is as ancient as the very bedrock, bred in
the early days by the first Elves.  He was once a force for goodness, but
when the Elves fell from the Light with the descruction of the Well of Souls
during the first ages of the Realms, so Glaurung fell too.  He was twisted
with demonic power, growing two mighty horns on his forehead that curl back
over his skull.  His once-golden coat is now blackened with age, and only
the barest glimmer of gold now shows through.  His wings span for twice His
body length and are wrinkled and contoured with age.  He was once the mount
of Nuahlon, although many held that Glaurung was the more powerful of the
pair.  He now bides his time, hidden from the eyes of the world by the still
loyal Elves.

name: Prince Torrel
shortdesc: Prince Torrel stands here, surveying the outpost
longdesc:
This is Prince Torrel, heir to the Elven Throne, the last surviving grand-
son of Coringor, the cursed Elven king.  He stands dressed in his battle
gear, his cloak tied loose around his shoulders, and his sword, Ringil,
hanging at his side, ready to use.

name: the Watcher in the Wood
shortdesc: The Watcher in the Wood is here, seeking intruders.
longdesc:
The watcher looks very much like a tree, except that once it moves you
can clearly see it is demonic in origin and has just adopted the look
of the local foliage to meld in to the background, making it very hard
to see.  But now that you do... It does appear to have some very sharp,
spikey fists, and long, dangerous-looking fangs dripping with something
green and oily.  Perhaps fighting this beast would not be a good idea!

name: An elven farmer
shortdesc: An elven farmer works diligently.
longdesc:
The elven farmer kneels over his garden, tending to its bounty.
He is so focused on the vegetables around him he hardly notices you
walking by. Tread lightly, one wrong step and you sense the farmer
could slip a knife into your belly.

name: Marlebryn
shortdesc: Marlebryn stands behind the smithing table working away.
longdesc:
A massive elf, possibly the largest elf you've seen, looms large over the
smithing table working hard on what you presume will be a sword when he's
finished. His chiseled face is unlike most elves you've seen with a bushy
moustache gracing his upper-lip. His bulging muscles stick out of his sleeveless 
tunic and sweat glistens every muscle and sinew in his arms. He swings his 
forging hammer like a man who knows how to use it. This is not a fight you want 
to initiate.

name: a wandering warg
shortdesc: A large warg darts in and out of the trees.
longdesc:
The warg is covered in a brown and black matted pelt.  The fleas and
ticks practically jump off and on the animal, like its a giant bus.
Snarling at your intrusion to its home, the warg crouches down to
attack.

name: a warg villager male
shortdesc: A carefree villager tends to the fire.
longdesc:
The warg villager tends to his fire, as though he does not have a care
in the world.  He is dressed simply, in what appears to be clothing made
from the local animals.  "Come, warm yourself by the fire with me.", he
smiles at you.  "These woods can be very chilly at night", he remarks,
poking a stick into the fire.

name: a warg villager female
shortdesc: A smiling warg villager tends to her home.
longdesc:
Humming quietly to herself, the beautiful warg villager continues to do
tasks around her home.  Stirring some soup on the fire, folding some
clothes on a pile near the wall and sweeping up the pine needle covered
floor, she sure takes care of her home.

name: a warg villager pregnant
shortdesc: A very pregnant warg villager tries to run after her small children.
longdesc:
She looks extremely uncomfortable.  Clearly ready to give birth at any
second, she places her hands on her hips and heaves herself out of her
chair, revealing her huge pregnant belly.  With a lovely smile, she
chases after her children, in what seems to be a game of tag.  Laughing
cutely, she soon tires and returns to her chair.  This poor woman.
Where on earth could her husband be?

name: a warg villager child
shortdesc: A young warg villager runs around his house, making a mess.
longdesc:
A young child runs around the house, chasing after his brothers.  He
performs some summersaults and then punches one of his brothers in the
nose.  "Sorry mom, we know.....no rough housing.", he sulks, and then
immediately starts running after his brothers again.

name: a warg villager warrior
shortdesc: A strong looking warrior looks you over carefully.
longdesc:
Glaring at you with hatred, the warg warrior places his hand on his
sword hilt.  "This is sacred ground.", he bellows.  "You should not have
come here."  He is dressed in standard studded leather gear.

name: a warg villager musician
shortdesc: A proud warrior beats a drum in a furious rhythm.
longdesc:
Finally, the source of the drums is realized.  The warg villager stands
towards the back of the clearing, beating on his drums like a madman.
The drumbeats are furious and intricate.  It is almost like they are
sending out a message that only the local villagers can understand.

name: a warg villager leader
shortdesc: A powerful warrior draws his sword and sets into an attack.
longdesc:
A long scar runs from the top right side of his forhead to the bottom 
left side of his face.  Whatever scratched or slashed him took his left
eye with it.  A studded leather eye patch covers what was left of his 
eye.  Drawing his sword, he places his right foot forward and sets into 
an attack.

name: a warg villager scientist
shortdesc: The warg scientist walks through his house, cackling madly.
longdesc:
He starts to giggle as you stare at him.  "You seem to have gotten lost,
young adventurer.  This is MY house.", he laughs at you.  He runs over
to the door, blocking the exit.  "Do not worry.", he grins, "You will
not be able to make that mistake again.".  "They have tried to stop my
experiments before,", he cackles, "and I doubt they will ever try
again!".

name: an undead warg villager
shortdesc: An ethereal hand reaches out towards you from the mist.
longdesc:
A cloud of mist rolls through the air in large fluffy clumps.  "You
should NOT have come here!", echoes from the mist, "This is holy
ground."  A boney, ethereal hand stretches out from the mist and right
towards you.  "I will make you pay.", the voice bellows, "I will make
you ALL pay.".

name: an enhanced warg
shortdesc: A large warg drools and snarls viciously at you.
longdesc:
The warg is covered in a brown and black matted pelt.  The fleas and
ticks practically jump off and on the animal, like its a giant bus.
There are several hand stitched scars running across the wargs body.
You can tell that this warg is somehow genetically enhanced, but the
almost human eyes hint that there is something more going on.  Snarling 
at your intrusion, the warg crouches down to attack.

name: A warg villager cheering
shortdesc: A warg villager cheers the battles going on below.
longdesc:
Smiling and cheering, the warg villager has all his attention on the 
fights in the cage towards the middle of the arena.  "Go, go, go!", he
shouts with excitement, holding his ticket in the air.

name: A warg villager gambler
shortdesc: An excited villager tries to get you to bet on the next fight.
longdesc:
Two for one odds!", he shouts at you, "You can't beat that!".  The man
is dripping in sweat and it is obvious he has not changed his clothes
in a long time.  The smell alone is nauseating.  Noticing you are not
interested, he turns away and runs to the next customer.  "Hey, hey!
I've got a deal for you!".

name: a warg villager trainer
shortdesc: The warg villager guards the gate to the cage.
longdesc:
Solemnly standing guard, the villager eyes you suspicously.  The sounds
of cheering and battle does not seem to phase him in the least.  There
is a small glimmer shining from his front vest pocket.

name: a warg villager trainer
shortdesc: A warg villager walks back and forth in front of the torches.
longdesc:
Solemnly standing guard, the villager eyes you suspicously.  The sounds
of cheering and battle does not seem to phase him in the least.  There
is a small glimmer shining from his front vest pocket.

name: A warg villager vender
shortdesc: A nice warg villager offers you a bite to eat.
longdesc:
Smiling warmly, the vender shows you his goods for sale.  "I just made
these today!", he says with pride.  "They are all fresh and warm.  Only
10 coins!

name: a strong and sturdy guard
shortdesc: A strong and sturdy guard patrols the streets with a stern face.
longdesc:
Boy does he look serious!  Heavily armored and looking to fight at a moments
notice, the strong and study guard of OldPort sweepingly patrols the streets
for trouble.  His heavy plated boots clank loudly on the road as he stomps
his feet, signaling you to walk on.

name: a strong and sturdy wandering guard
shortdesc: A strong and sturdy guard patrols the streets with a stern face.
longdesc:
Boy does he look serious!  Heavily armored and looking to fight at a moments
notice, the strong and study guard of OldPort sweepingly patrols the streets
for trouble.  His heavy plated boots clank loudly on the road as he walks
right by you.

name: a midlevel guard
shortdesc: A proud looking guard stands at attention on top of the blockade.
longdesc:
Dressed in standard OldPort military wear, this guard stands above the
blockade in the road.  He never meets your gaze, but slowly moves his eyes
from side to side, monitoring his surroundings.  His right hand secure
against the hilt of his sabre, he is ready for trouble at any time.

name: a wandering guard
shortdesc: A guard of OldPort patrols the streets for any sign of trouble.
longdesc:
A proud guard of OldPort walks chest puffed through the street.  Dressed in
green and black OldPort military wear, the guard looks very smashing.  A
solid looking shield with the crest of OldPort is slung across his back.  His
scabbard clangs loosely against his leg armor.

name: a lazy guard
shortdesc: A lazy guard lifts his head to look at you and then goes back to sleep.
longdesc:
One term can describe this lazy OldPort guard, asleep.  Lazily lounging
while the rest of the guards do all his work, this guard sits propped
against the blockade.  What a world.

name: a black dog
shortdesc: A black dog rifles through some garbage in the street.
longdesc:
A black colored dog is picking through some garbage on the street.
Someone seems to have kept this dog very well fed.  How odd for a city
without any townspeople.

name: a pitch black raven
shortdesc: A black raven squaks at you from the architecture.
longdesc:
A pitch black raven squaks at you from the building's buttresses and
swoops down at your head.  Missing only by inches, the beautiful bird
lands on the ground and picks through some trash.

name: a master thief bandit
shortdesc: A large man sizes you up from the back of the room.
longdesc:
Standing towards the back of the room, the bandit leader slowly sizes you
up.  For a group of bandits, this guy sure dresses nice.  His clothes are 
in perfect condition, as though he has never weathered a tough day in his
life.  The nervous look on his men's faces cause the master thief jump to
the front of the group shouting, "This is our territory, understand?".

name: a frightened bandit
shortdesc: A frightened thief seems to have worked his way to the back of the pack.
longdesc:
The smallest of the group, this short man immediately ran behind his friends
upon your entrance to the room.  A small black cap sits atop his head.  He
