has on black pants and a nice white shirt.

name: a scrappy bandit
shortdesc: A scrappy looking bandit stands here, punching his hand into his fist.
longdesc:
A flat, brown hat sits sideways on this scrappy fellows head.  His sleeves
are rolled up to his elbows and he won't stop beating his hand into his
fist as he stares straight in your eyes.  A small, red light flickers from
the end of his cigar as he takes a puff and blows the smoke in your face.

name: a wandering bandit
shortdesc: A man dressed in black robes quickly darts around the corner.
longdesc:
A shifty looking man, dressed in a long black robe, quickly walks across
the street.  He tries to avert all eye contact with you, but stares 
quickly at your wallet.  He darts around the next corner, fading away
from sight.

name: a pretty lady
shortdesc: A pretty lady stands in line, hoping to get into the party.
longdesc:
Glowing and demure, a pretty, young lady waits in line for one of the
the Earl's famous parties.  A quaint yellow parasol blocks her delicate
porcelain skin from the sun.  Her form fitting yellow dress reveals a
sexy hourglass figure.  She shyly notices you gazing and her cheeks
pink up.

name: a proper gentleman
shortdesc: A tuxedo glad gentleman waits patiently in line.
longdesc:
A proper looking gentlemen is waiting in line.  He is dressed in a sleek,
black tuxedo with a black top hat.  A frilly white shirt pokes through
the lapels of his tuxedo's jacket. He appears to be very collected even
in the direct sunshine.

name: a sweaty man
shortdesc: A robust man stands in line, dripping in sweat.
longdesc:
Wow! Somebody give this guy a towel.  His odd, purple and lavender suit
is seeping through in sweat marks.  The sweat mark on his shirt seems
to have formed the shape of a bat. Weird.

name: a shady creep
shortdesc: A shady looking man waits in line, his eyes are on your wallet.
longdesc:
He must be hot under all that clothing.  Why would someone be completely
covered in cloaks and cowls while waiting in line? He must be up to
something.

name: a wandering waiter
shortdesc: A smiling waiter offers you something cool to drink.
longdesc:
Dancing effortlessly around the party guests, this member of the Earl's
party staff flows from guest to guest.  He holds a tray of different
colored drinks.  He invites you to have one, with a warm smile.

name: a scared waiter
shortdesc: An uneasy looking waiter offers you a snack.
longdesc:
His whole face seems to start to sweat as the waiter notices you looking
at him.  The tray of scrumptious snacks starts to teeter and shake as
you come even closer.  Seemingly attempting to compose himself, the waiter
straightens his back and squeaks, "Would you know some finger food sir?".

name: a hummingbird
shortdesc: A pretty, little hummingbird buzzes amungst the tulips.
longdesc:
A delicate hummingbird flies from tulip to tulip, quickly tasting some
nectar and flys away.

name: a dancing woman
shortdesc: A woman is dancing around the room, having a good time.
longdesc:
Glowing and laughing, a pretty, young lady dances around with a smile
in one of the Earl's famous parties.  She may have had too much to 
drink, as she stumbles some of her steps.  Her form fitting yellow 
dress reveals a sexy hourglass figure.  She shyly notices you gazing 
and her cheeks pink up.

name: a dancing gentleman
shortdesc: A tuxedo glad gentleman dances happily around the room.
longdesc:
A proper looking gentlemen dances gleefully around the room.  He is 
dressed in a sleek, black tuxedo with a black top hat.  A frilly white 
shirt pokes through the lapels of his tuxedo's jacket. He appears to 
have drank too much and is getting a little too friendly with the
ladies.

name: a gossiping socialite
shortdesc: A well dressed man stands whispering into a woman's ear.
longdesc:
Staring at you immediately as you entered the room, the well groomed
socialite does not stop whispering into his friend's ear.  His eyes
follow you around the room and measure you up, top to bottom.  What a
freak.

name: a bored woman
shortdesc: A bored woman stares at the ceiling while someone gabs in her ear.
longdesc:
This poor woman.  There is a party going on, people dancing around, a
nice stiff drink in her hand and all she can do is listen to the local
gossip gabbing in her ear.  With a loud and public yawn, she sips her
drink and resumes studying the ceiling.

name: a lovely old receptionist
shortdesc: An old and lovely looking receptionist tends to her knitting.
longdesc:
A gentle and lovely looking old woman sits in her chair and tends to
her knitting.  "Are you ready for a good nights rest my dears?", she
seems to sing to you from her resting place.  "Just type "camp" dears
and I'll watch after your belongings.  Have a good rest!".  Strangely,
you can feel an odd power coming from the old lady, I wouldn't mess
with her.

name: a nice bartender
shortdesc: The good bartender smiles at you, offering a seat and a drink.
longdesc:
A scrawny bartender stands smiling from behind his bar.  He smiles at you,
offering a seat.  Strands of hair have been combed over his balding
head in an attempt to hide his years.  He tends to his other customers,
since you are having trouble making a decision on a drink.  Oddly enough,
he looks rather dangerous.

name: a local drunk
shortdesc: A very happy man raises his glass and cheers for you!
longdesc:
Ewww....  This man has puked all over himself.  Chunks of...something..
are resting at his feet.  He cheerfully raises his glass and makes a 
toast for you as you enter the room.  He quickly orders a drink for you
too so that he will have someone to talk with.  Better run.

name: a drunk fisherman
shortdesc: A drunk sailor listens intently to the conversation.
longdesc:
He seems to have wandered pretty far from the docks.  The mad clammering
of the scary old man next to him has completely engrossed his attention.
He can only raise his glass to his lips and take a sip.

name: a crazy man
shortdesc: A scrawny, crazy little old man is spouting something about the Earl.
longdesc:
What are you looking at?!", screams the angry, crazy little old man.
"I was here before you, before all you people.  That damn Earl ruined
everything.", he quietly weeps to himself.  He suddenly turns away and
shouts, "Strawberries!!!!!!".  Very confused, he sits down and lays
his head on the table.

name: a wayward gentleman
shortdesc: A well dressed man is engaged in a conversation.
longdesc:
He seems to have wandered pretty far from the docks.  The mad clammering
of the scary old man next to him has completely engrossed his attention.
He can only raise his glass to his lips and take a sip.

name: an angry fisherman
shortdesc: An angry fisherman is distrubed by your walking on his boat.
longdesc:
Hey, can't you see people are working here?", shouts the fisherman
from the back of the boat.  He is trying to sort and clean their catch of
the day so that he can finally head home.  He has clearly been out to
sea for a long time.

name: a tired fisherman
shortdesc: A tired looking fisherman is trying to mend a net.
longdesc:
Beaten by the sea and the sun, this fisherman is hastily attempting to
mend his net and go home.  His rosey red cheeks look up from his work
for a second to check you out and he immediately goes back to work.

name: a happy fisherman
shortdesc: A fisherman whistles a happy tune while cleaning some fish.
longdesc:
Strong and healthy, the fisherman continues to clean his fish as you
walk onto his ship.  He gives you a quick, "Hoi!", and continues on his
duties.

name: a cheery fisherman
shortdesc: A man waves and smiles at you from across the boat.
longdesc:
A hard working fisherman is cleaning up around the boat.  He looks up
and asks, "Would you like to come with us on our next run?  You look
really strong!".  Not waiting for a response, he continues preparing for
their next voyage.

name: a strong fisherman
shortdesc: A well built fisherman carries large barrels on each shoulder.
longdesc:
A strong, well built fisherman carries some barrels onto the ship.  The
barrels are easily as large as you.  No regular human could lift that
weight.

name: a injured fisherman
shortdesc:
An injured fisherman is struggling to get a wheelbarrel onto the 
boat.
longdesc:
One of his arms is wrapped up in a bandage.  The seas must be very 
rough.  He is still working his hardest, regardless of the setbacks.
He is trying to push a huge barrel across the deck of the ship in a
giant wheelbarrel.  He is too proud to ask you for any help.

name: a strange and ugly bird
shortdesc: A strange and ugly bird circles above your head.
longdesc:
This is the ugliest bird you have even seen.  The strange and ugly bird
does circles above your head, eyeing you intently.  It must be hoping
for a meal.

name: ticket salesman ferry
shortdesc: A large man grins, blocking your entrance to the ship.
longdesc:
A large man blocks your entrance to the ferry.  "Millers Falls mate?", 
  he laughs at you, "Sure you wanting to go there?".  He continues to
  collect tickets from other passengers and send them on their ways.
  He is dressed in handsome formal wear, so strange for such a large 
  man.  "Listen", he says to you, smile fading from his face, "It's
  your life, so just buy a ticket and unlock the ferry." The glowing
  smile pops back into his face, and he continues to sell his tickets.

name: a pretty ship lady
shortdesc: A pretty lady stands in line, hoping to get on the ship.
longdesc:
Glowing and demure, a pretty, young lady waits in line for one of the
Chessport tickets.  A quaint yellow parasol blocks her delicate
porcelain skin from the sun.  Her form fitting yellow dress reveals a
sexy hourglass figure.  She shyly notices you gazing and her cheeks
pink up.

name: a dock worker
shortdesc: A dock worker walks busily past you.
longdesc:
Carrying a heavy load, the docker worker walks busily past you.  His 
hugely muscled body does not seem to slack under all that weight.
He gives you no attention.

name: a naughty child
shortdesc: A very naughty child runs up and down the docks.
longdesc:
Where is this child's mother?  All he seems to be able to do is run up
and down the docks, screaming and pushing people.  He better stop or he
is going to hurt himself.

name: an intertube child
shortdesc: A happy child runs along the dock in a yellow ducky intertube.
longdesc:
Where is this child's mother?  All she seems to be able to do is run up
and down the docks, screaming and pushing people.  She better stop or she
is going to hurt herself.  You see the child trying to jump off the dock
and are too late to stop her as she splashes into the cool water.

name: a pretty dockwalker lady
shortdesc: A pretty lady walks down the docks, gazing into the water.
longdesc:
Glowing and demure, a pretty, young lady enjoys a long walk down the
wooden OldPort docks.  A quaint yellow parasol blocks her delicate
porcelain skin from the sun.  Her form fitting yellow dress reveals a
sexy hourglass figure.  She shyly notices you gazing and her cheeks
pink up.

name: a wayward dock traveller
shortdesc: A tired looking traveller walks slowly along the docks.
longdesc:
He seems very tired from his long trip.  He is very well dressed and
carries a single bag of luggage.  He does not appear to have anywhere to
go or no place to be.

name: a giant octopus
shortdesc: A giant octopus stares up at you from the bottom of the pool.
longdesc:
A giant red octopus stares at you hungrily from the bottom of the cave.
Its tentacles slowly creep and crawl around anything it can tounch.  It
contracts all the tentacles at once and propels itself off the floor,
directly at you.

name: the lighthouse keeper
shortdesc: An old lighthouse keeper slowly wanders through the lighthouse.
longdesc:
Slowly walking through the lighthouse, you wonder if he is actually going
anywhere.  A dull yellow fisherman's cap covers his graying hair.  A long
yellow raincoat, with the same dull color, completely covers his frail
body.  "Damn that Earl, how can I do this upkeep without helpers?", he
mutters and continues to wander around.

name: a rice mill worker
shortdesc: An unhappy worker stands here sorting through good and bad rice.
longdesc:
You can tell she has been doing this for years.  Sorting good rice from
the bad rice.  She is quick and methodical, not missing a single grain.
Clad only in a burlap bag, it is clear they do not pay her well.

name: a sad rice mill worker
shortdesc: A man weeps while carrying around big sack of rice.
longdesc:
You can tell he has been doing this for years.  He drops his baggage,
falls to his knees and starts to cry into his hands.  Getting a swift
kick from the other worker, he picks himself up and continues with his
work.  Clad only in a burlap bag, it is clear they do not pay him well.

name: a rice picker
shortdesc: A cute little rice worker makes her way through the rice fields.
longdesc:
She tilts her head towards you with shy smile as you pass the rice
fields.  Dressed in a simple white shirt and gray capri pants, she 
quickly walks up and down the isles of the field, pulling rice sprouts.

name: The head farmer
shortdesc: The head farmer walks about, making sure everyone is doing their job.
longdesc:
A white sash wrapped around his head, you can tell the head farmer does
not mind getting his hands dirty.  He proudly walks around the farm,
making sure things are running right and everyone is doing their job.
He looks at you uneasily, wondering why you are walking through his
farm.

name: an wild child
shortdesc: A wild looking child runs free throughout the rice field.
longdesc:
Where is this child's mother?  Splashing and playing around in the fields,
he looks like he is having the time of his life.  His parents must run
the farm.

name: the matron mistress
shortdesc: The beautiful matron sits invitingly on her soft looking bed.
longdesc:
The lovely matron mother stares at you longingly from her bed.  Covered
only in a silky, cloud patterend neglige, she playfully rolls over her
gigantic mattress and turns out the light.  What does she have in 
mind?

name: a lovely geisha
shortdesc: A petite geisha innocently giggles from across the room.
longdesc:
Back turned to you, she smilingly looks at you from the mirror of her
make-up stand.  She slowly stands, picking up a fan from a nearby table
and opening it, fans her hair back cutely.  Dressed in a silky red 
button down dress with a golden dragon running up the left hip, she walks
across the room to greet you.

name: a yakuza henchman
shortdesc: A underling of the Shogun is not treating a geisha nicely.
longdesc:
One of the Shogun's henchman is slapping around a local geisha.  Apparently,
the girl did not satisfy his needs.  His armor is almost completely
taken off, he must be in the middle of something.

name: a koto player
shortdesc: A beautiful young lady sits in the corner playing a koto.
longdesc:
She gentley plucks the strings of her koto, almost sending a song directly
to you.  Her melodies rise and fall like the quickening pase of a river.
She pauses and smiles to the passerbys, noticing you have been slightly
hypnotized by her playing.

name: a busy bartender
shortdesc: A busy man stands behind the bar taking drink orders.
longdesc:
A short, jovial looking fellow stands behind the bar taking orders from
all the local farmers.  He is dressed in a white kimono strapped with
a handsome gray sash.  Bowing to you he asks, "A drink for you sir?".

name: a drunk farmer
shortdesc: A farmer rocks in his chair singing along with the koto.
longdesc:
He sure must have had a hard day.  Rocking in his chair, he loudly sings
along the the koto player.  He lifts his drink into the air, giving some
kind of imaginary acknowledgement and goes back to singing.

name: a drunk crying farmer
shortdesc: A farmer whimpers softly and does another shot of saki.
longdesc:
Whimpering loudly and sometimes singing with his friend, this drunk fool
looks quite the sight.  "It's not fair, it's all the Earl's fault!",
he cries as he pours himself another shot of saki. Banzai!

name: an arm wrestler
shortdesc: A burly arm wrestler struggles for his life to win!
longdesc:
A muscular arm wrestler fights for his life on a table against the north
wall.  Sweat pours down his face as he tries to slowly work his way
to victory.  Clinching his teeth and eyeing his opponent with hate, 
he lets out a yell and makes his move.  He doesn't even notice you 
enter the room.

name: a resting yakuza
shortdesc: One of the yakuza lounges lazily on a comfortable couch.
longdesc:
A strong looking bodyguard watches the entertainment from the couch.  
His sword at his side and a drink in his hand, he was obviously not
expecting any company today.  He quickly realizes they are not alone.
Quickly alerting his friends, he grabs his scabbard from the side of
the couch and starts to attack.

name: a sexy dancing woman
shortdesc: A seductive looking woman is performing on stage.
longdesc:
Dancing on a stage to the south of the room, she seductively entices 
the staring onlookers.  You can tell she has their complete attention,
their very whims at her command.  A slight touch of her hip, a gentle
rub of her stomach and the men are drooling at the mouth.

name: an excited yakuza
shortdesc: A man is cheering at all the action going on.
longdesc:
An excited yakuza cheers on all the activity in the room.  He can barely
contain his excitement with so much entertainment.  Is that a new game
starting?

name: a card player
shortdesc: A man is holding a few cards, trying to figure out his next move.
longdesc:
A few drops of sweat have appeared on his forehead.  His eyes dart back
and forth between his opponents.  You can tell he is very hesitant to
make his next move.  He has not even noticed you have entered the room.

name: The master shogun
shortdesc: The master shogun surveys the room from his posh seat.
longdesc:
The master shogun sits in a comfortable looking chair against the east
wall.  You can tell he is the leader of this group by the energy that
seems to pulse around him.  He quickly notices that you have somehow
snuck into his backroom and he is not pleased.

name: a giant mastiff
shortdesc: A huge dog barks loudly, flinging slobber all over.
longdesc:
A giant black mastiff circles around the top of the tower, barking at
you insesantly.  Its loud, room shaking coughs almost make you fall off
the ladder.  He stops, letting out a low, gutteral snarl and leaps to 
attack.

name: the head cook
shortdesc: The head cook folds his arms and barks orders around the room.
longdesc:
The head cook stares at you with disdain as you violate his kitchen.
His crisp white smock glistens with perfection.  A tall white hat sits
squarely on his head.  The hat is so tall it tilts at the end, making
it look like a question mark.

name: a busy cook
shortdesc: A cook of the Earl is busy making a delightful meal.
longdesc:
He is dressed in a sleek white uniform.  He does not even look up to
greet you as you enter the kitchen.  Mixing a variety of ingredients
he quickly molds and shapes food into a delicious looking treat.

name: a cook's apprentice
shortdesc: A man runs around the room obeying the head cook's every order.
longdesc:
Boy does he look tired.  Sweat pouring down his forehead, this pour guy
jumps from station to station, carefully trying to follow the head cook's
demands.  Startled by the barking commands, he quickly stops what he was 
doing and heads to the next station.

name: a crying dishwasher
shortdesc: A man cries by the sink, trying to keep up with the dishes.
longdesc:
Frantically scraping, scrubbing and rinsing the piles and piles of dishes
and pans, the poor man works as fast as he can.  He tries not to listen
to the cruel shouts from the head cook and just buries his head into
his work, weeping quietly.

name: Earl Trakad
shortdesc: A man creeps carefully along the hallway, sweating and shaking.
longdesc:
He hasn't seemed to notice you yet.  The Earl slowly creeps along the
hallway, shaking and sweating profusely.  It looks like he is overcome
with some kind of flu.  He stops and stares at certain paintings, 
letting out a loud cackle.

name: Frust the mad scientist
shortdesc: A man works at a table, mixing herbs and chemicals into a giant cauldron.
longdesc:
Loud and crazy laughter fills your head as you try to look at this
strange little man.  He is dressed in mutiple colors, having no sense
of direction.  A long gray beard flows down his face and continues to
the floor.  He has obviously not left this room in many years.

name: a wargxie
shortdesc: Half warg, half skexie, the wargxie growls at you from its cage.
longdesc:
The body of warg with the face and feathers of skexie, this poor creature
growls at you from the bars of its cage.  His toothy beak tries to bite
and snap at you as you attempt to get a closer look.  Poor thing.

name: a manbearpig
shortdesc: A manbearpig hides in the back of his cage, shivering with fear.
longdesc:
Alone and desperate, the manbearpig soils himself in the back of his
cage. Half man, half bear, half pig and all freak.  You can notice a
small "I <3 AG" pin attached to some of his fur. I wonder what that 
means?

name: a purple speckled lamianoid
shortdesc: A mushroom stump with a funny looking lamia head stares at you.
longdesc:
Why on earth would someone combine a lamia and a myconoid?  Purple and
speckled, it looks like a stumpy easter egg.  How could this do any 
good to anyone?  What is that wretched smell?  Why can you only ask 
yourself questions?

name: the Knight Marshal
shortdesc: The Knight Marshal is working very hard at his desk.
longdesc:
He smiles at you from behind his desk.  Strong and charsimatic, he
looks very formidable as the head of security.  He is dressed in a 
classy blue outfit with a frilly white fringe.

name: Seers the royal handyman
shortdesc: The royal handyman is here messing with some equipment.
longdesc:
Seers is problably the dirtiest man you have ever seen.  The only clean
part appears to be the areas around his eyes.   He is tweaking and
fidgeting with many of the objects that are lying around.  He doesn't
seem to notice that you are even in the room.

name: Zintar the royal mage
shortdesc: The royal mage sizzles with energy and burns with a bright light.
longdesc:
Zintar, the royal mage, does not even open his eyes as you enter the
room.  He begins to mutter some strange words and his clothes ignite
into a burning yellow flame.  His eyes burst open, glowing and pulsing
with power, and trying to burn right through you.

name: a garden beetle
shortdesc: A green and blue beetle crawls across some grass and flies away.
longdesc:
A green and blue garden beetle slowly crawls across the plush green
lawn.  He quickly beats his wings and flies away when he notices you
reaching out to touch him.

name: a butterfly
shortdesc: A pretty butterfly flies lazily from flowerbed to flowerbed.
longdesc:
A pretty, multi-colored butterfly floats through the air.  It lands on
a few flower blossoms, taking little drinks.  It quickly flies away
when it notices you are getting too close.

name: a sleepy warg
shortdesc: A sleepy warg rests peacefully underneath a tree.
longdesc:
Resting peacfully, the cute little warg does not seem to pay you any
attention.  With a big yawn, he rolls over and falls asleep.

name: a gardener
shortdesc: A gardener carefully snips off dead leaves and collects fallen blooms.
longdesc:
A gardener walks through the garden looking for any imperfection in the
landscape.  Noticing a broken limb, he jumps the fence and runs to the
fauna to fix its beautiful face.  Satisfied, he returns to his work.

name: the ghost of King Trakad
shortdesc: The ghost of King Trakad moans silently from his tomb.
longdesc:
Reaching out to touch you from his tomb, the ghost of the once mighty
King Trakad opens his moutch wide to let out a silent scream.  Fountains
of etherial blood sprays from his gaping mouth and all over you.  "My
children!", he gasps, falling to his ghostly knees.  "Have you seen
my children?", he asks as his wide eyes well up and weep ghostly tears
onto the soil.

name: a swarm of bees
shortdesc: A swarm of bees have made their hive inside a rosebush.
longdesc:
It looks like a little city.  The bees have intricately laced their
hive inside a huge rosebush.  It is hard to tell where the bees end
and the rosebush begins.  *slap* Uh oh, by killing one of the bees you
have angered the bees.  The swell into a giant cloud in the air,
preparing to attack

name: a worker bee
shortdesc: A lone bee flys lazily through the air.
longdesc:
A worker bee flys from blossom to blossom collecting pollen.  Dancing
around and making sure to get loaded up, he flys off to the next
location.

name: the Captain of the guards
shortdesc: The Captain of the guards looks around diligently for trouble.
longdesc:
He is clearly one of the toughest of OldPort's military force.  He has
scars all over his face and arms.  "You should NOT be in this part of 
the castle!", echoes the Captain as he notices you walking through the
hall.  "May god have mercy on your soul.", he slowly whispers, drawing
his sword and advancing.

name: an engineer
shortdesc: A man stands against a giant control panel, turning and pushing buttons.
longdesc:
Dressed in a long, white lab coat, the engineer focuses his attention
on the control board before him.  He carefully turns some dials and
pushes a few buttons, turning several lights on and off.  He makes a
couple of notes on his clipboard and continues working.

name: a wandering engineer
shortdesc: An engineer walks along the hallway looking for things to fix.
longdesc:
This engineer is carefully checking every inch of the tower for signs
of damage or fatigue.  He is smiling and whistling as he works, he must
really enjoy his job.  He is dressed in a long, white lab coat and has
an open backpack strapped to his shoulder that must contain his tools.
"Ah ha!", he laughs as he disconnects a section of the light shaft,
tinkers with it and puts it back into place.

name: a wandering scientist
shortdesc: A young woman is making notes on this area of the tower.
longdesc:
Wow is she pretty.  She does not seem to notice that you have entered
the room.  She is dressed in a long, white lab coat with a pair of
black high heels.  Her blonde hair is pulled back into a bun, held 
together with a pencil.  She stares at a section of the light
shaft, studying it intently.  She goes to make a note, but can't seem
to find her pencil.  I wonder where it is?

name: the platform operator
shortdesc: A man ushers you onto the platform, with a nice smile.
longdesc:
Dressed in a nice brown suit, he smiles as you enter the room.  "Please
enter platform, sir.  I will take care of the rest.", he assures,
ushering you onto the platform.

name: Babette the Baker
shortdesc: Babette smiles at you, offering her latest treats.
longdesc:
Babette stands behind a table, kneading a lump of dough into shape.
She leans over the table, revealing a beautiful set of...rolling pins.
She grabs some flour and spreads it all over the table.  Pounding the
lump of dough into the table, she grabs a rolling pin and continues 
with her work.  Wiping some sweat from her forehead, she drops some
flour on her boxom assets and asks, "Can I get anything for you,
cutie?".

name: Mr. Pickle the Grocer
shortdesc: Mr. Pickle rests on some cushions behind the counter.
longdesc:
A plump man, Mr. Pickle rests on a plush pile of cushions behind the
counter.  Though he has some extra pounds, you can tell he is capable
of handling anything around the store.  Comforted to know Gail is doing
her job, he continues to enjoy his comfortable seat.

name: Gail the attendant
shortdesc: A pretty, young girl greets you with a kind smile.
longdesc:
How may I help you?", she confidently asks, as you look around the
store.  She is dressed in a cute brown skirt with a simple red shirt.
A weathered leather girdle slims her waste while revealing a hint
of a blossoming womanhood.  She pinks up as she notices you staring at
her.

name: Margaret the seamstress
shortdesc: Margaret rocks in her chair, tending to her knitting.
longdesc:
Margaret appears to be about one hundred years old.  She sits in a 
rocking chair between two wooden tables.  One of the tables is piled 
with all sorts of armor that needs mending.  She finishes her project
and lays it on the table to her right.  Looking to the table of work 
yet to be finished, she gives out a sigh and grabs the next garment.

name: Henrietta the head seamstress
shortdesc: Henrietta rocks in her chair, gently cutting some fabric.
longdesc:
Did you need some repairs, dears?", asks Henrietta, not stopping what
she is doing to greet you.  "Just give the garment to me, love.  I'll
have it fixed in a snap.", she says, offering out her arm.  She looks
even older than Margaret!

name: Mortimor the salesman
shortdesc:
A well dressed man stands behind the counter, greeting you with a 
smile.
longdesc:
Anything!", he shouts at you as you enter the door.  Noticing your
jump, he interjects, "Anything for your boating needs!".  "I have
low, low prices, just for you today, sir!", he smiles slyly.  He
quickly comes from behind the counter and tries to show you all of his
goods.

name: Kabor the blacksmith
shortdesc: A large and muscular man is pounding metal on an anvil.
longdesc:
Kabor smashes a huge hammer into a long piece of metal on top of a
large black anvil.  Sparks fly across the room as he masterfully works
on the metal and throws it back into the fire.  Wiping his forehead
with a little towel, he looks at you and asks, "What can I get for you?
Or do you just need that repaired?".  "Just give the weapon to me and
I will bang it back into shape.", he reassures, offering out his hand.

name: Captain James
shortdesc: Good old Captain James rests on a stool by the counter.
longdesc:
Good old Captain James.  You still remember back to when you were a 
little child.  It was you, Scarface, Billy and Good old Capitan James
behind the docks. Wait a minute, Good old Captain James wasn't there.
"Hey kid!", he shouts in your face.  "Wake up!", he barks.  "This
isn't some open market!", he states and asks, "Did you want a boat or
what?".  Wow is he impatient.

name: a happy fisherman
shortdesc:
An enthusistic fisherman casts his line off the pier, into the 
water.
longdesc:
He sure does look happy.  The fisherman is talking up a storm with his
friend.  He does a long cast and reels his line back in real quick.  He
continues this process until he has a bite on the line.  Fish dinner
tonite!

name: the ghosts of the Prince and Princess
shortdesc:
The ghosts of the Prince and Princess hold hands in the middle of 
the room.
longdesc:
The ghosts of the Prince and Princess Trakad stand in the middle of the
room, holding hands.  In unison they speak, "Where is our father?  We
have been alone for so long.".  They have multiple stab wounds up and
down their torsos.  They suddenly float towards you, reaching their free
arms for your face.  "So warm, you are SO WARM!", they scream, distorting
their faces into an elongated wraith like quality.

name: a sewer rat
shortdesc: A black rat crawls along the sewer floor.
longdesc:
A small black rat crawls around on the ground.  He is plump and does
not even run away as you walk by.  He twitches his nose cutely and
continues to look around.

name: the west judge
shortdesc: The judge of the west is prisiding over a court hearing.
longdesc:
The judge of the west sits behind his desk, listening to the case before
him.  He has a white, powdered wig on and is wearing a robe in the
green and black OldPort design.  He is rather massive for a man who
sits behind a desk all day.  You better not mess with him.

name: a sad prisoner
shortdesc: A man stands here with his head held low, hands shackled.
longdesc:
This poor man has lost all hope.  His head is hanging low.  He cannot
seem to look the judge straight in the eyes.  He is dressed in sloppy
looking vagrant wear.  His attorney is valiantly pleading his case, but
there is no hope in the prisoner's eyes.

name: a smart lawyer
shortdesc: An intelligent looking man is arguing the prisoner's case.
longdesc:
The lawyer seems to be very passionate about the case he is arguing.  
Dressed in a brown business robe, he discusses each point and counter
point that the judge reviews.  He does not notice that his client does
not seem to have the same faith.

name: the east judge
shortdesc: The judge of the east is working at her desk.
longdesc:
The judge of the east sits behind her desk, going over some files before
her.  She has a white, powdered wig on and is wearing a robe in the
green and black OldPort design.  Cute wire-rimmed glasses rest on her
delicate nose.  She looks very strong for someone who sits behind a 
desk all day.  You better not mess with her.

name: the warrior guildmaster
shortdesc: The warrior guildmaster stands on top of the platform.
longdesc:
The warrior guildmaster stands proud before his disciples.  Raising his
staff with a yell, he performs an intricate series of movements.  His
thrusts and kicks are so fast you are having trouble keeping up.  He
jumps into the air, thrusting his staff into the ground.  The entire
room seems to shake a little.  "Now, begin!", he shouts, staring with
a burning intensity at this students.

name: a warrior disciple
shortdesc: A warrior disciple practices a kata before the platform.
longdesc:
Frantically trying to keep up with his guildmaster, the warrior kicks
and slashes his staff in every direction.  Almost dropping his weapon,
he notices the piercing gaze of his master and gets right back on track.

name: the paladin guildmaster
shortdesc: The paladin guildmaster practices some moves with his sword.
longdesc:
Practicing his moves, the paladin guildmaster shuffles up and down the
length of the room.  His sword thrusts and slashes are very precise and
powerful.  There is no doubt he is indeed a master paladin.  He smiles
at you, offering to do some sparring.

name: the mage guildmaster
shortdesc: The mage guildmaster is instructing his disciples in the ways of magic.
longdesc:
The mage guildmaster stands before a boiling and smoking cauldron in
the middle of the pentagram circle.  He lets out some low chants and
makes a few different hand signs, causing the cauldron to bubble over.
"This is the mage guild.", he says to you, not taking his attention off
his work.  He must be concentrating.

name: a mage disciple
shortdesc: a mage disciple sits indian style, in a circle around the guildmaster.
longdesc:
The mage is sitting at the tip of a point in the pentagram circle.  His
legs are crossed into an indian style position and his hands rest on
his knees, palm up.  He is staring at the guildmaster and chanting along
with him.  He cannot take his eyes off his master.

name: the cleric guildmaster
shortdesc: The cleric guildmaster welcomes you to his guild house.
longdesc:
A holy light seems to shine from within the cleric guildmaster.  His
incandescance lights the entire rooms with a warm glow.  He smiles at
you saying, "The way of the cleric is a tough road, but you look like
you could follow its disciplined path.

name: a gentle cow
shortdesc: A clueless cow stares at you with big innocent eyes.
longdesc:
Brown with white circle shapes on its fur, this cow looks very healthy.
You could feed your family for weeks on the legs alone!  Its eyes grow
big noticing the drool streaming from your mouth.

name: a fluffy sheep
shortdesc:
A large fluff of wool, with four little legs, walks around the 
room.
longdesc:
Two black eyes stare out at you from within the giant fluff ball.  Its
pelt is very clean and healthy.  Someone took very good care of this
animal.

name: Queen Trakad
shortdesc:
Unwashed and disheveled, A tired woman looks up at you from the 
corner.
longdesc:
You have finally found her, the Queen Trakad.  She has barely any weight
to her as you pick her up into your arms.  She tries to lift her arms
to protest, but cannot seem to find the energy.  Someone has visciously
assaulted the Queen.  Her clothes are torn to shreds and a dry trickle
of blood cracks ominiously from the corner of her dry lips.

name: a Lotus Blossom employee
shortdesc: An old woman is suprised at your entrance to the room.
longdesc:
An old woman is looking carefully at the bottles and barrels lined up
along the walls.  She jumps back, startled at your entrance to the room.
There must not be many visitors back here.

name: a card player
shortdesc: A man is holding a few cards, trying to figure out his next move.
longdesc:
A few drops of sweat have appeared on his forehead.  His eyes dart back
and forth between his opponents.  You can tell he is very hesitant
to make his next move, as he hasnt even noticed you've entered the
room.

name: an aged magician
shortdesc: A wise looking aged magician eyes you carefully from behind the wooden table.
longdesc:
Powerful and majestic, the blue robed magician looks down at you from 
atop his wire-rimmed bifocal glasses.  The air around him is crackling 
and popping with magical energy.  He toughtfully strokes his long gray 
and black beard as he anazlyes your person.  Reaching into his robe, he
pulls out an item in his clenched fist and opens up his hand towards 
you.  "This is what you needed, right?", he smiles politely.  Placing 
the item on the long wooden table before you and immediately getting 
back to work he speaks, "Just leave the money on the table, I'm very 
busy.".

name: Jaana the blacksmith
shortdesc: A large and muscular woman is pounding metal on an anvil.
longdesc:
Jaana smashes a huge hammer into a long piece of metal on top of a
large black anvil.  Sparks fly across the room as she masterfully works
on the metal and throws it back into the fire.  Wiping her forehead
with a little towel, she looks at you and says, "I'm new in town but you
probably know my brother Kabor in Oldport.  What can I get for you?
Or do you just need that repaired?".  "Just give the weapon to me and
I will bang it back into shape.", she reassures, offering out her hand.

name: the white wizard
shortdesc: A white robed wizard floats high above the deep hole.
longdesc:
Deep in concentration, a white robed wizard floats about one hundred feet
above the deep, bottomless hole.  The robes flap in the air furiously,
as though the wizard was in the middle of a hurricane.  However, the
air surrounding the mage appears to be in a dead calm.  Without opening
an eye he speaks, "I can let you through, but only for a short time!".
"Go, all of you.... GO!", he barks, thrusting his hands in the air and
screams, "GO!".

name: a wandering orc warrior
shortdesc: An orc warrior marches through the corridor.
longdesc:
An orc warrior, dressed in the armor of his previous victims, marches
through the corridor.  Drool dripping from his mouth, he searches the
hallways for any signs of trouble.

name: an orc warrior
shortdesc: An orc warrior slashes the blue shield with all his might.
longdesc:
Hanging from the ladders, he unsheaths his sword and slashes at the 
glowing blue shield with a grunt.  He shakes his head, grunts something
in orc to his friend and they strike the shield again in unison.  Letting
out another squeal of frustration, he attacks the shield in a flurry of 
attacks.

name: a ghostly shadow
shortdesc: A ghostly shadow slips through the ladders, mimicking reflections.
longdesc:
Pitch black and almost shapeless, the ghostly shadow crawls along the
corridor walls.  It slips in and out of the shadows reflected from the
torches hanging on the ladder like structures.  It quivers and pulsates
when it notices you staring.

name: an elven warrior
shortdesc: An elven warrior shoots some arrows into climbing orcs.
longdesc:
The elven warrior dances and leaps around the cavern, avoiding capture
from the orc assailants.  He slips his legs through a ladder rung, flips
upside down, and quickly knocks his bow and shoots!  He is amazingly
fast and accurate.  With a quick smirk, he rights himself on the ladder
and continues upward.

name: a climbing orc warrior
shortdesc: An orc warrior climbs quickly up the ladders.
longdesc:
Trying his best to avoid the arrows being shot at his head, the orc
warrior swings and jumps from ladder to ladder, in order to avoid 
getting hit.  Drool dripping from his mouth, he squeals up at his 
attacker.

name: the orc leader
shortdesc: A gigantic orc stares at the plans on the wall.
longdesc:
The black orc is massively muscled and takes up most of the cavern.  He
seems to be staring with a confused look at the plans stuck up to the
northen corridor wall.  Scratching his head, he folds his arms and
continues to stare at the plans.

name: a large wandering orc warrior
shortdesc: A large orc warrior marches through the corridor.
longdesc:
An orc warrior, dressed in the armor of his previous victims, marches
through the corridor.  Drool dripping from his mouth, he searches the
hallways for any signs of trouble.  He is rather large and can barely
fit through the corridor.

name: a human warrior
shortdesc: A mighty warrior runs through the hallway, sword in hand.
longdesc:
Dressed in attire suitable for a king, the strong warrior makes his way
along the corridor.  "They must not reach the Shire.", he speaks, "The
white wizard can only hold them for so long.".  Lowering his sword, he 
pleads, "Kill the orcs....Every last one!".  He nods his head and runs 
to the next corridor.

name: a dwarf warrior
shortdesc: A proud dwarf warrior pounds in an orc's head.
longdesc:
I left some for you, almost ready for death!", he boasts.  "I like to
make them wait a while" he grins, "but, you can finish them off.".  "A
warrior's promise!", he says, pounding a clenched fist into his chest.
A long red beard runs down his face and across his magnificent breast
plate.  Clearly the best dwarven mail you have ever seen.

name: a wounded orc warrior
shortdesc: A bloody mess of an orc twitches on the ground.
longdesc:
Yuck!  Some has bashed this poor animals head in.  Wait a minute, it is
an orc.... Kill it!

name: a minor ghostly shadow
shortdesc: A small, ghostly shadow crawls across the wall.
longdesc:
Pitch black and almost shapeless, the ghostly shadow crawls along the
corridor walls.  It slips in and out of the shadows reflected from the
torches hanging on the ladder like structures.  It quivers and pulsates
when it notices you staring.

name: a halfling warrior
shortdesc: A halfling warrior creeps around in the shadows.
longdesc:
The halfling warrior creeps along the corridor walls, trying to stay in
the darkness of the shadows.  I guess he forgot orcs can see in the dark.
Wait a minute, why are there torches in the first place?!  So yeah,
creeping..........  A blue glow starts to pulse around the hilt of his
sheathed sword.  That does not look good.

name: a wounded human
shortdesc: A human body lies moaning on the ground.
longdesc:
Oh my.... He is probably not going to make it.  Better put him out of 
his misery.

name: a construction orc
shortdesc: A large orc warrior makes repairs to the ladders.
longdesc:
An orc warrior, dressed in the armor of his previous victims, marches
through the corridors looking for breaks in the structure.  Awfully
smart for an Orc!  He is huge and could easily smash your head in.

name: a ghostly shadow
shortdesc: A ghostly shadow slips through the ladders, mimicking reflections.
longdesc:
Pitch black and almost shapeless, the ghostly shadow crawls along the corridor
walls.  It slips in and out of the shadows reflected from the torches hanging
on the ladder like structures.  It quivers and pulsates when it notices you 
staring.  A soft glowing medallion appears to be lodged in the shadows neck.

name: The Turkey Farmer
shortdesc: The large farmer is too busy chasing turkeys to notice you.
longdesc:
A well built turkey farmer is here swatting and swearing at turkeys as they
run around his feet and throughout the barn.  He's far too busy to notice
someone of your stature.  He holds a large pitchfork, normally used for hay
and takes a big swing at a fat turkey.

name: A Rampant Turkey
shortdesc: A turkey runs wild through the farm.
longdesc:
Unlike most of the other turkeys throughout the farm, this
particular one has somehow gotten loose.  Maybe a gate
was left open.  The huge bird starts making gobbling noises.

name: A Frightened Turkey
shortdesc: A large turkey flees in terror.
longdesc:
A rather large turkey flees at the sight of the gate opening.
The bird makes gobbling noises and tries to hide in the corner
of its pen.

name: A Large Turkey
shortdesc: A large turkey roams about its pen.
longdesc:
This enourmous bird runs around its pen eating whats
left of the feed and drinking from the small water trough
every now and then.  It flaps its wings uselessly and then
makes gobbling noises.

name: A Fat Turkey
shortdesc: A fat turkey wobbles around looking for food.
longdesc:
This fat turkey looks perfect for a nice Thanksgiving dinner.  It
wobbles about looking for more food and barely notices your
presence.

name: A Fleeing Turkey
shortdesc: A scared turkey runs about gobbling madly.
longdesc:
A rather large turkey gobbles madly as it flees from a crazy old
farmer.  The bird runs about the barn, trying to find a way out.

name: haylok dwarf
shortdesc: Haylok the mystical dwarven salesman is here ready to sell you his wares.
longdesc:
Haylok is an old grey-bearded dwarf, obviously weathered from many years of
travel.  He is particularily well dressed for a dwarf, clothed in the
finest linens of the realms. He offers you a peek inside his cloak
and all you see is a variety of magical goods, each with a tiny
printed label on them.

name: the shopcat
shortdesc: A large tubby black cat watches you warily as you browse.
longdesc:
The large tubby black cat stares back at you with eyes that pierce through 
the boundaries of space and time.  She yawns constantly as if in a state 
of feline catatonic boredom, yet her eyes never leave you.  Around her neck
is a blue collar, from which hangs a small silver tag that simply says 
"shopcat".

name: the travelling baker
shortdesc: A short stocky baker is here, selling breads and pastries.
longdesc:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.

name: the crazy man
shortdesc: A very dirty looking man is here, staring around the room.
longdesc:
This man is obviously off his rocker!  He is making a kicking motion with one
leg and twirling his other in a circle over and over.  Occasionally he makes a 
"Whoop Whoop" noise and looks at you as if you're the crazy one.

name: Byrons personal blacksmith
shortdesc: Byrons personal blacksmith stands here lookin slick
longdesc:
This man is obviously off his rocker!  He is making a kicking motion with one
leg and twirling his other in a circle over and over.  Occasionally he makes a 
"Whoop Whoop" noise and looks at you as if you're the crazy one.

name: the fat toby ghost
shortdesc: The ghost of Toby the Fat is here chewing loudly on a hamster treat.
longdesc: It seems very good at its job.

name: ghost of patches the burned
shortdesc: The ghost of Patches the Burned is here obsessively trying to unlock the secrets held within the trinket he is holding.
longdesc: It seems very good at its job.

name: ghost of teddy the aggressive
shortdesc: The ghost of Teddy the Aggressive grumbles angrily in the corner, his back facing you.
longdesc: It seems very good at its job.

name: a frozen man
shortdesc: A frost covered man stands frozen by the Christmas tree.
longdesc:
This man appears to be in pretty bad shape.  His skin is a frosty blue
colour and an opaque white film covers his eyes.  He is dressed in some
silky pyjamas, ready for a good sleep.  Mr. Meany must have taken over
the town right before bedtime.  The man was frozen with his arm out-
stretched to the tree, trying to place a last minute ornament.  The
film over his eyes begins to glow with a dark red lustre.  He turns to
you and throws the ornament at your head.

name: a frozen child
shortdesc: A young child sleeps peacefully in his bed, frozen stiff.
longdesc:
Resting under a thick, quilted bedding, the young child sleeps like he
does not have a care in the world.  He was obviously tucked in with
care, as you can see finger indents in a fold in the blanket under his
little back.  His eyes open, glowing with a dark red lustre.  He rips
back his covers and jumps off his bed, rearing to attack.

name: a frozen child
shortdesc: A young child sleeps peacefully in her bed, frozen stiff.
longdesc:
Resting under a thick, quilted bedding, the young child sleeps like she
does not have a care in the world.  She was obviously tucked in with
care, as you can see finger indents in a fold in the blanket under her
little back.  Her eyes open, glowing with a dark red lustre.  She grabs
the teddy bear tucked in her arms with her right hand and aims right for
your head.

name: a frozen man reading
shortdesc: A frost covered man sits, reading his paper by the fire, frozen.
longdesc:
This man appears to be in pretty bad shape.  His skin is a frosty blue
colour and an opaque white film covers his eyes.  He is dressed in some
silky pyjamas, ready for a good sleep.  Mr. Meany must have taken over
the town right before bedtime.  The man is sitting in a soft looking,
red backed chair by the fire.  He is holding out a copy of today's paper
and was frozen in mid-read.  The film over his opaque eyes begins to
glow with a deep red lustre.  He crumples up his paper into a club and
rears to attack.

name: a frozen woman
shortdesc: A frost covered woman sits on the couch, sipping tea.
longdesc:
This poor woman is completely covered in frost.  Her skip is a pale blue
and her eyes are glazed over with an opaque white film.  She is dressed
in some simple, pink pyjamas, ready for a good nights rest.  Her right
arm is frozen in mid-air, holding her tea cup up to her face.  Her white
eyes begin to glow with a deep red lustre and she drops her tea cup to
the ground.  She quickly stands up from the couch and walks over towards
you.

name: a frozen woman sleeping
shortdesc: A beautiful woman is sleeping comfortably in her bed.
longdesc:
This poor woman is completely covered in frost.  Her skip is a pale blue
and her eyes are glazed over with an opaque white film.  She is dressed
in some simple, blue pyjamas, sleeping comfortably in her bed.  Her
eyes suddenly start to glow with a deep red lustre.  She throws over
her cover, grabs one of her pillow and rears to attack.

name: Frosty, the snowman
shortdesc: An enraged snowman is pounding into the western wall.
longdesc:
*Whoosh**Smash*  You just miss a head size boulder being thrown at your
head by this snowman.  The snowman has a black top hat on his head, a
button nose, two eyes made out of coal and a corn cob pipe.  The small
pieces of coal making up his mouth and been formed into a frown.  He
is very upset and can only seem to take out his anger on you.  He grabs
another boulder from the ground and drags himself across the ground in
your direction.

name: a wandering snowman
shortdesc: A snowman pulls himself along the ground.
longdesc:
The snowman looks very fierce indeed.  It pulls its oddly shaped body
along the ground, looking for its next victim.  It has a long, multi
colour scarf wrapped around its neck and trailing down its back.  There
is a long carrot stuck in its face where a nose should be and a couple
of buttons are poked in for a mouth and eyes.  It lets out a muffled
scream and drags itself straight towards you!

name: a wandering wolf
shortdesc: A lone wolf wanders through the woods, stalking prey.
longdesc:
A grey wolf quickly runs in and out of the trees of the barren forest.
He is so light on his feet that he is barely leaving any tracks in the
snow.  *Howl*  The wolf lets out a howl, letting you know he can sense
you now also, or is he maybe calling for friends?

name: a flying owl
shortdesc: A brown owl hoots down at you from a near by tree.
longdesc:
*HootHoot*  The cute, brown owl sings to you from a near by tree.  *Hoot
Hoot*  It sings again, moving and turning its head and then flies away.

name: Santa Claus
shortdesc: A jovial, fat man sits behind his desk, reviewing paperwork.
longdesc:
Ho, Ho, Ho", laughs Santa Claus as you walk through the door.  He is
reviewing a nearly endless scroll of names, but continues to address
you.  "Merry Christmas, but we have an important matter at hand.  Mister
Meany has taken over this town with his mind control.  I am too busy to
stop him, but I know you can do it!  Please defeat Mister Meany and free
his small town."  He sighs, marking off a name on his list, "Naughty for
three years!".  "Please read the poster on the wall and try to help my
friend, Rudolf, if you have some time.  I will try to get him after I
get to all the children."  Santa is dressed in a bright red coat with
a long, red hat on his head.  There is a fluffy, white ball hanging
from the tip of the hat.  A long, white beard flows from Santa's face
and down under the table.

name: Mrs. Claus
shortdesc: Mrs. Claus stands behind the huge table, making pies.
longdesc:
Hello, my dears!", smiles Mrs. Claus as you enter her kitchen.  She
continues to work on kneading the dough for more pies.  Ingredients and
supplies magically fly around the room.  The large, steel ovens behind
her open and close, spitting out steaming apple pies.  The apple pies
magically float over to a metal rack to the right of the ovens on the
eastern wall.  Mrs. Claus has a white cloth wrapped around her hair and
is dressed in a simple patterned dress.  "Some cookies dear?", she asks,
slamming her rolling pin into some dough.

name: a worker elf
shortdesc: A cute worker elf does his best to get everything done.
longdesc:
A worker elf is trying his best to get everything done for Santa on time.
He is dressed in a green, button down vest with green tights.  There
are cute little green shoes on his feet, that have a curled tip near the
toes.  He does not stop working as you stare at him, he must have too
much to do.

name: a worker elf small
shortdesc: A smiling worker elf runs around completing projects.
longdesc:
A worker elf is trying his best to get everything done for Santa on time.
He is dressed in a green, button down vest with green tights.  There
are cute little green shoes on his feet, that have a curled tip near the
toes.  He does not stop working as you stare at him, he must have too
much to do.  He finishes up some projects, stands up and puts them in
the shelves on the wall.

name: a wandering worker elf
shortdesc: A smiling worker elf runs around completing projects.
longdesc:
A worker elf is trying his best to get everything done for Santa on time.
He is dressed in a green, button down vest with green tights.  There
are cute little green shoes on his feet, that have a curled tip near the
toes.  He does not stop working as you stare at him, he must have too
much to do.  He walks from room to room, making sure everyone has enough
supplies to do their job.

name: a large reindeer
shortdesc: A large reindeer walks around the garage.
longdesc:
The large, muscular reindeer walks around the garage, waiting for Santa.
He is mostly brown, with clusters of tiny white spots all over his back.
He stomps his foot on the floor, and exhales a huge snort from his
noose.  You must be getting to close.

name: an abominable snowman
shortdesc: A large, yeti like creature walks the mountain path.
longdesc:
The abominable snowman is covered from head to toe in white hair.  It
looks very strong and could probably squash you quite easily.  It stares
down at you with its deep red eyes, trying to intimidate.  Baring its
teeth, a cloud of steam comes out, along with the smell of putrid death.

name: a mountain goat
shortdesc: A mountain goat makes his way along the trail.
longdesc:
A brown mountain goat walks with ease along the slippery mountain
trail.  A long, white goatee sticks out from his chin and he appears
to be chewing something in his mouth.  He looks at your lazily and
continues along the mountain trail.

name: Mr. Meany
shortdesc: Mr. Meany stands atop his machine, shouting orders to his minions.
longdesc:
Mr. Meany has pale blue skin and frosty white lips.  No wonder all the
townsfolk were turned blue, he wanted to make everyone like him!  "You
are never gonna stop me!", he cackles.  Turning to his minions he shouts,
"Kill them... Kill them all!"  Laughing, he turns back to his machine.

name: a tree top
shortdesc: A leafless tree top tries to strangle you to death.
longdesc:
Hundreds of leafless tree limbs fly at you, pummelling you mercilessly.
The barren tree is old, but the branches are very strong.  They are
hard to break without a weapon.

name: The evil elf bunny
shortdesc: The evil elf bunny is here, ready to slay you! Ho! Ho! Ho!
longdesc:
This strange creature has long rabbit ears, a cute button nose and an evil
glint in its eyes. It can only be the evil elf bunny!!! You better ruuuun!

name: a cave bat
shortdesc: A large, brown cave bat flaps its wings.
longdesc:
A large, brown cave bat grasps tightly to the cavern's roof.  Its
wings flap restlesly as you cross its path.

name: A white salamander
shortdesc: A translucent looking creature scurries under a rock.
longdesc:
This slimy looking creature has a pale white appearance.  Its tongue
flicks quickly from its mouth, as it turns and scurries under a rock.

name: a white fish
shortdesc: An oddly white fish swims down the river.
longdesc:
A pale white fish stares blankly at you from the river.  It quickly
swims away as you move closer.

name: The water sprite
shortdesc: A cute water sprite dances beautifully in the water.
longdesc:
The water sprite floats serenly in the water, smiling shyly towards
you.  She is singing the most soothing song you have ever heard.  You
can barely keep your eyes open, as you notice her shy smile turns into 
a grin and she starts swimming towards you.

name: a small fish
shortdesc: A small, colorless fish swims through the water.
longdesc:
A pale, gray fish stares blankly at you from the water.  It quickly
swims away as you move closer.

name: a giant fish
shortdesc: A huge fish stares at you with a hungry look.
longdesc:
A huge gray fish opens its gaping mouth and races across the cavern
floor.  This thing is about the size of a bear, its teeth the length
of knives, its eyes are focused on you.

name: a group of guppies
shortdesc: A small group of guppies dart through the water.
longdesc:
A lovely group of guppies swim quickly through the water.  Some red,
some yellow, they dart quickly around eachother and move on.

name: a tiny huffball puddle
shortdesc: A tiny, black puddle tries to slowly climb the walls.
longdesc:
You see a bit of fur covered slime stuck to the wall.  There are no
eyes, ears or any other appendage that you can see.  It slowly 
contracts its body and makes a move to climb the walls.

name: a huffball
shortdesc: A fist sized huffball sits afixed to the wall.
longdesc:
The black, furry mold has seemed to form into a small huffball.  There
are no eyes, ears or other appendage that you can see.  It rustles its
fur as you stare closer at it.

name: a medium huffball
shortdesc: A huffball, about the size of your head, lets out a low growl.
longdesc:
The black huffballs have grown even larger.  This huffball bears a
nice row of teeth at you, shivering against the wall.  It lets out
a low growl as you climb along the staircase.

name: a large huffball
shortdesc: A large huffball swims ackwardly through the water.
longdesc:
This huffball is about the size of a large dog.  There are fins,
that appear to be forming legs, pushing the huffball through the water.
Tiny claws jut out from its chest, dangling uselessly in the water.

name: a giant huffball
shortdesc: The biggest huffball yet rests lazily in the corner.
longdesc:
Easily the size of a horse, the moss covered huffball rests happily
in the southwest corner of the room.  Fortunately for you, it doesn't
seem very interested in you disturbing dinner time.  It must have
just eaten.

name: a water monster
shortdesc: A scary looking monster blinks its eyes at you from its hiding spot.
longdesc:
You can barely get a good look at this thing with all the teeth
chomping in your face and fins flailing about.  The water monster is
so enraged it heads face first into the wall, knocking bricks onto 
the ground.  It immediately turns and charges at you again, mouth wide,
teeth bared.

name: a giant water monster
shortdesc: A giant monster rises from the ground and attacks!
longdesc:
Cold, blank eyes stare at you from the back of the room. Dust from
the floor of the caverns begins to rise in the water as this huge monster
floats into the middle of the room.  Huge, white teeth jut out from its
closed mouth as he stares right back at you.  This beheamoth is at
least two times your size. Backing out of the cavern, you startle the
water monster and it begins to attack.

name: a medium fish
shortdesc: A good size fish swims quietly through the water.
longdesc:
A good size fish swims through the water before you.  The colors are
non-existant, as it has been out of the sun for too long.  It quickly
swims away as you try to grab it.

name: Seperina
shortdesc: A half fish, half man floats peacefully in the water.
longdesc:
You stand before the mighty Seperina.  The water practically swirls
around him, as though he was in the middle of a whirlpool.  A bright
blue helmet sits atop his head.  A soft looking white cape floats
freely behind the powerful mage's shoulders.  A slender, ruby and
crystal encrusted trident is slung across his back.  His hands begin to glow
with a green luster as he notices you eyeing his prized possessions.

name: a small rat
shortdesc: A small rat scurries across the floor.
longdesc:
A small black rat looks very malnutritioned.  It looks like it hasn't
eaten in weeks.  Its tiny head drops and turns away as it realizes you
aren't a meal.

name: a seagull
shortdesc: A seagull sits atop the posts of the dock.
longdesc:
A white seagull fluffs its wings as you pass.  It folds its wings
back into its side and goes back to sleep, not thinking you are a
threat.

name: a sick dog
shortdesc: An emaciated dog is sniffing a flower.
longdesc:
A sick looking dog is sniffing a lone yellow flower growing from
the ruins of a flower cart.  The dog looks like he has not eaten in
weeks.

name: a vagrant man
shortdesc: A nervous looking man hurries along in the street.
longdesc:
He appears to not want to look you in the eye.  Dressed only in rags,
you doubt he has anyplace to go.  He quickly looks up and darts away,
noticing you are staring at him.  There is a shiny glimmer coming from
his back pocket.

name: a vagrant man
shortdesc: A nervous looking man hurries along in the street.
longdesc:
He appears to not want to look you in the eye.  Dressed only in rags,
you doubt he has anyplace to go.  He quickly looks up and darts away,
noticing you are staring at him.

name: a dog
shortdesc: A dog sniffs through some garbage in the road.
longdesc:
A brown colored dog is picking through some garbage on the street.
It appears it has not eaten in weeks.

name: a lepper
shortdesc: A sickly looking man rests on the ground, wrapped in bandages.
longdesc:
Gross!  The parts of this person not wrapped in bandages are covered
in sores and lesions.  You can't tell if there is a man or woman under
all those bandages and clothes.  It doesn't even move as you poke
it with a stick.

name: a vagrant man bully
shortdesc: A mean looking vagrant is beating up some poor lepper.
longdesc:
He appears to not want to look you in the eye.  Dressed only in rags,
you doubt he has anyplace to go.  He is beating the living soul out of
a poor, unfortunate lepper.  He must want to steal his room.

name: a wounded lepper
shortdesc: A sickly looking man lays wounded on the ground, beaten to a pulp.
longdesc:
Gross!  The parts of this person not wrapped in bandages are covered
in sores and lesions.  You can't tell if there is a man or woman under
all those bandages and clothes.  It doesn't even move as you poke
it with a stick.  This poor bum has been beaten beyond recognition.

name: a man ghost
shortdesc: The foggy mist seems to take the form of a man.
longdesc:
The mist has taken the form of one of the former townspeople.  Dressed
in white and black dinnerwear you can tell this person was on his way
to a fancy meal.  His nose stuck up in the air gives you a hint of his
manners.  The huge gash across his midsection gives you a hint of his
death.  Didn't the townspeople die of plague?

name: a woman ghost
shortdesc: The foggy mist seems to take the form of a woman.
longdesc:
The mist has taken the form of one of the former townspeople.  She
is wearing a pretty, yellow dress and holds a white parasol.  As she
turns and walks right through you, you notice her head has been
severed.  Her head hangs loosely by a piece of gore, her eyes stare
blankly through you.

name: a girl ghost
shortdesc: The mist has taken the form of a small girl.
longdesc:
The ghost of a young girl stands before you.  Her best sunday dress
is drenched in blood.  Her cold, lonely eyes seem to be looking right
through you.  Her arms, cut off at the elbows, reach out for you
wantingly.

name: a monster
shortdesc: The scariest thing you have ever seen creeps out from an empty grave.
longdesc:
A mass of arms and legs slowly crawls out from the emtpy gave.  The
only face you can see is a skinless knob at the shoulders of this
mixed up creature.  A dark hole in the middle of the knob slowly turns
in your direction and starts to pulsate.  A dark, stinky liquid starts
to spurt from the hole, around the room and all over you.

name: the gravekeeper
shortdesc: A large man, with a huge shovel on his back, stands before you.
longdesc:
The gravekeeper is easily as large as two men.  He scowls at you
menacingly, grabbing for the shovel on his back.  His large, dirt
covered hands grasp the shovel tightly, swinging it across the hallway.
"You may NOT disturb these graves!", he shouts.  "I will just bury you
too!", he bellows as he swings his shovel towards your head.

name: an invisible killer
shortdesc: A mad man stares at you from the shadows, licking his knife.
longdesc:
You somehow survive being backstabbed.  The cackling from this man
is so unnerving you begin to lose your step.  Turning and looking into
his eyes, you only see the eyes of a mad man.  Death is the only thing
on this man's mind and he will not stop until he is satisfied.

name: giant rat master
shortdesc: The biggest rat you have ever seen sits smiling at you.
longdesc:
This is the biggest rat you have ever seen.  Its front teeth are
easily the size of your head, its beaty red eyes the size of your fists.

name: a black rat
shortdesc: A small black rat scurries across the floor.
longdesc:
A small black rat looks very malnutritioned.  It looks like it hasn't
eaten in weeks.  Its tiny head drops and turns away as it realizes you
aren't a meal.

name: mage man master
shortdesc: A man stands here talking to his rats.
longdesc:
You have never seen such a dirty individual.  His skin appears to be
caked in sewer mud and rat feces.  He is wrapped in a tattered black
robe.  A scarf of blue silk wraps totally around his neck and drapes
down the center of his back.  Little red eyes appear from every fold
and crevis in his outfit.  This man is totally covered in rats.

name: a redeyed monster
shortdesc: A pair of red eyes stare at you from the darkness.
longdesc:
>From the darkess, a pair of red eyes seems to be staring directly at
you.  As you get adjusted to the room, you can begin to make out its
shape.  This thing covers the entire room, ceiling to floor.  There are
at least four arms and three feet.  Its mouth slowly opens, revealing
several rows of sharp, small teeth.  It is clearly meant for grinding
bones.

name: a hidden serial killer
shortdesc: You see a whip hover up into the air, rearing to attack.
longdesc:
You can barely make out the outline of a man holding the gore drenched
whip. You see right through him, like distortions in the water, the air
ripples around the man before you.  The whip is at least four feet long.
The head splits into a nine-tailed spiked rope, that is still dripping
with the blood and gore from a fresh kill.  The whip rears back with
a snap and flys towards you.

name: a master mage
shortdesc: A man dressed in flowing black robes hovers inches above the floor.
longdesc:
The man before you is covered entirely in flowing black robes.  Power
erupts from the magus so forcefully that his robes rustle and float
around him.  His piercing eyes open and lock onto yours.  He begins to chant
and you find that you are unable to move.  A bright green glow starts
to emit from his hands and he brings them together like he is making
a prayer.  The last thing you see is the smile forming on his mouth.

name: a giant griffin
shortdesc: A proud and mighty griffin snaps its beak at you.
longdesc:
A beautiful griffin stands in the arena before you.  It spreads its
wings and rears onto its hind legs.  Someone has clipped this poor
creature's wings so it cannot escape the arena.  It falls back onto
its front legs and sets into a charge.

name: a strongman man giant
shortdesc: A hooded, overly muscled man stares at you angrily from the corner.
longdesc:
A tiny, tiny head protrudes from a heaping mass of muscles.  His head
is covered with a thin black hood.  His red, bloodshot eyes stare
at you with a look of pure hatred.  His bare chest is criss-crossed
with a leather strap that holds up his britches.  He does not appear
to have a weapon and will probably rip you to pieces with his bare
hands.

name: a centaur beast
shortdesc: A mighty centaur snorts through its nose and charges towards you.
longdesc:
Half man, half beast, the centaur towers above you.  Huge stone
bracelets seem to bolt the beasts arms down.  A huge, golden spear is
strapped to its back.

name: a scary clown
shortdesc: A disturbingly scary clown juggles puppies while dancing on a ball.
longdesc:
A huge cheshire grin glows from the clown's face.  His eyes immediately
connect with yours upon entrance to the room.  He does not faulter a
single step or drop one puppy as you come closer to his performance.
Without missing a beat, he jumps off his ball, grabs some puppy dog
tails and begins to pummel you mercilessly with them.  A maniacal 
cackle lets lose from his fat and sweaty face.

name: Crazed Scientist
shortdesc: A mad-looking man steps out from the shadows with a crazed look in his eyes.
longdesc:
The scientist is dressed in white surgical gowns that are splattered in
gore and blood.  Wet pieces of red matter from a fresh kill still drip 
down his gown as he walks towards you from the back of the room.  A green 
surgical mask covers the man's face.  You can see his lips moving from 
behind the cloth yet no words are coming out.  The eyes above the mask 
are blood-shot red, their pupils are completely dialated.  Their piercing 
glare stares right down at you with utter hatred.  He begins to let 
loose a small giggle as he moves more quickly towards you.  Yanking down 
the chain from the window above, he begins to swing it in a circle above
his head and rears to attack.

name: Ghost Cook
shortdesc: A fat and long dead ghost picks up a pan from the oven top and rears to attack.
longdesc:
The etheral ghost floats in the air in front of the stove lying against
the northern wall of the ship.  He seems to have been the cook of the
ship, as he is still dressed in a cook's smock and chef's hat.  The
ghost cook continues to cook in death as he did in life, terribly.
There is a wretched strench coming from the pots and pans on and in
the stove.  If this did not kill the crew, they were strong sailors
indeed.  Noticing you holding your nose in disgust, the ghost cook seems
to get angered and slowly turns in your direction.  He quickly grabs
a large frying pan from the stove and rears to attack.

name: Mad Alchemist
shortdesc: A crazy looking man in a long white trench coat glares at you menacingly.
longdesc:
The crazed man takes a long, hard look at you from across his long
wooden table.  The alchemist has some thin wire-rimmed glasses across
his pudgy nose.  You can see his blood shot eyes pulsing from behind
them as he stares intently into yours.  The poor man's hair is pure
white and is standing up in clumps and in multiple directions.  It looks
like he has been electrocuted or blown up repeatedly.  His breathing
begins to quicken as he notices you approaching his work table.  This
is probably a good time to run in the other direction.

name: a wandering ghost
shortdesc: A ghostly crewmate wanders the ship in search of his captain.
longdesc:
This poor soul looks very lost.  It sadly wanders up and down the ship,
endlessly searching for its captain.  The creature just wails and cries
as it floats throughout the ship.  Stopping immediately upon sensing you,
it turns abruptly and charges in your direction.  Trespassing is bad!

name: ticket salesman ferry
shortdesc: A cloaked man blocks the entrance to the gangplank.
longdesc:
A scary looking, cloaked man is blocking the way into the ferry.  You 
can't quite get a good look at his face, as it is shaded under his hood. 
If you want to take a risk and go to OldPort, just buy a ticket.  But 
I dont recommend it, I hear theres lots of danger over there!

name: a slime worm
shortdesc: A giant, slimy worm splashes around in the mud and slime.
longdesc:
The Slime Worm slowly rises from the pool of slime and mud.  Its mouth is
full of several rows of strong mandibles, all of them crunching and pulsing
in a very scary manner.  Its body is long, thin and sectioned into
segmented parts.  The worm hisses, spitting slime around the room and
rears to attack.

name: A fearsome grizzly bear
shortdesc: A fearsome looking grizzly bear roars with all his might.
longdesc:
Peeking around some trees, you can see the black grizzly bear picking
through the remains of a recent kill.  His frame is massive, easily
the size of an extra large human.  He licks his chops, slopping up the
last bits of his dinner.  Sniffing in the air, he begins to let out a 
low growl and turns his mighty head in your direction.  You freeze,
shifting some of the underbrush beneath you.  Reacting to the sudden
noise, the bear runs at you with full speed, teeth bared.

name: a cute bear cub
shortdesc: A cute bear cub playfully tumbles around on the ground.
longdesc:
A brown bear cub plays with some pine cones on the ground.  It has cute
litte ears and innocent brown eyes.  It grabs a pine cone in its mouth
and throws it up in the air, only to slap it back down to the ground
with its paws and pounce on it.  How cute.

name: A tropical bird
shortdesc: A multi-colored bird squaks at you from a tree limb.
longdesc:
The bird irritatingly ruffles its feathers at you and lets out a loud
squak.  It has a plump black body with a multi-colored beak.  The colors
run in strips of red, white and orange.  It lets out another loud squak
and flies away to another tree.

name: A white and gray bird
shortdesc: A white and gray colored bird flies through the forest.
longdesc:
A small white bird with brown wings sits picking through some underbrush.
It quickly sticks its beak straight up in the air and reveals that its
searching wasn't for naught.  A plump, pink earthworm dangles out of
its beak.  It gulps down its prize and quickly flies away.

name: A white speckled deer
shortdesc: A brown and white speckled deer nibbles on some leaves.
longdesc:
Long, branched horns stick out from the bucks head.  He has brown fur
with white spots all along his side.  His head shoots up, possibly
noticing your presence.  His strong jaw continues to munch on his lunch
as he looks around for signs of trouble.  Seemingly finding some, he
quickly hops away, deeper into the forest.

name: a wandering crab
shortdesc: A red, horned crab scurries sideways across the beach.
longdesc:
A large crab snaps its claws at you menacingly.  Its body is a red and
pink hued color and the top of its back is covered in rugged looking
horns.  It scurries quickly to the left, walking sideways on its many
legs.  Little air bubbles spit from the mandibles before its mouth.

name: An elven traveller
shortdesc: An elven traveller walks quickly through the forest.
longdesc:
The elf is dressed in a long, green travelling cloak.  He nearly blends
in completely with the forest.  His walking pace is so quick that you 
almost miss him passing by.  You barely notice him putting his bow back
under his cloak and wonder if you missed him pointing it at you!  He must 
not consider you a threat.

name: A orc scout
shortdesc: A large orc is running through the forest.
longdesc:
Making no attempt to conceal his movement through the forest, the large
orc appears to be looking for something.  He is mostly covered in a 
tattered black cloak that must be his attempt at concealing himself.
This scout does not appear to be much of a scout at all.

name: A human ranger
shortdesc: A green cloaked human raises his bow to attack.
longdesc:
Carefully walking through the forest, the human ranger has his bow knocked
and ready for attack.  Without making a sound, he quickly moves in and
out of the trees and underbrush.  He must know this area well.  He is
dressed in a long green cloak that almost makes him disappear within 
the thick forest.

name: a rock creature
shortdesc: A rock creature walks along the cavern hallways.
longdesc:
The rock creature is about six feet tall.  Its expression is vacant as
it wanders along the cavern hallways.  Its black eyes stare straight
foward.  The creature must have somewhere to go.  Its large stone arms
hang to its side.  There are scratches and chips on his huge fists.  They
are clearly meant for breaking rocks.

name: a clay creature
shortdesc: A clay creature carries some rock debris through the cavern.
longdesc:
The clay creature is a reddish-brown color.  It looks like a walking mud
puddle.  Dark black eyes stare out from a melting clay face.  Its skin
seems to be in constant movement.  Ripples form and move in a downward
motion all over its body.  The creature is carrying a load of debris
somewhere.  The debris seems to be broken up rocks.  What could it be
up to?

name: a rock creature
shortdesc: A rock creature stands here, breaking down the cavern walls.
longdesc:
Pummeling his fist into the cavern, the rock creature breaks off pieces
of the wall.  It looks to be about six feet tall and is very muscular.
Well, for a rock creature anyway.  It continues to pound away at the
wall, even with your intrusion to cavern.  In fact, it does not even
seem to notice you at all.  Its only job must be to break through the
walls.

name: a clay guard
shortdesc: A clay guard slithers along the cavern hallways.
longdesc:
A large clay guard slithers along the rocky cavern hallways.  It does
not have any legs or feet, but its lower body seems to creep along the
hallway floor, like a snake.  Its upper body is much more developed than
the other clay creatures you have seen walking along the hallway.  This
creature has huge, muscled arms and a broad chest.  There is a muddy
carapice atop its head, almost like the mud has hardened into a helmet.
Noticing you at last, its arms morph into a giant pick-axe and it starts
to move towards you.

name: a giant flower bulb
shortdesc: A gigantic red and yellow flower bulb grows from the vines.
longdesc:
A red and yellow flower bulb is growing out of a tangle a vines to the
back of the cave.  The petal's tips of the bulb are thorned and red in
