color.  The color turns into a bright yellow about half way down the
bulb, continuing to the stem.  The bulb is about 3 feet long.  It is
gigantic!  The vines around the run start to wiggle and stir as you move
closer to the plant.  Suddenly, the petals start to bloom into a bright
and lovely flower, except for a huge mouth of teeth in the middle.  The
teeth open and close quickly, drooling a greenish fluid onto the cavern
floor.  Gross.

name: a tangled stone creature
shortdesc: A rock creature seems to have tangled itself in the vines.
longdesc:
One of the rock creatures is trapped in a tangle of green vines.  It
continues to struggle in an attempt to break free and get out of this
cavern.  It would probably be screaming for help if it could talk.  Poor
thing.

name: a rock villager
shortdesc: A rock villager sits on a stone against the cavern wall.
longdesc:
A rock villager sits on a large stone, staring into the darkness.  It
does not appear to have anywhere to go, unlike the rest of the creatures
walking around the caverns.  Its eyes look dark and lonely.  It does not
even stir when you wave your fingers annoyingly in front of its face.
Stop that!

name: a rock villager
shortdesc: A rock creature is rocking a baby clay creature to sleep.
longdesc:
The rock creature does not seem to be as large as the other rock types
that you have seen.  It is only about four feet tall.  There is a small
baby clay creature cradled in the rock creature's arms.  The baby seems
to be sleeping peacefully.  The rock creature looks at its baby lovingly
and continues to rock it back and forth.

name: a clay villager
shortdesc: A clay creature is rocking a baby rock creature to sleep.
longdesc:
The clay creature does not seem to be as large as the other clay types
that you have seen.  It is only about three feet tall.  There is a small
baby rock creature cradled in the clay creature's arms.  The baby seems
to be sleeping peacefully.  The clay creature looks at its baby lovingly
and continues to rock it back and forth.

name: a clay baby
shortdesc: A clay baby is sleeping quietly in a rock creatures arms.
longdesc:
The clay baby looks so peaceful sleeping in the rock creatures arms.  A
small spit bubble forms on its mouth and pops.  How cute!

name: a rock baby
shortdesc: A rock baby is sleeping quietly in a rock creatures arms.
longdesc:
The rock baby looks so peaceful sleeping in the clay creatures arms.  A
small spit bubble forms on its mouth and pops.  How cute!

name: a small vine creature
shortdesc: A small vine creature runs along the cavern hallway.
longdesc:
The vine creature appears to be about the size of a small dog.  Its body
is made mostly of vines and its feet are some brown roots.  The vine
creatures behavior is even reminiscent of a canine.  It appears to be
playful and love to run around after the rock and clay children.  It
walks up to your boots, takes a sniff and takes off into another cavern.

name: a large vine creature
shortdesc: A large vine creature sniffs a pile of rock debris.
longdesc:
The large vine creature seems to look like the bears in the Oldport
forest.  Its body is made up mostly of green vines and there are large
brown roots for legs and feet.  It starts to charge at you when it
notices you staring at it.  Didn't your mother teach you not to stare?
Its mouth opens wide in a silent roar.  The vine creaures black eyes
stare right at you.  It rears onto its vine legs and swipes it root
paw at you.

name: An abnormal creature
shortdesc: An abnormal looking creature tries to hide in the corner.
longdesc:
A sad looking creature cowers against the side of the cave.  You would
not have been able to find it if it weren't for the creature's constant 
shivering.  It seems to be an amalgam of the cavern creatures.  There 
are rock, clay and vine features.  Vine whips flail at the end of the 
creatures rock arms.  Its body is mostly rock, but there are clay and
vines interlaced throughout.  A sad, clay face stares are you from the
darkness, but quickly throws its hands over its face.

name: a rock shopkeeper
shortdesc: A rock creature stands behind the counter, handing out goods.
longdesc:
The rock storekeeper is about average size for a rock creature.  It
stands behind a large stone counter.  The counter runs the length of
the rock cavern.  The storekeeper reaches underneath the counter and
pulls out two bottles and a rock cake.  It hands the goods to some
customers at the counter and gives a little smile.  The shopkeeper
starts to stare at you uncomfortably.  It must be waiting for you to
order something.

name: a clay shopkeeper
shortdesc: The clay shopkeeper stands behind the counter, helping customers.
longdesc:
The clay storekeeper is about average size for a clay creature.  It
stands behind a large stone counter.  The counter runs the length of
the rock cavern.  The storekeeper reaches underneath the counter and
pulls out two bottles and a mud cake.  It hands the goods to some
customers at the counter and gives a little smile.  The shopkeeper
starts to stare at you uncomfortably.  It must be waiting for you to
order something.

name: a vine shopkeeper
shortdesc: A human shaped vine creature stands behind the counter.
longdesc:
The storekeeper is about size of an adult human, maybe six feet.  He is
made up entirely of green vines and brown roots.  His arms and hands are
mostly root but are interlaced with the bright green vines.  Almost as
though the vines were moving the roots.  It stands behind a large stone 
counter.  The counter runs the length of the rock cavern.  The storekeeper 
reaches underneath the counter and pulls out two steaming cups of tea and 
an herbal muffin.  Mmmm... herbal muffin......  It hands the goods to some
customers at the counter and gives a little smile.  The shopkeeper starts 
to stare at you uncomfortably.  It must be waiting for you to order 
something.

name: a small vine creature
shortdesc: A small vine creature runs and plays around the pen.
longdesc:
The vine creature appears to be about the size of a small dog.  Its body
is made mostly of vines and its feet are some brown roots.  The vine
creatures behavior is even reminiscent of a canine.  It appears to be
playful and loves to run around after its brothers and sisters.  It
walks up to your boots, takes a sniff and takes off to another part of
the pen.

name: a clay caretaker
shortdesc: A clay creature is watching over and playing with the puppies.
longdesc:
The clay creature does not seem to be as large as the other clay types
that you have seen.  It is only about three feet tall.  The creature is
walking around the vine pen, taking care of the vine creatures.  It
starts playing with some of the vine creatures as they jump up and tackle
it for attention.  What a tuff job.

name: a rock baby
shortdesc: A rock baby is running rampant around the nursery.
longdesc:
The baby would be cute if it wasn't for its rampage around the nursery.
It runs around on its tiny legs with its arms raised staight above its
head.  The baby waives its arms back and forth and kicks toys across
the cavern.  It kicks a rubber duck across the room and nails the clay
caretaker in the face.  Ouch!

name: a clay baby
shortdesc: A clay baby is causing a ruckus in the nursery.
longdesc:
The clay baby crawls along the cavern ceiling.  It looks like a cute
moving bowl of jello.  There is a wide smile across the baby's face as
it slithers across the ceiling.  It takes a deep breath and spits a
ball of mud at the clay caretaker.  These babies are out of control!

name: a clay caretaker
shortdesc: A clay creature is trying to put the babies back in their cribs.
longdesc:
The clay creature does not seem to be as large as the other clay types
that you have seen.  It is only about three feet tall.  There are clay
are rock babies hanging all over this poor creature.  The caretaker
doesn't seem to notice as it continues to attempt to put the babies 
back in the cribs.  The creature gently pulls a baby off itself, rocks
it to sleep and lays it down in the crip.  The sleeping babies look so
happy.

name: a rock and clay dancers
shortdesc: A rock and clay creature dances around the throne room.
longdesc:
They are dancing very beautifully.  The creatures move in perfect time
to the music flowing through the cavern.  The creatures appear to be
having the time of their lives.  They would probably be laughing if
they could talk.

name: two rock dancers
shortdesc: Two rock creatures dance around the throne room.
longdesc:
They are dancing very beautifully.  The creatures move in perfect time
to the music flowing through the cavern.  The creatures appear to be
having the time of their lives.  They would probably be laughing if
they could talk.

name: two clay dancers
shortdesc: Two clay creatures dance around the throne room.
longdesc:
They are dancing very beautifully.  The creatures move in perfect time
to the music flowing through the cavern.  The creatures appear to be
having the time of their lives.  They would probably be laughing if
they could talk.

name: a rock musician
shortdesc: A rock creature dances around the party, playing a violin.
longdesc:
The rock creature is playing a lovely wooden violin.  However, when the
creature moves its bow over the strings of the violin, an entire 
orchestra of music comes out.  There must be magic at work!  The rock
musician gracefully dances around the many groups of creatures at the
party, careful not to bump into anyone.  It is very skillful at its job.

name: the mountain king
shortdesc: The mountain king sits atop his throne, looking out over the party.
longdesc:
A thin looking human is sitting upon the rocky throne before you.  He
is dressed in simple black attire with a black cloak.  He sits straight
up on his throne with his black against the seat.  His eyes stare right
through you and over the crowd of creatures.  He seems to be muttering
something.  Suddenly, his eyes look to the up and to the west.  A cold
sweat breaks out over his face and he returns to looking over the crowd.
His mouth begins to move again.  The words don't appear to make any
coherent setences.

name: an evil mage
shortdesc: A black robed figure is whispering in the King's ear.
longdesc:
Standing behind the throne, invisible and hiding, the black robed mage
whispers into the King's ear.  He appears to be very skinny and frail.
His black robe hangs loosely over his body, revealing a skeletal figure.
The mage's eyes lock onto yours, but he does not stop whispering into
the King's ear.  His lips being to move faster and faster.  He appears
to be chanting an incantation.

name: a rock soldier
shortdesc: The rock soldier makes his way through the party, towards you.
longdesc:
This is the largest rock soldier yet.  It is easily eight feet tall and
looks like it could pound you to a pulp.  The giant rock creature carries
a spear nearly as tall as it is.  It does not give you a friendly look
as it inches closer and closer to your position.  It whips the spear
down and prepares to attack.

name: a rock soldier
shortdesc: A strong rock soldier stands watch against the wall.
longdesc:
This is the largest rock soldier yet.  It is easily eight feet tall and
looks like it could pound you to a pulp.  It carres a long stone spear
as long as it is tall.  It eyes you suspiciously from the side of the
room.  Better not get in its way.

name: a clay youth
shortdesc: A young clay creature runs through the hallways.
longdesc:
The young looking clay creature is about two feet tall.  It is 
running along the cavern hallways causing all sorts of mischief.
It walks over to a small vine creature, gives it a quick kick 
and runs off, how rude!

name: a rock youth
shortdesc: A young rock creature runs through the hallways.
longdesc:
The young rock creature is about four feet tall.  It towers over
the young clay creatures you have seen.  The rock youth look very 
strong for its size, and appears to be able to handle its own.

name: a huge mosquito
shortdesc: A large mosquito lands on your arm and starts to suck your blood.
longdesc:
Ouch!  Slapping your arm, the bloody and black remains of a mosquito are
left smeared there.  Its body is about the size of a gold coin!  These
suckers are huge.  Better watch out, they are swarming.

name: a beautiful butterfly
shortdesc: A beautiful butterfly flutters lazily from flower to flower.
longdesc:
The butterfly has colorful patterns on its wings that resemble a large
eye.  When the butterfly's wings are outstretched it looks like someone
is starting straight at you.  It flutters away as it senses you have
gotten too close.

name: a large walking stick
shortdesc: A large walking stick is engaged in a fight to the death.
longdesc:
The walking stick is about a foot long.  It is fighting for its life
against another large walking stick.  Their stick hands make a quick
barrage of clicking sounds as they spar against each other.  It gets
the upper hand by chopping of its friend's leg and going in for the
kill.  Geez, these things do not play around.

name: a baby walking stick
shortdesc: A newborn walking stick walks around the hatchery.
longdesc:
These walking sticks are so cute!  As they hatch from their eggs, they
shake the goo off their stick like bodies and immediately start to run
around.  You can see some babies eating leaves, some of the babies are
sleeping and a few of the babies are already fighting!  These creatures
sure are from some hearty stock.

name: a walking stick
shortdesc: A walking stick clicks its hands together loudly at you.
longdesc:
A walking stick is roaming around the hatchery, helping the newborn
babies along.  It helps them break out of their eggs and also helps
break up some fights.  These creatures are always fighting.  Sensing 
your presence, the walking stick runs up to you angrily, clicking its
arms at you loudly.  It must be trying to defend the babies.

name: an old walking stick
shortdesc: An elderly walking stick tries to start a fight in the trees.
longdesc:
An old walking stick fights with a friend in the tree.  You can tell
these sticks are old due to the heavy amount of scars all over their
bodies.  It feebly tries to swipe its stick arm at the other walking
stick but slips and falls into the mud.  What silly creatures.

name: a water strider
shortdesc: A cute little water strider glides across the water.
longdesc:
The cute little bug skips and glides across the pond water.  It looks
so innocent, playfully dancing around like an ice skater.  The water
striders wings beat non-stop.  They seem to propel the insect across
the pond.

name: a dragonfly
shortdesc: A red and green dragonfly quickly buzzes after mosquitos.
longdesc:
The dragonfly buzzes around the air, chasing after mosquitos.  It has
a bright red upper body with a green tail.  Its little wings beat
wildly through the air as it manuevers around the swamp.  The dragonfly
doesn't seem to be very helpful with controlling the mosquito population.
It really needs to eat much faster.

name: a giant frog
shortdesc: A giant green frog swims through the swampy water.
longdesc:
A large bubble floats from the frogs mouth as it croaks at you from the
bottom of the murky marsh.  The frog as rather large, as frogs go.  It
is probably the size of a bear.  It uses its powerful legs to jump off
the swamp floor and begins to swim all around the pound.  The giant
frog is extremely graceful as it dances through the murky water.

name: a large python
shortdesc: A large python hangs from the mossy tree, eyeing you hungrily.
longdesc:
It was hard to see the gigantic python at first.  Its long and sleek body
seems to meld into the mossy tree it nests in.  However, you can now
seem the snake slithering in and out of the branches in the tree above
you.  Its head suddenly drops down from the tree, mouth wide in a fear-
some hiss.  Venom slowly drips down its teeth and into your clothes.  The
liquid starts to burn through leaving a huge hole.  How rude!  Its red 
eyes stare at you with a deep and hungry gaze.  The center of its eyes 
seem to be spinning, almost as if it was hypnotizing you.

name: an ancient beetle
shortdesc: An ancient looking beetle sleeps atop a comfy padded bed.
longdesc:
The beetle is a brownish color and has beautiful, shining wings covering
its back.  The ancient beetle is in a deep sleep atop and comfy padded
bed.  It seems that this beetle is someone of importance.  It glitters
with the same iridescence as the other beetles as the sun reflects off
its shell.

name: a large beetle
shortdesc: A large iridescent beetle climbs all over the log.
longdesc:
The shine off the beetles shell is almost blinding.  It is very hard
to maneuver around the beetles home when you cannot even see what lies
ahead of you.  It flutters its wings quickly as you are about to step
on one of the smaller beetles.  Better watch where you are going.

name: a small beetle
shortdesc: A small iridescent beetle twinkles in the sunlight.
longdesc:
The small beetles are difficult not to step on.  They scurry around the
floor of the log without regard to where you are going.  They do not
seem to glitter as much as the large beetles, regardless of how much
sun light shines on them.

name: an army ant
shortdesc: A red army ant walks in single file along a tree branch.
longdesc:
Walking in the single file line, the red army ants seem to be very busy.
They are all doing their duties, wether it is carrying food to or from
their nest.  Ouch!  You better not get to close because they sure do
like to bite.

name: a queen ant
shortdesc: A large queen ant rests on a small hill, chewing on leaves.
longdesc:
The crimson red queen ant does not appear to have any worries in the 
world.  She sits atop a tiny dirt hill, surrounded by her army ants and
chews on some delicate green leaves.  The army ants continually march
up and down the hill bringing the queen ant her food.  That is one
lucky ant!

name: a fierce lion
shortdesc: A fierce lion bursts through the brush and charges towards you.
longdesc:
A rustling in the bramble underbrush produces a massive and fierce
looking lion.  It roars, sending the wildlife in the surrounding areas
running.  The lion quickly takes control of the situation, starting to
circle around the room, looking for a clean shot.  It roars again and
leaps into the air to attack.

name: a black crow
shortdesc: A jet black crow circles high in the air.
longdesc:
The crow circles from far above the river.  It is almost as though it
is waiting for some carcasses to be left around.  What do they know
that you do not?  The crows are pitch-black and have large feathery
wings.

name: a female deer
shortdesc: A brown and white speckled deer drinks from the river.
longdesc:
The doe gently laps up some sparkling water from the passing stream.
There is a small fawn benath the doe, hiding between her legs.  The doe
carefully nudges the fawn towards the stream to take a drink, but the
animal is reluctant to leave its mother's side.  How cute.  Sensing
some movement, the doe's head shoots straight up, listening for any
signs of trouble.  Not finding any, she goes back to drinking from the
river.

name: a small fawn
shortdesc: A small brown fawn hides between its mother's legs.
longdesc:
The gentle fawn looks like it is ready to fall down at any time.  It is
possible it was recently born and has not had time to get steady on its
hooves.  The fawn is brown and has a large variety of white speckled 
spots covering its side and under-carriage.  It seems very reluctant
to leave its mother's side.  Maybe it senses danger near by?

name: a large stag
shortdesc: A large brown stag with mighty horns watchs out for trouble.
longdesc:
The large stag is tall and very strong looking.  He carefully watches
out over his pack, looking for any signs of trouble.  The stag's horns
are huge and covered in a mossy fur.  The stag is a solid brown color 
with no white patches to be seen.

name: a sleeping bear
shortdesc: A large brown bear has fallen fast asleep in the blueberry patch.
longdesc:
It looks so cute sleeping in the thick blueberry patch.  Its blueberry
stained paws swipe at the air, like it is attacking something in its
sleep.  Awwww, how cute.  Its fur is a matted brown and you can see
fleas jumping all over the poor creature.  The bear lets out a mighty
yawn and scratches its side with its huge paw.  *SNAP*  You seemed
to have stepped on a thick briar branch and woken up the bear.  Better
run.

name: a swarm of hornets
shortdesc: A nasty looking hive of hornets is built into the tree.
longdesc:
A cloud of scary looking hornets seems to be swarming around a large
tree in the thicket.  They fly in and out of the tree going about their
business.  This must be a huge nest.  *Ouch*  One of the hornets stings
you.  *OuchOuch*  They start to swarm above your head and all over you.
This is not the time to be standing around!

name: a field mouse
shortdesc: A small field mouse scurries out of the brush and over your feet.
longdesc:
The thick underbrush seperates and a cute field mouse runs out.  Its
nose twitches back and forth as it looks you over carefully.  The mouse
must not assess you are a threat as it runs over your boots and into 
another thick patch of underbrush.

name: a construction lizard
shortdesc: A well built lizard is hauling timber along the trail.
longdesc:
The lizard stands about five feet tall.  It has a long tail that wags
lazily behind it.  The lizard is well muscled so this kind of work must
be its only job.  It carries two thick tree trunks along the trail,
waiting to be told where to put them.  It stares impatiently at the
chubby lizard and shouts something in their language.  It was probably
not very friendly.

name: a construction lizard
shortdesc: A large and muscular lizard carries a huge load of stones.
longdesc:
Wow, this lizard is big.  Standing at least six feet tall, it seems to
be the largest of its race that you have seen to far.  The lizard's huge
arms are hauling a substantial load of round, stone plates.  The plates
look to be several hundred pounds.  The lizard's green face does not
show the slightest sign of fatigue.  It patiently waits for the chubby
lizard to give some orders.

name: a construction lizard
shortdesc: A chubby lizard is barking some orders at the workers.
longdesc:
Standing to the side of the muddy swamp path, the chubby lizard looks
over a piece of parchment.  He looks at the paper in a strange manner
and scratches his head.  One of his workers shouts at him in their
tongue and the manager barks back to him, almost violently.  Turning
to you the lizard says, "Sorry travellers, we will have construction
to the path done shortly."  He smiles, "Please pass on by.

name: a green frog
shortdesc: A small green frog croaks at you from the swamp floor.
longdesc:
The frog cocks its little head sideways and blinks its round eyes to
you innocently.  It flicks its long tongue out to catch a mosquito and
gulps it down happily.  *ribbit**ribbit*

name: a mad hermit
shortdesc: A strange old reptile lays crying on the floor.
longdesc:
You stare at the man and he looks at you and says, "I was once a great 
mage.  I could cast spells you could never attempt.  I should not be hiding 
in disgrace like this.  Help me please."  He grabs your shirt to keep you 
here, but you shrug him off easily.  Madmen can be so distasteful at times.

name: a bridge guard
shortdesc: Crouched and ready to pounce, a large lizard balances on the bridge rail.
longdesc:
A long, dark-green cloak covers the lizards face and upper torso.  You
can feel the lizard is staring straight at you.  "What is your business
here.", it speaks calmly.  "Evil ones..... are not welcome here.", it
says, lifting its arm to remove the cloak from in front of its face.  A
large scar runs down the the middle of the lizard's right eye.  A long
smile runs across its face as it sees you step back.  Moving its hand to
the hilt of its dagger it sneers, "Go back to where you come from before
I have to kill you.".

name: a lizard fisherman
shortdesc: A lizard creature fishes off the side of the rowboat.
longdesc:
The lizard throws a net off the side of the boat and lets it sink into
the mirky waters.  He waits a couple minutes and hauls up the net with
all his might.  The net is full of bony, black fish the wiggle in an
attempt to get free.  He dumps the net into his boat and continues the
process.

name: a lizard fisherman
shortdesc: A lizard creature throws a net into the deep section of the lake.
longdesc:
The lizard barks at you to stop disturbing the water.  At least thats
what it is probably saying since it is speaking in its own tongue.  It
hauls a large net with a long cord attached into the air and swings it
in a circle above its head.  The lizard tosses the net into the deep
part of the lake and calmly waits.  Jerking the net back after a few
minutes, it takes the fish it caught out of the net and throws them
into a bucket.

name: a tour guide
shortdesc: A lizard with a red scarf is talking to the crowd of people.
longdesc:
The lizard stands confidently before the crowd of people.  It smiles and 
says, "We are about to leave for the Swamp Birds of Amnos Tour!".  It
coughs politely into its fist saying, "Please be sure to listen carefully.
If you journey too far from the tour group you could be lost.  I assure
you.  There are parts of this swamp even I do not like to go to.".  It
smiles again and laughs, "So are we ready?".  "Please take out your
Swamp Birds card and check off all the birds you see!", the lizard
turns to the north and heads into the swamps.

name: a human camper
shortdesc: A human male is setting up a large red tent.
longdesc:
The human appears to be about thirty years old.  He is on his knees,
spreading out the tent supplies and setting up to camp.  "What?!", he
shouts at his wife angrily, "Don't you want a nice place to sleep?".
He goes back to doing his work, totally oblivious to the fact that the
tour is about to start.

name: a human camper
shortdesc: A female human dressed in camping gear is listening to the tour guide.
longdesc:
She keeps looking from her husband, to the tour guide, to her husband to
the tour guide.  You can tell that she is trying to listen carefully to
what the tour guide is saying.  "Hal", she whispers.  "HAL", she shouts
to the man setting up the tent.  "We are about to leave.  I don't want
to leave our stuff here.  For the last time, please stop setting up the
tent.".  Frustrated, she returns to listening to the tour guide.

name: an annoyed camper
shortdesc: A red faced human stands arms crossed listening to the tour guide.
longdesc:
Steam is practically pouring out this pour man's ears.  His arms are
crossed across his chest and his face has turned beat red.  "This is
the last time Helen.", he says teeth clenched to the whining woman.
"I am not wasting another vacation like this.", he mutters under his
breath, returning to listening to the tour guide.

name: a whining camper
shortdesc: A human female is talking and whining over the tour guide's instructions.
longdesc:
Does it have to be this hot out here?", the woman whines to her husband.
She shouts, "Hey, tour guide lizard.  Yeah, you.  Is there a local inn
or something around here?".  She jumps back and slaps a mosquito off her
wrist, screaming bloody murder.  "HaaaaaaaaAAAAAAAAROLD!", she screams.
"I wanna go home!".

name: a whining child
shortdesc: A human child is pulling at his mother's shorts, balling his eyes out and screaming.
longdesc:
Snot is dripping from his nose and a river of tears is pouring from this
poor child's face.  He is holding a well-worn teddy bear beneath is right
arm and tugging at his mother's shorts with his left hand.  The child
notices you looking at him and grinds his face into his mother's leg.

name: a lizard shopkeeper
shortdesc: A old hunched over lizard stands behind the counter.
longdesc:
The lizard looks to be very old.  There is a white goatee growing from
the shopkeeper's chin.  It carefully goes towards the entrance of the
tent and shouts, "Go away, I'm closed to the likes of you!".  Waving
you over it whispers, "I have to say that, it scares off the tourists.".
The old lizard smiles and strokes its goatee with its hand.  "Please,
I can tell you are a hearty adventurer.", it says quickly, walking back
behind the counter.  "What can I do for you?  Anything on the shelves
is for sale today.  10% off since you look so strong!", it states,
looking at you with a careful smile.

name: the head tour guide
shortdesc: A lovely looking lizard looks up from her paperwork.
longdesc:
It is obvious now that there are male and female lizards.  This lizard
is very lovely and has a purple sash wrapped around its neck.  It blinks
a few times and says, "We have a few tour packages available today!
There is the very popular bayou tour, the hot springs tour and the swamp
bird tour.".  It smiles, continuing to go about its paperwork.  "Please,
let me know when you have come to a decision.

name: a mad fairy
shortdesc: A mad little fairy flys around freezing all the plants.
longdesc:
The fairy is awfully tiny for the amount of chaos it is creating.  The
little creature flys all around the brush freezing everything it can.
The poor creature screams in frustration as her efforts are for naught.
The plants that she is freezing seem to defrost a few seconds after
she freezes them.  So much for fairy power.

name: a tour guide
shortdesc: A red scarved lizard tries to calm down a lost camper.
longdesc:
The tour guide is trying its hardest to bring the camper to his scenses.
It trys to talk to him, it pours some cold water on his head and finally
slaps him across the face!  Now that is some tour guide training.  "Sir,
SIR!", it shouts, "Please remain calm and follow me back to the camp
site.  We can find some help for you there.".

name: a lost camper
shortdesc: A cold and shivering camper looks completely lost.
longdesc:
This poor gentleman is covered in frost.  Little icicles hang from his 
hair.  His arms are clasped across his chest and you swear you can hear
his knees knocking together.  "It's...  it's...  it's true!", he screams
out suddenly, "There is a fairy in the brush.  Don't go any further."  
His face starts to turn from a pinkish color to a pale blue.  The man's
eyes roll back into his head and he falls limp to the ground.

name: a confused camper
shortdesc: A confused looking camper stumbles around the brush.
longdesc:
A few days growth sprouts from the man's face.  His clothes are worn
and torn, as though they have not been changed in a week.  A wild look
is in the man's eyes.  "I'm going to find the fairy.", he whispers.
"It's only been a week,", he laughs, "I just need a little more time.
A little more time.  A little more time.".  He laughs somemore and
starts to run around the room.

name: a damselfly
shortdesc: A navy blue damselfly clings lazily to the cattails.
longdesc:
How strange that the damselfly isn't buzzing around.  It just calmly
rests on a cattail, as if waiting for something.  Its wings beat softly
as it takes off and flys away.  You must have gotten too close.

name: vach the mouse
shortdesc: A small mouse takes off his black top hat and bows to you.
longdesc:
My name is Vach.", the little mouse states very clearly as he stands
up in its canoe and takes a small bow.  He continues, "I was once a
mighty wizard!".  He stops and stares down at his feet.  "The lizard
creatures showed me the error of my ways.", he smiles and goes back to
his rowing.

name: a giant pike
shortdesc: A giant pike trashes about in murky swamp water with another pike.
longdesc:
The giant fish appears to be about four feet long.  Its skin seens to
be a greenish color with black spots all over.  The pike fights for its
life against another giant pike or could they possibly be mating?  It
is mating season after all.  Wow, that would certainly not be a fun way
to continue to species.

name: a pickerel
shortdesc: A small pickerel hides behind the weeds.
longdesc:
The pickerel's skin is almost translucent at this point in its life.  
The sun shining down from above seems to go right through the small 
fish.  The young pike is about eight inches and is almost hidden 
completely within the green weeds.  You would never have found it if
it wasn't for the sun reflecting off its scales.

name: a small goldfish
shortdesc: A small goldfish swims swiftly through the murky water.
longdesc:
The small goldfish swims around as though it does not have a care in
the world.  It swims around its school mates, playing in their little
games.  What fun!

name: a large muskie
shortdesc: A large muskie tries unsuccefully to hide in the weeds.
longdesc:
The large pike thinks it is very clever, hiding behind a large clump
of weeds.  It does not realize that half of its body is sticking out
for the world to see.  The bright sun shining down from above shines
brightly off the muskie's brilliant white and sharp teeth.  Very scary.

name: a small pickerel
shortdesc: A small pickerel makes its way through the swampy water.
longdesc:
The pickerel's skin is almost translucent at this point in its life.  
The sun shining down from above seems to go right through the small 
fish.  The young pike is about eight inches.  It tries valiantly to make
its way through the water.  You would probably never have found it if
it was hiding on the bottom of the lake.

name: a small goldfish
shortdesc: A little goldfish seems to have wandered away from its school.
longdesc:
The goldfish looks very odd swimming all alone in the water.  Its little
tail and fins flap as fast and hard as they can to propoel the goldfish
through the swampy water.  Where in Oldport is it going?

name: a black mussel
shortdesc: A black mussel sticks out from the sandy lake bottom.
longdesc:
A tiny stream of bubbles is released from the mussel's shell.  The shell
is completely black which offsets it nicely from the dusty-gray sand.  A
whitish-pink tongue slowly creeps out of the shell and the mussel digs 
itself back into the deep sand.

name: a black cormorant
shortdesc: A black cormorant sits on a tree limb drying off its wings.
longdesc:
The cormorants have no oil on their feathers so they must dry them after 
swimming in the water.  They stretch their wings out wide to catch the 
most sun as possible.  They are shiney black and have small feather tufts
on the tops of their heads.

name: a swamp sparrow
shortdesc: An angry swamp sparrow does an intricate dive bomb at your head.
longdesc:
The swamp sparrow is a dull blue color with black speckles on its under
belly.  It carefully sits on top of a nest high in the trees.  The
sparrow squaks at you as you get too close to its tree.  It stands up
and dive bombs your head to give you another reminder.

name: a yellow-crowned night heron
shortdesc: A yellow-crowned night heron walks through the swamp land.
longdesc:
The yellow-crowned night heron is a very beautiful creature.  It walks
through the swamp in an almost majestic manner.  There is a cute yellow
ploom of feathers growing from its cheaks to the back of its head.  It
ruffles its feathers to show you how brilliants its colors are.  What
a stuck up bird!

name: an anhinga
shortdesc: An anhinga's head quickly zips through the swamp water.
longdesc:
The Anhinga is a graceful bird with with a long thin neck.  Most of the
bird is submerged in the water.  Just its neck sticks out.  It blinks
at you quickly and dives back into the water.

name: a cory's least bittern
shortdesc: A Cory's Least Bittern runs quickly through the reeds.
longdesc:
What a rare find!  It is the elusive Cory's Least Bittern.  The bird is
brown colored and has two white lines running from the bottom of its
beak to the bottom of its underbelly.  It quickly freezes when it senses
you are staring at it.

name: a snowy-white egret
shortdesc: A snowy-white egret is walking on the swamp floor.
longdesc:
You see a small white heron that has a narrow black bill.  It must be 
the breeding season for it because it has beautiful plumes all along 
its back.  It ruffles its feathers and continues walking along the
swamp floor.

name: a mother duck
shortdesc: A yellow-billed duck quacks at you while it stands on an old log.
longdesc:
The momma duck is completely white with a yellow bill.  She fluffs her
feathers and quacks at you as you get closer.  She must be protecting
something.  Better not mess with a mother.

name: a baby duck
shortdesc: A baby duck shivers in fear behind an old log.
longdesc:
The baby duck looks so cute! Even shivering and in fear for death, it
looks up at you with huge button eyes and sheds a single tear.  Oh
yeah, gotta kill it.

name: a barred owl
shortdesc: A barred owl hoots at you from a long tree branch.
longdesc:
*HootHoot**HootHoot* echoes down to you from the tree limbs above.
Looking up, you can see a brown barred owl sitting on a long tree branch.
It appears to be about a foot high and has a white patch for a face.
*HootHoot**HootHoot*.

name: a red billed woodpecker
shortdesc: A tiny red billed woodpecker drills its beak into a tree.
longdesc:
The woodpecker has a red head and neck with a black body.  It clings
to a tree with its feet and drills its beak into it.  It drills and
drills until it digs out a hole worth crawling into.  Finally, all that
pecking will stop.

name: a white ibis
shortdesc: A beautiful white ibis walks gracefully through the swamp.
longdesc:
What a magnificent creature.  The ibis is the purest white you have
ever seen.  It's like a bright shining light within the swamps.  The
ibis carefully walks through the swamp, trying to fish for some food.
It spears its beak into the water and pulls out a fresh catch.  Lunch!

name: a prothonitary warbler
shortdesc: A prothonitary warbler flutters quickly through the air.
longdesc:
A lovely yellow under belly is all you can see as the warbler flys past
at high speeds.  The bird appears to be brown in color but it could be
black.  Its hard to tell from this distance.

name: Russel the skiff salesman
shortdesc: A cigar smoking lizard appears from the darkness.
longdesc:
Smiling wryly and taking a deep inhale from his smoking cigar, a lizard
creature steps out from the darkness of the swamps.  "I got just what
you need there.", he states, blowing out a plume of smoke in your face.
He grins, "Skiffs for sale.  Since you are my favorite customer I'll 
give you a bargain price.".  The lizard has a black leather vest covering
his chest.  A studded black eye patch covers an obvious scar running
down his face.

name: an innocent manatee
shortdesc: Two large eyes stare up at you innocently from the water.
longdesc:
The manatee's large body floats lazily through the water, munching on
some green plant life.  It doesn't even bother to move as your boat runs
right over it.  The sea cow turns and looks at you innocently, almost
looking as though it is about to weep.

name: an innocent manatee
shortdesc: Two large eyes stare up at you innocently from the water.
longdesc:
The manatee's large body floats lazily through the water, munching on
some green plant life.  It doesn't even bother to move as your boat runs
right over it.  The sea cow turns and looks at you innocently, almost
looking as though it is about to weep.

name: a large crocodile
shortdesc: A scaly green crocodile is swimming through the bayou.
longdesc:
The large crocodile is easily six feet long.  It swims quickly through
the water, almost like a snake.  Its black eyes seem to be staring at
you.  You better not get too close or you may wind up the next meal!

name: a large crocodile
shortdesc: A scaly green crocodile is swimming through the bayou.
longdesc:
The large crocodile is easily six feet long.  It swims quickly through
the water, almost like a snake.  Its black eyes seem to be staring at
you.  You better not get too close or you may wind up the next meal!

name: a snapping turtle
shortdesc: A red and green colored snapping turtle almost takes off your finger.
longdesc:
Ouch!  Looking down into the water, you can see the red and green shell
of a snapping turtle as it dives back down into the bayou.  Its little
head turns back and almost seems to smile at you.  How rude.

name: a screaming monkey
shortdesc: A brown monkey screams at you from the tree branches.
longdesc:
The monkey jumps up and down on the swamp tree's branches.  It throws
a piece of fruit it was holding at you and screams at you with all its
might.  The monkey turns around, scratches his butt at you and swings
away to another tree.

name: the monkey king
shortdesc: A regal looking monkey stares down at you from the branches.
longdesc:
The large monkey's face looks down at you with displeasure.  It folds
its arms across its chest and lets out a grunt.  The monkey king lets
out a loud shout and screaming monkeys begin to pelt you with fruit.

name: a swamp monster
shortdesc: A pile of swamp moss slowly rises from the river.
longdesc:
The swamp moss starts to shift and move along the river.  Clumps of
the green moss rise into the air, gathering together into a humanoid
like shape.  Bright red eyes begin to glow where eyes should be.  The
swamp monster opens its mouth, letting out a low, inhuman moan.  The
moan slowly rises into a loud roar as the monster raises its giant arm
and reaches out for you.

name: a monkey child
shortdesc: A small monkey child is drinking water from the stream.
longdesc:
Leaning over to drink from the stream, the young monkey cups its hands
into the bayou and lifts some water to its mouth.  The monkey child
screams and scampers back up a tree when is realizes you are staring
at it.

name: a gray baboon
shortdesc: A large gray baboon stares down at you from the trees.
longdesc:
Stoic and proud, the large baboon stares down at you from the tree limbs.
It has a furry gray pelt with a bright red face.  There are white and
yellow striped lines under the creature's eyes.  The baboon stands back
patiently and lets its king do all the talking.

name: the baboon king
shortdesc: A large baboon stands at the front of troop.
longdesc:
The baboon king raises its arms out wide and starts to viciously beat
its own chest.  It grunts at you, letting you know who is in charge
of the bayou.  The baboon quickly charges across a tree limb and 
directly at you.  It stops suddenly and lets out several loud 
gutteral grunts.  The baboon king resumes beating its chest with all
its might.  That really has to hurt.

name: Lildenowin the dwarven mage
shortdesc: A ghost of a dwarven mage wanders through the hallways.
longdesc:
The dwarven mage is almost transparent, as you can see straight through
him.  A long blue hat with golden stars sits atop his head.  The stars
seem to move in constant motion.  A long white robe covers his body.  
It reaches the floor and sweeps along behind him.  A gigantic golden
moon flames and flares the back of the robe.  It seems to pulse and turn
in a clockwise direction.  Lildenowin is reading a giant volume of text.
He raises his hand to his chin, giving a pensive look.  *Creek*  The
floor you just stepped on reveals your intrusion.  A bright white fire
starts to surround the mage.  "Can't you see people are working here.",
Lildenowin speaks, turning to greet you.  His eyes spark and burn with
a deep hate.  "I'll teach you to sneak up on the king's royal mage.",
he grins, as he starts to chant and move his long fingers in the air.

name: a queen spider
shortdesc: The queen spider looks at you with a hungry gleam in her eyes.
longdesc:
The queen spider covers a majority of the room.  Her body is easily as
large an adult human.  Her long, hairy legs seem to make her even larger.
She suspends herself in the middle of the room with silky threads that
are attached to the main supports of the web.  A large egg sack hangs
from the end of her abdomen and seems to go down and to the west.  Some
fluid drops from her mouth as she sees her latest meal has arrived. Her
eight eyes are locked completely on you as she moves from her comfortable
position and straight towards you.

name: a large spider
shortdesc: A large spider walks along the silky spider webs.
longdesc:
The spider's body is about the size of a large dog.  Its eight long legs
easily move the spider quickly along the silky spider webs.  The spiders
body is grayish black and has prickly hairs along its cephalothorax.  It
immediately turns and moves in your direction when it feels you vibrate
the webs with your feet.

name: a baby spider
shortdesc: A little baby spider skitters quickly along the web trails.
longdesc:
Awwww, the baby spider is so cute!  It runs aimlessly along the spider
webs.  It must be lost.  The little thing would probably be crying if
it could.

name: a baby spider
shortdesc: A huge mass of baby spiders crawl out of a giant egg sack.
longdesc:
Ewwwwwww, you must have ruptured the egg sack, as a cancer like mass of
baby spiders poors out.  They shake off the white fluid covering them
and run as fast as they can towards you.  Being born works up quite the
appetite.

name: a trapped fly
shortdesc: A gigantic fly tries to free its wings from the sticky webs.
longdesc:
Vibrating its wings as fast as it can, the gigantic fly tries to free
itself from the sticky white webs.  You can almost see a panicked look
in its two huge eyes.  The fly has a green body with multi-colored
wings.  There are two long antenna sticking out from its head.  Suddenly,
two spiders show up out of nowhere and start to spin the trapped fly
into a cacoon.  Better get moving before they do it to you too.

name: a black spider
shortdesc: A small black spider makes its way along the webs to the west.
longdesc:
The spiders move along the webs to the west.  The spiders are not all
that large, almost babies really.  They are definitely not here to
defend the web.  Where are they going?

name: a parachute spider
shortdesc: A spider spins some silk into a parachute and floats away with the wind.
longdesc:
Several of the spiders as spinning their silky threads into a parachute.
They finish their project and wait patiently.  The wind soon picks up, 
lifting their parachute into the air and carrying the spiders away.
What fun!

name: a human tourist
shortdesc: A male tourist looks lovingly at his girlfiend.
longdesc:
The man is dressed in some brown shorts and forest green button down
shirt.  He has a tan hat on his head and tips it a bit as he stares at
his girlfriend.  His cheeks glow with a bright red luster as he reaches
into the pocket of his shorts and pulls out a little box.  Clearing his
throat, he tries to open up the tiny box and fumbles it into the pool
of water.  Oh no!

name: a lovely tourist
shortdesc: A very pretty tourist gazes longingly into the deep sapphire water.
longdesc:
The lovely blond female rests her elbows on the railing of the pool and
stares deeply into the sparkling sapphire water.  She sighs a little as
she marvels at the beauty of the deep sapphire pool.  The tourist has
long, flowing blond hair that seems to blow in the wind.  She barely
even notices her boyfriend is here.

name: an irritated tourist
shortdesc: An irritated tourist stands at the railing, tapping his foot impatiently.
longdesc:
The human male looks about at the end of his ropes.  Arms crossed and
face beet red, he taps his foot impatiently on the ground.  "Always on
time.  Always on time.", he says mockingly to the female tourist.  "It
is too hot in this hot spring to be waiting around like this."  He looks
to the north and says, "Let's just go around the mountain.  I hear the
views up there are wonderful!"  You can practially see the steam coming
out of his ears.  Maybe it's just the hot spring.

name: a watching tourist
shortdesc: A male tourist checks his sand-dial and looks over the railing.
longdesc:
I can't believe this.", he says checking out the mini sand-dial on his
wrist.  "The geyser is always on time every ten minutes!  Something has
to be wrong with this stupid sand-dial."  The man is about five and a
half feet tall with brown hair.  He has on a blue polo shirt and some
cargo pants.  It must be hot in those pants!

name: a patient tourist
shortdesc: A middle-aged woman waits patiently for the geyser to appear.
longdesc:
The woman appears to be about forty years of age.  She looks very pretty
in tan shorts and a peach polo shirt.  She stands looking to the west,
waiting for the geyser to go off.  She sighs at the impatient tourist
and says, "It's always on time.  Just a few more seconds dear.".  She
goes back to staring absent-mindedly to the west.

name: a chatting tourist
shortdesc: An old woman talks up a storm with her friends.
longdesc:
The old woman looks very happy in her one-piece swim suit and hair net.
She smiles and chats with her friends like there is no tomorrow.  She
does not seem to care that there are other people trying to enjoy the
hot spring.

name: an elder male
shortdesc: An old man covers his ears and tries to enjoy the steam bath.
longdesc:
The poor old man leans back, trying to enjoy the hot springs.  He looks
over to the chatting ladies with an irritated look on his face.  The
old man gives up and just puts his hands over his ears.

name: a deaf old man
shortdesc: An old man looks totally a peace resting in the steam bath.
longdesc:
Singing and rocking back and forth, the old man seems to really enjoy
the hot steam bath.  He looks over to the chatting ladies and says, "Huh?
Did you say something Marge?".  Not getting a response, he immediately
returns to enjoying his bath.

name: a red steam bather
shortdesc: An extremely red steam bather is revealing his next big idea.
longdesc:
We can expand.", the heavy set man proclaims, "Nobody owns the forest
and we can just take it over!".  Looking excited, he raises his hands
in victory and states, "Profit is what its all about!"  The business
man's skin is completely red.  The water and steam seems to have boiled
him like a lobster.  He sways a little from the intense heat and then
continues spewing out ideas to the young business man.

name: a young business man
shortdesc: A young man takes notes as fast as he can while sweating profusely.
longdesc:
Taking notes at a frantic pace, the young business man shifts uncomfort-
ably in the steam bath.  "Sir..  sir..  it's a little hot in here and
I'm starting to get sick.", he young man proclaims as his skin turns
from a pinkish to a deep red.

name: a large clay blob
shortdesc: A large clay blob wanders around the caverns at a snail's pace.
longdesc:
The blob looks likes an erupting mound of moving clay.  Ripples of clay
flow down its body in constant motion.  It does not seem to have any
wants or needs.  Its mouth opens in a silent scream, revealing a deep
black hole in the creatures face.  A large ball of mud shoots out of its
mouth and straight at your head!  How rude.

name: a clay blob
shortdesc: A clay blob is playing around and caushing a ruckus.
longdesc:
The clay blob is playing with its friends around the cave.  It is about
the size of a bowl of jelly and quivers just as easily.  It is so cute
how they spit little balls of clay at eachother.

name: a clay blob
shortdesc: A clay blob looks at you curiously and then spits some clay at you.
longdesc:
The blob just sits there, staring at you.  The blob is a reddish-brown
color.  It looks to be two feet tall.  The blob bobs its head up and down
and gives you an extremely curious look.  It takes a deep breath and spits
a good size ball of clay at you.

name: a teenage climber
shortdesc: A human female teenager giggles with her friends near the edge of the mountain.
longdesc:
She looks about sixteen years old.  The teenager has a yellow ribbon in
her brown, shoulder length hair.  Her friends must like to copy her
because they all have the same hair cut.  How clicky.  She giggles and
cheers with her friends about the fact that they actually climbed the
mountain side.  The young girl gets excited when the tour guide says
its time to start climbing down.

name: a teenage climber
shortdesc: A teenager stands at the edge of the mountain breathing heavy.
longdesc:
This boy looks scared to death.  It looks like he is starting to hyper-
ventilate as his breathing picks up to a rapid, heaving pace.  "Do we
really have to climb back down?", he pleads to the tour guide.  "You 
said there was a way to walk back down right?", he asks with some tears
in his eyes.

name: a tour guide
shortdesc: A lizard with a red scarf is giving instruction to tourists.
longdesc:
Is everyone ready?", the tour guide starts off.  "We are about to get
started.  Please make sure to listen to me carefully and watch your step.",
he smiles.  "Ladies, please start off and we will follow behind you.",
he says.

name: a climbing tourist
shortdesc: A male tourist is making his way up the mountain with his team.
longdesc:
Decked out in the latest camping gear, the tourist makes his way up the
mountain side.  Looking down to make sure his friends are ok, he nails
in another piton and continues upwards.  He grips the rocks carefully,
making sure not to miss step.  He looks up and smiles as he realizes he
doesn't have that far to go.

name: a male climber
shortdesc: A male climber carefully follows his lizard instructor's directions.
longdesc:
This is obviously this man's first time climbing.  He does not seem to
get the rythym of the lizard's instructions.  "Mister, listen.  I just
think I'm going to stay down here.", he complains to the tour guide.
He pouts and sits down on the ground.

name: a female climber
shortdesc: A female climber tries her best to climb and follow directions at the same time.
longdesc:
This may be the lady's first time, but she is trying her best.  She
carefully follows the lizard's instructions and is making her way up
the mountain side.  "Hey!", she says laughing, "This isn't that hard
after all!".

name: a black blob
shortdesc: A black blob laughs and throws stones off the mountain.
longdesc:
You see a black creature four feet tall with webbed feet.  He looks over
the edge of the cliff to the north, throwing down rocks and cackling.  
Then all of a sudden he whirls around and sees you.  He quickly scampers
away.

name: the ghost of king Gilfor
shortdesc: The ghost of king Gilfor stares transfixed at his riches.
longdesc:
The ghost is a truely horrible sight to behold.  He appears to be a 
half formed creature composed of half dwarven and half lizard features.
A long lizard tail swings behind him as he stares down at you from the 
throne.  He notices you reaching for his treasure and slaps your hand.
"I am king Gilfor.", he smiles.  The smile instantly turns into a frown
and he growls,"Do not touch that, it is mine to keep....  forever!".  
He leaps from his throne with a hiss and swipes his lizard like claws 
at you.

name: a ghost of a dwarven elder
shortdesc: The ghost of a male dwarven elder waits patiently in a chair.
longdesc:
You can see the faint outline of a dwarven elder sitting in the one of
the plush chairs of the waiting room.  He is dressed in a regal blue
robe from head to toe.  His hairs have turned white, including the long,
braided goatee growing from his chin.  The poor man's head keeps bobbing
forward and back as if he is nodding to someone, but you can tell that
he is just taking little cat naps.

name: a ghost of a dwarven elder
shortdesc: An old female dwarven ghost is reviewing some paperwork before she sees the king.
longdesc:
The ghost of a dwarven elder pushes her wire trimmed glasses back up 
her nose as she reviews some paperwork.  An entire of stack of this
paperwork sits on her lap.  She must plan on speaking with the king for
quite some time.  It's fortunate for her that she is dead because she
now has all eternity to do so.

name: a ghost of a dwarven guard
shortdesc: The ghost of a strong dwarven guard is guarding the hallways.
longdesc:
Stout and very strong looking, the ghost of a dwarven guard stands ready
for any sort of attack.  He is dressed to the hilt heavy battle gear.
The dwarves must have been preparing for a huge fight before the flood.
He finally notices you starting, unsheaths his sword and thrusts an
attack.

name: a ghost of a dwarven guard
shortdesc: The ghost of a strong dwarven guard is patrolling the hallways.
longdesc:
Stout and very strong looking, the ghost of a dwarven guard stands ready
for any sort of attack.  He is dressed to the hilt heavy battle gear.
The dwarves must have been preparing for a huge fight before the flood.
He finally notices you starting, unsheaths his sword and thrusts an
attack.

name: a ghost of a dwarven princess
shortdesc: The ghost of a dwarven princess sits combing her long brown hair.
longdesc:
The dwarven princess sits at her vanity combing her long brown hair.
She sets down her jeweled silver hair brush and grabs a bottle of bright
green liquid.  She sprays a little of it on her neck and a squirt or
two in the air.  She smiles brightly, grabbing a white ribbon and tying
into her hair as a bow.  Her eyes shift to the top of the mirror as she
finally realizes she is not alone.  Standing up quickly, she kicks her
seat at you and grabs her brush.  Letting out a small growl, she chucks
the brush at your head and leaps into a flying kick.  Geez, where is
Neo?

name: a ghost of a dwarven prince
shortdesc: The ghost of a crying child sits crying in the corner of the room.
longdesc:
Dressed in all black and crouched in the corner, the dwarven prince is
crying his eyes out.  He looks to be about eight years old.  His big
brown eyes peer out in between his fingers.  The young prince stands
up and starts to walk towards you, hands still covering his face.  He
removes his hands and lets out a loud shriek.  Better run before the
guards hear it.

name: a ghost of a dwarven prince
shortdesc: The ghost of a dwarven prince dances around the room.
longdesc:
The dwarven prince dances and prances around the room.  He is wearing
a frilly white shirt and black spandex pants.  He jumps into the air
and spins over to a vase of flowers on his desk.  Smiling, he smells
the flowers and continues to dance around the room.  He doesn't appear
to have a care in the world!  No wonder the king had another son.

name: a ghost of a dwarven crown prince
shortdesc: The ghost of a crown prince is reviewing some scrolls at his desk.
longdesc:
The crown prince looks very tall for a dwarf, even while sitting.  He
is vigorously reviewing some paperwork on his desk and making little
notes on a piece of paper.  He stops and looks up at you, "The guards
didn't stop you.  Good.".  Smiling, he stands and bows to you, "I 
haven't had a good fight all day.".  He reaches into his desk and pulls
out two long, cleaver like knives.  Twirling the daggers around like
a martial arts master, he assumes a fighting stance and motions you
towards him with his left hand's fingers.  Geez, Gilfor really trained
these kids how to fight.

name: a ghost of a dwarven queen
shortdesc: The ghost of a dwarven queen sitting at her vanity, looking in the broken mirror.
longdesc:
The queen sits sraight up in her chair and stares into the mirror on
her vanity.  She is dressed in a long silky night gown that reveals
her amble bussom.  The queen is quite beautiful for a dwarf, she must
be of mixed blood.  She looks up at her lady in waiting and sighs
impatiently.  Must be tiring being waited on hand and foot.  "Enough.",
the queen says pushing away her lady in waiting.  "Enough!", she says,
standing to address you.  "My husband's insanity does not reflect our
people's pride.  Damn him for cursing our people to live as lizards."
She starts to cry and sits back down, staring deep into her vanity
mirror.  "Just get it over with.", she says matter of factly to the
mirror, staring back at you through the reflection with piercing eyes.
"I know what you came here to do.

name: a ghost of a lady in waiting
shortdesc: A young dwarven female ghost is carefully dressing the queen's hair.
longdesc:
The dwarven girl tries her hardest to finsh the queen's hair.  She pins
and ties sections of the queen's hair into a beautiful work of art.
The young girl is dressed in rags compared to the rest of the royal
family.  It is obvious she is not of the king's blood line.  She smiles
at the queen when the matriarch sighs at her and then sticks her tongue
at the queen when she turns her head away.

name: a young lizard
shortdesc: A young lizard sleeps in a nest on the queen's bed.
longdesc:
The young female lizard is curled up in her nest on the queen's bed.
She jumps as you enter the room.  "She said I could stay here.", the
young lizard shouts at you.  "The queen said I was beautiful and I
don't have to be ashamed for being a lizard.", the girl sniffles as
a tear drips from her big eyes.

name: a human thief
shortdesc: A man dressed in all black ramages through the king's belongings.
longdesc:
Overturning dresser drawers and rifiling through the king's possessions,
the thief takes anything valuable and stuffs it in a large bag.  The
man looks human and stands about six feet tall.  He is dressed completely
in black and has a cloth covering his face.  He doesn't even stop his
stealing spree when he notices you enter the room.  There must be some
good stuff in here.

name: a ghost of a dwarven miner
shortdesc: A strong looking dwarven ghost is trying to break through the wall.
longdesc:
The dwarven ghost looks very strong with his well muscled arms.  He
ineffectually swings his pickaxe into the cave wall, trying to do his
job in death as he did in life.  The weapon does not seem to do any
damage to the wall.  The miner is wearing some sturdy blue overalls and 
has some muddy boots on his feet.  He stops swinging and grasps the 
pickaxe tightly.  Looking quickly to his friend, he gives a quick nod.  
"We'll teach you to wander through the dwarven kingdom.", he shouts.  
Grasping the end of the pickaxe with his strong right hand, he lifts 
it above has head and aims his weapon directly at yours.

name: a ghost of a dwarven miner
shortdesc: The ghost of a dwarven miner pushes a cart out of the store room.
longdesc:
The stout and plump ghost of a dwarven miner is suprised by your 
entrance into the store room.  He can't seem to figure out what to do.
He is frozen in his tracks.  "Um...  You there.", he stutters, slowly
coming to his senses.  "I'll show you!", he shouts, jumping over the
cart and running directly towards you.

name: a ghost of a dwarven miner
shortdesc: The ghost of a dwarven miner wanders through the hallways.
longdesc:
The large dwarf almost looks lost.  He has a glazed look over his eyes
and is dragging his pickaxe on the ground.  A stream of etheral ooze
drips from his mouth and into the dirt on the cavern floor.  Is he
asleep?

name: a young lizard girl
shortdesc: A young lizard girl is sitting in the mud, crying into her scaly hands.
longdesc:
This poor lizard is crying her eyes out.  She sits crouched in the mud
with her hands over her eyes.  When you ask her why she says, "I like 
being a reptile, but I'm not supposed to."  You try in vain to get her
to talk to you again but can't.  Her weeping starts to get worse and
snot starts seeping from her nose.  Gross.

name: a reptilian child
shortdesc: A reptilian child is playing ball with its friends.
longdesc:
The lizard looks to be quite young, probably a child by reptile standards.
It laughs and plays with its friends, throwing the ball back and forth.
The lizard stops playing and looks at you as you walk through the muck.
Its friend takes this opportunity to peg it in the head with the ball
they were throwing around.  Nice.

name: an old lizard
shortdesc: An old lizard swings down from the trees and scolds the children.
longdesc:
The lizard looks old and is very wrinkley.  It swings down from a tree
branch and lands with a splat in the muck.  The old lizard slowly rises,
staring at the young lizards and says, "You know better than to play like
this.  We must be quiet and good to prove to the Earth Mother that we 
have reformed.  You don't want to be reptiles all your life, do you?".
*tchh*  The lizard clicks its tongue, climbing back up a tree.

name: a lizard mage
shortdesc: A blue robed lizard is casting an intricate spell.
longdesc:
The lizard stands in the muck with its arms outstretched.  The lizard
seems to be chanting in its own language, but it seems to have an elven
sound to the dialect.  A tree begins to grow from the ground and up
into the sky as the lizard mage moves his arms and fingers in intricate
patterns.  The lizards falls to the ground huffing and puffing heavily.
There must be some heavy magics involved here.

name: a lizard shopkeeper
shortdesc: A old hunched over lizard stands behind the counter.
longdesc:
The shopkeeper looks extremely old.  His scaley skin has gone all wrinkley
with age.  He give you an odd look and lets out a short hiss.  "Look,
I don't have all day with my age.  What do you want?

name: a sleeping lizard
shortdesc: A lizard creature is sleeping on the floor in the corner of the room.
longdesc:
The lizard does not even notice you have entered the room.  It continues
to take a nap on the bare floor.  It's curled up like a little dog.  
How cute.

name: a lizard creature
shortdesc: A lizard creature walks quickly through the muck.
longdesc:
The lizard looks about four feet tall.  It has olive green scaley skin
covering its entire body.  A long tail waves innocently behind it.  The
lizard moves quickly through the muck.  The muddy, gooey mess does not
seem to hinder it in the least.  It sees you staring at it and quickly
walks in another direction.

name: a lizard creature
shortdesc: A lizard creature walks quickly through the hallways.
longdesc:
The lizard looks about four feet tall.  It has olive green scaley skin
covering its entire body.  A long tail waves innocently behind it.  The
lizard moves quickly through the house.  It must have somewhere to go
and something to do.  It sees you staring at it and quickly walks in 
another direction.

name: a lizard school teacher
shortdesc: A lizard is standing in front of his class giving a lecture.
longdesc:
The lizard holds a text book with his left hand and addresses the class
with his right.  "King Gilfor could not rid himself of his greed.", the
teach says to his students.  "We are lizards because of his selfishness."
Noticing the children starting to get upset he says, "It was not all
bad though.  The elves have taught us humility and honor.  There is
nothing greater.".  He proudly puts his in front of his heart and smiles,
"We must atone for the sins of our forefathers.  All hail the Earth
Mother."  The children repeat after him in their cute little voices.
He finally looks at you.  "We are a school here.  Please move on.

name: a lizard school teacher
shortdesc: A lizard is sitting behind his desk smoking a pipe.
longdesc:
The lizard takes a deep inhale from his pipe with a pleasant smile.  He
leans back on his chair and exhales a huge ploom of smoke.  Jumping to
his feet when he notices you, he says to you with a scared look, "You
didn't see anything.".  The lizard then slips you a gold coin.  Wee!

name: a lizard school child
shortdesc: A lizard child is listening to its instructor and taking notes.
longdesc:
The lizard looks so cute sitting on the floor and taking notes on its
slate.  It looks up at its teacher in awe as he talks about their former
king.  The young reptilian child is enraptured by its teacher's lecture.

name: Llendolwir lizard girl
shortdesc: A lizard girl rests on some cypress branches.
longdesc:
How strange.  Most of the lizard creatures don't wear clothes, but this
young girl has a blue dress on.  "The last.", she says to you, staring
up at you from the floor.  "I am the last of the king's descendants.  The
blood line stops...", and she stops, letting out an insane cackle.  The
lizard girl stands and shakes her fists at you.  "Blood line!  HA!  Who 
would want this accursed blood.", she laughs, falling down and curling 
up into a ball.

name: a singing lizard
shortdesc: A lizard sings songs from an elven hymnal.
longdesc:
A lizard creature stands with the rest of the choir.  The singing lizard
is holding a hymnal that appears to have elven writing on the cover.
The lizards are singing in their native tongue.  It does not sound much
like singing, but more like a harmonic series of croaks and throat
clicks.  The lizard looks at you curiously as you make your way through
the choir.

name: a choir master
shortdesc: The choir master conducts the lizard choir with his hands.
longdesc:
The choir master screams at you as you make your way through the choir.
"Hey!  This is a place of worship.", the choir master screams at you.
"Can't you have a little respect?!"  He tries to compose himself and
continues to conduct the choir members.

name: a lizard priest
shortdesc: The priest glares at you from on top of his pulpit.
longdesc:
The priest is dressed in a simple black scarf.  He holds an elven gospel
in his hands as he preaches his sermon to the praying lizards.  The
lizard is very old as you can see his mane is mostly white.  His eyes
pierce through the crowd and right at you as you walk through the praying
lizards.  You must be making too much noise.

name: a praying lizard
shortdesc: A lizard creature prays on its hands and knees while listening to the sermon.
longdesc:
The lizard reads from the elven gospel as it tries not to fall asleep
from the boring drone of the priest.  It looks from the book, to its
friend, to the priest, to its friend.  The lizard must be ready to go.

name: a meditating lizard
shortdesc: A lizard woman quietly meditates in the middle of the smoke filled room.
longdesc:
The lizard is sitting indian style on the floor with its eyes closed.
It seems to be humming in a meditative state.  It rocks back and forth
as it takes deep breaths of the sweet smelling smoke.  *Hum*Hum**Hum*
Better get a move on before you fall asleep.

name: a janitor lizard
shortdesc: An old lizard sweeps up around the museum.
longdesc:
The thin and old looking lizard slowly sweeps for the floors of the
Museum of Rememberance.  It does not seem to be enjoying its job in
the least.  Looking around, it's strange that someone is sweeping up
in this place at all.  The museum is in prestine condition.

name: a janitor lizard
shortdesc: A hearty lizard walks through the swamp picking up trash.
longdesc:
The lizard has a nice blue scarf tied around its neck.  There is a 
leather strap across its left shoulder that is attached to a large
sack on the lizard's hip.  The janitor walks along the swamp trails
picking up and trash left from the tourists.  A lizard's work is never
done.  He smiles at you and continues along the trail.

name: a ranger lizard
shortdesc: A cloaked lizard moves silently through the swamps.
longdesc:
The ranger weaves silently in and out of the swamp tree shadows.  It
is covered in a full length gray cloak that almost perfectly blends
into the darkness of the shade.  Suddenly the lizard disappears from
sight.  There are no tracks or signs of the lizards where abouts.
A piercing pressure comes sharply and quickly from your neck.  Looking
as far back as you can, you can see a large reptilian arm holding the
weapon.  A low hiss whispers in your ear, "You've wandered a little
far from the trail.  I suggest you turn around.".  Without so much as
a sound the lizard is gone.  It's almost as if he was never there.

name: a bronze dragon
shortdesc: A small bronze dragon sweeps down from the sky.
longdesc:
The dragon's skin is very beautiful.  It glistens and shines in the
beaming sunlight.  You almost forget that a fearsome dragon is roaring
at you.  The dragon stretches out his might wings and flaps them at
you violently.  The remains of corpses and skeletons fly at you at an
amazing speed.  *Ouch*  The remains pelt you everywhere, leaving a 
fresh barrage of bruises.  A white glow starts to shine from the dragon's
mouth.  A fountain of electric sparks flow out and strike some bones
on the ground, turing them to dust.

name: a black vulture
shortdesc: A black vulture with a long red neck flies over head.
longdesc:
The vulture circles high above the battle field.  It is probaby
looking for something to eat.  It has a fat black feathered body with a
white feathery collar.  It squacks at you impatiently, waiting for you 
to die.

name: a dwarven skeleton
shortdesc: A dwarven skeleton is choking the hell out of a elven skeleton.
longdesc:
A pile of bones slowly rises from the field, floating into the air to
form the skeletal frame of a dwarf.  The bones seem to glow with a dark
light.  The skeleton's frame is stout and the bones are thick.  This
is definitely the frame of a dwarf.  The skeleton immediately attacks
an elven skeleton that has formed across the room.  Death must not stop
the need for a fresh kill.

name: an elven skeleton
shortdesc: An elven skeleton is choking the hell out of a elven skeleton.
longdesc:
A pile of bones floats up from the ground and forms the skeletal remains
of an elven warrior.  The bones of the warrior glow with a dark energy.
The skeletal elf immediately charges across the field and starts choking
a skeletal dwarf.

name: A skeletal mage
shortdesc: A piles of bones begins to glow and slowly forms a skeletal human mage.
longdesc:
A pile of bones slowly rises from the ground and begin to pulse with
a dark burning light.  The bones form the skeleton of a long dead human
being.  The skeletal remains seem to smile at you.  A bright red luster
seems to rotate clockwise in its eye sockets.  The skeletons jaw starts
to move as though it was talking, possibly making some incantations.
Better run.

name: a dwarven skeleton
shortdesc: A dwarven skeleton is wandering around the battlefield looking for a fight.
longdesc:
A pile of bones slowly rises from the field, floating into the air to
form the skeletal frame of a dwarf.  The bones seem to glow with a dark
light.  The skeleton's frame is stout and the bones are thick.  This
is definitely the frame of a dwarf.  The skeleton picks up some weapons
and begins to hunt for fresh prey.  It may not have a stomach but you
can tell it is hungry.

name: an elven skeleton
shortdesc: An elven skeleton wandering around the battlefield looking for a dwarf to fight.
longdesc:
A storm of bones rises into the air, circling like it is caught in a 
tornado of some sort.  When the dust settles the bones have formed into
the skeleton of an elven warrior.  The warrior immedialy picks up a
weapon and starts to hunt some dwarfs.  Some bad blood never dies.

name: a tree guard
shortdesc: A massive cypress tree blocks your entrance.
longdesc:
A tree slowly pulls its roots from the swampy earth and moves
onto the path, blocking any entrance to the south.  A flock of
birds fly from the cypress's head from all the movement.
*SniffSniff* the tree snorts at you, "You smell of power!
the Swamps of Amnos are only for those lower than the level
of 175!"  Two deeps lights pulsate from where the eyes of this
beast would be located, and it starts to sway its giant branches
in a display of its mighty power.

name: a horned worm
shortdesc: A large worm swims through the sand and right towards you.
longdesc:
A tan brown worm is about he size of large horse.  A sharp beak opens
in a scream from the worm's mouth.  It swims and jumps through the sand
with amazing ease.  There are long, sharp horns growing all down its
back.  The worm quickly starts to swim towards you when it realizes you
are stuck in its home.

name: a large rattlesnake
shortdesc: A large rattlesnake is coiled in a pile, shaking its tail.
longdesc:
*RATTLE*RATTLE*RATTLE*  The large tan snake with green diamonds running
along its thick body shakes its tail at you menacingly.  Coiled and
ready the pounce, the rattlesnake stares at you with a hungry look in
its eyes. *RATTLE*RATTLE*RATTLE*

name: a black vulture
shortdesc: A black vulture with a long white neck flies over head.
longdesc:
The vulture circles high above the plains.  It is probaby looking for
something to eat.  It has a fat black feathered body with a white 
feathery collar.  It squacks at you impatiently, waiting for you to die.

name: A brown bison
shortdesc: A large and furry bison roams the plains, looking for food.
longdesc:
The bison is very large considering there is no noticable water source
for miles.  Its shiny brown coat glistens under the relentless light
from the sun.  Bending its head down, it chews up some grass and begins
to munch contently.  The mighty beast does not seem to have a worry in
the world.

name: a plains mouse
shortdesc: A small plains mouse scurries out from beneath a rock and over your feet.
longdesc:
A small brown mouse cutely scurries out from beneath a rock and looks
up at you innocently.  It twitches its nose back and forth, quickly
deciding that it needs to run over your shoes and in the other
direction.  What a weird little creature.

name: an elder black dragon
shortdesc: An elder black dragon hovers menacingly in the air.
longdesc:
The black dragon's scales seem to suck in all the sunlight.  The suns
incandesence is almost eclipsed by this monsters very being.  A
bubbling, smelly liquid drips from the dragon's mouth and lands with
a hiss, burning through the floor.  The dragon's ruby red eyes stare
through you as though you are not even there.  It roars with a terrible
scream and dives at you to attack.

name: A stranded grizzly bear
shortdesc: A moaning and yelping grizzly bear tries to escape the sand.
longdesc:
The black grizzly bear fights for its life to escape the sand pit.  It
moans and yelps in frustation as it sinks deeper into the center of the
pit.  You can tell that the bear is worn down and ready to give into
the sands.  What can it be trying to escape from?

name: A trapped orc
shortdesc: A large orc struggles for its life to escape from the sand pit.
longdesc:
Screaming in orcish tongue the large orc struggles for its life to escape
the sand pit.  The orc is dressed in standard armor for a scout but it
is probably weighing him down.  He claws and treads his way up the
sandy embankment but the twisting tide continues to drag him into the
center.  What is he so scared of?

name: A white and gray bird
shortdesc: A white and gray colord bird flies through the forest.
longdesc:
A small white bird with brown wings sits picking through some underbrush.
It quickly sticks its beak straight up in the air and reveals that its
searching wasn't for naught.  A plump, pink earthworm dangles out of
its beak.  It gulps down its prize and quickly flies away.

name: A white speckled deer
shortdesc: A brown and white speckled deer nibbles on some leaves.
longdesc:
Long, branched horns stick out from the bucks head.  He has brown fur
with white spots all along his side.  His head shoots up, possibly
noticing your presence.  His strong jaw continues to munch on his lunch
as he looks around for signs of trouble.  Seemingly finding some, he
quickly hops away, deeper into the forest.

name: A fearsome grizzly bear
shortdesc: A fearsome looking grizzly bear roars with all his might.
longdesc:
Peeking around some trees, you can see the black grizzly bear picking
through the remains of a recent kill.  His frame is massive, easily
the size of an extra large human.  He licks his chops, slopping up the
last bits of his dinner.  Sniffing in the air, he begins to let out a 
low growl and turns his mighty head in your direction.  You freeze,
shifting some of the underbrush beneath you.  Reacting to the sudden
noise, the bear runs at you with full speed, teeth bared.

name: a ranger lizard
shortdesc: A cloaked lizard is carefully watching the farm to the north.
longdesc:
The ranger glares and watches the farm to the north very carefully from
