behind a thick tree.  It is covered in a full length gray cloak that 
almost perfectly blends into the darkness of the shade.  Suddenly the
lizard disappears from sight.  There are no tracks or signs of the
lizards where abouts.  A piercing pressure comes sharply and quickly
from your neck.  Looking as far back as you can, you can see a large
reptilian arm holding the weapon.  A low hiss whispers in your ear,
"Don't you even think of coming to the swamps.  Your kind is not welcome
there.".  Without so much as a sound the lizard is gone.  It's almost 
as if he was never there.

name: a yellow billed woodpecker
shortdesc: A tiny yellow billed woodpecker drills its beak into a tree.
longdesc:
The woodpecker has a yellow head and neck with a brown body.  It clings
to a tree with its feet and drills its beak into it.  It drills and
drills until it digs out a hole worth crawling into.  Finally, all that
pecking will stop.

name: A wounded brown bison
shortdesc: A large and furry bison screams in pain as a grizzly tears it apart.
longdesc:
This poor creature has been torn to shreds.  Somehow he is still able
to wail in pain, even though you are positive that those are his lungs 
laying on the ground.  His legs kick back and forth in reflex as the
large gizzly bear tears into its side.

name: A bloody grizzly bear
shortdesc: A blood drenched grizzly bear rips into a screaming bison.
longdesc:
Frenzied and in blood lust, the gigantic black grizzly bear claws and
bites his way into his fresh kill.  The bear does not seem to notice
you with all his attention towards his latest meal.  He must not get
to eat like this very often.  His entire head is soaked in the bison's
blood and gore.  He stops and begins to sniff the air.  The large
creature must sense his next meal.

name: a pink pig
shortdesc: A large pink pig wallows happily in the mud puddle.
longdesc:
The pig happily wallows and rolls around in the shallow mud puddle.
Most of its pink skin has been covered in wet and drying mud.  It stands
up and walks over to another part of the puddle, repeating the process.

name: a white and brown cow
shortdesc: A white and brown patched cow grazes lazily in the meadow.
longdesc:
The cow peacefully grazes on the bright green grass of the meadow.  It
looks up at you and begins to chew on its meal.  *MOOoooo*  The cow 
wags its tail and begins to walk away.

name: a white and brown cow
shortdesc: A white and brown patched cow floats in the air, spinning in a circle.
longdesc:
The cow looks like it is caught in the middle of a small hurricane.  It
has been levitated about a foot off the ground and is spinning very
slowly to the right in a circle.  Normally you would think the animal
would be distressed, but cow looks very serene, almost as though it
is enjoying the ride.

name: a white and brown cow
shortdesc: A white and brown patched cow eats some hay from the ground.
longdesc:
*MOOooOOoo*  The cow bellows at you as you walk into the milking station.
Mostly white with brown patches all over, the cow resumes munching on
some hey from the bottom of the barn.  The animal does not seem bothered
by the farmer milking it.

name: a brown horse
shortdesc: A magnificent brown horse walks across the meadow.
longdesc:
Proud and majestic, the brown horse walks across the meadow before the
farm.  It stops to take a quick look at you, but continues along its
way not thinking you are a threat.  The beast is strong and is obviously
used to help with the field work in the crop field.

name: a white and black dog
shortdesc: A white and black colored dog chases a butterfly across the meadow.
longdesc:
Tongue and tail wagging, the playful dog runs across the meadow.  The
dog jumps into the air trying to grab a butterfly in its mouth. *CHOMP*
Landing on all fours, the dog looks sadly into the air and watches its
prey flutter away.  Another blutterfly soon attracts its attention a
little ways across the meadow and it darts off towards its next victim.

name: a yellow duck
shortdesc: A yellow duck swims peacefully across the lake.
longdesc:
*QuackQuack* The duck yells as you wander into its part of the pond.
It quickly flaps its wings aggressively at you and swims off to the
other side of the pond.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome stares at you with a careful look.
longdesc:
The gnome stands about six inches tall.  He is carefully eyeing you
from behind a thick patch of grass in the meadow.  He has a white pointy 
hat on his head and is wearing some green pants and a white shirt.  The
gnome is so small that you probably would pass right by if you were not
looking for him.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome flys through the air causing all sorts of havoc.
longdesc:
The gnome has a green pointy hat on his head.  He is wearing a white
shirt and has some red pants on his legs.  He zooms around the air like
a bird.  Suddenly stopping in mid-air, he begins to stare are you and
speaks in a tongue you have never heard.  His eyes seem to be getting
larger, it is almost as if he is getting bigger.  The world starts to
shift and move out of focus.  A drip of blood runs out of your nose
and down your face.  This would probably be a good time to run.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome flys and dances through the air with a joyful laughter.
longdesc:
The gnome is moving around the room at an amazing rate of speed.  She
flys so fast that she can really can only be seen when standing still.
She has a red pointy hat on her head and is wearing a white shirt with
green  pants.  Carefully and methodically, she dissasembles the farmer's 
large garden hoe and immediately starts to reassemble it.  It is almost
as though she is doing this with her mind.  The gnome never seems to 
touch any of the objects with her hands.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome flys through the air causing all sorts of havoc.
longdesc:
The gnome is hiding behind a bottle of fruit preserves on the shelf.
He has a pointy red hat on his head and is wearing a white shirt with
blue pants.  Flying out from behind his hiding spot, he zooms around
the room like lightning bug.  He seems to be leaving a small trail of
colors behind him.  The gnome laughs as a steel can of vegetables
smashes into your head.

name: a sleeping grandma
shortdesc: A lovely old lady is taking a cat nap in the rocking chair.
longdesc:
Rocking back and forth in a wooden rocking chair, the old grandma has
fallen into a deep sleep.  She is dressed in her prettiest blue dress,
ready for this evening's dinner.  This poor lady is older than dirt.
It looks as though she will turn into dust and blow away at any second.
Better let her get her rest.

name: an old farmer
shortdesc: An old farmer is trying his best to milk the huge cow beside him.
longdesc:
An old farmer sits on a stool besides the cow, milking its utters. 
The farmer is doing his best to milk the large cow before him.  His
blue overalls and checkered white and red shirt are covered in the milk
he tries to hard to gather.  There are some broken milk bottles lying 
on the floor next to the farmers feet.  A trickle of blood drips from 
the farmer's forehead where one of the bottles must have hit him.  He 
must be used to this kind of chaos to be remaining to calm.

name: a young grandma
shortdesc: A beaufitul, young looking grandma cleans some vegetables in the sink.
longdesc:
The gray haired woman appears to be quite youthful.  She could easily
pass for someone in her thirties.  The woman leans over the sink and
methodically cleans some potatos.  She throws the peeled spuds into
a boiling pot on the stove when she's done.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome hides behind a loaf of bread on the kitchen table.
longdesc:
Staring at you from the table, the small gnome tries to hide behind a
loaf of white bread.  He raises his hands into the air and starts making
quick movements with his hands and fingers.  A bowl of steaming turkey
gravy starts to ice over, soon freezing solid.  Could this gnome have
something to do with that?  The gnome is wearing a pointy blue hat with
a white shirt and some brown pants.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A flaming hand reaches from the fireplace, directly towards you!
longdesc:
Englufed in flames, the gnome laughs at you from inside the fireplace.
The gnome has a pointy white hat on his head and is wearing a white
shirt with red pants.  He molds the fire into the shapes of the farm 
animals.  Flaming likenesses of horses, pigs and ducks walk around the 
room in a parade.  Unfortunately for the farmers, this is also setting
all their belongings ablaze.  He finally notices you and his eyes begin
to glow with a bright white light.  The flames surrounding the gnome 
start to form into a giant hand and charge straight towards you.

name: a tall man
shortdesc: A very tall man sits uncomfortably in his chair.
longdesc:
The man sits on a wooden chair against the south wall,  He shifts
uncomfortably to the left, trying to avoid the flames shooting from
the fireplace.  A trickle of sweat runs down his face as he adjusts
the collar of his blue shirt and settles back into his chair.

name: a young man
shortdesc: A young man rests on the couch, talking to the rest of his family.
longdesc:
The young man is dressed in his sunday best.  His black shoes glow with 
a gleem only shown from a newly polished shine.  He is talking to the 
two other men in the room about his adventures on the farm.  He does not 
seem to notice the woman running around the room has caught on fire.

name: a strong man
shortdesc: A strong looking man is starting to fall asleep on the couch.
longdesc:
The brown haired man is trying to listen intently to the young man's
story.  He leans his left arm on the arm of the couch, resting his head
on his hand.  His eyes slowly being to shut, but spring back open as he
realizes the young man is getting upset.  Noticing the young woman in 
the middle of the room has caught fire, he grabs a blanket from the back
of the couch and tries to put her out.

name: a young woman
shortdesc: A panicked young lady tries to put out the flames on her blouse.
longdesc:
The young lady is passing out some hour-derves to the farm men.  Some
wonderful smelling tidbits lie on a small try she is carrying.  She is
wearing a lovely red blouse and black skirt.  A flare erupts from the 
fireplace and starts a small fire on her blouse sleeve.  Screaming and
crying, she begins to run around the room pleading for help.

name: a playing child
shortdesc: A young girl is playing with some toys on the bed.
longdesc:
A young girl lays on the bed playing with a doll.  Her brother jumps
on the bed, kicks the doll from her hands and the rest of the toys onto
the floor.  She stands up crying but soon joins him and jumping up and
down on the plush looking bed.  They seem to be having the time of their
lives.

name: a playing child
shortdesc: A young boy is jumpin on the bed with all his might.
longdesc:
The young man creeps around the side of the bed, watching his sister
play with some toys.  He quickly jumps up on the bed, kicks the doll 
from her hands and kicks all the other toys to the floor too.  Sticking
his tongue at his sister, he jumps up and down on the bed with all his 
might.  Is he trying to break the bed?

name: a young woman
shortdesc: A young woman crouches in the corner of the room.
longdesc:
The young woman has her forearms covering her head, but you can still
tell that she is crying.  The front of her blue dress is wet with fallen
tears.  She looks up at her boy friend with a sullen frown, begging for
help with her bright green eyes.

name: a heroic man
shortdesc: A heroic man tries to shield his girl friend from flying debris.
longdesc:
The man is being pelted with random flying objects.  Picture frames,
lamps, chairs, even the room's bedpan flies at full force into this
poor man's back.  He looks back in the center of the room, into the
center of the small hurricane.  You can see his lips screaming
something but the crashing sound sof the room's furniture drowns out
the words.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small hurricane twirls in the middle of the room.
longdesc:
The gnome has a pointy green hat on his head.  He is wearing a white
shirt with some blue pants.  He twists and turns in the air, creating
a small hurricane.  The gnome laughs and giggles as the room's furniture
crashes on the distressed humans.

name: a black cat
shortdesc: A small black cat walks through the house.
longdesc:
*Meow*  You know what they say about that black cat crossing your path?
Better kill it. *Meow*

name: a yellow chicken
shortdesc: A yellow chicken clucks and pecks his way around the coop.
longdesc:
The chicken is mostly yellow but has some white spots in its feathers.
It clucks and pecks at the ground, trying to gobble up some feed. It
looks at you and quickly scampers to another side of the coop.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome collects some water from the pails.
longdesc:
The gnome has a pointy brown hat on his head.  He is wearing a white
shirt with some white pants.  He grabs one of the many pails of water
hanging from the railings.  Dumping the water into a siphon tube, he
immediately replaces the bucket onto the railing.  He moves onto the
next bucket and repeats the process.

name: a lady bug
shortdesc: A pretty lady bug looks at you like it's hungry.
longdesc:
At this size the lady bug is huge!  Its giant mandibles click and move
very quickly as the insect charges towards you.

name: a praying mantis
shortdesc: A green praying mantis slices at you with its arms.
longdesc:
Long and elegant, the mantis looks about the size of a horse when you
are this small.  The mantis slowly turns around on the mushroom top and
begins to crawl towards you.  It raises one giant arm in the air and
slashes for your face.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome carefully studies a monsum on the table.
longdesc:
The gnome carefully studies the monsum on the table.  Looking over his
clip board, he makes some notes and continues to stare at the creature.
He is wearing a long, white lab coat and has a pointy green hat on his
head.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome makes some magical gestures at the shadows.
longdesc:
The gnome's long, white lab coat is flowing behind him from the intense
energy of the spell he is casting.  He has a pointy silver hat sitting
on his head.  Twirling his fingers in the air, the gnome whispers some
gnomish chant and stares intently at the shadows.  The shadows soon
begin to disappear and navy blue flowers begin to glow with a pink light.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome is feeding the gnolls and troglodytes.
longdesc:
The gnome looks almost happy feeding some food to the monsums in the
cage.  His long, white lab coat piles on the floor behind him as he
leans down and places a bowl before the creatures.  He is wearing a
white shirt and has some red pants on his legs.  Strangely, there is
no hat on this gnome's head.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome crouches in the corner with his arms over his head.
longdesc:
The gnome looks scared for his life.  He sits huddled in the corner,
crouched with his arms over his head.  He looks up at the dragon and
then to the doorway.  He must be planning to make his escape.  The
dragon breaths another plume of fire, quickly changing his mind.  The
gnome has a pointy brown hat on his head and is wearing a long, white
lab coat.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome is trying to feed the white dragon some pieces of meat.
longdesc:
The gnome has a pointy blue hat on his head and is wearing a long, white
lab coat.  He grabs some pieces of meat off a silver plate on the table
and slowly tries to feed the white dragon.  The gnome looks a little
reluctant as the dragon just stares at him.  He just back just as the
dragon opens its mouth and shoots a streak of lightning at him.  What
a dangerous job!

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome chases a carrion crawler around the room.
longdesc:
The gnome is wearing a long, white lab coat and has a pointy white hat
on his head.  He is running around the wooden table in the middle of
the room, trying to corral a carrion crawler back into its cage.  He
stops, trying to catch his breath and then continues his pursuit of the
animal.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome carefully studies the dials and measures of the machine.
longdesc:
The gnome has a pointy gold hat on his head and is wearing a long,
white lab coat.  He is standing in front of the huge hydroponic machine,
studying the dials and measures.  He makes some notes on his clip board
and begins to review his paperwork.  He looks quit busy, better not
mess with him.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome walks along the vine trails examining flowers.
longdesc:
The gnome is wearing some standard issue gnome wear.  He walks along
the wooden walkways making notes on a clip board.  He stops to examine
some flowers and jots down a few more notes.  Clipping off a bloom,
he taps it on his hand and a monsum appears.  Making another note, he
continues along the walkway.

name: a dirty earthworm
shortdesc: A dirty earthworm wiggles its way up the steel wire.
longdesc:
The earthworm is about 8 inches long, so it is just a little bigger than
you are.  It appears to be enjoying the mist from the sprinkling system.  
Some of the dirt is even being washed off!

name: a garden beetle
shortdesc: A large garden beetle crawls along the wooden pathway.
longdesc:
The sparkling green beetle makes its way along the wooden pathway.  It
stops to smell some flowers and flutters its wings with excitement.
The beetle looks roughly the size of a giant bear from this angle.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome walks along the vine trails examining flowers.
longdesc:
The gnome is wearing some standard issue gnome wear.  He walks along
the wooden walkways making notes on a clip board.  He stops to examine
some flowers and jots down a few more notes.  Clipping off a bloom,
he taps it on his hand and a monsum appears.  Making another note, he
continues along the walkway.

name: a pretty hummingbird
shortdesc: A pretty hummingbird buzzes around the flower blooms.
longdesc:
The wings of the hummingbird almost blow you off the wooden walkway
as you approach it.  The hummingbird is sipping some nectar from inside
some of the blooms.  It quickly zips around eats all it can.

name: a large centipede
shortdesc: A large centipede inches and squirms along the thin wires.
longdesc:
The hundred feet of this creature move its wiggling and gyrating body
along the thin wires of the vine wall.  It appears to be about ten
inches long, about twice your height.  The insect appears to be enjoying
the water sprayed from the sprinkling system.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome is chipping away at the rocks and crystals.
longdesc:
Sparks fly around the gnomes head as he chips away at the rocks.  He
grabs some crystals that he has placed on the table and continues to
chip and work them into shape.  The tools he uses look like little
hammers and chisels.  He is very busy.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome is sorting some crystals on the tables.
longdesc:
The gnome grabs some crystals from the table and gathers them into the
whicker baskets.  He is sorting the crystals according to color and
size.  The light reflected through the crystals is quite brilliant and
lovely.

name: a small gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome is sleeping inside the glowing green gel.
longdesc:
The gnome looks totally serene and peaceful.  He is curled into the
fetal position and floats freely through the gel.  He does not even
wake up with your intrusion to the regeneration chamber.

name: a shrunken hill giant
shortdesc: A shruken hill giant is strapped to an examination table.
longdesc:
The shurken hill giant is in a deep sleep atop the examination table.
The gnomes have strapped it down just in case it wakes up.

name: the gnome princess
shortdesc: The young gnome princess sits upon the large pink bloom.
longdesc:
The princess slouches in her throne and appears to be falling asleep.
She does not seem the least bit interested in the family duties.  She
has a pointy silver hat on her head and is wearing a white shirt with
silver pants.

name: the gnome queen
shortdesc: The gnome queen sits upon the large orange bloom.
longdesc:
The queen looks very regal and sits straight up in her lovely looking
throne.  The queen has a pointy gold hat on her head.  She is dressed
in a white shirt with silver pants.  She looks at her husband with
concern as you enter the throne room.

name: the king gnome
shortdesc: The king gnome sits upon the large pitch-black bloom.
longdesc:
The king is dressed in a white shirt with gold pants.  He has a pointy
gold hat upon his head.  Looking at you with a kind smile, he does not
appear at all worried that a stranger is in the throne room.

name: a gateguard
shortdesc: A gateguard is standing here.
longdesc:
A gateguard is here to stop any one who does not belong, he is heavily
armored.  You are suprised he can even move with all his heavy platemail.

name: an archer
shortdesc: An archer stands here looking out into the forest.
longdesc:
A archer stands here watching the forest, he give you a glance as you
walk by.  The archer is very lightly armored but his bow is huge and
looks like it could send an arrow through most armor.

name: a blue guard
shortdesc: A blue guard stands here.
longdesc:
A blue guard stands here polishing his armor to get ready for his duties
of the day.

name: a green guard
shortdesc: A green guard stands here.
longdesc:
A green guard stands here polishing his armor to get ready for his duties
of the day.

name: a yellow guard
shortdesc: A yellow guard stands here.
longdesc:
A yellow guard stands here polishing his armor to get ready for his duties
of the day.

name: a purple guard
shortdesc: A purple guard stands here.
longdesc:
A purple guard stands here polishing his armor to get ready for his duties

shortdesc: A black guard stands here.
longdesc:
A black guard stands here polishing his armor to get ready for his duties

name: a brown guard
shortdesc: A brown guard stands here.
longdesc:
A brown guard stands here polishing his armor to get ready for his duties
of the day.

name: a mystic
shortdesc: A mystic stands here.
longdesc:
A mystic stands here by his desk studying a book, he looks around as
you come in and says you are not welcome here.  He is one old centaur
maybe you should leave him be before gets crabby.

name: a shaman
shortdesc: A shaman warrior stands here.
longdesc:
A shaman stands here mixing potions, he gives you quizical look as you
enter.  A shaman is clothed in a simple silk shirt.  The shaman looks
like he is a trained warrior besides being a shaman.

name: a centaur warrior
shortdesc: A strong centaur warrior stares at you menacingly.
longdesc:
The warrior is clothed in simple furs of what appears to be varying
colored wolf pelts.  The warrior has had alot of fighting experience
if the scars he sports are an indication of past battles.

name: a bard
shortdesc: A bard stands here.
longdesc:
A bard is gentley strumming his lute, he stops as you enter and turns
to you.  The bard is dressed in very fine silks, he must be well liked
by the king and queen to wear such fine attire.

name: a lieutenant
shortdesc: The lieutenant stands here looking agitated.
longdesc:
The lieutenant stands up as you enter and puts down the sharping stone
he was using on his sword.  He does not put down the sword however.

name: a captain
shortdesc: The captain stands here looking over his boards.
longdesc:
The captain stands here looking at his boards.  The captain is wearing
what appears to be mainly ceremonial armor.

name: a maid
shortdesc: The maid is here relaxing.
longdesc:
The maid is dressed in simple wool clothing. The maid looks pretty tired
obviously she is relaxing after a long days work.

name: a clerk
shortdesc: The clerk stands here.
longdesc:
The clerk is proably the smallest centaur you have seen so far. The
clerk is dressed in a suit.... well a suit for a centaur at least.

name: a city guard
shortdesc: A city guard patrols the village.
longdesc:
The city guard would appear to be more of a police officer then anything
else, he is lightly armored in leather.  The city guard looks pretty
young, it would appear his armor is older then him.

name: armorer
shortdesc: An armorer stands here working on a piece of armor.
longdesc:
The armorer is standing behind one of the display cases.  He has on
simple leather armor.  He looks like if a customer gets out of hand
though he might be able to handle them with the hammer he has at his
side.

name: Darnel the Weapons Smith
shortdesc: Darnel the Weapons Smith stands by his forge.
longdesc:
Darnel the Weapons Smith looks to have been around a forge most of his life,
his hands look like they could double for clubs they are so hardenened
for working with a hammer and hot metal.  The weapons smith looks at you
and you get the feeling you should give him your weapon to be repaired
and be on your way.

name: cleric
shortdesc: A cleric stands here.
longdesc:
The cleric stands here mixing potions.  The cleric appears to have had
at least one potion go awry atleast you hope it was a potion, he has a
greenish tent.

name: a centaur youth
shortdesc: A youth wanders about the village.
longdesc:
The youth wanders about aimlessly looking for other youths to play with.
He is dressed orange and white leathers.

name: the royal mage
shortdesc: The royal mage stands here.
longdesc:
The mage stands here right next to his king, so he can give him any
advice that he needs.  He is dressed in silk and holds a crystal wand.

name: the royal priest
shortdesc: The priest is here praying.
longdesc:
The priest is dressed in green robes which is covered in runes.  He
stands up as you enter and says, "How may I help you my son".

name: a bodyguard
shortdesc: The bodyguard stands here.
longdesc:
The bodyguard is by far the biggest centaur you have seen.  Whoever made
his armor has put alot of time into, it is very ornate.  The bodyguard
has massive forearms that are covered in runes on his skin.

name: The centaur king
shortdesc: The king sits here upon his throne.

name: a prince
shortdesc: The prince is here playing with his toys.
longdesc:
The prince is still tiny.  He is here playing with his toys.  The prince
is dressed in black silks.  He seems very active and seems to be enjoying
him self.

name: The queen
shortdesc: The queen is relaxing here.
longdesc:
The queen is dressed in silks and has all kinds of expensive jewerly.
She is the most beautiful centaur you have seen no wander she is the
queen.

name: Chielna
shortdesc: Chielna stands here.
longdesc:
Chielna leader of all the blue guards. He is massive and has many battle scars,
which would suggest he would be a worthy oppenent.

name: Yoamora
shortdesc: Yoamora stands here.
longdesc:
Yoamora stands looking or ancient manuscripts of ancient spells. She has
many golden trinkets braided in to her tail. She mos be a well respected
member among the centaurs.

name: Sielina
shortdesc: Sielina stands here.
longdesc: Sielina stands here looking more then capable of defending her fellow centaurs.

name: a black scorpion
shortdesc: A black scorpion raises its tail and rears to attack.
longdesc:
A black scorpion skitters out from under a rock and snaps its claws at
you.  Its tail begins to twitch, slowly raises and forms a sort of
question mark.  A drop of poison drips from its tail and burns straight
through the sand.

name: a scaly lizard
shortdesc: A green scaly lizard flicks its tongue and runs under a rock.
longdesc:
The lizard has bright white eyes that seem to twirl in its sockets.  It
tilts its little head to the right, looking at you almost quizmically.
Flicking its tongue at you quickly, it turns and runs under the nearest
rock.

name: an old scientist
shortdesc: An old scientist is examining the hieroglyphics.
longdesc:
The scientist's gray hair reveals his age.  He has a long beard growing
from his face.  He appears to be in deep thought as he ponders the
etchings on the front of the sarcophagus.  Rasing his hand, he carefully
traces the intricate patterns with his fingers and continues to converse
with his colleagues.

name: a writing scientist
shortdesc: A young scientist is carefully making notes on a clipboard.
longdesc:
The scientist is completely wrapped up in his work.  He stares carefully
at the etchings on the wall and makes some quick notes on his clipboard.
He continues this process until he has examined every inch of the wall.

name: a sifting scientist
shortdesc: A scientist carefully sifts through the sands in the catacombs.
longdesc:
Carrying a mesh net tray, the scientest carefully shovels a small amount
of sand into it and shakes it ever so carefully.  The sands falls through
the net to the ground, leaving small pieces of remnants from the decaying
wall.  He looks pleased with himself as he stop to catagorize his find
and repeats the process.

name: a scared scientist
shortdesc: A scared scientist cowers in fear against the walls of the catacombs.
longdesc:
The scientist seems to have been through quite an ordeal.  Cowering in
fear, the poor man has his arms covering his head, as though he is
protecting himself from something.  What could he be so afraid of?

name: a frightened scientist
shortdesc: A frightened scientist runs around the room, screaming his head off.
longdesc:
The poor man is running around the room like a chicken with its head
cut off.  "Mummies.....  MUMMIES!", the screaming man is proclaiming.
What on earth is he talking about?  The scientist runs up to you and
grabs your shirt yelling, "Can't you seem them?!  Run for your lives!".

name: a worried scientist
shortdesc: A worried scientist looks around with a panicked look on his face.
longdesc:
The scientist seems to be sweating profusely, large beads of sweat pour
down his face.  He wipes his face with his sleeve and nervously looks
around for signs of trouble.  He looks from is colleagues

name: A mummy
shortdesc: A bandage-wrapped mummy lunges at you from across the room.
longdesc:
The mummy is wrapped completely in some white cloth bandages.  Its
mouth slowly opens, letting loose an inhuman moan.  The moan chills you
to your very core.

name: A wandering mummy
shortdesc: A bandage-wrapped mummy slowly creeps through the catacombs.
longdesc:
The mummy is completely wrapped in white cloth bandages.  It slowly
creeps up and down the hallways of the catacomb, dragging a foot behind
it.  The mummy raises its arms and changes directions, right towards 
you.

name: A wandering 2nd level mummy
shortdesc: A bandage-wrapped mummy slowly creeps through the catacombs.
longdesc:
The mummy is completely wrapped in white cloth bandages.  It slowly
creeps up and down the hallways of the catacomb, dragging a foot behind
it.  The mummy raises its arms and changes directions, right towards 
you.  It opens its mouth and lets loose and inhuman moan.

name: A royal mummy
shortdesc: A bandage-wrapped mummy stands guard over the pharaoh's sarcophagus.
longdesc:
The mummy is completely wrapped in white bandages.  It holds a long
wooden spear and has some ceremonial dressings draped over its shoulders.
It quickly notices that you have invaded its pharaohs final resting
place and rears to attack.

name: Prince Khufaru
shortdesc: The mummy of Prince Khufaru slowly rises from his sarcophagus.
longdesc:
A tiny hand slowly raises from the sarcophagus, grasping at the air
like it needs to breath.  The prince throws back the cover and stands
straight up on the altar.  He stairs straight at you with a look of
pure hatred moaning, "My toys..... my toys.".  Jumping off the altar,
the young Prince Khufaru charges right towards you.

name: Queen Nefertari
shortdesc: The mummy of Queen Nefertari quickly crawls across the floor towards you.
longdesc:
Queen Nefertari is completely wrapped in ancient, off-white cloth bandages.
She slowly crawls hand over hand, dragging her long dead body out from the
overturned sarcophagus like a Ray Harryhausen special effect.  She lets out
an unholy moan and quickens her movement as she senses warm bodies.

name: Pharaoh Ammunae
shortdesc: The mummy of Pharaoh Ammunae stares down at you with contempt.
longdesc:
Pharaoh Ammunae is wrapped completely in ages-old, off-white cloth bandages.
He stands arms crossed on the top of the white marble altar.  Looking down at
you with the utmost comtempt, Pharaoh Ammunae starts to moan in a particularly
disturbing manner.  You can tell that he is letting you know you are very much
not welcome here.

name: a blue scarab
shortdesc: A blue scarab crawls quickly across the walls of the catacomb.
longdesc:
The scarab rather large.  It seems to glow with a deep blue sapphire
luster as the light from the torches lining the catacomb walls reflects
off its shell.  The scarab buzzes its wings at you and flies off down
the hallway.

name: a thief
shortdesc: A black robed thief stares at you from the darkness.
longdesc:
The thief darts in and out of the shadows of the room.  The collapsed
hallways and overturned coffins provide him excellent cover to hide.
A sparkling gleam reflects from his belt as the light from the hallways
shines in.  What could he be hiding there?

name: A mummified servant
shortdesc: A linen-wrapped mummy walks lazily around the room.
longdesc:
The mummy is completely wrapped in off-white, low-quality linen.  It walks
around the room picking up the mess, much like it must have when it was
alive.

name: A stone statue
shortdesc: A gigantic stone statue blocks any further travel to the north.
longdesc:
The stone statue stoically stands guard along the swirling vortex's
path.  It looks down at you and smiles, but impassively returns to
guarding whatever lies to the north.  What could be over there?
"Please read the sign.", it says to you with its eyes closed.

name: a golden scarab
shortdesc: A golden scarab crawls quickly across the floors of the catacomb.
longdesc:
This is a large sacred scarab beetle of the genus Scarabaeus.  It has a
lustrous golden sheen that shimmers like oil on water.  And, most notably,
a series of hieroglyphs that seem to be carved in relief on the shell of
the creature that spell the word 'AMMUNAE'.  That's probably some sort of
clue.

name: Vicyrae Arkenzynge
shortdesc: Vicyrae Arkenzynge, handmaid of Lloth, is here casting her Dweomer on the tower.
longdesc:
This is Vicyrae Arkenzynge.  She looks like any other drow female, with
hair as white as new snow and skin as black as coal - not brown or tan -
black, like the sky on a starless night.  However, Vicyrae is not a
mortal woman, instead she is one of the closest servants of the Spider
Queen, a handmaid who appears in this form on this plane.  And, unlike
the mortal drow she resembles, she stands well over ten feet tall, and
possesses a strength that would make a giant blush.

name: Lillith Lhalabax
shortdesc: Lillith Lhalabax, the Crimon Lady, stands here planning her next moves.
longdesc:
Born a commoner in the Drow city of Rakdagor, Lillith Lhalabax had a hard
upbringing.  Her mother, a poor disciple of a minor sect of the Spider
Queen, worked hard to get Lillith a place in the main temple complex as
an initiate.  But on Lillith's first day, to gain acknowledgement of the
Archmistress of the Temple, she successfully evaded a dozen guards and
murdered her own mother using just the laces of her boot to garrote the
poor woman.  The Archmistress, suitably impressed, initiated Lillith in
to the Sisterhood of the Crimson Dawn, a group of non-priestly females
who did simple murder-for-hire on behalf of the temple.  Lillith quickly
ascended the ranks but was disillusioned with the Archmistress and sought
more exotic custom for her skills.  Eventually she took command of the
Crimson Dawn and disavowed it from the Temple, renaming it to the Crimson
Night and moving her headquarters to a tower on the surface to provide
more work for her trusted sisters. She is a powerful and lithe figure of
authority, with the tell-tale dark skin of the Drow and dyed crimson hair.
She possesses the skills of a master assassin and the cunning of a decorated
general, and perhaps most importantly, she is revered by the very Goddess
she worships.

name: Alicyn Zynn
shortdesc: Alicyn Zynn, commander of the Crimson Night stands here, giving orders.
longdesc:
Alicyn Zynn is an unusually short and thick-set Drow.  She was a waif on
the streets of Rakdagor when she was found by Lillith Lhalabax and brought
in to what was then known as the Sisterhood of the Crimson Dawn.  When
Lillith rebelled and took control of the group, so Alicyn stood by her as
a trusted lieutenant - unusual for the cruel and chaotic drow.  Her brute
strength and skill were key to Lillith's success, and she acts now as the
Commander of the Crimson Night, leaving the Crimson Lady herself to deal
with more important matters.  She wears her hair shaved at the sides and
hanging in a braid down her back, and dyed the crimson of the order.  She
is a fierce fighter and not one be trifled with.

name: Crimson Sister Mazzra
shortdesc: Crimson Sister Mazzra stands guard here, leaning against a wall and looking bored.
longdesc:
Crimson Sister Mazzra is a member of the elite drow sisterhood of
assassins known as the Crimson Night.  Her naturally white hair
has been dyed crimson.  She looks capable of defending herself.

longdesc:

shortdesc: Crimson Sister Talabax is sitting on a stair here, cleaning her nails.
longdesc:
Crimson Sister Talabax is a member of the elite drow sisterhood

name: Crimson Sister Knaffa
shortdesc: Crimson Sister Knaffa is here, practicing her martial skills.
longdesc:
Crimson Sister Knaffa is a member of the elite drow sisterhood
of assassins known as the Crimson Night.  Her naturally white hair

name: Crimson Sister Thrace
shortdesc: Crimson Sister Thrace is here, looking for her next assignment.
longdesc:
Crimson Sister Thrace is a member of the elite drow sisterhood
of assassins known as the Crimson Night.  Her naturally white hair
has been dyed crimson.  She looks capable of defending herself.
She was acting as bodyguard for one of the tower residents but
is now freed from that task and available to pursue things that
interest her more.

name: Crimson Sister Qaytee
shortdesc: Crimson Sister Qaytee is here, reading quietly.
longdesc:
Crimson Sister Qaytee is a member of the elite drow sisterhood
of assassins known as the Crimson Night.  Her naturally white hair
has been dyed crimson.  She looks capable of defending herself.

name: Dread Drider Durnyl
shortdesc: The Dread Drider Durnyl is here, prowling the killing fields
longdesc:
Before being cursed to a life of mindless servitude, Durnyl was a strong
and capable drow male of house Misraria.  He rose in the ranks and became,
eventually, a prominent weapon master and duellist.  He was famed in the
city Rakdagor for his prowess, and it was rumoured he was even looked on
as breeding stock by the most noble of the competing families.  It was in
his arrogance that he had a young member of the Crimson Dawn whipped for
having the audacity to look at him in a way he disliked.  That mistake
cost him dear, for that young drow grew to become the Crimson Lady, and
she never forgot the punishment he gave.  Her first act, when she took
over the order and disavowed herself from the Temple, was to snare the
lackless male in a trap and gifted him her Kiss, the curse all males in
the drow society fear, the transformation in to a mindless drider.  Now
the Crimson Lady's personal pet, he is tasked with guarding the way to
the old border tower.

name: a tormented kitten
shortdesc: A cute little tabby kitten is here, hissing at her tormentor.
longdesc:
This is a very young kitten, no more than a month or two old.  She is
a dark tabby in colour with short hair.  She is being tormented by the
drow.  Be a hero and step in and rescue her!

name: Sergeant Gwilliam
shortdesc: Sergeant Gwilliam, last survivor of the old Border Tower is here, fettered to the wall.
longdesc:
This is the old and grizzled Sergeant Gwilliam, the last remaining survivor
the old border tower.  He witnessed the drow rise up and murder his friends
with furious, hateful glee.  He fought as hard as he could but he was just
too slow to stop them.  After many weeks of toying with him, torturing him,
giving a teaser of escape and than snatching it away from him, they have
finally grown bored and have left him to die slowly in a dark, dank room,
with no light.  And to keep him company, they piled in the corpses of his
colleagues, to rot and stink and decompose before him.  He wishes for
death, but a warriors death... Will you provide it?

name: Honorary Sister Daethie Ulaven
shortdesc: Honorary Sister Daethie Ulaven is here, casting her magic.
longdesc:
The Crimson Night is a sisterhood of assassins, but even they need the
powers of a mage occasionally, for transportation, protection, and when
all else fails, for that explosive damage they can deal out.  Daethie
Ulaven is on loan from the Arcane Academy of Rakdagor, where her skills
and extreme malice have her earned her praise from her peers.  Although
not a member of the Sisterhood, they treat her like one of their own, 
as an equal, a fact that has not gone unnoticed on the powerful spell
weaver.  She too has dyed her hair crimson, in honour of the order.

name: the Vile Spectre
shortdesc: The Vile Spectre of a long dead commander is here, wailing in eternal pain.
longdesc:
This is the spectre of a fallen commander of the tower, but you can't
tell who it was in life.  Whatever happened to the commander, it was
violent and terrible, but that wasn't the sole reason that this person
now stands as one of the most reviled undead in the Realms.  It had
obviously been laid to rest without becoming the creature that now
howls and cries before you.  It has been risen by the drow, for their
own amusement and to torment the poor soul, proving that even in the
grips of death, they can get you.  It is a transparant thing, shaped
like a human, although the gender is hard to discern, with strands
of luminous hair that rise from the head as if struck by electricity.
It reaches out, but can't seem to move from the gravesite with those
strange chains wrapped around it that rise from the soil below - as
if to add injury, the drow also bound it to this place, and for that
it screams, and screams, screeching in to the forever dark night in
pain and anger.  There is nothing you can do.  Leave it, and leave
this cursed place.

name: The animated corpse of a Tower Soldier
shortdesc: The animated corpse of a tower soldier is here, groaning.
longdesc:
This is the animated corpse of a luckless soldier of the border tower.
Whomever he was in life, he didn't deserve to end like this.

name: The animated corpse of Erin Lockheart
shortdesc: The animated corpse of the border tower commander Erin Lockheart is here.
longdesc:
This is the animated corpse of Erin Lockheart.  She was known to be beautiful
and strong, but now all that is left is this rotting cadaver of blackened and
purpled meat with lank red hair and dead white eyes.

name: The animated corpse of an old soldier
shortdesc: The animated corpse of an old soldier is here, swaying in the wind.
longdesc:
This is the animated corpse of an old soldier.  Probably one of the Commanders
trusted lieutenants.  But now its no more than a fleshy, stinky thing held in
place by foul magic.

name: a carrion crawler
shortdesc: A carrion crawler lurks here, chewing on some long-dead meat.
longdesc:
A carrion crawler is a burrowing aberration that scavenges the dead and
occasionally preys on living creatures.  This latter fact, however, is
entirely unproven as these creatures are as rare as rocking-horse poop.
Similar in size to a giant, with a body reminiscent of a centipede, with
a tentacled mouth, the crawler is often accompanied by a foul odor of
death - and this one certainly does stink.  A fact caused by the diet of
rotting soldiers it has been living on.  Although considered by most to
be an aberration, Doctor Sagacious Blackwood of the Midgard Zoological
Society has repeatedly argued that these are natural animals to the
Realms and have evolved in the deep places due to an abundance of
carrion.

name: a flesh golem guardian
shortdesc: A mindless flesh golem stands here, protecting Daethie Ulaven.
longdesc:
This golem is a fleshy representative of a humanoid.  It has been crafted
from an assortment of body parts, all stitched together with enchanted
thread, and animated by a mage of incredible power; in this case, the
animator being Deathie Ulaven.  This particular specimen looks to made
from the corpse-parts of many of this tower's former residents.  It stands
around seven feet tall and looks incredibly strong.  Rumours about these
things suggest that it is slow but extremely powerful with abilities that
include a resistance to magic.  It is likely to tear you apart like you
are made of paper.

name: a flying demon
shortdesc: A winged demon flies freely throughout the large abyss.
longdesc:
Completely black, the demon looks almost like a shadow flying through
the air.  It comes to a complete stop and begins to look around the
abyss.  A red glimmer emits from its eye sockets as it glares around
its surroundings.  What could it be looking for?  It's diffcult to 
judge as it floats in the air, but the demon seems to be about seven
feet tall.  A long curved neck stretches out from the top of its torso.
Its head looks like a hammerhead sharks, lying lengthwise on the top
of its neck.

name: an eating demon
shortdesc: A winged demon greedily devours on a lost soul.
longdesc:
The demon hovers in mid-air with a glowing blue soul in its claws.  It
rips and tears at the poor soul's flesh with its vicious looking teeth.
Whipping its long neck into the air, the demon gulps down large pieces
of the soul.  It is difficult to tell from here, but the demon appears
to be about seven feet tall.  Its body is completely black, except for
the deep red glimmer from its eyes.  The demon seems to notice you
as its long neck slowly turns in your direction, but it quickly returns
to its meal.

name: a fighting demon
shortdesc: A winged demon fights with all its might against another demon.
longdesc:
Loud shrieks are coming from the demon.  It is difficult to tell if it
is shrieking from pleasure or pain.  It claws at its friend with both 
hands and feet.  They seem to be fighting over a lost soul that is 
grasped in one of the demon's feet.  Unfortunately for both of them, 
the soul has wiggled free and is drifting back down towards the bottom 
of the abyss.

name: a fighting demon
shortdesc: A winged demon fights against a terrordon with its clawed feet.
longdesc:
Swooping and twisting through the air, the demon slashes its sharply
clawed feet at the terrordon.  It does not seem to want to get close
to the mighty creature.  It flaps its wings and flies back into the
air.  Letting out a ear-splitting shriek, it speeds down and under
the terrordon, slicing at its underbelly.

name: a fighting demon
shortdesc: A winged demon claws viciously at a flaming sulfiend.
longdesc:
It is strange to see an almost worried look on the demon's face.  It
backs up anytime the sulfiend gets close to it.  Holding tightly to 
the soul grasped in its feet, the demon slashes its sharp claws at the 
flaming sulfiend.  Its claws start to blister and pop the longer it 
draws out the fight.

name: a climbing demon
shortdesc: A wingless demon crawls quickly along the walls of the abyss.
longdesc:
The black demon looks almost like a snake as it crawls along the rocky
walls of the abyss.  This must be a lesser demon because it has not 
grown the wings of its brothers.  It twists its long neck and hisses
at you as it senses your presence.  The demon's claws look very sharp.
You probably should not get too close.

name: a lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul stares at you with a blank look on its face.
longdesc:
A blue glow pulses from the opaque white body of the lost soul.  Its
face is rather featureless except for two pale white eyes.  The eyes
contrast nicely with the pulsing color emitting from its body.  The
creature looks at you blankly, tilting its head from side to side.  It
must not sense you are a threat as it goes back to floating through
the fires of the cavern floor.

name: a screaming lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul screams in pain as it burns eternally in the fire.
longdesc:
The glowing blue soul does not seem to be in pain, but it is screaming
at the top of its lungs.  The soul's body is an opaque white that has
a dull blue pulse emitting from it.  Its pale eyes stare up into the 
air as it lets loose another tirade of wails.  It begins to drift away
as you get closer.

name: a writhing lost soul
shortdesc: The lost soul twists and contorts in pain as it burns in the fire.
longdesc:
This poor soul is doubled over in pain, its body twists and contorts
in unnatural directions.  It hovers inches above the ground, slowing
summersaulting through the intense flames.  The soul is completely
opaque white and has a blue pulse emitting from deep within its body.

name: a crying lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul hovers in the air, crying quietly to itself.
longdesc:
The soul is completely opaque white and has a blue glow emitting from
deep inside its body.  The soul hovers in mid-air, holding its hands
over its eyes.  Shining silver tears leak out from its eyes, fall into
the air and down into the flaming fires below.

name: a half-eaten lost soul
shortdesc: A half-eaten lost soul lies all too still in the air.
longdesc:
This poor creature is not happy.  A lost arm, half a leg and a large
section of its torso has been ripped out.  Its pale white eyes stare
at you with no emotion.  At least the lost soul does not seem to be
in any pain.

name: a tasty lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul does not seem concerned that a demon is feasting on it.
longdesc:
The soul rests quietly within the demon's claws.  It does not squirm or
try to escape its captor's grasp.  Its pale white eyes stare at you
blankly, even as the demon rips into its body and tears off some flesh.

name: a sulfiend
shortdesc: A glowing pair of eyes stares at you from within a ball of flame.
longdesc:
The flaming creature looks like a giant match stick engulfed in a ball
of fire.  What looks like a silver strand of fabric runs through the
middle of the sulfiend where the stick of a match would be.  A glowing 
pair of red eyes stares out at you from the top of the fireball with 
utter hatred.  Some flame-like hands begin to form and reach out from
the middle of the sulfiend.  It slowly begins to move towards you.

name: a fighting sulfiend
shortdesc: A flaming sulfiend closes in on a flying demon.
longdesc:
The flames burning around the sulfiend seem to be getting hotter and
turn from red to white.  The sulfiend's eyes are completely focused
on the demon and the lost soul in the demon's clutches.  It has not
even noticed how close you have gotten to its battles.  The sulfiend
must be very hungry.

name: a flaming demon
shortdesc: A flaming demon strides along the cavern floor.
longdesc:
The demon looks almost exactly like its flying brothers except it has
no wings.  Its skin is a flaming ruby red, unlike the pitch-black
luster of the demons flying above your head.  Laughing and smiling,
the demons walks along the cavern floor whipping the hell out of any
lost soul it can attack.  The whip appears to be made is pure fire and
looks to be about eight feet in length.

name: a flaming worm
shortdesc: A fire red worm swims freely through the flames on the cavern floor.
longdesc:
This creature is enormous!  The worm is ruby red in color.  It appears
to be about thirty feet long and almost just as wide.  It swims freely
through the flames as though it was wading through water.  Lost souls
have grabbed onto the sides of the worm and seem to be enjoying the 
ride.  At least they probably would be if they could show any emotions.

name: a flying terrordon
shortdesc: A flying beast charges at you in mid-air.
longdesc:
The terrordon is about the size of a large elephant and is sandy brown
in complexion.  It is covered from the top of its neck to the base of 
its back with pointy spikes.  A long tail swings behing the creature 
with a spiked ball at the end.  Its face looks like a large shield
with long, curved spikes sticking out from ten o'clock, twelve o'clock
and two o'clock.  It leaps around the air as though it was walking on 
the ground.  The terrordon turns and charges at you when it realizes 
you are staring at it.

name: a fighting terrordon
shortdesc: An angry terrordon savagely bites at the lost soul in a demon's arms.
longdesc:
The terrordon is about the size of a large elephant and is sandy brown
in complexion.  It is covered from the top of its neck to the base of 
its back with pointy spikes.  A long tail swings behind the creature 
with a spiked ball at the end.  Its face looks like a large shield
with long, curved spikes sticking out from ten o'clock, twelve o'clock
and two o'clock.  It charges through the air and tries to gorge the
flying demon before it.  The terrordon takes a large bite out of the
lost soul in the demon's arms and continues its charge.  Turning
around, it rears on its hind legs and starts into another charge.

name: a climbing terrordon
shortdesc: A terrordon makes its way across the cavern walls.
longdesc:
The terrordon is a little different from the flying ones.  The spikes
on its body have not fully developed and it only has one long, curved
spike sticking out from the top of its shield-like head.  Its tail is
short and does not have a spiked ball on it.  The terrordon does not
seem to be able to fly freely, but it easily walks up and down the 
walls of the abyss.

name: a mother terrordon
shortdesc: An angry terrordon stomps its feet on the ground and prepares to charge.
longdesc:
This is a strange terrordon indeed.  Its back and neck are completely
smooth.  There are spikes all over the terridon's face, almost like
a very scary meat tendorizer.  It seems to be guarding something that
is in the back of the cave.  What could that be?  It stomps its feet at
you, shaking the cavern walls a little.

name: a baby terrordon
shortdesc: A baby terrordon crawls around the cavern floor.
longdesc:
Awwww, how cute.  The baby crawls around the cavern floor with its
brothers and sisters.  It fights over some scraps of lost souls with
its new family and then starts to chase another baby around the room.

name: a crying baby terrordon
shortdesc: A baby terrordon cries as it tries to break free from its egg shell.
longdesc:
The baby terrordon screams and cries as it tries to break free from its
egg.  It rolls over and uses its legs to kick apart the egg shell, 
finally freeing itself.  Standing and shaking off some birth slime, it
yawns and joins it brothers and sisters.

name: a flying tunnel demon
shortdesc: A winged demon hovers a few inches above the floor of the rocky cavern.
longdesc:
A pair of glowing red eyes stares out at you from the shadows.  Emerging
from the darkness, the flying demon glides into the middle of the cavern
hallway.  The demon flaps its leathery black wings, kicking up some
dust in the hallway.  It unclenches its claws with a *snikt*, revealing
long blade-like nails.  You almost think its smiling as it closes in,
blocking your escape down another cavern hallway.

name: a climbing tunnel demon
shortdesc: A wingless demon creeps along the walls of the rocky hallway.
longdesc:
The black demon looks almost like a snake as it crawls along the rocky
walls of the hallway.  This must be a lesser demon because it has not 
grown the wings of its brothers.  It twists its long neck and hisses
at you as it senses your presence.  The demon's claws look very sharp.
You probably should not get too close.

name: a feasting tunnel demon
shortdesc: A winged demon crouches in the corner, feasting on a lost soul.
longdesc:
Silvery blood drips down the demon's chin, pooling into a puddle on the
cavern floor.  The demon is crouched down with its wings tucked behind
its back.  It shoves its face into the lost soul, ripping off a large
piece of opaque white flesh and tilts its head back to gulp it down.
The demon seems to tilt its head slightly in your direction, but not
sensing you are not a threat returns to its meal.

name: a shrieking tunnel demon
shortdesc: A winged demon shrieks loudly at you from the back of the cave.
longdesc:
The demon opens its mouth and lets out an ear-piercing shriek from the
back of the cavern.  Spreading out its leathery wings, it flaps them
at you in a brasen attempt of bravado.  It does not seem to want to get
close to you, maybe it is calling for back-up?

name: a tunnel terrordon
shortdesc: A large terrordon stomps through the rocky hallways.
longdesc:
Shaking and rumbling the rocky hallways, the terrodon charges in your
direction.  Its large head is tilted down, horns barred.  It lets
out a mighty roar and begins to pick up speed as it closes in.

name: a half-eaten lost tunnel soul
shortdesc: A half-eaten lost soul lies all too still on the cavern floor.
longdesc:
Lying in a pool of its own silvery blood, this poor creature looks a
sad sight.  Missing a leg, half its arm and a majority of its mid-
section, this lost soul is truely a mess.  Its head turns to you as
you enter this part of the cavern and stare blankly.  At least it does
not seem to be in much pain.

name: a lost tunnel soul
shortdesc: A lost soul stares at you with a blank look on its face.
longdesc:
A blue glow pulses from the opaque white body of the lost soul.  Its
face is rather featureless except for two pale white eyes.  The eyes
contrast nicely with the pulsing color emitting from its body.  The
creature looks at you blankly, tilting its head from side to side.  It
must not sense you are a threat as it goes back to wandering through
the cavernous hallways.

name: Greed
shortdesc: A grinning demon stares down at your from the pile of treasures.
longdesc:
Emerging from the shadows, the demon Greed stares down at you with
a dangerous grin.  It is dressed in the most decadent armor that you
have ever seen, most likely stripped from the corpses of previous
adventurers.  "My treasure, huh?", the demon finally speaks.  "If you
think you are going to get your hands on it.... it will be the last
thought in your little head.".  It grasps a hilt on its waist and
draws an unnaturally large and long sword.  Grinning even further when
it notices your shock it disappears from the top of the pile.  *POOF*
Reappearing directly if front of you it says, "Hmm.... I think you have 
something I could add to my collection."  Its face turns from a smile 
and contorts into wraith-like scream, "GIVE IT TO ME!".

name: a fighting warrior
shortdesc: A warrior brandishes its sword and swings for its teammate.
longdesc:
The warrior's flesh is practically falling from its bones.  It's
obvious that this poor creature has been here forever.  It is dressed
in the usual attire of a warrior, but you notice that all of the
warriors are dressed alike.  What could be so valuable that teammates
are turning on each other?  Whatever it is, the warrior is completely
content with slicing and dicing through its friends to get it.

name: a kicking warrior
shortdesc: A warrior kicks its teammate in the leg with a powerful hit.
longdesc:
Dodging an attack from its teammate, the warrior quick rolls across
the cavern floor and kicks out a teammate's legs from beneath it.  The
warrior quickly stands and runs towards the altar, only to be punched
in the face and fall to the floor.  What carnage!  The warrior's flesh 
is practically falling from its bones.  It's obvious that this poor 
creature has been here forever.  It is dressed in the usual attire of a
warrior, but you notice that all of the warriors are dressed alike. 
This is no way for teammates to act!

name: a ground warrior
shortdesc: A warrior reaches up for the altar as its teammates pummel it mercilessly.
longdesc:
Crawling across the floor, the warrior heads directly towards the altar.
The undead warrior tries to stand but quickly falls back to the floor
with two shattered legs.  Finally reaching the altar, it reaches up
and grabs the diamond, only to have it disappear.  The warrior does
not have must time to grieve as one of its friends smashes its shield
into this poor creatures back.  The warrior's flesh is practically 
falling from its bones.  It's obvious that this poor creature has been 
here forever.  It is dressed in the usual attire of a warrior, but you 
notice that all of the warriors are dressed alike.

name: a punching warrior
shortdesc: A warrior lets out a barrage of punches on its teammates.
longdesc:
Running towards the altar, this warrior barely misses getting its
head cut off by one of its teammates.  It dodges and flips towards the
altar, only to be kicked half way across the cavern.  Standing up and
letting out an unholy scream, the warrior runs across the room and
starts punching anything it can get its fists on.  The warrior's flesh 
is practically falling from its bones.  It's obvious that this poor 
creature has been here forever.  It is dressed in the usual attire of 
a warrior, but you notice that all of the warriors are dressed alike.
It's such a shame when friends fight over possessions.

name: a smashing warrior
shortdesc: A warrior smashes his heavy shield into the middle of his teammates back.
longdesc:
The warrior's flesh is practically falling from its bones.  It's
obvious that this poor creature has been here forever.  It is dressed
in the usual attire of a warrior, but you notice that all of the
warriors are dressed alike.  Smashing anything it can swing its shield
at, the warrior walks through the cavern battling its friends.

name: a grinning shadow
shortdesc: An unholy smile forms in a shadow on the cavern wall.
longdesc:
The shadows begin to swirl as a chesire smile shines in the darkness.
The shadows give form to a head, then torso and finally an entire body 
compossed of darkness.  A hand reaches out from the darkness and 
directly towards you.

name: a smiling shadow
shortdesc: An almost pleasant smile forms in a shadow on the cavern wall.
longdesc:
The shadows begin to swirl as an almost pleasant smile shines out at
you from the darkness.  The shadows give form to a head, then torso and 
finally an entire body compossed of darkness.  A hand reaches out from 
the darkness and directly towards you.

name: a staring shadow
shortdesc: A pair of intense looking eyes form in a shadow on the wall.
longdesc:
The shadows behind the ring begin to swirl as an intense pair of eyes
open up and stare out at you the darkness.  A shadowed hand reaches
out from the darkness and reach for the ring, only to have it disappear
from its grasp.  A loud groan echoes through the cave and the shadows
begin to swirl even faster.  Suddenly, the eyes become part of a shadowed
head as a darkness covered creature steps from the shadows.

name: a fighting soldier
shortdesc: A soldier fights with its teammates in a pile on the cavern floor.
longdesc:
Fighting with its teammates, the soldier struggles with all its might
to keep its hands on the helmet.  It turns and sticks a knife into
one of its friends as they put their hands on it.  Fortunately for them
they are already dead.

name: a kicking soldier
shortdesc: A soldier in the pile kicks one of its teammates in the head.
longdesc:
The soldier struggles to get its hands on the glowing helmet.  It
reaches down to touch the object, only to get bitten by one of its
teammates. Ouch!  The soldier kicks its friend in the face as a thank
you.  Some friend!

name: a ground soldier
shortdesc: A soldier looks up at its teammates from the bottom of the pile.
longdesc:
The soldier jumps to its feet as the glowing helmet wiggles free from
another soldier's grasp and starts to fly around the room.  The soldier
cheers with joy as it grabs the helmet and falls to the ground.
Unfortunately for this soldier, the other soldiers are right behind it
and bury him beneath a pile of their bodies.  The soldier looks up at
its teammates with a smile as realizes it has the treasure in its
hands.

name: a crying soldier
shortdesc: A soldier cries quietly to itself next to the pile of undead men.
longdesc:
Weeping like a wimp, the soldier sits on the cavern floor next to a
pile of its friends and pouts.  It seems that no matter how many times
the glowing helmet circles and flies around the room this soldier can
never get its hands on the treasure.  Poor baby.

name: a mean soldier
shortdesc: A mean looking soldier pokes one of its teammates in the eye.
longdesc:
This soldier will do anything it can to get its hands on the glowing
helmet.  It kicks one of its teammates in the groin, slits another's
throat and forms a peace sign, only to poke another in the eyes.  This
is no way for teamwork to be done!

name: a soldier leader
shortdesc: A large soldier seems to be kicking more ass than the others.
longdesc:
The leader seems to have even less control over its men it death as it
did in life.  It is deeply entrenched in the fighting, stabbing and
punching the hell out of its men.  It stands up and begins to throw
its men around the room, kicking and punching them as they run back.
What a fight!

name: a smiling warrior
shortdesc: A smiling warrior clutches a sledge hammer towards the back of the cave.
longdesc:
A gleaming white smile shines out at you from the back of the cavern.
It is strange that such a thing would occur in a place of total carnage.
A man steps out from the darkness, tightly clutching a brilliant green
sledge hammer to his chest.  His smile turns into a sickly-wide grin
as he notices you staring at his treasure.  "Mine", he says out loud.
"All...... MINE!", he yells, raising the gigantic hammer above his
head and rearing to attack.

name: a greed demon
shortdesc: A demon stands in the back of the cave, clutching its treasures.
longdesc:
The demon seems to be more interested in looking at its treasures than
attacking you.  It stands in the back of the cave, carefully polishing
and admiring every shiny object on its body.  It holds up its claws 
palms out to take a closer look at its many shiny rings.  While looking
through the gaps in its claws it notices you, but still is enjoying
its treasure more than fighting.  It must not want to loose them.

name: a wandering greed demon
shortdesc: A demon with a giant "G" burned into its chest walks through the hallways.
longdesc:
A sizzling red "G" has been burned into the front of this demon.  That
must have hurt!  The demon walks through the rocky hallways looking
around for shinies to add to its collection.  The demon is covered
head to claw in a variety of treasures it has probably taken from
previous explorers.  Better not mess with it.  The demon quickly darts
to the ground and picks up an object, only to disgard the object when
it finds it's junk.  What a greedy jerk.

name: Pride
shortdesc: A beautiful demon skates gracefully on the lake of blood.
longdesc:
This beautiful demon is perfection personified.  Its wears a pristine
white skaters one-piece and has its hair bunned up Princess Leia style.
It skates around the lake of blood perfectly, never disturbing the 
suface enough to dirty its uniform.  Extending its wings and arms out
gracefully, it performs intricate patterns that would make Dorothy
Hamel jealous.  It lands perfectly and begins to skate over to you,
smiling to itself in contentment.  This would be a great time to run.

name: a stretching ballet dancer
shortdesc: A ballet dancer does her warm-up stretches on the floor.
longdesc:
The ballet dancer looks almost perfect.  It is obvious she takes much
pride in the study of dance.  Straightening her leg and placing it
on the dance bar, she begins to stretch in preperation for her next
class.  She probably does not want to make her teacher look bad or be
disappointed.

name: a dancing ballerina
shortdesc: A skinny ballerina practices her dance moves around the class.
longdesc:
This dancer is so skinny that you can see her ribs sticking out.  If it
was not for the fact she was already dead, you would definitely want
to get her a hot dog or something.  She performs an intricate series
of dance steps and admires herself in the studio's long mirror while
she does it.  What a ham!

name: a pirouette ballerina
shortdesc: A petit ballerina pirouettes gracefully around the classroom.
longdesc:
The ballerina is dressed very eloquently in a frilly white tutu.  She
spins and pirouettes all over the dance floor, smiling at herself in
the mirror the whole time.  She does not miss a single step or a single
beat.  She takes intense pride in her work.

name: a dance teacher
shortdesc: A dance teacher beams at her students with pride.
longdesc:
The dance teacher beams a huge smile as she watches her students perform
with perfection.  She does not have to criticize a single step, as all
her students are moving with pride today.  She casually changes a record
from the player when a song is over so that her students do not have 
to stop dancing.  She suddenly realizes you are disturbing her class
and turns in your direction.  Better run.

name: a lawn mower man
shortdesc: A man yells at you to stay off his beautiful grass.
longdesc:
Get off my lawn you damn kids!", is shouted from the back yard as 
you hear the distinct sound of a lawn mower getting closer.  Finally
you can see the mower and the demon driving it come into view.  At
one time this was probably a human, but taking such extreme pride
in the condition of his lawn has corrupted his soul.  "I'm not going
to tell you again.", the demon shouts, contorting his face into much
more demon like qualities.  "GET OFF MY LAWN!", he shouts, picking up
his lawn mower and throwing it in your direction.

name: a beauty queen
shortdesc: A beautiful woman sits at her vanity, staring in the mirror.
longdesc:
This woman is quite lovely as she stares into the vanity's mirror.  She
picks up a brush and begins to comb her long, beautiful brown hair.
Her eyes have a sapphire blue luster that seem to sparkle in the mirror.
The woman grabs some make-up and carefully begins to apply the product
to her face.  However, as far as you can tell from here, she does not
need any help in the least.  Her eyes suddenly see you staring from
the corner of the vanity's mirror.  As she stands up and turns to you,
you see a completely different site from what you were looking at in
the mirror.  Her hair is short and completely frazzled.  Her face is
half torn off and scars are running across what is left of it.  She is
not appreciative that you messed up the pride she sees in the mirror
and rears to attack.

name: an undead skater
shortdesc: A skeleton thin skater slides along the top of the bloody pool.
longdesc:
The skin has almost completely fallen off of this poor soul.  Bones
stick out of its clothes like sharp knives.  The skater slowly skates
along the top of the pool, trying to avoid running into Greed.  Even
an undead soul does not want to mess with a greater demon.

name: a pride demon
shortdesc: A demon stares into a mirror with true pride.
longdesc:
The demon is completely black, almost blending in with the shadows
of the cavern hallways.  You would probably not have noticed it if it 
wasn't for the glimmer of the mirror in its hand reflecting off your 
light source.  The demon cannot stop itself from looking at its visage 
in the mirror.  It is truely a sight only a mother could love.  You 
have to admit to yourself, this is probably one of the more beautiful 
demons that you have seen in the abyss.  That's saying something.

name: a wandering pride demon
shortdesc: A demon with a giant "P" burned into its chest walks through the hallways.
longdesc:
A sizzling red "P" has been burned into the front of this demon.  That
must have hurt!  The demon walks through the rocky hallways in search
of things to make itself look more beautiful.  The demon is already
quite beautiful, its pitch-black body almost radiates in the darkness.
It flips its long silky black hair and smiles as it notices you staring.
Unfortunately for you, the demon side in it takes over and she rears
to attack.

name: Lust
shortdesc: An androgynous looking demon rises from the party and points at you invitingly.
longdesc:
Opening its wings and flapping them softly, the demon Lust slowly rises
from the sexy party and hovers above them.  Its hair is a short black
and its lips shine with ruby red lipstick.  A black corset covers its
torso and abodomen and a pair of fish net stockings covers its legs.
Its bosom it not ample in the least, an almost manly chest sticks out
from the top of the corset. Hmmm, what a strange demon.  Lust purses
its lips and seems to blow a kiss at you.  It raises one slender arm
and points a long clawed finger at you, inviting you to join in on the
fun.

name: a male jacuzzi demon
shortdesc: A male demon relaxes in the boiling lava jacuzzi.
longdesc:
This demon is having the time of his life.  He is the only man in a
jacuzzi full of female demons.  What more could a demon ask for?  He
lays back and relaxes, knowing that the women will have to come to him.
Unfortunately for him, the women seem to see to be busy with plans of
their own.  He quickly snaps awake and begins to make whitty banter
with the women.  Most of them are uninterested but he seems to have
caught the interest of one particularly giddy female.

name: a female jacuzzi demon
shortdesc: A female demon sips a glass of warm blood while she relaxes in the lava.
longdesc:
Extremely uninterested in what the male demon has to say, this female
sips blood from a beautiful jeweled gauntlet that she has brought into
the jacuzzi.  She rolls her eyes as the female next to her laughs
at all the male's lame jokes.  However, her eyes perk up when she 
notices the action happening at the other end of the jacuzzi.  Not so
delicately, she stands up walks over to the ladies on the far side of
the lava jacuzzi.

name: a laughing female jacuzzi demon
shortdesc: A female demon laughs at all the male demon's jokes and twirls her hair.
longdesc:
The demon is laughing hysterically at the male demon's jokes and comments.
She sticks her fingers in her hair and begins to twirls some strands
as he continues to talk.  She seems very interested in what he has
to say, or is very concerned with her hair.  Regardless, her laugh
is making you want to bash her head in.

name: a moaning female jacuzzi demon
shortdesc: A female demon moans as another demon provides her with lustful pleasures.
longdesc:
This demon is being extremely naughty.  She is engaged in all sorts
of sinful activities with another female demon.  They are putting on
quite the show for any one watching.  The moans coming from this demon
are echoing all throughout the cavern.  Oh my!

name: an inviting female jacuzzi demon
shortdesc: A female demon looks up from her lustful activities and beckons you to the pool.
longdesc:
She is in complete control of the situation.  She teases and taunts
another female demon, bringing the creature to a moan, even scream.
She looks around the hot tub, making sure all the other demons are
watching.  Noticing you are now watching, she smiles and beckons you
over to join in on the fun.

name: a neglige demon
shortdesc: A neglige dressed demon eyes you wantingly as she plays with her friend.
longdesc:
The demon plays coyly on top of the silk sheets of the four-poster
bed.  She engages in all sorts of lustful and sinful activities with
her friend.  The demon is dressed in a sexy white neglige and has long
white stockings that go up to her mid-thigh.  She stops to take a quick
look at you in between..... whatever she was up to.  She gives a sexy
little wink and continues with her fun.  These demons are so naughty!

name: a hell dog
shortdesc: A rabid looking dog charges at you from across the room.
longdesc:
This dog is unlike any canine you have ever seen.  It has at least three
eyes and has a blueish-white liquid foaming from its mouth.  It seems
to be chained to the four-poster bed in the northeast part of the cave.
The hell dog charges at you from across the cave but is immediately
yanked back when it reached the end of its chain.  The poor thing.

name: a sleeping demon
shortdesc: A demon has collapsed and is sleeping on the cavern floor.
longdesc:
The demon is drenched in sweat and covered in filth.  Long gashes line
its chest and back from where it was clawed in vicious passion.  You 
would think it was dead if it wasn't for the dreadful snoring the 
creature is unleashing.  The smile on its face tells the tale.  It 
must have had a very good time at the party in the southeast corner 
of the cave.

name: a napping demon
shortdesc: A demon is laying on the floor with its friends, taking a nap.
longdesc:
This demon looks like it could wake up at any moment.  Its head rests
on one of its sleeping friends as it tries to catch a little demon nap.
It kicks its feet out and lets loose a little snort.  Yawning, it turns
over and goes back to sleep.

name: a moaning demon
shortdesc: A demon moans loudly from all of the lustful activities.
longdesc:
The demon gets very close to the rest of the group.  Claws, tongues
and other various limbs are touching and feeling everyone and
everything.  The demon moans at the sinful pleasure and continues to
enjoy the group activitiy.

name: a sighing demon
shortdesc: A demon sighs as it gets left out from the group fun.
longdesc:
The demon trys its hardest to get back into the group.  It jumps into
the middle of the fun only to be tossed right back out again.  The
demon sighs and walks around the outskirts of the group, trying to
find a way back in.  This demon wants some action!

name: a busy demon
shortdesc: The demon looks awfully busy with whatever naughtiness it is engaging in.
longdesc:
This demon is being extremely naughty!  It is involved with everything
and everyone.  No demon goes unturned!  It smiles as it realises the
moans and shivering are being caused by its hard work.  A demon's job
is never done!  Don't get too close, those claws look awfully sharp.
Ouch!

name: a frantic demon
shortdesc: A demon looks extremely frantic as the activities get it very excited.
longdesc:
This demon looks ready to explode.  It speeds up its activities to such
a furvor that it is cutting into some of the other demons.  Ouch!  It
begins to howl and shake as the movements of the group rise in intensity.
Better not get too close!

name: a shivering demon
shortdesc: A demon shivers and undulates as the group moans in pleasure.
longdesc:
This demon's eyes are rolling back in its head.  It can barely control
itself as the sinful activities of the group continue.  The demon
shakes and shivers as the party seems to move and undulate in one giant
mass.  This is just plain naughty!

name: a lust demon
shortdesc: A demon stares at you invitingly from the cavern wall.
longdesc:
The demon is resting against one of the cavern walls.  It looks up and
winks at you as you pass.  Maybe it is looking for a good time?  The
demon is dressed in some cute pink panties and a pink-laced bra.  Where
are these demons getting all this night ware from?  Is there a local
Victoria's Secret in hell?  We already know there has to be a Starbucks.

name: a wandering lust demon
shortdesc: A demon with a giant "L" burned into its chest walks through the hallways.
longdesc:
