A sizzling red "L" has been burned into the front of this demon.  That
must have hurt!  The demon walks through the rocky hallways in search
of a good time.  It is dressed in a lacey-white bra and has some thigh
high white stockings on.  The demon's stiletto high heels click along
the rocky hallway floor as it walks towards you.  "Hey baby", it calls 
out to you.

name: Wrath
shortdesc: A powerful demon stares down at you from on top of its throne.
longdesc:
Wrath stares down at you from its throne with intense hated.  This is
the largest creature you have ever seen.  Its mighty wings ruffle as
you enter its throne room.  It eyes sparkle and glow at you through
the darkness.  You can see a snarl start to form on the demon's face.
Wrath stands up from its throne with a growl and begins to move across
the room, directly towards you.

name: a sword fighting lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul grabs a sword and fights against another soul.
longdesc:
A blue glow pulses from the opaque white body of the lost soul.  Its
face is rather featureless except for two pale white eyes.  The eyes
of this soul are much more intense than the souls in the main abyss
cavern.  This soul obviously has a lot on its mind.  It grabs a loose
sword from the cavern wall and attacks another lost soul in the arena.

name: a staff fighting lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul grabs staff from the dirt and attacks another soul.
longdesc:
A blue glow pulses from the opaque white body of the lost soul.  Its
face is rather featureless except for two pale white eyes.  The eyes
of this soul are much more intense than the souls in the main abyss
cavern.  This soul obviously has a lot on its mind.  It grabs a loose
staff from the cavern floor and attacks another lost soul in the arena.

name: a kick fighting lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul runs across the arena floor and kicks another soul in the head.
longdesc:
A blue glow pulses from the opaque white body of the lost soul.  Its
face is rather featureless except for two pale white eyes.  The eyes
of this soul are much more intense than the souls in the main abyss
cavern.  This soul obviously has a lot on its mind.  The soul runs
across the floor, jumps in the air and kicks another soul right in the
face.  It looks quickly towards the throne room above and continues
to fight with all its might.

name: a fist fighting lost soul
shortdesc: A lost soul runs across the arena floor and punches another soul in the head.
longdesc:
A blue glow pulses from the opaque white body of the lost soul.  Its
face is rather featureless except for two pale white eyes.  The eyes
of this soul are much more intense than the souls in the main abyss
cavern.  This soul obviously has a lot on its mind.  The soul runs
across the floor, slides under a sword swing and punches another soul 
right in the face.  It looks quickly towards the throne room above 
and continues to fight with all its might.

name: a caged wife
shortdesc: A dirty and malnutritioned woman thanks you for saving her.
longdesc:
Dressed in dirty rags this poor woman looks in desperate shape.  She
begins to cry as you open the cage to her freedom.  Falling down to
her knees, she reaches for your feet and thanks you through her tears.

name: a caged daughter
shortdesc: A young lady starts to cry as she knows she is about to be rescued.
longdesc:
The young lady stands behind the older woman and peers at you from
behind her back.  Tears begin to well in her eyes as she realizes she
is about to be rescued.

name: a caged son
shortdesc: A young boy sits in the back of the cage, covered in his own filth.
longdesc:
This poor boy is extremely malnourished, it looks like he hasn't eaten
in weeks.  He is dressed in dirty, torn rags and appears to have soiled
himself.  He runs up to you and starts begging for some food.

name: a caged grandfather
shortdesc: An old grandfather sits covered in blankets on the floor of the cage.
longdesc:
Hunched over and shaking, the old man leans against the bars towards
the back of the cage.  His eyes are closed and a little bit of foam
is drooling from his mouth.  He starts to cry when he hears joyful
sounds coming from the ladies.

name: a typing worker
shortdesc: A diligent worker types away at his desk.
longdesc:
This man is very involved in his work.  He grabs papers from his desk
and begins to input data in his computer.  Once done, he puts the
completed work to the left of his computer and repeats the process.
He sure can type fast!

name: a writing worker
shortdesc: A happy worker quickly writes her way through a huge report.
longdesc:
This worker smiles and whistles as he works.  He quickly tears through
a huge report, making notes and writing where he needs to do.  You can
tell that he has been doing this for years.

name: an sorting worker
shortdesc: A busy worker sorts his way through a tall stack of papers.
longdesc:
Tall stacks of work are piled on top of this poor man's desk.  You can
barely see him as he works hard to get all the work done.  He wipes
some sweat from his brow and gulps down a cold glass of water.  Poor
guy.

name: an intense manager
shortdesc: An intense looking manager walks up in down the isles of the office.
longdesc:
The manager is dressed in a business suit and looks very professional.
He walks up and down the isles of the office, making sure everyone is
doing everything they are supposed to.  Of course, he's not doing much
work himself, but management rarely does.  Oh the humanity.

name: an enraged worker
shortdesc: An enraged worker bursts through the door shouting madly.
longdesc:
Bursting through the door, the demon starts shouting madly, "It wasn't
right, it wasn't fair.".  It looks around the room at all the workers
with intense hated and finally sets its eyes upon the manager.  "You",
he says softly, "YOU!".  It reaches behind its back and pulls out a 
long curved knife.  "I was just taking a nap under my desk.  I was
freaking tired!", it screams, "You'll never be able to fire anyone
again!".

name: a cheating man
shortdesc: A smiling man sits on the couch next to a beautiful woman.
longdesc:
A smiling man sits on a couch, trying to get closer to the beautiful
lady.  He eyes her from head to toe, licking his lips hungrily.  He 
takes off the golden ring on his wedding finger and slips it into his
shirt pocket.  He inches even closer to the woman and makes his move.

name: a nervous woman
shortdesc: A pretty woman sits next to a man on the couch, eyeing the door nervously.
longdesc:
The woman sits on the couch nervously.  She looks over to her male
friend and some beads of sweat break on her forhead and drop down her
cheek.  She looks from her friend to the door and back to her friend.
She does not look very comfortable the closer her friend gets to her.

name: an upset boyfriend
shortdesc: An upset looking boyfriend opens the door at stares at the couch in disbelief.
longdesc:
Bursting through the front door of the house, this demon stares at the
couch in utter disbelief.  "Six years baby.", the demon states, "SIX
YEARS!".  "How could you betray my trust like this.", the demon screams.
Reaching into its coat pocket, it pulls out a sharp dagger and moves
towards the couch.  "I assure both of you.....", the demons face turns
into a wraith-like quality and screeches, "you will NEVER get the 
chance to do this again!".

name: a mean child
shortdesc: A mean child laughs with his friends on the swings.
longdesc:
The child looks like a mean bully.  He rocks back and forth on the
swing slowly, laughing with his friends about today's activities.
"We got that kid good, right?", he cackles, pushing off the ground to
swing even faster.

name: a laughing child
shortdesc: A laughing child pushes off the ground and swings with all his might.
longdesc:
This child does not look nearly as mean as his friends.  He swings
nervously, almost like he is not happy with the current conversation.
His laughter is a nervous one, forced to make his friends happy.  He
pushes off the ground to swing even higher.  He is not very interested
in their convesation.

name: a snickering child
shortdesc: A child sits on the slide, snickering with gleeful joy.
longdesc:
The child sits at the end of the slide, snickering with a wry smily
on his face.  Holding up a book bag he proclaims, "We got that nerd
good!".  Opending up the book bag and emptying its contents on the 
ground he says, "Looks like Mr. Straight A's won't beg getting to
his homework tonite.".  Cackling madly, he stands up and throws the
book bag into the trash.

name: an upset child
shortdesc: An upset child glares at the children on the playground from behind the slide.
longdesc:
The demon child listens to the conversation the human children are
having on the playground from behind the slide.  Black tears drop from
its glowing read eyes and stain its white t-shirt.  The demon gets
more infurated the longer it listens to the children mock and laugh
about all its hard work.  It moves its hand to its belt and slides
the dagger in and out of the scabbard, amost as though it was hesistant
to take wrath upon the laughing children.  However, once it notices
the children empty its backback, it unsheaths its sharp weapon and
charges towards the childen.

name: a busy postal worker
shortdesc: A busy postal worker sorts through some mail on the counter.
longdesc:
The postal worker looks very busy.  He dumps out the mail bag and begins
to sort through its contents.  He is much too busy to notice someone
staring at his activities through the window at the front of the post
office.

name: a postal worker
shortdesc: A postal worker stands at the front desk, not doing much of anything.
longdesc:
Smiling and not doing much work, the postal worker stands behind the
front desk.  He would be ready to greet any customers, if they had any.
Its strange that even though he is not doing anything he still does
not notice the man staring through the front window of the post office.

name: a frantic postal worker
shortdesc: A frantic postal worker points at the front window with a shaking finger.
longdesc:
Shaking and shivering, the postal worker frantically points her finger
at the crazy looking man that is staring through the front window
of the post office.  She begins to turn and run into the back, but
it is already too late.

name: a gun toting maniac
shortdesc: A gun toting maniac bursts through the glass doors, guns ablazing.
longdesc:
Bursting through the glass front doors of the post office, the maniac
reaches into its long jacket and pulls out two hand guns.  It instantly
shoots the frantic postal worker that is trying to run away in the knee
caps.  "Oh no,", it says calmly, "you are all going to stay here and
listen to what I have to say."  It walks over to the front counter,
staring the postal worker right in the eyes.  "Two thousand days in
a row without a day off.... TWO THOUSAND.", it screams.  "This shit
can't be legal!  You people will never do this to another person again.",
he yells as he begins to blow his former co-workers away.

name: a wrath demon
shortdesc: A demon glares at you from the back of the cavern.
longdesc:
The demon stands against the walls of the cavern, glaring at you with
instense hatred.  It is not happy that you are traveling in its
hallways and it is going to show you the way out.  The demon looks to
be about seven feet tall and is completely black.  Its slender body
has a long curved neck coming out of the torso and a hammerhead like
head on the top.

name: a wandering wrath demon
shortdesc: A demon with a giant "W" burned into its chest walks through the hallways.
longdesc:
A sizzling red "W" has been burned into the front of this demon.  That
must have hurt!  The demon walks through the rocky hallways in search
of someone to beat down.  The demon looks very angry and will probably
pummel the first thing it can get its sharp claws on.

name: Envy
shortdesc: A healthy looking tree flourishes in the beautiful garden.
longdesc:
The tree's leaves begin to shake as you walk on the green grass of the
garden.  The tree is full of multi-colored fruit that hangs from its
many branches.  The fruit looks sweet and ripe enough to take a huge
bite.  Upon closer inspection, every piece of fruit has a face on it.
The faces are contorted and seem to be screaming in pain.  Hmm, maybe
this should be thrown to the ground with the others.

name: a swinging female
shortdesc: A smiling female sits on the wooden front porch swing.
longdesc:
The female looks very happy as she ways on the wooden porch swing with
her husband.  She snuggles close to him and stares into the sky.  She
closes her eyes and just enjoys the quiet time.

name: a swinging male
shortdesc: A content looking man swings on the wooden front porch swing.
longdesc:
The man puts his arm around his wife and draws her close.  He moves
his legs back and forth, forcing the swing to sway ever so gently.  He
gazes at his wife with such love that it would make anyone envious.

name: an envious man
shortdesc: An envious man watches the happy couple from the bushes.
longdesc:
The demon hides in the bushes of the front yard and watches the couple
with a sad longing.  Black tears weep from its red eyes and fall into
the green grass with a hiss.  The demon cannot take his eyes off of
their happy times.  It is truely envious.

name: a middle female child
shortdesc: A young female sits down at the table for dinner.
longdesc:
The child sits down at the kitchen table and discusses her day with
the family.  She is dressed very simply, ready for a delicious dinner.
The girl talks very excitedly about her goings on for the day.

name: a middle male child
shortdesc: A young male child sits down at the table for dinner.
longdesc:
The young man sits down at the kitchen table and gets ready for a 
delicious dinner.  His mouth is drooling at the wonderful smells coming
from the kitchen.  His father tries to engage him in conversation but
he is too hungry to listen.

name: a older female child
shortdesc: A teenage female child sits down at the table for dinner.
longdesc:
The teenager sits down at the kitchen table and immediately starts to
engage in coversation with her family.  She talks excitedly about
her day at school and all the things she learned.

name: a older male child
shortdesc: A teenage male sits down at the table for dinner.
longdesc:
The teenager sits down at the kitchen table with a slump.  He does not
seem interested in dinner or any of the conversations going on at the
table.  He pulls out a picture of his girlfriend and sighs quietly.
A small tear falls from his eye.

name: a happy dad
shortdesc: A smiling dad sits down at the kitchen table for dinner.
longdesc:
The dad beams happily at all of his children.  He folds up his news
paper and tries to engage each child in conversation.  He does not seem 
to notice the small child at the end of the table however.  The child 
starts to cry as its eyes glow with a deep red.  The father does not 
seem the least concerned.

name: a smiling mom
shortdesc: A smiling mom brings a great smelling turkey to the dinner table.
longdesc:
The mother beams with pride as she carries a delicious looking and
smelling turkey to the kitch table.  She sets it down and waits for
a thank you from the family.  Not receiving one, she turns with a smile
and returns to the kitchen for more food.  A mother's work is never
done!

name: an unhappy child
shortdesc: A lonely child stares at its family with an unhappy frown.
longdesc:
The demon is the last one to arrive to dinner.  It takes its little
body and hoists itself onto one of the chairs.  The demon looks around
the table and frowns when it finds no one talking to it.  Some black
tears leak from its glowing red eyes and drip into the floor with a
hiss.  It looks around enviously for someone, anyone to talk to it.

name: a smiling manager
shortdesc: A smiling manager sits behind his desk and addresses his employees.
longdesc:
The manager looks very proudly at the two employees.  He holds up some
paperwork and shows them how the profits have doubled in the last month
alone.  He walks over to one of the employees and shakes their hands,
returning to his desk shortly after.  He continues to go on about how
he could not have done it without them.

name: a happy worker
shortdesc: A happy worker smiles as her manager sings her praises.
longdesc:
The worker sits in the chair in front of the manager's desk and beams
a wide smile.  "Yes sir, it was my idea, even though he did help me
out a little bit.", she says, smiling to her co-worker.  "We have been
working on this project for months and we are just glad it is helping
out the company."  She sits up straight in her chair and shakes the
manager's hand as he walks over to her.

name: an unhappy worker
shortdesc: An unhappy worker grumbles in its chair as the manger talks.
longdesc:
She's so smug.", the demon thinks to itself as she talks to the man in
charge.  "It should have been my idea, I could have thought of it
myself.".  The demon grumbles below its breath and sinks down into the
chair.  "I'm so envious of her success.".  The demons red eyes glow
with a dark intensity.

name: a peeping tom
shortdesc: A peeping tom looks in through a window at a happy family.
longdesc:
The demon looks through the window of the house with a frown on its
face.  It carefully places its claw on the window and rubs a panel
remorsefully.  Black tears weep from its red eyes as it sighs and turns
towards you.  "Some love....I just want to be loved," the demon whispers.
"It should have been my family.  I'm so envious.".

name: an envy demon
shortdesc: An envious demon looks at you with sad eyes from the cavern wall.
longdesc:
The demon stares at you with sad glowing red eyes from the back of the
cavern.  Black tears drop from its eyes as it sees you walk freely
through the hallways.  It crouches down and hugs its knees with its
arms, rocking back and forth slowly.  Freedom, what a concept.

name: a wandering envy demon
shortdesc: A demon with a giant "E" burned into its chest walks through the hallways.
longdesc:
A sizzling red "E" has been burned into the front of this demon.  That
must have hurt!  The demon walks through the rocky hallways in search
of some attention.  It looks very lonely with its sad glowing red eyes.
It almost runs away when it see how happy you are.

name: Sloth
shortdesc: A tall and lanky demon slowly rises from the pile of bones.
longdesc:
The pile of bones start to shift as a long top hat slowly rises from
the top of the remains.  A skeletal thin black face is beneath the
hat.  It smiles scarily at you as its body continues to ascend.  Its
body is as skinny and frail as its face.  You can see its bones right
through its almost translucent black skin.  Its arms are long, almost
twice the length of its body.  Black and white stripes run up and down
the imposing appendages.  Finally revealing its full form, Sloth uses
its long arms to slowly descend the large pile of bones.  It walks kind
of like a bat, folding its arms and wobbling with each stop.  You take
as step back as you notice everywhere the demon's hand touch instantly
shatters and turns to dust.  This demon is amazingly strong.  Better
not let it land a hit.

name: a dirty man
shortdesc: A dirty man rises from a pile of trash and filth.
longdesc:
Phew!  Not only is this demon dirty but it smells terrible!  It slowly
rises from a huge pile of trash and snaps up its glowing red eyes.  The
demon kicks away the filth and begins to slowly walk straight towards
you.

name: a bad maid
shortdesc: A bad maid wanders around the room, not doing its job.
longdesc:
This maid has obviously not had much training.  This room has not been
properly cleaned in, well, forever!  Dust and trash lie all about the
room.  Chairs are turned over and the bed has probably never been
made.  Someone needs to be fired!  The maid smiles as it sees the
repulsion on your face and walks towards you slowly.

name: an sloth demon
shortdesc: A sloth demon moves very slowly in the back of the cavern.
longdesc:
The demon is scary indeed, almost resembling a clown.  It slowly stands
up from the floor and unfolds its insanely long arms.  The arms easily
reach from the top to the bottom of the cavern.  It has a classy top
hat on its head and its face is completely made-up with beauty products.
A creepy smile has been drawn across its face so that it can never turn
into a frown.

name: a wandering sloth demon
shortdesc: A demon with a giant "S" burned into its chest walks through the hallways.
longdesc:
A sizzling red "S" has been burned into the front of this demon.  That
must have hurt!  The demon walks slowly through the rock cavern hallways.
Its movements are almost in slow motion as it raises its long thin
arms to stop you.  It mouth opens wide to let out a shriek, but you
walk too quickly by it and miss the noise.

name: Gluttony
shortdesc: A long and swollen worm dives in and out of the lake of slime.
longdesc:
Yuck!  Gluttony looks like a grub you would find in a garden, except it
is the size of a whale.  The demon is swollen and its banana yellow
skin seems to bubble and undulate as it swims through the slime.  The
slime weeps out from the demon's skin and falls into the pool.  Gross.
The demon quickly dives into the slime and disappears completely.  It
is awfully fast for such a large creature.  The slime below you seems
to bubble and churn, better move!

name: a fried donut salesman
shortdesc: A fried donut salesman offers you a tray of delicious looking treats.
longdesc:
The salesman smiles at you from behind the donut kiosk.  It reaches
under the counter and pulls out a huge tray of delicious looking donuts.
The donuts are of several differnt varieties, not one sweet smelling
treat looks alike.  "Please,", the demon speaks directly to you, "take
all you want, eat all you want.  Join us.".  It smiles as its body
begins to swell and expand.  Man this demon is fat.

name: a snack cake vendor
shortdesc: A cute demon offers you a tray of various baked goods.
longdesc:
The snack cake vender smiles at you from behind its kiosk.  The demon
is quite large and has obviously not been excersizing.  Broccoli has
never been in this demon's diet.  It reaches under the counter and
pulls out a silver tray full of delicious looking baked goods.  They
smell even better than they look.  It points from the tray to you and
back to the tray.  The demon must want to you to gorge yourself as it
has.

name: an gluttony demon
shortdesc: A worm-like demon undulates in the back of the cavern.
longdesc:
Ewww.  The demon sits in the back of the cave, undulating disgustinly.
It looks almost like a large grub and it's skin is has a putrid yellow
hue.  With each movement, a spray of banana colored slime squirts out 
from random spots and all over the cave.  The demon is almost in a 
puddle of its own waste.  That's just nasty.

name: a wandering gluttony demon
shortdesc: A demon with a giant "G" burned into its stomach slithers through the hallways.
longdesc:
A sizzling red "G" has been burned into the demon's stomach.  That
must have hurt!  The worm-like demon slithers and undulates through
the hallways in search of something to eat.  The demon's color is a
putrid banana yellow.  It leaves a slime trail behind it in the same 
nasty color.

name: a swimming fat worm
shortdesc: A fat worm slims slowly across the slime pool.
longdesc:
Just a large and bloated worm, the demon swims carefree across the top
of the pool.  It turns and swims towards you as it realizes its next
meal has arrived.

name: A wandering angel
shortdesc: A angelic creature wanders through the hallway slaying demons.
longdesc:
The angel glows with a pure white light.  He is dressed in sturdy looking
white plate armor with platinum gold runes and designs engraved into it.
Long and beautiful white wings stick up and out from its back.  
The angel turns quickly as you approach and swings its mighty sword, only
stopping at the last minute when it realizes that you are in fact, not a demon.

"Did you hear my sister in the caverns above?", he shouts at you.
"KILL THEM ALL!", he says before turning and running down another hallway.

name: A wandering angel
shortdesc: A beautiful female angel runs through the rocky hallways.
longdesc:
The angel looks like she has been in quite a fight.  She glows with a
pure white light.  A pair of long and beautiful white wings stick up
and out from her back, almost reaching the floor.  Some of her white
plate armor has been scratched and torn.  Demon blood is splashed on
almost every piece.  You notice the angel is extremely beautiful as
she flings her long brown hear over her shoulder to get it out of her
face.  She notices you staring and gives a little smile.  "Here to
help human?", she states plainly, "You must have found my sister.".
"Just kill them all!", she says slowly losing her smile. "We do not
 have
time to waste.".

name: An angelic mage
shortdesc:
An angelic looking mage hovers a few inches about the
 floor here.
longdesc:
The mage indian-style in mid-air above the cavern hallways.  His eyes
are closed but you can sense that he can see you.  He is dressed in
white plate armore that is embroidered with platinum gold runes and
signs.  He has long and beautiful white wings that grow up and out from
its back, almost reaching down to the cavern floor.  The white energy
around the mage begins to crackle and glow brighter as you approach.
"That's close enough human.", he says out loud, not opening his eyes.
"Let us kill all this demon filth.  Do NOT let one of these foul
creatures live.", he yells, rotating in the air and flying down one
of the dark corridors.

name: a wounded angel
shortdesc: A wounded angel limps through the cavern, holding her wounds.
longdesc:
The angle hobbles and limbs along the rocky corridors.  One of her wings
has been broken off and she is bleeding from several gaping wounds.
Sensing your presence, she turns around and says, "The sins of man must
be destroyed.  You must eliminate them all!".  Falling to the floor
from exhaustion, she looks up at you with tearful eyes, ".....please.".
"The Mountain King blocks the portal to the abyss.", she whispers
before passing out.

name: an elder shadow dragon
shortdesc: A humongous elder black dragon fades in and out of the shadows.
longdesc:
The dragon is almost difficult to see, even in full sight.  Its black
scaly skin seems to allow the sunlight beaming down through the trees 
to pass right through it.  The shadow dragon is easily as tall as four
men and wide as three.  Even with its massive size, it seems to sneak
easily around the forest without disturbing even the slightest branch.
It has not seemed to notice you yet as you follow it deeper into the
forest.  Suddenly, it disappears without notice, fading into the
shadows of some nearby trees.  An intense gust of hot air breathing
on your neck is an immediate sign of where the creature went.  RUN!

name: a male camper
shortdesc: A male camper huddles around his family towards the back of the tent.
longdesc:
The camper has a frightened look on his face as you enter the tent.  It
is almost like he was expecting something to attack.  "Did you see it?",
he whispers to you, "It was right outside our tent!".  The man moves
closers to his family and starts to hug them.  "We were just out looking
for our lost son.  He left out camp grounds in the Swamps of Amnos and
we have not been able to find him!".  He moves closer to you and 
pleads, "If you see him, please bring him back to us!"  He turns to
go to the back to the tent and huddles around his family.

name: a female camper
shortdesc: A female camper holds her children tightly in her arms.
longdesc:
The woman is hugging her children tightly and crying.  She looks up to
her husband with tear filled eyes and begins to whimper quietly.
Grasping her children closer to her chest she whimpers, "I just want
my boy back.  Please..... find my boy.".

name: a young female camper
shortdesc: A girl cries and shakes uncontrollably in her mother's arms.
longdesc:
She cannot stop shaking as you walk through the tent flaps.  She hugs
her mother even harder and begins to let out a quiet whimper.  The
poor girl.

name: a crying baby
shortdesc: A crying baby screams from its mother's arms.
longdesc:
*waaaaaah*waaaaah*waaaaah*poot*  The baby lets out a quiet smile and
falls asleep in his mother's arms.

name: a mountain beast
shortdesc: A hairy and spiked mountain beast stares at you with a hungry look.
longdesc:
The beast hunkers down in the back of the cave, staring at you quietly
as you enter its cave.  It slowly stands to greet you and opens its
blood-shot red ruby eyes.  The beast is extremely furry and its entire
back is covered in bony spikes.

name: a young captured camper
shortdesc: A young man is bloodied and tied up towards the back of the cave.
longdesc:
The young man has been torn to pieces.  You can tell he is still alive
by the slow rise and fall of his chest.  His hands and legs are tied
together so that he cannot escape.  He looks up at you with a solemn
gaze and begins to cry.

name: a lost female camper
shortdesc: A bloody girl walks along the mountain side with a glazed look in her eyes.
longdesc:
Covered in gore and blood the girl stares blankly as she wanders along
the mountain trail.  Her eyes are glazed over, she does not even 
notice you as she walks right past you.  There is a small glimmer
shining from the pocket of her bloody dress.

name: a mountain goat
shortdesc: A furry mountain goat climbs along the mountain side.
longdesc:
*baaaaah*  The covered in a coat of white and grey fur.  It has two
long horns jutting from its head.  The goat walks over to you and
begins to chew on your clothing.  The poor thing is hungry.

name: a young shadow dragon
shortdesc: A young shadow dragon slithers around its nest and glares at you hungrily.
longdesc:
The young dragon resembles a long snake.  It is completely black and
its scaly skin seems to shine with a luster even in this dark cavern.
It begins to twist and wreath as you enter its home.  The shadow 
wormkin opens its eyes and quickly slithers across the floor towards
you with a hungry look in its eyes.

name: a mountain sage
shortdesc: An old mountain sage hovers inches above the stone door frame.
longdesc:
The mage stands in mid-air, staring down at you from above the pulsing
stone door.  He has a flowing grey beard and wears a long white robe.
The old sage has some beautiful blue silk boots on his feet.  His
gaze tightens as he notices you starting at his precious treasures.
He levitates down from his perch to towards you.  Hopefully just to 
get a better look.

name: a rock salamander
shortdesc: A giant salamander slithers around the fallen rocks.
longdesc:
This is one of the largest lizards you have ever seen.  The salamander 
is tan in color and has red stripes running up and down its back.  It
quickly whips its tail and runs under a nearby rock.

name: A fat man
shortdesc: A sad, pathetic and fat man stares intently at the glowing box.
longdesc:
Sitting in a chewed up leather chair behind the desk in the back of the
basement,  this fat pathectic loser stares entranced at the glowing box
before him.  He looks so sad that all you want to do is kill him.
Please make sure to fulfil his wish.  It would make everyone happy.

name: A singing chef
shortdesc: A rotund man dances around the kitchen, singing at the top of his lungs.
longdesc:
The ridiculously fat man dances around the kitchen as he prepares 
today's meals.  It is obvious that this slob does not miss any meals.  
He sings and hums a pleasant melody as he adds spices, mixes up 
liquids and carefully brings prepared food to the main kitchen to cook.

name: A reading teenager
shortdesc: A colorfully dressed teenager reads a long parchment on her bed.
longdesc:
This young teenager is dressed in the most atrocious clothing you have
ever imagined.  Probably every color of the rainbow is present in her
attempt at fashion.  She sits peacefully in her bed, reading over a
long parchment.  Quickly tossing it aside, she rolls over and looks
out the broken window to the front yard.

name: Snickers
shortdesc: A large dog runs across the yard and tries to lick you to death.
longdesc:
The dog is brown with little, white, faded speckles all over her fur.
She runs over to you quickly, almost menacingly, but immediately pushes
you to the ground, lickly you all over.  It is a shame that you have
kill her rather violently.

name: Bruno
shortdesc: A big fat dog rolls around on the enormous mattress.
longdesc:
Easily the biggest dog in the house, he rolls all over the sheets with
grunts of pleasure.  Bruno is mostly black with little brown patches
over his face.  He looks up from his activity as you walk into the room
and beings to pant quietly.  Not recognizing you as a threat he goes
back to the thrashing of the enormous mattress.

name: Pebbles
shortdesc: A small dog growls at you from beneath her muzzle.
longdesc:
She looks at you with almost a human-like intelligence.  A black mesh
muzzle has been placed over her face to prevent her from biting the
other dogs.  You can tell that she is the real terror of the house.
Pebbles begin to growl beneath her muzzle as you traverl deeper into
her room.

name: Towlie
shortdesc: A large dog runs across the yard and barks at you menacingly.
longdesc:
Stupid and ugly, this dog is not capable of more responses than barking.
You want to run your weapon through him immediately.  Please kill him
and get is over with.

name: Blanket
shortdesc: A good sized dog barks at you relentlessly from the back of the room.
longdesc:
The dog is a lovely brown, almost mahogany color.  She was quiet until
you entered her room.  She immediately lets out a relentless barrage of
baking and howling that nearly causes your ears to burst!  The only
answer is to kill this animal immediately.

name: Wimpy
shortdesc: A shaking and wimpering dog raises its head and looks at you with sad eyes.
longdesc:
You have never seen a sadder sight in your life.  The dog shivers,
shakes and whimpers in the back of the room.  She looks up at you with
sad eyes and immediately buries her head back into her paws.  Please
kill her.

name: A Dust Monster
shortdesc: The dust on the floor swirls into a tornado and forms a giant monster.
longdesc:
The dust along the floor of the room begins to move and shake as you
move within the mansion.  The dust begins to raise into the air and
begin to swirl around like a mini tornado.  The dust begins to form
together into the shape of a giant dust monster!  Its glowing red eyes
glare at you from within its sockets.  This is probably a good time to
run.

name: A Killer Sink
shortdesc: The kitchen sink rises from the counter with a loud gurgling sound.
longdesc:
The dishes and pans left in the sink begin to shake and tremble as you
move further into the kitchen.  A disconcerting gurgling sound, like a
stuck drain trying to unclog itself, erupts from the center of the sink
sending out a wave of dirty water.  Yuck!  Some eyes slowly begin to
open just below the pile of dishes.  Two large arms reach out from
beneath the sink and pull it from the counter, directly towards you!
Stop screaming like a girl, it will just make it more hungry.

name: A Dog Hair Monster
shortdesc: Tufts of dog hair roll across the floor and form a giant monster.
longdesc:
Small tufts of dog hair start to roll across the floor like tumbleweed
and begin sticking together in the middle of the room.  The pile of 
hair grows bigger andbegins to take a humanoid like shape.  Suddendly, 
the hair tufts stop moving and a giant dog hair monster is standing
before you.  It does not look happy to see you.

name: A Filth Monster
shortdesc: Piles of trash and filth fly across the room and form a giant monster.
longdesc:
The piles of trash and filth begin to fly together like a garbage magnet
was stuck in the middle of the floor.  It is rather disgusting and smelly
as its humanoid shape begins to take form.  Red pulsing eyes stare out
at you from within its head.  The filth monster reaches towards you
with a moan.

name: A Filth Monster
shortdesc: Piles of trash and filth fly across the floor and form a giant monster.
longdesc:
The piles of trash and filth begin to fly together like a garbage magnet
was stuck in the middle of the floor.  It is rather disgusting and smelly
as its humanoid shape begins to take form.  Red pulsing eyes stare out
at you from within its head.  The filth monster reaches towards you
with a moan.

name: A Mail Monster
shortdesc: The unpaid bills begins to rise from the furniture and slowly form a giant monster.
longdesc:
The scrolls and parchments all over the desks and furniture slowly begin
to rise and circle around the room.  The papers fly together and fold
in an origami like manner to form into a humanoid like shape.  Perhaps
if the home owners paid their bills this would not have happened.

name: A disgusting cockroach
shortdesc: A huge cockroach walks along the walls of the house.
longdesc:
Yuck!  A huge brown cockroach runs quickly along the walls of the 
house.  It stops and wiggles its antenna at you tauntingly.  Does this
thing want a fight?!

name: A smelly rat
shortdesc: A smelly rat walks across the floor and twitches its nose at you.
longdesc:
Ugh, nothing says dirty like a nasty and smelly rat.  The rat looks
almost at home as it wanders along the floor of the mansion.  It quickly
twitches its nose at you and moves along its way.

name: A Dog Hair Monster
shortdesc: Tufts of dog hair roll across the floor and form a giant monster.
longdesc:
Small tufts of dog hair start to roll across the floor like tumbleweed
and begin sticking together in the middle of the room.  The pile of 
hair grows bigger andbegins to take a humanoid like shape.  Suddendly, 
the hair tufts stop moving and a giant dog hair monster is standing
before you.  It does not look happy to see you.

name: The mushroom king
shortdesc: The mushroom king sits smiling upon his throne.
longdesc:
The mushroom king sits upon him simple throne.  The smiles with the
pride and job exemplified througout his kingdom.  His smiling face
widens as you approach his throne.  With stubby fingers and a tiny
little hand, he reaches out to you to shake hands in a greeting of
friendship.

name: The mushroom queen
shortdesc: A frantic looking mushroom looks all around the room.
longdesc:
The mushroom queen looks quite frazzled!  She looks around the inside
of the gigantic tree in a frantic manner.  The queen searches under
each mushroom with care in an attempt to find something.  "My children!",
she shouts out to you.  "Have you seen the prince and princess?"  She
immediately returns to her hurried search.

name: The mushroom prince
shortdesc: A smiling mushroom wanders about the grassy fields.
longdesc:
Without a care in the world, the mushroom prince wanders freely around
the grassy fields.  He stops to smell some flowers and lets out a
huge smile.  The prince stares up at the run for a second and continues
on his way along the rolling fields of green grass.

name: The mushroom princess
shortdesc: A blushing mushroom looks at you and runs away.
longdesc:
The mushroom princess looks very peaceful as she picks different
colored and smelling flowers across the grassy fields.  She stops to
smell every different flower and smiles with pleasure and joy.
Carefully placing the flowers in her mushroom pouch, she continues to
the next patch of beautiful looking flowers.

name: A mushroom villager
shortdesc: A cute mushroom villager looks up at you from the field.
longdesc:
The cute little mushroom snuggles comfortably in its dirt bed.  It
looks up at you with a careful look and smiles as it realizes you are
not going to step on it.  The mushroom closes its eyes and begins to
take a sleepy nap.

name: A mushroom villager
shortdesc: A cute mushroom villager smiles as you walk by.
longdesc:
This mushroom pops immediately out of its dirt bed and smiles to greet
you.  Its cute little mushroom cap head wiggles with excitement from
seeing a new visitor to the mushroom fields.  It runs up to you quickly
and beings to rub its head against your leg.  How cute!

name: A mushroom villager
shortdesc: A mushroom villager walks carefree along the trails.
longdesc:
This mushroom villager is a little larger than the planted mushrooms.
It walks along the trails around the tree with a carefree manner.  Its
mushroom cap head bobs side to side with each step its short and stumpy
stems take.

name: A mushroom villager
shortdesc: A mushroom villager raises its head towards the sun and smiles.
longdesc:
The young mushroom shakes the morning dew from its cap and tilts its
head towards the sun with a smile.  It sways its stem back and forth
as the breeze sweeping across the plain passes through.

name: A mushroom warrior
shortdesc: A large mushroom warrior stands guard over the king.
longdesc:
The mushroom guard looks almost stoic as it stands before the king's
mushroom cap with its long stem arms crossed on its chest.  The guard
is much larger than the other mushroom villagers and looks like it
could put up quite a fight.

name: A mushroom warrior
shortdesc: A large mushroom warrior stands guard over the village.
longdesc:
The mushroom guard stands silently before a large patch of its fellow
villagers.  It is quite a bit larger than the rest of the mushrooms
that you have seen so far.  The guard glares at you with an intense
stare as you pass.

name: A mushroom warrior
shortdesc: A large mushroom warrior fights off a large black crow.
longdesc:
Step back!", the guards shouts as you pass through the mushroom fields.
It lifts up its stem arms and flails them at the large crow.  The
relentless attacks from the crow do not dissuade these loyal villagers
in the least.

name: A mushroom warrior
shortdesc: A large mushroom warrior walks across the grassy field.
longdesc:
The large mushroom warrior walks with an almost stern face along the
paths of the grassy fields.  It marches in perfect rhythm with the
swaying of its stemmy arms.  Its stubby little stem legs look so
cute!

name: A large black crow
shortdesc: A large black crow pecks viciously at some mushroom warriors.
longdesc:
The large black crow looks very menacing with its piercing red eyes.
It viciously pecks at the mushroom warriors trying to protect the
growing mushrooms of the village.  It opens up its wings, rears back
and swipes one of its sharp feet right across the face of one of the
mushroom warriors.  Ouch!

name: A wild hog
shortdesc: A wild hog sniffs the mushrooms with a hungry look.
longdesc:
The hog is black with patches of gray all over its hide.  It snorts
and makes gutteral noises as it sniffs all through the growing
mushroom villagers.  Looks like someone is hungry!

name: A gigantic boar
shortdesc: A gigantic boar chews up every mushroom it can fit in its mouth.
longdesc:
The gigantic boar has a huge smile across its face.  Mushroom pieces
fall from its fat face as it chews up its most recent victims.  The
mushroom villagers try to run away from this huge beast but it quickly
snatches them in its mouth and chews away.

name: A pink sow
shortdesc: A pink sow happily rolls around in the field.
longdesc:
The sow is a beutiful shade of pink.  It rolls around in the grassy
field with an almost happy smile on its face.  The pig lets out a
snort as you walk buy and continues warming itself under the bright
sun.

name: A beautiful butterfly
shortdesc: A beautiful butterfly flutters from flower to flower.
longdesc:
The butterfly gracefully flies around the fields of flowers with a
gentle flap of its beautiful wings.  It lands on a flower, flutters
it colorful wings and flys off to find a new place to land.

name: A white termite
shortdesc: A white termite falls from within the tree and lands on a mushroom cap.
longdesc:
The termite falls from the ceiling and lands on a mushroom cap with
a soft squish.  It clicks its mandibles together and quick jumps off
the mushroom cap, trying to dig its way back into the tree.

name: Infested Mushroom King
shortdesc: the King stands here, something has completely taken him over
longdesc:
An infested Mushroom King stands here, you better get out while you can, he
has clearly no control over his body anymore.

name: Hogger
shortdesc: Hogger, the chief of boars is here, pawing at the ground!
longdesc:
This is Hogger, a giant boar that makes other giant boar look titchy in
comparison.  He has a stocky, powerful body that rivals a rhinoceros in
size.  He is covered in a double-layer of thick grey-brown hair, which
provides a natural armour. A set of oversized tusks protrude from his
mouth.  Overall, Hogger looks like a newbie killer.  Get away whilst you
can!

name: A knife thrower
shortdesc: A dangerous looking man tosses weapons at the wall.
longdesc:
The knife thrower looks at you with a smirk as you enter his booth.
He stands of medium height and has a slender build.  The knife thrower
has on some loose gray pants and wears a leather vest.  He notices you
looking at him and he walks over to his weapons rack.  Gently caressing
his sharp and wicked looking tools, he quickly grabs one and flings it
at the bulls-eye across the room.  Scary!

name: A flame breather
shortdesc: A dirt-covered man releases a plume of fire into the air.
longdesc:
It looks like this man has not taken a bath in weeks, he is completely
covered in dirt and soot.  The flame breather walks with heavy and
dramatic steps across the dirty carnival path.  He makes sure that
everyone is watching every move that he makes.  Quickly taking a swig
of liquid from a flask, he raises his wand to his mouth and spits out
a huge plume of fire.  This guy is going to burn down the carnival!

name: A juggler
shortdesc: A dexterous man manipulates objects and tosses them in the air.
longdesc:
Looking towards you with a sly look, the juggler shows you his fists
and opens his empty hands.  He spreads his fingers and shakes his hands.
Suddenly, several different colored balls lay clamped between his
fingers.  Shaking his hands again, balls now lie between each of his
fingers.  Throwing his hands straight up, he launves the balls high into
the air.  The juggler catches each of the balls and begins to manipulate
and juggle each of the balls with amazing dexterity.  Amazing!

name: The ring master
shortdesc: A charismatic man takes off his top hat and bows to the crowd.
longdesc:
The ring master smiles to the crowd and takes off top hat.  Bowing to
the crowd, he reaches into the hat and pulls out a glittering scroll.
"Ladies and gentleman!", he grins, unrolling the scroll.  Fireworks
begin to shoot out from the scroll and all throughout the the bigtop.
He shouts to the crowd, "Welcome to the circus!  We hope that you have
the time of your lives!".

name: A smiling clown
shortdesc: The clown smiles as a pie gets thrown in her face.
longdesc:
The clown is dressed in standard clown gear, colorful down to the last
detail.  She smiles to the crowd and walks towards the front of the
stage.  Bowing for a brief moment, she stands up with a frown as she
realizes another clown slammed a pie in her face.

name: A creepy clown
shortdesc: A creepy looking clown slams a whip cream pie in his friend's face.
longdesc:
The clown creeps along the stage, pie in hand, looking for his next
victim.  His make-up matches his creppy demeanor.  The make-up looks
almost like a smiling demon.  Yuck!  He waits for his friend to bend
over, slides right between her legs and slams his pie in her face.
How mean!

name: A sad clown
shortdesc: A colorful clown pretends to weep real tears from the goings on.
longdesc:
The clown is dressed in pretty standard clown gear, colorful and very
baggy.  He stays crouched in the middle of the stage, hands in fists
in front of his face.  Wrenching the fists back and forth, it makes
it appear as though he is crying.  He throws his arms out at the
mischevious actions of his friends and makes a pouty face.  His make-up
even has tears painted down his face.

name: An excited clown
shortdesc: A very happy clown does cartwheels around the ring.
longdesc:
The clown claps and cheers at all the excitement going on all over
the stage.  He starts to do cartwheels around his friends and laughs
as he flips head over heals.  He stops abruptly towards the edge of
the stage and shoots confetti out over the crowd.

name: A trick clown
shortdesc: A short and pudgy clown tries to pull a prank on another performer.
longdesc:
This clown is not very nice.  He stands behind the clown holding balloons
and looks out over the audience.  Grabbing the clown's waistband, he
starts to laugh and pants the poor man!  What a mean trick.

name: A balloon clown
shortdesc: A smiling clown tries to hand you a colorful balloon.
longdesc:
The clown stands towards the edge of the stage.  He is dressed in pretty
typical clown clothes, colorful and baggy.  Grabbing one of his balloons,
he reaches down and tries to hand one to you.  Unfortunately for him,
one of his friends has snuck up behind him and pulled down his pants.
Reaching down to pull up his pants, he mistakingly releases all his
balloons into the air.

name: A cotton candy vendor
shortdesc: A pudgy man offers you a sweet smelling treat.
longdesc:
The pudgy man stands behind the counter, working diligently on his
next batch of sweets.  He mixes in a large bag of sugar into a giant
steel cauldron and stirs with all his might.  Sweat pours down his
face and hopefully not into his cotton candy!  He sticks a white stick
into the cauldron, twirls it around and pulls out a nice puff of
pink sticky goodness.  He smiles in your direction as he notices you
salivating.

name: A hot peanut vendor
shortdesc: A tall and skinny man offers you a sack of nuts.
longdesc:
Standing behind the stand, the peanut vendor tosses his nuts very
carefully over the fire.  He is strangely tall, clearly towering over
everyone at the carnival.  His head pops out over the top of the
carnival booth.  Noticing you looking he asks, "Want to try my salty
nuts?  They will taste great in your mouth!".  He raises his nut sack
in your direction.

name: A hot dog vendor
shortdesc: A homely looking woman grabs a weiner and slaps it on a bun.
longdesc:
Someone forgot to coome their hair before coming to work!  The hot dog
vendor barely smiles as you approach the counter of her booth.  "Hot
dog?", she asks nonchalantly, grabbing a weiner from the boiling cauldron
and slapping it on a bun.

name: A fried dough vendor
shortdesc: A sweating man sprinkles some powdered sugar over his treats.
longdesc:
Geez!  This man needs to wear a sweatband.  Rivers of sweat flow down
this poor man's face as he kneeds some dought on the counter.  The
fried dough vendor's clothes have pools sweat all over his body.  He
really needs to change his clothes.  Taking the now beaten dough in
his hand, he turns to the deep fryer and tosses it in.  The fried
dought slowly rises back to the top of the oil and he scoops it out,
back onto the counter.  Sprinkling the top of the dough with some
sugar, he smiles at you as he notices you drooling.

name: A fierce tiger
shortdesc: A growling tiger stares at the crown menacingly.
longdesc:
Oh my!  This creature should not be messed with.  It is tied down with
a collar and long steel chain, but it looks like it could break free
at any moment.  The tiger is an orange color and has black stripes all
over.  It bares its pearly white fangs at you and makes a growling
sound.  This is a good time to run.

name: A dancing bear
shortdesc: A friendly looking bear dances on top of a gigantic ball.
longdesc:
The bear seems to be concentrating as it tries to keep its balance atop
a gigantic red ball.  The bears fur is a shiny brown color and it looks
like it has been well kept for.  There is even a cute little red hat
on the top of its head.  The bear slowly rolls its ball around the
ring, trying not to fall off.

name: A large elephant
shortdesc: A large elephant munches on hay in the back of the tent.
longdesc:
This animal does not seem to be doing much of anything.  It is tied to
a stake near the back of the tent with a thick tweeded rope.  The
elephant grabs some hay with its enourmous and muscular trunk and lifts
the food into its mouth.  Chewing away, it just stares at the action
in the center ring.

name: A ball game man
shortdesc: A plesant man asks if you would like to play a game.
longdesc:
Winner, winner!", the man says to you as you approach the counter
of his game table.  The game man seems to be dressed in the standard
uniform for the fair, slacks and a button down shirt.  He raises
several multi-colored balls to you and begs the questions, "Care to
take a chance?".

name: A dart game woman
shortdesc: A smiling woman asks if you would like to play a game.
longdesc:
The game woman is quite lovely.  She has long flowing blond hair that
hangs straight down her back.  Dressed in the standard carnival uniform,
her slacks and button down white shirt seem to fit her much more snuggly
than the other workers.  They must be trying to show off her amazing
figure.  She smiles as you stare at everywhere besides her eyes and
says, "There are lots of other people that would like to play, hun.".
Holding up three shiny darts to you she whispers, "Care to take a
chance?".

name: A balloon game man
shortdesc: A grinning man asks if you would like to play a game.
longdesc:
The game man chuckles a little as you enter his carnival booth.  He
grins his a sucker is born every minute smile and moves closely to the
counter as you approach it.  Dressed in the standard the standard
carnival uniform, he scratches his privates as you waste his time.
Gross!  "I don't have all night patron.", he bemuses staring at you.
Holding up three shiny darts he grins, "Care to take a chance?".

name: A hoop game man
shortdesc: A smiling man asks if you would like to play a game.
longdesc:
The game man shakes his waste as he whirls a hool hoop around and
around.  With a swift shift of his waste, he hurls the hoop into the
air and grabs it with his hand.  Picking up two other hoops from the
ground, he turns to you and says, "Care to take a chance?".  His warm
and wide smiles compels you to reach for your coins and play the game.

name: A strength game man
shortdesc: A strong man asks if you would like to play a game.
longdesc:
This guy must sure work out!  Every muscle on this man is bulging with
purge strength.  He flexes a little as he notices you staring at his
tremendous size.  The strong man has even had to cut off the sleeves
of his uniform because his massive size could obviously not fit into
them.  He wears a steel mesh vest over the cut off button down white
shirt.  Grabbing an extremely heavy hammer against the wall with his
huge hands, he slams it on the sandbag, forcing the weight to hit the
bell at the top of the pole.  "See, little one?", he asks with a smile.
"This game is easy!  Care to take a chance?", he proposes as he hands
you the hammer.

name: A trapeze artist
shortdesc: A young woman smiles and waves at the cheering crowd.
longdesc:
She stands at the top of the trapeze platform, looking out over the
cheering crowd.  The trapeze artist has on a sparkling sky blue leotard.
She waves to the crowd in the bleachers below, getting them even more
excited.  A beautiful pink sash flows from her neck, reaching half way
down her back.  Smiling at you as you reach the top of the platform,
she reaches for one of the trapeze and hurls herself into the air.

name: A carousel ticket man
shortdesc: A sloppy man asks for your ticket to the carousel.
longdesc:
Geez, someone should have checked his clothes when he arrived at work.
His shirt is untucked, his pants are all wrinkled and it looks like
both pieces of clothing could use a good wash.  Pointing to the lock
on the gate of the carousel he says, "Just unlock the gate and you
can go right on the ride.".

name: A content man
shortdesc: A smiling man stares contently at this girlfriend.
longdesc:
This man seems to really be enjoying the carousel ride.  Sitting on
on a bench in the image of two githyankis touching claws, he stares
lovingly into his girlfriend's eyes.  Maybe he might pop the question!

name: A dreaming woman
shortdesc: A beautiful woman stares longingly into her boyfriend's eyes.
longdesc:
The young woman cannot seem to take her eyes off her boyfriend's face.
Her hands are clasped in his, just like the githyanki bench they are
sitting on are touching claws.  She sighs contently as the ride
continues.  The beautiful woman seems to be having the time of her
life.

name: A bratty child
shortdesc: A screaming child demands that the ride go faster.
longdesc:
Ugh, someone smack this kid.  "DADDY!", he shouts, "Make the ride go
faster!".  Pouting to himself, he makes a puffy face and sticks his
tongue out at his dad.  What a little brat!

name: A frowning father
shortdesc: An unhappy man man holds his hands over his face and just shakes his head.
longdesc:
This poor man just hides his head in his hands as the carousel goes
round and round.  He sits atop a skexie seat, right next to his son's
warg seat.  These seats sure look realistic!  The frowning father tries
to apologize to you as you pass him.

name: A smiling child
shortdesc: A smiling child seems to be really enjoying the carousel ride.
longdesc:
This child seems to be having the time of his life.  He could not be
happier sitting atop his Demi-lich seat as the carousel continues to
go round and round.  The brown, floppy haired youngster kicks his heels,
almost as though he is trying to make his seat gallop foward.  What
a cute kid.

name: The ticket man
shortdesc: A well dressed man welcomes you to the carnival.
longdesc:
Come one, come all!", the man shouts as you approach the entrance of
the circus.  He is dressed in a black and white tuxedo with a black
shiny top hat.  "Take your time patrons, please!", he implores, "There
are plenty of tickets for everyone!".

name: A watching man
shortdesc: A smiling man watches the goings on in the center ring.
longdesc:
The man stares intently at the center ring.  He smiles with joy as
he sees the ring master fight off the dangerous looking tiger.  He
cheers with excitement every time the tiger takes a vicious swipe
at the ring master, only missing by inches.  Standing up with a shout,
he claps his hands and cheers even louder.

name: A watching woman
shortdesc: An excited woman screams in joy at the action in the center ring.
longdesc:
The woman sits pristinely in her seat as she stares at all the action
going on in the center ring.  She screams at the top of her lungs as
it appears the ferocious looking tiger is about at reach the ring
master.  Settling back into her seat when she notices the man is just
fine, she wipes her sweating brow and breathes a deep sigh of relief.

name: A old man
shortdesc: An old man looks at his sleeping wife and smiles.
longdesc:
The old man looks at his wife contently as she takes a little nap. He
smiles and continues to watch the circus going on below.  What a good
husband.

name: A sleeping lady
shortdesc: An old lady snoozes peacefully on her husband's shoulder.
longdesc:
Wow, this lady can sure sleep.  There is no way someone can take a nap
through all this excitement.  Everyone around her is cheering and
screaming at the top of their lungs.  Maybe she has her hearing aid
turned off.

name: A coddling mother
shortdesc: A slightly pudgy mother gazes lovingly at her sleeping baby.
longdesc:
The mother smiles as her baby sleeps peacefully in her arms.  Rocking
it back and forth lovingly, she sings it a gentle lullaby that can
barely be heard above the roar of the crowd.

name: A sleeping baby
shortdesc: A beautiful baby sleeps peacefully in his mother's arms.
longdesc:
How on earth can this baby be sleeping to peacefully with all this
racket?  The baby is wrapped in a red blankey and is nuzzled deep
within its mother's arms.  What a lucky baby.

name: An annoying child
shortdesc: An annoying child bothers the other spectators.
longdesc:
This little kid is a jerk!  He tosses popcorn and other assorted food
stuff at other spectators.  He chews up some paper, grabs a straw
from his drink and starts shooting spit balls at people.  How rude!
Somebody slap this kid!

name: A watching child
shortdesc: A child watches the center ring in amazement.
longdesc:
Sitting down like a little gentleman, the child watches the center ring
in complete awe.  He cheers with excitement with every move the tiger
and the ring master make.  Smiling at his parents, he stands up and
shouts at the top of his lungs with joy.  This must be his first time
to the circus.

name: A wandering man
shortdesc: A man snacks on some cotton candy as he walks through the carnival.
longdesc:
Humming a happy tune, the man walks along the dirty carnival path.  He
happily eats from his cotton candy treat.  He smiles with each bite that
he takes.  It must very very enjoyable!

name: A wandering woman
shortdesc: A desperate looking woman rocks her baby as she runs through the carnival.
longdesc:
This lady really needs to calm down with the breeding.  Not only is
she very preganant and carrying a baby in her arms, but she seems to
have lost another child!  "My little girl!", she screams, "Has anyone
seen a lost little girl?".  She hurredly runs past you, screaming to
the next group of people.

name: A happy couple
shortdesc: A happy couple walks hand in hand through the carnival.
longdesc:
They stare into each others eyes as they walk hand in hand through the
carnival.  The happy couple do not seem to notice any of the carnivals
other patrons.  They seem to be totally lost in each other.  Must be
nice.

name: A wandering child
shortdesc: A small child looks around in wonderment.
longdesc:
The child walks around the dirty paths of the carnival with his
mouth and eyes wide open.  He cannot seem to take enough of the sights
in as his eyes dart from one attraction to another.  Bumping into other
patrons since he isnt watching where he is going, he apologize and moves
on.

name: A wandering child
shortdesc: A young child rubs her nose and sniffles, breaking out in tears.
longdesc:
This poor thing.  She is stopped in the middle of the road and is just
staring at people.  Rubbing her nose and sniffling a little bit, she
can not help herself from breaking out in tears.  "MOMMMMMMMMMY!

name: A child thief
shortdesc: A dirty looking child stares at your wallet and runs away.
longdesc:
The child walks stealthfully through the crowd, weaving in and out
of other carnival patrons.  He catches a quick eye of your wallet and
suddenly disappears.  Suddenly you feel some light tugging at your back
pocket.  HEY!

name: A wandering salesman
shortdesc: A man wanders the streets, selling his goods.
longdesc:
The salesman is carrying a large box filled with assorted goods.  There
are several straps attached to the box that are hooked over his shoulders,
making is easier to carry.  "Fresh popcorn!  Cold drinks!  Come and
get it!", the salesman shouts as he passes by.

name: A wandering dog
shortdesc: A sad looking dog begs for a bite of food.
longdesc:
This poor animal sure looks pathetic.  His mane is all manged and is
covered with flees.  He sits down in the dirt and gives you the most
pathetic looks you have ever seen.  Whelping with regret, he turns and
wanders over to the next person to beg from.

name: A house of mirrors ticket man
shortdesc: A cock-eyed man asks for your ticket to the house of mirrors.
longdesc:
This guy seems to have affected by standing in front of the house of
mirrors all day.  His eyes have gone all cock-eyed and crazy.  He looks
like he just escaped from the looney bin.  Pointing to the gate to the
back of the booth, he says, "Just unlock the gate yourself, you can
handle it.".

name: A lost man
shortdesc: A man looks lost and confused as he walks through the house of mirrors.
longdesc:
Thank god you are here!", he shouts.  " I have been lost in this place
all day."  The man starts to weep and breaks down right in front of you.
How sad.  He rolls up in a little ball and may have even peed himself.
Yikes.

name: A lost woman
shortdesc: A lost woman starts to cry as she see you approaching.
longdesc:
Thank the heavans!" the woman cries as you approach her.  "I just
cannot find my way out of here."  She looks around maniacally, staring
from mirror to mirror.  She whispers in your ear, "It doesn't matter
which way I go, I always wind up back here.  Please help!".  She
cries even harder and falls down to the floor in a heap.

name: A lost child
shortdesc: A child lays on the floor crying his eyes out.
longdesc:
The poor child cannot even look up from the floor.  He just lays here,
sprawled out on the floor.  A pool of drool is forming beneath him.
It is obvious that he has been stuck in here for hours, possibly days.
Poor thing.

name: A ferris wheel ticket man
shortdesc: A bored man asks for your ticket to the ferris wheel.
longdesc:
Yawning as you approach him, the ferris wheel attendant looks very
bored.  He points to the gate and says, "Just unlock it yourself.  I'm
busy.".  Nice that he at least tries to do his job.  At least he stopped
the ferris wheel for a second so that you could get on.

name: A confused rider
shortdesc: A confused looking rider rushes out of the cart as you enter.
longdesc:
The man gasps deeply as you rush into the ferris wheel cage.  He must
have thought that his girl friend and him were all alone.  Standing
up and grabbinghis girl friend's hand, he runs away with her at full
speed.

name: A confused woman
shortdesc: A shocked woman screams and runs out of the cart as you enter.
longdesc:
The shocked woman screams as you burst into their ferris wheel cage.
She stands up and starts to hit you over the head!  Her boyfriend grabs
her hand and hurriedly rushes her from the cage.

name: A contortionist
shortdesc: A young woman contorts and bends her body in interesting shapes.
longdesc:
The contortionist moves in unnatural ways as she slithers and undulates
across the stage.  She is dressed in a blue leotard and has on some
red leggings.  How flashdance!  What a feeling!

name: A game player man
shortdesc: A man tries his hardest to beat the game.
longdesc:
This game player is concentrating very hard on beating the game.  He
uses every last brain cell to try and figure out the strategy.  Taking
a deep breath, he relaxes and gives is another try.

name: A game player woman
shortdesc: A woman looks hesitantly at the game, deciding if she wants to play.
longdesc:
The woman looks at the other people playing and blushes.  She watches
as they do their thing and plans a strategy to beat this thing.  Taking
a few coins from her purse, she holds them tightly to her chest.  It
looks like she is having second thoughts.  What a wimp.

name: A game player couple
shortdesc: A happy couple plays one of the carnival games.
longdesc:
The couple laughs and smiles at each other as they enjoy the carnival
game.  They look completely in love as they stare into each other's
eyes.  Almost oblivious to the others playing, they take a second to
share a quick kiss.  Awwwwwwww.

name: A happy child
shortdesc: A happy child tries his hardest to beat the carnival game.
longdesc:
This kid is persistant!  He slams some money on the counter and demands
another try.  Trying his hardest, he goes for another attempt to win
the game.

name: A gang of kids
shortdesc: A gang of kids harasses the woman behind the counter.
longdesc:
What a bunch of punks.  They all look like they just got out of the
local orphanage.  The gang is doing nothing but harrasing the poor
lady behind the counter.  You shake your fist angrily at them.

name: A game player loser
shortdesc: A man slams his fist into the counter as he loses another game.
longdesc:
This poor man has been playing all day.  He has yet to win any of the
carnival games.  The game attendant behind the counter is almost ready
to give him a prize for free.  The loser sighs and throws another
couple of coins on the counter.

name: A wandering gang of kids
shortdesc: A gang of kids walks towards you menacingly.
longdesc:
These kids are just mean.  They push carnival patrons as they pass them.
they steal whatever carnival patrons are holding or eating directly
out of their mouths and hands.  The gang laughs at every act of
terrorism they can commit.  They glare at you menacingly as they get
closer to you.  What a bunch of punks.

name: A wandering woman
shortdesc: A carefree woman wanders with a smile through the carnival.
longdesc:
This lovely woman seems to be having the time of her life.  She walks
carefree through the carnival, enjoying everything and talking to
everyone that she can.  The woman almost seems to be skipping!  She
sure is happy.

name: a bearded lady
shortdesc: A large, bearded lady is here, checking identifications and tickets for the carnival.
longdesc:
This woman has a full, thick, macho beard. I would not mess with her if
I was you.

name: Apep
shortdesc: The serpent god Apep is angered by your presence here.
longdesc:
Apep is a dark serpent worshiped by the goblins.  He is an evil god who 
despises the light.  His length is nearly fifty feet, and his eyes glow 
bright green in the darkness.  His massive form slithers towards you 
preparing to strike.  Your presence here is most unwelcomed.

name: goblin guardian
shortdesc: The goblin guardian stands here guarding the entrance to the temple.
longdesc:
The goblin guardian stands here scanning the courtyard.  He has been placed 
here to protect the temple against would be thieves.  For a goblin he is 
extremely large.  He holds both a shield and sword, poised to attack should a 
situation present itself.

name: goblin priestess
shortdesc: The goblin priestess is performing a sacrifice to Apep.
longdesc:
The goblin priestess is adorned with a long flowing white robe.  There 
is a quite calm about her has she mutters to herself, ... sacrifice ... 
Apep ... darkness ...  You hear but a few words but realize great evil is 
drawing near.

name: goblin priest
shortdesc: The goblin priest is preparing a sacrifice for Apep.
longdesc:
The goblin priest holds a sacrificial dagger high above his head.  Blood
drips from the blade down onto the altar.  You stand there horrified as he 
prepares to sacrifice to Apep, the evil serpent god.

name: goblin guard
shortdesc: The goblin guard stands ready to attack.
longdesc:
A goblin guard is here protecting the entryway to the temple.  No one is 
allowed past the gate, save the priest themselves.  He is clothed in rags 
and a small padded helmet.  He wields a long spear and moves to attack 
upon your approach.

name: Mbenr
shortdesc: Mbenr stands alert guarding the path towards the temple ruins.
longdesc:
Mbenr is a trained killer.  He lurks in and out of the shadows lying in 
wait to ambush his enemies.  He is cloaked in dark brown to help him 
blend in with the roots.  He carries a blowgun and some poisonous darts 
for attacking from a distance.

name: goblin archer
shortdesc: The goblin archer trains his bow upon you.
longdesc:
The goblin archer works with Mbenr to protect the path towards the 
temple.  He feels right at home in the roots and the muck.  His skin is 
brown with dark yellow eyes.  He wears soft leather armor to protect him 
in battle.

name: Dutz
shortdesc: Dutz the goblin hunter is here cleaning his latest quarry.
longdesc:
Dutz is an experienced hunter in these woods.  With several of his quarry 
at hand, he begins to clean them one by one using a dull hunter's knife.  
He is completely wrapped in a thick fur pelt with only his head showing.  
His eyes are a pale orange and he is covered with green skin.

name: Xrok
shortdesc: Xrok the goblin mage stands here brewing his potions.
longdesc:
Xrok seeks great power like all mages.  He is extremely short, even by 
goblin standards.  His blood red eyes are fixed intently on his potions.  
His skin has a greenish hue and he is covered mostly in rags, save a 
small medallion around his neck.

name: great horned owl
shortdesc: A great horned owl sits here on its perch.
longdesc:
The great horned owl sits on a nearby branch.  He turns his head side to 
side searching for his prey.  He has a razor-sharp beak and claws.  His 
feathers are a dark gray, which disguise him well in the forest at night.  
All you can really see are his dark red eyes.

name: cave troll
shortdesc: A cave troll sits here warming himself by the fire.
longdesc:
The cave troll is crouching next to the fire for warmth.  His shoulders 
are hunched over with his head resting on his knees.  You can see a pair 
of greaves on his legs and a large battle-axe next to his side.  His skin 
is a grayish brown with long dark hair.

name: cave troll
shortdesc: A cave troll sits here leaning against his shield.
longdesc:
The cave troll is in the back of the room leaning against his massive 
shield.  In his hands you can see a large sword.  He seems to be reliving 
the battles he has fought as he swings his sword back and fourth.  You 
notice several scars on his arm, perhaps he is counting the number of 
humans he has killed.

name: cave troll leader
shortdesc: The cave troll leader sits upon his throne admiring his treasure.
longdesc:
The cave troll leader is completely entranced by the loot the goblins 
have collected for him.  He scoops up a big pile of jewels and lets them 
slowly run through his fingers.  The cave troll leader has a large steel 
gorget wrapped around his neck.  On the floor next to his feet you can 
see a large maul.

name: Kgen
shortdesc: Kgen the goblin shaman is here mixing his herbs.
longdesc:
Kgen is the goblin's resident shaman and healer.  Kgen is sitting Indian 
style on the floor with his hands clasped together.  He is performing 
some type of chant or ritual.  On his head is a large headdress that 
hangs down to the small of his back.  It is made up of several different 
colored feathers.  On his belt you see a small pouch with a number of 
herbs overflowing the brim.

name: Tsor
shortdesc: Tsor the goblin taskmaster is here taking inventory.
longdesc:
Tsor is dressed in fine clothes from his dark leather jacket to his 
steel-toed boots.  He has been rewarded well by the cave trolls to 
enslave his own people.  He is a violent man with a lust for blood.  
His skin is a fiery red that contrasts with his demonic black eyes.

name: Warg
shortdesc: A warg wanders aimlessly searching for food.
longdesc:
The warg is a monstrous creature.  His shoulders are arched up well above 
the rest of his body.  He is covered in brown four and walks on all four.  
He is extremely dangerous with razor-sharp claws and fangs.  His armor is 
still in place from his last attack run on Midgard.

name: wolf
shortdesc: A wolf is here darting in and out of the trees.
longdesc:
The wolf is here darting back and forth between the trees trying to 
avoid being seen.  He has a nice gray coat of fur with pale brown eyes.  
His tongue hangs out as he pants for air.  He can not stop long or a 
goblin might have him for dinner.

name: goblin woman
shortdesc: A goblin woman is here gathering berries.
longdesc:
The goblin woman is clothed in rags and scraps of cloth.  She is picking 
berries in the forest.  A small dagger can be seen tucked into her belt.  
She has long black hair and deep green eyes.

name: goblin child
shortdesc: The goblin child is running about playing in the woods.
longdesc:
The goblin child is swinging from the branches.  He is hanging upside 
down using his legs to hold him in place.  He chuckles once or twice and 
then spits in your direction.  He is covered in rags.

name: goblin warrior
shortdesc: The goblin warrior sits here planning his next plunder.
longdesc:
The goblin warrior is a stout little fellow.  He is covered in padded 
armor and carries a small sword.  He looks anxious to plunder and 
destroy.  He has dark hair and thick brown skin.

name: goblin mage
shortdesc: The goblin mage wanders aimlessly reciting spells.
longdesc:
The goblin mage is here practicing his craft.  Muttering several magical 
incantations the air around him erupts with fire.  He is dressed very 
shabbily with some old cloth.

name: bugbear warrior
shortdesc: The bugbear warrior is here searching for a fight.
longdesc:
The bugbear warrior is covered in brown fur.  He does not wear any armor 
nor does he need it.  He carries a small stone axe tied together with 
some rope.

name: bugbear chieftain
shortdesc: The bugbear chieftain is here giving orders to his warriors.
longdesc:
The bugbear chieftain stands here barking out orders.  He is much larger 
than the other bugbears.  He carries a large stone club that he is waving 
vigorously in the air.  His fur is dark black.

name: A sunning man
shortdesc: A very tan man suns himself along the sandy beach.
longdesc:
The man looks very peaceful and content as he suns himself on a 
multi-colored beach towel.  This poor guy is extremely tan, almost
olive in complexion.  "Hey! Get outta my sun!", he screams at you
as you have clearly gotten too close.

name: A sunning woman
shortdesc: An exceptionally tan woman stares up at the sun and smiles.
longdesc:
The woman is dressed simly in a one-piece purple bathing suit.  She
smiles happily as she stares into the sun with her sunglass covered
face.  Her tan is quite exceptional.  She must be out here every day.
Does anybody go to work around here?

name: A sleeping man
shortdesc: A tired looking man rolls over on his blanket, snoring away.
longdesc:
Somebody has been out in the sun entirely too long!  His skin is bright
red, like a freshly cooked lobster.  You can almost heal his skin
sizzling from here.  This poor man is going to be in terrible pain when
he wakes up.  It is probably best not to disturb him.

name: A sleeping woman
shortdesc: A sleeping woman snoozes peacefully on her beach towel.
longdesc:
This woman is quite lovely.  She snoozes peacefully on a large beach
towel.  Shifting gently under the sun, she sleeping woman finds a 
comfortable position and resumes a deep sleep.

name: A reading man
shortdesc: A content man carefully reads through the latest novel.
longdesc:
The man appears to be very comfortable on resting on his beach chair.
He is deep into a novel and is concentrating with all his might.  It
must be a good one!

name: A reading woman
shortdesc: A young woman takes out a book and sinks back in her chair.
longdesc:
The young woman seems to be having an extremely relaxing day.  A glass
of iced tea in one hand and a small paperback in the other, she sinks
back into her chair with a happy sigh.  "What.", she states plainly,
looking up at you above the rim of her sunglasses.  "Can't you see I'm 
trying to read.".  Oh my, better not mess with her.

name: A walking man
shortdesc: A smiling man takes a peaceful walk along the sandy beach.
longdesc:
The man walks peacefully along the beach, enjoying the sights, sounds
and smells of his surroundings.  He is dressed simply in some colored
swim trunks.  His bare upper body is taking a nice licking from the 
sun high above, as his skin is turning a love shade of brown.  Smiling
at you as he notices you checking him out, he non-chalantly continues
along the beach.

name: A walking woman
shortdesc: A beautiful woman tosses her hair as she strides across the sand.
longdesc:
Wow!  What a beautiful woman!  She almost floats across the sand as she
walks along the beach.  Everyone on the beach stops what they are doing
and simply stare at her, tongues wagging.  Tossing her hair at the 
onlookers, she smiles and continues along the beach.

name: A walking child
