shortdesc: A smiling child walks carefree across the sandy beach.
longdesc:
The child walks and skips along the sandy beach.  He smiles and waves
at all the other beach goers.  You have never seen a more carefree
spirit in all your life.  He seems to be having the time of his life.

name: A sand castle man
shortdesc: A smiling man builds a sand castle with his family.
longdesc:
The man carefully plans his next move.  He takes a step back to look
at his work and begins to shake his head.  Getting on his knees, he
looks at the sand castle and begins to smile.  "We need somemore
water boy.", he shouts to his son.  "Run to the water and grab some
for me, won't you?

name: A sand castle child
shortdesc: A young child helps his father build a huge sand castle.
longdesc:
The young man packs some sand into different size buckets next to the
sand castle.  He awaits the newest order from his father with baited
breath.  Quickly realizing that his father is too busy, he continues
to pack more buckets with sand.

name: A sand castle child
shortdesc: A little girl cries next to a large sand castle.
longdesc:
The little girl is a complete mess.  Her long blond pig tails are
drooped across her face.  Strands of snot flow from her nose and
drip into the sand as she cries for attention.  She must be jealous
of her brother.

name: A ball playing child
shortdesc: A small child tosses a beach ball to an older boy.
longdesc:
This young man seems to be having a ball, quite literally.  "Throw it
to me!", he shouts, jumping up and down.  "Stop hogging it all to
yourself!".  He stands about three feet tall and has a full head of
brown hair.  The child is dressed only in some red swimming shorts.

name: A ball playing kid
shortdesc: A young man plays ball with a small child.
longdesc:
Taunting his playmate, the young man keeps making motions that he is
going to throw his friend the ball, but keeps it all to himself.  The
boy seems to be about thirteen years old and is acting every bit of
it!  How rude.  He sticks his tongue out at the other boy and continues
to tease him.

name: A mean kid
shortdesc: A mean-looking young man walks up and kicks sand at you.
longdesc:
What a jerk!  This boy looks mean as spit!  He walks along the beach
kicking sand at beach goers and making rude remarks.  The bully notices
you looking at him and starts to move in your direction.  Stopping just
a few feet in front of you, he kicks a nice amount of sand on your
feet and moves about his merry way.  Jerk!

name: A walking couple
shortdesc: A happy couple walk hand in hand along the beach.
longdesc:
The couple does not even notice you as they walk along the beach  Their
hands break contact briefly as they move seperately around you, only
to reconnect quickly behind your back.  It is amazing they did not knock
you over!  Turning around to get another look at the love birds, you
notice them gazing lovingly in eachothers eyes.  L'amour!

name: a life guard
shortdesc: A life guard stands watch over the ocean.
longdesc:
*WHISTLE*  "HEY!", the life guard shouts, "Stop messing around over
there!".  Walking up and down the surf of the water, the life guard
watches diligently over the entire ocean.  He is taking his job very
seriously!  Blowing his stainless silver whistle again, he shouts at
more swimmers to behave themselves.

name: a life guard
shortdesc: A life guard stands vigilant watch over the ocean.
longdesc:
The life guard looks like something out of one of those naughty
parchments.  She is dressed in a skin tight one-piece swim suit that
shows off all of her ample assets.  Flowing brown hair falls down her
back like a waterfall and blows carefree from the breeze off the ocean
waters.  Turning towards you and smiling, she warns you to be careful
of the heavy surf.

name: A relaxing man
shortdesc: A man lays sprawled out over his beach towel, enjoying the day.
longdesc:
Somebody should have really re-thought the red speedo.  The over-weight
man lays sprawled out, spread eagle on a multi-colored beach towel.  He
smiles face up towards the sun, eyes closed.  Sweat glistens and rolls
off his plentiful skin like a deluge from a broken dam.  Yuck!

name: A relaxing woman
shortdesc: A relaxed looking woman sits comfortably under her beach umbrella.
longdesc:
The young woman sits lazily under her beach umbrella, enjoying the bright
day on the Oldport beach.  Her back is propped up against some beach
towels and she has a wide-brimmed straw hat on her head.  She takes out
a book from her sack and starts to read a book-marked page.

name: A eating man
shortdesc: A smiling man eats his lunch with much vigor.
longdesc:
The man smiles as his wife passes around food for the entire family.
He looks like he has not eaten all day and seems to be drooling just 
a little bit.  The smiling man is dressed only in some flowered green
swim shorts.  He grabs one of the sandwiches on the beach blanket and
begins to devour it with much vigor.

name: A eating woman
shortdesc: A joyful woman hands out food to her family.
longdesc:
What a beautiful woman!  She carefully takes out food from a straw
picnic blanket and carefully places it on a large beach blanket.  She
smiles tenderly at her family as she can tell they are all very hungry
for her tasty treats.  Pouring some drink from a sweating pitcher of
liquid into each of her family members glasses, she smiles and says,
"Dig in!".

name: A eating child
shortdesc: A young man sucks on a purple popsicle stick.
longdesc:
This young man is really enjoying the day with his family.  His purple
popsicle melts streaks of purple down his tanning arm.  Licking his
lips with his purple tongue, he looks up at his mom and asks for
another popsicle.

name: A eating child
shortdesc: A young girl nibbles on a peanut butter and jelly sandwich.
longdesc:
The young girl grabs a sandwich from a plate in the center of the picnic
blanket.  She looks up at her mother and screams her favorite letters,
"PBJ!"  With much gusto, she starts to nibble voraciously at the yummy
looking delight.  It is like a pack of pirahnas!  She lets out a cute
little scream and attacks the sandwhich again.

name: A walking man
shortdesc: A man walks peacefully in ankle deep water.
longdesc:
The beach goers is dressed in only some red swim shorts.  He walks 
through the ankle deep water without a care in the world.  Staring up
at the clouds, he sighs contently and continues to walk along the
shore line.

name: A walking couple
shortdesc: A happy couple walks hand in hand through the ankle deep water.
longdesc:
Ugh!  These people are so terribly happy it makes you start to gag.
They walk hand in hand through the beach shore line, almost singing as
they stare into each others eyes.  You better run before the music
starts.

name: A wading man
shortdesc: A smiling man wades serenly in the water.
longdesc:
Wading hapily through the water, the swimmer smiles up at the sky and
takes a deep breath.  He turns over onto his back and starts to float
peacefully in the water.  Hopefully there are not any sharks close by!

name: A tubing man
shortdesc: A man sits peacefully on a yellow intertube and floats along the water.
longdesc:
Legs and arms hanging over the yellow intertube, the tubing man floats
serenely atop the ocean water.  A black visor covering his eyes, his
face points up towards the sun and lets out a great big smile.  He lets
out a deep sigh and seems to drift off to a peaceful sleep, hopefully
not out to sea.

name: A lapping female
shortdesc: A young woman does laps up and down the shoreline.
longdesc:
This lady is dedicated!  All the people around her are relaxing and
enjoying themselves, yet here she is, doing laps along the shoreline.
Her strokes are deep and even as she easily breaks through the ocean's
waves.  Geez, take a break lady.

name: A sea gull
shortdesc: A white sea gull sits on the sand, waiting for some food to drop.
longdesc:
Wings folded in and eyes on high alert, the sea gull sits around the
beach goers.  It moves its heads back and forth, checking every inch
of sand for some small particle of food.  This poor thing must be
hungry.

name: A flying sea gull
shortdesc: A white sea gull swoops from the air and scoops up some food.
longdesc:
Soaring high above the beach, the sea gull lets out a terrible screaching
sound as it searches for food.  It circles the beach like a vulture,
just waiting for some sign of discarded food.  Quickly diving to the
ground, it scoops up something and climbs back into the air.

name: A crawling crab
shortdesc: A large crab crawls sideways across the sandy beach.
longdesc:
How cute!  The bright red crab crawls along the sandy beach, trying to
escape being stepped on.  It's white and red pinchers open and close
slowly as its many feel move quickly beneath it.  A bubbly breath sprays
from its mandibles as it sneaks underneath an unsuspecting beach goer.
Ouch!

name: A swimming male
shortdesc: A healthy man swims strong atop the rough ocean waters.
longdesc:
This man is in great physcial condition!  He swims quickly with tremendous
strength along the top of the ocean.  The waters are very rough out here
but he does not seem to be having any trouble at all.  He looks at you
quickly through his googles and continues with his training.

name: A swimming woman
shortdesc: A strong woman swims quickly across the rough open ocean.
longdesc:
This woman is a straight up pro!  The ocean waters are not very kind 
this far from the shoreline, but she does not seem to be bothered in the 
slightest!  Deeping her stroke and quicking her kick, she moves with
even more assurance throught the water.

name: A lost intertube man
shortdesc: A panicked man tries his hardest to swim back to shore.
longdesc:
HELP!", screams the man as he gets tossed around in the rough ocean
water. "My boy!", he pleads, "please find and save my child!".  The
look of desperation in his eyes brings a tear to yours.  He knows with
the new conviction in your eyes that you will help save his boy.

name: A lost intertube child
shortdesc: A screaming child looks at you and starts to cry.
longdesc:
Tears streaming down his face, the young man looks up and you and just
starts screaming.  "DAAAAAAADDDDDDDDYYYYYYY!", he lets loose under the
chokes of sobbing.  He simply puts his hands up to his face and starts
shaking untrollably.  This poor boy must have been out here for hours.

name: A snorkling man
shortdesc: A man swims quickly though the water with a snorkel in his mouth.
longdesc:
Decked out with some huge goggles and a snorkle, the man swims through 
the water with a smile on his face.  He seems to be enjoying all the 
sights of the ocean.  Stopping to stare at some fish here and there, he 
quickly moves along the bottom of the ocean.  He must have done this 
once of twice before, he is quite skilled.

name: A snorkling woman
shortdesc: A woman swims quickly through the water with a snorkel in her mouth.
longdesc:
This woman seems to be on a mission.  She dives down to the bottom of
the ocean and looks all around the sand for something.  Sifting through
the sand, she pulls out a shell and places it in a small sack.  Smiling,
she quickly swims up to the ocean's surface for some fresh air before
further investigation.

name: A snorkling couple
shortdesc: A couple swims quickly through the water, hand in hand.
longdesc:
Awwwwwww, how sweet.  This couple is just taking their time as they
swim through the water, checking out all the sights of the ocean.  They
grasp each other's hands and smile lovingly into each other's eyes as
they float back to the ocean's surface for some fresh air.

name: A snorkling man
shortdesc: A snorkler looks at all the pretty reef life.
longdesc:
This snorkler seems to be having the time of his life.  With gigantic
eyes, he carefully floats through the water as he examines the plentiful
ocean reef.  Looking at all the colorful coral and stroking a few
starfish with his fingers, he smiles and heads back up to the ocean's
surface for some fresh air.

name: A snorkeling woman
shortdesc: A snorkeling woman carefully touches the coral reef.
longdesc:
The woman smiles lovingly as she carefully touches different parts
of the coral reef.  She looks at all the different colors and shapes
of the coral.  The snorkler lets out a look of diappointment as she has
to float back to the ocean's surface for more air.

name: A dolphin
shortdesc: A blue and grey dolphin swims freely through the ocean.
longdesc:
What a beautiful creature!  The dolphin's skin seems to give off a blue
and gray shimmer as the sunlight from above hits it.  It notices you 
briefly and darts in another direction quickly.  Suddenly, you feel a
poke at your back and see the dolphin nodding its head.  It must want
to play some games with you!

name: a shark
shortdesc: A grey shark cautiously circles around you.
longdesc:
Oh geez!  The shark looks very frigthening as it swims entirely to
close to you.  Starting to slowly circle, you can tell the shark has
noticed its next meal.  This shark must just be curious as it stays
a considerable distance away from you.  It is probably best to just
swim away from the creature as slowly as you can.

name: a shark
shortdesc: A grey shark swims towards your menacingly.
longdesc:
Oh geez!  The shark looks very frigthening as it swims entirely to
close to you.  Starting to slowly circle, you can tell the shark has
noticed its next meal.  Quickening up its pace, you can almost see
the creature salivating at the thought of fresh meat.  This would be 
a good time to swim faster.  The shark must have sensed your panic
as it stops circling and opens up its mighty jaws to attack.

name: A barracuda
shortdesc: A silver barracuda swims quickly through the water.
longdesc:
*Ouch!*  Something stabs at your side as you swim through the open
water.  Looking at your side, you can see this glimmer of silver skin
quickly swimming away.  Without much time passing, another sharp pain
comes from you right leg.  This is a great time to swim away really
fast.

name: A blue fish
shortdesc: A blue fish swims away from you quickly.
longdesc:
The fish is almost circular when lookin at it from the side.  As it
turns toward you, its circular shape turns into just about a two or
three inch width.  Its cute little fishy beak makes faces at you in
protest for you violating its ocean.  The blue fish swims away quickly
as you approach to get a closer look.

name: A red fish
shortdesc: A red fish darts quickly through the water.
longdesc:
The fish has almost a oblong shape as it darts through the water.  Its
quick swimming must have stream-lined its species throughout time.  The
red glimmer of its skin as the sun touches it almost make it look like
a streak of flame.  How pretty!

name: A sparkly fish
shortdesc: A sparkly fish glitters from the falling sunlight.
longdesc:
A sparkling light shoots through the water just a few feet in front of
you.  Adjusting your eyes a little, you can see a sparkly fish swimming
quickly through the ocean.  The sunlight falling down through the water
makes it look like the fish is actually emitting light.  How beautiful!

name: A sea turtle
shortdesc: A large sea turtle slowly drifts through the water.
longdesc:
Lumbering slowly through the water, the sea turtle drifts along the
ocean currents.  Gorgeous with a nice combination of blue and green
colorings, the ancient creature almost smiles at you as it passes.  
Its long and majestic fins wave and continue to drift along the 
currents.

name: a giant squid
shortdesc: A giant squid shoots a cloud of ink and swims off.
longdesc:
My goodness!  The scariest thing you have seen in a long time drifts
directly into your sights.  Its many tentacles start to flail and 
contract around your head and body.  A huge plume of ink sets off in
the water as you feel the tentacles of the giant squid start to let
go.  You barely get another look at the creature as the ink cloud starts
to clear and the squid swims away in the distance.

name: a whale
shortdesc: A gigantic whale sings a song as it lumbers along the ocean.
longdesc:
Wow!  Easily the size of a house, the whale lumbers along the ocean
waters directly in front of you.  A soothing sound drifts through the
waters as you approach closer to the gigantic mammal.  Once of the
animal's huge eyes looks at you carefully as it turns and starts to
drift in another direction.

name: a small crab
shortdesc: A small crab scrambles along the coral reef.
longdesc:
The small crab has almost an orange color to it.  The little creatures
clambers along the coral reef, weaving in and out of holes.  It seems
to know its home quite well and has probably been here for a while.

name: A sea anemone
shortdesc: A large sea anemone sways back and forth on the coral reef.
longdesc:
The sea anemone is quite beautiful with its purple and blue colors.  It
sways back and forth very peacefully, moving like a slave to the ocean
current.  Tiny fish dart in and out of the sea anemone's long tentacles.
They seem to be quite at home here.

name: a small wrasse
shortdesc: A small wrasse darts in and out of the coral reef.
longdesc:
The wrasse is a tiny little fish.  It is almost gray in color and
does not seem to have a care in the world.  The little fish just swims
in and out of the holes along the coral reef.

name: A parrot fish
shortdesc: A parrot fish swims peacefully along the coral reef.
longdesc:
The parrot fish looks at complete peace as it swims along the coral
reef.  It has a blue-beaked mouth and orange colored scales.  The fish
swims through the coral with great adeptness and agility.

name: An angel fish
shortdesc: An angel fish swims gracefully along the coral reef.
longdesc:
The angel fish truely lives up to its name!  This is probably the
most beautiful fish in the ocean.  The sun glistening in from the
top of the ocean almost seems to make the animal glimmer.

name: a large sponge
shortdesc: A large sponge sits affixed to the coral reef.
longdesc:
It's a sponge.  Quite honestly, what do you expect it to do.  It is
large and yellow, and of course, quite spongey.

name: An orange starfish
shortdesc: An orange starfish sticks steadfast to the coral reef.
longdesc:
The starfish is affixed to the side of the coral reef.  It is orange
and has five tentacles.

name: A spiny lobster
shortdesc: A spiny lobster crawls all over the coral reef.
longdesc:
The lobster is red and has large spiked claws.  It crawls along the
coral reef without fear, unafraid of you or anything.  Its mighty
spiked take shakes back and forth as it continues to crawl along the
coral reef.

name: A large grouper
shortdesc: A large grouper swims lazily along the coral reef.
longdesc:
The grouper is rather gray in color.  It lumbers along the bottom of the
ocean, swimming closely to the coral reef.  Perhaps it thinks that it
can blend into the surroundings of the reef and not be captured.  The
only thought on your mind is roasted grouper.  Go catch that lunch!

name: an albino octopus
shortdesc: A pale white octopus glares at you menacingly from the bottom of the pool.
longdesc:
The bottom of the pool starts to swirl and become cloudy as you enter it.
Pale white tentacles shoot out towards you and begin to wrap around your
body.  They begin to constrict like several large boa constrictors and
the air slowly starts to leave your lungs.  Staring down to the bottom
of the pool, you see the hungry eyes of the albino octopus looking up
at you.

name: a ghost shark
shortdesc: The ghost of a long dead shark swims towards you quickly.
longdesc:
Pale and translucent, the shark-like ghost shimmers through the water
in front of you.  It emits a cold that sends shivers straight through 
to your very bones.  The ghost shark begins to circle you as it seems
to think of the best way to attack.  Opening its mouth, it shows an
unnatural amount of sharp and deadly looking teeth.  This is a great
time to get out of the water.

name: the pirate king
shortdesc: The pirate king divvies out the latest booty to the pirates.
longdesc:
Tall and strong, the pirate king stands in the center of the cave and
looks over their latest booty.  There is a huge chest here, heaping
with golden coins and shining gemstones.  The king has a large black
brimmed hat with skull and crossbones on the front.  He quickly notices
that you have entered the cave and prepares his men for attack.

name: a stocky pirate
shortdesc: A stocky pirate sits on a stone towards the back of the cave.
longdesc:
This pirate does not look very intelligent.  In fact, he seems to be
picking the remainder of his intelligence directly out of his nasal
cavity.  He looks up with a dumb stare when his commander orders an
attack, but resumes his favorite business.  Picking his nose?

name: A short pirate
shortdesc: A short pirate plays with his dagger on the cavern floor.
longdesc:
Looking quite skilled, the short pirate almost dances with his dagger.
He throws it in the air, twirls it around his fingers and spins it
around his hand.  It truely seems like it is walking on air.  He stands
quickly at his commanders orders to attack and aims his dagger directly
at your face.

name: A one-eyed pirate
shortdesc: A one-eyed pirate stares at you menacingly.
longdesc:
This pirate looks like someone just stepped on his puppy.  You have 
never seen such a sad face in all your life.  It is probably best to
not even mess with this person.  Unfortunately for you, his commander
has just ordered for attack.  He stands with a terrible face and
practically slits your throat with his eyes.

name: a brown bat
shortdesc: A brown bat stares down at you from the tunnel ceiling.
longdesc:
A pair of red eyes opens up from the top of the tunnel ceiling.  A
large brown bat stares down at you hungrily.  It bares its teeth and
dive bombs straight at your head.

name: Beezlebub Junior
shortdesc: A smiling demon looks down at you from his throne.
longdesc:
"So", the demon smiles down at you from his throne.  "You've come to
take back the heart of the midnight thicket?"  His smile turns into a
huge demonic grin as he pats his stomach.  "You are too late!  I have
already eaten its heart and ingested its power!"  Beezlebub Junior
starts to glow with a red light.  The light has so intense that it
illuminates the entire cavern.  "Killing me will not get back the
heart, but you are welcome to try.", he smirks, cackling at the top of
his lungs.

name: A prickly demon
shortdesc: A demon with large thorns grows out from the vines.
longdesc:
The demon grows out from the vines directly in front of you.  Its colors
are a mixture of dark green and black.  Huge black thorns with red tips,
almost like a blade, grow out of its body.  The demon stares at you
menacingly.  You must be intruding in his territory.

name: A prickly demon
shortdesc: A demon with large thorns slides along the vines.
longdesc:
The demon slides down a long length of vine, swerving in and out of
large thorns sticking out from the fauna.  The prickly demon is a dark
green color and has black patches all over its body.  Lifting its
forearms in front of its face, large thorns grow out from its arms
like a razor blade.  Looking up from behind its arms, it stares at you
with an intense hatred.

name: A prickly demon
shortdesc: A demon with large thorns slices at you viciously.
longdesc:
The prickly demon jumps at you from on top of a large vine.  It has
long, curved black thorns on its forearm that look very sharp!  A
bright red color lines the edge of the thorn.  It is difficult to tell
if it is blood or the demon's natural color.  Slash viciously at your
face and chest, it follows up with a high kick to your face.  Some 
thorns from the demons legs almost take out your eyes.  What a jerk!

name: A vine demon
shortdesc: An elongated demon grows out from the vines.
longdesc:
The demons slowly rises from one for the gigantiv vines of the midnight
thicket.  The demon is extremely long and seems to be made up of
bundles of tiny vines.  Well, tiny compared to the huge tree-like vines
making up the majority of the thicket.  Red ruby eyes glow from where
eye sockets should be.  This thing looks angry!

name: A vine demon
shortdesc: An elongated demon swings and slides along the vines.
longdesc:
Swinging in like a jungle man, the vine demon lands on the vine in
front of you with a thump.  Its long tendril like vines flail through
the air in pure fury.  The demon's body is made up of a mass of small
vines, dark green in color.  It moves towards you slowly in a menacing
manner.

name: A vine demon
shortdesc: An elongated demon slashes at you with a long spikey whip.
longdesc:
*CRACK*!  The vine demon snaps its whip-like hands just a few feet from
your head.  It is obvious that the demon knows you were not looking
because it probably could have taken off your head.  Seeming to want
a fair fight, the demon backs off a little and allows you to draw your 
weapon.  How nice!

name: A black demon
shortdesc: A black colored demon rises from the shadows.
longdesc:
Rising slowly from the shadows, the demon would completely blend with
the darkness if it was not for a faint outline of its figure.  Suddenly
the outline is gone and you can feel a faint breath at your neck.
Something or someone is definitely behind you!  Jumping away quickly,
you can finally see the demon in full.  It almost looks like a small
child in shape.  There are no distinct characteristics besides the
swirling vortex that is its mouth.  It seems to be sucking everything
in, including you!

name: A black demon
shortdesc: A black colored demon stares at you as he materializes.
longdesc:
Stepping out from the darkness, a pitch-black demon materializes
directly in front of you.  The demon looks something like a small child,
except it has no features.  Slowly opening its mouth, the darkness
in that area begins to swirl and rotate.  It almost looks like a vortex.
The black demon slowly moves towards you as the vortex swirls faster
and faster.  You can almost feel yourself being pulled towards it.

name: A shivering demon
shortdesc: A shivering demon stands up slowly and creeps towards you.
longdesc:
Slowing rising from the vine in front of you, this demon shivers like
it is intensely cold.  The air here is rather warm, so something else
must be happening here.  The shivering demon's head jerks towards you
with a snap and its eyes open wide.  You can tell it is hungry from 
the look in its eyes and you appear to be its next meal.

name: A shivering demon
shortdesc: A shivering demon crawls through the vines looking very hungry.
longdesc:
The shivering demon looks like a mummy as it roams the midnight thicket.
Its arms are stretched out straight and long, almost like it is 
searching for something.  It stops abruptly, sensing your presence and 
its eyes and mouth open wide.  The demon's intense red eyes stare 
directly into yours and youcan tell only one thing is on its mind.  Its 
next meal.

name: A shivering demon
shortdesc: A shivering demon reaches out and tries to steal your warmth.
longdesc:
The demon immediatey reaches for you as you pass by it.  Your skin
begins to feel cold and your armor starts to crack.  The shivering
demon begins to smile as it drains your energy.  Its grip is getting
stronger and firmer.  This would be a great time to run.

name: A spikey demon
shortdesc: A demon with huge spikes grows out from the vines.
longdesc:
The demon looks almost like a porcupine or puffer fish.  There are small
spikes sticking out all over its body.  Most noticeably on its forearms,
chest and back.  The demon is growing out directly from a large length
of the midnight thicket.  It stares at you intently as you walk further
along the vine.

name: A spikey demon
shortdesc: A demon covered in huge spikes jumps from vine to vine.
longdesc:
The spikey demon seems very lively!  It jumps from vine to vine,
searcing out its next victim.  You almost get lots in its acrobatic
feats until you realize it is moving directly towards you.  The demon
raises his hands above his head in a clenched fist and tries to drive
them into you.

name: A spikey demon
shortdesc: A demon with huge spikes points his fists and shoots some spikes at you.
longdesc:
You feel a slight prick in your neck, almost like a mosquito.  Looking
around, you see a large spikey demon staring directly at you.  It 
raises its arms straight out towards you and small spikes begin to
fly at you.  Yikes!

name: A perched bird
shortdesc: A chirping bird sits perched on top of a vine.
longdesc:
The bird sits perched on top of a large thorn along the vines of the
midnight thicket.  It chirps happily and without a care in the world.
The bird is blue in color and has a white patch on its chest.

name: A flying bird
shortdesc: A distressed bird can't seem to find its way out of the vines.
longdesc:
The bird soars in and out of the vines, trying to find a way to escape.
It can not seem to find a way out.  The bird seems to be in distress.
It is obvious that this poor creature has been trying to escape for 
a while.  The bird it red in color and has cute little white patches
beneath its wings.

name: A cricket
shortdesc: A cricket rubs its legs together as it stares at you.
longdesc:
The cricket sits peacefully on a nearby fine.  It stares are you, but
does not seem afraid.  Rubbing its legs together, it seems to be playing
some music.  It could be pleasant song but may be your death knell.

name: A roaming cricket
shortdesc: A large cricket jumps along the vines.
longdesc:
The cricket jumps from vine to vine, fluttering its wings to have even
more air time.  It does not seem to have a care in the world.  Jumping
on your head and resting for a second, it quickly hops off to another
vine.

name: A grasshopper
shortdesc: A grasshopper chews on one of the larger vines.
longdesc:
The grasshopper seems to be having the time of its life.  It chews
away on a vine like it owns the place.  The poor thing must be hungry.

name: A roaming grasshopper
shortdesc: A grasshopper flies blindly through the midnight thicket.
longdesc:
The grasshopper flies full out through the midnight thicket.  It does
not seem to want to be here anymore.  You have the same feeling!

name: A millipede
shortdesc: A long millipede curls itself around a large thorn.
longdesc:
The millipede looks so cute as it sits curled up around the large thorn.
Its thousand legs move and twitch like it is having a busy dream,
maybe it is chasing smaller bugs.

name: A roaming millipede
shortdesc: A long millipede twists and clings to a large vine.
longdesc:
The millipede twists and curls along a large vine as it moves through
the midnight thicket.  It is quite long as it wraps around the
considerably large vines almost two times.

name: A laughing demon
shortdesc: A demon laughs and dances around the giant cavern with his friends.
longdesc:
The demon seems to be having a great time.  It laughs at the top of
its lungs and dances all around the gigantic cavern.  Looking up to
its master on the top of his throne, the demon shouts something loud
in its own tongue.  It was probably something celebratory!

name: A singing demon
shortdesc: A smiling demon sings the praises of the demon prince.
longdesc:
The demon drops to its knees and bows to Beezlebub Junior.  It smiles
as it see the demon glow with an intense red light.  Standing up with
conviction, the demon lets out a strange sounding ballad in honor of
its master.  You can not understand a thing since it is in demon
tongue.

name: A spinning demon
shortdesc: A joyful demon grabs his friend and spins around in a circle.
longdesc:
Spinning like a top, the demon screams with glee as it dances around
the cavern.  It grabs some of its friends nearby and has them join
it in the dancing.  Screaming with delight, it lets go of its friends
and spins off in another direction.

name: A laughing demon
shortdesc: A demon laughs with all his might at all the fun going on.
longdesc:
The demon grabs its stomach and doubles over in laughter.  It cannot
seem to control itself with all the mayhem going on.  The demon stands
up, points at its friends and laughs even louder.  What a card.

name: Beelzebub Junior
shortdesc: A smiling demon looks down at you from his throne.
longdesc:
"So", the demon smiles down at you from his throne.  "You've come to
take back the heart of the midnight thicket?"  His smile turns into a
huge demonic grin as he pats his stomach.  "You are too late!  I have
already eaten its heart and ingested its power!"  Beelzebub Junior
starts to glow with a red light.  The light has so intense that it
illuminates the entire cavern.  "Killing me will not get back the
heart, but you are welcome to try.", he smirks, cackling at the top of
his lungs.

name: the King of Tarin
shortdesc: The king of Tarin stands here looking at the statues.
longdesc:
The first thing you notice about this man is the way he stands.
Nothing, not even a single muscle seems to move on his body. He
stands like he was frozen in time and space.  Battle scars show
the great deal of experience this man has.

name: the stone statue
shortdesc: A stone statue stands here.
longdesc:
You see a statue with a strange skin made of stone. It's pearly white
looks mad.

name: magic minotaur servant
shortdesc: a Magic Minotaur Servant stands here in attention
longdesc:
The servant of the Minotaur God stands here with its eyes
fixed on the ground. He would never dare to look his master
in the eye, he quitely whispers 'please get out of here'

name: the Warlord
shortdesc: An enormous looking warlord stands here.
longdesc:
You see a golem, undead, hovering above you with an insane look in its
eyes.

name: the silver dragon
shortdesc: A beautiful silver dragon rests on a throne of gold.
longdesc:
You see a beautiful silver dragon, though tired of holding this last
bastion from the evil forces, still pretty. Once in a while you see
the silver body fade into an even more beautiful young woman.

name: the royal elven captain
shortdesc: A royal elf captain stands guard here.
longdesc:
You see a young elf guard, looking human though a couple of sticky ears
shows the difference.

name: the elven guard
shortdesc: A young elven guard stands here.
longdesc:
You see a rather broad shouldered guard with a firm look in his eyes.
The many days under siege have surely made him tired, but non the less
he is still on his post guarding the queen, the silver dragon.

name: the elven hall guard
shortdesc: A large elven hall guard stands here watching the curtains.
longdesc:
You see a tired looking elf with big blue eyes, the white hair is long
and though the tired look on his face, he seems ready to fight for his
life.

name: the elven battlemaster
shortdesc: A large elven battlemaster stands here.
longdesc:
You see a dark elf with frey hair, his eyes is sparkling blue and shows
no fear of anything.

name: the undead lich
shortdesc: A large undead lich is here growling like a fierce animal.
longdesc: You see an undead wizard assembling wierd powers of evil.

name: thievy minotaur servant
shortdesc: A Thievy Minotaur Servant stands here in attention
longdesc:
The servant of the Minotaur God stands here with its eyes
fixed on the ground. He would never dare to look his master
in the eye, he quitely whispers 'please get out of here'

name: mystic minotaur servant
shortdesc: A Mystic Minotaur Servant stands here in attention
longdesc:
The servant of the Minotaur God stands here with its eyes
fixed on the ground. He would never dare to look his master
in the eye, he quitely whispers 'please get out of here'

name: the black knight
shortdesc: A black knight charges you.
longdesc:
You see a humanoid creature, it's skin is dark and no-one ever seemed to
be able to rid the world of it's presence.

name: the drake
shortdesc: A large drake stands here, burning with scorching heat.
longdesc:
The huge mouth is covered in blood, and from the color you guess it must be
human. -* Eirk *-

name: the undead blacksmith
shortdesc: The undead blacksmith stands here, doing it's dirty job.
longdesc:
You see the looks of a once peaceful blacksmith turned, by the evil forces,
into this horrible creature.

name: the black minotaur
shortdesc: A large black minotaur stands here, drooling like a madman.
longdesc: You see a large creature, totally enveloped in darkness.

name: Minotaur God
shortdesc: The God of Minotaurs rests on the throne looking very angry.
longdesc:
You see a mass with the form of a minotaur, large claws that look to be able
to cut through rock are on both hands and feet. His rings look like they have
been crafted over generations by skilled craftsmen. His armor and sword shines.
On his head he wears a great set of horns with trophies impaled.

Eyes burning with hatred and a laugh meet you as your paths cross.

name: the black baron
shortdesc: The black baron stands here planning the next attack upon the dragon.
longdesc:
The black baron is a nasty looking man converted to the dark side of life,
his eyes ears have been cut off and the only thing on him that reminds of a
human being is the fact that he still got his nose and eyes. Both blue!

name: the elven soldier
shortdesc: An elven soldier stands guard here.
longdesc:
You see an elf with green eyes and huge sticky ears. The long blond hair is
carefully placed beneith a helmet.

name: the undead wolf
shortdesc: An undead wolf sneaks around here.
longdesc: You see a wolf like creature with red flaming eyes.

name: the burned tree
shortdesc: A burned tree hoovers above you, it seems to have been dead for ages.
longdesc:
You see an enormous tree lacking every branch and every leaf on it's body,
what ever the force who did this is, it is indeed powerful.

name: the undead earth snake
shortdesc: A fairly large undead earth snake slitters around here.
longdesc: A slimy slettering snake, with an ugly tongue.

name: the silvery waiter
shortdesc: A young silvery waiter stands here.
longdesc: You see one of the personal waiter of the silver dragon.

name: the king of trees
shortdesc: The king of all trees in the world stands here, thinking about life.
longdesc:
You see a "thing" with leaf's and branches almost in the shape of a human
being, a pair of white eyes have been placed on something looking just like
a human head.

name: A huge ancient tree
shortdesc: A huge ancient tree stands here, guarding the north entrance.
longdesc:
You see a large tree, that doesn't move a bit when you approach it. It's
arms and legs are leg giant branches from the biggest tree you have ever
seen. Battlescars is everywhere on this trees body.

name: the black griffin
shortdesc: A black griffin flies around here.
longdesc:
You see a dark dog like creature with a huge pair of wings on it's back,
it's red eyes glares evilly at you.

name: the undead spirit
shortdesc: A transparent spirit is hoovering above the ground here.
longdesc: The spirit is white, and looks just like a cartoon monster.

name: the titan
shortdesc: A HUGE titan sits here eating some rotten flesh from a corpse.
longdesc:
You see a humanoid creature with ENORMOUS arms, it's eyes are firmly
fixedd upon the rotten flesh it's eating.

name: the sphinx
shortdesc: A strange looking sphinx rests under a huge tree.
longdesc:
You see a strange looking creature half dog half human, it's eyes looks
at you as though it was going to ask you a question.

name: A black wasp king
shortdesc: The black wasp king is disgusted and angry.
longdesc:
A black wasp king is here working to keep his Queen happy.
He commands the soliders and the workers and makes sure
that the larvae are fed the next meal.

name: The Black Wasp Queen
shortdesc: The Queen is looking fierce as she lays her eggs and eats her young
longdesc:
Straight out of the nightmare this Queen wasp is not happy, with a fierce stinger
ready to stab any thing that gets in her way. Her eyes filled with blackness with her
bulging mid-section that appears armored and battle worn.

name: a wasp soldier
shortdesc: A wasp soldier isn't happy working for the queen.
longdesc: This wasp soldier must be a commander because it is bigger than the others.

name: a wasp soldier
shortdesc: A wasp soldier isn't happy working for the queen.
longdesc: This wasp soldier is smaller and more fragile than the larger soldiers.

name: a wasp soldier
shortdesc: A wasp soldier isn't happy working for the queen.
longdesc:
This wasp soldier looks like it hasn't got much on the other larger soldiers in the
colony.

name: a wasp worker
shortdesc: The wasp worker goes back and forth for the queen.
longdesc:
This worker is thicker in the midsection than the soldier wasp, but does not have
the overall size. It is most likely that this worker wasp has no other role than
to serve the queen, and possibly as her next meal.

name: a wasp worker
shortdesc: The wasp worker goes back and forth for the queen
longdesc:
This worker is callous and energetic. He lacks the size of the larger soldier to serve
the queen in any other role.

name: a wasp worker
shortdesc: The wasp worker goes back and forth for the queen.
longdesc:
This worker could use a few more pounds. It doesn't seem very interested in doing
anything else but serving the queen.

name: a wasp worker
shortdesc: The wasp worker goes back and forth for the queen.
longdesc: Every wasp worker has its mission and role. Some are larger and some are just small. This worker appears to want to do nothing more than work for the queen.

name: a wasp larvae
shortdesc: The larvae is just here growing, and waiting to be trained.
longdesc:
The larvae is the next generation for the queen. They don't do anything and
have no other purpose than to grow and wait to be selected by the queen.

name: a wasp larvae
shortdesc: The larvae is just here growing, and waiting to be trained
longdesc: This larva looks like a fresh hatchling.

name: a small ugly rodent
shortdesc: The large ugly rodent is sniffing from bush to bush and foraging for food
longdesc:
The ugly little rodent is a creature of the dense forest and has a family of other
small rodent critters.

name: a pack of small rodents
shortdesc: The pack of smaller rodents are foraging for food and looking for shelter.
longdesc:
There are many rodents - at least 8 or more. They are looking for food and a place
to shelter. They don't seem to be too bothered at the moment.

name: a bushy tailed squirrel
shortdesc: A small bushy tailed squirrel is here runng through the forest
longdesc:
A small furry creature of the forest is here looking for nuts, plants, or any type of
vegetation that is edible.

name: a brown speckled spider
shortdesc: The brown speckled spider is crawling around looking for a place to hide
longdesc:
The brown speckled spider is a friendly spider that helps keep the bug population
from getting too large. He seems a bit bulky and has multiple legs, but may be a
good ally.

name: a giant wasp guard
shortdesc: The Giant Guard wasp is pulling a human prisoner around by his neck collar and chain.
longdesc:
I am not sure where the human is going - but it is clear that he is a prisoner and
does not look happy.

name: a human prisoner
shortdesc: A sad looking human prisoner is here wearing a chain and collar around his neck.
longdesc:
Perhaps this human is imprisoned for just being...well human. He doesn't look
happy, and he is closely guarded.

name: a giant prison gatekeeper
shortdesc: A Giant wasp gatekeeper is here guarding the entrance to the prison.
longdesc:
The Giant gatekeeper wasp is ugly and has a bad disposition. Do not anger
him or you could be his next prisoner.

name: Daane the Weaponsmith
shortdesc: Daane the Terberthian smithy is imprisoned in servitude for the queen.
longdesc:
The smithy is small and rotund, but not weak, after all he works with metals and
fire on a regulary basis. He is upset that he is trapped in the servitude of the
Queen wasp and is frequently visited by the Kings elite guard. He often thinks of
his sister Jaana and would love to be reunited with her someday. He has no idea where
she is.

name: Fabian the Financier
shortdesc: Fabian the financier of Terberthia has been working for the queen and is enslaved for life.
longdesc:
Fabian does not look happy to be here. He has been enslaved by the Queen wasp
and doesn't expect to live much longer, as he has already been warned to garner
wages from unsuspecting humans - or else!

name: Henry the Healer
shortdesc: Henry the healer does not look very satisfied in his current line of work enslaved by the Queen.
longdesc:
Henry has been told to heal the wasps using a formula give to him by the King
Wasp. However he certainly wants to be a better healer to the Humans but has
to be careful not to let the elite guard of the Queen's army catch him!

name: Reagen the InnKeeper
shortdesc: Reagen the local InnKeeper is enslaved by the queen but carefully serves weakened enemies of the colony.
longdesc:
Reagen doesn't appear to have much life left in her. She has been enslaved by
the Queen's army, but would like to help as much as possible rid Terberthia of
the wasp colony.

name: A Queen's Valkyrie Guard
shortdesc: The Elite Valkyrie Guard protects the queen with her life
longdesc:
The Valkyrie wasp guard is the Elite Guard that protects the queen at any
cost. He is, next to the King, the most massive wasp that lives within the
colony.

name: a wasp scout
shortdesc: The wasp scout is making sure the human slaves are attending to the colony.
longdesc:
The king has hand selected these wasps to scout around the town and make sure
the human slaves are working for the queen.

name: Travestin the Kept
shortdesc: Travestin stands alone unguarded - betrayer of the Terberthian mages
longdesc:
Travestin long ago betrayed Cragmeer and the Terberthian mages.  He
supported the queen wasp and was a traitor to his people. Now he lives among
the wasps as a mage traitor.

name: Doldomus the Traitor
shortdesc: Doldomus the mage stands here kept and unguarded, a traitor to Terberthia
longdesc:
Doldomus fooled Cragmeer and betrayed the mages of Terberthia.  He supported
the queen wasp for rewards of countless riches and power.

name: A King's Guardian
shortdesc: The Giant guardian for the King is here protecting the loot.
longdesc: The King's guard is securing the treasures of the colony with his life.

name: Borald Guardian Auctioneer
shortdesc: Borald stands tall and looks mean as he auctions and shouts to the crowd.
longdesc:
Borald is the wasp auctioneer and is quite inhumane about the way he does
his business.  His strength and demeanor let you know that there is nothing
to do but leave him alone.

name: a wasp slave driver
shortdesc: The wasp slave driver is here pushing around the enslaved.
longdesc:
The wasp slave driver is the one who reports directly to the king and finds new
recruits to join the slave community. Wanna Join?

name: Palmeiro the Shopkeeper
shortdesc: Palmeiro the Terberthian shopkeeper is imprisoned in servitude for the queen.
longdesc:
The shopkeep is thin and tall and is upset that he is trapped in the servitude of the
Queen wasp.

name: Redbourn the False Prophet
shortdesc: Redbourn stands alone, a traitor to his people.
longdesc:
Redbourn is a traitor and a complete fool. He designed many of the
weapons and armor of the mages - only to be tricked into using those
inventions against his own race.

name: Tufanda the mage warrior
shortdesc: Tufanda stands with weakness and for nothing, a traitor to Terberthia
longdesc:
Tufanda fooled his elders and betrayed the mages of Terberthia.  He supported
the queen wasp for power but only ended up being a prisoner of his own making.
He betrayed Cragmeer and joined forces with the colony, and with the help of
other traitors, he has almost completely destroyed his own kind.

name: an Elven Princeling
shortdesc: A young Elven Princeling is here, waiting on a ransom from his kin.
longdesc:
This young Elven Princeling is desperately waiting on a ransom from his
kin so that he can be free of this dreary prison.

name: a young Fortish noble
shortdesc: A young Fortish noble sits here, head in his hands, awaiting release by the Queen.
longdesc:
Taken from Fortrum in a daring raid, this young noble has not been home in a long time.
Are you his saviour?

name: Mari de Forxabell
shortdesc: Mari de Forxabell, a drow noble, sits here, alone, and afraid.
longdesc:
Mari de Forxabell was a young drow noble out of her first scouting mission in
the Underdark when the wasps attacked.  She alone was taken whilst the others
were fed upon by the angry soldiers.  Now she sits here, waiting for her fate.
If she has one.

name: Loqas the Lizard
shortdesc: Loqas, an adolescent lizardman, is here trying to escape his cell.
longdesc:
This is Loqas, a young lizardman of the tribes surrounding Dark Horn Hill.  He
was taken whilst out with his cousins in the Swamps of Amnos, raiding eggs from
the nests of rare birds.  Only he survived, and now he desperately seeks to
escape back to the wetness of the bogs.

name: Ophelia Trakad
shortdesc: Ophelia Trakad, youngest daughter of Queen Trakad, is here, crying.
longdesc:
This is Ophelia Trakad, youngest daughter of Queen Trakard of OldPort.  She
is a pretty young teen, taken by the wasps in a raid on OldPort just as her
uncle, the Earl Trakad, betrayed her family.

name: Morris the Undertaker
shortdesc: Morris the undertaker of Terberthia is here and will assist those in need.
longdesc:
Morris does not look happy to be here. He has been enslaved by the Queen wasp
and doesn't expect to live much longer - fitting role he has!!

name: A Queen's Valkyrie Guard
shortdesc: The Elite Valkyrie Guard protects the queen with her life
longdesc:
The Valkyrie wasp guard is the Elite Guard that protects the queen at any
cost. He is, next to the King, the most massive wasp that lives within the
colony.

name: Gosellel the Powerful
shortdesc: Gosellel the Powerful is here working for the queen - and is a traitor.
longdesc:
Gosellel cannot be trusted as he aligned with the colony to destroy the mages
for power and greed.  A once brilliant and trusted powermage - he has created a
most unique technology. His amazing size seems irregular, irrational, and bewildering.

name: Yyles the Ambassador
shortdesc: Yyles the Ambassador for the Queen wasp has hate in his eyes.
longdesc:
Another traitor to Terberthia stands before you. A double cross, a cheat, and a
staunch killer, Yyles looks for a reason to make you uncomfortable and fearful
of his new mistress, the Queen wasp.

name: a giant shark
shortdesc: A giant shark is hungry and swims around looking for a meal.
longdesc: A giant white shark with large teeth is here looking for a BITE to eat.

name: a large pirahna
shortdesc: A large pirahna with with sharp teeth passes through.
longdesc: A large pirahna aggressively swims toward you with super sharp teeth.

name: a jumbo electric jellyfish
shortdesc: A jumbo electric jellyfish with lots of tentacles heads your way.
longdesc:
A jumbo jellyfish is loaded with stingers and giant tentacles seems to be in a hurry
to meet you.

name: The Prison Warden
shortdesc: A wasp prison warden is here protecting the prison.
longdesc: The wasp prison warden is mean and has a fierce temper.

name: a wasp soldier
shortdesc: A wasp soldier isn't happy working for the queen.
longdesc:
This wasp soldier looks like it hasn't got much on the other larger soldiers in the
colony.

name: a wasp worker
shortdesc: The wasp worker goes back and forth for the queen.
longdesc:
This worker is thicker in the midsection than the soldier wasp, but does not have
the overall size. It is most likely that this worker wasp has no other role than
to serve the queen, and possibly as her next meal.

name: a giant wasp guard
shortdesc: The Giant Guard wasp is pulling a human prisoner around by his neck collar and chain.
longdesc:
I am not sure where the human is going - but it is clear that he is a prisoner and
does not look happy.

name: a wasp scout
shortdesc: The wasp scout is making sure the human slaves are attending to the colony.
longdesc:
The king has hand selected these wasps to scout around the town and make sure
the human slaves are working for the queen.

name: a riddle monster
shortdesc: The riddle monster is just super happy to be here.
longdesc: The riddle monster has no real purpose other than to be here

name: Newbie Mob
shortdesc: This is a newbie class mob
longdesc: This is a newbie class mob

name: Super Easy Mob
shortdesc: This is a Super Easy Mob
longdesc: This is a Super Easy Mob

name: Easy to Level 150 Mob
shortdesc: This is an Easy to Level 150 Mob
longdesc: This is an Easy to Level 150 Mob

name: Medium to Level 250 Mob
shortdesc: This is a Medium to Level 250 Mob
longdesc: This is a Medium to Level 250 Mob

name: Mid-Hard to Level 350 Mob
shortdesc: This is a Mid-Hard to Level 350 Mob
longdesc: This is a Mid-Hard to Level 350 Mob

name: Hard to Level 450 Mob
shortdesc: This is a Hard to Level 450 Mob
longdesc: This is a Hard to Level 450 Mob

name: Difficult to Level 500 Mob
shortdesc: This is a Difficult to Level 500 Mob
longdesc: This is a Difficult to Level 500 Mob

name: Uber Class Mob
shortdesc: This is an Uber Class Mob.
longdesc: This is an Uber Class Mob.

name: Phardred
shortdesc: Phardred glares at you intently.
longdesc:
Before you stands an ancient being. His eyes seem to have an evil
gleam to them.  He is dressed in ancient armor that appears to
have seen many battles.  The sword he holds seem to draw all
the light around into it.

name: setra
shortdesc: The beautiful vampiress, Setra.
longdesc:
The vampiress stands here radiating beauty and mystique.  She is 
wearing some rings that seem to shimmer. and her evening dress is
a blood red which match her boots and pants.

name: Julius The blade master.
shortdesc: Julius grins as you walk in.
longdesc:
This is a warrior straight out of legend he radiates confidence.
He is dressed in simple black silks and holds an ornate axe.

name: A Priest
shortdesc: A priest is here pacing back and forth.
longdesc:
You finally catch the priest's eye, and he says no no you must
leave at once.. The priest is wearing a simple wool robe and is
holding a large silver cross.

name: Igor
shortdesc:
A person or what appears to be parts of several people stands 
here.
longdesc:
igor stands here he seems to be several diffrent people stiched together
and he does not look to happy you are here.  He is holding a scapel and
wearing some heavily plated boots.

name: A beautiful woman
shortdesc: A beautiful woman is here resting.
longdesc:
The beautiful woman is here resting. upon first glance she seems
to be young but upon closer ispection she seems more then young she seems 
almost ageless.  She is dressed in simple black atire.

name: A handsome man
shortdesc: A handsome man rests here.
longdesc:
A handsome man relaxes here. As he notices you he gives
you a grin that is all sharp pointy teeth. he is dressed
in a runed leather jacket and pants

name: A scrawny man
shortdesc: A pathetic excuse of a man sits here.
longdesc:
The man is grimy and defiently looks like he has seen better days.
he is holding something between his hands which is giving of a faint
glow.

name: Lune Fenris-coloratus
shortdesc: Lune eyes grow brighter as you enter his clearing
longdesc:
This is the biggest werewolf by far. By his stance and many scars 
covering his body it would appear you have found the pack leader.

name: A pure white werewolf
shortdesc: The werewolf starts to flex as you enter.
longdesc:
The werewolf pelt is so beatiful and pure white my what a
nice cloak it would make. His large fangs and long claws
will make it hard to get though.

name: A silver werewolf
shortdesc: The werewolf jumps up as you enter.
longdesc:
The werewolves pelt shimmers brightly. He looks very excited to see
you...maybe he thinks it is feeding time.

name: A crazed werewolf
shortdesc: The crazed werewolf is standing hear howling.
longdesc: The Werewolves pelt is covered it what appears to be dried blood.

name: A large werewolf
shortdesc: The large werewolf is here ready to pounce
longdesc:
The Werewolf is very big and well muscled. He well be a good
fercious fighter.

name: An ancient werewolf
shortdesc: An ancient werewolf is relaxing here.
longdesc:
The Ancient werewolf has is almost all scar tissue 
from his numerous battles.

name: a large hell hound
shortdesc: A large hound stands here.
longdesc:
The hound lets out a low growl as he sees you. The hounds start to
brighter as you come closer...maybe you should leave it alone.

name: a large silver wolf
shortdesc: A large silver wolf prowls here.
longdesc:
The wolf lets out a ear piercing howl as he sees you. The
wolf stays just close enough to track you....perhaps waiting
on the rest of his pack.

name: a ghoul
shortdesc: A Ghoul launches toward you as you enter the cellar
longdesc:
The ghoul lunges toward you. if it had not moved you would have never 
even noticed sitting against the moldy cellar wall. The ghoul hisses
at you know that its surprise attack did not work.

name: a large cook
shortdesc: a very large man hovers over the stove.
longdesc: The cook is huge almost as big around as he is tall.

name: a pale villager
shortdesc: a villager stands here.
longdesc:
The villager has a deep death palor about him.
if you were not close enough to see him breathing
this man had passed over to the other side.

name: The Innkeeper
shortdesc: The Innkeeper sobs quietly to himself.
longdesc:
The Innkeeper is so dirty even beggars would would
give him a wide berth.

name: A scarred hunter
shortdesc: The Hunter sits here skinning his latest kill.
longdesc:
By the looks of this man he is not the kind of hunter who has
ever set a trap. Judgeing by his scars it would appear he likes
to get his kills up close and personel.

name: The Mayor
shortdesc: The Mayor sits at his desk reading a book.
longdesc:
The mayor seems to look so tranquil....How could a man be 
so tranquil in this place.

name: a level guard
shortdesc: A dwarven level guard glares up at you.
longdesc:
A stout guard in green armor looks at you inquisitively. He is 
obviously sizing you up and deciding whether or not to let you pass.

name: a level guard
shortdesc: A dwarven level guard glares up at you.
longdesc:
A stout guard in blue armor looks at you inquisitively. He is 
obviously sizing you up and deciding whether or not to let you pass.

name: a giant cave spider
shortdesc: The biggest cave spider you have ever seen is here.
longdesc:
A spider drops down from its web as you enter its home. It is every 
bit as big as you are, if not larger. You have heard stories of giant
caves spiders before, but never seen one up close. You kind of wish 
they had remained just stories!

name: a barking dog
shortdesc: A ferocious looking dog barks at you.
longdesc:
A dog barks as you near it. You are not sure what breed it is, but
it is certainly smaller than any dog you have seen before. The 
dwarves must have bred them that way.

name: a dwarven child
shortdesc: A tiny dwarven child is here, wearing his father's armor.
longdesc:
A tiny dwarven child proudly struts around in a full suit of battle 
armor. He is obviously very proud of his warrior father. He quite
obvioulsy wants to follow in his footsteps and make the clan proud.

name: a teenage dwarf
shortdesc: A teenage dwarf wanders around looking for trouble.
longdesc:
A teenage dwarf walks the streets acting tough. He looks to be about
sixteen or seventeen years old. But, with dwarves, it is hard to tell.

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A guard patrols the city, clad in green armor.
longdesc:
The dwarven guard looks like he means business. His colorful armor
bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high luster.
He patrols the street looking for any troublemakers.

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A guard patrols the city, clad in blue armor.
longdesc:
The dwarven guard looks like he means business. His colorful armor
bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high luster.
He patrols the street looking for any troublemakers.

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A guard patrols the city, clad in red armor.
longdesc:
The dwarven guard looks like he means business. His colorful armor
bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high luster.
He patrols the street looking for any troublemakers.

name: a sleepy guardsman
shortdesc: A dwarven guardsman has fallen asleep at his post.
longdesc:
The sleeping guardsman looks like he would be very good at his duties, 
if he were awake that is. He must have been drinking until late last 
night. These dwarves love their alcohol. He should be more careful, 
anything could happen to him in his current condition.

name: a half drunk guardsman
shortdesc: A half drunk dwarven guardsman leans against the wall.
longdesc:
The half drunk guardsman looks like he would be very good at his duties, 
if he were sober that is. He must have been drinking until early this 
morning. These dwarves love their alcohol. He should be more careful, 
anything could happen to him in his current condition.

name: a dozing guardsman
shortdesc: A guardsman is dozing off in the corner of the room.
longdesc:
The dozing guardsman looks like he would be very good at his duties, 
if he were awake that is. He must have been drinking all through the
night. These dwarves love their alcohol. He should be more careful, 
anything could happen to him in his current condition.

name: a green dwarven warrior
shortdesc: A dwarven warrior in green battle armor stands here.
longdesc:
The dwarven warrior looks like one tough customer. His muscled arms 
are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster.

name: a blue dwarven warrior
shortdesc: A dwarven warrior in blue battle armor stands here.
longdesc:
The dwarven warrior looks like one tough customer. His muscled arms 
are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster.

name: a red dwarven warlord
shortdesc: A dwarven warlord in red battle armor stands here.
longdesc:
The dwarven warlord looks like one tough customer. His muscled arms 
are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster. His studies of his clan's magic have advanced him well beyond
that of a simple warrior.

name: the green dwarven barkeep
shortdesc: The barkeep is here, wiping down the bar.
longdesc:
The barkeep looks like he is new to the job. Although he may be 
inexperienced, you are quite certain he would be able to handle 
himself if the need ever arose.

name: the blue dwarven barkeep
shortdesc: The barkeep is here, making sure everyone stays drunk.
longdesc:
The barkeep looks like he has been at this job for a long time. With 
all the action this guy has seen over the years, he has probably 
picked up a trick or two when it comes to fighting.

name: the red dwarven barkeep
shortdesc: The barkeep is here, looking like he knows something you don't.
longdesc:
This barkeep looks very old and very mean. You would not want to ever
get on his bad side. He has been around for so long, you are sure he
knows everything there is to know about this dwarven city.

name: a drunken dwarf
shortdesc: A drunk dwarf is here, telling tall tales.
longdesc:
A drunk dwarf sits at the bar telling a loud story about his days as
a warrior. Listening for a minute, you are quite sure he is being
very cavalier with the details of his battle epic.

name: a drunken dwarf
shortdesc: A drunk dwarf is here, itching for a fight.
longdesc:
A drunk dwarf sits at the bar staring around the room for something
to get upset about. He is obviously not a happy drunk. You turn away
quickly, but you think he noticed you looking at him.

name: a tiny dwarven store clerk
shortdesc: A tiny store clerk looks up at you curiously.
longdesc:
The clerk is here minding the store. She looks like she is very good
at her job. Ever since you walked in, she has been staring at you curiously.

name: a stocky dwarven store clerk
shortdesc: A stocky store clerk eyeballs you suspiciously.
longdesc:
The clerk is here minding the store. She looks like she is very good
at her job. Ever since you arrived, she has been staring at you suspiciously.

name: a bulky dwarven store clerk
shortdesc: A bulky store clerk stares at you with contempt.
longdesc:
The clerk is here minding the store. She looks like she is very good
at her job. Ever since you entered, she has been glaring at you.

name: The dwarven armorer
shortdesc: The armorer raises an eyebrow as you enter his store.
longdesc:
The armorer notices you enter, but then goes back to work. His shop
obviously gets a lot of business.

name: The dwarven weaponsmith
shortdesc: The weaponsmith is here, sweating from the heat.
longdesc:
The burly dwarven weaponsmith is here, pounding away at a weapon
for a customer.

name: The smithy's wife
shortdesc: The smithy's wife is here, preparing him a meal.
longdesc:
The smithy's wife moves quickly back and forth in the kitchen. She
is making a meal for her husband and has no time for small talk.

name: The barkeep's wife
shortdesc: The barkeep's wife is here, cleaing up the room.
longdesc:
The barkeep's wife moves quickly around the room, picking up all
the mess. She gets a look of confusion on her face when she notices
you in her house.

name: The dwarven blacksmith
shortdesc: The blacksmith is here, banging on something.
longdesc:
The dwarven blacksmith is her, banging out some dents in a
magnificent looking breast plate.

name: The blacksmith's wife
shortdesc: The blacksmith's wife is here, reading a book.
longdesc:
The blacksmith's wife sits in a comfortable looking chair, reading
a very thick book.  It must be a good read, because she doesn't notice
you at all.

name: Bolim the clan scout
shortdesc: Bolim the scout sits in his chair.
longdesc:
Bolim, a scout for the red clan, sits patiently in his chair. His
dragonscale armor looks like it has seen a lot of use. He awaits his
orders from the battle commander.

name: Hildr the clan scout
shortdesc: Hildr, the scout, sits in her chair.
longdesc:
Hildr, the head scout for the red clan, sits patiently in her chair.
Her dragonscale armor looks like it has seen a lot of use. She awaits
her orders from the battle commander.

name: Grimlag the dwarven battle commander
shortdesc: Grimlag, the battle commander, stares at you.
longdesc:
Grimlag, head battle commander for the red clan, is here making
battle plans. He looks very busy. His beautifully crafted mithril
armor is polished to a high sheen.

name: Drong the dwarven battle commander
shortdesc: Drong, the battle commander, stares at you.
longdesc:
Drong, a battle commander for the red clan, is here making
battle plans. He looks very busy. His beautifully crafted mithril
armor is polished to a high sheen.

name: Morina the dwarven cleric
shortdesc: Morina, the dwarven cleric, softly speaks a prayer.
longdesc:
Morina, the blue cleric, is making gestures around her own head, and 
softly speaking a prayer. She is quite beautiful, for a dwarf. Her 
beautiful ring gives off a stunning blue glow.

name: Auor the dwarven mage
shortdesc: Auor, the dwarven mage, looks through her spell book.
longdesc:
Auor, the red mage, is looking through a thick book. She must be 
trying to recall a particular spell. She is lovely to look at, 
although Morina is more your taste. Her lovely ring gives off a
radiant red glow.

name: The elite dwarven guard
shortdesc: A dwarf stands guard, clad in green armor.
longdesc:
A dwarf is guarding the door here. He is much bigger and stronger
than any of the guards you have seen on the upper levels. His 
green armor shines brightly, even in the dim torch light.

name: The elite dwarven guard
shortdesc: A dwarf stands guard, clad in blue armor.
longdesc:
A dwarf is guarding the door here. He is much bigger and stronger
than any of the guards you have seen on the upper levels. His 
blue armor shines brightly, even in the dim torch light.

name: The elite dwarven guard
shortdesc: A dwarf stands guard, clad in red armor.
longdesc:
A dwarf is guarding the door here. He is much bigger and stronger
than any of the guards you have seen on the upper levels. His 
red armor shines brightly, even in the dim torch light.

name: The elite dwarven guard
shortdesc: A dwarf stands guard, clad in golden armor.
longdesc:
A dwarf is guarding the door here. He is much bigger and stronger
than any of the guards you have seen on the upper levels. His 
golden armor shines brightly, even in the dim torch light.

name: Valek the clan priest
shortdesc: Valek, the clan priest, meditates in front of a green altar.
longdesc:
Valek is here, meditating. His dragonscale clothing is adorned with the
markings of his clan. Although quite small in stature, he is obviously
very old.

name: Gammel the clan priest
shortdesc: Gammel, the clan priest, prays next to a blue altar.
longdesc:
Gammel is here, meditating. His dragonscale clothing is adorned with the
markings of his clan. Although quite small in stature, he is obviously
very old.

name: Morral the clan priest
shortdesc: Morral, the clan priest, kneels before a red altar.
longdesc:
Morral is here, meditating. Her dragonscale clothing is adorned with the
markings of her clan. Although quite small in stature, she is obviously
very old.

name: Boril the clan warchief
shortdesc: Boril, the clan warchief, is studying a map on the wall.
longdesc:
One of the largest dwarves you have ever seen, Boril easily towers
several hands over the average dwarf. His muscled arms and legs
peek out from beneath his steel armor. They are covered in battle 
scars and tattooed with the markings of his clan.

name: Gorak the clan warchief
shortdesc: Gorak, the clan warchief, is here making battle plans.
longdesc:
One of the largest dwarves you have ever seen, Gorak easily towers
several hands over the average dwarf. His muscled arms and legs
peek out from beneath his steel armor. They are covered in battle 
scars and tattooed with the markings of his clan.

name: Groth the clan warchief
shortdesc: Groth, the clan warchief, glares at you.
longdesc:
One of the largest dwarves you have ever seen, Groth easily towers
several hands over the average dwarf. His muscled arms and legs
peek out from beneath his steel armor. They are covered in battle 
scars and tattooed with the markings of his clan.

name: Gilin the green clan elder
shortdesc: Gilin, the clan elder, bows to you as you enter.
longdesc:
Gilin must have celebrated his hundredth birthday a few centuries
ago. His long white beard drags slightly on the floor. His dress 
is humble, and is decorated with the markins of his clan. His few
flamboyances include a handsome wristband and a deep red cloak.

name: Bazel the blue clan elder
shortdesc: Bazel, the clan elder, welcomes you into his home.
longdesc:
Bazel must have celebrated his hundredth birthday a few centuries
ago. His long white beard drags slightly on the floor. His dress
is humble, and is decorated with the markins of his clan. His few
flamboyances include a deep red cloak and a handsome wristband.

name: Odin the red clan elder
shortdesc: Odin, the eldest of the dwarven council, sits here.
longdesc:
Odin must have celebrated his hundredth birthday several centuries
ago. His long white beard drags slightly on the floor. His dress
is humble, and is decorated with the markins of his clan. His few
flamboyances include a handsome wristband and a deep red cloak. He
wields a fierce looking weapon.

name: Orek the clan scout
shortdesc: Orek, the scout, sits in his chair.
longdesc:
Orek, the head scout for the green clan, sits patiently in his chair. He
awaits his orders from the battle commander.

name: Kragg the dwarven battle commander
shortdesc: Kragg, the battle commander, stares at you.
longdesc:
Kragg, head battle commander for the green clan, is here making
battle plans. He looks very busy.

name: Toogal the clan scout
shortdesc: Toogal, the scout, sits in his chair.
longdesc:

name: Gromm the dwarven battle commander

battle plans. He looks very busy.

shortdesc: A dwarven berserker in green battle armor stands here.
longdesc:
The dwarven berserker looks like one tough customer. His muscled arms 
are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster. His extensive studies in combat have advanced him well beyond
that of a simple warrior.

shortdesc: A dwarven berserker in blue battle armor stands here.
longdesc:

are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster. His extensive studies in combat have advanced him well beyond

longdesc:

are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster. His studies of his clan's magic have advanced him well beyond
that of a simple warrior.

name: a red dwarven warrior
shortdesc: A dwarven warrior in red battle armor stands here.
longdesc:
The dwarven warrior looks like one tough customer. His muscled arms 
are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster.

name: a red dwarven berserker
shortdesc: A dwarven berserker in red battle armor stands here.
longdesc:
The dwarven warrior looks like one tough customer. His muscled arms 
are like tree trunks in relation to his short stature. His colorful 
armor bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high 
luster.

name: a pleasant dwarven shopkeeper
shortdesc: A dwarven shopkeeper stands here, ready to help you.
longdesc:
The dwarven shopkeeper stares at you, patiently waiting to be of service.
His shop is the only one in town that is willing to cater to outsiders.

name: Dorf the dwarf
shortdesc: Dorf is stumbling about, the ground shakes....
longdesc:
A massive dwarf stands before you. Locked away from the world for centuries,
he was recently let loose. He walks about these corridors, stumbling on his
beard, which is well longer than he is by now. Rumor has it that he is the
strongest dwarf ever to have lived, and possible the most inept.

name: Scalie the dragon
shortdesc: Scalie, the dragon, is curled up on the front steps.
longdesc:
Scalie, the dragon, has been expertly trained by Hildr. She is used for
everything from protection to transportation. She is also a wonderful companion.

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A guard patrols the city, clad in blue armor, drinking from a tankard.
longdesc:
The dwarven guard looks like he means business. His colorful armor
bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high luster.
He patrols the street looking for any troublemakers.

name: a dwarven guard
shortdesc: A guard patrols the city, clad in green armor, drinking from a tankard.
longdesc:
The dwarven guard looks like he means business. His colorful armor
bears all the markings of his clan, and is polished to a high luster.
He patrols the street looking for any troublemakers.

name: A torn Fortish traveller
shortdesc: A torn Fortish traveller admires the views.
longdesc: This rather bedraggled dwarf is covered in ripped and torn clothing.

name: A dirty Fortish traveller
shortdesc: A dirty Fortish traveller moves about.
longdesc:
This has got to be the dirtiest dwarf you have ever seen. Sure, they work
in mines and some other unclean places but surely this one could have made
an effort to at least rub some of the dirt off! Be careful! Argh! He's
coming towards you as if he intends to wipe his hands on your nice clean
clothes!

name: A Fortish merchant
shortdesc: A Fortish merchant walks swiftly to deliver his latest trades.
longdesc:
The merchant is wearing some lavish, if impractical, clothing. He has a straight
cut beard, in the latest fashion. His hair has been slicked back with some
mysterious lacquer. Doing business with this man will cost you more than you can 
afford.

name: A Fortish patrol guard
shortdesc: A fierce looking guard patrols the area.
longdesc:
Ever alert. Ever watchful. The Fortish patrol guard is a keen reminder
to all. Unlawfulness is not tolerated in Fortrum!

name: A large brown eagle
shortdesc: A large brown eagle sits on the mountainside.
longdesc:
Mad eagle eyes focus on. You can almost hear the tiny bird-brain whirrling
as it splits you in to one of two categories; food or rock. It decides you
are rock and turns it's attention elsewhere.

name: A black Fortish dragon rider
shortdesc: A black Fortish dragon rider stands in salute.
longdesc:
The black dragon riders are a fearsome bunch. Considered elite in Fortish
society, they ride their mounts with pride and wield their tridents with the
skill of the finest weapons masters. To cross one is to dice with death himself.

name: A Fortish dragon rider lieutenant
shortdesc: A Fortish dragon rider lieutenant watches carefully.
longdesc:
Long in the saddle. Short in stature. Tall in command. Years of service
and action have seen this prideful dwarf ascend to the rank of lieutenant.
His hair and bear are neatly cropped and his demeanor is calm. Only his
eyes betray the fire and passion in his soul for his task. His lifes 
work. His duty.

name: A Fortish Horseman
shortdesc: A Fortish Horseman carrying goods rides along swiftly.
longdesc:
A skilled rider in every way, the Fortish horseman knows his role and knows
his job. More skilled in the saddle than on foot, he is still a capable fighter
and a dangerous foe.

name: a Fortish soldier
shortdesc: A Fortish soldier walks here to assist Fortrum.
longdesc:
This dwarf is quite tall, for a dwarf. His bearing is that of authority.
But, his manner is that of a helpful guardian, rather than an enforcer.
He is well groomed with a neatly brushed beard, precision-pressed clothes
and well polished adornments.

name: A drunken stumbling dwarf
shortdesc: A drunken dwarf stumbles all over the place.
longdesc: Boy is he hammered!

name: A Fortish villager
shortdesc: A Fortish villager walks here, enjoying the sights.
longdesc:
Hmm... He doesn't look too clever. You decide that asking him for
directions would likely be a mistake...  As would asking him for the 
answer to 2 + 2.

name: A Fortish spy
shortdesc: A Fortish spy sneaks right past you.
longdesc:
Cloak pulled tight. Hood pulled up. Shifty, nervous eyes. This spy is 
leaving nothing to chance that you might not guess her line of work...
Quick! Say something controversial!

name: A Fortish tradesman
shortdesc: A Fortish tradesman walks here, stumbling on all his goods.
longdesc:
This dwarf is busy plying his wares. From his dishevelled look, you
guess that he hasn't been very successful.

name: A tipsy gambling dwarf
shortdesc: A tipsy gambling dwarf wanders around looking for a dime.
longdesc:
The smell of stale wine assaults your nose so strongly, you almost think you'll
need to put it in a hospital to recover from it's injuries. Aside from the
alcohol abuse, this dwarf is too busy looking in the gutter for lost coins
to pay much attention to you.

name: An elven merchant
shortdesc: An elven merchant carries his goods carefully.
longdesc:
Why do elves always look so smug? I don't know, I was hoping you knew
the answer...  This one is selling something.  Bah! It can't be very
interesting, whatever it is. Move along, move along.

name: A human arms trader
shortdesc: A human arms trader carrying a huge bag is trying to get through.
longdesc:
Short cut blond hair sits atop a scarred and evil looking face. This man knows
his trade, and has dealt in it for a long time.
