name: A lizardman tourist
shortdesc: A lizardman tourist is searching Fortish artifacts.
longdesc:
Greeny-blue scales cover this lizardman's face. His tongue tastes the air
as he see's you looking at him. He looks you up and down with surprisingly
intelligent eyes and then turns to carry on his journey.

name: A human adventurer
shortdesc: A human adventurer coming to see wonders or make a buck wanders here.
longdesc:
He's quite young. Maybe 27 at the most. But that just makes him cocky. Look at him..
whistling as he walks.. so sure of himself. You hope he trips.

name: A Fortish rampart guard
shortdesc: A Fortish rampart guard watches the busy trail closely.
longdesc:
Used to standing for hours on end staring in to the middle-distance,
this dwarf is stalwart in his duty to guard.

name: An elven tourist
shortdesc: An elven tourist journeys to explore the magnificent Fortrum.
longdesc:
Obviously not content to stay in his tree, this elf has decided to see
what the Forts are up to.

name: a human mercenary
shortdesc: A human mercenary is here looking for work in the Fortish empire.
longdesc: A capable looking fighter, this human is not too picky about the company he keeps.

name: an elven scout
shortdesc: An elven scout sneaks about gathering information.
longdesc:
Sneaking, sneaking, sneaking. All these elves ever do is sneak
about, poking their noses in other peoples business. This one looks
like she's been poking her beak in to everything she can find.

name: A Fortish Guardian
shortdesc: A Fortish Guardian has been posted here.
longdesc:
A champion amongst dwarfs, he stands tall (ish) and prideful.  His
place as guardian is well earned. He is not to be trifled with.

name: A Mage Lookout
shortdesc: A Fortish Mage stands here conjuring a clear ball of light.
longdesc:
His bright red beard is parted down the middle into twin peaks, like a fiery
comet rising from his belly. He has earned his place amongst the elite by
battle and by spell.

name: a Fortish Battlemaster
shortdesc: A Fortish Battlemaster stands here looking for some action.
longdesc:
His beard is iron-gray and his eyes speak of untold trials. He carries himself
easily, like he is comfortable in his body and has honed it to perfection.

name: An exploring dwarven child
shortdesc: An exploring dwarven child plays nearby.
longdesc: A little girl...  With a beard...  Okaaaaay.

name: A wild dog
shortdesc: A wild dog is running lose on the trail.
longdesc:
Rwwwoooof!  Rwwwoooof!  She doesn't look to friendly.
Better not try and pet her.

name: a wasp larvae
shortdesc: The larvae is just here growing, stolen from his hive.
longdesc: This larva looks like a fresh hatchling.

name: a wasp soldier
shortdesc: A wasp soldier seems happy to be away from the queen.
longdesc:
This wasp soldier looks like it hasn't got much on the other larger soldiers in the
colony.

name: a wasp worker
shortdesc: The wasp worker paces the room, alarmed about what happened.
longdesc:
This worker is thicker in the midsection than the soldier wasp, but does not have
the overall size. It is most likely that this worker wasp has no other role than
to serve the queen, and possibly as her next meal.

name: a giant wasp guard
shortdesc: The Giant Guard wasp is wondering how he got here.
longdesc:
I am not sure where the human is going - but it is clear that he is a prisoner and
does not look happy.

name: a wasp scout
shortdesc: The wasp scout looks confused and angry.
longdesc:
The king has hand selected these wasps to scout around the town and make sure
the human slaves are working for the queen.

name: Nasis' henchman
shortdesc: Nasis' henchman stares at you in anger.
longdesc:
These are simple minded people who have sacrificed themselves to
serve the almighty Nasis.  They are prepared to do all it takes (even
dying) to protect their leader.

name: A hidden thief
shortdesc: A sneaky thief searches your pockets for gold and valuables.
longdesc:
Suprisingly you notice this sneaky little trouble-maker.  He is lightning
quick and stealthy.  You had better check your pockets!

name: A hidden assassin
shortdesc: A mysterious assassin hides in the shadows here.
longdesc:
An undistinguishable man tries to hide in the shadows from you.  He is
alerted to your presence and doesn't appreciate you being here.

name: A hairy man
shortdesc: A hairy man leans against the wall.
longdesc:
This man is disgusting.  Hair flows out of almost every pore in his entire
body.  You don't even want to touch him let alone fight him.

name: a Lost Soul
shortdesc: A ghostly apparition floats here, staring at you in utter hatred.
longdesc: The lost soul is a ghostly apparition, seeking revenge on the living.

name: a Githyanki
shortdesc: A disgusting creature of etheral nature stands here.
longdesc:
This man sized creature has bandages wrapped all about its body. Its eyes
glow with a brilliant red fire, in its right hand he grasps a an extremely
sharp blade of magical nature.

name: the Neo-Otyugh
shortdesc: A large, disgusting, vile creature stands here, smelling putrid.
longdesc:
This creature is covered with slime like substance, many tentacles protrude
from its disgusting body.

name: a Shadow Daemon
shortdesc: A shadowy figure stands here, looking you over with greed.
longdesc:
This creature has almost no form, it looks like some sort of shadow with
wings.

name: Bornta the Cliffkeeper
shortdesc: Bornta the Cliffkeeper has arrived from the inner corridors.
longdesc:
This is Bornta, the Cliffkeeper.  He is strong, wise and has a reputation
for being hard and cold.  His fierce eyes almost glow with an inner power
and confidence.  Tackling this one would be a mistake!

name: Shala the Farseer
shortdesc: Shala the Farseer has been called out to assist the Fortish Mages.
longdesc:
Shala.  The Farseer.  It is she who is first to see signs of danger and
malice towards Fortrum.  Her hair hangs in five thick braids over her
left shoulder, each one dyed a different colour; black, red, yellow, blue
and green.

name: Dra'kar the Dragonmaster
shortdesc: Dra'kar the Dragonmaster has landed to coordinate with his fellow riders.
longdesc:
The Dragonmaster, Dra'kar.  He is a fearsome warrior.  His very presence
here is enough to reassure the citizens of Fortrum that they are well
protected and cared for under his steely gaze.  His beard is black and
shot with gray flecks, yet he holds himself lightly, like a young dwarf
on a carefree afternoon.

name: Colonel Kratz
shortdesc: The Colonel stands here instructing his Guardians.
longdesc:
Known for his pomposity and arrogance, Colonel Kratz is however a great
strategist and leader of dwarfs.  His beard has been oddly dyed in greens
and browns and you imagine that if he was in a forest full of elves he
would be quite difficult to pick out.

name: Lana the High Sentinel
shortdesc: Lana the High Sentinel shimmers with a bright light.
longdesc:
The High Sentinel, Lana.  She is a sea of calm in a raging storm.  Her
bright blue eyes sparkle with intelligence and wisdom.  Her hair is thick
and white, and hangs in a single braid down her back.

name: Ragnorak
shortdesc: Ragnorak, the Hidden Fate, rises here, ready to be your undoing.
longdesc:
Even the mighty Odin bow's down to Ragnorak whenever this fearsome
dwarf takes to the Halls.  The very ground trembles beneath his
steel-clad feet as he brings ruin to all foes of Fortrum.

name: Hela
shortdesc:
Hela, Goddess of Death, stands here, all in black, ready to deal her doom to the world.
Hela, Goddess of Death, burns with a deep, shadowy flame!
longdesc:
Hela is the daughter Odin.  For a long time she was his pride and
his joy.  She took after him in power and often rode with him on
her dragon into battle.  But as she grew so did her power, and so
did her ego.  When she surpassed Odin she defied his wishes and
married Surtur the Demonic, becoming His Queen and plotting with
him to unite the clans rule as King and Queen in Fortrum.

name: Surtur the Demonic
shortdesc:
Surtur, the demonic King of Fortrum, burns brightly here.
Surtur, the demonic King of Fortrum, glows like a raging inferno!
longdesc:
Surtur is part dwarf, part demonic spawn from the deepest, darkest,
pits of Hell.  Long ago he was the older brother of Odin, and then
he was lost fighting deep in the Abyss.  For aeons he was thought
dead, destroyed in the fiery depths, but then one day he rose up in
Fortrum and sought to unite the clans under a single, powerful King.
That King was himself, Surtur the Demonic.  His failure to unite the
clans was offset by his prize at winning his brother's daughter for
his wife.  Now they and their son Loki strive to assert their claim
upon Fortrum.  Surtur, Loki and Hela are the doom of Fortrum, and
they will bring around the Ragnorak, the prophesied destruction of
the Dwarven kingdom.

name: Loki
shortdesc:
Loki, Lord of Mischief, stands here with a wide grin upon his face.
Loki, Lord of Mischief, glows with a golden light!
longdesc:
Born from the union of Surtur the Demonic, brother of Odin, and
Hela, daughter of Odin, Loki is quite the mad individual.  And
although he is still young, his power rivals that of his parents
already and he looks set to outstrip them both.  He is a master
wizard and a powerful priest.  His skill at arms with blade and 
hammer are unmatched by all except Odin himself.  Only Dorf thinks
nothing of Loki.  But then, Dorf thinks nothing of anyone unless
there is a tankard of beer to be had!

name: Battle Odin
shortdesc: Odin, the eldest of the dwarven council, stands here ready to do battle.
longdesc:
Odin must have celebrated his hundredth birthday several centuries
ago. His long white beard drags slightly on the floor. His dress
is that of the finest warrior set for battle, forged steel all over,
with the very best weaponry the Dwarfs of Fortrum can produce.

name: Prince Nuahlon
shortdesc: Prince Nuahlon is here, imprisoned by the dwarfs.
longdesc:
Prince Nuahlon was once the leader of the Elves across the whole of
the realms.  His power and influence stretched far and wide.  Then
the wars with the Dwarfs began, and Nuahlon unleashed demonic dragons
upon the planes.  The Dwarfs, working with the human nations, managed
to stem the flow of the dragons in a concealed outpost, containing
their menace and taking Prince Nuahlon prisoner. This brought about a
tentative peace that has lasted over a hundred years.  This Prince
longs to be set free, to use his orb to unite the Elven people and
begin, once more, the war that would engulf all the realms.

name: The Angelic form of Prince Nuahlon
shortdesc: The Angelic form of Prince Nuahlon is here, spewing forth fiery wrath.
longdesc:
Prince Nuahlon is dead!!  But his will power, his soul, his essence
was so powerful that he has risen as an angel of vengeance.  He is
blessed, for he uses the name of charity and good will, shepherding
the Elves through the Valley of Darkness, for he is truly his
brother's keeper and finder of lost elven children.  And he shall
strike down upon the dwarfs with great vengeance and furious anger
those dwarfs who attempt to poison and destroy his brothers.  He's
very dramatic, but probably quite powerful...

name: Fortrus the Ancient
shortdesc: Fortrus the Ancient is here, looking weary from age and duty.
longdesc:
This is the famous Fortrus, the dwarf who founded Fortrum.  He is old, grey
and bent with age.  There is weariness in his eyes that no living sleep will
cure.  His sole purpose left in this world is to protect this little area
that you have invaded.  If you believe you will get out of here alive, think
again!

name: an Ironbeard
shortdesc: An Ironbeard guard is here, looking vigilant.
longdesc:
The Ironbeards are honoured elders who have dedicated the final years of their
long lives to the ultimate duty in Fortrum--Protecting the prison that you are
invading right now!!  These are no greenbread dwarfs, fresh from the training
grounds.  These dwarfs have lived the lives of warriors and soldiers of the
great Dwarf city of Fortrum.  Songs are sung of their deeds in the vast halls
above.  Each one is capable of making you look like a clueless newbie with a
training sword.

name: Mad Vorta Goldbelly
shortdesc: Mad Vorta Goldbelly, the new Green Clan priestess, sweeps up the mess here.
longdesc:
Mad Vorta Goldbelly is a short, red-haired and freckled dwarf female who
led the opposition in the Green Clan against the promotion of Valek to
clan priest.  She has often voiced opinions about all of the leaders and
elders, often calling them spineless autocrats out to fill their pockets
from the treasures of Fortrum with little regard for her peoples and the
rich history of the Fortress.  She got her name after she fell in to a
bar brawl with Dorf and bit off part of his ear, which she apparently
keeps on a golden chain around her neck.  Unlike most Fortish dwarfs,
Vorta is unwelcoming and suspicious of all outsiders.  She also doesn't
fight fair, so beware when squaring off against this tiny terror.

name: A giant fireant
shortdesc: A giant fireant feels around with its antenna.
longdesc: This ant is massive. It stands at least shoulder-height to a human and has massive mandibles.  It could definitely crush a beer keg in those!

name: A Soldier Fireant
shortdesc: A large soldier fireant with big pinchers.
longdesc: A bright red, fireant angrily defending its nest races towards you.

name: The Queen Fireant
shortdesc: A huge, fat queen fireant.
longdesc: Surrounded by white, oval eggs, the queen glares at you with vast hunger.

name: A large, ferocious warg
shortdesc: A large warg stands here growling, menacingly.
longdesc: The warg spies you looking and, its red eyes gleaming with menace, it growls so low you feel your stomach knot in fear.

name: Half-grown warg like pup
shortdesc: Mean, half-grown pup.
longdesc: Larger and meaner looking than your normal fido. It looks very hungry.

name: Nearly grown warg like dog
shortdesc: Large, shaggy warg like fido.
longdesc: Three times the size of your normal fido. It looks very hungry.

name: Large warg
shortdesc: A massive and very aggressive warg.
longdesc:
The largest warg you have ever seen or heard about. It has a sleek, well-fed
look. Though from the way it is looking at you, perhaps it thinks you are
more food. Is it time to panic?

name: Angry warg trainer
shortdesc: Well equiped and evil looking trainer of the wargs.
longdesc:
Before you stands the a tall, strong limbed warrior. Equiped with beautifully
worked studded leather armor, he draws his sword and attacks.

name: Beautiful mistress
shortdesc: The beautiful mistress of the house.
longdesc:
Well of course, she is beautiful. After all, aren't all the women in these
fantasy worlds, both beautiful & scantilly clad? Well, this one meets half of
that wish. This wonder is the owner of the house, the warg puppies, and the
warrior you beat to get here. Prepare to die, for you have met the mistress
of wargs.

name: A giant tarantula
shortdesc: A giant black tarantula with orange bands rests here.
longdesc: This is the classic looking black tarantula with orange bands. Except this one is 100 times bigger than its relatives. And those mandibles look like they could skewer a horse! Uh oh!

name: the Wolf Spider
shortdesc: The Wolf Spider is here, licking its bloody fangs.
longdesc: The Wolf Spider is hairy, very hairy.

name: A wraith spider
shortdesc: A wraith spider preys here, waiting for the unwary.
longdesc: This spider is massive. Much larger than the tarantula which used to reside here... In fact, there appears to be a husk of some unindentifable spider in the corner.  Possibly the tarantula.  Eaten by this one?  Uh oh.

name: a sickly wasp worker
shortdesc: The wasp worker goes back and forth for the queen.
longdesc: This worker is thicker in the midsection than the soldier wasp, but does not have the overall size, he looks ill. It is most likely that this worker wasp has no other role than to serve the queen, and possibly as her next meal.

name: a wasp laborer
shortdesc: A wasp laborer isn't happy working for the queen.
longdesc: The wasp laborer follows orders, and knows his place in the hive.

name: a wasp vanguard
shortdesc: The wasp vanguard keeps scanning the area, insuring the hive is free of invaders
longdesc: The king has hand selected these wasps to ensure the queens protection by being on alert, quickly spotting any intruder.

name: a wasp slave driver's apprentice
shortdesc: The wasp slave driver's apprentice is here taking instruction on slavedriving techniques.
longdesc: The wasp slave driver's apprentice lears his trade from a master, he is a large wasp, and will probably one day grow into a fine Lead slave driver.

name: a diminutive fire-breathing hydra
shortdesc: A relatively small eight headed hydra is sleeping here
longdesc: The creature is obviously not full grown yet, but the scaled creature  has eight heads... each capable of breathing a dangerous stream of fire.

name: a cunning lamia
shortdesc: A cunning looking lamia stands here.
longdesc: A half snake half woman creature looks around cunningly at her surroundings, trying to figure something out...

name: The lamia
shortdesc: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
longdesc: This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

name: A big red beholder
shortdesc: A big red beholder floats here.
longdesc:
It has a large central eye that projects an anti-magic ray and ten
eyestalks atop the round body which can do anything from charm you
to disintegrate you.  Beholders are not known for their personality.

name: A weakling silver werewolf
shortdesc: A silver werewolf gleams with an inner light.
longdesc: This werewolf has the most beautiful silvery pelt you have ever seen. But it looks like something has reduced its strength... Quick! Kill it before it recovers!

name: A frail ancient werewolf
shortdesc: A frail ancient werewolf is napping here.
longdesc:
The Ancient werewolf has is almost all scar tissue
from his numerous battles, and looks past his prime.

name: a Bachelor Skexie
shortdesc: A Skexie Bachelor relaxes on a nearby nest.
longdesc:
This Skexie has black and red feathers. He is otherwise a
normal looking bird-man.

name: a Gentleman Skexie
shortdesc: A Skexie Gentleman sits in his chair.
longdesc:
This Skexie has black and orange feathers. He is otherwise a
normal looking bird-man.

name: the Skexie Maiden
shortdesc: An ugly Skexie Maiden winks at you suggestively.
longdesc: Wow! Is she ugly!

name: A skexie clown
shortdesc: The skexie clown capers about here with bladder on a stick and highly amusing anecdotes.
longdesc: Dressed in bright colours or blue and orange, the skexie clown capers around like... Well... A clown.

name: A sly drow assassin
shortdesc: A sly drow assassin lurks in the shadows!
longdesc: His dark, almost navy-blue skin is barely visible under his assassin garb of hood and cloak. But you catch the glint of a murderous look in his crimson eyes... Better keep an eye on that one!

name: The drow warrior
shortdesc: The drow warrior stands here guarding his home.
longdesc: He looks kind of p.o.ed!

name: The drow mage noble
shortdesc: The drow mage noble is here protecting his home.
longdesc: The mage prepares to cast a spell...at you!!

name: The drow priestess
shortdesc: The drow priestess is here shouting orders.
longdesc: I wouldn't want go get on her bad side!

name: Calimar the Drider
shortdesc: calimar the Drider is here staring at you with milky-white eyes.
longdesc: This is Calimar. He was once the scout for a powerful Drow family but he double crossed his kin when he tried to sell his own matron mother out to a rival family. His fate was sealed when the family he tried to turn to for asylum, the very family he had tried to sell his matron mother to, turned him over to his own family for retribution. The result was his hideous mutation in to a drider. The drider you now see before you!

name: a shuffling zombie
shortdesc: A long dead corpse shuffles stiffly around in circles.
longdesc: Slow moving, and stinking of rotten flesh, the zombie is a sight to frighten even the most stalwart of children.

name: A spectre
shortdesc: A spectre shimmers in the air, its eyes glowing red with malice.
longdesc: This is the spirit of a long-dead king. Why it has chosen this place to haunt you'll never know. Red orbs glow where its eyes should be.

name: an animated skeleton
shortdesc: A magically animated skeleton clicks as it walks around.
longdesc: This is the skeleton of some long-dead warrior. It is covered in rusted armour and weaponry. It is very fast, but with no muscle to bolster its attacks with you doubt it is very strong.

name: The dervish
shortdesc: The raggity dervish walks on aimlessly.
longdesc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
some rest.

name: The dervish
shortdesc: The large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
longdesc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
LOTS of rest.

name: The small scorpion
shortdesc: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
longdesc: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

name: A purple and black sandworm
shortdesc: A large purple and black sandworm swims through the sand.
longdesc: The sandworm is purple but banded with black. It looks like a large sock belonging to a child into vampires and pale make-up.

name: a grinning gnome
shortdesc: A gnome is here grinning mischievously.
longdesc: This gnome has the biggest grin on its face you have EVER seen.  What is it up to?

name: a laughing gnome
shortdesc: A gnome is here laughing like a king at his fool.
longdesc: This gnome is rolling on the floor, holding his belly, as she guffaws loudly at some mischief performed.

name: a capering gnome
shortdesc: A gnome is here capering madly around.
longdesc: This gnome is capering around for some bizarre reason... What could it be up to?

name: a hidden gnome
shortdesc: A gnome is here, hiding from someone... Or something.
longdesc: This gnome is hiding exceedingly well. So well, in fact, that you had to use a true sight spell to see it!

name: an immolated gnome
shortdesc: A tiny gnome is chipping away at the rocks and crystals.
longdesc: Sparks fly around the gnomes head as he chips away at the rocks and geodes he has a nice pile built up next on his right side.

name: Cornelius, Prince of Gnomes
shortdesc: A very regal gnome is here, planning havoc!
longdesc: This is Cornelius, the fabled Prince of Gnomes. His mischief knows no bounds and he is heralded as the greatest trickster and prankster even known in the Gnome Kingdoms. You had better be careful when tackling him!

name: a tired gnome
shortdesc: A small gnome is sleeping inside the glowing green gel.
longdesc:
The gnome looks totally serene and peaceful.  He is curled into the
fetal position and floats freely through the gel.  He does not even
wake up with your intrusion to the regeneration chamber.

name: an injured harpy
shortdesc: A harpy is here with a broken wing.
longdesc: The harpy looks at you with blood in her eyes, but she flaps her wings painfully. You have the advantage here it seems! Take it!

name: The screaming harpy general
shortdesc: The screaming harpy general tries to scratch your eyes out!
longdesc:
The harpy general looks at you and grins menacingly.  She stretches
her wings and you see insects crawling around them.  Her hair is
matted and greasy and you are sickened by the stench that pervades
her presence.

name: The mini air elemental
shortdesc: A mini whirlwind tears out the clouds here.
longdesc: This elemental is a whirl or air and vapour. But it is small. You don't think it has the power to lift you...

name: The curious effreeti
shortdesc: The curious effreeti grins in delight at its new prey.
longdesc:
The effreeti towers menacingly over you.  It is dressed in the
 feathery armor.

name: The large roc
shortdesc: The large roc.
longdesc:
This bird has a wingspan that stretches several spearlengths.  It
moves surprisingly fast for something of its size.

name: an archer
shortdesc: An archer stands here looking out into the forest.
longdesc:
A archer stands here watching the forest, he give you a glance as you
walk by.  The archer is very lightly armored but his bow is huge and
looks like it could send an arrow through most armor.

name: a centaur fighter
shortdesc: A centaur fighter glares at you menacingly.
longdesc:
The fighter is clothed in simple furs of what appears to be varying
coloured wolf pelts.  The fighter has had a lot of fighting experience
if the scars he sports are an indication of past battles.

name: The centaur lord
shortdesc: The lord sits around waiting for a opportunity to seize the throne and the queen for himself.
longdesc: The lord sits quietly contemplating his next action.

name: An elven warrior
shortdesc: The elven warrior is here going through his training techniques.
longdesc: This warrior is both deft and sure. His muscles are primed for fighting bare handed and with weapons. Surely he would be a challenge for any fighter. You think his beautiful golden sleeves may have something to do with his fighting prowess.

name: The elven priestess's assistant
shortdesc: The priestess's assistantant stands here by the altar.
longdesc: The priestess's assistant is eager to serve master and her god.

name: the young golden dragon
shortdesc: a small gold dragon raises up its head and turns toward you.
longdesc:
The gold dragon although beautiful, looks very dangerous and is rearing
back to breathe at you.

name: goblin guardian
shortdesc: The goblin guardian stands here guarding the entrance to the temple.
longdesc:
The goblin guardian stands here scanning the courtyard.  He has been placed
here to protect the temple against would be thieves.  For a goblin he is
extremely large.  He holds both a shield and sword, poised to attack should a
situation present itself.

name: goblin priestess
shortdesc: The goblin priestess is performing a sacrifice to Apep.
longdesc:
The goblin priestess is adorned with a long flowing white robe.  There
is a quite calm about her has she mutters to herself, ... sacrifice ...
Apep ... darkness ...  You hear but a few words but realize great evil is
drawing near.

name: goblin priest
shortdesc: The goblin priest is preparing a sacrifice for Apep.
longdesc:
The goblin priest holds a sacrificial dagger high above his head.  Blood
drips from the blade down onto the altar.  You stand there horrified as he
prepares to sacrifice to Apep, the evil serpent god.

name: an evil-looking goblin
shortdesc: An evil-looking goblin stands here rubbing his hands together in a dasterdly manner.
longdesc: This goblin is short, even for a goblin, but there is an evil glint in his eyes that foretells of horrors you cannot imagine. And he looks like he is cooking up some new evil right now!

name: goblin archer
shortdesc: The goblin archer trains his bow upon you.
longdesc:
The goblin archer works with Mbenr to protect the path towards the
temple.  He feels right at home in the roots and the muck.  His skin is
brown with dark yellow eyes.  He wears soft leather armor to protect him
in battle.

name: a giant green troll
shortdesc: A giant green troll is here looking for some humans to eat!
longdesc: This troll is a giant amongst trolls! And it is very green. It long clawed hands look ready to snatch you up and devour alive!

name: A mushroom warrior
shortdesc: A large mushroom warrior stands guard over the village.
longdesc:
The mushroom guard stands silently before a large patch of its fellow
villagers.  It is quite a bit larger than the rest of the mushrooms
that you have seen so far.  The guard glares at you with an intense
stare as you pass.

name: A confused-looking mushroom man
shortdesc: A mushroom man stands here looking confused by his surroundings.
longdesc: This mushroom man has awoken to a strange world indeed. Once bright sunlight did beat down up his cap, but now only the artificial magical light that illuminates the museum beats down on him... And it isn't quite the same thing.

name: The mushroom queen
shortdesc: A frantic looking mushroom looks all around the room.
longdesc:
The mushroom queen looks quite frazzled!  She looks around the inside
of the gigantic tree in a frantic manner.  The queen searches under
each mushroom with care in an attempt to find something.  "My children!",
she shouts out to you.  "Have you seen the prince and princess?"  She
immediately returns to her hurried search.

name: A child tourist
shortdesc: A greasy looking child is here fogging up the displays.
longdesc: This child looks like it needs a good wash. Preferably with a de-greaser!

name: An adult tourist
shortdesc: An adult walks around here looking at the displays.
longdesc: Just another tourist taking in the wonders of the museum!

name: A Fortrum tourist
shortdesc: A dwarf has come all the way from Fortrum to look around the museum is here.
longdesc: This dwarf is looking at all the displays with the air of one who has seen all these things manytimes before and is not impressed.

name: A lizardman tourist
shortdesc: A lizardman wanders around here gawking at the exhibits.
longdesc: This lizardman has travelled from an exotic, yet unknown, location just to view the exhibits on display at the Midgard Museum and Conservatory!

name: An elven tourist
shortdesc: An elven tourist is here drinking in the magnifence of the museum!
longdesc: This elven gentleman has travelled far, and he looks pleased with what he has found!

name: A Screaming child
shortdesc: A child is screaming louder than a dragon's roar here.
longdesc: This child has been spooked by one of the exhibits.  Which one?  And why?  Either way, it's best to move along -- that scream is *loud*!

name: A Clapping child
shortdesc: A child is here making seal impressions.
longdesc: This child is so impressed it is clapping.  For what reason?  No, no reason that you can fathom.  Maybe you should just join in and start clapping too?

name: A wandering child
shortdesc: A small child looks around in wonderment.
longdesc: A child that is obviously lost from the carnival and wondered down the street is wandering around aimlessly... Oh well. Someone will claim it soon.

name: A Lost child
shortdesc: A child is here looking very lost.
longdesc: This child looks very lost.  Dare you help it?  It might claim you as its parent...  You sure you wanna?

name: A Playing child
shortdesc: A child is here playing with a toy horse.
longdesc: The wonders of the museum hold no value for this child.  It's chipped and rather sad looking toy horse is, in it's eyes, the stuff of battles and heroics that no museum exhibit is going to top.  Wonderful.

name: A Dwarf child
shortdesc: A child is running around in a fake beard here.
longdesc: Wait a second!  Woah!  That is no fake beard!  Those whiskery tendrils are a real beard... And that child is barely a foot tall!  Who gave it an axe?  Who in the name of realms gave that child an axe?

name: A gelfling man
shortdesc: A gelfling man stands here in the freezing exhibit.
longdesc: Ice hangs from him in icicles...Do you think he might be cold?

name: A Dirty tourist
shortdesc: A dirty tourist is here.
longdesc: This tourist looks like his last bed was in some bushes and the last time he washed the dragon in the lobby probably had skin.  Eww!

name: A Fleeing tourist
shortdesc: A tourist is fleeing something from something here.
longdesc: Something has spooked this guy.  But what?  You can't see anything to be scared of...  Or can you?

name: A Scared tourist
shortdesc: A tourist is quaking in fear here.
longdesc: Some people are just easily spooked.  And this tourist is no exception.  Something has given him the willies (oooeerr).

name: A Gawking tourist
shortdesc: A tourist is here gawking at the exhibits.
longdesc: Is that drool?  Ewww!  Yes!  He's drooling over the exhibits.  Maybe he's been looking to closely at the drow priestess?  *Shiver*!

name: A Clapping tourist
shortdesc: A tourist does a demented monkey impression here.
longdesc: This tourist is so obviously overwhelmed by what he's seeing.  Aww.  Maybe you should tell someone?  It can't be natural to be clapping madly like that?

name: A Dwarf tourist
shortdesc: A young lady in a fake beard is here.
longdesc: Hang on a moment!  That's no lady!  The iron shoes have given it away.  Yeah.  It's a dwarf tourist.  Now say sorry to her- I mean him!

name: A Elf tourist
shortdesc: A silvan looking gentleman is here looking around.
longdesc: Smug.  So smug.  Why not hit him and make that smugness go away?

name: A skeleton dragon
shortdesc: The ancient bones of a dragon are on display here.
longdesc: Buried for thousands of years and dug up only last week.  These bones have been painstakingly re-assembled using wire and horse glue for your viewing pleasure.  It is an impressive sight,  reaching as high as the dome at the top of the lobby and easily spanning the width of the room.  In life, this beast must have been magnificent.

name: Eyebright
shortdesc: Some eyebright is here, looking sentient!
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Ginseng
shortdesc: Some ginseng is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Snakeroot
shortdesc: Some snakeroot is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Lily of the Valley
shortdesc: Some Lily of the Valley is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Lungwort
shortdesc: Some Lungwort is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Hawthorn
shortdesc: Some Hawthorn is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Morning Glory
shortdesc: Some Morning Glory is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Mandrake
shortdesc: Some mandrake is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Yarrow
shortdesc: Some yarrow is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Sunflower
shortdesc: A sunflower is here, looking sentient!
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: A brainy woman
shortdesc: A clever looking woman is here.
longdesc: This woman looks very clever.  Shame her hat doesn't fit her rather large head...

name: A brainy kid
shortdesc: A child is here looking smugger than an elf.
longdesc: This must be the child of family clever.  Whatever they have been eating is sure making them intelligent.  Look!  They have worked out the answer to the ultimate question of life, the universe and everything!  42?  What is 42?

name: Maidenhair Fern
shortdesc: Some Maidenhair Fern is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: A dirty bold gnome
shortdesc: a grubby looking gnome with no hair is here.
longdesc: This gnome not only has no hair (though no fault of its own no doubt) but it is also covered in dirt and grime.  Almost as if its been digging in the roots of the maidenhair fern...  Now why would it do that?

name: Wormwood
shortdesc: Some Wormwood is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Bloodroot
shortdesc: Some bloodroot is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Quaking Aspen
shortdesc: Some Quaking Aspen is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: A shaking man
shortdesc: A man is here shaking with violent tremors.
longdesc: This man has one hand on the Quaking Aspen and is violently shaking... Uh oh!

name: A quaking man
shortdesc: A man is here quaking in his boots.
longdesc: This man has one hand on the Quaking Aspen and is violently shaking... Uh oh!

name: The screaming maiden
shortdesc: A young maiden is here, screaming at the top of her lungs!
longdesc: Her beauty is past compare.  You stand in awe of her.  Men would crawl through fire and ash for her. Women plot her downfall.  Yet she stands here and screams so loudly that your eardrums whistle painfully.  Maybe you should end her suffering?

name: Goldenrod
shortdesc: Some Goldenrod is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Iris
shortdesc: Some Iris is here, looking sentient.
longdesc: It is a plant, and it looks alive!

name: Malice, cousin of Kalas
shortdesc: Malice, the cousin of Kalas, is here ready to steal your soul!
longdesc: Unlike his evil cousin, Malice was born stunted and grotesquely deformed. When he leers drool dribbles down his chin and splashes his doublet. But don't think him any less evil than his cousin, for he will steal your soul and leave your empty husk out for the ravens to feast upon if you underestimate him!

name: a stationary museum guard
shortdesc: A large and imposing museum guard stands here guarding the exhibits.
longdesc: The museum guards looks well trained. He twirls his long black truncheon with the surety of a master. You do NOT want to mess with this man.

name: a wandering museum guard
shortdesc: A large and imposing museum guard wanders around, looking for trouble makers.
longdesc: The museum guards looks well trained. He twirls his long black truncheon with the surety of a master. You do NOT want to mess with this man.

name: Clive the Head Night Watchman
shortdesc: Clive wanders around here, checking on his men.
longdesc: Clive is an old man now. Many years ago his was a warrior adventurer who claimed many victories and treasures. Now he proudly leads the museum night watch in their sworn duty to protect the museum at all costs. He carries a powerful lamp which he uses to spy out even the sneakiest of sneak thieves who may be prowling the museum looking for something valuable to steal.

name: Stanley the Head Day Watchman
shortdesc: Stanley wanders around here, checking on his men.
longdesc: This is Stanley, Head of the Day Watch. Rumours have it that he was once of the Shadow Guards, that elite corps who stand ready to protect Midgard at the drop of a hat, but he was forced to retire due to age slowing him down. This did not stop August Arcana from recognising talent when he saw it, and thus Stanley became the Head of the Day Watch in the museum. He is said to be just as deadly as he was during his years with the Shadow Guards.

name: Midgard Historian
shortdesc: A historian from the Midgard culture society is here trading for special items.
longdesc:
Before you stands a middle aged bald headed man wrapped in a clean but worn brown robe.  The man
looks of slender build, but by the size of his neck and the cut of his jaw, no doubt this man was
a fierce some adventurer.  In his garb he looks more like a monk that a historian, but the way the
economy has been, his uniform may be the only thing the society provides!

name: A sword spider
shortdesc: A sword spider bounces here, ready to kill the unwary.
longdesc:
The sword spider is unique amongst it's giant-spider kind.  It's leg's are sharper
than the finest steel, and it wields all eight of them in battle to deadly efficiency!

name: A blood raptor
shortdesc: A bipedal raptor with blood red scales stalks here.
longdesc:
This raptor reminds you of a dinosaur, with its large, bird-
like body, powerful legs and beady yellow eyes.  It has a maw
full of razor-sharp teeth.  I wouldn't attack it if I was you!

name: A Yuan-Ti Broodguard Leader
shortdesc: A powerful looking Yuan-Ti Broodguard looms here.
longdesc:
With the body of a snake and the torso of a human, this Yuan-Ti
represents the most common of these creatures found in the realms.
She wields a sharp looking scimitar, the traditional weapon of the
Yuan-Ti, as she protects her brood.

name: A cottonmouth snake
shortdesc: A nasty looking cottonmouth snake slithers around here.
longdesc: This dull yellow and grey snake is a lot more dangerous than is looks.

name: The Yuan-Ti Warrior Captain
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Warrior Captain eyes you with distaste.
longdesc:
This Yuan-Ti is the Warrior Captain.  He commands a legion of well
armed and ferocious Yuan-Ti Warriors.  You'd be wise not to piss
him off.

name: The Yuan-Ti Wizard
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Wizard conjures a fireball and prepares to throw it at you!
longdesc:
The Yuan-Ti is a wizard that rivals the well trained Drow wizards.
She has a vast knowledge of the arcane is not to be messed with!

name: Rhesa the Tarantula
shortdesc: The monstrous bulk of Rhesa the Tarantula is here, blocking the labyrinth.
longdesc:
Rhesa is a gigantic, demonic spider.  She has fat, hairy legs and a
bloated body.  She squeezes through the corridors of the Labyrinth
of Tartarus, searching for intruders to feed her never-ending hunger.
Rumour has it that Rhesa was released in to the maze by Nasis himself,
to prevent outsiders coming to the aid of his rival Adina and over-
throwing his command of the Dark Realm of Tartarus.

name: a labyrinth scavenger
shortdesc: A horrible little labyrinth scavenger hops around here, looking for food.
longdesc:
The labyrinth scavenger looks like a tiny dwarf with stumpy arms and
legs that end in vicious claws.  It is a pale, pinky flesh colour.
But perhaps the most noticeable feature is the face.  There are no
eyes, there is no nose, and no ears.  Instead just a long, red maw
exists filled with oversized shark-like teeth.

name: the Giant Scorpion
shortdesc: The giant scorpion scuttles around in here, waiting for prey to fall in.
longdesc:
This is a giant scorpion.  It has ten legs, two powerful claws and
a very nasty looking stinger.  But the main thing to note about this
particular specimen is the size.  It towers over even the biggest of
barbarians!

name: Shade of the Champion
shortdesc: The Shade of a long-dead Champion roams the labyrinth here.
longdesc:
This is the shade of a once noble and valiant crusader.  Adorned in the
spectral armour of its age and armed with a ghostly sword and shield, it
still follows the geas laid upon it in life - to seek out the evil at the
centre of the labyrinth and to vanquish it.  A task that, sadly, it can
never achieve, and so it wanders in never-ending rage and agony, doomed to
be a resident of these corridors for eternity.

name: Greatsword of Nasis
shortdesc: An animated Greatsword of Nasis floats along here, seeking intruders.
longdesc:
This is a large, and very powerful Greatsword that is under the magical
command of Nasis himself.  Animated objects like this have no will of
their own, instead they only follow basic instructions.  In this case,
the Greatsword leads a company of smaller weapons through the corridors,
seeking out intruders and putting them down.  Rumour has it that sometimes
these Greatswords are often accompanied by heralds who sound the alert and
call forth more animated guardians to the area.  Care should be taken when
dealing with these.

name: Hammer of Nasis
shortdesc: An animated Hammer of Nasis floats along here, seeking intruders.
longdesc:
This is a single-handed hammer of the type favoured by Dwarfs across the
realms.  This specimen has been enchanted by powerful magics and animated
by the hands of Nasis himself to follow a Greatsword and offer vanguard
support.  Alone it probably won't be much of an opponent for an experienced
adventurer, but in a group, it offers vital hitting power as the Greatsword
makes arcs and loops through the air.  Take care around this weaponry!

name: a Shrine Keeper
shortdesc: A sacred Shrine Keeper walks here, hooded and quiet.
longdesc:
This is one of the sacred Shrine Keepers, those who watch the gateway to
Tartarus and report back to their Master deep in the dark realm beneath.
They are known to be quiet and fair in their dealings with others, but
when provoked can also be powerful warriors.

name: Mordo, the Herald of Nasis
shortdesc: Mordo stands here, overseeing the gathering visitors.
longdesc:
Mordo is a very, very strong looking human monk in the service of
Nasis.  Dressed in crimson robes, he cries out the story of his one
true Master, and how He forged the realm of Tartarus back at the very
beginning of time.  And how Adina the Usurper rose from his breast
like a cancer and His peaceful realm fell to war and ruin.  Now it
is guarded behind a cunning Labyrinth filled with traps and terrible
guardians, to keep reinforcements reaching Adina, and to keep those
of you who are good at heart safe from the evil She has unleashed
therein.

name: Rhesa's Brood Websack
shortdesc: #{mag}a pulsating websack of Rhesa#{o}
longdesc:
A grotesque websack pulsates ominously here, a product of Rhesa's dark magic.
Its surface is slick and veiny, suggesting something vile is about to hatch.
The air around it feels thick with malice, a testament to the demonic energy
infused by Rhesa the Tarantula. It quivers as if sensing the proximity of
fresh prey, ready to unleash the horrors within upon the unwary.

name: Rhesa's Spawn Spiderling
shortdesc: a horrendous spiderling of Rhesa
longdesc: Spawned from the deepest shadows of the Labyrinth of Tartarus, a malevolent spiderling scurries with a terrifying intent. Bearing the sinister mark of Rhesa, its eyes gleam with a malefic glow, and its fangs drip with a venom most foul. This spawn of Rhesa's unholy brood moves with an unsettling agility, eager to feast and grow under the dark auspice of its monstrous matriarch.

name: a red beholder
shortdesc: A big red beholder floats here, alert for intruders.
longdesc:
This enormous beholder is bright red in colour. It's massive central eye
is a flitting orb of yellow that darts this way and that, ever alert to
signs of intruders.

name: a purple beholder
shortdesc: A purple beholder floats here, going about its business.
longdesc:
This beholder is purple in colour.  It's massive central eye lazily
flits about, it's eye-stalk eyes mimicking the movement as it floats
around, doing whatever it is that beholders do.

name: a yellow beholder
shortdesc: A yellow beholder floats here, protecting the emperor.
longdesc:
Big, ugly and yellow.  The eye stalks on this giant beholder have been
eaten off, leaving just the scarred stalks as a reminder of what it once
had.  But don't that fool you.  These beholders are powerful, able to
burn your skin to a crisp with their stares!

name: a green beholder
shortdesc: A beholder floats here, snoring gently.
longdesc:
This beholder is bulbous, green and currently asleep.  In fact
you could probably give it a hug and it wouldn't wake up.  But
I wouldn't try that if I were you...

name: Gynax Misraria
shortdesc: Gynax Misraria the Devourer is wandering the caverns.
longdesc:
Gynax Misraria is a Drow wizard of significance.  He is part of the
contingent that arrived with Morgania Misraria and whilst she conducts
the business of the Spider Queen with the beholders, he has taken a
stroll through the complex with the Beholder's blessing.  We all know
that Drow do not simply take a stroll for their own amusement, so he
must be up to something.  Spying?  Who know's? It might be best to
avoid this one, rumour has it he is more powerful than any wizard from
Midgard.

name: a mindless slave
shortdesc: A slave, the life beaten out of her, wanders along here on some errand for the beholders.
longdesc:
This slave is dressed in dirty rags and wears shackles on her wrists that
have left horrible red welts. But what you really notice is her eyes.
They are lifeless. Dead. She is no longer a person. The beholders have
destroyed her will and she is utterly in their power.

name: a food slave
shortdesc: A slave stands here, quaking, waiting for the feasting beholders to devour her.
longdesc:
This slave resisted the beholders domination and is now doomed to be
eaten alive!

name: a prisoner
shortdesc: A prisoner hangs here, being abused and beaten by the beholders.
longdesc:
This poor girl is being worked on by the beholders. They are trying to
break her mind and turn her in to a slave.

name: an albino beholder
shortdesc: An albino beholder floats, gazing around myopically.
longdesc:
Albino beholders are rare and elusive!  In most cases these poor
creatures are eaten immediately upon birth by their spawn-kin.
The ones that do survive to be adults are rumoured to be the most
powerful of all beholder-kin.

name: The Balor
shortdesc: The balor is here wreathed in ash and flame.
longdesc:
The Balor is a creature of flame and shadow that hides it's hideous form 
under clouds of billowing smoke and ash.  It wields a powerful sword in
one hand and in the other a whip.  This particular Balor only has one
horn left on it's big, red head, the other seems to have been sheared
off at some point in the past.

name: Mexxil
shortdesc: Mexxil the lizardman emissary sits here patiently.
longdesc:
Mexxil the lizardman is not dissimilar to most of his kind; covered in
greeny-blue scales, reptilian eyes and a bright blue forked tongue. But
his speech is quick and fast and those eyes reveal an intelligence you
did not expect. Where could he hail from? He is dressed in rich looking
bronze armour and carries a wicked-looking bronze xiphos.

name: Morgania Misraria
shortdesc: Morgania Misraria, an emissary from the Drow is here in talks with the Beholders.
longdesc:
Morgania Misraria is a messenger.  But don't let that simple title fool
you.  She has long served her house and greater good of the Drow by acting
as a diplomat to other races who might aid or serve the greater Drow plan.
What she is doing with the beholders?  That is anyone's guess.  She is
dressed in some of the finest attire her kind can produce and it has been
rumoured that she is also a cleric of formidable skill.

name: a beholder hatchling
shortdesc: A small beholder zips and darts around here.
longdesc:
This hatchling is only hours old, and yet it already displays powers you
could only dream of.

name: the Emperor beholder
shortdesc: The emperor beholder floats here, speaking to the latest emissary.
longdesc:
The Emperor beholder is massive. It's sheer size staggers your senses.
It's mouth is big enough to swallow a giant barbarian whole. It's skin is
lime green and the many eye stalks crowning it dart about looking in
every direction. It's massive red eye is fixed firmly on the emissary
it is speaking to though. You should be safe whilst it's talking!

name: a red feeding beholder
shortdesc: A red beholder floats here, gorging itself on fresh meat.
longdesc: This beholder is feeding on a rotting corpse. Gross!

name: a purple gorging beholder
shortdesc: A purple beholder floats here, feasting on fresh meat.
longdesc:
This big beholder is gorging itself on the bodies of dead slaves
Ewww!

name: an ochre beholder
shortdesc: An ochre beholder is here, inflicting pain and misery on the prisoners!
longdesc:
Ochre beholders are well known for their malice and cruelty towards any-
thing that is not beholder-kin. This one has been tasked with destroying
the will of prisoners and turning them in to mindless slaves. It has been
doing a good job too, much to your disgust!

name: a gauth
shortdesc: A small gauth floats here, making some slaves do some work.
longdesc:
The gauth is a lesser beholder that is of a yucky bogey-green colour.
It has a large central eye and six eye- stalks. This one has been
forced to work for its more powerful cousins and is exacting a heavy
toll from the slaves it is forcing to work.

name: a working slave
shortdesc: A slave is here, furiously working to patch the tunnel floor.
longdesc: This slave is exhausted! Too many hours labour and not enough rest or food.

name: a Glabrezu
shortdesc: The powerful form of a Glabrezu is here!
longdesc:
Standing as tall as a giant, it's body broad and muscular, a horned dog-like
head and 4 arms, two of which end in powerful pincers, the Glabrezu is no elf
to be admired and fawned upon.  It exudes power, confidence, evil.  To even
be in the same room as this creature is to court disaster.

name: A Yochlol
shortdesc: A Yochlol forms out of a swirling mist.
longdesc:
A Yochlol! The very handmaiden of the Drow deity Lloth herself! This
demonic creature was clearly summoned, although for what purpose is
yet unknown. The creature appears to look like a melted blob of wax
with 8 arms that continually reforms and remoulds itself. Yuck!

name: an Incubus
shortdesc: The beautiful form of an Incubus is here!
longdesc:
Grinning like a true demon, the Incubus is beautiful to behold.  His
energy, his charisma, his charm, all seem to glow around him like an
aura.  Were it not for the gigantic batwings that grow from its back
this would be the perfect specimen of maledom.

name: a Vrock
shortdesc: The terrible form of a Vrock is here!
longdesc:
Although this cross between a human and vulture stands over eight feet tall,
it's hunched form makes it appear smaller.  Covered in thick, grey skin, with
vicious claws at the end of it's arms and legs, a maw filled with razor-sharp
teeth, the Vrock has the appearance of a terrible foe!

name: a Wastrilith
shortdesc: The slithering form of a Wastrilith is here!
longdesc:
Floating in the air, skin a pale, deathly-blue, the Wastrilith looks like a
giant eel with bulbous, milky eyes and a maw filled with razor sharp teeth.
It doesn't appear to be very intelligent, but it is likely more powerful than
the biggest barbarian with the biggest axe!

name: Doctor Maldraxion
shortdesc: Doctor Maldraxion is here, flaying its latest victim.
longdesc:
Doctor Maldraxion is a mind flayer.  A true, living, powerful mind 
flayer.  Its skin is a pale, deathly grey, its eyes black like those
of a shark.  It has a thin, gaunt humanoid body and a head that is
shaped like that of an octopus.  Four thin tentacles writhe around a
lamprey-like mouth.  It is more intelligent that you will ever be.

name: a hulking aberration
shortdesc: A hulking aberration stands here, gazing mindlessly around.
longdesc:
This disgusting beast might once have been a troll, or a giant, or an ogre.
Or even any one of a number of humanoids that stood taller than a man.  It
is huge, covered in thick, corded muscles.  It has fists bigger than any
hammer you have seen, the knuckles of which have been enhanced by hammered
iron plates covered in spikes.  Naked it may be, it gives off an aura of
danger.

name: a mindless aberration
shortdesc: A mindless aberration stands here, gazing mindlessly around.
longdesc:
Human-sized, but oh-so-fast. This abberation seems to blur even whilst it
remains stationary.  It might once have been an elf, or a lizardman, or
even a Drow, but whatever it was, it is now this thing you see before you.
A thin strip of iron has been hammered around its head, as the top was, at
some time, removed and then replaced after the brain had been played with.
Naked it may be, it gives off an aura of danger.

name: Zain Misraria
shortdesc: Zain Misraria the Drow Scholar sits here, working on a spell.
longdesc:
Rare enough to find a male who has managed to become a cleric, but
to find a male who has mastered the mystical arts and the clerical
ones is a wonder indeed.  His powers are perfectly in-tune with the
Spider Queen's needs, his magical powers enhanced by the his link
to his Goddess.  He summons creatures from the lower planes to
serve his Goddess here, in the material world.

name: a thrall
shortdesc: A thrall is here, following orders to the letter.
longdesc:
This is a human slave, a thrall, in complete control of someone else.
She doesn't have any will of her own and has been programmed with a
few basic commands and suggestions.  It's likely she will defend her-
self when attacked, but otherwise she shouldn't bother you.

name: a ferocious drider
shortdesc: A drider is here, guarding the hall.
longdesc:
Drider's are used by the Drow for all sorts of purposes, from guards and
watchers to farmers and slaves.  A drider has no will and follows the
order's of it's maker to letter.  In this case, the maker was the Matron
of House Misraria.  But what they are doing here, and what they are
guarding is unknown.  The ways of the Drow are dark and mysterious.

name: a vicious drider
shortdesc: A drider is here, guarding the hall.
longdesc:
Drider's are used by the Drow for all sorts of purposes, from guards and
watchers to farmers and slaves.  A drider has no will and follows the
order's of it's maker to letter.  In this case, the maker was the Matron
of House Misraria.  But what they are doing here, and what they are
guarding is unknown.  The ways of the Drow are dark and mysterious.

name: a flayed orc
shortdesc: A flayed orc is here, going crazy in its madness!
longdesc:
This orc has been flayed to within an inch of his life.  There is no
doubt whatsoever that this poor creature has lots his mind, but there
seems to be some issue about controlling it... Uh oh!

name: a corpse devourer
shortdesc: A disgusting slug-like thing is here devouring corpses!
longdesc:
This is a corpse devourer.  It looks like a slug that is around fifteen
feet long and has the weight and power of several storm giants all rolled
in to a single sleeping bag.  It has slimy, black, glistening skin and
eye stalks that peer around myopically.  It doesn't seem to see very well
but it does have an amazing sense of smell!  Although it just uses that
for finding corpses.  It wouldn't be wise to go petting it for it is has
been known to rear up in to an attack posture and spray attackers with a
concentrated acid that is likely to melt weapons, armour, flesh and bone.

name: a flayed purple beholder
shortdesc: A purple beholder has been secured to a device here, it's massive gooey brain exposed!
longdesc:
This purple beholder has been the victim of some kind of horrible,
evil experiment!  The thick, gelatinous-like skin around the top of
it's... Well... It's head has been peeled back to reveal the
pulsating, disgusting blob of pink biomass that is the poor creatures
brain!  Yuck!  It looks at you in fear and horror, blinking wildly
as if to communicate a call for help or mercy!

name: a #{red}#{bold}Hell hound#{o}
shortdesc: A #{red}#{bold}Hell hound#{o} is here, attacking wildly!
longdesc:
This Hell hound resembles a monstrous dogs with a powerful physique.
It stands around four and half feet high at the shoulder and weighs
about one hundred and twenty pounds.  Its fearsome form is covered in
short, rust-red and red-brown fur and its eyes glow like red-hot coals.
The markings on its body, as well and its fangs and tongue, is the
colour of soot. It reeks of sulphurous smoke.

name: the #{cyan}Sorrowborn Warrior#{o}
shortdesc: The #{cyan}Sorrowborn Warrior#{o} is here, defending its master!
longdesc:
The Sorrowborn Warrior is a demonic mirror of a mortal warrior with
skin that resembles armour, one hand that looks like a sword and the
other that looks like a shield.  It is covered in a black, glossy hide
that folds and twists as if it was real platemail, and looks just as
thick as the real thing.  Its eyes are a dim, dark-red umber, and are
the only source of colour on the creature.  It exists to fight, to
kill.  And you are likely to be its next victim.

name: The Blue Slaad
shortdesc: The Blue Slaad hulks here, guarding the passages in to Dark Horn Hill.
longdesc:
The Blue Slaad is a demonic humanoid toad. It stands around 18 feet tall
and is built like a strapping human; all muscle and definition.  It's maw
is full of razor-sharp teeth and it's fists end in long, boney claws; both
of which drip some horrid blue slime...  No doubt some nasty poison. Its
skin is blue, as its name suggests, and ranges from a pale, almost creamy
cyan on its stomach, chest and thighs to dark, ocean sapphire on its back
and crown of its head. The skin also looks very, very tough.  It looks
very aggressive!

name: The Red Slaad
shortdesc: A Red Slaad is hiding amongst the reeds here.
longdesc:
The Red Slaad is a demonic humanoid toad. It stands around 7 and a half feet
tall. It's maw is full of razor-sharp teeth and it's large fists look quite
capable of bludgeoning you to death. It's skin is red, as its name suggests,
and ranges from a pale, almost creamy red on its stomach, chest and thighs to
dark, ochre-red on its back and crown of its head. The skin also looks very,
very tough.

name: The Green Slaad
shortdesc: A Green Slaad is here, searching for magical power.
longdesc:
The Green Slaad is a demonic humanoid toad. It stands around 9 and a half feet
tall. It's maw is full of razor-sharp teeth and it's large fists look quite
capable of bludgeoning you to death. It's skin is green, as its name suggests,
and ranges from a pale, almost creamy green on its stomach, chest and thighs to
dark, olive-red on its back and crown of its head. The skin also looks very,
very tough.

name: A Skink Scout
shortdesc: A blue-scaled skink is here, scouting the bog for intruders.
longdesc:
The skink is a hobbit-sized humanoid lizard.  It is covered in Blue scales
and has a large blue crest on its head that reveals a bright red fan when
it gets angry.  Its eyes are yellow, and they flit here and there looking
for danger.  It carries a short bronze-tipped javelin in one hand.

name: A Skink Warrior
shortdesc: A blue-scaled skink is here, ready to fight.
longdesc:
The skink is a hobbit-sized humanoid lizard.  It is covered in Blue scales
and has a large blue crest on its head that reveals a bright red fan when
it gets angry.  Its eyes are yellow, and they flit here and there looking
for danger.  It carries a short bronze xiphos in one hand and a wood and
bronze shield in the other.

name: A Skink Warrior Elite
shortdesc: A blue-scaled skink is here, ready to fight.
longdesc:
The skink is a hobbit-sized humanoid lizard.  It is covered in Blue scales
and has a large blue crest on its head that reveals a bright red fan when
it gets angry.  Its eyes are yellow, and they flit here and there looking
for danger.  It carries a sharp bronze sickle in one hand and a heavy-
looking bronze shield in the other.

name: Barbula, Ottaconqua's Bodyguard
shortdesc: Barbula, the green scaled Skink bodyguard stands here, ready to defend Ottaconqua.
longdesc:
This is Barbula, a large and muscular Skink. He once challenged Ottaconqua's
leadership, and now bares the scars of his attempt as a badge of honour. He
now serves Ottaconqua with undying loyalty. Barbula is covered in green scales
and has a large green crest on his head that reveals a bright cyan fan when
he gets angry.  His eyes are purple, and they flit here and there looking
for danger.  He carries only the finest in bronze weaponry and armour...

name: Varcula, Ottaconqua's Bodyguard
shortdesc: Varcula, the grey scaled Skink bodyguard stands here, ready to defend Ottaconqua.
longdesc:
This is Varcula. Although he is only as big as the other Skinks you have
seen, he wields his bronze weapons with masterly ease. He has served as
Ottaconqua's favoured lieutenant for many years, and most of the Skink
tribe believe he will one day succeed Ottaconqua as leader. He is covered
in grey scales and has a large blue crest on his head that reveals a bright
yellow fan when he gets angry.  His eyes are black, and they flit here and
there looking for danger.  He carries only the finest in bronze weaponry
and armour...

name: Ottaconqua the Skink Chief
shortdesc: A big blue-scaled skink is here, dressed in finery.
longdesc:
Ottaconqua is a Skink with ambitions.  A clever warrior, he also
acts as spiritual leader for his Skinks, offering prayers to the
crocodile Goddess, Krocoatl. He twirls his twin silver Xiphos with
the air of a master... You had best be careful with this one!

name: A Lizardman
shortdesc: A lizardman is here, going about its business.
longdesc:
The lizardman is a monstrous humanoid lizard.  They are most commonly covered
in green scales but colours can vary from violet blue to deep, ochre-red.  It
stands around 6 feet tall and is roughly equal in weight to an adult, human
male.

name: A Lizardman Warrior
shortdesc: A lizardman warrior is here, looking for intruders.
longdesc:
The lizardman is a monstrous humanoid lizard.  They are most commonly covered
in green scales but colours can vary from violet blue to deep, ochre-red.  It
stands around 6 feet tall and is roughly equal in weight to an adult, human
male. This one is well armed with bronze xiphos and wicker and bronze shield.

name: Lizardman Guard
shortdesc: A lizardman guards the path here.
longdesc:
This lizardman has deep green scales and yellow eyes. It's blue forked
tongue continually tastes the air for danger. It carries a long spear
tipped with a sharp bronze point, ready to repel any intruders.

name: Rabekka, the Night Hag
shortdesc: Rabekka the ancient and evil Night Hag has made her home here.
longdesc:
This ancient, blue-skinned old crone is actually a demon from some dark and deep
outer plane.  How it got here is anyones guess, however, here it is and it is
really enjoying itself, making a home in the bog. "Hello my pretty!" she squeals
when she spots you. Uh oh!

name: Yug-Yug the Bog Troll
shortdesc: Yug-Yug, the foul old Bog Troll is here, eating some disgusting pond-scum!
longdesc:
Old, wiry and tough. Yug-Yug roams the bog looking for things to eat. Which
could be anything!  He has long, slimey-grey arms that end in long, hook-like
claws and small, beady, black eyes. He doesn't look like he see's too well.

name: A Stirge
shortdesc: A massive Stirge zips and buzzes around... Annoying thing!
longdesc:
The Stirge looks like a Dalmatian-sized mosquito! Ack! If it bites you with
that you're going to need more than a band-aid!

name: A Barrow Wight
shortdesc: A Barrow Wight is here, lurking in the shadows.
longdesc:
Once, long-ago, wight simply meant man. Now it means death, decay and
ancient un-ending evil. The barrow wight is the pale, corporeal corpse
of the deceased who was once buried here. Skin, now stretched taught
over sinewy muscle, is translucent and papery. The nails of on the
wights' death-blackened hands are long and disease ridden... You have
heard tales of how ghouls can paralyse...  You should think twice
before attacking this creature un-aided.

name: A Gnoll warrior
shortdesc: A Gnoll warrior is here, evading the Skinks.
longdesc:
This gnoll stands around 7 feet tall. It has a shaggy-dog like head
and massive canines. It doesn't look very aggressive, in fact, if
anything it doesn't look like it wants to attack you at all! Its eyes
dart around the surrounding area, keeping a weary eye out for Skinks.
It is wearing some old, but serviceable leather armour and carries a
long pike.

name: Biter
shortdesc: Biter, the Gnoll Alpha, is here ready to defend his pack!
longdesc:
Biter is one of the last of a once mighty pack of Gnolls that once
ruled the whole of the bog.  Then the lizardmen came and a short
and bloody war ended with the Gnolls losing everything.  Biter was
the last of a group of Gnoll guards, nearly all his pack killed or 
taken, but his position left him as alpha of the other six Gnolls
who have survived ever since.  They squeeze out a a living in the
bog as best as they can, but they know they're days are numbered.
He carries a crude cleaver.

name: a blood fly
shortdesc: A blood fly buzzes around looking for something to suck.
longdesc: Yuck! It's a big, bloated blood fly! Ack! Squash it, quick!

name: a water rat
shortdesc: A water rat scrabbles around here.
longdesc: It looks like a small water-logged rat. You could catch something petting it!

name: a deadly viper
shortdesc: A deadly viper is slithering around here.
longdesc: A small snake with zig-zag patterns down its back... It might be poisonous, so be careful!

name: A small blue slaad
shortdesc: A small blue slaad is here,
longdesc:
The Blue Slaad is a demonic humanoid toad. It stands around 12 feet tall
and is built like a strapping human; all muscle and definition.  It's maw
is full of razor-sharp teeth and it's fists end in long, boney claws; both
of which drip some horrid blue slime...  No doubt some nasty poison. It's
skin is blue, as its name suggests, and ranges from a pale, almost creamy
blue on its stomach, chest and thighs to dark, ocean blue on its back and
crown of its head. The skin also looks very, very tough.  It looks very
aggressive!

name: Krocoatl the Crocodile Goddess
shortdesc: The fearsome Krocoatl the Crocodile Goddess looms here.
longdesc:
Krocoatl is the manifestation of the Skink belief in their crocodile 
Goddess.  She stands 9 feet tall, her scales are as hard as rock and 
her mouth is filled with hundreds of razor-sharp teeth!  Around her 
waist she wears a belt of interlinked golden discs, the seemingly only
ornamentation given to this mighty beast.

name: Scratcher
shortdesc: Scratcher is here, snickering insanely.
longdesc:
Scratcher is the reason that this band of Gnolls still exist in
the bog.  She is much weaker than her male counterparts, but
what she lacks in strength she makes up for in cunning.  She
was the Gnoll that learned how to evade the Skinks, how to lay
traps and capture them, how to skin them and then extract all
of their knowledge from them.  She is a learned cleric, a mage,
and she has all the skill and cunning of a rogue.  She carries
a wicked-looking spike and is adorned in the bright blue, green
and cyan skins of her enemies.  Be wary of this one...

name: A tortured Lizardman Warrior
shortdesc: A lizardman warrior is here, bound, gagged and tortured.
longdesc:
The lizardman is a monstrous humanoid lizard.  They are most commonly covered
in green scales but colours can vary from violet blue to deep, ochre-red.  It
stands around 6 feet tall and is roughly equal in weight to an adult, human
male. This one has been beaten, bound and gagged.  It is unlikely to put up
much of a fight.

name: Qing-Qong and the Red Strider
shortdesc: Qing-Qong is here patrolling on Red Strider, his Centrosaur.
longdesc:
Qing-Qong is a famed and heroic lizardman warrior - not that you would know
this of course as you don't care about lizardman politics.  BUT!  If you did,
you would know that this oversized, muscular beast of a lizardman is the main
protector of the lizardman caves hidden inside Dark Horn Hill.  He rides his
Centrosaur (a bull-sized dinosaur with a plated frill protecting the neck and
a single, curved boney horn at the centre of it's nose) looking for invaders
and, so far, successfully removing them from the surrounds of Dark Horn Hill.

name: Meg Mucklebones
shortdesc: Meg Mucklebones is here, looking for a child to gobble up, bones and all!
longdesc:
Meg Mucklebones is a semi-aquatic swamp witch.  She hails from no darker a place
than these very Realms.  She was once a pretty young woman who lived with her
kin on the banks of a river, long, long ago.  There she would sit and gaze at
her own reflection in a mirror-like pool for hours on end.  She had no time for
anyone but herself, so when marauders came she saved herself and left her young
siblings to gruesome fates.  In retribution she was cursed by the village elders
and made to live in a filthy swamp where the waters would never reflect her true
form - now hideous and grotesque!  She feeds on young lizardmen offspring and
other unwary travellers.  And she is far more dangerous than you can imagine,
with those long curling claws, sharp pointed teeth and tiny piggy eyes!

name: a Blue Slaad
shortdesc: a Blue Slaad hulks here, eating all the flies and lizardmen is can find.
longdesc:
The Blue Slaad is a demonic humanoid toad. It stands around 18 feet tall
and is built like a strapping human; all muscle and definition.  It's maw
is full of razor-sharp teeth and it's fists end in long, boney claws; both
of which drip some horrid blue slime...  No doubt some nasty poison. It's
skin is blue, as its name suggests, and ranges from a pale, almost creamy
blue on its stomach, chest and thighs to dark, ocean blue on its back and
crown of its head. The skin also looks very, very tough.  It looks very
aggressive!

name: Q'Tec the Lizardman Chief
shortdesc: Q'Tec, the Lizardman Chief, commands respect here.
longdesc:
Q'Tec is a master of arms and poisons. He is a renowned warrior and
assassin.  He stands over 7 foot tall and sports red scales that range
from a deep red on his back and tail to a creamy red on his belly and
inner arms. Q'Tec is covered in scars and old wounds. He didn't become
chief of this mighty clan by accident.  He is a feared and terrible foe.

name: A Skum Slave
shortdesc: A Skum is here, gathering food.
longdesc:
The Skum is a grotesque cross between a human and a fish. It has cold,
clammy green skin covered in pale, translucent scales. It's eyes are
bulbous, dark orbs and a leathery, wet-looking fin starts at its brow,
passes through its lank, dark hair and down its back. It's wide mouth
is full of blunt, tombstone-like teeth.

name: A Skum Warrior Slave
shortdesc: A Skum warrior is here, guarding the pathways
longdesc:
The Skum is a grotesque cross between a human and a fish. It has cold,
clammy green skin covered in pale, translucent scales. It's eyes are
bulbous, dark orbs and a leathery, wet-looking fin starts at its brow,
passes through its lank, dark hair and down its back. It's wide mouth
is full of blunt, tombstone-like teeth.

name: Or-Qatz the Lizardman Shaman
shortdesc: Or-Qatz is skulking in the background here.
longdesc:
Or-Qatz is a skilled wizard and clever priest. Ever since the
Sahuagin cut their way into the lizardman caves and bought off
his chief, Q'Tec, with petty material gifts has he sought for a
way to overthrow the rule of his chief and provide his people
with a worthy leader who lead them against the Sahuagin, and to
victory.  He appears to be placing all his faith in the young
warrior Qelz-Tii.

name: The Death Slaad
shortdesc: The Death Slaad stands, confident in the knowledge it can destroy you.
longdesc:
The Death Slaad is a human sized demonic frog like creature from another plane.  It
oozes power and confidence, safe in the knowledge that on its own plane it is the
most powerful being of all.  It is dressed like a very wealthy mage and carries a
staff that almost screams with power.  You should be careful of this one...

name: The Grey Slaad
shortdesc: The Grey Slaad is here, beckoning forth the mists from the pit below.
longdesc:
Grey Slaad are demonic, humanoid frogs that closely resemble master wizards.  They
have advanced from the lesser Green Slaad in knowledge and power and are known to
hold many highly magical artefacts, making them a deadly foe, but also a temptation
to any adventurer with a taste for treasures.

name: A Sahuagin Frenzy
shortdesc: An intimidating Sahuagin frenzy is here, ready to skewer you with her fish-spear!
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-people, normally found in the
deepest oceans.  This one is a trained and vicious frenzy, ready to
kill at a moments notice, with no thought for personal safety.

name: A Sahuagin Whaler
shortdesc: A Sahuagin whaler stands guard here.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-people, normally found in the
deepest oceans.  This one stands on guard duty. It appears to be a
little relaxed and isn't really paying attention to very much...

name: A Sahuagin Sekkite
shortdesc: A Sahuagin Sekkite is here, crying for all to worship the Shark God, Sekolan!
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  This one is of a priestly persuasion and appears to crackle with
power.  It's God must be strong indeed to grant such ferocious power to
His worshippers!  Maybe you got it all wrong, and you too want to join
these fishy guys in this plaice and worship with them just for the
halibut?  Let minnow how that goes for you.  Tuna in next time for more
awful puns.

name: A Sahuagin Temple Sekkite
shortdesc: A Sahuagin Temple Sekkite is here, watching over the flock.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans. This one is a powerful temple Sekkite. He watches his underlings
with interest, seeing which are the most feverous in their worship and
which need to be flogged for a lack of passion.

name: Atalantic, The Sahuagin High Sekkite
shortdesc: Atalantic, the Sahuagin High Sekkite stands here, buzzing with power.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  Atalantic is the very embodiment of their evil God, Sekolan.  He
is the leader of the Sekkites and the one who summoned and bound the Slaad
to this plane.  He plots for far more than just a temple to worship his
God within, but even his Sekkites cannot fathom the depths of his plans.

name: Pacacific, Sawtooth of the Sahuagin Outpost
shortdesc: Pacacific stands here, marking out the outpost defences.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  Pacacific is a powerful and cunning warrior, known as a sawtooth
to his people.  He has won many battles against many foes and he fights
solely for the Sahuagin Shark Prince who resides deep in the ocean, away
from surface dweller eyes.

name: Qelz-Tii the Lizardman
shortdesc: Qelz-Tii is here, working some metal.
longdesc:
Qelz-Tii is a proficient blacksmith and warrior of the lizardman
tribe living in Dark Horn Hill.  He is strong and clever and
quick of wit, but he is also trying to get his people out of the
cave system and free from the thraldom imposed by the Sahuagin
masters and his chief, Q'Tec.

name: A Lizardman
shortdesc: A lizardman is here, going about its business.
longdesc:
The lizardman is a monstrous humanoid lizard.  They are most commonly covered
in green scales but colours can vary from violet blue to deep, ochre-red.  It
stands around 6 feet tall and is roughly equal in weight to an adult, human
male.

name: A Lizardman Warrior
shortdesc: A lizardman warrior is here, looking for intruders.
longdesc:
The lizardman is a monstrous humanoid lizard.  They are most commonly covered
in green scales but colours can vary from violet blue to deep, ochre-red.  It
stands around 6 feet tall and is roughly equal in weight to an adult, human
male. This one is well armed with bronze xiphos and wicker and bronze shield.

name: Lizardman Guard
shortdesc: A lizardman is standing guard here.
longdesc:
This lizardman has deep green scales and yellow eyes. It's blue forked
tongue continually tastes the air for danger. It carries a long spear
tipped with a sharp bronze point, ready to repel any intruders.

name: A Cave Dirth
shortdesc: A slimey cave dirth is here, snuffling around for roots and fungi.
longdesc:
The cave dirth looks like a cross between a rat and a pig. It also looks quite
blind. The lizardmen keep them for food... Would you like to try the Dirth Steak?

name: A Sahuagin Shoalrunner
shortdesc: A Sahuagin Shoalrunner is here obeying his Sawtooth!
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  Sahuagin Shoalrunners are deadly bodyguards and fearless leaders.
They will defend their Sawtooth to the death.

name: A Sahuagin Chummixer
shortdesc: A Sahuagin Chummixer is lounging around here.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  This one is a Chummixer - he makes sure that prisoners get turned
in to tasty bait.  He has a bundle of keys.  Maybe they're important?

name: A Sahuagin Shoalrunner
shortdesc: A Sahuagin Shoalrunner is here patrolling the halls!
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  Sahuagin Shoalrunners are deadly bodyguards and fearless leaders.
They will defend their Sawtooths to the death.

name: Antoinettenamatadon
shortdesc: The Antoinettenamatadon swirls here in a frenzy of teeth and tentacles!
longdesc:
What can be said about the Antoinettenamatadon.  The distant cousin of
