the all-power Buntagonamadon, the devourer of mortals and destroyer of
worlds?  It has a distinctive smell, much like garbage left out in the
sun for too long, with a hint of that goo that is found the world over
under cookers that haven't been moved in a decade.  It is multi-tentacled,
slimy, greenish-gray-purple in colour and has more mouths than a school of
piranha.  And it is your doom.  There is now escape, prepare to be its
next meal!

name: A spiny lobster
shortdesc: A spiny lobster crawls around the tank.
longdesc:
The lobster is red and has large spiked claws.  It crawls along the
bottom of the tank hoping to find some coral to cling to... Or eat.
Who knows what Lobsters seek coral out for?

name: a small crab
shortdesc: A small crab scrambles along the edge of the tank.
longdesc:
The small crab has almost an orange color to it.  The little creatures
scrambles around the tank with surprising agility. Shame it is likely
to end up as a Sahuagin's supper. Oh well.

name: A Sahuagin Reefcrawler
shortdesc: A Sahuagin is here attending the needs of Death Slaad.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans. This one is a powerful Reefcrawler that tends to the mortal-world
needs of the Death Slaad.

name: a human prisoner
shortdesc: A human prisoner cowers in the dampness here.
longdesc:
This prisoner is filthy! She is dressed in rags and looks like she
has suffered many beatings at the hands of the Sahuagin.

name: A Sahuagin Abyssal Guard
shortdesc: A Sahuagin Abyssal Guard is here, ready to skewer you!
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  This one guards the temple and protects the Sekkites from
intruders like you!

name: A Sahuagin Coralworker
shortdesc: A short Sahuagin is here, running errands for the priests.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  This short and scrawny one is running errands for the Sekkites
and alerting the Abyssal Guards to any intruders...

name: A Sahuagin Dambuilder
shortdesc: A Sahuagin is here, fixing some part of the temple.
longdesc:
The Sahuagin are an evil race of fish-men, normally found in the deepest
oceans.  This one looks like it's fixing some minor faults in the temple
structure that only he can see... Be careful though, he'd probably raise
the alarm if he saw you!

name: a Dragonborne noble Leader
shortdesc: A huge multi-hued dragon stands here with a well-armored man astride it.
longdesc:
A man of clearly noble birth sits upon the back of this huge, 45-foot long
polychromatic dragon.  He surveys the area with open contempt.

name: the Prophet
shortdesc: The Prophet stands here with a fanatic gleam in his eye.
longdesc:
The Prophet of the Dragon is a small but imposing figure.  There is
a sense of both the charismatic and the mad about him.

name: a white Dragonborne soldier
shortdesc: A well-armored man and his large white dragon mount stand here.
longdesc:
The rider of this 30 foot long dragon looks about with a cold, inscrutable
gaze while his mount eyes you hungrily.

name: A reading kid
shortdesc: A kid wanders through the library reading.
longdesc:
A kid is wandering through the library and reading at the same
time paying no attention to where he is going.

name: The Librarian
shortdesc: The Librarian is here replacing various books
longdesc: He looks like a rather peaceful old man.

name: The Scholar
shortdesc: The Scholar rest here reading a book
longdesc:
He is very intent on his book, looks like he would not 
notice anything in the world around him.

name: Boneclaw
shortdesc: Boneclaw flaps her wings and pecks at something on the ground.
longdesc:
Boneclaw was, in life, a beautiful golden gryphon.  She was the mount of
Count Buntavic before his downfall.  Her once perfect feathers are tattered
and missing in places, purple-black instead of their once sun-touched sheen.
Where her flesh can be seen it is rotting and fetid, crawling with grave-
worms and maggots.  Her beak is a notched and darkened thing, illuminated by
the light of her glowing ruby-red eyes.  She feeds on adventurers and gypsies
who become lost in the forests of Bloodclaw Estate.

name: Lord Hester
shortdesc: Lord Hester is here, howling at the moon!
longdesc:
This is Hester Romanov.  In life he was just another honest gypsy making
a living as best he could.  He answered a call to murder the Count and
rescue his sisters daughter, Anna Romanov.  When things went wrong and
Anna was killed he ran.  But the Count caught up with him with his fear-
some hounds before he made it out of the forest.  Hester was cursed to
lead the hounds in a midnight hunt never ending, tracking and bringing
down anyone who ventures in to the Counts' land.  He has human-like
features but appears to have been melded with a wolf, giving him long
and pointed ears, a stubby nose, big canine teeth and hands that end in
dark and blackened claws.

name: a felhound
shortdesc: A felhound is here, snuffling the ground, searching for scents.
longdesc:
This is a normal-looking hound... If normal hounds had little bump-
like horns that protruded from their foreheads and glowing red eyes.
It also has unusually large teeth.  It stands around six feet tall
at the shoulder, with a powerful barrel-like chest and hind quarters.

name: a death hound
shortdesc: A death hound is here, which means Lord Hestor is close by!
longdesc:
This vile creature is a death hound.  It is the risen corpse of a
large hunting hound.  It has been mutated in death, standing close
to seven feet tall at the shoulder.  The lack of flesh makes it
slim and lithe, almost cat-like.  It is held together by a glowing
green cloud of magic that is highly focussed around the eyes, making
them glow eerily.  It's possible this thing can see you no matter
where or how you hide.

name: a risen corpse
shortdesc: A corpse shuffles around here... Looking for brains, maybe?
longdesc:
This is the corpse of a gypsy invader that has been risen in death.  It's
not quite a zombie, but also not quite a magical construct.  It appears to
be cursed, like an ancient mummy in a sandy kingdom, to wander these woods
for eternity in penance for the crimes of its tribe.

name: a suppressor
shortdesc: A bound and blindfolded corpse moans here.
longdesc:
Ever since Anna Romanov was murdered, the Count has found gypsies
invading his lands.  Some he kills, some he hunts, and some he
tortures.  The latter, when they finally die, are cursed to walk
the estate, blindfolded and bound in the bonds that held them
during their last days.  They have no faces, and their hands are
now clawed and broken things, blackened with disease.  Known now
as suppressors, they are rumoured to have the ability to paralyse
a man.

name: a brood maggot
shortdesc: A large brood maggot crawls on the ground here.
longdesc:
Wherever there is dead flesh, you will find maggots ready to feast.
Brood maggots are not the larva of an insect, they are the adult-form
of their kind.  Usually found with a brood mother, the brood maggot
is around three feet in length, fat and pudgy, with no legs, and a
tubular mouth armed with stylets that the maggot uses to lock on to
prey and suck the goodies from the inside.  Generally they do not
attack living things... So don't die and you won't get eaten?

name: Lauke, the Brood Mother
shortdesc: Lauke, the Brood Mother of the maggots is here, feeding.
longdesc:
This is Lauke, a giant Brood Mother, queen of maggots and filth.  She
spawns her many children inside the many corpses found in this wood,
laying her eggs and letting them hatch and eat their fill before moving
on to the next fetid cadaver in a never-ending cycle of nature.  Unlike
her offspring, she is an aggressive, vile thing, that has no fear of
the living.

name: a skeletal militiaman
shortdesc: The skeletal remains of a militiaman is here, patrolling the estate.
longdesc:
In life the militiamen were peasants in the employ of the Count who
took the role of patrolling the estate much like groundskeepers or
game wardens.  They kept the riff-raff away from the noble family
who resided in the magnificent castle.  For habitual offenders and
thieves, they would also act as judge, jury and executioner, taking
the guilty to the Hanging Tree and taking their lives in punishment.
Now they are as cursed as everything else in this place, risen from
the dead to continue their patrols for an eternity in servitude to
the Count.

name: a skeletal captain
shortdesc: The skeletal remains of a militia captain is here, leading a patrol.
longdesc:
Patrol Captains were respected elders among the peasants who lived
on the Estate.  They took their role seriously, dealing out capital
punishment for even the smallest of crimes committed against the
Count.  And in death, they are no different!  Wearing the faded
colours of the count they patrol for invaders, attacking any who
do not belong here and ensuring death follows with them.

name: Count Buntavic
shortdesc: Count Buntavic is here hunting his next victim.
longdesc:
This is Count Buntavic von Moarte.  He's a centuries old vampire fuelled by the
need for revenge upon those who took his love in life.  He assumes everyone is
an enemy, without exception, and will kill them on sight, or worse, curse them
as he has done to countless others.  Your only choice is to run and hide!
He is well dressed, in cape and evening wear.  Were it not for the slightly
grave-green tint to his skin and his long, pointed fangs, one would think
him quite elegant.

name: An ANnoYiNG Frog Demon
shortdesc: #{flash}#{YELLOW}An ANnoYiNG demonic frog is here, about to ribbit at you.#{off}
longdesc: demon

name: a bloated water spider
shortdesc: a fat, white, bloated water spider scuttles around here.
longdesc:
The water spider is about the size of your head, not including the legs.
It hunts near the ceiling of the Yuan-Ti cavern, looking for any tasty
morsels that may be washed down.

name: a kingsnake
shortdesc: A colourful kingsnake slithers about here.
longdesc:
It has colourful bands going down it's entire body. #{bold}#{yellow}Yellow#{o}, #{bold}#{red}Red#{o},
#{bold}#{yellow}Yellow#{o}, #{bold}#{black}Black#{o}, #{bold}#{yellow}Yellow#{o}, #{bold}#{red}Red#{o}. Uh-oh!

name: a slow worm
shortdesc: A slow worm slithers about slowly, devouring the trash.
longdesc:
This little grey snake is actually a lizard with no legs. It is perfectly
harmless as it goes about scavenging in the corridors.

name: a tiny cave salamander
shortdesc: A tiny, bright-red salamander scuttles about here.
longdesc:
The salamander is a lizard.  It is coloured bright red.  Salamander's
have been associated with fire.  Should you be careful?  Maybe not.

name: a cavern raptor
shortdesc: A cavern raptor is here, rooting around for junk.
longdesc:
The cavern raptor is a bipedal lizard standing around a meter in height.
It has a big bloated belly, full of complex stomachs that can break down
even the grossest of trash.

name: a Yuan-Ti Broodguard
shortdesc: A Yuan-Ti broodguard is here eyeing you suspiciously.
longdesc:
The Yuan-Ti broodguard is well trained, and well armed!  Even with the body
of a snake, he's probably going to cause you a problem or two!

name: a Yuan-Ti commoner
shortdesc: An angry-looking Yuan-Ti commoner wanders about here.
longdesc:
Half snake, half human, the Yuan-Ti are monstrous to behold.  And even
though this race is associated with evil, doesn't mean they all are. 
The commoner wanders around on it's business, ignoring you.

name: the Yuan-Ti Matron
shortdesc: A large, obviously feminine Yuan-Ti is here, protecting the hatchlings.
longdesc:
The Yuan-Ti matron is large and imposing.  She looks like she would
pull your arms off and hit you with the wet end!

name: a Yuan-Ti female
shortdesc: A Yuan-Ti female stands here, looking for a male.
longdesc:
This female seems really intent of finding a mate.  Perhaps you should
move on?

name: a Yuan-Ti hatchling
shortdesc: A young Yuan-Ti hatching is here, hissing loudly at you!
longdesc:
Although small in stature, even the Yuan-Ti young are not to
be meddled with.  This one shows the famous snake body of her 
race!

name: The Yuan-Ti Battlemaster
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Battlemaster is here training some troops.
longdesc:
The Yuan-Ti Battlemaster is in charge of training the broodguards that
wander the platforms of the palace complex.  He is an expert in all
forms of martial arts!

name: a Yuan-Ti broodguard-in-training
shortdesc: A Yuan-Ti is here learning how to be a broodguard.
longdesc:
This Yuan-Ti is strong, muscular and capable.  He is being
trained to be an effective guard for the Yuan-Ti palace!

name: Captain Extaminos
shortdesc: Extaminos the Broodguard Captain is here reading a report.
longdesc:
Extaminos is an old Yuan-Ti, the scales on his tail have dulled
by the passage of time.  But don't let that fool you.  Older Yuan-
Ti are known to be as powerful as gods!

name: Arch Priestess Sarrish
shortdesc: Sarrish, the Yuan-Ti Arch Priestess is here, praying.
longdesc:
Sarrish is an emaciated Yuan-Ti, her scales pulled tight about her
face and body, yet each one gleams and glimmers as if with the very
youth of the youngest and fittest cleric.

name: Sorcerer Hss'thiss
shortdesc: Hss'thiss, the Yuan-Ti Sorcerer is here weaving the winds of fate.
longdesc:
Hss'thiss oozes power and confidence.  His power is known to exceed
that of even the mighty liches of old!

name: King Surrekh
shortdesc: Surrekh is coiled here, commanding an audience and your respect.
longdesc:
Surrekh has been King of the Yuan-Ti for a long, long time. Even
aged as he is, he is still a commanding figure!

name: Ambassador Krishna
shortdesc: Krishna, the Yuan-Ti Ambassador is lounging here lazily.
longdesc:
Even compared to other Yuan-Ti, Krishna looks rich.  He is bedecked
by jewels and trinkets of every kind!

name: An adolescent Yuan-Ti
shortdesc: A sullen-looking Yuan-Ti adolescent is here.
longdesc: He looks disgruntled.  Well, aren't all adolescents?

name: An adolescent Yuan-Ti
shortdesc: A angry-looking Yuan-Ti adolescent is here.
longdesc: He looks disgruntled.  Well, aren't all adolescents?

name: An adolescent Yuan-Ti
shortdesc: A bored-looking Yuan-Ti adolescent is here.
longdesc: He looks disgruntled.  Well, aren't all adolescents?

name: An adolescent Yuan-Ti
shortdesc: A sullen-looking Yuan-Ti adolescent is here.
longdesc: He looks disgruntled.  Well, aren't all adolescents?

name: Princess Sasssha
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Princess is here being overly dramatic about something.
longdesc:
This young Yuan-Ti is a Princess.  You can tell because she's really demanding
and an expert at throwing a bigger sulk than your average PR player after a
nerf!

name: Poisoner Saark
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Poisoner is here, dousing a knife with venom!  Watch out!
longdesc:
Being a race of part snake creatures, the Yuan-Ti find poisons to be a
very valuable resource.  So much so that there is even a job for one in
the palace!

name: Prince Ajakan
shortdesc: The prince of the Yuan-Ti is here, admiring himself in a mirror.
longdesc:
Cold, cruel and vain.  Those are the nice things that you can
say about this self-serving, backstabbing, sociopathic prince.
Everything else would be the bad stuff, so you can imagine
just how bad it is.

name: War Dancer Zzaln
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti War Dancer is here moving hypnotically.
longdesc:
Fighting a War Dancer is a dangerous business, it is rumoured that
the dance is so hypnotic that many a foe has changed sides mid-fight
and attacked their friends!

name: Champion Karnax
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Arena Champion is here flexing his impressive muscles.
longdesc:
His skin and scales glitter and gleam from the application of many
oils.  He is as big and strong as you'd expect of an Arena winner!

name: Demonologist Fauush
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Demonologist is here, evoking his spells!
longdesc:
The Yuan-Ti entreat with demons on a daily basis, and the presence of
a powerful wizard just dedicated to this should come as no surprise!

name: High Commandant Quee'Quee
shortdesc: Quee'Quee the Yuan-Ti High Commandant stands here, looking serious!
longdesc:
Rumour has it that Quee'Quee was magically enhanced and is able to rip
your head off and do things to your corpse that would make your mother
weep.

name: Queen Agamagdon
shortdesc: Queen Agamagdon is here, looking dangerously calm.
longdesc:
Queen Agamagdon is the true ruler of the Yuan-Ti, no matter
what the King may say.  She exudes power, confidence and for
a half-snake half-human creature, she is also quite beautiful.

name: a Yuan-Ti wizard
shortdesc: A Yuan-Ti wizard is here teaching her students the subtle magical arts.
longdesc:
This wizard is teaching younger Yuan-Ti wizard wannabes how
to perform the most intricate of magic... So watch out for
those magic missiles!  Right now it looks like the wizards
are learning how to summon various creatures.

name: Cleric Raaska
shortdesc: The Yuan-Ti Cleric Raaska sits here, praying to the demonic Yuan-Ti Goddess.
longdesc:
Raaska is as pious as the Yuan-Ti can be.  And the Yuan-Ti
are very pious indeed.  He is adorned in fine blue robes
and symbols of the six-armed snake Goddess.  Even his skin
and scales have been tattooed in her image.

name: a young Yuan-Ti wizard
shortdesc: A young Yuan-Ti wizard is here summoning a terrible creature!
longdesc:
This young Yuan-Ti wizard looks like he has succeeded in one
of his spells!

name: an experienced Yuan-Ti student wizard
shortdesc: An experienced Yuan-Ti student wizard is here, dreaming of napping.
longdesc:
This Yuan-Ti wizard is still learning his art, yet he looks
smugly arrogant about his abilities.

name: the Eater of Souls
shortdesc: The robed and hooded Eater of Souls is here, ready to devour you!
longdesc:
Dressed in a black robe that cover its face, the Eater of
Souls is a demon from some dark and dingy plane upon which
no mortal should tread.  But you know, some people just
cannot help themselves and go anyway, as the Yuan-Ti wizards
demonstrate by summoning one here.

name: a rock elemental
shortdesc: A rock elemental moves towards you in a whirl of dust and pebbles!
longdesc:
Rock elementals look like animated rocks that roll and tumble
together in the vague shape of a humanoid.  This one has lovely
glowing red eyes.  How nice!  It appears to have been summoned
by some of the Yuan-Ti wizards.

name: The cavern crawler
shortdesc: A yucky cavern crawler stretches its tentacles towards you!
longdesc:
This marvellous creature looks like it is all mouth.  In fact, so much of it
is mouth that there doesn't appear to be anywhere for it to digest its food.

name: A massive grizzly bear
shortdesc: A massive grizzly bear is here, roaring in rage!
longdesc:
This is a grizzly bear.  You know?  The ones you find on mountains that
eat salmon and look really cute?  Yeah, those ones.  It is NOT happy.

name: Malligan the Giant
shortdesc: Malligan the Giant stands here, swinging his club menacingly!
longdesc:
This is Malligan.  He's a giant.  He stands just over 9 feet tall.  He has
shaggy brown hair that mats his body and acts like natural armour.  He has
rotting yellow teeth and small eyes that roam and roll madly.  He has
breath so bad it could melt tin.  Other than that he's a very pleasant
chap who likes walks in the rain and crushing rabbit skulls in his fist.

name: the cat of nine lives
shortdesc: The Cat of Nine Lives is here, yowling madly.
longdesc:
Covered in white fur that ripples as if in an invisible wind, it's
hackles raised it's stance ready to attack, the Cat of Nine Lives is
no pretty kitty for you to pet and love upon.

name: Yowler the Gnoll
shortdesc: The rabid gnoll berserker Yowler is here!
longdesc:
Yowler is a Gnoll.  A big gnoll, with a dog-like snout and the pointy
ears of a hunter.  Rumour has it when he howls at you, it hurts!
AWOOOOOOOOOOooooooooo!

name: The Marilith
shortdesc: The Marilith is here, whirling her weapons in her six arms!
longdesc:
The Marilith is the demonic goddess of the Yuan-Ti!  Why have there been all
those cheers as you fought your way in to the arena?  Because you are a
sacrifice to the great Marilith.  She rises up to 8 feet above the ground, a
different weapon held in each of her six arms!  And she moves fast, quickly,
slithering across the open ground to get at you.  Defend yourself or run!

name: Howler
shortdesc: The insane gnoll warrior Howler is here, roaring a war cry!
longdesc:
Howler is a Gnoll.  A big gnoll, with a dog-like snout and the pointy
ears of a hunter.  Rumour has it when he hits you, it hurts!
AWOOOOOOOOOOooooooooo!

name: Scourge
shortdesc: The crazed orc warlock Scourge is here, preparing to MASH you!
longdesc:
Scourge is a warlock of incredible power.  He has bright red
eyes, powerful muscles and a mind full of spells!

name: Growler
shortdesc: The crazed gnoll fighter Growler is here, snarling viciously!
longdesc:
Growler is a Gnoll.  A big gnoll, with a dog-like snout and the pointy
ears of a hunter.  Rumour has it when he hits you, it hurts!
AWOOOOOOOOOOooooooooo!

name: Buntagonamadon
shortdesc: The Buntagonamadon swirls here in a frenzy of teeth and tentacles!
longdesc:
What can be said about the Buntagonamadon.  Ancient God of the Yuani-Ti?
Most powerful being ever to inhabit the realms?  It has a smell akin to
rotting garbage and low tide even underwater?  There are many things that
can be said but perhaps the most important is that this multi-tentacled,
grey, green and purple slimy monster is your doom.  There is no escape
for you now, you will be the devoured.

name: a cavern pterosaur
shortdesc: A ferocious pigeon-sized pterosaur swoops down at you!
longdesc:
A remnant of a bygone era, this pterosaur has remained biologically
unchanged for millions of years.  It feeds quite happily off the
spiders and lurkers that haunt dark, damp caverns.  It has big eyes
that are capable of seeing in the dark and a mouth full of vicious
little teeth.

name: a cavern lurker
shortdesc: A disgusting lurker is here, looking for food.
longdesc:
Lurkers could be described as a slug with teeth,  so we shall
describe them as such.  They stretch out to just over a metre
in length with slimy black skin that glistens wetly.  Yuck.
I wouldn't touch it if I were you.

name: Advisor Memnon
shortdesc: Memnon, the Yuan-Ti Ceremonial Advisor is here, reading his books.
longdesc:
Memnon is a curiosity amongst the Yuan-Ti.  He studies the
cultures and traditions of other races in order to advise
his King and Queen on how best to relate to other races.
He was the first Yuan-Ti that August Arcana spoke to.

name: a Yuan-Ti male
shortdesc: A Yuan-Ti male stands here, looking for a female.
longdesc:
This male seems really intent of finding a mate.  Perhaps you should
move on?

name: Arch Priestess Xanasha
shortdesc: Xanasha, the Yuan-Ti Arch Priestess is here, praying.
longdesc:
Xanasha is a Yuan-Ti of middling years.  She is powerfully built, 
standing well over seven feet in height, her scales a dark, burnt
umber.  Her eyes gleam with malcontent.

name: Arch Priestess Alliss
shortdesc: Alliss, the Yuan-Ti Arch Priestess is here, praying.
longdesc:
Allis is a young and beautiful Yuan-Ti, her scales gleam and glimmer
with youth and energy.  Yet, she seems to have a power far beyond her
years.

name: The Zombie of King Surrekh
shortdesc: The Zombie of King Surrekh is here, seeking vengeance on all non-Yuan-Ti!
longdesc:
Surrekh was the King of the Yuan-Ti for a long, long time. Then some
adventurers came and killed him!  Now he has risen again to seek
vengeance upon his murderers!

name: The Creeping Doom
shortdesc: The Creeping Doom is here, devouring all in its wake!
longdesc:
This is the Creeping Doom.  It is not actually a single creature, although
it acts like a solitary entity.  It is made up of millions upon millions
of tiny insects - spiders, locusts, roaches, beetles - you name it, it's
got them all swarming and buzzing and scuttling together so that they have
taken all the mass and form to destroy anything in their wake!

name: a spawn of doom
shortdesc: a spawn of doom is here, devouring and growing!
longdesc:
This is a spawn of doom, a football-sized mass of insects that is devouring
everything it can!  Best kill it quick before it becomes too large to handle!

name: Bashgar Oneeye
shortdesc: Bashgar Oneeye, Orc Wizard Hero of Moria, is here frantically trying to make the tower phase!
longdesc:
This is Bashgar.  Or 'Bossman' to his friends.  He's big.  He's mean. He
wears a wizard's hat and carries the staff Omshomnargar (which can be
loosely translated from orcish gutterspeak as 'stick').  He is the half-
brother of the famous hero of Moria, Balgor.  He is also a necromancer
of awesome power.  Legend has it that Bashgar invaded and took over the
moving-tower domain of an evil mage, but crashed it on his way home and
now it forever looks like a half-mountainous cavern, half-squat and dull
tower on the outside, and the inside looks like a maze of corridors and
strangely connected rooms.  Still, it's Bashgar's home now, and he'll
defend it will all his power!

name: an undead behemoth
shortdesc: An undead behemoth looms here, guarding the dark witch.
longdesc:
This large and fearsome monstrosity is the animated remains of a long-
dead orge.  It's pale, milky eyes peer out from under a heavy brow full
of rotten flesh that looks likely to slough off at any moment.  It has
no mind, it follows only the simple orders of its creator, Millicent,
and will guard her until it can move no more.

name: an undead minotaur
shortdesc: An undead minotaur looms here, guarding the dark witch.
longdesc:
Minotaurs are a breed half-man half-bull humanoids.  They have a heavyset
bovine head with jutting horns.  This one would be typical of the race
were it not for the fact that there is no flesh on the head except for a
few dark patches of dried fur.  The creatures' horns curl forward and up
so that when the beast charges there is a good chance of being impaled
on those sharp horntips.  The body is mostly rotting meat and exposed
bone, but it looks very powerful.  Standing over 8 feet tall, the long
dead animated corpse is the puppet and protector of Millicent.

name: a chained wraith
shortdesc: A chained wraith is here, furiously wrenching at its shackles!
longdesc:
A chained wraith is an undead that has been summoned and bound to an evil
necromancer against its will; there has been no bargain, no exchange, no
life-for-deed promises.  The wraith is a slave to the whim of the dark
witch it must now call mistress - in this case that will be Millicent
Soulforge.  Black iron fetters hang around the creature, clanking and
squeaking with every movement, binding it to the plane, enslaving its non-corporeal body.

name: a cadaverous ghoul
shortdesc: A cadaverous ghoul is here, chittering away to itself.
longdesc:
This pale ghoul looks like a normal human corpse come to life.  It is
bent almost double, squatting like an ape, it's long arms laying in what
looks like lifelessness under it.  But don't be fooled!  Ghouls are known
to be very fast and you can see that those very arms end in long, nasty-
looking claws!  Beware the ghoul, for they are known to paralyse!

name: a stony gargoyle
shortdesc: A gargoyle, its face frozen in a voiceless scream, stands here.
longdesc:
This gargoyle is a construction of stone and flesh, melded in
to a single, animated being.  Its face is forever contorted in
to a rictus of horror.

name: Millicent Soulforge
shortdesc: Millicent Soulforge is here, reclaiming her property.
longdesc:
Millicent Soulforge is a Duergar with a lot of ambition.  Malcontent with
the life of honest toil deep beneath a mountain, she left her own kind in
search of adventures and wonders.  Whatever paths her life took has lead
to her becoming a witch, a necromancer, a wizard, and a known ally of the
Drow.  Her skin is pale grey, almost deathly-white, and contrasts starkly
with her mane of thick, burnt-umber coloured hair.  Under her right eye
is a dark-red tattoo that is clearly Drow in origin - although what it
means is known only to the witch herself. She wears a low-cut traditional
black Duergar dress that comes down to the ground and is cinched at the
waist by a long silver chain.  About her shoulders is an old weather-worn
black shroud that she keeps fastened in place with a beautiful silver-
filigree spider.  Upon her head is an over-sized, wide-brimmed black hat
with a crooked point.  She carries an old ebony-staff adorned with bird
skulls in one lace-gloved hand and wields a cruel rust-flecked sickle in
the other.

name: a skeletal soldier
shortdesc: The animated remains of a long-dead soldier stands here.
longdesc:
This is the animated remains of a soldier who died long, long ago.  It is
still wearing it's plate armour and carries it's ancient weapon.  These
are the meat (so to speak) of an undead horde.  You will likely find many
of these puppet-like corpses near any necromancer.  This one is probably
dangerous as it obeys commands from the Duergar witch, Millicent
Soulforge.

name: a flesh beast
shortdesc: A beast made from human flesh stands here... Oozing.
longdesc:
This fearsome looking beast, with huge maw and three arms, is made up
entirely of human remains!  You can recognise an arm there - a leg over
there - and that must be a face!  Eww!  It is fast and deadly.

name: The Dragon Turtle
shortdesc: The colossal Dragon Turtle roars in anger here.
longdesc:
The Dragon Turtle looks like a distant relative to a dragon and is even
rumoured to have dragon blood.  This one is a huge turtle-like creature
with a long tail and neck, and large, taloned flippers.  Its head has a
golden crest running down the centre of it.  Its scales are large and
smooth and you can see several are missing in places - whether this be
from a natural molt or some more nefarious reasons it's not clear.  Most
striking of all on this huge creature is the shell - measuring roughly
twenty-five to thirty feet in diameter, it looks strong enough to turn
every weapon.  The shell is streamlined and has a series of jagged
protrusions that make it look more menacing than it already is.  The 
creature ranges in colour from pale, creamy pink on the underbelly to
deep, dark ochre on the shell, matching the lake of lava it thrives in.

name: Valek the Betrayer
shortdesc: Valek, the betrayer of Fortrum, stands here imbuing energies.
longdesc:
Valek - Ancient, wise, intelligent, and just.  At least, that is what used to
be said of the great priest of the Fortish green clan.  His once meticulously
cared for dragonscale clothing is gone, replaced by the dark red chitinous
armour of something far more rare, and more powerful.  His old clan emblem,
the three-leaf clover over the Fortish ale keg, has been defaced with a big,
red cross brand.  He looks far more powerful than he ever did at his peaceful
altar...

name: General Aodhan Sunblight
shortdesc: General Aodhan Sunblight is here, surveying the work of Valek.
longdesc:
General Aodhan Sunblight is a stocky, thickly-set Duergar with dark grey skin
and a shock of soft, snowy-white hair.  His white beard has been trimmed back
to the bristles, allowing the bright-red warpaint he wears like a blood-
spatter across the left hand side of his face to really stand out.  His eyes
are a bright golden colour with the tell-tale red-glow in the pupils that
reveals his natural infravision.  He wears the dark, angular armour of his
kind and carries an axe bigger than he is!

name: a Duergar Blockade Breaker
shortdesc: A sturdy Duergar Blockade breaker guards the passages here.
longdesc:
Dressed head to toe in spiky, evil-looking armour, Blockade Breakers are the
elite guards of the Duergar forces.  Rarely seen, these deep dwarfs are fully
capable of taking on dragons, ogres, and armies.  You won't be a problem!

name: a raging steam elemental
shortdesc: A steam elemental buffets and billows in rage here!
longdesc:
Formed from high-pressure steam in deep, volcanic conditions, this elemental
has clearly been abused by someone, or something.  Now it rages at everything
it can find, blasting all and sundry with red hot jets of steam.

name: a Duergar Darkforger
shortdesc: A masked and shielded Duergar Darkforger is here extracting something from the volcano.
longdesc:
Darkforgers are the elite engineers, smiths, and crafters of the hidden 
Duergar city of Morkrike.  They are not as skilled as the runesmiths of
Fortrum, but using cunning and stealth, they will steal ideas from others
and claim them as their own!  Crafty and clever, these dark fellows should
not be trifled with.

name: a Duergar Darkforger
shortdesc: A panicked Duergar Darkforger is here running from something!
longdesc:
Darkforgers are the elite engineers, smiths, and crafters of the hidden 
Duergar city of Morkrike.  They are not as skilled as the runesmiths of
Fortrum, but using cunning and stealth, they will steal ideas from others
and claim them as their own!  Crafty and clever, these dark fellows should
not be trifled with.

name: the Shadow of Ondeld
shortdesc: A shadowy visage of the Duergar God Ondeld wavers in the air here.
longdesc:
Ondeld is the dark God of the Duergar.  He commonly appears as a gigantic
column of fiery lava, ash, and flame, wielding his hammer Gnaddlefus.  This
is a shadowy visage of Ondeld - not the god in all His glory at all.  Even
so, it is a terrible sight to behold!

name: the mournful shade of Valek
shortdesc: The mournful shade of Valek is here, wailing at his mistakes.
longdesc:
This is the mournful shade of Valek.  In life he choose to betray his
peoples, and only in death did he realise he was duped!!  Now he has
risen as a vicious spirit of his former self, a being bent on revenge.
He will kill all who try to stop him!

name: Deepspeaker Bhaldor
shortdesc: The imposing form of Deepspeaker Bhaldor is here.
longdesc:
Deepspeaker Bhaldor is a giant of a Duergar, standing over six feet
tall with the same powerful build of the dark-Dwarfen race.  Deep-
speakers are revered amongst the Duergar, being skilled warriors and
clerics in their own rights, they are the explorers of the spaces
below the Underdark, where even Drow fear to tread.  They sing to the
caverns and hear the whispers of deep, lost worlds.  Of all the dark,
evil, members of the Duergar race to meet, a Deepspeaker should be
your most feared.  And why is Bhaldor here, so close to the surface...

name: a muscular rioting prisoner
shortdesc: A muscular prisoner is here, rioting.
longdesc:
This stocky, muscular prisoner is rioting in the Stockades of Midgard.
What set him off, what made him do this, are all questions that the
authorities are trying to answer.

name: a clever rioting captive
shortdesc: A clever captive is here, rioting
longdesc:
This human female looks to be very strong and lithe.  She is currently
engaged in a riot in the Stockades of Midgard.  Although, the whys and
wherefores of her actions are unknown.

name: a rioting dwarf inmate
shortdesc: A dwarf inmate is here, rioting
longdesc:
This dwarf looks to be strong, tough and capable of smashing any and
all breakables placed before him.  He is rioting in the Stockades of
Midgard, although why he doing so is a mystery.

name: an angry rioting convict
shortdesc: A large, angry convict is here, rioting.
longdesc:
With arms like tree trunks carrying two invisible carpets, you don't want
to get on the wrong side of this rioter!

name: a Stockades' guard
shortdesc: A Stockades' guard tries to stem the chaos!
longdesc:
Highly trained and skilled, the Stockades' guards are Shadow Guards
in the making.  These ones hold the stairs leading into and out of
the Stockades prison.  Which means, they'll probably try and stop
you getting out too!

name: a rioting insurgent
shortdesc: An insurgent rampages around the Stockades here.
longdesc: This insurgent is taking part in the riots gleefully.

name: a frothing convict
shortdesc: A convict is here, frothing at the mouth from a berserkers rage!
longdesc:
This convict has let himself get in to the spirit of the chaos with white-speckled
foam frothing at the corners of his mouth.

name: A shifty prisoner
shortdesc: A shifty prisoner watches the chaos with a sly smile.
longdesc:
This prisoner is watching the unfolding chaos with a sly smile, appraising
the situation for any opportunity to profit.

name: A dangerous captive
shortdesc: A dangerous captive skulks about, waiting for the trouble to come to him.
longdesc:
This captive is one of a number of captives found in prisons the world
over.  They are capable, dangerous and above all else, dangerous.

name: a crazed convict
shortdesc: A crazy convict goes wild here!
longdesc:
This convict is really getting in to the rioting season why ripped
clothing and feisty attitude.

name: a dwarf captive
shortdesc: A surly-looking dwarf is here, not enjoying the anarchy one bit.
longdesc: This dwarf doesn't look to be enjoying all the chaos and anarchy at all!

name: a laughing inmate
shortdesc: An inmate is here laughing at the chaos.
longdesc: This inmate it cheering and laughing at all the chaos around him.

name: an inmate anarchist
shortdesc: An inmate intend upon anarchy is here, rioting.
longdesc: This inmate is inciting more anarchy amongst her fellow captives!

name: Otto 'Cupid' Strangelove
shortdesc: Otto 'Cupid' Strangelove is here, following orders from the ringleader.
longdesc:
This is Otto Strangelove, AKA Cupid, one of the notorious love-struck
gang that terrorised Migardian citizens during the spring of '02.  He
has been imprisoned for over twenty years, but the time has not dulled
his wits or his strength.  Still a towering, bearded half-giant, he is
a fearsome and deadly foe, and for him to follow orders... Uh oh.

name: Dorian 'Blue-Eyes' Lovesong
shortdesc: Dorian 'Blue-Eyes' Lovesong sharpens a knife here.
longdesc:
This is Dorian.  He is a towering ogre covered in thick, leathery skin and
large, corded muscles.  He has a single horn protruding from the centre of
his forehead and, most importantly, his eyes are a piercing eye-blue that
bore in to you.  Intelligent, cunning, and with a streak of sadism to make
a Drow blush, he is the perfect lieutenant.

name: Bazel 'The Cheat' Creed
shortdesc: Bazel 'The Cheat' Creed is here, plotting.
longdesc:
Bazel is a long-term resident of the Stockades.  A half-orc of powerful
repute, he was caught trafficking in slaves in the underbelly of Midgard
over twenty years previously.  But he earned his nickname by cheating
all his customers in some way.  With a list of crimes longer than he can
recount, he is the perfect lieutenant to incite chaos and rioting.

name: Zorsha Misraria
shortdesc: The Drow Inquisitor Zorsha Misraria is here, holding a life-like human mask.
longdesc:
This is Zorsha Misraria, a powerful Inquisitor of the infamous Drow
House Misraria.  She is wearing the garb of a human female inmate and
holding a very life-like mask.  She has also retrieved her precious
tessen, the dark iron warfan, from the destroyed armoury.  She looks
intent upon harm...

name: Auruch Fel
shortdesc: Auruch Fel stands here, guarding his mistress, Zorsha Misraria.
longdesc:
This is Auruch Fel.  He, and he is most definitely very He, is a minotaur.  He
stands around nine-feet tall, has the head of a red-eyed and crazed bull, and
the torso of a powerfully built giant.  This creature seems bred for his task
and probably won't run when the going gets tough...

name: a crazed man
shortdesc: A crazed man runs around here in abject terror
longdesc:
This is Constable Crane, and he is crazed out of his mind.  He
wears the fine clothes of a local lord or dignitary, but it is
all in tatters, as if pulled and ripped by the foliage of the
forest.  He carries a shiny key which he seems to hold like a
precious treasure that must protect and mutters over and over,
'They mustn't let him out!  They mustn't!'

name: a Burning Effigy
shortdesc: A burning effigy stands here, laughing manically whilst wreathed in flames.
longdesc:
This horrible visage is (or was) a man that burns in a raging fire. 
Through the flames that engulf it you can make out a rounded head
that resembles the shape of a pumpkin and the sound of a manic,
mechanical laugh and words 'He comes!  He comes!  Don't lose your
heads!'.

name: Jack Skellington
shortdesc: The bony-figure of Jack Skellington is here, wielding his scythe as an agent of Death.
longdesc:
Jack Skellington is a 7-foot tall skeleton in a raggedy but fine
suit.  He wears neat little shoes and there is a withered black rose
boutonniere pinned to his lapel.  His smile, which stretches from
one side of his head to the other, gives him a jolly, almost manic
look.  However, that scythe he wields look freshly sharpened and is
like to cut one such as you down to size!

name: the Headless Horseman
shortdesc: The Headless Horseman is here, riding his flaming steed and wielding his sharp sword!
longdesc:
Before you stands the Headless Horseman.  And there are two things you should
know about the Headless Horseman... Firstly!  He is Headless!  And secondly...
Yes, you guessed it, he is a Horseman.  This disgraced knight turned against
his masters, pillaging and burning and taking heads for his own gratification.
He was cursed, and here he stands, without a head, riding his fel-steed in a
never-ending cycle of death, destruction and terror.  But you can end it all
right now!  Kill him!  Kill him before he takes YOUR head!

name: Sienna
shortdesc: Sienna the Maid is here, fretting.
longdesc:
Sienna is the maid to Constable Crane.  She frets about the place waiting
for the Constable to return, following her last order to keep the key to
the Ottoman safe at all times. 'Oh where can he be?!' she asks herself
over and over, worried sick after the Constable went mad and fled to the
woods.

name: a Pumpkin Soldier
shortdesc: A Pumpkin Soldier wanders around here on curly green roots.
longdesc:
This is a pumpkin soldier.  It's face looks like a grinning jack o'lantern
that glows with an inner, ruddy light.  It doesn't look that dangerous...
You wonder why it's a soldier...
